label: 'perfect' gold bar
title: 'perfect' gold bar
lead:
A 'perfect' gold bar is an untradeable gold bar smelted from 'perfect' gold ore. It is used in the Family Crest quest with a ruby and a necklace mould or ring mould to craft a 'perfect' necklace and 'perfect' ring respectively. It can be used as a normal gold bar when crafting any other item of jewellery, creating a normal piece of jewellery, which will not receive the prefix of 'perfect'.

Just like normal gold ore, two 'perfect' gold bars can be smelted at once at the Edgeville furnace if the appropriate tier of Varrock armour is worn.

label: 'perfect' gold ore
title: 'perfect' gold ore
lead:
'Perfect' gold ore is ore mined in the Witchaven Dungeon, found south-east of Ardougne. It requires 40 Mining to mine and can be smelted into a 'perfect' gold bar.

'Perfect' gold ore is the same as regular gold ore. The differences are only seen by Avan from Family Crest quest. He will say that he'll give you his piece of the crest if you make him a necklace and ring made from a 'perfect gold bar' with rubies in them.

label: 'perfect' necklace
title: 'perfect' necklace
lead:
A ' perfect' necklace is a quest item in the Family Crest quest. It is made with a 'perfect' gold bar, ruby, and necklace mould at a furnace, requiring 40 Crafting and yielding 75 Crafting experience. A 'perfect' necklace and 'perfect' ring are given to Avan in exchange for his crest part.

It is possible to mine 'perfect' gold and craft 'perfect' jewellery without speaking to Boot, but he must be spoken to in order to give the jewellery to Avan.

label: 'perfect' ring
title: 'perfect' ring
lead:
A 'perfect' ring is a quest item in the Family Crest quest. It is made with a 'perfect' gold bar, ruby, and ring mould at a furnace, requiring 40 Crafting and yielding 70 Crafting experience. A 'perfect' ring and 'perfect' necklace are given to Avan in exchange for his crest part.

It is possible to mine 'perfect' gold and craft 'perfect' jewellery without speaking to Boot, but he must be spoken to in order to give the jewellery to Avan.

label: A scribbled note
title: A scribbled note
lead: A scribbled note is an item obtained while searching the table in the Shaman Caves during Legends' Quest. It cannot be reobtained after completing the quest.

label: A scruffy note
title: A scruffy note
lead:
A scruffy note is a quest item used only in Plague City. It is obtained from Bravek after the player asks how to cure a hangover, but it is difficult to read.

The note is not required to learn how to make hangover cure and can be dropped at any time. Players may make a hangover cure even before obtaining the note.

label: A small key
title: A small key
lead:
A small key is a quest item used only in the Plague City quest. It is found by searching the barrel on the of the plague house where Elena is being held. The house can only be accessed while holding a warrant that is obtained from Bravek.

It is used to open Elena's cell in the basement of the plague house.

label: A stone bowl
title: A stone bowl
lead:
A stone bowl is a quest item used only in Elemental Workshop I. It is found by searching the boxes north-east of the hatch in the Elemental Workshop.

It is used to make a stone bowl filled with lava from a lava trough. The full stone bowl is then used on the furnace to heat it up.

label: A used spell
title: A used spell
lead: A used spell is one of the results of using the druidic spell given to the player by Filliman Tarlock during the Nature Spirit quest. When the player uses the druidic spell to cast Bloom, it turns into a used spell. This item must later be used on the grey stone outside of the nature spirit's grotto to progress in the quest.

label: A wooden log
title: A wooden log
lead: A wooden log is an Agility shortcut found west of the Shipyard (Karamja) near a broken gnome glider.

label: A'abla
title: A'abla
lead: A'abla is a nurse, alongside Sabreen, in the Emir's Arena hospital. She heals the player for 20% of their total Hitpoints plus 2, but does not cure poison.

label: Aaron's Archery Appendages.
title: Aaron's Archery Appendages.
lead: Aaron's Archery Appendages is a shop where Aaron the Armour salesman sells low level ranged armour. Aaron also sells the Ranged Cape of Accomplishment. His shop is located in the Ranging Guild, so it can only be accessed by players with at least level 40 Ranged.

label: Abbot Langley
title: Abbot Langley
lead:
Abbot Langley is the head of the Edgeville Monastery in northern Asgarnia. He prevents players with less than 31 Prayer from entering the guild (this cannot be boosted in any way). He can restore 4 + 12% of the player's hitpoints if they are injured.

He can also attach a sigil to a blessed spirit shield for a fee of 1,500,000 coins, as well as remove sigils from them, though this destroys the blessed spirit shield; this is usually done to the arcane spirit shield in order to use the sigil to fortify Elidinis' ward.

label: Achey Tree
title: Achey Tree
lead: Achey Trees are uncommon lumber trees that require level 1 Woodcutting to chop, providing 25 Woodcutting experience per set of achey tree logs received. Achey trees are near exclusively cut to obtain achey tree logs, for the purpose of creating Ogre arrows and Brutal arrows. These arrows are required in the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest and optional in the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest.

label: Achey tree logs
title: Achey tree logs
lead:
Achey logs are logs only available to members. They can be obtained at level 1 Woodcutting from Achey trees for 25 experience each. Players can burn these logs at level 1 Firemaking for 40 experience each.

These logs are needed for the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest to make ogre arrows, as well as composite ogre bows for Zogre Flesh Eaters.

label: Achey Tree stump
title: Achey Tree stump
lead: An Achey Tree stump appears when an Achey Tree is cut down. After a period of time between 35.4 - 58.8 seconds the tree will grow back.

label: Achietties
title: Achietties
lead:
Achietties is the guard and chancellor of the Heroes' Guild, between Burthorpe and Taverley, standing outside the guild's front door. She is the starting and finishing point of the Heroes' Quest. After the quest is complete, she allows players to enter the guild. She wears steel armour and a grey headband.

When spoken to outside of the guild, Achietties gives the player information about the Heroes' Quest, including the requirements. She later makes an appearance in Dragon Slayer II.

label: Adamant 2h sword
title: Adamant 2h sword
lead:
The adamant 2h sword is a two-handed sword that requires 30 Attack to wield. As with other two-handed weapons, a shield may not be equipped while wielding one.

Players may smith one at level 84 Smithing with 3 adamantite bars for 187.5 Smithing experience.

id: category:items needed for an emote clue
label: Items needed for an emote clue
Adamant arrow
title: Adamant arrow
lead:
Adamant arrows are stronger than mithril arrows, and can be used by any standard bow of maple or stronger. They can be made at level 60 Fletching by using 15 adamant arrowtips on 15 headless arrows, granting 150 Fletching experience. As with most arrows, they can be poisoned.

They are the best arrows available to free-to-play players.

label: Adamant arrowtips
title: Adamant arrowtips
lead:
Adamant arrowtips are made with an adamant bar requiring 75 Smithing, yielding 62.5 Smithing experience and 15 adamant arrowtips. They are made into adamant arrows when used with headless arrows, requiring 60 Fletching, yielding 150 experience per 15 arrows.

They are purchased for coins at the ranging shops: Hickton's Archery Emporium in Catherby, Dargaud's Bow and Arrows in the Ranging Guild, and Void Knight Archery Store at the Void Knights' Outpost.

label: adamant axe
title: adamant axe
lead:
An adamant axe is a one-handed axe requiring 30 Attack to wield and 31 Woodcutting to use to cut trees. Making one requires 1 adamant bar and 71 Smithing, yielding 62.5 Smithing experience. As with all axes, it can be used to cut trees even when in the player's inventory.

The success rate for getting a set of logs is approximately 300% that of a bronze axe and 20% better than a mithril axe.

label: Adamant axe head
title: Adamant axe head
lead:
The adamant axe head is an unobtainable item that was originally used in the axe handle random event. The axe head would become detached from the player's axe while Woodcutting. To fix their axe, players had to collect the axe head off the ground and reattach it to the axe handle.

A similar event used to happen to players while Mining, but with a pickaxe head and pickaxe handle.

id: category:pages using information from game apis or cache
label: Pages using information from game APIs or cache
adamant battleaxe
title: adamant battleaxe
lead:
The adamant battleaxe is a battleaxe that is stronger than a mithril battleaxe, but weaker than a rune battleaxe. Like most adamant weapons, 30 Attack is required in order to wield it.

Players are able to obtain adamant battleaxes via trading with players, monster drops, or purchasing it at Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar (located in Port Sarim). It may also be a reward from a clue scroll. At level 80 Smithing, players can use 3 adamant bars to smith an adamant battleaxe, granting 187.5 experience.

label: Adamant chainbody
title: Adamant chainbody
lead: Adamant chainbody is piece of armour made from adamantite. A player can create an adamant chainbody by using an adamantite bar on an anvil while a hammer and 3 adamantite bars are in the player's inventory. A Smithing level of 81 is required to make an adamant chainbody and doing so will grant the player 187.5 Smithing experience. Level 30 Defence is required to wear an adamant chainbody. It can also be bought from Wayne's Chains in south Falador. One adamant chainbody is required for Song of the Elves.

label: Adamant claws
title: Adamant claws
lead: Adamant claws are a two-handed melee weapon. They can be made with two adamantite bars and a hammer at any anvil granting 125 Smithing experience. They can only be made by players who have completed the Death Plateau quest and have a Smithing level of at least 83. They have an Attack requirement of 30 to wield. They are not a very popular weapon due to the fact they require 2 hands to wield and provide inferior stats to that of the adamant scimitar.

label: Adamant dagger
title: Adamant dagger
lead: The adamant dagger is a dagger made of adamantite. It can be created by using one Adamant bar and a hammer on an anvil at level 70 Smithing, granting 62.5 Smithing experience. As with most daggers, it can be poisoned.

label: Adamant dart
title: Adamant dart
lead:
Adamant darts are Ranged throwing weapons. To wield the player must have at least 30 Ranged. They can be obtained by either using the Smithing and Fletching skills or trading with another player. Adamant darts can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

To make adamant darts, the player must have completed the Tourist Trap quest and have at least 74 Smithing and 67 Fletching. Each adamant bar will create 10 adamant dart tips and the player will receive 62.5 Smithing experience. When feathers are added the player will receive 10 adamant darts and 15 Fletching experience per adamant dart.

label: Adamant dart tip
title: Adamant dart tip
lead:
Adamant dart tip is an item that can be created at level 74 Smithing. It grants 62.5 Smithing experience upon making and requires one adamantite bar to make 10 adamant dart tips. They can be fletched into adamant darts at level 67 Fletching when used with feathers, granting 150 Fletching experience per 10 darts made.

To smith darts, one must complete the Tourist Trap quest.

label: Adamant fire arrow
title: Adamant fire arrow
lead:
Adamant fire arrows are adamant arrows wrapped in an oily cloth, which are then lit by using them on a tinderbox. They, along with any other fire arrow, are primarily used to pierce the rope in the Underground Pass to lower the bridge so that a player may walk across.

They have the same Ranged Strength as regular adamant arrows.

label: Adamant full helm
title: Adamant full helm
lead: An adamant full helm is a full helmet made out of adamant. It can be worn with at least level 30 in Defence and can be smithed with at least level 77 Smithing using 2 adamantite bars (this grants 125 Smithing experience). These helms are stronger than mithril full helms but weaker than rune full helms.

label: Adamant full helm (g)
title: Adamant full helm (g)
lead: Adamant full helm (g) is a part of adamant gold-trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Adamant full helm, and requires level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

id: category:items storable in the costume room
label: Items storable in the costume room
Adamant full helm (t)
title: Adamant full helm (t)
lead: Adamant full helm (t) is a part of adamant trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Adamant full helm, and requires level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant javelin
title: Adamant javelin
lead:
The adamant javelin is a type of member's only Ranged ammunition used by the light and heavy ballistas. As with most javelins, they can be poisoned.

They can be fletched by attaching adamant javelin tips to javelin shafts at level 62 Fletching, granting 150 experience per 15 javelins made. They can also be obtained by buying them from the Ranging Guild, the Void Knight Archery Store or from Oobapohk's Javelin Store after Monkey Madness II.

label: Adamant kiteshield
title: Adamant kiteshield
lead: The Adamant kiteshield is the second-best smithable kiteshield, requiring 30 Defence to wield. A player with 82 Smithing can make the shield by using three adamantite bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 187.5 Smithing experience.

label: Adamant kiteshield (g)
title: Adamant kiteshield (g)
lead: Adamant kiteshield (g) is a part of adamant gold-trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Adamant kiteshield, except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant kiteshield (t)
title: Adamant kiteshield (t)
lead: Adamant kiteshield (t) is a part of adamant trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Adamant kiteshield, except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant knife
title: Adamant knife
lead:
The adamant knife is a throwing knife that requires a Ranged level of 30 to wield. It is stronger than a mithril knife but weaker than a rune knife. To create adamant knives, the player must have at least 77 Smithing. Each adamant bar will create 5 adamant knives and give the player 62.5 Smithing experience. They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Throwing knives are among the fastest weapons in the game (along with darts), and are commonly used for PKing or training Ranged.

label: Adamant longsword
title: Adamant longsword
lead: The adamant longsword is a longsword that is stronger than the Mithril longsword, but weaker than the Rune longsword. Like all other adamant weapons, it requires 30 Attack to wield. Players can make an adamant longsword with 76 Smithing using 2 adamantite bars, granting 125 experience. It can be bought from the Varrock Swordshop for 3,200 coins.

label: Adamant mace
title: Adamant mace
lead: An adamant mace is a mace that requires level 30 Attack to wield. Players can make an adamant mace with the Smithing skill at level 72 using 1 Adamant bar, giving 62.5 Smithing experience. Players can purchase this mace from Flynn's Mace Market in Falador or the weapons shop in the Warriors' Guild, and is also dropped by Twisted Banshees.

label: Adamant med helm
title: Adamant med helm
lead:
The adamant med helm is a medium helmet made of adamantite. This helm requires 30 Defence to wear. It provides more protection than its mithril counterpart. It can be made at level 73 Smithing using an adamantite bar, granting 62.5 experience.

Though the helmet provides a smaller Defence bonus than that of an adamant full helm, it has a lower penalty to Magic and Ranged attack. This means it is potentially more useful than the full helm to players who are training the Magic skill.

label: Adamant pick head
title: Adamant pick head
lead:
An adamant pick head was obtained as part of a discontinued random event, in which the adamant pickaxe head flew off the handle while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle.

If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another.

label: Adamant pickaxe
title: Adamant pickaxe
lead:
The adamant pickaxe is a pickaxe that is stronger than the mithril pickaxe, but weaker than the rune pickaxe. It requires an Attack level of 30 to wield, and a Mining level of 31 to mine with.

The adamant pickaxe mines on a 4-tick cycle, unlike other pickaxes. This allows it to be used for tick manipulation in various places, such as mining shooting stars.

label: Adamant platebody
title: Adamant platebody
lead:
The adamant platebody is an armour used in melee with stat bonuses between mithril and rune. It requires 30 Defence to equip and provides greater protection than an adamant chainbody. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's Ranged and Magic stats.

Players with level 88 Smithing can make one by using 5 adamantite bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 312.5 experience.

label: Adamant platebody (g)
title: Adamant platebody (g)
lead: Adamant platebody (g) is a part of adamant gold-trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Adamant platebody, and requires level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant platebody (t)
title: Adamant platebody (t)
lead: Adamant platebody (t) is a part of adamant trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Adamant platebody, and requires level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant platelegs
title: Adamant platelegs
lead:
Adamant platelegs are platelegs made of Adamant and, as such, require a Defence level of 30 to wear. These platelegs have the same stats as the Adamant plateskirt, but are 1kg heavier.

Adamant platelegs can be smithed using 3 adamant bars at level 86 Smithing, granting 187.5 experience.

label: Adamant platelegs (g)
title: Adamant platelegs (g)
lead: Adamant platelegs (g) is a part of adamant gold-trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. They have the same stats as regular Adamant platelegs, and require level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant platelegs (t)
title: Adamant platelegs (t)
lead: Adamant platelegs (t) is a part of adamant trimmed armour and a reward from medium Treasure Trails. They have the same stats as regular Adamant platelegs, and require level 30 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Adamant plateskirt
title: Adamant plateskirt
lead:
The Adamant plateskirt is a plateskirt made out of adamant. At least 30 Defence is required to wear it. The plateskirt has the same stats as the Adamant platelegs, but are 1kg lighter.

They can be made at level 86 Smithing using 3 adamantite bars, which grants 187.5 experience.

label: Adamant scimitar
title: Adamant scimitar
lead:
The adamant scimitar is the fourth strongest scimitar in the game, behind rune, gilded and dragon. Like most adamant weapons, it requires to wield.

Players can make it with using two adamantite bars, earning 125 experience. The scimitar can also be obtained from killing monsters, and is a reward from the quest The Feud.

label: Adamant spear
title: Adamant spear
lead: The adamant spear is a two-handed members'-only melee weapon requiring 30 Attack to wield. It can be bought from the Mount Karuulm Weapon Shop or Fortis Blacksmith, or obtained as a drop from monsters. Using the Smithing skill, players can create adamant spears with level 75 Smithing This requires 1 adamantite bar and 1 yew log. However, players must have begun Barbarian Smithing training to be able to smith these spears. Like most spears, the adamant spear can be poisoned. Smithing an adamant spear at the anvil at Otto's Grotto is a requirement for the Kandarin Hard Diary.

label: Adamant sq shield
title: Adamant sq shield
lead: Adamant square shields are the third-strongest square shields, requiring 30 Defence to wield. A player with level 78 Smithing can make the shield by using two adamant bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 125 Smithing experience.

label: Adamant sword
title: Adamant sword
lead:
The adamant sword is the second-strongest sword available to free players, after the rune sword. As with most adamant weapons, level 30 Attack is required to wield it.

Adamant swords can be created at level 74 Smithing. One adamant bar is required to make the sword, and 62.5 Smithing experience is rewarded per sword created.

label: Adamant thrownaxe
title: Adamant thrownaxe
lead: The adamant thrownaxe is the third strongest type of throwing axe, requiring level 30 Ranged to wield. They can be obtained by buying them from the Tribal Weapon Salesman in the Ranging Guild.

label: adamant warhammer
title: adamant warhammer
lead:
The adamant warhammer is a warhammer stronger than the mithril warhammer. Unlike other adamant weapons, it requires 30 Strength to wield. They are the fourth-strongest warhammers for all players. Players can make them using the Smithing skill at level 79 using 3 adamantite bars, giving the player 187.5 Smithing experience.

The adamant warhammer can be used as a substitute for a regular hammer when banging the big door at the entrance of Bandos' Stronghold in the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Adamantite bar
title: Adamantite bar
lead: Adamantite bars can be smelted with 6 coal and 1 adamantite ore at level 70 Smithing. Smelting the bar grants 37.5 Smithing experience, and any item that is smithed from adamantite bars grants 62.5 Smithing experience per bar, yielding a net of 100 experience.

label: adamantite ore
title: adamantite ore
lead:
Adamantite ore can be mined at level 70 Mining providing 95 Mining experience. After adamantite rocks are mined, it will take four minutes until it reappears. Adamantite ore is used with six coal to smelt adamantite bars. Smelting an adamantite bar gives 37.5 Smithing experience.

Wearing either superior mining gloves or expert mining gloves while mining an adamantite rock makes the rock not deplete upon mining adamantite, allowing you to mine one or two additional ore, respectively, before depleting.

label: adamantite rocks
title: adamantite rocks
lead:
Adamantite rocks are a rock containing adamantite. A player with a Mining level of 70 or higher can mine adamantite ore from adamantite rocks. Each rock grants 95 Mining experience for each ore mined. After being mined, an adamantite rock takes 4 minutes to respawn, or two minutes within the Mining Guild. Players may want to employ a world switch tactic due to the scarcity of available ore.

Wearing superior mining gloves or expert mining gloves makes the rock not deplete upon mining adamantite, allowing you to mine one (with superior gloves) or two (with expert gloves) additional ore before depleting.

label: Address label
title: Address label
lead:
The address label is an item used during Tribal Totem. Players can obtain it by searching the double-stacked crates south-east of the southernmost bank in East Ardougne in the GPDT Depot.

The player must then use the label on the teleport block created by Wizard Cromperty so that it is delivered to Lord Handelmort's Mansion, after which the player can teleport into his house to continue the quest.

label: Adventure
title: Adventure
lead:
Adventure is a music track that can be unlocked inside Varrock city walls, excluding the Grand Exchange. It also plays in the Phoenix Gang Hideout and in the basement of the Blue Moon Inn. Within this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Garden, Medieval, and Spirit.

In Classic mode, this track plays in Varrock Palace.

label: Adventurers' Camp (Lumbridge Swamp)
title: Adventurers' Camp (Lumbridge Swamp)
lead: The Adventurers' Camp (Lumbridge Swamp) is a small camp located at the threshold between the forest and the swamp between Draynor Village and Lumbridge and north of Father Urhney's house. It has a monk, wizard, archer, and warrior. The monk, wizard, and archer will not talk to the player much, but talking to the warrior will clumsily reveal their intentions to find Zanaris and start the Lost City quest.

label: Aemad
title: Aemad
lead:
Aemad runs Aemad's Adventuring Supplies. together with Kortan in East Ardougne. His store can be found south of the church and north of the Ardougne Zoo.

His store acts like a general store, even though it sells some unique items, like papyrus and cooked meat, but it does not sell common staples seen in other stores such as bowls.

label: Aemad's Adventuring Supplies.
title: Aemad's Adventuring Supplies.
lead:
Aemad's Adventuring Supplies is a general store in East Ardougne. The store is run by its owner, Aemad, and his assistant, Kortan. Although it does not sell the default items of a typical general store, it sells several items used in quests around RuneScape, notably rope.

Two nearby banks (Ardougne north bank and Ardougne south bank) make this general store useful for buying and banking vials of water. The Ardougne Market is also nearby, making this store handy for selling items stolen from stalls.

label: Afrah
title: Afrah
lead: Afrah is one of the people observing the fights at the Emir's Arena. She can be found at the south-easternmost corner of the walls.

label: Aggie
title: Aggie
lead:
Aggie is a witch that resides in Draynor Village. She sells dyes if the player provides her with the ingredients. Players can use ingredients directly on Aggie to save going through three parts of dialogue.

If the player insults her, she will take either 5 or 20 coins from them (depending on how many coins are in their inventory). Should the player not have coins, but instead a pot of flour, she will take that instead.

label: Agility
title: Agility
lead:
Agility is a members-only skill which gives access to various shortcuts around Gielinor. Other benefits of the skill include faster run energy restoration, slower run energy dissipation while running, and the ability to wear weight-saving outfits like the graceful outfit, as well as wield certain tools and weaponry. Note that the passive benefits of faster energy restore and lower run energy drain rate also apply in free-to-play worlds.

__TOC__

label: Agility arena ticket (discontinued)
title: Agility arena ticket (discontinued)
lead:
Agility arena tickets were earned from tagging ticket dispensers within the Brimhaven Agility Arena minigame. Each ticket was rewarded after tagging more than one dispenser in a row. Tickets could then be redeemed for Agility experience and rewards from the Brimhaven Agility Arena Ticket Exchange run by Pirate Jackie the Fruit.

Exchanging larger amounts of tickets for Agility experience offered experience bonuses, up to 33% more per ticket. Wearing Karamja Gloves 2 or higher from completing the medium Karamja Diary when exchanging tickets rewarded 10% more total experience. Completing the elite Karamja Diary rewarded a 10% chance of receiving double tickets when tagging a pillar. The experience rewards increased by 5 per ticket for each Agility level above 40.

label: Agility Level Up!
title: Agility Level Up!
lead: Agility Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Agility.

label: Agility potion
title: Agility potion
lead:
Agility potions are made by mixing toadflax into a vial of water, creating a Toadflax potion (unf), and then adding toad's legs. This requires level 34 Herblore, and grants 80 Herblore experience. Agility potions temporarily raise your Agility by 3.

A 4-dose agility potion is required for Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. Ironmen who want to complete the quest but do not have the Herblore requirement can have an irit leaf cleaned by Zahur in Nardah (for 200 coins), then wait for the Dr Jekyll random event, for which he will trade the irit leaf for a 4-dose agility potion. Alternatively, level 40, 63, 72, and 77 skeletons in Tarn's Lair as well as the level 77 skeletons nearby the entrance to the Ruins of Ullek can drop 2-dose agility potions, which can be decanted into a 4-dose potion.

id: category:items storable in the potion storage
label: Items storable in the potion storage
Ah Za Rhoon
title: Ah Za Rhoon
lead: Ah Za Rhoon, which means Magnificence Floating on Water in an ancient language, was an ancient temple in Karamja that was built by Zadimus and destroyed by Rashiliyia. After being lost for many years, the temple became a legend, making many doubt its existence. This temple is visited during the Shilo Village quest.

label: Air Altar
title: Air Altar
lead:
The Air Altar is a runic altar upon which air runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 5 Runecraft experience per essence imbued.

Players may create an air tiara here by using either an air talisman or tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 25 Runecraft experience. An elemental tiara can also be created here by using an elemental talisman and gold tiara, granting 40 Runecraft experience.

label: Air battlestaff
title: Air battlestaff
lead:
The air battlestaff is an elemental staff requiring 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of air runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created at level 66 Crafting by combining an air orb and battlestaff. It can also be upgraded to a mystic air staff by paying Thormac 40,000 coins to upgrade it (less with the completion of certain Kandarin Diaries). The mystic air staff is an even stronger alternative, providing better melee and magic stat bonuses.

label: Air elemental
title: Air elemental
lead:
Air elementals are encountered during the Elemental Workshop I quest. It should be noted that players do not actually have to kill any air elementals to complete Elemental Workshop I.

Killing one is a requirement for an Easy Kandarin Diary task.

label: Air orb
title: Air orb
lead:
An air orb is a glass orb that has been charged at the Obelisk of Air by using the Charge Air Orb spell, requiring 66 Magic, on the obelisk. The spell requires an unpowered orb, 30 air runes, and 3 cosmic runes, yielding 76 Magic experience. The Air Obelisk is located in level 7 Wilderness, north of Edgeville. To get there, climb the ladder north of the black demons in Edgeville Dungeon.

An air orb can be used on a battlestaff, requiring 66 Crafting, yielding an air battlestaff and 137.5 Crafting experience. Charging air orbs is also a hard Wilderness Diary task.

label: Air rune
title: Air rune
lead:
Air runes are one of the four elemental runes. They are used in every combat spell and most teleportation spells in the standard spellbook, as well as in many spells from other spellbooks. Because they are used very often, players are recommended to purchase an item that can provide infinite air runes while equipped, such as a staff of air.

A common way for beginning players to obtain air runes is to talk to the magic tutor in Lumbridge. She will give you 30 air and mind runes if you don't have any in your inventory or bank. Air runes or packs can be bought from Magic shops, such as Aubury's Rune Shop in Varrock. Non-ironman players can also purchase them from the Nightmare Zone using 25 reward points.

label: Air talisman
title: Air talisman
lead:
The air talisman is a talisman that allows players to enter the Air Altar. At the altar, the player can use the Runecraft skill to turn rune essence or pure essence into air runes.

Also at the Air Altar, an air talisman can be combined with a silver tiara to make an air tiara for 25 Runecraft experience by using the tiara on the altar while having an air talisman in the inventory. This consumes the talisman, but the air tiara can be used the same as an air talisman and can be worn, opening an inventory slot to carry another essence.

label: Al Kharid
title: Al Kharid
lead:
Al Kharid is a city in the north of the Kharidian Desert. It is the only desert city open to non-members, and players in the city do not suffer from the desert effect. Al Kharid is ruled by the Emir, although the vast majority of the work has been taken over by Chancellor Hassan since the Emir's son was kidnapped.

Al Kharid contains one of the closest banks to a range as well as two reasonably close fishing spots. It also houses a tanner, Ellis. In free-to-play, Al Kharid's furnace is the second-closest to a bank, after Edgeville's furnace.

label: Al Kharid (music track)
title: Al Kharid (music track)
lead:
Al Kharid is a music track that is unlocked in Al Kharid, at the Al Kharid mine and the Giants' Plateau. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Arabian, and Arabian 2.

In Classic mode, the track plays in Al Kharid, and the west of the Giants' Plateau.

label: Al Kharid bank
title: Al Kharid bank
lead:
The Al Kharid bank is a bank in western Al Kharid, immediately west of the Al Kharid Palace. The bank is frequently used by free-to-play players while tanning hides or trading. It was added to RuneScape alongside the Catherby bank.

While the bank has no upper level, the roof of the bank is part of the Al Kharid rooftop Agility course.

label: Al Kharid General Store
title: Al Kharid General Store
lead:
The Al Kharid General Store is a general store located in the desert town of Al Kharid.

It mainly stocks the normal general store items. However, many players train their Crafting nearby, because of the crafting store and Tanner that are also in Al Kharid, which often leads to great amounts of leather items, most often hardleather bodies, in the player stock of the store. Silk cannot be sold to this general store.

label: Al Kharid mine
title: Al Kharid mine
lead:
The Al Kharid mine (also called Scorpion mine) is a Mining area located just north of the desert city of Al Kharid.

The mine is advantageous because it is near a bank and a furnace and is located in a very low-risk location for its high-value infrequent rocks, such as gold, mithril, and adamantite. In addition, this mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining.

label: Al Kharid Palace
title: Al Kharid Palace
lead:
The Al Kharid Palace is the southernmost and largest building in the city of Al Kharid, and it is the residence of the Emir and the seat of government for the emirate of Al Kharid. Hassan, the Emir's chancellor, is present in the palace's throne room and features in the Prince Ali Rescue quest. Osman, the emirate's spymaster, is found wandering outside the palace. Members can use an amulet of glory to teleport inside the palace, on the in the southern room.

The palace is primarily important in Prince Ali Rescue. There are several guards that spawn within the palace in the multicombat area, and they can be attacked or pickpocketed, but when one guard is attacked, the others will attempt to attack you as well.

label: Al Kharid warrior
title: Al Kharid warrior
lead:
Al Kharid warriors are guards of Al Kharid found in the palace. When one warrior is attacked, the others will attempt to attack you as well. For Free-to-play and low level players, they are a great place to train Attack, Strength, and Defence, as Al Kharid warriors have high Hitpoints but a low combat level.

Level 25 Thieving is required to pickpocket these warriors. It is very easy to trap an Al Kharid warrior between objects such as beds or tables, immobilising him.

label: Al Shabim
title: Al Shabim
lead:
Al Shabim is the enigmatic leader of the Bedabin Nomads, a tribe of wandering nomadic people who settle down in different areas when they have exhausted the natural resources around their current camp. Shabim can be found in the larger of their two tents in their camp, south of the oasis.

He is involved with The Tourist Trap quest, in which the players must make a bargain with him to obtain a Tenti pineapple, which are prized by many people in the desert for their succulency. For the pineapple, Al Shabim asks you to steal weapon plans from the Desert Mining Camp, which turn out to be plans to make a deadly throwing dart. He asks you to make a prototype and gives you permission to use the anvils in the north tent of their camp, after which he will give you the pineapple needed for the quest.

label: Alfonse the waiter
title: Alfonse the waiter
lead: Alfonse the waiter runs The Shrimp and Parrot in Brimhaven which sells food. He is a member of the Phoenix Gang and will help the player during the Heroes' Quest if they are in the gang. He also sells fish including cooked karambwan. Alfonse is quite well-mannered. This is odd for a resident of Brimhaven, known for its population of pirates and thieves.

label: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
title: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
lead: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl is a miniquest that is required to be completed in order to gain access to the Horror from the Deep and Scorpion Catcher quests, and access to the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course, where it is considered a "rite of passage". To complete it, you must trek around various bars and pubs in Old School RuneScape, drinking a specialty drink, having them sign off a supplied Barcrawl card. The miniquest is notable for granting the ability to automatically smash vials on drinking the last dose of a potion.

label: Almera
title: Almera
lead:
Almera is located in a house south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the Baxtorian Falls. She is the starting point for the Waterfall Quest and has a son named Hudon.

She will send the player to check on her son, who is looking for treasure in the river behind the house.

label: Alomone
title: Alomone
lead:
Alomone is the leader of the Cult of Hazeel, a group dedicated to the revival of the Zamorakian mahjarrat Hazeel.

The cult stole a set of armour from Ceril Carnillean then broke in four more times in search of the scroll required to revive Hazeel, but failed each time. In Hazeel Cult, Ceril commissions the player to retrieve the armour, pointing them to the cult's lair in the sewers.

label: Alone
title: Alone
lead:
Alone is a music track unlocked at Ice Mountain, or in the Clock Tower dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays in a wider area around the Ice Mountain, as well as the Edgeville Monastery, as described in the first map with obvious square-like borders (not the next one) in case its caption is not visible.

label: Alrena
title: Alrena
lead:
Alrena is a citizen of East Ardougne, the wife of Edmond, and the mother of Elena. She lives north of the Flying Horse Inn.

She plays a part in the Plague City quest, helping the player attempt to locate Elena, and offering the player the gas mask if they bring her dwellberries. If the player has lost the gas mask, it can be retrieved in the cupboard.

label: Altar (Edgeville Monastery)
title: Altar (Edgeville Monastery)
lead: The Altar in the Edgeville Monastery is one of the many altars dedicated to Saradomin. Praying at this altar recharges prayer points, and gives 2 extra prayer points. A prayer level of 31 is required to reach the altar.

label: Altar (Saradomin)
title: Altar (Saradomin)
lead: An Altar dedicated to Saradomin can be found in many places across Gielinor. These altars can all be used to recharge prayer points.

label: Altar (The Restless Ghost)
title: Altar (The Restless Ghost)
lead:
The Altar in the Wizards' Tower basement is searched during The Restless Ghost quest.

When players have progressed far enough in the quest, searching the altar will give a Ghost's skull and awaken a level 13 skeleton. Otherwise, searching it will give the message "That skull looks scary. I've got no reason to take it, I think I'll leave it alone."

label: Altar of Guthix
title: Altar of Guthix
lead:
The Altar of Guthix is the centerpiece of the stone circle at Taverley. As this is the last surviving circle under Guthixian control, it is incredibly important to the druidic order. The altar is overseen primarily by Kaqemeex, an important druid within Taverley.

Every year during the summer, the druids get together to perform a ritual to Guthix, which helps maintain balance and protect nature from evil, corrupting spirits. This involves making offerings to the altar, which the player could help complete the ritual by figuring out the correct offering during the 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017 Midsummer events.

label: Altar of nature
title: Altar of nature
lead:
The Altar of nature in the Nature Grotto is repaired during the Nature Spirit quest. Praying at the altar restores prayer points, and gives 2 extra points.

During the quest, an adventurer helps Filliman in becoming a Nature Spirit. The spirit then heals the grotto.

label: altar slab
title: altar slab
lead: The altar slab can be found in south-east Varrock next to the Chaos Altar there, as well as in the chaos druids' alcove and near the monks of Zamorak in the Taverley Dungeon. Using any item on the altar slab gives the message "You don't want to think about what's been on there!"

label: Aluft Gianne
title: Aluft Gianne
lead:
Aluft Gianne was the original owner of the Gnome Restaurant business in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. He offered a small tutorial on Gnome cooking, which allowed players to make gnome food, and sold premade versions of the food in Gianne's Restaurant. Afterwards, he would hire the player to cook specific foods for him, offering Coins and Cooking experience as a reward.

In 2006 the Gnome Restaurant was improved and expanded, changing the way in which the food is prepared and having the deliveries be made to clients instead. Aluft Gianne was split into two new characters, Aluft Gianne snr. and Gianne jnr. As a result, he has never been present in Old School RuneScape, although the character of Aluft Gianne snr. is very similar.

label: Ambient Jungle
title: Ambient Jungle
lead:
Ambient Jungle is a music track that is unlocked inside Shilo Village. It also plays in the underground area of the Shilo Village mine. Interestingly, although the 2024 update to its unlock area reduced the amount of area outside of the village walls, there are still some individual tiles where the track can be unlocked outside of the village gates. One such place is the southern banks of the river, on the western side of the village.

In Classic mode, a section of area outside the border of Shilo Village also plays this track.

label: Ammo mould
title: Ammo mould
lead:
An ammo mould is a quest item used in Dwarf Cannon. It is obtained from Nulodion after speaking to Captain Lawgof after repairing his broken dwarf multicannon. Additional moulds can be purchased from Nulodion's Multicannon parts for sale store for .

It is given to Captain Lawgof alongside Nulodion's notes to complete the quest. It is also used to smith cannonballs with metal bars at a furnace to make 4 cannonballs per bar.

label: ammonium nitrate
title: ammonium nitrate
lead:
Ammonium nitrate is a quest item. It is used in The Dig Site quest along with nitroglycerin, ground charcoal, and arcenia root to make a chemical compound.

It is obtained by using the chest key to open the chest near the panning point, and is brought to Terry Balando, who identifies it as ammonium nitrate. Before he identifies it, it is known as chemical powder.

label: Amulet mould
title: Amulet mould
lead: An amulet mould is used to create amulets through the Crafting skill. It can be obtained at the Crafting Guild and some crafting stores. It can also be obtained in your house if you have a tool store 4 in your workshop.

label: Amulet of accuracy
title: Amulet of accuracy
lead:
An amulet of accuracy is a reward from the Imp Catcher quest. To complete Imp Catcher, Wizard Mizgog trades an amulet of accuracy for a set of black, red, white, and yellow beads. After the quest it is possible to give him one of each bead again for another amulet.

The amulet is easily obtainable for new players because the quest has no requirements apart from killing imps; however, it is only recommended if the player is an Ironman lacking Magic levels to enchant better amulets. Amulet of power is already a straight upgrade across all stats.

label: Amulet of defence
title: Amulet of defence
lead:
The amulet of defence is created when an emerald amulet has been enchanted using the Lvl-2 Enchant spell. It is not widely used, as it only gives defence bonuses. However, it can prove useful in situations where more damage is going to be taken than dealt, such as skilling in the Wilderness or activities like Pyramid Plunder. For this purpose, for Members, the Gnome amulet can be a better option as it has nearly twice the melee defensive bonuses (but no ranged or magic defensive bonuses).

Amulets of defence can be sold to Davon's Amulet Store in Brimhaven, starting at 1,147 coins each if none are in stock. The amulet of defence (t), a cosmetic variant, can be obtained as a rare reward from beginner clue scrolls.

label: amulet of doomion
title: amulet of doomion
lead:
The amulet of doomion is an item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by killing the level 91 demon Doomion. It is one of the three amulets used in the quest. The other two are obtained by killing Doomion's comrades, Holthion and Othanian. Players can use their amulets to open a chest that contains Iban's shadow.

After the quest, the amulets cannot be obtained and have no other use.

label: Amulet of glory
title: Amulet of glory
lead:
The amulet of glory is a dragonstone amulet that has been enchanted by the Lvl-5 Enchant spell. After completion of Heroes' Quest, it can be charged at the Fountain of Heroes and the Fountain of Rune. When charged at the Fountain of Rune they will have 6 charges instead of the normal 4. With the completion of Dragon Slayer II, it can be charged at the Fountain of Uhld below the Myths' Guild. The amulet of glory is tradeable on the Grand Exchange only when it has zero, four, or six charges.

It is a very popular amulet in members-only worlds amongst players of all levels, as it provides good damage bonuses, has no requirements to wear, is much less expensive than the amulet of fury, and offers useful teleports.

label: amulet of holthion
title: amulet of holthion
lead:
Amulet of holthion is an item obtained during the Underground Pass quest. After defeating Holthion, one of Iban's guardians, the player receives the amulet. In conjunction with the other two amulets from the other guardians, all the amulets open the chest containing Iban's shadow.

After the quest, the amulets cannot be obtained and have no other use.

label: amulet of magic
title: amulet of magic
lead:
An amulet of magic is an amulet that gives a Magic attack bonus when worn. It is created by casting Lvl-1 Enchant on a sapphire amulet. It is one of the cheapest and most common amulets in the game because of the low Crafting level to craft it, how common sapphires are, and the low Magic level to enchant the amulet.

A normal amulet of magic, as well as its trimmed variant are both possible reward for the completion of easy Treasure Trails.

label: Amulet of othanian
title: Amulet of othanian
lead:
The amulet of othanian is an item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass. It is obtained by killing the level 91 demon Othainian. Once Othainian and his comrades Holthion and Doomion have been killed, the player can use their amulets to open a chest that contains Iban's shadow.

After the quest, the amulets cannot be obtained and have no other use.

label: Amulet of power
title: Amulet of power
lead:
An amulet of power offers a good balance of attack and defence bonuses for all classes of combat. It is created by casting Lvl-4 Enchant on a diamond amulet, and has no requirements to be worn.

This item is a less expensive option for players who do not wish to buy an amulet of glory. It lacks the glory's teleportation capabilities and has weaker attack and Prayer bonuses, but has the same strength bonus as well as higher defence bonuses.

label: Amulet of strength
title: Amulet of strength
lead:
The Amulet of strength is an enchanted ruby amulet. Players frequently use it to increase their max hit. At level 50 Crafting, players can craft a ruby amulet. With at least 49 Magic, Lvl-3 Enchant can be cast on a ruby amulet to create an amulet of strength.

A trimmed version of the amulet of strength is available from medium clue scrolls.

label: an experimental anvil
title: an experimental anvil
lead: An experimental anvil is an anvil used during The Tourist Trap to smith prototype darts. It can only be used during the quest. The Bedabin Nomad Guard will stop you from entering the tent containing it otherwise.

label: Ana
title: Ana
lead:
Ana is a girl from Misthalin who likes exploring. Unfortunately, she likes it a little too much and has recently disappeared into the Kharidian Desert. The player meets her mother, Irena, at the beginning of the quest, 'The Tourist Trap', in which they must rescue Ana. After searching the desert and finding her scarf, the player will discover that she has been captured by the slavers of the Desert Mining Camp. After a series of trials and tricks, the player is able to smuggle her out of the camp by hiding her in a barrel, and thus reuniting Ana with her mother.

At the end of the quest, Irena will do the wave emote and say "Hi Ana!". Then, Ana will walk towards her and disappear. Though Ana disappears, Irena stays at the entrance of Shantay Pass, as though she is still waiting for her daughter.

label: Ana in a barrel
title: Ana in a barrel
lead: Ana in a barrel is the result of using a Barrel on Ana, which is used to smuggle her out of the mining camp she has been imprisoned in, and is a quest item used by the player during The Tourist Trap quest. If a player drops the barrel, Ana will climb out of it, and she will appear in the mines again. Players who attempt to teleport out while carrying her will drop the barrel first.

label: Anchovies
title: Anchovies
lead:
Anchovies are a type of fish that restores 1 Hitpoint when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw anchovies on a fire or cooking range, granting 30 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt anchovies. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Anchovies are one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 34, or 31 when using the Lumbridge range.

Anchovies are an ingredient in anchovy pizzas, and are also used in the creation of impling jars.

label: Anchovy pizza
title: Anchovy pizza
lead:
Anchovy pizza is a type of pizza that restores 18 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 9. It can be obtained by using anchovies on a plain pizza, requiring 55 Cooking and granting 39 experience.

Anchovy pizzas are the highest healing food per slot in free-to-play and are also a type of fast food.

label: Ancient gallows
title: Ancient gallows
lead: The Ancient gallows are located at the end of Ah Za Rhoon. During the Shilo Village quest, the gallows must be searched to obtain Zadimus corpse. After quest completion, looking-at or searching them will produce the chat message, "You notice nothing significant about this".

label: Ancient Gate
title: Ancient Gate
lead: The Ancient Gates are located in the Shaman Caves and must be opened to proceed through the caves during the Legends' Quest. The first gate features a complex locking mechanic and must be opened using a lockpick (note: a strange old lockpick will not work), requiring 50 Thieving. The second gate is heavily constructed, being made from cast-iron, 50 Strength is required to push it open. The third gate located in the room with the Carved rocks can only be opened by casting any Charge Orb spell on it while having an uncharged orb in the inventory, resulting in the player automatically jumping through it.

label: Ancient talisman
title: Ancient talisman
lead:
Ancient talisman is a quest item. It is obtained and used in The Dig Site quest. Once you have passed all exams, go to dig in level 3 site (requires trowel and specimen brush) and you will eventually find the ancient talisman. Bring it to archaeological expert Terry Balando to learn that it is actually a talisman of Zaros. The archaeology expert is impressed and will give you an invitation letter to enter winches.

Additionally, duplicates can only be obtained during this part of the quest. In order to obtain a duplicate it must be done via the drop-trick while excavating the level 3 dig site. The duplicates are not removed from one's inventory upon completing the quest's section.

label: Angry
title: Angry
lead:
Angry is the fourth listed emote. Upon use the player puts one hand on their hips and waves their fist in the air showing their anger.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Animal skull (scenery)
title: Animal skull (scenery)
lead: Animal skulls can be found all over Gielinor, typically marking the outside of scary dungeons. They act as a scenery element representing an ominous warning, and serve no practical purpose.

label: Anita
title: Anita
lead:
Anita is a gnome who first appears in The Grand Tree quest. She and her boyfriend, Glough, both live in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, though they do not live together. Her home is in the north-west of the stronghold, just west of the swamp.

She plays a part in The Grand Tree, with players obtaining Glough's key from her. She's also the author of the translation book used to understand Hazelmere.

label: Anna
title: Anna
lead:
Anna Sinclair is one of Lord Sinclair's children. She is a suspect during the Murder Mystery quest. She seems to be the most common culprit of the murder, but there is no doubt that all the children were involved.

According to the Gossip, she loves sewing and gardening. At one point of time she had a relationship with Stanford the gardener, but they broke up and she tried to get him fired by killing the flowers in the garden.

label: Anna's barrel
title: Anna's barrel
lead: Anna's barrel can be found inside the Sinclair Mansion in Anna's bedroom. During the Murder Mystery quest, the player must search the barrel to find her silver necklace.

label: Anna's print
title: Anna's print
lead: Anna's print is a quest item in the Murder Mystery quest. It is created by using flypaper on the silver necklace after dusting it with a pot of flour. If the prints match those of the unknown print, it will become a killer's print, meaning Anna is the killer.

label: Annakarl
title: Annakarl
lead:
Annakarl was one of Zaros' fortresses that was located in what is now the Wilderness. It was captured in the early Third Age by Saradominist forces, and likely destroyed during the God Wars by followers of Zamorak and Saradomin. Zilyana, an Icyene commander of the Saradominist forces, was likely injured during the battle in Annakarl, leading to the creation of Saradomin's tear.

The last known location of Lamistard, a Mahjarrat who betrayed Zaros, is also the former fortresses of Annakarl.

label: Anti-dragon shield
title: Anti-dragon shield
lead:
The anti-dragon shield is an item given by Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle during the Dragon Slayer I quest. After the quest, the shield can be purchased from Oziach, or obtained from Duke Horacio for free. It is tradeable, but can only be equipped if the player has started Dragon Slayer I.

The anti-dragon shield mitigates the effects of dragonfire, reducing the maximum hit of most dragon-breath attacks by roughly ~80%. It also prevents Elvarg from severely draining the player's combat stats. The effects of antifire potion stack with the anti-dragon shield; using both provides full protection from standard dragonfire attacks.

label: antifire potion
title: antifire potion
lead:
An antifire potion provides slight immunity to a dragon's breath. When used in conjunction with an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield, a single dose will provide complete immunity against dragonfire for 6 minutes. It can be made by a player with 69 Herblore by mixing clean lantadyme and then dragon scale dust in a vial of water, which grants 157.5 Herblore experience. It may only be used after starting Dragon Slayer I. Additionally, it can be upgraded to either an extended or super antifire by adding lava scale shards with 84 Herblore or crushed superior dragon bones with 92 Herblore, respectively.

Players will get a warning in their chatbox when the potion is about to wear off after approximately 5 minutes, 45 seconds: " " Then they will get another message when it has worn off, approximately 6 minutes in total: " " This allows you to keep track of how long you have until you have to drink again.

label: antipoison
title: antipoison
lead:
An antipoison is a potion made by using unicorn horn dust on a marrentill potion (unf), requiring 5 Herblore, yielding an antipoison(3) and 37.5 Herblore experience. A dose of antipoison cures poison and provides immunity to poison for 90 seconds. Drinking two doses of antipoison will cure venom. The first dose will reduce the venom to poison and the second will remove the poison.

The next cheapest alternative, superantipoison, cures poison and provides immunity for 6 minutes.

label: anvil
title: anvil
lead:
An anvil is used to smith items through the Smithing skill. An anvil can be used to smith items by click on an anvil or using a bar on it while the player has a hammer in their inventory or is wielding an Imcando hammer. Upon interaction, a selection screen will come up allowing the player to choose an item to make. Multiple players can use the same anvil simultaneously.

There are several anvils located around Gielinor which are identified with an anvil icon on the minimap and world map.

label: Apothecary
title: Apothecary
lead:
Ingald Belger the Apothecary runs the pharmacy and potion shop in south-west Varrock. He plays a part in certain quests, often making delicate potions and herbal products.

Free acne potions can be obtained from him about 50% of the time when talking to him.

label: Apple orchard
title: Apple orchard
lead:
An apple orchard can be found immediately south-east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Inside the orchard, players can find a Rotten Apple Pile. During Mourning's End Part I, players use a barrel on the pile to receive a barrel of rotten apples, and then use the resulting barrel on the nearby Apple Press to make an apple barrel.

The scout from The General's Shadow miniquest can also be found wandering just outside of the orchard, to the west.

label: Apple pie
title: Apple pie
lead:
Apple pie is a type of pie that restores 14 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 7. A pie dish will remain after both bites are consumed. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked apple pie on a cooking range, requiring level 30 Cooking and granting 130 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt pie. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 63. Alternatively, casting the Bake Pie spell from the lunar spellbook will always create a pie without burning it.

Apple pie is a possible task from Romily Weaklax in the Cooks' Guild. Three apple pies are given to the player when starting Nature Spirit.

label: Arabian
title: Arabian
lead:
Arabian is a music track that is unlocked in Al Kharid, at the Al Kharid mine and the Giants' Plateau. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Al Kharid and Arabian 2.

In Classic mode, the track plays in several locations in northern Kharidian Desert:
*On the path to the Emir's Arena north of Al Kharid.
*At the Citharede Abbey.
*At the Uzer mine.

label: Arabian 2
title: Arabian 2
lead:
Arabian 2 is a music track that is unlocked in Al Kharid, at the Al Kharid mine and the Giants' Plateau. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Al Kharid and Arabian.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the Al Kharid mining site.

label: Arabian 3
title: Arabian 3
lead:
Arabian 3 is a music track unlocked in members parts of Kharidian Desert. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Desert Heat, Desert Voyage, The Desert, Egypt, Scarab, Sphinx and Sunburn.

In Classic mode, the track plays near the Kalphite Lair which is in the western part of the desert.

label: Arabique
title: Arabique
lead: Arabique is a music track that is unlocked near the Hellhounds in Taverley Dungeon.

label: Arcenia root
title: Arcenia root
lead: Arcenia root is a quest item used in the quest The Dig Site to make Chemical compound along with nitroglycerin, ammonium nitrate and ground charcoal to blow up bricks blocking the path below digsite. It is obtained from tunnels where players can only enter with the invitation letter. Entering the tunnels requires 10 Agility.

label: Archer (Ardougne)
title: Archer (Ardougne)
lead: Archers are found in Ardougne, atop Ardougne Castle. They are not aggressive to players, but when attacked, will defend themselves with Ranged attacks that are fairly accurate and can hit up to 6.

label: Archer (Burthorpe)
title: Archer (Burthorpe)
lead:
Archers are level 42 guards for Burthorpe Castle in Burthorpe, and are members of the Imperial Guard.

They are not aggressive to players, but when attacked, will defend themselves with Ranged attacks that are fairly accurate and can hit up to 6. They are occasionally trained on by mid-level players looking for their Green d'hide chaps drop.

label: Archer (Lost City)
title: Archer (Lost City)
lead: The Archer is part of a band of adventurers searching for Zanaris. The archer and her three companions, a wizard, a monk, and a warrior, can be found in the north-west part of the Lumbridge Swamp, near the Draynor bank. She is a part of the Lost City quest.

label: Archery ticket
title: Archery ticket
lead:
An archery ticket is the reward given for using the target range at the Ranging Guild. The quantity received varies from 0-100 tickets per 10 shots at the cost of 200 coins. They can be exchanged with the Ticket Merchant within the guild for prizes, most notably rune arrows and green d'hide bodies.

The archery ticket is one of the items that may be asked for during Mourning's End Part II.

label: Archmage Sedridor
title: Archmage Sedridor
lead: Archmage Sedridor is the head wizard and chief of research at the Wizards' Tower, which trains wizards in the magical arts. He can be found in his office in the basement of the tower. After completion of Rune Mysteries, players can use him among other wizards to teleport to the rune essence mine.

label: Ardougne
title: Ardougne
lead: Ardougne ( ) is the capital and largest city of the Kingdom of Kandarin. It is divided into East Ardougne and West Ardougne. West Ardougne is closed off to the general public because of a mysterious "plague" affecting the inhabitants, but you can slowly gain complete access by completing the first few quests of the Plague City quest line. It is also probably the best place to find thieves in all of Gielinor.

label: Ardougne Baker's Stall.
title: Ardougne Baker's Stall.
lead:
The Ardougne Baker's Stall is a store located on the east side of the East Ardougne market that sells bread, cake, chocolate slices, and chocolate bars. It is run by a baker. It requires 5 Thieving to steal from.

Stealing a cake from one of the bakery stalls is an easy Ardougne Diary task.

label: Ardougne Castle
title: Ardougne Castle
lead:
Ardougne Castle is a castle in East Ardougne near the border to West Ardougne. King Lathas, the current king of Kandarin, lives on the . Players can start the Underground Pass quest here. Aside from the king, many Paladins wander the area around it.

There is also a Black scimitar spawn in the upper level of the castle behind a door (requires a Thieving level of 61 to lockpick), and two chests requiring a Thieving level of 72 to open. Stealing from one of these chests is a requirement for completing the Hard Ardougne Diary, and can be assigned as a skill challenge by Sherlock for elite clue scrolls.

label: Ardougne Fur Stall.
title: Ardougne Fur Stall.
lead:
The Ardougne Fur Stall is a Fur stall in the south-eastern part of the East Ardougne marketplace. It is run by the fur trader.

The stall sells bear fur and grey wolf fur. They will buy and sell polar kebbit fur, common kebbit fur, feldip weasel fur, desert devil fur, tatty larupia fur, larupia fur, tatty graahk fur, graahk fur, tatty kyatt fur and kyatt fur from the player stock, but do not normally carry them.

label: Ardougne Gem Stall.
title: Ardougne Gem Stall.
lead: The Ardougne Gem Stall is a gem shop in East Ardougne market run by the gem merchant.

label: Ardougne Market
title: Ardougne Market
lead:
Ardougne Market, also called Ardougne Marketplace or the Equal Trade Market, is the biggest stall marketplace on Gielinor. The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the caster into the centre of Ardougne Market. With East Ardougne being very wealthy, the marketplace is very popular with thieves, with it often being called the hub of Thieving. It contains eight market stalls (six with availability to buy from) listed with information below. The owners of the stalls will not buy back their products for 30–60 minutes from the player if they steal from their stalls.

The market is cited to have originated from the aftermath of The Great Battle at the Outpost north of Ardougne, wherein one of the survivors established the marketplace to promote equality of trade among the people.

label: Ardougne Monastery
title: Ardougne Monastery
lead:
The Ardougne Monastery, or Kandarin Monastery, in the kingdom of Kandarin is a building located south of Ardougne Zoo and north of the Fight Arena. It is made up of two two-story towers (east and west) joined by a single-story foyer. It is dedicated to the god Saradomin. Players can teleport here an unlimited number of times using an Ardougne cloak.

The monastery is fairly close to a fairy ring ( ), which can be reached by running east, as well as the Khazard Battlefield spirit tree, which can be reached by running west, then north. The convenience of the Monastery's location makes the Ardougne cloak arguably the best easy Achievement Diary reward.

label: Ardougne church
title: Ardougne church
lead:
The Ardougne church is the church of Kandarin capital's city of Ardougne. It features multiple characters who appear in the Sheep Herder quest. Interestingly, despite being a Saradominist church, there is a Zarosian grave in front of the building.

Praying at the altar is an easy Ardougne Diary task.

label: Ardougne farm
title: Ardougne farm
lead:
The Ardougne farm, also known as the Ardy farm, is a large farm just north of Ardougne, known for offering a herb patch which can conveniently be teleported to with the Ardougne cloak 2 or above. The farm is surrounded by oak trees. A mysterious statue near the potato field is used during the Holy Grail quest to help players find the Fisher Realm.

Players can build an easy STASH unit on the top floor of the farm's windmill.

label: Ardougne north bank
title: Ardougne north bank
lead:
The Ardougne north bank, also known as Ardy north, is the second bank of Ardougne. Among buildings dedicated exclusively for use as a bank, the internal area of the Ardougne north bank's is one of the smallest.

There is a Deadman chest in the bank.

label: Ardougne Sewers
title: Ardougne Sewers
lead: The Ardougne Sewers are an extensive dungeon system underneath East Ardougne and part of West Ardougne. Currently, players have access to three separate sections of the sewers, which are visited during various quests.

label: Ardougne Sewers mine
title: Ardougne Sewers mine
lead:
The Ardougne Sewers mine is a mine that features five iron and coal rocks. It is located below Ardougne in the Ardougne Sewers.

The iron ore is roughly 130 tiles away from the bank.

label: Ardougne Silver Stall.
title: Ardougne Silver Stall.
lead: Ardougne Silver Stall is a silver stall located in the East Ardougne Marketplace. It is run by the silver merchant.

label: Ardougne south bank
title: Ardougne south bank
lead:
The Ardougne south bank, also known as Ardy south or often simply Ardy bank, is the first of two banks added to the city of Ardougne.

The bank has three floors, although the and are trivial, due to being small 3x3 rooms with no features.

label: Ardougne Spice Stall.
title: Ardougne Spice Stall.
lead: The Ardougne Spice Stall is a spice stall in East Ardougne that sells knives, spices, and garlic. It is run by the spice seller.

label: Ardougne teleport
title: Ardougne teleport
lead: Ardougne Teleport teleports the caster to East Ardougne market. This spell can only be cast after reading the Ardougne teleport scroll, which is a quest completion reward from the Plague City quest. Once the player reads the scroll they will memorise the spell Ardougne Teleport and the scroll will crumble to dust. If a player loses this scroll, they can go back to Edmond in north-west of East Ardougne to get a new one. Casting the spell is a requirement for the Medium Ardougne Diary.

label: Ardougne teleport scroll
title: Ardougne teleport scroll
lead:
The Ardougne teleport scroll is a quest item reward in Plague City. It is obtained from Edmond after completion of the quest.

When read, players will be able to cast Ardougne Teleport spell (requiring level 51 Magic), although reading the scroll itself does not have a magic level requirement. Players do not need to read the scroll to use the Ardougne teleport tablet.

label: Ardougne Zoo
title: Ardougne Zoo
lead: The Ardougne Zoo, located in the southern part of East Ardougne, holds a variety of creatures gathered from across Gielinor. It is currently the only zoo in Old School RuneScape, and is involved in a handful of quests. The Ardougne Zoo is the only place outside of Ape Atoll where the player can use a monkey greegree.

label: Ardrigal
title: Ardrigal
lead:
Ardrigal is the clean form of grimy ardrigal, a herb obtained by searching the palm trees with large leaves on the north-eastern peninsula of Karamja, on the south side of the tree grapple shortcut. It is the second herb Trufitus asks the player to bring him during Jungle Potion, and is also used during Legends' Quest in combination with snake weed to make a bravery potion.

Trufitus will buy clean ardrigals for a random amount of coins between and . This can only be done by using the herb on him, as there is no dialogue option for selling them to him. He will not buy grimy ardrigals, his reasoning being that he cannot identify what the herb is.

label: Ardrigal mixture
title: Ardrigal mixture
lead: The ardrigal mixture is an item used during Legends' Quest to make a bravery potion. It is made by using an ardrigal on a vial of water. Snake weed can then be added to make the bravery potion, which is used to enter the dark cave during the quest. It can be made after completion of Legends' Quest, although it has no use.

label: Arhein
title: Arhein
lead:
Arhein runs Arhein's General Goods in Catherby, on a pier just south of the bank, near the charter ship. During Current Affairs he attempts to speed up the docking process at Catherby dock with the help of his duck. He also plays a small part in the Merlin's Crystal and the One Small Favour quests.

Arhein owns a ship on the pier, which he uses to deliver candles to Keep Le Faye, a fortress to the south. He does not allow players to ride his ship, although it is possible to sneak aboard it to get to Keep Le Faye by hiding in a crate near the candle shop in Catherby, which is used by the player during Merlin's Crystal.

label: Arhein's General Goods
title: Arhein's General Goods
lead: Arhein's General Goods is a general store in Catherby. It is run by Arhein and is also known as the Catherby General Store.

label: Aris
title: Aris
lead:
Aris Maye is a fortune-teller who resides in a large tent outside Varrock town square.

She is notable for being the start point of the Demon Slayer quest, in addition to being largely featured in Recipe for Disaster.

label: Armadyl pendant
title: Armadyl pendant
lead:
The Armadyl pendant is a quest item in the Temple of Ikov quest. A Guardian of Armadyl in the Temple of Ikov dungeon gives the player the pendant if the player sides with them. Equipping it allows players to attack Lucien, once he is defeated, the quest is complete.

This pendant is the easiest obtainable protection against Armadyl and followers of Armadyl in the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Armour salesman
title: Armour salesman
lead: Aaron the Armour salesman is the owner of Aaron's Archery Appendages. in the Ranging Guild. His shop sells low level Ranged armour. Players who have achieved 99 Ranged can purchase the Ranged Cape of Accomplishment from him for 99,000 coins.

label: Armoury
title: Armoury
lead: Armoury is a shop in the Combat Training Camp. This shop sells various weapons for Melee and Ranged combat. The owner is a shop keeper. Buying from this shop is not recommended because it charges prices 50% higher than other shops that sell the same items.

label: Army of Darkness
title: Army of Darkness
lead:
Army of Darkness is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, it plays at Dark Warriors' Fortress as well as Wilderness Bandit Camp.

label: Arrival
title: Arrival
lead:
Arrival is a music track that can be unlocked inside Falador city walls. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Fanfare and Workshop.

In Classic mode, the track plays west of Falador at the West Falador mine.

label: Arrow shaft
title: Arrow shaft
lead:
An arrow shaft is used in Fletching to make arrows. Arrow shafts can be cut from different types of logs by using a knife on them, each tier yielding 5 additional Fletching experience per set of 15 arrow shafts. 15 Feathers can be attached to 15 arrow shafts at 1 Fletching, yielding 15 experience and 15 headless arrows. Arrowtips are then attached to headless arrows to create arrows. Spider on shaft can be made by using an arrow shaft on a spider carcass with 16 Cooking.

Arrow shafts are purchased for coin at Dargaud's Bow and Arrows in the Ranging Guild.

label: Arrows (scenery)
title: Arrows (scenery)
lead: Arrows consist of five arrows hanging on a rack on a wall. The arrows appear to be Steel arrows.

label: Asgarnia
title: Asgarnia
lead: The Kingdom of Asgarnia is one of the main kingdoms of the Old School RuneScape world, Gielinor. Asgarnia's primary economic activities are crafting, mining, and fishing. It also has a notable navy based in Port Sarim. It is ruled over by the King Vallance, however he has fallen quite ill. With the King unable to stand, Sir Amik Varze manages the Kingdom in his stead.

label: Asgarnian ale
title: Asgarnian ale
lead:
Asgarnian ale is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Strength by 2 while draining Attack by \lfloor Level \times \frac{5}{100} \rfloor + 2 (see table below). It can be obtained through brewing at level 24 Cooking granting 248 experience. It is brewed using 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, 4 asgarnian hops, and a pot of ale yeast. The stronger, mature version of the ale is the Asgarnian ale(m).

4 Asgarnian ales are required during the Recipe for Disaster Dwarf subquest, where they are turned into Asgoldian ale by using a coin on them. One is also required for the Death Plateau quest.

label: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
title: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
lead:
The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon is a moderately large dungeon in Asgarnia. It is found south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point, , under a trapdoor. Look for the red exclamation sign ( ) on the minimap, which indicates a dungeon. This dungeon is particularly dangerous to low level players, as every single monster within it is aggressive. The dungeon is also crucial to the The Knight's Sword quest as this is the only location in Gielinor that contains blurite rocks, allowing players to mine blurite ore.

Three Agility shortcuts can be found in the dungeon; one just east of the entrance ladder requiring 82 Agility, another in the chamber with muggers requiring 60 Agility, leading them to the ice chamber to the west, and a third right before the ice giants and warriors in the eastern area, requiring 72 Agility. All three are boostable.

label: Ash
title: Ash
lead:
Ash is a troll chef found on Death Plateau. He stands next to Dung at the centre of the plateau, just in front of the cooking pot they both maintain.

When the player searches the cooking pot in My Arm's Big Adventure, the troll cooks will attack with weak ranged attacks, hoping to put you in the stew for dinner.

label: ashes
title: ashes
lead:
Ashes are a common item that are produced when a fire burns out. Ashes are used as a Herblore secondary, and are needed in a number of quests. They are commonly discarded, and can often be found where players are lighting fires for Firemaking training. If a player acquires multiple of Old man's message and starts a new task at the Wise Old Man, the duplicates will explode into ashes when attempting to read them.

Ashes can be crushed into ground ashes using a pestle and mortar.

label: Assorted flowers
title: Assorted flowers
lead:
Assorted flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Astronomy book
title: Astronomy book
lead:
The Astronomy book, or The Tale of Scorpius, is obtained during the Observatory Quest. It has a brief history of Scorpius and how he introduced astronomy to Gielinor.

After finding the book, a copy can also be found in the shelves in your house.

label: Asyff
title: Asyff
lead: Asyff Bymajique, the fancy dress shop owner, runs the Fancy Clothes Store in Varrock. Players can bring un-noted Hunter furs or hides to him to have him make Hunter clothing for a small fee. He is also involved in the Eagles' Peak quest.

label: Attack
title: Attack
lead: Attack is a player's accuracy in melee combat. As a player raises their Attack level, they can deal damage more consistently as well as wield weapons of stronger materials.

label: Attack 1
title: Attack 1
lead:
