Attack 1, is a music track that is unlocked on and to the north-west of the Khazard Battlefield. It also plays at a small area north of West Ardougne. It can also play in the Nightmare Zone when facing the Khazard warlord.

If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

label: Attack 2
title: Attack 2
lead:
Attack 2 is a music track that is unlocked in Elvarg's lair in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon. It can later be heard in Dragon Slayer II, during the cutscene of the Dragonkin battle on Lithkren. It can also play in the Nightmare Zone when facing Elvarg.

If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

label: Attack 3
title: Attack 3
lead:
Attack 3 is a music track that is unlocked at the Lava Maze Dungeon and Obor's lair. If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

It is the third in a set of six tracks known as the "Attack" series.

label: Attack 4
title: Attack 4
lead:
Attack 4 is a music track that is unlocked during the Fight Arena quest. It can also be unlocked in the Iorwerth Camp cave during Song of the Elves. It can also in the Nightmare Zone when facing Bouncer.

If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

label: Attack 5
title: Attack 5
lead:
Attack 5 is a music track that is unlocked at the King Black Dragon's Lair, or in a cutscene at the Lithkren Vault during Dragon Slayer II. If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

It is the fifth track in the series of six "Attack" music tracks.

label: Attack 6
title: Attack 6
lead:
Attack 6 is a music track that is unlocked at the Gu'Tanoth Ogre Enclave lair. It can also be unlocked and heard in the quest The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute, when the player fights Cuthbert, Lord of Dread. If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

It is the sixth track in the series of six "Attack" music tracks.

label: Attack Level Up!
title: Attack Level Up!
lead: Attack Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling attack.

label: Attack Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Attack Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Attack Level Up! (Unlocks) is a Jingle for leveling Attack.

label: attack potion
title: attack potion
lead:
An attack potion is a potion made by using an eye of newt on a guam potion (unf), requiring 3 Herblore, yielding an attack potion(3) and 25 Herblore experience. It is the first available potion to make with the Herblore skill. A dose of attack potion provides a temporary skill boost to Attack equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Attack level, rounded down. This is less than the super attack's boost of 5 + 15% of the player's current Attack level, rounded down.

After Barbarian Herblore Training, roe or caviar can be added to an attack potion(2), requiring 4 Herblore, yielding an attack mix and 8 Herblore experience. An attack mix has 2 doses, boosts Attack equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Attack level, rounded down, and heals 3 Hitpoints per dose.

label: Attention
title: Attention
lead:
Attention is a music track that unlocks around Rimmington. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Emperor.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the coastline south of Rimmington and western side of Thurgo Peninsula.

label: Aubury
title: Aubury
lead:
Layte Aubury is the owner of the Aubury's Rune Shop in Varrock. He features heavily in the Rune Mysteries quest. He stocks many free-to-play runes, including chaos and death runes. Players who have completed Rune Mysteries can also ask him to be teleported to the rune essence mines. When he teleports players, he utters .

He is a close associate with Archmage Sedridor of the Wizards' Tower, and his research helped re-discover the incantation to teleport to the rune essence mines.

label: Aubury's Rune Shop.
title: Aubury's Rune Shop.
lead:
Aubury's Rune Shop. is a shop located in south-eastern Varrock and owned by Aubury. It is a small building just south of the eastern Varrock bank. The shop's easy to access location makes it one of the most convenient ways for players to buy runes and to teleport to the rune essence mine after the quest Rune Mysteries.

The nearby level 6 Mugger will be aggressive to low level players, however he will not enter the shop.

label: Authentic Throwing Weapons.
title: Authentic Throwing Weapons.
lead: Authentic Throwing Weapons is a shop where the Tribal Weapon Salesman sells javelins and throwing axes up to runite. The shop is located in the Ranging Guild, so it can only be accessed by players with a Ranged level of 40 or higher.

label: Autumn Voyage
title: Autumn Voyage
lead:
Autumn Voyage is a music track that is unlocked when the player first arrives in Lumbridge. It can also be heard around the Lumbridge Swamp and farmlands. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Book of Spells, Dream, Flute Salad, Harmony, and Yesteryear.

In Classic mode, the track plays in eastern Lumbridge, near the cow calves.

label: Avan
title: Avan
lead:
The man found in Al Kharid mine is a non-player character who plays a big role in the Family Crest quest. During the quest it is revealed that his real name is Avan Fitzharmon.

After the quest, he can turn steel gauntlets into goldsmith gauntlets. This is free if players have not previously chosen an enchantment for the gauntlets, but if they have, it will cost . If the Family Pest miniquest has been completed, Avan will give the goldsmith gauntlets directly for free instead. The player can reobtain the goldsmith gauntlets after completion of the quest by right clicking and selecting the "Gauntlets" option, which will allow you to reobtain the gauntlets, even on a F2P world.

label: Avantoe
title: Avantoe
lead:
Avantoe is a mid-level herb, requiring a Herblore level of 48 to clean from the grimy version. It can be obtained as a monster drop or through the Farming skill, with a level of 50, by planting an avantoe seed in a herb patch. It is used to make fishing potions, super energy potions, and hunter potions. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create an avantoe potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

According to the book Gielinor's flora - herbs, the name means "moment", likely due to its unusual lifecycle caused by the harsh climate of the Kharidian Desert. Avantoe sprouts only after rain and then dies shortly in a matter of days.

label: Avantoe potion (unf)
title: Avantoe potion (unf)
lead: An avantoe potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using an avantoe on a vial of water, requiring 50 Herblore. Using a snape grass on an avantoe potion (unf) with 50 Herblore yields a Fishing potion(3) and 112.5 Herblore experience. Using a mort myre fungus on an avantoe potion (unf) with 52 Herblore yields a super energy(3) and 117.5 Herblore experience. Using a kebbit teeth dust on an avantoe potion (unf) with 53 Herblore yields a Hunter potion(3) and 120 Herblore experience.

label: Axe handle (historical)
title: Axe handle (historical)
lead:
Axe handles were items created through a random event that caused axe heads to fly off whilst Woodcutting. Heads and handles were either re-attached or deleted to prevent them from becoming discontinued items.

Dragon axes were included in this event. As they were worth over 2 million at the time, players who were not paying constant attention risked substantial losses. Curiously, although a special version of the Dragon axe handle was added in 2006, it was still possible to combine a Dragon axe head and a regular Axe handle.

label: Aztec
title: Aztec
lead: Aztec is a music track that is unlocked in the Brimhaven Agility Arena. If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

label: Baby blue dragon
title: Baby blue dragon
lead:
Baby blue dragons are the young of adult blue dragons found in Taverley Dungeon, the Isle of Souls Dungeon, the bottom floor of the Ruins of Tapoyauik, and in the basement of the Myths' Guild. Unlike their adult forms, they do not breathe fire.

Players who wish to kill baby blue dragons without being attacked by the adult blue dragons can find some in the Taverley Dungeon near the lava eel fishing spot, south of the Agility shortcut. They can also be killed on the east side of the main Taverley Dungeon room as no adult blue dragon will walk there.

label: Baby dragon (unused)
title: Baby dragon (unused)
lead:
The Baby dragon was an unused monster that was added in the RuneScape 2 Beta. It did not have any colour, and just used the generic grey baby dragon model with no recolouring. It is unknown what purpose, if any, the monster was intended to serve, yet it remained in the game files for many years and was graphically updated in 2006. Therefore, it was never present in Old School RuneScape, and was deleted entirely from the cache on 10 September 2015.

The model is the same as the baby black dragon.

label: Babydragon bones
title: Babydragon bones
lead:
Babydragon bones are dropped by baby green, blue, red and black dragons. They can also be obtained as a common loot from dragon impling jars and crystal impling jars.

Babydragon bones give 30 Prayer experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 90 XP when casting Sinister Offering.
* 90 XP when offered at the sacred bone burner after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 105 XP when offered at a gilded altar with two burners lit or at the Chaos Temple. The Temple additionally has a 50% chance to not deplete the bones; effectively doubling the XP to 210 per bone.
* 120 XP when offered at the Ectofuntus in the form of Baby dragon bonemeal.
* 120 XP when blessed and broken down into blessed bone shards and offered at the libation bowl, or 144 XP when offered with a jug of blessed sunfire wine. Virilis outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.

label: Background
title: Background
lead: Background is a music track that is unlocked on Entrana. It also used to play during the Candlelight random event until it was removed. Until 2026, it also played in a small corner south of Keep Le Faye, until it was replaced with Trinity in both Modern and Classic mode.

label: Bad Roll (Death Plateau)
title: Bad Roll (Death Plateau)
lead: Bad Roll (Death Plateau) is a Jingle that plays when losing a dice gamble with Harold during Death Plateau.

label: Badly repaired wall
title: Badly repaired wall
lead: The Badly repaired wall is found on the Fishing Platform, and must be kicked down during the Sea Slug quest to let out Kennith.

label: Bailey
title: Bailey
lead: Bailey is the keeper of the Fishing Platform, and plays a significant role in the quests Sea Slug and The Slug Menace. Throughout the first two quests of the Sea Slug series, he tries his best to get rid of the sea slugs and manages to evade being mind-controlled.

label: Bailing bucket
title: Bailing bucket
lead:
A bailing bucket is used in the Fishing Trawler minigame. Its sole purpose is to bail water out of the trawler. It is recommended for all players to have this item before going on a fishing trawler trip, as there is always a need to bail at least once.

Players can obtain bailing buckets from either the Khazard General Store (conveniently close to the Fishing Trawler) and Rasolo west of the Fishing Guild. However, the latter store is not recommended due to the location and stock. If players don't have a bailing bucket when starting a Fishing Trawler run, the crates on the deck of the Trawler can be searched for one. Bailing buckets can be traded with other players but not through the Grand Exchange.

label: Baker
title: Baker
lead:
Bakers run bakery stalls in the East Ardougne market as well as in the Great Kourend market. Players can purchase or steal cakes, bread, and chocolate cake slices from their stalls. Stealing, however, may attract the attention of nearby guards, who will attack the player. If a player attempts to steal from the stall while in the bakers' view, that player will be unsuccessful. One Ardougne baker has a daughter named Ramara du Croissant.

Bakers also sell all the items that can be stolen from their stalls. However, if a player attempts to trade or talk with the bakers having stolen from their stalls within the previous 15 minutes, the bakers will not only refuse to trade or talk with the player; they will alert the guards. If players steal from one baker and then go to the other, they still call the guards.

label: Bakery stall
title: Bakery stall
lead:
Bakery stalls are food stalls that can be stolen from at level 5 Thieving. The stalls are typically found near stores selling baked goods.

A successful steal will reward 16 Thieving experience and either a cake, bread, or chocolate slice. Thieving will fail if the player is spotted by the stall's owner or nearby guard.

label: Balancing ledge (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
title: Balancing ledge (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
lead: The balancing ledge is an Agility obstacle found within the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. Passing the obstacle requires 35 Agility and will award 22 Agility experience.

label: Balancing ledge (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Balancing ledge (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The balancing ledge is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to cross will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

The amount of damage dealt by the fall is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: Balancing ledge (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
title: Balancing ledge (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
lead:
The Balancing ledge is an Agility shortcut. An Agility level of 40 is required to use the shortcut. It is the first obstacle into the Yanille Agility Dungeon, giving access to the Chaos druid warriors. Failing drops the player into a pit of poison spiders.

Some people use the balancing ledge as a low-intensity way to train Agility, as with the right camera placement it is possible to keep the mouse cursor in one spot and continuously click. Players can gain up to 13,200 experience per hour.

label: Balancing rope (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Balancing rope (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead: The balancing rope is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to cross will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

label: Balancing rope (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
title: Balancing rope (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
lead: The balancing rope is an Agility obstacle found within the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. An Agility level of one is required to pass the obstacle, which will then grant the player 10 Agility experience. It is not possible to fail this obstacle.

label: ball
title: ball
lead:
The ball is a quest item used only in Witch's House. It is found in the shed of Nora T. Hagg's garden and can be picked up after killing the witch's experiment.

It is returned to the boy to complete the quest.

label: ball of wool
title: ball of wool
lead:
A ball of wool is used in the Crafting skill. It is made by using a spinning wheel.

Players looking to obtain large numbers of balls of wool often use Neitiznot supplies. in Neitiznot as it has the largest stock of any store with a bank in the same building. After Monkey Madness II, Hamab's Crafting Emporium on Ape Atoll is also located close to a bank.

label: Ballad of Enchantment
title: Ballad of Enchantment
lead: Ballad of Enchantment is a music track that is unlocked at the Ardougne Monastery and the Clock Tower.

label: Ballista (Tree Gnome Village)
title: Ballista (Tree Gnome Village)
lead:
The ballista is a gnome weapon found in the Battlefield of Khazard, north of the Tree Gnome Village. It is used during the Tree Gnome Village quest to pierce through a wall of the Khazard building to the north after the player has obtained the coordinates from three Tracker gnomes. The machine requires three coordinates in order to fire: height, x, and y.

Before the ballista can be fired, repairs must first be made. Commander Montai will request the player's help in obtaining six logs to make the repairs during the Tree Gnome Village quest.

label: Banana
title: Banana
lead:
A banana is a type of food that restores 2 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be found on trees in tropical locations, such as Karamja and Ape Atoll, or bought from various stores. Six bananas can be picked at a time from a banana tree grown by planting a banana sapling in a fruit tree patch with 33 Farming. They can also be obtained by using the spell Bones to Bananas, which converts bones of all types in the caster's inventory to bananas.

A single banana is required to cast the standard spellbook Ape Atoll Teleport with 64 Magic. The teleport can be added to a portal chamber or portal nexus, requiring 100 and 1,000 bananas respectively.

label: Banana plantation
title: Banana plantation
lead: Luthas' banana plantation can be found across from Zembo's bar on Musa Point. Players can collect bananas for Luthas and put them in the box outside his hut. When they've filled the box with 10 bananas, Luthas will pay them 30 coins. Luthas is useful if a player forgets their money and cannot go back from the island. There are 33 banana trees in the plantation, each with 5 bananas on each tree. This is a rival money making method to making stew for the guard in a tree in Draynor Village, although it is better to collect the bananas and sell at the Grand Exchange for a much higher price.

label: Banana tree
title: Banana tree
lead:
Banana trees are trees found in tropical areas that grow bananas. Up to 5 bananas can be picked from a tree, after which the tree will be empty and require time to grow more bananas. Banana trees take 5 minutes to regrow. The trees can be found growing in the Musa Point banana plantation, which is owned by Luthas and features prominently in Pirate's Treasure. The trees are also found in the Ape Atoll banana plantation.

A variant of banana trees can be found on Ape Atoll in the Monkey Child's garden, as well as a special tree on the west side of the island that grows red bananas.

label: Bandit
title: Bandit
lead: Bandits are enemies that inhabit the Bandit Camp (Wilderness). The bandits are guarded by Guard Bandits. These bandits are aggressive, so players should take caution when approaching the camp. The camp's champions, however, such as Donny the lad, are not aggressive.

label: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
title: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
lead:
The Bandit Camp is an outlaw stronghold located within levels 17 to 24 Wilderness. It is most often visited for Treasure Trails and the Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest, as well as to kill bandits for a Krystilia Slayer task and to sell items to the general store.

The camp can only be entered from either the south or the east, as it is surrounded by walls. The south entrance is guarded by level 22 and level 130 bandits. To enter, the player must walk from levels 17 to 19 Wilderness along a narrow pathway with lava on either side, or go through the safer way, from the east where there is a break in the wall. This entrance is guarded by two giant rats, and one of them is of the aggressive level 6 variety.

label: Bandit Camp mine
title: Bandit Camp mine
lead: The Bandit Camp mine (or the Hobgoblin Mine) is a mining site found north-east of the Bandit Camp in the Wilderness from levels 32 to 35 and east of the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. The mine is occupied by a large number of aggressive hobgoblins, from whom the mine gets its nickname.

label: Bandit Duty Free
title: Bandit Duty Free
lead:
Bandit Duty Free, owned by Noterazzo, is a general store located in the Wilderness Bandit Camp. It offers some of the best prices among general stores, initially buying items at their high alchemy value (60% of the base value) while most others buy at low alchemy value (40%).

If players ask Noterazzo about his store buying at high prices, he will explain that he can do so because the tax collector does not come to his store due to its dangerous location.

label: Bank booth
title: Bank booth
lead:
Bank booths are found throughout Gielinor in the majority of banks and allow access to the banking system. Bankers can be found behind most booths. Players can left-click the booth to access the bank or right-click the booth and "Collect" to gain access to their Grand Exchange listings where they can withdraw completed trades. However, players cannot make or cancel Grand Exchange offers from this menu.

Several bank booths are permanently closed. These cannot be used.

label: bank chest
title: bank chest
lead:
A bank chest is interactive scenery that allows quick access to a player's bank account, usually found in remote locations or places where a normal bank would not fit. Like any other banking facility it is indicated with a bank icon ( ).

Players can access their bank and their Grand Exchange collection boxes at bank-chests, but must visit a Banker to change their PIN settings or Grand Exchange offer notification settings.

label: Bank note
title: Bank note
lead:
A bank note or note is a stackable certificate that represents an item. It is equivalent in value to the item it represents, but cannot be used physically until exchanged for the real thing. Almost all tradeable items can be 'noted' and 'unnoted' in the bank interface, with very few exceptions (such as mysterious emblems).

Notes are useful for players who wish to trade large amounts of items at a time. They can also be used for training magic or for converting into coins via the Low or High Level Alchemy spells.

label: Bank table
title: Bank table
lead: Bank tables are decorative scenery commonly found in banks across Gielinor.

label: Banker
title: Banker
lead:
A banker works in a bank where players can safely store coins and items. Players can use coins on bankers to receive platinum tokens at a static rate of 1,000 coins per token. The bankers can also sell up to 450 bank spaces to the player in sets of 50 at a time, each set increasing in price as the player buys more spaces.

The bankers look different at various banks. Most of them are human, but those in Zanaris are fairies. Bankers in Arceuus are citizens of Arceuus. The ones in Cam Torum, at the Hunter Guild, Keldagrim, and Lovakengj are dwarves. In Port Phasmatys, they are ghost bankers. In Darkmeyer and Ver Sinhaza they are vampyres. On The Great Conch they are tortugans. Those in Lletya are elves; bankers found within the gnomish empire are gnomes; those in Dorgesh-Kaan are cave goblins, and the ones in Mor Ul Rek are TzHaar-Ket. They are not directly part of any quests. Players can speak to a banker either by clicking the banker or by clicking on the bank booth.

label: Banker (Al Kharid)
title: Banker (Al Kharid)
lead: These bankers run the Al Kharid branch of the Bank of Gielinor, and are located in the western part of the city.

label: Banker (Canifis)
title: Banker (Canifis)
lead: Bankers run the Canifis branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Like regular bankers, they provide access to the bank and collecting Grand Exchange offers.

label: Banker (Shilo Village)
title: Banker (Shilo Village)
lead: These bankers run the Shilo Village bank, located in the southern part of the city.

label: Banker (Tutorial Island)
title: Banker (Tutorial Island)
lead:
These bankers run the Tutorial Island branch of the Bank of Gielinor.

Unlike the rest of Gielinor's bankers, attempting to talk to them will open the bank interface instead.

label: Banker (Zanaris)
title: Banker (Zanaris)
lead: These bankers run the Zanaris branch of the Bank of Gielinor, and are located in the western part of the city.

label: Bar pumps
title: Bar pumps
lead: Bar pumps are scenery found inside some bars around Gielinor. They are for decorative purposes and serve no function.

label: Baraek
title: Baraek
lead: Baraek Brigson is a fur trader in the Varrock Square (the centre of Varrock) who owns a Fur stall, although you cannot steal from it. Baraek is also a member of the Phoenix Gang and plays a small role in the Shield of Arrav quest. If players wish to be in the Phoenix Gang, he must be bribed to reveal the location of their headquarters.

label: Barb bolttips
title: Barb bolttips
lead: Barb bolttips are bolt tips that are made into barbed bolts when used with bronze bolts, requiring 51 Fletching, yielding 95 Fletching experience per 10 bolts. 30 barb bolttips can be purchased for 140 archery tickets from the Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange in the Ranging Guild.

label: Barbarian (historical)
title: Barbarian (historical)
lead: Barbarian is an unused barbarian that was originally found at the Barbarian Village and Barbarian Outpost in the early stages of RuneScape 2. On 20 February 2006 the Barbarian Village was graphically updated, and its inhabitants were replaced by new Barbarians with unique names. While the original Barbarians remained at the Outpost, they too were replaced with the release of Barbarian Assault. As a result, the unused NPCs have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Barbarian guard
title: Barbarian guard
lead:
The Barbarian guard is a guard at the Barbarian Outpost. He does not let players in the Barbarian Outpost until they complete the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest. Unlike many other barbarians, he cannot be attacked. He stands next to the gate of the Barbarian Outpost, just east of the Barbarian Assault building.

Players who have completed Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl will gain the ability to automatically smash vials upon drinking the last dose of a potion. This ability can be toggled on or off by speaking to him or in settings.

label: Barbarian Outpost
title: Barbarian Outpost
lead:
The Barbarian Outpost is a fenced stronghold north-west of Baxtorian Falls and north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

Locals will address players who have completed The Fremennik Trials by their Fremennik name.

label: Barbarian Outpost Agility Course
title: Barbarian Outpost Agility Course
lead:
The Barbarian Outpost Agility Course is an Agility training area located in the Barbarian Outpost, available to players with level 35 Agility. Access to this course requires completion of the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest.

The Agility course rewards 153.3 Agility experience and 41.3 Strength experience per completed lap. With an average time of 32 seconds per lap (49 ticks if using additional clicks for tick-perfect), it is possible to get upwards of 18,000 Agility experience per hour from this course. At lower Agility levels expect to get around 11,000–14,000 Agility experience per hour, depending on concentration levels. In addition to experience, players will also receive marks of grace on this course.

label: Barbarian Village
title: Barbarian Village
lead: Barbarian Village is a small village south of Edgeville and west of Varrock. The entire village is a multicombat area containing many aggressive barbarians, so low level players are advised to proceed with caution. Players can enter the Stronghold of Security through a hole in the centre of the village.

label: Barbarian Village mine
title: Barbarian Village mine
lead:
The Barbarian Village mine in the centre of Barbarian Village has four coal and five tin rocks. At the centre of the mine is the entrance to the Stronghold of Security.

This mine has the closest free-to-play coal and tin rocks to a bank with no aggressive monsters and without any requirements to access.

label: Barbarian woman (historical)
title: Barbarian woman (historical)
lead:
Barbarian women were attackable NPCs that could previously be found at several locations. Following several updates they were gradually phased out of the game, and replaced by unique characters with mostly the same combat stats and drops.

Firstly, the Barbarian Village was graphically updated on 20 February 2006, and new Barbarians with distinct names and appearances were added. With the release of Barbarian Assault on 4 January 2007, the Barbarian women at the Barbarian Outpost were also replaced. This left just one Barbarian woman in the game, who could be found at the Blue Moon Inn; she too was replaced with the release of the Varrock graphical update. As a result, they were deleted from the game files, and have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Barbed bolts
title: Barbed bolts
lead:
Barbed bolts are bronze bolts with barbed tips. Barbed bolts can be created through the Fletching skill at level 51, simply by using barb bolttips with bronze bolts. 30 barbed bolt tips can be obtained from the Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange in the Ranging Guild in exchange for 140 archery tickets. For each barbed bolt tip attached to a bronze bolt, a player is granted 9.5 Fletching experience.

Barbed bolts can be shot from any standard crossbow, including the regular or Phoenix crossbow, so they may be used at level 1 Ranged as a superior version of bronze bolts. However, they both do less damage and are more expensive than opal bolts (e), so their usage is inadvised. Additionally, Ironmen require level 40 Ranged to enter the guild and buy the bolt tips, at which point much stronger weapons are available.

label: Barcrawl card
title: Barcrawl card
lead:
The barcrawl card records player's progress in the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest. It is given to player by the Barbarian guard when they first try to enter the Barbarian Outpost north of Baxtorian Falls. If players try to read the card after finishing the crawl they will be told: "You are too drunk to be able to read the barcrawl card."

Passing the Barcrawl test gives the player access to the outpost, although in order to access the agility course within they still require 35 agility.

label: Bark sample
title: Bark sample
lead: The bark sample is a sample of bark from the dying Grand Tree which you receive during The Grand Tree quest to have examined by Hazelmere, a gnome who lives near Yanille. Upon giving Hazelmere the bark sample, you must use the Translation book to find out what he is saying in order to find out why the Grand Tree is dying.

label: Barker
title: Barker
lead: Barker is a werewolf clothier and owns Barkers' Haberdashery in northern most building of Canifis. His shop is marked with a . He sells a selection of colourful robes.

label: Barkers' Haberdashery
title: Barkers' Haberdashery
lead: Barkers' Haberdashery is run by Barker. The shop sells an assortment of robe sets, gloves, and boots in five different colours; grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. He also sells five coloured capes; red, black, blue, yellow, and green.

label: Barmaid (historical)
title: Barmaid (historical)
lead:
Barmaids were two former bartenders who previously could be found at the Rising Sun Inn in Falador. During Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl, they would sell a Hand of Death Cocktail for 70 coins.

In 2006, Falador was graphically updated, and the Barmaids was replaced by three new characters named Emily, Kaylee, and Tina. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Barman (Blurberry Bar)
title: Barman (Blurberry Bar)
lead:
A barman is a gnome in the employment of Blurberry. They sell premade versions of Blurberry's cocktails.

Two can be found in Blurberry's Bar in the Grand Tree, and one can be found in the bar slightly east of the Gnome Ball field.

label: Barman (unused)
title: Barman (unused)
lead: The Barman is an unused NPC that was added to the game files in the RuneScape 2 beta. It is unknown what purpose he would have served, if any, since he lacks any chathead or options. He possibly may have appeared somewhere in East Ardougne.

label: Baroque
title: Baroque
lead: Baroque is a music track that is unlocked in East Ardougne.

label: Barrel (beer)
title: Barrel (beer)
lead:
Several types of beer barrel with a tap can be found all across the world, most commonly in pubs or kitchens. Out of these, only the plain barrels standing on the floor that have the examine text It's got ale in it. will allow the player to tap a beer by using an empty beer glass or Beer tankard on them. All other types of barrels, even those that refer to beer in the examine text, will not allow the player to obtain beer from them. Interestingly, even though the barrels in the Mess hall have a beer glass spawn right next to them, they cannot be used to tap a beer.

Players can also use a beer glass on the barbarian type, but this will cause all nearby Barbarians to become aggressive to the players, shouting . Players will also receive a message in their chat box saying The barbarians probably don't like people messing with their barrels.. The player will not be able to actually fill their glass on these barrels.

label: Barrel (Desert Mining Camp)
title: Barrel (Desert Mining Camp)
lead: Barrels can be found within the Desert Mining Camp, near the minecarts that lead deeper into the mine. During The Tourist Trap, the player must search the empty barrels to obtain a barrel item, which they then use to smuggle Ana out of the mine.

label: Barrel (Digsite)
title: Barrel (Digsite)
lead: The barrel is located in the southern part of the Digsite just to the west of the tent, and is primarily used during the quest The Dig Site. A player must use a trowel on the barrel in order to open it. The barrel is full of an orange liquid, which the player can obtain by using a vial on the opened barrel to receive unidentified liquid. The unidentified liquid can be taken to Terry Balando, the archaeological expert, to be identified as nitroglycerin. The barrel reseals itself after the player has completed going through the chat dialogue as a result of filling a vial.

label: Barrel (Fishing Trawler)
title: Barrel (Fishing Trawler)
lead:
Barrels are scenery objects that can be found in the water after a failed round of the Fishing Trawler minigame. Players can climb-on the north-western barrel within the trawler's boundary to exit the minigame; identifiable by the top of the barrel being parallel to the water. Attempting to climb-on another barrel will fail due to the player being unable to get a grip.

Leaving the minigame via the barrel will damage the player for 2 Hitpoints, and place them on a small peninsula east of the Tower of Life.

label: Barrel (god staves)
title: Barrel (god staves)
lead: Barrel can be found inside the sparkling pool inside the Mage Arena bank. It can't be interacted with, but shows off all three available god staves.

label: Barrel (Lumber Yard)
title: Barrel (Lumber Yard)
lead: Barrels are scenery objects found in the Lumber Yard, primarily used as decoy locations of Fluffs' kitten during the Gertrude's Cat quest. Searching the barrels will yield nothing.

label: Barrel (Plague City)
title: Barrel (Plague City)
lead:
The barrel is a scenery object found on the of the house where Elena is being held, located in the southern part of West Ardougne. Players must search the barrel during the Plague City quest in order to obtain a small key used to unlock the Elena's cell in the basement.

The barrel is also found in Varrock Sewers and can be used to obtain the small key during the quest.

label: Barrel (Shaman Caves)
title: Barrel (Shaman Caves)
lead: Barrels are found in the Shaman Caves accessed during and after Legends' Quest. They are located around the winch leading down to the Viyeldi caves. Smashing a barrel will reveal a random item, a random monster, or both.

label: Barrel (The Tourist Trap)
title: Barrel (The Tourist Trap)
lead:
A Barrel is a quest item which is obtained during The Tourist Trap.

Multiple empty barrels can be found around the mine cart and the lift and, according to Ana, is the only way rocks get out of the mines. This gives the player an idea and uses one of these barrels to get Ana out of the mines. Ana is forced into the barrel by the player, and is then taken to Irena.

label: Barrel of flour (Sinclair Mansion)
title: Barrel of flour (Sinclair Mansion)
lead:
Barrel of flour is used in the Murder Mystery quest, and is located inside the Sinclair Mansion's kitchen.

During the quest, players can use the barrel to fill their pots with flour, which then can be used to dust the criminal's dagger and various silver items belonging to the suspects inside the mansion in order to collect the fingerprints using flypaper found inside the gardener's shed outside the mansion.

label: Barstool
title: Barstool
lead: Barstools are scenery objects found in various bars across Gielinor. Players cannot interact with these barstools, but they can examine them.

label: Bartender (Blue Moon Inn)
title: Bartender (Blue Moon Inn)
lead:
The Bartender at the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock is a non-player character who serves the purpose of selling beer to players.

The bartender also seems to be one of the few NPCs who is aware that Old School RuneScape is a "computer game". This is an example of a character "breaking the fourth wall".

label: Bartender (Dancing Donkey Inn)
title: Bartender (Dancing Donkey Inn)
lead: The Bartender at the Dancing Donkey Inn in Varrock is a non-player character who serves beer to players for two coins.

label: Bartender (Dead Man's Chest)
title: Bartender (Dead Man's Chest)
lead: The bartender of the Dead Man's Chest bar in Brimhaven is a barman who can sell the player grog and Karamjan rum. He wears an eye patch and a leather body.

label: Bartender (Dragon Inn)
title: Bartender (Dragon Inn)
lead:
The bartender of the Dragon Inn plays a small role in the quest Zogre Flesh Eaters, where the players must show him the Dragon Inn tankard in order to learn that it once belonged to the late Brentle Vahn. He also features in Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl, where he sells the player a Fire Brandy for coins.

Additionally, it appears that the bartender is knowledgeable about the gossip of Yanille and its community, as he seems well acquainted with the gossip thereof. As such, during the quest he is able to reveal the whereabouts of Brentle prior to his "disappearance", and signs a portrait of Sithik Ints to verify his identity.

label: Bartender (Flying Horse Inn)
title: Bartender (Flying Horse Inn)
lead: The Bartender at the Flying Horse Inn, west of East Ardougne, is a non-player character who serves beer to players for two coins.

label: Bartender (Forester's Arms)
title: Bartender (Forester's Arms)
lead: The bartender at the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village is a NPC who serves beer, meat pies and stews.

label: Bartender (Jolly Boar Inn)
title: Bartender (Jolly Boar Inn)
lead: The bartender runs the Jolly Boar Inn outside Varrock, selling beer. If asked, he will tell players about another bartender who thinks RuneScape is a computer game.

label: Bartender (Rusty Anchor Inn)
title: Bartender (Rusty Anchor Inn)
lead: The bartender at the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim is a non-player character who serves beer to players for two coins.

label: Bass
title: Bass
lead:
Bass is a type of fish that restores 13 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw bass on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 43 Cooking and granting 130 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt fish. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 80 on both ranges and fires.

Bass are one of the fish required by Caleb in the quest Family Crest.

id: category:items exempt from grand exchange tax
label: Items exempt from Grand Exchange tax
Bat bones
title: Bat bones
lead:
Bat bones are a type of bone which are dropped by bats and giant bats. Players will need bat bones for some quests, including Merlin's Crystal, Forgettable Tale..., and Watchtower.

Bat bones give 5.3 Prayer experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 15.9 XP when casting Sinister Offering.
* 15.9 XP when offered at the sacred bone burner after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 18.5 XP when offered at a gilded altar with two burners lit or at the Chaos Temple.
* 21.2 XP when offered at the Ectofuntus in the form of bat bonemeal.
* 25 XP when blessed and broken down into blessed bone shards and offered at the libation bowl, or 30 XP when offered with a jug of blessed sunfire wine. Virilis outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.

label: Bath
title: Bath
lead: A bath is a scenery object found in various buildings throughout Gielinor. Players cannot interact with these baths, but they can examine them.

label: Bath pipes
title: Bath pipes
lead: Bath pipes can be found throughout Gielinor. Players cannot interact with the pipes but they can examine them.

label: Bathroom table
title: Bathroom table
lead: Bathroom tables are located in numerous buildings across Gielinor.

label: batta tin
title: batta tin
lead:
A batta tin is used for making battas in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. It can be obtained in the Grand Tree by buying from the Gnome Restaurant food shop owned by Hudo, by searching the nearby cupboard to find one, or by looting it from the gnomes in the stronghold.

If one gianne dough is added into the tin a raw batta is created, and if this is cooked over the gnome cooker or any other range, half baked batta will be made. From here, any of the battas in the gnome cuisine can be made. Examples of battas include worm batta, toad batta, cheese and tomato batta, fruit batta, and vegetable batta.

label: battered book
title: battered book
lead:
The battered book, titled Book of the Elemental Shield is a quest item used in Elemental Workshop I. It is found by searching the east bookcase in the building with a cooking range, south of the building with anvils in it in Seers' Village.

It is read to start the quest. When a knife or any slash weapon is used on it, the player will receive a battered key to get into the Workshop and the book will become a slashed book. The battered or slashed book also acts as a tool in the player's inventory to make elemental shields. After the Elemental Workshop II quest, mind shields can also be smithed.

label: Battered key
title: Battered key
lead:
The battered key is a quest item used in Elemental Workshop I. It is made by using a knife on a battered book. Additionally, it can be found by searching the bookcase where the battered book was originally found, only after creating a slashed book for the first time.

It is used to open the Odd looking wall in the building with the anvils in Seers' Village in order to access the workshop.

label: Battle mage
title: Battle mage
lead:
Battle mages are a group of wizards found in the Wilderness Mage Arena, loyal to either Guthix, Saradomin, or Zamorak. Players must fight them following the Mage Arena I miniquest in order to cast god spells outside of the arena.

While it's not required to fully kill any of the mages, players must cast the god spell of choice on them 100 times to unlock it. Since the god spells are fairly accurate, and the mages have 120 hitpoints, this usually means about 6-10 casts per kill. Note that these casts can be done in multiple trips; progress will not reset, and each spell's progression may be checked by talking to Kolodion in the Mage Arena bank.

label: Battlefield
title: Battlefield
lead:
The Battlefield (also known as the Khazard Battlefield and The Battlefield of Khazard) is located south of West Ardougne, and north of Tree Gnome Village. The forces of the gnomes and the Khazard Army are in an endless battle, similar to the God Wars Dungeon and Goblin Village. To the north is a passageway by the southern edge of West Ardougne. Up the passageway is the Khazard warlord (level 112).

The battlefield is separated by a small river (with three bridges), with the gnomes on the south side (by Tree Gnome Village), and the Khazard Army on the north side. From the appearance of the battlefield and the condition of the fortress, the gnomes have dealt a significant amount of damage to General Khazard's forces; isolating them from other Khazard territories like the Fight Arena and Port Khazard.

label: Battlefield mine
title: Battlefield mine
lead: The Battlefield mine is located to the south of West Ardougne and west of the Khazard Battlefield. This mine is rarely used, as the nearest bank is in East Ardougne. Aside from copper and tin rocks, it also contains many rocks that never contain any ore. Because it is extremely small and relatively secluded, many players are unaware of its existence.

label: Battlement (Gu'Tanoth)
title: Battlement (Gu'Tanoth)
lead: Battlement is an obstacle found on the outer wall of Gu'Tanoth. During the Watchtower quest, the player must bribe the nearby ogre guards with a rock cake to be allowed to pass.

label: Battlement (Toban's island)
title: Battlement (Toban's island)
lead:
Battlements are the edges of a broken bridge that links the mainland to Toban's island east of Gu'Tanoth. Because the bridge is unusable, the only way to access the island is through through tunnels beneath Gu'Tanoth.

The battlement's misleading name and examine are a remnant of an older design of the area, in which they made up a low wall at the end of the broken bridge.

label: Battlestaff
title: Battlestaff
lead:
A battlestaff is a members-only magic weapon which provides standard magical bonuses, heightened melee bonuses, and the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield. Due to not having any elemental features, this staff has limited long-term use. Its advantage over basic tier elemental staves and other lesser staves are its melee and magic bonuses.

The staff can be purchased from Zaff's Superior Staffs! in Varrock after the completion of the quest What Lies Below, and he'll stock 15 to 120 extra staves daily for players who have fully completed task tiers of the Varrock Diary (they can be obtained by interacting with the barrel in the north-west corner of the shop). The magic store owner in the Wizards' Guild and Baba Yaga on the Lunar Isle also stock them. It can also be bought on the Grand Exchange, obtained through other players, dropped by various enemies, or fletched from Celastrus bark with level 40 Fletching.

label: Baxtorian Falls
title: Baxtorian Falls
lead: The Baxtorian Falls is a small series of water rapids flowing southwards from the Lunar Sea to the River Dougne, featured in the Waterfall Quest. Baxtorian Falls is a part of the Kingdom of Kandarin, north-west of Ardougne, and east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Under the rapids is the Waterfall Dungeon, which is also heavily featured in the Waterfall Quest. At the top of the Falls, there is a dock leading up to a whirlpool. Players who have completed the required portions of the Barbarian Training miniquest can jump into this whirlpool where they will be swept down to the entrance of the Ancient Cavern.

label: Bay window
title: Bay window
lead: A bay window is found on the building containing the southern entrance to the Yanille Agility dungeon.

label: Beads of the dead
title: Beads of the dead
lead: The beads of the dead are used during the Shilo Village quest to enter safely into Rashiliyia's Tomb. It is made by using bone beads on bronze wire. If lost, you can obtain another necklace from Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 1,200 coins. He will also buy the necklace for 1,000 coins.

label: Bear fur
title: Bear fur
lead:
Bear fur is an item obtained by killing a bear. It can be sold to Baraek for 12 coins, or 20 with the ring of charos. Bears are located in, among other places, north-east of East Ardougne, the Wilderness, near Goblin Village, in Isafdar, east of Varrock and north of Falador. Bear fur can also be purchased from the fur merchant in the marketplace in East Ardougne.

Although the examine text says, "This would make warm clothing," currently no clothing can actually be made by players from the fur. Wooden cats, used in the The Great Brain Robbery quest, can be made with bear fur.

label: Beckon
title: Beckon
lead:
Beckon is the ninth listed emote. Upon use the player waves their hand towards them.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Bed (Shaman Caves)
title: Bed (Shaman Caves)
lead: A Bed can be found in the first room of the Shaman Caves and can be searched for a Scrumpled note during the Legends' Quest.

label: Bedabin Camp
title: Bedabin Camp
lead:
The Bedabin Camp is a very small nomad camp south-west of Al Kharid and the Kalphite Lair. It is visited during the Tourist Trap quest and is the starting point of the Desert Treasure I quest. The Bedabin Camp is also a destination that can be flown to using the Magic carpet transportation system from the Shantay Pass.

The Bedabins are known as a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers, and are often nicknamed "Tenti's" because they live in tents. They are renowned for surviving in harsh desert climates, and also for growing the renowned Bedabin ambrosia, or Tenti pineapple. The pineapples are grown in a secret location in order to stop thieves from raiding them.

label: Bedabin key
title: Bedabin key
lead: The Bedabin key is a key used during the Tourist Trap quest to open a chest in Captain Siad's room. It can be obtained from the Bedabin Camp north-west of Pollnivneach.

label: Bedabin Nomad
title: Bedabin Nomad
lead: Bedabin Nomads can be found in the Bedabin Camp, in which they sell a variety or desert survival items in their store, Bedabin Village Bartering. Although there are several nomads in the camp that offer to trade, the stock is shared among them.

label: Bedabin Nomad Guard
title: Bedabin Nomad Guard
lead: The Bedabin Nomad Guard guards the tent containing an experimental anvil used to make a dart for the Tourist Trap quest. Players cannot enter this area after completion of the quest. The guard appears to wielding an iron scimitar and wearing desert robes.

label: Bedabin Village Bartering
title: Bedabin Village Bartering
lead: Bedabin Village Bartering is a shop in the Bedabin Camp, run by the Bedabin Nomads. The Bartering store sells some basic items like a general store, but will not buy any non-stocked items from players. Although there are several nomads in the camp that offers to trade, the stock is shared among them.

label: Bedroom door
title: Bedroom door
lead: Bedroom door is a door found in Guidor and Julie's home in south-east Varrock. The door is encounted during the Biohazard quest. It cannot be opened unless the player is wearing priest gowns.

label: beehive
title: beehive
lead: A beehive is a piece of interactive scenery where players can obtain buckets of wax, used in Merlin's Crystal and Troll Romance, provided they have insect repellent in their inventory or are wearing a full set of the beekeeper's outfit. If they do not, the player will be stung by bees, take 2 hitpoints of damage and not receive the item they were going after.

label: Beer
title: Beer
lead: Beer is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Strength by 2% + 1, while draining Attack by 6% + 1. Unlike other ales, it cannot be created through brewing.

label: Beer glass
title: Beer glass
lead:
Beer glasses are obtained by drinking certain beverages (such as beer), or from the shelves in the Sorceress's house. Although you can also get a variant of beer glass from the kitchen shelves (Wooden shelves 2 or higher) of a player-owned house, they will disappear upon leaving the house. The barmaids in the Rising Sun Inn buy empty beer glasses for coins each.

A quick way to acquire beer glasses would be to buy drinks in the Burthorpe pub The Toad and Chicken, then go down into the Rogues' Den, and repeat. Drink afterwards. Another method to obtain them quickly is by searching the wall shelves in the Sorceress' house (from the Sorceress's Garden minigame), in the very south-east of Al-Kharid.

label: Beggar
title: Beggar
lead: The beggar is a character encountered only during Merlin's Crystal. During the quest the player is sent by the mysterious Lady of the Lake to the jewellery shop in Port Sarim for instructions for a task. The player is met instead by the beggar, who is hungry and asks for some bread. It is later discovered that he is the Lady of the Lake in disguise, testing the player to see if they are worthy and kind enough to wield Excalibur.

label: Bell (unused object)
title: Bell (unused object)
lead: The Bell is an unused object added to the game during the RuneScape 2 beta. It formed a contraption along with the Bell mechanism and the Bell rope. It is unknown where the bell would have appeared, or why it was removed before release.

label: Bell mechanism
title: Bell mechanism
lead: The Bell mechanism is an unused object added to the game during the RuneScape 2 beta. It formed a contraption along with the Bell and the Bell rope. It is unknown where the bell mechanism would have appeared, or why it was removed before release.

label: Bell rope
title: Bell rope
lead: The Bell rope is an unused object added to the game during the RuneScape 2 beta. It formed a contraption along with the Bell and the Bell mechanism. It is unknown where the bell rope would have appeared, or why it was removed before release.

label: Bellows (Elemental Workshop)
title: Bellows (Elemental Workshop)
lead: The Bellows are found in the elemental workshop near the air elementals. During the Elemental Workshop I quest, they need to be repaired with 20 Crafting using leather, a needle and thread which can be found in crates nearby.

label: Belt buckle
title: Belt buckle
lead: A belt buckle can be found while using a trowel on the soil in the level 3 dig site in the north-eastern Digsite, along with a specimen brush and a specimen jar in the inventory. When shown to Terry Balando, he says "I should imagine it came from a guard." Currently the belt buckle has no uses. It is not worth anything, therefore it is advised to simply drop it as soon as it is obtained.

label: Berry
title: Berry
lead:
Berry is a troll that guards the prison in the Troll Stronghold. During the Troll Stronghold quest, players must either fight or pickpocket him (requiring 30 Thieving) to obtain the cell key 2, which opens the cell where Eadgar is held.

He is normally sleeping, but if pickpocketing fails, he wakes up and attacks the player.

label: Bervirius notes
title: Bervirius notes
lead:
The bervirius notes is a quest item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by searching the dolmen in Tomb of Bervirius. The notes must be given to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai Village.

When clicked, it will give you an option to read a Tattered Yellow papyrus, a Crusty Orange papyrus, or a Decayed White papyrus.

label: Betty
title: Betty
lead:
Betty is the owner of Betty's Magic Emporium in Port Sarim. She is the only character selling eyes of newt in free-to-play worlds.

Betty features in The Hand in the Sand and While Guthix Sleeps quests by assisting with the creation of pink dye.

label: Betty's Magic Emporium.
title: Betty's Magic Emporium.
lead: Betty's Magic Emporium is located in Port Sarim and owned by Betty. Free players must visit this store to buy an eye of newt for the Witch's Potion quest.

label: Beyond
title: Beyond
lead: Beyond is a music track that is unlocked in the White Wolf Tunnel, the Ice Queen's Lair under White Wolf Mountain, or the basement of the Warriors' Guild.

label: Big bones
title: Big bones
lead:
Big bones are a bigger variant of bones. They are always dropped by certain large monsters including giants, ogres, trolls, cyclopes, and the lizards in the Kharidian Desert just north of Nardah. A few spawns of big bones can also be found in the Bone Yard in the Wilderness, and in the area around the Colossal Wyrm Remains located in Varlamore's Avium Savannah.

Big bones are also used to charge teleports on the giantsoul amulet, with each set of big bones and a law rune providing one teleport charge. Players can exchange excess amulets for 30 bones by speaking to the Odd Old Man with the amulets in their inventory.

label: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
title: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
lead: Big Chompy Bird Hunting is a quest in which you help Rantz the ogre catch a chompy bird so that he may feed his children.

label: Big Chords
title: Big Chords
lead: Big Chords is a music track that is unlocked west of Yanille.

label: Big Dave
title: Big Dave
lead:
Big Dave is one of the competitors in the Fishing Contest quest.

Prior to aforementioned quest he was the current champion, but was then overthrown by the player. He won't give up his fishing spot, because it is his "lucky fishing spot".

label: Big egg
title: Big egg
lead: Big eggs are dragon eggs found in some locations with large amounts of dragons. They can be found by the lava dragons on Lava Dragon Isle, by the iron and steel dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon, and by the blue dragons in Taverley Dungeon.

label: Big fish (random event)
title: Big fish (random event)
lead: The big fish was a random event. While fishing, a large fish would sometimes appear in a fishing spot and eat the player's fishing equipment, then spit it somewhere nearby, usually 3 to 10 squares away. When this happened, the player had to find their equipment quickly before someone else saw it and took it or it would disappear. When the player had found the equipment, then they could go back to fishing. When this event happened, the fishing spot would usually move to a new location as well.

label: Big fishing net
title: Big fishing net
lead:
A big fishing net can be purchased from various fishing shops. It is mainly used on Net/Harpoon fishing spots, however there are two different big net fishing spots available at Camdozaal and Civitas illa Fortis. Because of the large variety of practically worthless fish and other objects that will quickly fill the player's inventory while fishing in this way, it is rarely used other than for the bass it produces, which may be used with a ring of charos (a) to re-enchant lyres, or caskets which may rarely contain half keys or higher-level talismans.

If a player is lucky, the net may catch multiple (2-9) fish and/or items at once. Each fish/item has one roll, except for raw mackerel which has two. The net is also able to catch big bass. Wearing a skills necklace with at least one charge while big net fishing will slightly increase the chance of finding a casket.

label: Big Wolf
title: Big Wolf
lead: The Big Wolf is a canine monster found around the White Wolf Mountain and in the Feldip Hills. It is a stronger version of a normal wolf. It can prove deadly to low-level players who encounter it among its pack. Big wolves do not share the appearance of the wolves in their region.

label: Billy
title: Billy
lead:
Billy is a mountain goat who is found within the fencing of Tenzing's house.

A second Billy was discovered in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, located on a small island in the north-eastern corner of Great Kourend's Port Piscarilius.

label: Billy Rehnison
title: Billy Rehnison
lead: Billy Rehnison is a boy in West Ardougne. He is the son of Ted and Martha Rehnison. He is the brother of Milli Rehnison. Their house is in the north-east of the city.

label: Bind
title: Bind
lead:
Bind is a level 20 Magic spell located in the Standard spellbook. Casting bind on an opponent will prevent it from moving for 8 ticks (4.8 seconds). When used on a player and the bind is about to wear off, the bound player will receive this message in their chatbox: The holding effect is beginning to fade. Players can increase the binding duration by equipping swampbark armour; the helm, body, and legs will increase the duration by 2 ticks (1.2 seconds) each, up to a maximum of 14 ticks (8.4 seconds).

Bind gives 31 Magic experience if it successfully hits the target, or 30 experience if it splashes. It requires two nature, three earth, and three water runes to be cast.

label: Binding book
title: Binding book
lead:
The binding book is an integral part of the Legends' Quest. It contains information on demons and can also create enchanted vials, which are required to make holy water.

To get the book, go into the mossy rock and make sure you have the "SMELL" runes: 1 soul rune, 1 mind rune, 1 earth rune, and 2 law runes. In addition, bring a cut sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond, red topaz, jade, and opal to place onto certain spots in the cave. For more details, please see this section on the quest guide.

label: Biohazard
title: Biohazard
lead: Biohazard continues the storyline after the Plague City quest. The plot deepens as Elena finally gets a chance to process her plague samples. Buried under these samples lies a well-hidden secret.

label: Bird feed
title: Bird feed
lead:
Bird feed is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is found by searching the cupboard in Jerico's house, immediately south of the northern bank in East Ardougne.

It is thrown onto the watchtower fence to cause a distraction by releasing the pigeons from the pigeon cage, in order for the player to climb the rope ladder near Omart to access West Ardougne.

label: Black 2h sword
title: Black 2h sword
lead:
The black 2h sword is a two-handed sword stronger than the steel 2h sword, requiring level 10 Attack to wield. Players can purchase this two-handed sword from Gaius' Two Handed Shop in Taverley. It can also be a reward from the Observatory Quest, from the Shades of Mort'ton minigame, completing a Treasure Trail or as a drop from various monsters.

As with all black and white equipment, the black 2h sword cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.

label: Black amulet (interface item)
title: Black amulet (interface item)
lead: The black amulet is an interface item. It can be seen in the interface for crafting jewellery. If the player does not have the correct gem to craft an amulet, the black amulet appears in its place as a greyed out version.

label: Black Arm Gang
title: Black Arm Gang
lead:
The Black Arm Gang is a gang at war with the Phoenix Gang. Their headquarters is situated in the south-west of Varrock, near the city's southern entrance. The Black Arm Gang operates under the front of a financial advice company.

According to the Phoenix Gang leader, Straven, the Black Arm Gang was formed when some Phoenix Gang members mutinied and branched off into a separate gang. They broke the Shield of Arrav in two during the process, taking the right half with them.

label: Black Arm Gang Headquarters
title: Black Arm Gang Headquarters
lead:
The Black Arm Gang Headquarters is located in the south-western part of Varrock, near the southern entrance to to city. The building is the headquarters for the ruthless and notorious Black Arm Gang. It is inhabited by three thieves, and Katrine Raven, the leader of the Black Arm Gang. The first two rooms are accessible by any player, however the back room and upstairs are locked for anyone who isn't a Black Arm Gang member.

Players must visit the location to speak to Katrine during the Shield of Arrav quest if they wish to join the Black Arm Gang. During the quest, players who are part of the Black Arm Gang must search the cupboard located upstairs to retrieve the right half of the Shield of Arrav.

label: Black axe
title: Black axe
lead:
A black axe is an item mostly used in the Woodcutting skill. Using this axe requires level 11 Woodcutting. Level 10 Attack is required to equip it. As with all axes, carrying it in your inventory along with the necessary Woodcutting level will work.

The success rate for chopping a log is approximately 225% that of the bronze axe, or 12.5% better than a steel axe.

label: Black axe head
title: Black axe head
lead:
The black axe head is an unobtainable item that was originally used in the axe handle random event. The axe head would become detached from the player's axe while Woodcutting. To fix their axe, players had to collect the axe head off the ground and reattach it to the axe handle.

A similar event used to happen to players while Mining, but with a pickaxe head and pickaxe handle.

label: black battleaxe
title: black battleaxe
lead:
The black battleaxe is a battleaxe stronger than the steel battleaxe, but weaker than the Mithril battleaxe. It requires 10 Attack to wield. Players can purchase this battleaxe from Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar in Port Sarim. It can also be received as a drop from a Dark beast, and as a reward from a beginner clue scroll or easy clue scroll.

As with all black and white equipment, the black battleaxe cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.

label: black bead
title: black bead
lead:
The Black bead is a bead used in Imp Catcher quest. It is a drop from Imps and is returned to Wizard Mizgog in the Wizards' Tower along with White bead, Red bead and Yellow bead to finish the quest.

The bead can also be used to bait traps when hunting imps.

label: black bear
title: black bear
lead:
Black bears are large monsters that can be found in forests and are the weaker, non-aggressive cousins of the aggressive grizzly bear.

Despite their non-aggression, they can pose a threat to newer players who accidentally attack them, although safespots can usually be found for rangers and mages.

label: black beret
title: black beret
lead:
The black beret is a hat that can be obtained from Easy Treasure Trails. They provide no stat bonuses and are worn purely for cosmetic purposes. There's other variants: the white beret, blue beret and red beret.

Black berets can be attached to a mime mask to make a beret mask by talking to Patchy on Mos Le'Harmless, along with 500 coins. Doing so requires the completion of Cabin Fever and a book o' piracy.

label: Black candle
title: Black candle
lead:
A black candle is a light source used in the Merlin's Crystal quest.

During Merlin's Crystal, in exchange for sparing Sir Mordred's life, Morgan Le Faye details how to free Merlin, requiring a black candle among other things. The Candle maker in Catherby offers to make one if the player brings him a bucket of wax. Once all the other items are obtained, it is lit with a tinderbox when inside the magical symbol, inside the fence on the north-east side of Camelot Castle. After the remaining items are used, and with the correct incantation, Thrantax the Mighty is summoned for the player to command to free Merlin.

label: Black cape
title: Black cape
lead: A black cape is a low-level cape that is commonly obtained by killing a highwayman. It can also be made by using black dye on any coloured cape, and can be purchased from Barkers' Haberdashery in Canifis and Shayzien Styles in Shayzien.

label: Black cavalier
title: Black cavalier
lead:
The black cavalier is a piece of headwear. There are no requirements for wearing this cavalier, and they do not confer combat bonuses upon the player.

A cavalier of any colour is a potential reward from hard Treasure Trails.

label: Black chainbody
title: Black chainbody
lead:
The black chainbody is stronger than the steel chainbody, and can be worn by players with 10 Defence. Players can purchase this item at the Keldagrim and Falador Chainmail shops. This item cannot be made using the Smithing skill, and has the same bonuses as a white chainbody, except it lacks a prayer bonus.

Sold at Wayne's Chains shop in southern Falador for 1,440 coins, and at Saro's armour shop in Keldagrim for 1,872 coins.

label: Black claws
title: Black claws
lead:
Black claws are a fast two-handed melee weapon. To wield them, a player must have at least level 10 Attack. They can only be obtained as a monster drop.

As with all black and white equipment, the black claws cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.

label: Black cog
title: Black cog
lead:
The black cog is a quest item used only in Clock Tower. It is found in a burning room in the Clock Tower's basement, requiring a bucket of water in the inventory, or ice gloves or smiths gloves (i) equipped to pick up.

It is used to repair the eastern black clock spindle in the basement.

label: Black d'hide body
title: Black d'hide body
lead:
Black d'hide body is a part of the black dragonhide armour set. It requires at least level 70 Ranged and 40 Defence to be worn.

It is the strongest standard dragonhide body and is among the most resilient armours against Magic damage. However, Blessed dragonhide armour provides higher defensive stats while maintaining the same offensive stats.

label: Black d'hide chaps
title: Black d'hide chaps
lead:
Black d'hide chaps are a piece of the black dragonhide armour set, and require level 70 Ranged to wear. Similarly to other dragonhide chaps, they have no Defence level requirement.

A player with 82 Crafting can make them using 2 black dragon leather and 1 thread with a needle, granting 172 experience.

label: Black d'hide vambraces
title: Black d'hide vambraces
lead:
Black d'hide vambraces are a piece of black d'hide armour worn in the hand slot, which require 70 Ranged to wear.

Kebbit claws can be used on these vambraces to make black spiky vambraces, requiring a Crafting level of 32.

label: Black dagger
title: Black dagger
lead:
The black dagger is a dagger slightly more accurate than the steel dagger. Like most daggers it can be poisoned, giving an advantage in combat. Like all black weapons, wielding it requires an Attack level of 10.

As with all black and white equipment, the black dagger cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.

label: Black dart
title: Black dart
lead:
Black darts are ranged throwing weapons. To wield black darts, players must have at least level 10 Ranged.
Black darts cannot be made with the Fletching skill and instead are obtained through monster drops. The only monsters to drop black darts are Burthorpe soldiers. This makes black darts rather rare and hard to obtain. Black darts can be poisoned and they can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

label: black demon
title: black demon
lead:
Black demons are large demons that inhabit various dungeons throughout Gielinor. They are weak to demonbane weapons; as with most demons, they are also weak to magical attacks.

A unique black demon is defeated during The Grand Tree. This demon can be re-fought in the Nightmare Zone after the quest has been completed. Black demons as well as Scarred black demons can be found in The Scar.

label: Black demon (The Grand Tree)
title: Black demon (The Grand Tree)
lead:
A unique Black demon is summoned by Glough during The Grand Tree. This demon can be re-fought in the Nightmare Zone after the quest has been completed.

Players can either fight the demon using melee, or hide in a safespot and use ranged, magic, or a halberd. If the demon is not killed within 8-9 minutes, it will disappear and players will have to start the battle all over again.

label: black dragon
title: black dragon
lead:
Black dragons are the most powerful adult chromatic dragons. As with all adult dragons, protection from dragonfire (such as an anti-dragon shield) is recommended when fighting them, although like other common chromatic dragons, they only use dragonfire at melee range.

Black dragons are the only common chromatic dragons that drop the draconic visage. Notably, the stronger level 247 variant in the Wilderness Slayer Cave drops the draconic visage at a rate of 1/5,000, the most common out of any dragon tied with the King Black Dragon and Vorkath.

label: Black dragon leather
title: Black dragon leather
lead: Black dragon leather is used in the Crafting skill to make black d'hide armour. It can be created by giving a black dragonhide and 20 coins to a tanner (45 coins at Sbott in Canifis). Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Forthos Dungeon, Canifis, Auburnvale, and the Crafting Guild. Alternatively, black dragon leather can be made using the Tan Leather spell. Crafting any piece of black dragonhide armour will grant the player 86 experience per hide.

label: Black dragonhide
title: Black dragonhide
lead: Black dragonhide (also called Black d'hide by tanners) is a 100% drop from black dragons, brutal black dragons, lava dragons, and the King Black Dragon. The hide can be tanned to become black dragon leather by paying a tanner or by using the Tan Leather lunar spell. A tanner will charge 20 coins for each hide, or 45 in Canifis. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Canifis, the Crafting Guild, Auburnvale, and Forthos Dungeon.

label: Black flowers
title: Black flowers
lead:
Black flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds. Players have a 2/1,001 chance of obtaining a black flower when harvesting from a mithril or adamant seed.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Black full helm
title: Black full helm
lead:
The black full helm is a full helmet that requires 10 Defence to equip. As with all black armour, it cannot be made using the Smithing skill. It can be bought at Valaine's Shop of Champions in the Champions' Guild for 1,372 coins. It can also be obtained as a Treasure Trails reward.

A black full helm is used in King's Ransom and, if you're part of the Black Arm Gang, Heroes' Quest.

label: Black full helm (g)
title: Black full helm (g)
lead: Black full helm (g) is a part of black gold-trimmed armour and a reward from easy Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Black full helm, and requires level 10 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Black full helm (t)
title: Black full helm (t)
lead: Black full helm (t) is a part of black trimmed armour and a reward from easy Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal black full helm, and requires level 10 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Black headband
title: Black headband
lead: The black headband is a members only item worn on the head. There are no requirements to wear it. Aside from its use in hard Treasure Trails, it is purely cosmetic, meaning it does not offer any combat bonuses.

label: Black Heather
title: Black Heather
lead:
Black Heather is a member of the leading trio of Bandits in the Wilderness Bandit Camp in levels 24-31 of the Wilderness, along with Donny the lad and Speedy Keith. She, like the other two leaders, wields a steel scimitar.

If players attempt to talk to her, they will receive a message stating, "Black Heather is not interested in talking."

label: Black kiteshield
title: Black kiteshield
lead:
The black kiteshield is a Black Knight kiteshield that requires 10 Defence to wield. The black kiteshield has the same defensive bonuses as a white kiteshield, but without the +1 prayer bonus.

The black kiteshield can be found in trimmed and heraldic forms from Treasure Trails.

label: Black kiteshield (g)
title: Black kiteshield (g)
lead: Black kiteshield (g) is a part of black gold-trimmed armour and a reward from easy Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal black kiteshield, except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 10 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Black kiteshield (t)
title: Black kiteshield (t)
lead: Black kiteshield (t) is a part of black trimmed armour and a reward from easy Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Black kiteshield, except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 10 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: black knife
title: black knife
lead:
The black knife is a throwing knife that requires a Ranged level of 10 to wield. It is stronger than a steel knife but weaker than a mithril knife. As with all black equipment, this item cannot be made via the Smithing skill. A black knife must either be obtained as a monster drop, or bought from another player. They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Throwing knives are among the fastest weapons in the game (along with darts), and are commonly used for PKing or training Ranged.

label: Black Knight
title: Black Knight
lead:
Black knights, also known as the Kinshra, are Zamorakian warriors found mainly in their fortress and stronghold. They are central to the Black Knights' Fortress quest.

Once Wanted! has been completed, black knights can be slain in order to increase the player's White Knight rank. As their rank gets higher, they unlock more white equipment. Even though the quest, as well as white equipment, is only for members, non-members are still able to increase their rank.

label: Black Knight Captain
title: Black Knight Captain
lead:
The Black Knight Captain is a prominent member of the Kinshra order in north-eastern Asgarnia. The captain can be seen in an inaccessible part of the Black Knights' Fortress on Ice Mountain, alongside Greldo, a witch and her black cat.

When players listen through the grills, the above persons can be heard plotting to a make a potion to assist in the destruction of the White Knights. Even in the conversation he has with the witch, the captain does not speak much.

label: Black Knight Titan
title: Black Knight Titan
lead:
The Black Knight Titan is a hill giant encountered during the Holy Grail quest. He is reasonably powerful for his level; but his attacks are inaccurate and very slow. He should be fought with Melee, as he has incredibly high Ranged and Magic defence. He does not move from his tile.

If the player is not holding Excalibur as his hitpoints reach 0, he regenerates back to full hitpoints and players must kill him again. This means either the finishing blow must be dealt using Excalibur, or (if using a delayed attack such as magic or ranged) Excalibur must be switched to before the blow hits him. Since the titan is immobile, players with a fast weapon may employ a hit-and-run technique to kill the titan without being hit. Players can also use a halberd from two squares away to melee him without taking damage.

label: Black Knights' Base
title: Black Knights' Base
lead:
The Black Knights' Base is a Kinshra base in the far south of Taverley Dungeon. The base has two main areas, and both are swarming with black knights. In the top right of the first area is a kitchen, with a sink and a range. In the far right area of the second compartment is the jail. To gain access to the jail cells, the jailer must be killed; his combat level is 47. Inside the south cell is Velrak the explorer, who can give the player a dusty key which gives access shortcuts in the dungeon.
