The Chaos Temple (AKA Zamorak Temple) in the Wilderness is a temple of Zamorak located around level 11 Wilderness, north of Varrock. The easiest way of getting there is using a burning amulet. The entire building is near-completely surrounded by molten lava. It contains many spawns of bones. Free players may use these bone respawn points at a lower Prayer level to raise Prayer, especially if the player has low Combat and cannot efficiently raise Prayer from killing monsters such as Hill Giants.

For members, a hunting location with black salamanders can be found north-east of the temple. The temple itself also becomes significantly more dangerous in members' worlds, as it is populated by numerous elder chaos druids that can deal hefty damage and frequently teleport players to them, making escape very hard if multiple druids are attacking a player. Many zombie pirates also spawn around the temple, frequently engaging the druids.

label: Charcoal
title: Charcoal
lead: Charcoal is used as a writing and sketching tool in quests. It is often used with papyrus.

label: Charge
title: Charge
lead:
Charge is a spell used to empower the god spells from the Mage Arena. Unlike the god spells themselves, which require level 60 Magic to cast, charge requires level 80 Magic. When cast, the player becomes imbued with magical power, and for the next seven minutes (700 game ticks) god spells will deal up to 30 damage per cast, instead of the usual 20. The respective god cape must be worn for the charge effect to work. Unequipping and reequipping the god cape still provides the bonus as long as the seven minute timer has not elapsed.

Charge can only be cast once every 60 seconds, preventing players from gaining Magic experience at an incredible rate. On activation "You feel charged with magic power" appears in the chat box and when the spell expires, "Your magical charge fades away" appears.

label: Charge Air Orb
title: Charge Air Orb
lead:
Charge Air Orb is a spell which can be cast on the Air Obelisk above Edgeville Dungeon, turning an unpowered orb into an air orb. It requires 66 Magic to cast, at which point it will autocast every 3.6 seconds. Players can speed up this time by casting it manually for each orb; it is possible to gain up to 40,000 Magic experience per hour using the spell in this way.

Using an air orb on a battlestaff makes an air battlestaff, requiring 66 Crafting and granting 137.5 Crafting experience. Charging an air orb is a hard task for the Wilderness Diary.

label: Charge Earth Orb
title: Charge Earth Orb
lead:
Charge Earth Orb is an enchantment spell that requires a Magic level of 60 to cast. It can only be cast at the earth obelisk in the Wilderness area of Edgeville Dungeon, south of the Black demons in the area where Chronozon is found.

If you have an unpowered orb and the correct runes in your inventory, each cast will create an earth orb, which yields 70 Magic experience.

label: Charge Fire Orb
title: Charge Fire Orb
lead:
Charge Fire Orb is an enchantment spell that requires a Magic level of 63 to use. It can only be cast on a fire obelisk, deep in the Taverley Dungeon after passing the ladder to the water obelisk and the two black dragons in the dungeon on the main floor.

When you have an unpowered orb and the correct runes in your inventory, it will turn each orb into a fire orb.

label: Charge Water Orb
title: Charge Water Orb
lead:
Charge Water Orb is an enchantment spell that requires a Magic level of 56 to cast. It can only be used on the Obelisk of Water, located on an island in Catherby bay, accessed by climbing a ladder in Taverley Dungeon very close to the water obelisk. Each cast will turn an unpowered orb in the player's inventory into a water orb.

Using a water orb on a battlestaff makes a water battlestaff. This requires 54 Crafting and gives 100 Crafting experience.

label: Charlie (prisoner)
title: Charlie (prisoner)
lead:
Charlie is a man held prisoner for allegedly trying to poison The Grand Tree. He is held in the cell at the top of the Grand Tree.

He was hired by Glough to act as a deliveryman, such as transporting gold to the Ship Yard and transporting Daconia rocks from Hazelmere to the Grand Tree, and had been doing so for some time before he was imprisoned. Glough denied this and used Charlie's possession of the rocks to convince King Narnode Shareen that the humans planned to invade. He was later released when Glough was caught with the rocks.

label: Charlie the cook
title: Charlie the cook
lead: Charlie the cook is the chef (and part owner) of The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven. He is also a member of the Phoenix Gang, and plays a role in the Heroes' Quest. During the quest, the player has to give him the password "Gherkin" to assure him that they are a member of his gang; he will then tell the player about a secret panel in the kitchen.

label: Charlie the Tramp
title: Charlie the Tramp
lead:
Charlie Lyeman the Tramp (or Charles E. Trampin) is a tramp that tells the player about the Black Arm Gang headquarters during the Shield of Arrav quest. He is found right next to the southern entrance to Varrock, at the end of the alleyway to the Black Arm Gang's headquarters. If players choose to do so they may donate a coin or two to him.

He has a cousin named Marley, who the player seeks out as part of the quest Below Ice Mountain.

label: chart
title: chart
lead: A chart is used for coordinate clues for Treasure Trails. It is used along with a watch and sextant if one wishes to find a coordinate clue. A chart can be obtained from the Observatory professor at the Observatory. It is not necessary to have a sextant and a watch to obtain the chart. The drop trick can be used to obtain multiple charts if desired.

label: Cheer
title: Cheer
lead:
Cheer is the eighth emote listed. Upon use the player move their arms up and down in the air, depicting cheering.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Cheerleader
title: Cheerleader
lead:
Cheerleaders are found next to the Gnome Ball minigame. They tell players when they have scored a goal (they will shout "Goal!" and dance around) in the minigame. When players have won they will do a similar dance and shout "You Win!"

Cheerleaders dressed in orange, purple, and dark grey could be seen at Death's party after completing the 2015 Halloween event, and green-skinned cheerleaders dressed in red, blue, and spring green could be found in the Realm of Memories after completing the 20th Anniversary event and 25th Anniversary event.

label: Cheese
title: Cheese
lead:
Cheese is a food item which heals 2 hitpoints when eaten. Its primary use is an ingredient in other dishes, including pizza and a baked potato with cheese.

Cheese can be bought from Port Sarim, in the Grand Tree, or from the Culinaromancer's chest in Lumbridge. Members can make some by using a bucket of milk on a dairy churn at level 48 Cooking, giving 64 Cooking experience. A pot of cream can also be churned into cheese, giving 46 Cooking experience, as well as a pat of butter or not garlic butter, which both give 23.5 Cooking experience.

label: Cheese+tom batta
title: Cheese+tom batta
lead:
A cheese and tomato batta (spelled in-game as Cheese+tom batta) is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 11 Hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade c+t battas are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 120 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make a cheese+tom batta via gnome cooking with 29 Cooking, yielding 158 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Chef's hat
title: Chef's hat
lead:
A chef's hat is a white hat that grants players access to the Cooks' Guild with a Cooking level of 32. Aside from this, it has little practical use and is purely cosmetic.

The hat is dropped by several monsters, often to fill space in their drop tables.

label: chemical compound
title: chemical compound
lead:
Chemical compound is a quest item used in The Dig Site quest to blow up bricks blocking the path below the digsite. It can be lit using a tinderbox. Creating the compound requires 10 Herblore and gives 7.5 Herblore experience.

Warning: Dropping the vial will deal 65 damage to the player, but this will never kill the player, at most reducing them to a single hitpoint. If the chemical compound is dropped while the player only has a single hitpoint, they will say but take no damage.

label: Chemist
title: Chemist
lead:
The chemist is in his house in Rimmington. He explains how to make lamp oil in the lamp oil still for oil lamps, oil lanterns, and bullseye lanterns. He gives sieves for making imp repellent.

During the Biohazard quest, he gives the player touch paper for Guidor.

label: Chemist's house
title: Chemist's house
lead:
The chemist's house is a home located on the western side of Rimmington. The following features can be found here:
* The chemist, who can be consulted for various quests.
* A lamp oil still, found on a table in the east of the house.
* A fractionalising still, located just outside.
* Three delivery men: Da Vinci, Hops and Chancy, who play a part in the Biohazard quest.
* Several bookcases, which contain unreadable books with the following titles:
** 'A Beginner's Guide To Blowing Things Up' by Herbert 'Banger' Mcgree
** 'Magicks Most Destructive' by *D (better known as the Wise Old Man)
** 'The Pursuit of the Elixir of Life' by Jorg W. Kiln
** 'The Hooded Arts of Natural Philosophy' by Hermes Bimegistus

label: Chemistry Table
title: Chemistry Table
lead:
Chemistry tables can be found in several places across Gielinor. Players cannot interact with the chemistry tables. When an item is used on the chemistry table, the message "The table appears to be in use." appears in the chatbox, signifying that the chemistry table cannot be used as an ordinary table.

A chemistry table in Zahur's house must be interacted with during Beneath Cursed Sands quest, when she asks the player to warm up her chemistry equipment whilst she makes the pox cure.

label: Chest (10 coins)
title: Chest (10 coins)
lead: There are nine chests scattered around Gielinor that yield 10 coins when thieved from. All chests require 13 Thieving and grant the player 7.8 experience with each successful unlock. Once unlocked these chests will lock themselves after 7 seconds. Players must right click and "Search for Traps;" failing to do so results in the player taking substantial damage.

label: Chest (50 coins)
title: Chest (50 coins)
lead: There are three thievable chests scattered around RuneScape that always yield 50 coins when opened. Each of these chests require 43 Thieving to open, granting the player 125 experience for each successful unlock. A lockpick is not necessary to loot the chest. Once unlocked these chests will lock themselves after 50 seconds. Players must right click and "Search for Traps," as attempting to open these chests without doing so results in the player taking substantial damage.

label: Chest (Ardougne Castle)
title: Chest (Ardougne Castle)
lead:
The Ardougne Castle Chest are two thievable chests located on the of Ardougne castle, one to the North and one to the South. The chests require 72 Thieving (boostable) to unlock, and rewards the player with 500 experience each time it is opened.

A door requiring 61 Thieving to pick (also boostable) must be opened to gain access to the chest, using the "Pick-lock" option on the door. This may be failed, but can simply be attempted again. The player gets 50 experience for unlocking either of the North or South doors. The chest must first be searched for traps, upon succeeding the player will trigger a second trap and be teleported to Witchaven. If the player does not search for traps and instead clicks open they will be dealt high damage. It takes 500 seconds (8 minutes 20 seconds) for the contents of the chest to respawn.

label: Chest (Chaos Druid Tower)
title: Chest (Chaos Druid Tower)
lead:
Thieving from the blood rune chests located in the Chaos Druid Tower requires 59 Thieving, rewarding 250 experience per opened chest. To open one, players must right-click on the chest and choose the option "Search for traps" or else they will take up to 22 damage (boosting above 99 Hitpoints will further increase this damage). The chest is capable of killing the player if they attempt to open it while having 6 or less hitpoints. The chest's loot will respawn once every 135 seconds. Once looted, a second magical trap will be triggered, teleporting the player to the house located west of Elena in East Ardougne.

The damage taken is calculated using this formula:

label: chest (Chemical powder)
title: chest (Chemical powder)
lead: The chest located at the Digsite around the panning point can be opened with the chest key during the Dig Site Quest to obtain some chemical powder. It can still be opened after the quest is completed should the player own the respective key or any duplicates of it obtained via drop tricking. This can be useful should the player wish to gather more ammonium nitrate to damage themselves. Players may open the chest for others, allowing those players to loot the chemical powder after completing the quest, even if they don’t have keys of their own. The chest remains open for 3 minutes before closing.

label: Chest (Desert Mining Camp)
title: Chest (Desert Mining Camp)
lead: The chest inside Siad's office at the Desert Mining Camp can be searched during The Tourist Trap quest to obtain the Technical plans. To do so, the player needs the key given by Al Shabim. As the respective key can not be obtained after the quest is completed, the player can no longer open the chest.

label: chest (Doll of iban)
title: chest (Doll of iban)
lead: The chest inside Kardia the witch's house in the Underground Pass needs to be searched during the Underground Pass quest. It contains one restore potion, a super attack potion, the history of iban and most importantly the doll of iban needed to progress the quest. The chest can only be looted once, and after the quest is completed access to the chest is restricted as the player can't find another cat to distract the witch.

label: Chest (Dwarven Mine)
title: Chest (Dwarven Mine)
lead:
A chest is located at the Dwarven Mine. It can be opened and searched for Thalzar's map part of the Crandor map during Dragon Slayer I. To reach the chest, the player must first pass a locked door, which requires silk, a lobster pot, an unfired bowl, and a wizard's mind bomb to pass.

Upon opening the chest a chat window opens reading an inscription left behind by Thalzar to dissuade the player from taking the map and disturbing Elvarg. Players can still open and search the chest after the quest is completed. However, no additional map pieces can be obtained. Instead, the message You find nothing in the chest. will be displayed in the chat box.

label: chest (Fight Arena)
title: chest (Fight Arena)
lead: The chest can be opened and searched for the Khazard armour and helmet during the Fight Arena quest. After the quest is completed, the player can still visit the chest to obtain another set, should they have lost theirs.

label: Chest (Glarial's amulet)
title: Chest (Glarial's amulet)
lead: The chest in Glarial's Tomb can be opened and searched for the Glarial's amulet which is needed to enter the Waterfall Dungeon during the Waterfall Quest. After the quest is completed, the player can still visit the chest to obtain another amulet, should they have lost theirs. However, as the Glarial's Amulet is no longer needed to enter the dungeon after the quest is completed, there is little reason to do so.

label: Chest (Gu'Tanoth, spider)
title: Chest (Gu'Tanoth, spider)
lead:
The chest located in Gu'Tanoth can be opened by the player. Upon opening it, an aggressive spider level 1 will spawn, attacking the player. Opening it will also display the following messages in the chat box:
*Ahh! Theres a spider inside.
*Someone's idea of a joke...

Strangely enough, after opening the chest it will stay open for quite a long time. While the chest is open players can not close, examine or otherwise interact with the chest in any way.

label: Chest (Gu'Tanoth)
title: Chest (Gu'Tanoth)
lead:
The chest in Gu'Tanoth is located in the southern part of the city, near the Ogre chieftain. It spawns random items and may be opened once every three minutes. This timer is dependent on the world and as such, players may choose to hop worlds in order to effectively search the chest more often.

The player character will comment on what they find, whether it is an item, nothing at all, or an NPC.

label: chest (Hazeel Cult)
title: chest (Hazeel Cult)
lead:
The chest found in the Carnillean Mansion's secret room can be opened with the chest key during the Hazeel Cult quest if the player chose to side with Hazeel. It contains the Hazeel scroll needed for Hazeel's resurrection. It can still be reached after the quest is completed, but only should the player have kept the key.

Players that sided with the Carnillean family during the quest can not reach the chest.

label: Chest (Heroes' Quest)
title: Chest (Heroes' Quest)
lead: A chest in Brimhaven is used in the Heroes' Quest. The player has to use Grip's keyring to unlock the door in order to access the chest and obtain two copies of Pete's candlestick.

label: Chest (Iban's shadow)
title: Chest (Iban's shadow)
lead: Chest is a scenery object found within the Underground Pass that contains Iban's shadow. It can only be unlocked with the three amulets obtained by defeating the three demons Othainian, Doomion, and Holthion. If the player has the doll of iban in their inventory, Iban's shadow will immediately be applied to it without the item ever appearing in the player's inventory.

label: Chest (Maze)
title: Chest (Maze)
lead:
The chests found inside the maze random event can be opened by the player to obtain various lower-tier loot. As opening these chests takes time and thus reward potential away, it is recommended that players looking to maximise the value of their loot from the maze instead ignore the chests and try to reach the strange shrine as fast as possible.

Chests will automatically close after 60 seconds, at which time they can be searched again for more loot. The timer is paused while the chest dialogue box is open, so this can be used to receive multiple rewards from a single chest before the timer runs out.

label: Chest (Melzar's Maze)
title: Chest (Melzar's Maze)
lead:
The chest located in Melzar's Maze can be opened and searched for Melzar's part of the Crandor map during the Dragon Slayer I quest.

After the quest is completed, players are still able to open the chest once they reach the end of Melzar's Maze again. However, no additional map pieces can be obtained from it. Instead, the message You find nothing in the chest. will be displayed in the chat box.

label: Chest (nature runes)
title: Chest (nature runes)
lead: Thieving from a Nature Rune Chest requires 28 Thieving, and each chest gives 25 experience upon looting. Once unlocked, these chests will lock themselves after 15 seconds. Players must right click and "Search for Traps;" failure to do so results in the player taking \lfloor CurrentHitpoints \times \frac{12}{100} \rfloor + 3 damage. The chest will always yield one nature rune and 3 coins when successfully opened.

label: Chest (Observatory Dungeon, antipoison)
title: Chest (Observatory Dungeon, antipoison)
lead: The chest inside the Observatory Dungeon can be opened during and after the Observatory Quest to obtain infinite doses of antipoison(1). These doses could then also be combined into full potions which might be useful to negate damage from the poison spiders encountered during the Quest.

label: Chest (Observatory Dungeon, key)
title: Chest (Observatory Dungeon, key)
lead: The chests in the south-eastern part of the Observatory Dungeon can be searched for the Goblin kitchen key during the Observatory Quest. While the chest in which the key is found may vary from player to player, it is always obtained from either one of these three south-eastern chests. After the quest is completed players are still able to search their chest for another kitchen key.

label: Chest (Observatory Dungeon, spider)
title: Chest (Observatory Dungeon, spider)
lead:
The chests inside the Observatory Dungeon may be searched by the player during the Observatory Quest in hopes of finding the Goblin kitchen key to progress the quest. However, as the key can only be obtained from one of the three south-eastern chests, the player will not obtain it from any other chest found around the dungeon. When searching the chests the following message will be displayed in the chat box:
*Nothing in that chest except spiders!

label: Chest (Pirate's Treasure)
title: Chest (Pirate's Treasure)
lead:
The chest inside the Blue Moon Inn can be opened with the chest key to obtain the Pirate message during the Pirate's Treasure quest. As the key dissolves upon opening the chest, it can normally be opened only once. However, if the player obtained more than one chest key trough Drop Tricking the chest may be opened multiple times by using the key on it. This allows for the player to obtain multiple messages as long as they didn't advance to the next quest stage by reading the pirates message.

Each time the player successfully opens the chest, these messages will appear in the chatbox:
*"You unlock the chest."
*"All that's in the chest is a message..."
*"You take the message from the chest."

label: Chest (Shield of Arrav)
title: Chest (Shield of Arrav)
lead:
The chest is accessed during the quest Shield of Arrav, and contains one half of the broken shield. Because it is found inside of the Phoenix Gang Hideout, only players who have joined the Phoenix Gang can reach it.

You can only grab one shield half from the chest at a time, and you can no longer obtain it after completing the quest. If the player attempts to open the chest and search it after the quest is completed, a dialogue box will open saying "You open the chest, but don't find anything of interest inside."

label: Chest (Specimen jar)
title: Chest (Specimen jar)
lead: The chest inside the exam centre contains a specimen jar which is needed to search the specimen tray during the Digsite Quest. It can still be opened after the quest is completed. However, more specimen jars can only be obtained from the southern wall cupboard at the exam centre and the following message will instead be displayed in the chat box: You search the chest and find nothing

label: Chest (steel arrowtips)
title: Chest (steel arrowtips)
lead: These three chests always yield 5 steel arrowtips and 20 coins when picked. They require Level 47 Thieving and a lockpick. Players must right click the chests and 'Search for traps' to open them, and upon doing so the player receives 150 experience. Alternatively, players can use a lockpick on the chest to attempt to unlock it. Once opened these chests remain looted for 90 seconds before re-locking themselves.

label: Chest (Toban)
title: Chest (Toban)
lead: Toban's chest is used in the Watchtower quest. During the quest, it contains Toban's gold, which was stolen from Og by his nemesis Toban. It can be opened with Toban's key, which is given to the player by Og.

label: chest (Tribal Totem)
title: chest (Tribal Totem)
lead: The chest from Tribal Totem is found inside Lord Handelmort's house after investigating the staircase that is locked behind a password door. Players must open and search the chest to obtain the totem required to finish it.

label: Chest (Witchaven Dungeon)
title: Chest (Witchaven Dungeon)
lead: Chests can be found inside the Witchaven Dungeon. Searching them results in the following message: You search the chest and find nothing.

label: Chest key (Digsite)
title: Chest key (Digsite)
lead:
The chest key is a members-only quest item. This version of chest key is used in The Dig Site quest. It is obtained from Doug Deeping and opens a chest near the panning area on the River Salve, where players find ammonium nitrate.

If players wish to use the ammonium nitrate to create chemical compounds to damage themselves, they should do the drop trick to obtain multiple copies. Banking the keys does not allow you to get another, it must be dropped.

label: Chest key (Hazeel Cult)
title: Chest key (Hazeel Cult)
lead: The Chest key is a key found during the Hazeel Cult quest. It is located in the basement of the Carnillean Mansion in Ardougne. It opens the chest in the secret room, which gives the player the scroll needed to revive Hazeel. This key is no longer needed after the quest and may be safely dropped.

label: Chest key (Pirate's Treasure)
title: Chest key (Pirate's Treasure)
lead:
The Chest key is a quest item used only in Pirate's Treasure. It is given to the player by Redbeard Frank after giving him some Karamjan rum.

It is used to open the chest in one of the guest rooms upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock to retrieve a pirate message. The key can only be obtained during the quest and is kept upon completion.

label: chicken
title: chicken
lead:
Chickens are a type of domesticated bird kept as livestock by farmers, and are often found inside pens in the farms of Gielinor.

Chickens are one of the weakest enemies in Old School RuneScape, and are often killed by low-level players training their combat skills as they have very low defence and cannot deal damage to players: the chicken farms in Lumbridge are often crowded for this reason. Chickens will sometimes try to retreat when they have 1 hitpoint left.

label: Chicken (Tutorial Island)
title: Chicken (Tutorial Island)
lead:
Chickens are found on Tutorial Island as part of the Magic training tutorial. The Magic Instructor provides air and mind runes to cast Wind Strike on a chicken to progress in the tutorial.

The chickens are located behind a fence, so they can't be attacked using melee, and any dropped bones can't be picked up.

label: Child's blanket
title: Child's blanket
lead:
A child's blanket is a quest item used only in Monk's Friend. It is found on a table in the Clock Tower Dungeon, which can be accessed by a ladder in a stone ring south of the Clock Tower.

It is given to Brother Omad so he can sleep.

label: Chisel
title: Chisel
lead:
A chisel is a tool used in the Crafting skill to cut and shape hard non-metals, mainly gems and limestone. Chisels are also used in Fletching to cut gems into bolt tips. Chisels can be purchased for 1 coin at all general stores, except for those in Dorgesh-Kaan and Ardougne. There is a free-to-play chisel spawn in the Crafting Guild.

At level 15 Construction, members can make a tool store 1 for the workshop room of their house, which will provide an unlimited supply of chisels.

label: Choc saturday
title: Choc saturday
lead:
A chocolate saturday is an gnomish alcoholic drink that can be made at level 33 Cooking, granting 170 Cooking experience. It is used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. It heals 5 Hitpoints, lowers Attack by 2% - 3 levels and increases Strength by 5% + 2 levels.
The ingredients are whisky, equa leaves, a bucket of milk, some chocolate dust, a pot of cream and a chocolate bar. Access to a range is also required to complete the beverage.
To mix it, players need a cocktail shaker, and a cocktail glass.

There is a premade choc s'dy spawn in Brimstail's cave.

label: Chocchip crunchies
title: Chocchip crunchies
lead:
Chocchip crunchies are a food that players consume in one bite, healing 7 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade ch' crunch are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 85 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make chocchip crunchies via gnome cooking with 16 Cooking, yielding 106 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Chocolate bar
title: Chocolate bar
lead:
A chocolate bar is a food item that heals 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It is used as an ingredient in Cooking but can also be ground to chocolate dust using a pestle and mortar or a knife, which is required for the Plague City quest.

When eaten, the message You eat the chocolate bar. is displayed.

label: Chocolate bomb
title: Chocolate bomb
lead:
A chocolate bomb is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 15 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade chocolate bombs are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 160 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make a chocolate bomb via gnome cooking with 42 Cooking, yielding 190 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: chocolate cake
title: chocolate cake
lead:
Chocolate cake is a type of food that restores 15 Hitpoints in total, 3 bites each healing for 5. It can be obtained by using a chocolate bar or chocolate dust on a cake, requiring level 50 Cooking and granting 30 experience. Both ingredients can be bought from the Ardougne Baker's Stall.

Chocolate cake is a reward from the quest Gertrude's Cat, and optionally from The Dig Site when not choosing the Fruit blast as a reward. It will also be served by the butler when asked to prepare food in your player-owned house.

label: Chocolate dust
title: Chocolate dust
lead:
Chocolate dust is made by using a knife or a pestle and mortar with a chocolate bar. It can also be obtained by bringing Wesley in Nardah noted chocolate bars, who will crush them for you for a fee of 50 coins per item. Chocolate dust can be bought from Hudo and Heckel Funch at the Grand tree.

It is used for making energy potions in Herblore, chocolate cake for food or chef's delight by brewing.

label: Chocolatey milk
title: Chocolatey milk
lead:
Chocolatey milk is a type of untradeable drink that restores 4 Hitpoints when drunk. It can be obtained by using chocolate dust on a bucket of milk. Chocolate dust can be obtained by using a knife or pestle and mortar on a chocolate bar. Unlike other dairy products, it cannot be made using a dairy churn.

Chocolatey milk can be used with snape grass to create a Hangover cure which is required for the Plague City quest and the Skippy and the Mogres miniquest.

label: Chompy bird hat (bowman)
title: Chompy bird hat (bowman)
lead: The bowman hat (in-game: Chompy bird hat) is a members only decorative hat. To wear this hat, the player needs at least 5 Fletching and 30 Ranged. To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 40 Chompy birds, then talk to Rantz. As this hat is purely for decoration, it gives the player no bonuses.

title: Chompy bird hat (bowmaster)
lead: The bowmaster hat (in-game: Chompy bird hat) is a members only decorative hat. To wear this hat, the player needs at least 5 Fletching and 30 Ranged. To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 700 Chompy birds, then talk to Rantz. As this hat is purely for decoration, it gives the player no bonuses.

title: Chompy bird hat (dragon archer)
lead: The dragon archer hat (in-game: chompy bird hat) is a members only decorative hat. To wear this hat, one needs at least 5 Fletching and 30 Ranged. To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 2,250 chompy birds, then talk to Rantz. As this hat is purely for decoration, it gives no bonuses.

The ogre expert hat (in-game: Chompy bird hat) is a members only decorative hat. To wear this hat, the player needs at least 5 Fletching and 30 Ranged. title: Chompy bird hat (yeoman)
lead: The yeoman hat (in-game: Chompy bird hat) is a members-only decorative hat. To wear this hat the player needs at least 5 Fletching and 30 Ranged. To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 70 Chompy birds, then talk to Rantz with the ogre bow in the inventory. As this hat is purely cosmetic, it gives no bonuses.

label: Chompy bird obj
title: Chompy bird obj
lead: Chompy bird obj is an interface item released alongside the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. It appears in the chatbox when checking the number of chompy birds killed on the Ogre bow. The actual item, however, cannot be obtained.

label: Chompy Hunt
title: Chompy Hunt
lead:
Chompy Hunt is a music track that can be unlocked in the Feldip Hills. It also plays in the Corsair Cove Dungeon, Red chinchompa hunting ground, Jungle eagle's cave, and Rantz's cave.

In Classic mode, it is only heard in the chompy bird hunting location east of Feldip Hills and in Rantz's cave.

label: Chopped onion
title: Chopped onion
lead:
Chopped onion is a type of food that restores 1 Hitpoint when eaten. It is made by chopping an onion into a bowl using a knife.

Similar to onions, the message It's always sad to see a grown [man/woman/person] cry. appears when eaten.

label: Chopped tomato
title: Chopped tomato
lead:
Chopped tomato is a type of food that restores 2 Hitpoints, the same as one of its base ingredients the tomato. It can be obtained by using a bowl on a tomato with a knife in your inventory.

Creating Onion & tomato is one of multiple steps needed to create the ugthanki kebab which requires level 58 Cooking and restores 19 Hitpoints.

label: Chopped ugthanki
title: Chopped ugthanki
lead:
Chopped ugthanki is an intermediate product used to make an ugthanki kebab. It is made by using a bowl on a cooked ugthanki meat with a knife in the inventory.

If an onion or tomato is added, it becomes a Ugthanki & onion or Ugthanki & tomato, respectively. Adding a tomato to the onion mix or an onion to the tomato mix will result in a Kebab mix. Finally, adding pitta bread will result in Ugthanki kebab. The pitta bread requires level 58 Cooking, but the rest can be made at level 1.

label: Christmas cracker
title: Christmas cracker
lead:
Christmas crackers are a tradeable holiday item that can be obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year. They can be used on another player to provide party hats and rewards to both participants.

Ironmen cannot use party crackers on other players, so they have no use for crackers other than to sacrifice them to Death's coffer. Group ironmen however can open crackers with members of their group.

label: Chronozon
title: Chronozon
lead: Chronozon is a blood demon that must be defeated towards the end of the Family Crest quest. It is found in the Wilderness area of the Edgeville Dungeon, by the Earth obelisk. Chronozon must be hit with all four elemental blast spells in order to be killed, or otherwise it will return to full health when it is nearly dead.(Note TWINFLAME STAFF double hit does not count) Players should note that Chronozon has to be hit (i.e. do actual damage: if the spell splashes, it will not count). It will not drop the crest part unless the player has completed most of the quest. He can be fought in the Nightmare Zone after the quest is complete.

label: chunk of crystal
title: chunk of crystal
lead:
The chunk of crystal is a quest item used during the Legends' Quest. It is obtained by defeating San Tojalon in the Viyeldi caves beneath the Kharazi Jungle. When combined with the lump of crystal, and the hunk of crystal (obtained by defeating the other two warriors) at the furnace, they form the heart crystal required to unlock a door leading further into the cave.

It is not possible to obtain the heart fragments after completing the quest; killing the knights again does not provide the player with the fragments. However, duplicate parts of the crystal can be obtained during the quest by utilising the drop trick. If the player does this, they are able to create another (albeit useless) heart crystal after completing the quest.

label: Church organ
title: Church organ
lead: Church organs are interactive scenery found in churches throughout Old School RuneScape. Players can play the organ to hear one of two unique songs. Playing the organ in Seers' Village is an easy task in the Kandarin Achievement Diary.

label: City gate
title: City gate
lead: City Gate is one of the two gates allowing entry to Gu'Tanoth. Access is granted by the Ogre guard during the Watchtower quest. City Gate may also refer to the gate allowing entry to Prifddinas.

label: City guard
title: City guard
lead: Ogre city guards can be found in the middle of Gu'Tanoth. Four bridges must be crossed to reach them. To cross these bridges, a rock cake from the market and 20 coins must be brought. During the Watchtower Quest, they provide players with a Skavid map.

label: Civic Office of West Ardougne
title: Civic Office of West Ardougne
lead: The Civic Office of West Ardougne is the main governmental building in West Ardougne. It is run by Bravek and also contains the Clerk. The building features into the Plague City quest, in which the player delivers the hangover cure to Bravek.

label: civilian
title: civilian
lead:
Civilians are citizens of West Ardougne who can be found in the western section of the city, just east of the Underground Pass. When talked to, they will complain that they are busy because of the rat infestation, and say that they need a cat.

Players can sell adult, overgrown, wily, hell and lazy cats to civilians for 100 Death runes each, or 200 after completing the Easy Ardougne Diary. This will have them take your cat away from you permanently, but you can buy a replacement from Gertrude. Note that they will not accept kittens or the Witch's cat from the Underground Pass quest. To sell the cat you need to use it as an item on the Civilian.

label: Clap
title: Clap
lead:
Clap is the twenty-first listed emote. Upon use, the player claps their hands together three times.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Clarity of Thought
title: Clarity of Thought
lead:
Clarity of Thought is a prayer unlocked at level 7. Clarity of Thought increases the player's Attack by 5%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Attack level, such as Improved Reflexes.

label: Claus the Chef
title: Claus the Chef
lead: Claus the Chef is the chef of the Carnillean family. He can be found in the basement of the Carnillean household, where the kitchens are. His soup is poisoned by the player during the Hazeel Cult quest, provided the player sides with the Cult of Hazeel, resulting in the family dog, Scruffy, being poisoned and killed.

label: Claws of Guthix
title: Claws of Guthix
lead:
Claws of Guthix is a combat spell in the standard spellbook, requiring 60 Magic and the completion of Mage Arena I to cast. In addition, players must also be wielding a Guthix staff, void knight mace, or staff of balance. Only the void knight mace and staff of balance are able to autocast the spell.

Initially, the spell can only be cast within the Mage Arena against the battle mages. Upon casting the spell 100 times (regardless of whether it was a successful hit or not), the spell becomes usable outside the arena.

label: Clay
title: Clay
lead:
Clay (sometimes called hard clay to distinguish it from soft clay) is mined from clay rocks, requiring 1 Mining, and yielding 5 Mining experience. When mined it respawns in one game tick. Using a water container, such as a bucket of water, on it makes soft clay. Alternatively the Lunar spell humidify can do the same.

Soft clay is used to make pottery in Crafting, furniture in Construction, and Magic tablets. Mining a clay rock while wearing a bracelet of clay yields soft clay, similar to how it can also be mined directly from soft clay rocks in Trahaearn mine in Prifddinas.

label: clay rocks
title: clay rocks
lead:
Clay rocks are Mining rocks that can be mined with level 1 Mining, producing 1 clay and providing 5 Mining experience. If the player equips a Bracelet of clay, soft clay will be produced instead.

Clay is used with water to make soft clay, which in turn is used in Crafting and Construction and making magic tablets.

label: Clerk
title: Clerk
lead:
Clerk is Bravek's secretary and can be found in the Civic Office of West Ardougne. He plays a minor role in the day-to-day running of West Ardougne, mostly administering paperwork. In the Plague City quest, the player has to convince him to let the player see Bravek.

Another clerk can be found in the eastern room of the building.

label: Climb Rope
title: Climb Rope
lead:
Climb Rope is one of four Mime emotes unlocked as a Random event reward.

Upon completing a Mime event, players are returned to their previous location in game, with a new mime emote unlocked. Players cannot choose which of the four emotes unlock since this is random.

label: Climbing boots
title: Climbing boots
lead:
Climbing boots are a low-level piece of armour used in the troll quest series, requiring the completion of the Death Plateau quest to wear. After finishing Death Plateau, players may buy climbing boots from Tenzing for each.

Climbing boots are popular among players of all combat levels due to their low price, lack of negative bonuses, and the fact that they give +2 Strength bonus with no Defence requirement. They offer the same strength bonus as rune boots and mixed hide boots, which drop from Nechryael or can be crafted with 69 Crafting, respectively. By contrast, climbing boots can be obtained by most players within 30 minutes of making an account.

label: Climbing rocks (Tomb of Bervirius)
title: Climbing rocks (Tomb of Bervirius)
lead:
The climbing rocks in the Tomb of Bervirius must be climbed up to leave the tomb which puts the player back on Cairn Isle next to Tinsay. Succeeding gives the message "You managed to climb back out again!"

Failing deals 1‐10 damage and causes the player to yell

label: Climbing rocks (Yanille)
title: Climbing rocks (Yanille)
lead: The climbing rocks on the northern side of Yanille can be climbed over to leave the town. Doing so requires 5 Agility and yields 25 Agility experience. The shortcut is one-way and can't be used to enter the town.

label: Climbing rope (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Climbing rope (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead: Climbing ropes are found on the bottom level of each of the Brimhaven Agility Arena platforms, and can be used to climb back up to the level above after failing an obstacle.

label: Climbing rope (Crandor Dungeon)
title: Climbing rope (Crandor Dungeon)
lead: A Climbing rope is found at the north end of the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon and serves as the way to Crandor Island.

label: Climbing rope (Viyeldi caves)
title: Climbing rope (Viyeldi caves)
lead: A Climbing rope is found at the entrance to the Viyeldi caves and is used to climb back up to the Shaman Caves above. The rope hangs from the winch on the level above.

label: Clivet
title: Clivet
lead:
Clivet is a member of the Cult of Hazeel, a group dedicated to the revival of the Zamorakian mahjarrat Hazeel.

Several months ago, the cult stole a set of armour from Ceril Carnillean then broke in four more times in search of the scroll required to revive Hazeel, but failed each time. In Hazeel Cult, Ceril commissions the player to retrieve the armour, pointing them to the cult's lair in the sewers.

label: Clock spindle (black)
title: Clock spindle (black)
lead: Black clock spindles can be found in the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. During the Clock Tower quest, the player must match the black cog with the black spindle in the tower's cellar to help repair the clock.

label: Clock spindle (blue)
title: Clock spindle (blue)
lead: Blue clock spindles can be found in the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. During the Clock Tower quest, the player must match the blue cog with the blue spindle on the tower's to help repair the clock.

label: Clock spindle (red)
title: Clock spindle (red)
lead: Red clock spindles can be found in the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. During the Clock Tower quest, the player must match the red cog with the red spindle on the tower's to help repair the clock.

label: Clock spindle (white)
title: Clock spindle (white)
lead: White clock spindles can be found in the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. During the Clock Tower quest, the player must match the white cog with the white spindle on the tower's to help repair the clock.

label: Clock Tower
title: Clock Tower
lead: Clock Tower is a quest that takes place in the Ardougne Clock Tower. The tower's mechanism has stopped working, and you are asked to retrieve its missing parts from the dungeons.

label: Clock Tower (building)
title: Clock Tower (building)
lead:
The Clock Tower is a tower south of Ardougne. There are 4 floors, the fourth one being the basement. During the quest of the same name, you have to find 4 cogs in different colours.

The owner and monk of the Clock Tower is Brother Kojo, the giver of the Clock Tower quest. Kojo also gives the player a watch for use in Treasure Trails.

label: Clock Tower Dungeon
title: Clock Tower Dungeon
lead: The Clock Tower dungeon is a major part of the Clock Tower quest. It is a huge, multi-zone dungeon complex underneath the south-western part of East Ardougne. It is where you find the four cogs that are needed in the Clock Tower quest. Players must start the quest before they can access zones 1 and 2 of the dungeon.

label: Close Quarters
title: Close Quarters
lead:
Close Quarters is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon. If unlocked, it can be heard in the Nightmare Zone as one of the possible tracks that play when facing the Corsair Traitor, Witch's experiment, Tanglefoot, Trapped Soul, or Chronozon.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the Eastern Ruins in level 26-29 Wilderness.

label: Closed chest (Temple of Ikov)
title: Closed chest (Temple of Ikov)
lead:
The Closed chest(s) is found inside the Temple of Ikov's ice area. During the quest, players need to search through these chests to obtain Ice arrows that are used to kill the dungeon's boss Fire Warrior of Lesarkus to progress further in the quest.

The Chests have a random chance of containing a random number of ice arrows and all chests must be opened to re-attempt opening them once more to get the arrows.

label: Closed chest (The Grand Tree)
title: Closed chest (The Grand Tree)
lead: The chest is used in the The Grand Tree quest. It can be opened with Glough's key that Anita gives you. After unlocking the chest you will find some Invasion plans detailing his plan to seize control of Gielinor.

label: Closed chest (Tree Gnome Village)
title: Closed chest (Tree Gnome Village)
lead: The closed chest is interacted with during the quest Tree Gnome Village. It is found in the upper floor of the destroyed Khazard house after the player climbs the crumbled wall and climbs the ladder in the western room. Players obtain the orb of protection after opening the chest, which is needed to continue the Tree Gnome Village quest.

label: Clue scroll (easy)
title: Clue scroll (easy)
lead:
A clue scroll (easy) is a valuable random drop from a large variety of lower-levelled monsters. Clue scrolls are the start of a Treasure Trail - a treasure hunt that sends players hunting all around Gielinor. At the end of the hunt players receive a reward of items randomly selected from a specific list, possibly including very rare and very valuable items. Easy clue scrolls do not feature any coordinate clues, and require nothing to be fought. They also do not take the player into the Wilderness.

Easy clue scrolls can be between 2 and 4 steps long.

id: page:clue scroll (easy) - a crate found in the tower of a church
label: Clue scroll (easy) - A crate found in the tower of a church
title: Clue scroll (easy) - A crate found in the tower of a church
lead: Clue scroll (easy) is a cryptic clue obtained from easy Treasure Trails.

id: page:clue scroll (easy) - at the standing stones north of falador
label: Clue scroll (easy) - At the standing stones north of Falador
title: Clue scroll (easy) - At the standing stones north of Falador
lead: Clue scroll (easy) is a map clue obtained from easy Treasure Trails.

id: page:clue scroll (easy) - look in the ground floor crates of houses in falador
label: Clue scroll (easy) - Look in the ground floor crates of houses in Falador
title: Clue scroll (easy) - Look in the ground floor crates of houses in Falador
lead: Clue scroll (easy) is a cryptic clue obtained from easy Treasure Trails.

label: Clue scroll (hard)
title: Clue scroll (hard)
lead:
A clue scroll (hard), more commonly referred to as a hard clue, is a rare drop from a variety of high-levelled monsters. The clue is part of the Treasure Trails activity, and sends players across Gielinor and other realms to complete it. Completing a trail rewards players with a casket containing several random items, some of which are very rare and valuable.

Hard clue scrolls can be between 4 and 6 steps long, and are longer, more dangerous, and have harder requirements than previous tiers of clues. In addition to needing to complete puzzle boxes, players may have to enter the Wilderness, as well as fight Zamorakian or Saradominist wizards and the double agent.

label: Clue scroll (medium)
title: Clue scroll (medium)
lead:
A clue scroll (medium) is a valuable random drop from a large variety of mid-levelled monsters. Clue scrolls are the start of a Treasure Trail - a treasure hunt that sends players hunting all around Gielinor. At the end of the hunt players receive a reward of items randomly selected from a specific list, possibly including very rare and very valuable items. For a guide on how to complete a clue scroll, see: Treasure Trails Guide. Medium clue scrolls are mostly easy to obtain and complete, and offer average rewards in return. The rewards can range from mithril armour to ranger boots.

Medium clue scrolls can be between 3 and 5 steps long.

label: Coal
title: Coal
lead:
Coal can be mined at level 30 Mining providing 50 Mining experience. After coal rocks are mined, it will take 30 seconds until it reappears. Coal is required to smelt all ores above iron (other than gold, silver, lead, and nickel), in increasing amounts.

Members can store 27 pieces of coal in one inventory space by using a coal bag, obtained from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 100 golden nuggets at Motherlode Mine.

label: coal rocks
title: coal rocks
lead:
Coal rocks are a rock that contains coal. Players with a Mining level of 30 can mine coal rocks with a pickaxe, granting 50 Mining experience. Coal rocks can be found in numerous mines throughout Gielinor, most abundantly in the Mining Guild.

On rare occasions the rock may give an uncut sapphire, emerald, ruby, or diamond.

title: Coal Truck
lead:
Coal Trucks are used to store coal, and are found by the Coal Trucks mine west of McGrubor's Wood and in the house north of the Forester's Arms Pub in Seers' Village. All coal trucks share the same storage, therefore any coal placed into a coal truck can be removed from any other coal truck. The coal trucks are mainly used by players to deposit the coal mined in the coal trucks mine, then when the coal trucks are full, the coal can be unloaded in Seers' Village and taken to the bank.

The maximum number of coal that can be stored in the coal trucks starts at 120, and increases to 140, 280, and 308 after the easy, medium and hard Kandarin Diaries. Additionally, after the completion of the elite Kandarin Diary, the first 200 coal placed into the coal trucks will automatically be transported to the player's bank.

label: Coal Trucks
title: Coal Trucks
lead:
The Coal Trucks are located north of the Fishing Guild and west of McGrubor's Wood. At the coal truck mining area, there are 18 coal rocks and several carts. Coal can be deposited into the trucks and later retrieved from any truck along the mine track, allowing players to collect and bank their coal from the depot at Seers' Village.

120 coal can be stored in the carts if no Kandarin achievement diaries have been completed, though 158, 280, or 308 pieces of coal can be stored in the trucks if the easy, medium, or hard diary is completed (respectively). With the elite diary, the first 200 coal removed in a day are automatically transported to the player's bank. Though the diary reward says placed, you must first place then attempt to remove the coal from the coal truck to initiate transfer to your bank. An exploit currently exists in which a player can transport 27 additional coal if the trucks are filled up to one less than full, then an entire inventory of coal is placed in the cart.

label: Cocktail glass
title: Cocktail glass
lead: Empty cocktail glasses are used to make Gnome cocktails. They can be bought from Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree. There is also a respawn right next to him. They can also be obtained by drinking gnome cocktails or a poison chalice.

label: Cocktail guide
title: Cocktail guide
lead:
The cocktail guide has a collection of recipes for the various gnome cocktails for you to make. It's useful for the Gnome Restaurant minigame or if you just want to make the cocktails for yourself.

You can get the book from Blurberry, Heckel Funch, Rasolo, or from the bookcase in your house. The book will not be available in your bookcase until completing the mixing tutorial with Blurberry.

label: cocktail shaker
title: cocktail shaker
lead:
A cocktail shaker is an item used in Gnome cooking to make cocktails. It can be purchased from Grand Tree Groceries or Funch's Fine Groceries in the Grand Tree for coins, or through dialogue with the Blurberry Bar barmen for coins. One also spawns in Grand Tree Groceries.

Ingredients can not be used on the shaker directly; the "mix-cocktail" option opens an interface where players must click "create" to make the drink. Doing so will create an intermediate mixed drink, still in the shaker, which can then be poured into a cocktail glass while having the appropriate garnish in the inventory.

label: Cocoon
title: Cocoon
lead: Cocoons are objects that can be found in the section of the Kalphite Lair where the Kalphite Queen is found. Throughout the fight, if the Kalphite Queen is near any of the cocoons, there is a 1/20 chance it will hatch an aggressive Kalphite Worker each time the Queen is hit (including on unsuccessful hits).

label: Cod
title: Cod
lead:
Cod is a type of fish that restores 7 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw cod on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 18 Cooking and granting 75 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt fish. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Cod is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 51 on a fire, 49 on a range, or 46 when using the Lumbridge range.

Cod is used as an ingredient in fish pie which requires Cooking level 47 to make.

label: Coffin (Hazeel Cult)
title: Coffin (Hazeel Cult)
lead: The coffin of the Mahjarrat in torpor Hazeel can be found in the far west of the Ardougne Sewers. It appears in the Hazeel Cult quest if the player sides with Hazeel. The coffin is shown at the end, when Alomone uses a scroll on the coffin to revive Hazeel.

label: Coffin (Priest in Peril)
title: Coffin (Priest in Peril)
lead:
The coffin is on found the of the Paterdomus Temple. Drezel states that the coffin was brought to the temple by the monks of zamorak that took over the temple, and that inside the coffin is a sleeping vampyre which would wake up and attack Drezel if he were to get too close to it. During the Priest in Peril quest, the player must use blessed water on the coffin to trap the vampyre, allowing Drezel to escape from his prison cell.

Attempting to open the coffin results in the player stating that it would not be a very good idea to do so.

label: Coffin (The Restless Ghost)
title: Coffin (The Restless Ghost)
lead: The coffin is located south of the Lumbridge church within the Lumbridge Graveyard, and is used during the quest The Restless Ghost. Within is the skeleton of the Restless ghost. During the quest the player must find the ghost's skull and return it to the coffin.

label: Coffin (Vampyre Slayer)
title: Coffin (Vampyre Slayer)
lead: The coffin is located in the basement of Draynor Manor, and is used during the quest Vampyre Slayer. Within the coffin is Count Draynor Drakan, who the player must kill during the quest. Attempting to open the coffin whilst not on the quest will display the message "The coffin is sealed shut.".

label: Coif
title: Coif
lead:
A coif is an improved cowl that requires 20 Ranged to equip. Coifs are the best ranged headgear available for free to play. It can be made by members at level 38 Crafting with one leather (soft), a needle, and thread.

Making a coif in the Lumbridge cow field is a requirement for the medium Lumbridge & Draynor Diary.

label: Coins
title: Coins
lead:
Coins (also referred to as gold pieces, gp, gold, or simply money) are the most common form of currency in Gielinor. They are used among players and non-player characters alike to exchange for items and services.

Players often refer to one thousand (1,000) coins as 1k and one million (1,000,000) coins as 1m or 1mil. Both can be applied to larger numbers, for example, 10m refers to ten million coins (10,000,000). 1b or 1bil refers to one billion coins (1,000,000,000).

label: Coins (Shilo Village)
title: Coins (Shilo Village)
lead:
Coins are found in Rashiliyia's Tomb, entered during the Shilo Village quest. Attempting to pick up the coins will cause four undead ones to spawn, accompanied by the following message:

The coins will not disappear from the floor, but they cannot be picked up. However, casting Telekinetic Grab on the item will allow the player to obtain it.

label: Colonel Radick
title: Colonel Radick
lead:
Colonel Radick is located in Yanille near the west gate and has extremely high hitpoints for his combat level. He does not play any role in any quest despite being a unique character. He appears to wear the same armour as the paladins found in East Ardougne.

When talking to him, he asks if the player is a friend or a foe. Of course, if the friend option is chosen, he will let you go but if the foe one is chosen, he will attack the player. When asked why Yanille is so heavily defended, he explains that as the southernmost city of Kandarin, it must be protected from the ogres of the Feldip Hills.

label: Column (Mage Arena)
title: Column (Mage Arena)
lead: Columns can be found inside the sparkling pool inside the Mage Arena bank. One version of the columns can also be found inside the Smoke Dungeon. They can't be interacted with.

label: Combat Training Camp
title: Combat Training Camp
lead: The Combat Training Camp is a combat training facility which players may access upon completion of the Biohazard quest. The camp is located north of West Ardougne and just east of the Gnome Stronghold's entrance. It was established by King Lathas of East Ardougne to train his forces, and various guards can be seen within the camp.

label: Combination
title: Combination
lead:
The combination is an item used in the Death Plateau quest. It is obtained by inspecting the Iou given to the player by Harold in lieu of paying a gambling debt he owes from losing a dice rolling game.

The combination is a cryptic list of clues that give the relative locations of a set of coloured stone balls that must be positioned on a device which locks and unlocks the equipment room in Burthorpe Castle. If lost, the combination can be obtained by talking to Harold again.

label: Commander Montai
title: Commander Montai
lead: Commander Montai is the commander of the Gnomic defence at the Khazard Battlefield north of the Tree Gnome Village. Montai directs the battle from behind the trenches at the front line, wearing a red helmet and chestpiece to show his importance. To help ensure victory for his forces on the battlefield against the forces of General Khazard, he has enlisted the help of an adventurer to help him to fix a ballista and retrieve coordinates for the attack from three gnome trackers during the Tree Gnome Village quest. Commander Montai has also ordered the addition of the Tortoise Regiment led by Lieutenant Schepbur. He is spoken to mainly during the Tree Gnome Village quest, but he can be spoken to after the quest as well, where the player will inquire as to how the battle is going, to which he will reply "We're hanging in there, soldier.".

label: Commence The Fight! (Duel Arena)
title: Commence The Fight! (Duel Arena)
lead: Commence The Fight! (Duel Arena) is an unused Jingle it played at the start of a duel in the Duel Arena; no longer in-game after being replaced by the Emir's Arena.

label: Competition Judge
title: Competition Judge
lead:
The Competition Judge manages the Target range and gives out archery tickets as rewards, which can be used to purchase items from the Ticket Merchants.

By paying , you are given 10 bronze arrows and have 10 shots at the nearby target. For each shot, you may score between 0-100 points, for a maximum of 1,000 points. You get 1 archery ticket for every 10 points.

label: Compost (scenery)
title: Compost (scenery)
lead: Several piles of compost can be found around Gielinor. If a bucket is used on the compost a message appears saying "This compost has sat here for too long - I should make some fresh compost myself."

label: compost heap
title: compost heap
lead:
The Compost heap is located just west of Draynor Manor and must be searched for a key during the Ernest the Chicken quest. Searching the heap requires a spade, as attempting to search it without one will result in the player saying: "I'm not looking through that with my hands!"

Using a bucket on the compost heap returns the message: This compost has sat here for too long - I should make some fresh compost myself.

label: Confuse
title: Confuse
lead:
Confuse is a low-level Magic spell. When cast on an opponent, their Attack level is reduced by 5%. The spell gives experience whether it hits or misses, making it a popular way to gain experience cheaply. The spell can only be cast if an opponent's stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you can not stack stat-reduction with multiple spells in a row.

The spell grants 13 Magic experience and requires three water, two earth, and one body rune in order to be cast.

label: Contest
title: Contest
lead: Contest is a music track that is unlocked at the Troll arena south of Trollheim and the eastern edge of Death Plateau. It also plays in the Nightmare Zone when facing Dad or Arrg in Practice or Endurance mode.

label: Cook (Lumbridge)
title: Cook (Lumbridge)
lead:
The cook is the head cook of Lumbridge Castle. He usually seems unprepared, but with the player's help, he prepares great food. He is the starting point for the Cook's Assistant and Recipe for Disaster quests. He can be found in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen on the .

When the Cook's Assistant quest is completed, the player is granted use of his special range, which has a lower chance of burning certain foods compared to other ranges.

label: Cook's Assistant
title: Cook's Assistant
lead: Cook's Assistant is the first RuneScape quest ever released and one of the six quests available during the game's launch. In the quest, the player must help the cook of Lumbridge Castle make a birthday cake for Duke Horacio.

label: Cooked chicken
title: Cooked chicken
lead:
Cooked chicken is a type of food that restores 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw chicken on a fire or cooking range, granting 30 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt chicken. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Cooked chicken is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 34, or 31 when using the Lumbridge range.

Cooked chicken does not require a cooking level to cook, and can be used as an ingredient to make a stew or curry. It is an easily obtainable early food source, as killing chickens at the Lumbridge East Farm is a common activity for a low level player.

label: Cooked chompy
title: Cooked chompy
lead:
Cooked chompy is an ogre delicacy obtained by skewering a raw chompy with an iron spit, then cooking the skewered chompy on a fire, requiring level 30 Cooking and granting 100 experience when successful. Players may burn the chompy while cooking one, resulting in a ruined chompy; the burn rate while cooking these will decrease as players reach higher Cooking levels. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 99.

Cooked chompy heals 10 Hitpoints. If hunting chompy birds, due to the meat's weight of 10 kg, it is recommended to do so south-west of Castle Wars. Big Chompy Bird Hunting is required to hunt them.

label: Cooked meat
title: Cooked meat
lead:
Cooked meat is a type of food that restores 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking various raw meats on a fire or cooking range, granting 30 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt meat. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Cooked meat is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 34, or 31 when using the Lumbridge range.

Cooked meat is used in the making of stews, pies, and steak sandwiches, or as a topping on pizzas.

label: cooked oomlie wrap
title: cooked oomlie wrap
lead:
Cooked oomlie wrap is a food made from cooking a wrapped oomlie. It heals 14 Hitpoints when eaten, and gives the message "You eat the oomlie meat; it tastes very gamy."

Cooked oomlie wraps can be cooked with a Cooking level of 50 or higher, granting 30 Cooking experience.

label: Cooking
title: Cooking
lead:
Cooking is a skill that allows raw food to be made edible, healing hitpoints when eaten. To do this, the player uses a raw, cookable food on a range or fire.

Depending on the player's Cooking level, food will sometimes burn, becoming unusable. Ranges burn food less often than fires at the same level, and some foods can only be cooked on ranges. Some ranges, such as the one in the Lumbridge Castle or in the Hosidius Kitchen, burn food less often than a normal range.

label: Cooking apple
title: Cooking apple
lead:
Cooking apples are primarily used as an ingredient to make apple pies. They can be obtained from the Cooks' Guild, Culinaromancer's Chest, Logava Gricoller's Cooking Supplies, or alternatively, harvested from an apple tree grown from an apple tree seed in a fruit tree patch by a player with a Farming level of 27.

Baskets of apples (which contain 5 apples each) can be used in the Farming skill to pay farmers to watch planted trees. One basket is needed to watch willows and strawberries, while four baskets are needed to watch a banana tree.

label: Cooking gauntlets
title: Cooking gauntlets
lead:
Cooking gauntlets are a pair of gloves available after completing the Family Crest quest, along with the goldsmith and chaos gauntlets. They can be worn to significantly decrease the likelihood of burning lobsters, swordfish, cooked kyatt, monkfish, sharks, and anglerfish when cooking them. They do not work on other types of food.

In order to obtain this enchantment on your Family Crest gauntlets, one must bring the steel gauntlets that were rewarded from the quest to Caleb in or around the house north of the archery shop in Catherby. (Note: if your gauntlets have a different enchantment on them already, Caleb will charge you 25,000 coins). If the gauntlets are destroyed or lost due to death, these gauntlets may be re-obtained free of charge from Dimintheis in south-east Varrock and will have the same enchantment on them.

label: Cooking Level Up!
title: Cooking Level Up!
lead: Cooking Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling cooking.

label: Cooking Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Cooking Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Cooking Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Cooking.

label: Cooking pot (Fred's farm)
title: Cooking pot (Fred's farm)
lead:
Cooking pots can be found across Gielinor, and can be used to cook food just like a fire.

One cooking pot appears in the northern farm house of Lumbridge conveniently close to chickens so that the player may cook their raw chicken drops to recover health.

label: Cooking pot (scenery)
title: Cooking pot (scenery)
lead:
Cooking pots can be found across Gielinor, and can be used to cook food just like a fire. Cooking pots will not allow players to cook food requiring a range.

One cooking pot appears in the eastern farm house of Lumbridge conveniently close to cows and chickens so that the player may cook their meat drops to recover health when training on them.

label: Cooking pot (unobtainable item)
title: Cooking pot (unobtainable item)
lead: The cooking pot is an interface item visible in the Cooking skill guide summary and it previously appeared in the Cooking level-up interface. However, the leveling up interface was updated on 26 June 2007 with an image of a different pot, before the release of Old School RuneScape. As a result, it served no purpose and could not be seen or obtained by players during normal gameplay until the skill guide summaries update in 26 March 2025.

label: Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)
title: Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)
lead:
This Cooking range, referred to as the Cook-o-matic 100 by the Lumbridge Cook (more commonly referred to as the Lumbridge Castle Range or simply the Cook's range) is a special range, located in the kitchen, on the of the Lumbridge Castle.

It is notable as it improves the chances of cooking certain foods, especially mushroom and botanical pies. This makes it particularly helpful for players without access to other special cooking ranges, or a cooking cape.

label: Cooks' Guild
title: Cooks' Guild
lead:
The Cooks' Guild (also known as the Cooking Guild or the Chefs' Guild) is a guild for master chefs located in a three-story windmill west of Varrock. To enter the guild, players need at least 32 Cooking and must wear one of the following:
*A chef's hat or golden chef's hat
*A Cooking cape or Cooking hood
*A Max cape or Max hood, or any of their variants
*Varrock armour 3 or 4 (reward from completing the hard or elite Varrock Diary)

Players may remove these items while they are inside the guild without being kicked out.

label: Copper ore
title: Copper ore
lead: Copper ore can be mined at level 1 Mining providing 17.5 Mining experience. After mining copper rocks, it will take 2.4 seconds until it reappears. Copper ore is used with tin ore to smelt bronze bars, or used with nickel ore to smelt Cupronickel bars. Smelting a bronze bar gives 6.2 Smithing experience.

label: copper rocks
title: copper rocks
lead:
Copper rocks are a type of rock that contains copper ore; they can be mined with a Mining level of 1. They are one of the first rocks that can be mined, along with tin rocks. Each time a player successfully mines a copper rock, they gain 17.5 Mining experience.

Mining 14 tin ore and 14 copper ore (wielding the pickaxe as a weapon to free the 28th inventory space) and smelting them to bronze bars is a slow but accessible way to train Mining and Smithing, especially in free-to-play worlds.

label: cormorant
title: cormorant
lead:
Cormorants are a species of large bird native to many coastal regions including Karamja, Fossil Island and Hosidius, and are often found alongside Pelicans. They are carnivorous and feed mainly on fish. Most cormorants cannot be fought or interacted with in any way, essentially making them scenery.

A certain kind of cormorant can be used for aerial fishing, a Hunter technique similar to falconry practiced by Alry the Angler on the small island in Lake Molch. These cormorants will require either some fish offcuts, fine fish offcuts , or king worms on a regular basis to catch fish for the player.

label: Cosmic Altar
title: Cosmic Altar
lead:
The Cosmic Altar is a runic altar upon which cosmic runes are crafted from pure essence, providing 8 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 27 Runecraft and completion of the Lost City quest is required to craft cosmic runes.

Players may create a cosmic tiara here by using either a cosmic talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 40 Runecraft experience. A catalytic tiara can also be created here by using a catalytic talisman and gold tiara, granting 60 Runecraft experience.

label: Cosmic rune
title: Cosmic rune
lead:
The cosmic rune is a rune used primarily in enchanting spells. Enchanting spells enchant jewellery, such as rings and amulets, into something that has an effect when worn or operated. For example, when the player casts Lvl-4 Enchant on a diamond ring, the ring will become a ring of life. Cosmic runes are also used for the Lunar spells NPC Contact, Cure Me, Cure Group, and Spellbook Swap and for the resurrection spells in the Arceuus spellbook.

They can be crafted at the Cosmic Altar in Zanaris through the Runecraft skill at level 27 for 8 experience per pure essence after the Lost City quest. They can also be purchased at Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop in the Mage Arena in the Wilderness, Amlodd's Magical Supplies in Prifddinas after completing Song of the Elves, or from Ali Morrisane after completing The Feud and the Rogue Trader miniquest. At level 59 Runecraft, the amount crafted doubles to two cosmic runes per pure essence. Twisted extracts can also be used to increase the quantity of crafted cosmic runes by 60 per pure essence, requiring partial completion of Desert Treasure II and access to the Scar essence mine.

label: Cosmic talisman
title: Cosmic talisman
lead:
A cosmic talisman is a talisman needed to enter the Cosmic Altar in the southern part of Zanaris. It can be combined with a tiara to make a cosmic tiara for 40 Runecraft experience at the Cosmic Altar by using the tiara on the altar. This makes the talisman disappear, but the tiara can be used in just the same way and can be worn. Both the tiara and the talisman allow players to craft cosmic runes at level 27 Runecraft.

To enter the altar the player needs to have completed the Lost City quest or Enter the Abyss if using the Abyss.

label: Councillor Halgrive
title: Councillor Halgrive
lead: Councillor Halgrive is a councillor in the Ardougne City Council responsible for public health and safety in East Ardougne. He can be found outside the East Ardougne church.

label: Count Draynor
title: Count Draynor
lead:
Count Draynor Drakan lives in a coffin in the basement of Draynor Manor. He was part of House Drakan, being the younger brother of Lowerniel, Ranis and Vanescula Drakan.

He can be fought in the Nightmare Zone after the quest Vampyre Slayer is complete. A stake is not necessary to kill him in the Nightmare Zone, as he will automatically die upon reaching 0 health.

label: counter
title: counter
lead: Counters can be found inside various shops, and serve no practical purpose. They can be used as a table by putting items on top of them.

label: Counter (Gu'Tanoth)
title: Counter (Gu'Tanoth)
lead: A counter can be found in Gu'Tanoth's market. At level 15 Thieving, and after partial completion of the Watchtower quest, players may steal rock cakes from it. Each successful steal awards 6.4 Thieving experience.

label: Counter (The Toad and Chicken)
title: Counter (The Toad and Chicken)
lead: A counter can be found inside The Toad and Chicken bar in Burthorpe, an Asgarnian ale and a beer glass spawn on it. It looks almost identical to most other counters found in Gielinor, except it is slightly slimmer. The counter functions as a table, allowing for items to be put on it.

label: cow
title: cow
lead:
Cows are common low level monsters new players train on. They are one of the first NPCs new players see outside of Lumbridge. Cows can help new players earn money, Cooking experience, and combat experience. The cowhides that they drop can be tanned to make leather or hard leather, or they can be sold for coins to players wanting to raise their Crafting level.

While most locations containing cows are crowded, there are some spots usually vacant, like the spot north of the windmill north-west of Lumbridge. Along with cows, you can also find cow calves and dairy cows. Regular cows cannot be milked; attempting to do so using a bucket will display the message Only dairy cows are suitable for milking..

label: cowhide
title: cowhide
lead:
Cowhides are dropped by cows or undead cows when they are killed. If it is brought to a tanner, it can be turned into soft leather for 1 coin or hard leather for 3 coins. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Forthos Dungeon, Canifis, Auburnvale, Neitiznot, Kebos Lowlands, and the Crafting Guild. Soft and hard leathers can then be crafted into various pieces of equipment through the Crafting skill.

It is also used alongside a unicorn horn to generate a unicow in the Tower of Life.

label: Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup
title: Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup
lead: Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup is a parrot that sits on Cap'n Izzy No-Beard's shoulder, occasionally adding something into the conversation.

label: Cracked sample
title: Cracked sample
lead: A cracked sample is found whilst digging in training digs or searching the chests in the Exam Centre south of the Digsite. If the certification exam has been completed, it can be smashed with a rock pick causing it to disintegrate. It is a useless item; there are no uses for it, it is untradeable, and it is worth nothing.

label: Crafting
title: Crafting
lead:
Crafting is a skill that allows players to create items such as jewellery, pottery, and armour for use or for trade.

The Crafting Guild is located north-west of Rimmington and can be entered at level 40 Crafting while wearing a brown apron.

label: Crafting Guild
title: Crafting Guild
lead:
The Crafting Guild is located south-west of Falador and north of Rimmington. It provides top-notch workshops for accomplished crafters. A Crafting level of 40 is required to enter the guild as well as wearing one of the following:

*A brown or golden apron
*A Crafting cape
*A Max cape or any of its variants

label: Crafting Guild mine
title: Crafting Guild mine
lead:
The Crafting Guild mine is a mine accessible only to players who can gain entry to the Crafting Guild. In order to access the guild, players must have at least 40 Crafting and wear either a brown or golden apron, or a Crafting or Max cape.

The nearest bank and furnace are in Falador. Members with level 26 Agility can take a shortcut tunnel under the city wall and go up the west side of the moat. Members who own a crafting cape or have completed at least the hard Falador Diary can access a bank chest and bank deposit box next to the mine, allowing them to bank ore in the guild.

label: Crafting Level Up!
title: Crafting Level Up!
lead: Crafting Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling crafting.

label: Crafting Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Crafting Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Crafting Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Crafting.

label: Crandor
title: Crandor
lead:
Crandor is a small volcanic island north of Karamja. Players gain access to the island during Dragon Slayer I, when the Guildmaster tasks them with defeating the mighty dragon Elvarg, who terrorizes the island.
