Players are unable to sail to Crandor themselves, as the jagged underwater reef surrounding the island make it impossible for boats of all types to safely approach it. Only boats of Crandorian design, like the Lady Lumbridge, are capable of handling the reefs.

label: Crandor and Karamja Dungeon
title: Crandor and Karamja Dungeon
lead: The Karamja Dungeon is located underneath the Karamja Volcano, and the Crandor Dungeon is located underneath Crandor. Both dungeons are connected to each other. In order for a player to gain full access to the Crandor dungeon, they must have completed or be about to engage in the final fight in the quest Dragon Slayer I. No part of the dungeons are multicombat zones.

label: Crandor map
title: Crandor map
lead:
The Crandor map is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is made by using any two pieces on each other when all three map parts are in the inventory.

It is given to Ned so he can sail the player to Crandor.

label: Crane (Sea Slug)
title: Crane (Sea Slug)
lead:
A crane is found on the of the Fishing Platform. After kicking down the badly repaired wall during the Sea Slug quest, players must rotate the crane which initiates a cutscene where they lower Kennith to the platform below.

Once the cutscene is completed, players are not able to rotate the crane, providing a message saying: Maybe I shouldn't be playing with that...

label: Crashed glider
title: Crashed glider
lead: A crashed glider is a gnome glider that has crashed. One can be found on Karamja and just west of the Digsite, two are located in the Underground Military Glider Hangar, and ten can be found on and around Crash Island.

label: crate (Biohazard)
title: crate (Biohazard)
lead: A crate containing a distillator can be found in the storeroom on the of the Mourner Headquarters. The crate is located third from the left on the north side of the storeroom. During the Biohazard quest, the player must search the crate to find a distillator to give to Elena. To access the storeroom in which the crate is found, players must first obtain a key by killing a Mourner in order to unlock the gate. Multiple distillators can be obtained from the crate by drop tricking, however, duplicates will be removed once the player provides one to Elena.

label: Crate (Dwarf Cannon)
title: Crate (Dwarf Cannon)
lead:
The crate is found in the north-western part of the Goblin Cave and must be searched during the Dwarf Cannon quest, in order to find the dwarf child Lollk.

There is a small chance to either receive an uncut red topaz, or spawn an aggressive chicken, rat, or spider whilst searching the crate outside of the quest.

label: Crate (Food Store, banana)
title: Crate (Food Store, banana)
lead:
The crate is located at the back of Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim. Searching the crate gives players the option to take a banana. Players can take as many as they want from the crate, one at a time.

During Pirate's Treasure, the player smuggles a karamjan rum into a crate of bananas which is delivered to Wydin's store, where they must retrieve the rum from the crate.

label: Crate (Food Store, cabbage)
title: Crate (Food Store, cabbage)
lead:
The crate is located at the back of Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim. Searching the crate gives players the option to take a cabbage. Players can take as many as they want from the crate, one at a time.

Access to the back of the Food Store requires partial completion of Pirate's Treasure and a white apron equipped.

label: Crate (Food Store, potato)
title: Crate (Food Store, potato)
lead:
The crate is located at the back of Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim. Searching the crate gives players the option to take a potato. Players can take as many as they want from the crate, one at a time.

Access to the back of the Food Store requires partial completion of Pirate's Treasure and a white apron equipped.

label: crate (Gertrude's Cat)
title: crate (Gertrude's Cat)
lead: Six crates can be found around the Sawmill east of Varrock. During the quest Gertrude's Cat, the player must search these crates to find Gertrude's three missing kittens. All three kittens are in one crate, and the crate in which the kittens can be found in is different for every player.

label: Crate (Hazeel Cult)
title: Crate (Hazeel Cult)
lead: A crate can be found in the basement of the Carnillean Mansion, located in the south-western corner of East Ardougne. Players who side with Hazeel must search the crate during the Hazeel Cult quest to obtain a key to unlock the chest found upstairs in the secret room.

label: Crate (Lumber Yard)
title: Crate (Lumber Yard)
lead: Crates are scenery objects found in the Lumber Yard, primarily used as decoy locations of Fluffs' kitten during the Gertrude's Cat quest. Only the mewing crates contain the kitten. Outside of a hard clue step, searching the crates will yield nothing.

label: Crate (Merlin's Crystal)
title: Crate (Merlin's Crystal)
lead: A crate that belongs to Arhein is located behind the Candle maker's store in Catherby. During Merlin's Crystal, the player hides in it to stow away on Arhein's ship as it delivers to places along the coast. Although not mentioned, one of the places is Keep Le Faye, which is where the player will arrive after hiding in the crate.

label: Crate (Pirate's Treasure)
title: Crate (Pirate's Treasure)
lead: Musa Point's banana plantation, operated by Luthas, is run through a series of crates which store bananas. The crates are ready to be shipped via the Customs-run shipping lines to Port Sarim. Players may speak to Luthas and take on a job filling the crate, which holds 10 bananas, in exchange for 30 coins. In the Pirate's Treasure quest, the crate is used to smuggle an illegal shipment of Karamjan rum, which is banned by the Customs and Excise Office. There is also a crate on Ape Atoll.

label: Crate (Shaman Caves)
title: Crate (Shaman Caves)
lead: A crate can be found in the first room of the Shaman Caves, south of the circle of fire. During the Legends' Quest the crate can be searched in order to obtain a Scrawled note. After the quest, searching the crate prints the messages You search the crate. and You can't find anything else here.

label: Crate (Shop of Distaste)
title: Crate (Shop of Distaste)
lead:
The crate could previously be found at the Duel Arena bank. It was filled with rotten tomatoes which players could purchase. Clicking on the crate would give the player access to the Shop of Distaste.

With the release of the Emir's Arena in July 2022, the crate was removed, and replaced by a different crate which gives access to Pelters' Veg Stall instead. Since Fadli still runs the Shop of Distaste, this is presumably an oversight.

label: Crate (Tribal Totem)
title: Crate (Tribal Totem)
lead: Crates are scenery objects that can be found in the GPDT depot located in East Ardougne. During the Tribal Totem quest, players must investigate the north-easternmost double-stacked crate in the GPDT Depot to obtain an address label. Players must then affix the label to the single crate containing a teleport block, originally bound for the Wizards' Tower, to be able to gain access to Handelmort Mansion once the crate is delivered.

label: Crate (Underground Pass)
title: Crate (Underground Pass)
lead: A crate is a scenery object located in the Underground Pass. Players can search the crate to obtain two salmon and two meat pies; however, food can only be taken from the crate once.

label: Crates (Food Store, raw chicken)
title: Crates (Food Store, raw chicken)
lead:
The crate is located at the back of Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim. Searching the crate gives players the option to take a raw chicken. Players can take as many as they want from the crate, one at a time.

Access to the back of the Food Store requires partial completion of Pirate's Treasure and a white apron equipped.

label: Cream boots
title: Cream boots
lead: Cream boots can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Cream hat
title: Cream hat
lead:
A cream hat can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree. These hats are a slight upgrade from Wizard hats, as Gnome hats have 1 more Magic attack and defence.

This item can be obtained when the player is chasing Solus during the Wanted! quest.

label: Cream robe bottoms
title: Cream robe bottoms
lead: Cream robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions. You can find Rometti on the of the Grand Tree, in the north-eastern area.

label: Cream robe top
title: Cream robe top
lead: A cream robe top can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Crest part
title: Crest part
lead:
The crest parts are items obtained during the Family Crest quest. Each part is owned by one of three Fitzharmon brothers, who have all left their family home. Each brother took a separate piece of the crest with him to prevent the other two brothers from inheriting the family fortune.

The player must complete a set of tasks for each of the brothers as follows:

label: Crevice (Shaman Caves, exit)
title: Crevice (Shaman Caves, exit)
lead: A crevice is a piece of scenery found in the Shaman Caves. When entered, it takes players back to the first room of the caves after the player has searched the bookcase. Looking at the crevice results in the message: It looks like a crevice, you could possibly squeeze through.. Searching the crevice results in the message: "You search the crevice. It looks as if you might be able to squeeze through, would you like to try?"

label: Criminal's dagger
title: Criminal's dagger
lead:
The Criminal's dagger is a quest item that is found at the murder scene during the Murder Mystery quest. This dagger cannot be equipped and is used to help gather evidence against the culprit during the quest. In the quest, you must use a pot of flour on the dagger to dust it, then use flypaper on the dagger to get the unknown print. You must do the same with the items belonging to the suspects. Then compare them by using a suspect's fingerprints on the criminal's fingerprint to get the killer's print.

If you lose it, it will respawn in the same place as where you got it.

label: Criminal's thread
title: Criminal's thread
lead:
The Criminal's thread is a quest item that is found at the murder scene during the Murder Mystery quest. It is used again during King's Ransom. It is used to help identify the murderer in the Murder Mystery Quest.

Note: the colour of the thread is different for each person who does Murder Mystery. It can either be red, green, or blue.

label: Crone
title: Crone
lead: The crone is an old woman who appears briefly during a chat scene with the High Priest of Entrana during the Holy Grail quest. She gives information regarding passage to the Fisher Realm. She tells the player to "go to where the six heads face" and "blow the whistle".

label: Cross
title: Cross
lead: A cross is on the wall of the building containing the incinerator in the sheep pen used during Sheep Herder. It can only be examined.

label: crossbow
title: crossbow
lead:
The crossbow is the weakest type of crossbow, along with the Phoenix crossbow, and requires a Ranged level of 1 to wield. It can only fire bronze bolts and mith grapples. The crossbow and the bolts can be bought from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock. There is a crossbow spawn in the Graveyard of Shadows, Bone Yard, and Hugor's house at Land's End (south-west of the Kourend Woodland).

It possesses the longest range of any crossbow in the game, with 10 tiles of range on rapid.

label: crude raft
title: crude raft
lead: A crude raft can be constructed during the Shilo Village quest to sail on the river out of Ah Za Rhoon. It can be constructed out of the smashed table found close to the entrance to the temple.

label: Crumble Undead
title: Crumble Undead
lead:
Crumble Undead is a spell on the standard spellbook, requiring level 39 Magic to cast and costing 2 air runes, 2 earth runes, and 1 chaos rune. This spell can only be cast on undead enemies, such as skeletons, zombies, ghosts and shades; trying to cast it a non-undead NPC yields the chatbox message: This spell only affects skeletons, zombies, ghosts and shades.

Crumble Undead can only be autocast by a skull sceptre (i), slayer's staff, slayer's staff (e), staff of the dead, toxic staff of the dead, staff of light, staff of balance, or void knight mace. In particular, the skull sceptre (i) is the only free-to-play weapon that can autocast this spell.

label: Crumbled wall
title: Crumbled wall
lead: The Crumbled wall is located in the northern section of Khazard Battlefield, and can be climbed over to enter the building. During the Tree Gnome Village quest, a Khazard commander will attack you once you enter.

label: Crumbling wall (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
title: Crumbling wall (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
lead: The crumbling wall is an Agility obstacle found within the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. Passing the obstacle requires 35 Agility and will award 13.7 Agility experience.

label: Crumbling wall (Falador)
title: Crumbling wall (Falador)
lead:
The crumbling wall is an Agility shortcut found in Falador, south-west of the western bank. An Agility level of 5 is required to use the shortcut. The shortcut allows players to quickly get between Falador and the mine north of the Dark Wizards' Tower.

Climbing over the wall is a requirement for the Falador Easy diary.

label: Crumpled scroll
title: Crumpled scroll
lead:
The crumpled scroll is a quest item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by searching some sacks in the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. The scroll must be given to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai village.

Players can sell the scroll for 100 coins to Yanni Salika after the quest.

label: crunchy tray
title: crunchy tray
lead: Crunchy trays are items used in gnome cooking. They can be obtained by buying them from the Grand Tree, the Grand Exchange or by trading with other players. The trays can be combined with gianne dough to make raw crunchies.

label: crushed gem
title: crushed gem
lead:
A crushed gem is produced when a player fails to cut a semi-precious gem (opal, jade and red topaz). Players will gain a small amount of Crafting experience when a gem is crushed. The chance of obtaining crushed gems decreases with higher Crafting levels.

Crushed gems may be one of the items required in the Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest to make the magic secateurs.

label: Cry
title: Cry
lead:
Cry is the seventeenth listed emote. Upon use the player puts their hands to their face and cries.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Crystal (Watchtower)
title: Crystal (Watchtower)
lead:
Crystal is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest. As the quest opens, ogres have stolen the four crystals needed to power the watchtower and protect Yanille from invasion by the ogres. There are four crystals, each a different colour, and the player must retrieve them by performing various tasks around Gu'Tanoth.

* Yellow Crystal - obtained from Grew in return for Gorad's tooth.
* Magenta Crystal - obtained by completing the dialogue with the Mad skavid after learning bits of the Skavid language.
* Cyan Crystal - obtained from the last Ogre Shaman killed in the Ogre Enclave. (If lost, it is reobtained by picking-up and searching the shaman robe found within the enclave.)
* Grey Crystal - found by mining the Rock of Dalgroth, within the centre of the Ogre Enclave. (Requires all Ogre Shaman to be dead.)

label: Crystal ball (Sorcerer's Tower)
title: Crystal ball (Sorcerer's Tower)
lead:
A Crystal ball is found on the table in the Sorcerer's Tower on the . It presumably belongs to the resident of the tower, Thormac.

When an item is used on the crystal ball, the message "The table appears to be in use." appears in the chatbox, signifying that the crystal ball cannot be used as a table.

label: Crystal Cave
title: Crystal Cave
lead: Crystal Cave is a music track that is unlocked anywhere in Zanaris, other than the Fairy Resistance Hideout. To get there, the player must have completed the Lost City quest.

label: crystal chest
title: crystal chest
lead:
The Crystal chest can be found in the house directly south of the witch's house in Taverley. The chest is locked and can only be opened using a crystal key, which is made by combining a loop half of key and a tooth half of key. Attempting to open the chest without the crystal key yields the message: This chest is securely locked shut. Opening the crystal chest grants an uncut dragonstone and possibly a variety of other rewards.

Opening the crystal chest is a task for the medium Falador Diary.

label: Crystal key
title: Crystal key
lead:
The crystal key is created by combining a tooth half of key with a loop half of key, displaying the message, "You join the two halves of the key together." Key halves can be obtained as rewards from Barrows, the Gnome Restaurant minigame, Managing Miscellania, Treasure Trails, looting magpie implings, random events, the rare drop table, etc.

It is used to open the crystal chest located inside a house in Taverley. The chest always contains an uncut dragonstone in addition to a variety of other items. Some items of note are 3 runite bars, rune platelegs/plateskirt (depending on the player's gender), or another half of the crystal key. After the key is used, it disappears and the player must use another one if they want to open the chest again.

label: Crystal Sword
title: Crystal Sword
lead:
Crystal Sword is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness or in Ardougne's eastern sewers. It also plays at Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays in level 1 Wilderness, north of Varrock as well as Ardougne's eastern sewers.

label: Cube part
title: Cube part
lead:
Cube parts were the original components of the Strange box. Although they were in fact items, they could never be obtained by players.

These cube parts were difficult for colour-blind players to identify. As a result in 2006, the Strange box was updated to use numbers instead of colours. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape - however, they remain in the game cache.

label: Cup of tea
title: Cup of tea
lead:
A cup of tea is a drink which restores 3 Hitpoints and temporarily boosts Attack by 2 + 2% (rounded down); it will also instantly cancel the effect of the goading potion. Upon drinking a cup of tea, the player will exclaim and an empty cup will remain in the player's inventory.

Tea may be purchased at Ye olde Tea Shoppe in Varrock or stolen at the nearby Tea stall with 5 Thieving.

label: cupboard (Edmond's house)
title: cupboard (Edmond's house)
lead: A cupboard containing a gas mask, found in Alrena and Edmond's house located north-east of the Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne. Searching the cupboard will yield a gas mask after Alrena has made one during the Plague City quest, provided the player does not currently own one. However, multiple gas masks can be obtained from the cupboard by drop tricking.

label: Cupboard (Hazeel Cult)
title: Cupboard (Hazeel Cult)
lead: A cupboard can be found on the of the Carnillean Mansion, located in the south-western corner of East Ardougne. Players who side with the Carnillean family must search the cupboard during the Hazeel Cult quest to find evidence of Butler Jones's involvement with the cult and finish the quest.

label: cupboard (Heroes' Quest)
title: cupboard (Heroes' Quest)
lead: A cupboard containing Grip's drinks is located within Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven. During the Heroes' Quest, a player who is a Black Arm Gang member must open the cupboard to lure Grip in to the room, allowing a Phoenix Gang member to kill him.

label: Cupboard (Jerico's house)
title: Cupboard (Jerico's house)
lead: A cupboard full of bird feed can be found within Jerico's house, found immediately south of the northern bank in East Ardougne. It is used during the Biohazard quest to retrieve bird feed that is thrown at the West Ardougne watchtower to distract mourner guards with pigeons released from a pigeon cage. Multiple bird feed can be obtained from the cupboard by drop tricking, however, once bird feed is thrown during the quest, the others will be deleted. Searching the cupboard after throwing the bird feed will cause the player to state that they don't need any more bird feed.

label: cupboard (Legends' Quest)
title: cupboard (Legends' Quest)
lead: A cupboard is found inside Sir Radimus Erkle's house in the Legends' Guild courtyard. At the start of the Legends' Quest, Radimus Erkle lets the player search the cupboard for a machete. After the completion of the quest, the player is no longer able to search the cupboard as they will receive the message: "You don't think Radimus Erkle would be very pleased if he caught you rifling through his cupboards without permission."

label: Cupboard (Morgan's home)
title: Cupboard (Morgan's home)
lead: The Cupboard in Morgan's home in Draynor Village can be opened and searched for garlic. The cupboard is located in his second floor, before reaching the bed.

label: cupboard (Nurse Sarah's house)
title: cupboard (Nurse Sarah's house)
lead: A cupboard containing a medical gown can be found within Nurse Sarah's house, located in the southern area of West Ardougne. It is used during the Biohazard quest to retrieve medical gown that must be worn to access the Mourner Headquarters. The cupboard is searchable for another gown if the player loses theirs. Multiple gowns can be obtained from the cupboard by drop tricking.

label: Cupboard (Shield of Arrav)
title: Cupboard (Shield of Arrav)
lead: The cupboard is located on the of the Black Arm Gang Headquarters in Varrock, and is used during the quest Shield of Arrav. It is only accessible by members of the Black Arm Gang. During the quest, the player, if they have chosen to join the Black Arm Gang, must search the cupboard to retrieve the right half of the Shield of Arrav.

label: cupboard (The Grand Tree)
title: cupboard (The Grand Tree)
lead: A cupboard is located in Glough's house within the Tree Gnome Stronghold. During The Grand Tree quest, players must search the cupboard to obtain Glough's journal for evidence.

label: Cupboard (The Knight's Sword)
title: Cupboard (The Knight's Sword)
lead: The cupboard is located on the of the White Knights' Castle in Falador, and is used during the quest The Knight's Sword. During the quest, the player must search the cupboard to retrieve a portrait of a paladin. Before the portrait can be found within the cupboard, the player must first talk to the Squire. The cupboard may only be searched if Sir Vyvin is not in the room, otherwise he will stop the player from doing so.

label: Cupboard (witch's house)
title: Cupboard (witch's house)
lead: A cupboard can be found in the basement of the witch's house in Taverley. It is used during the Witch's House quest to retrieve a magnet in order to catch a mouse. In order to access the cupboard, the player must be wearing an appropriate pair of gloves in order to open an electrified gate, and avoid taking damage.

label: Curator Haig Halen
title: Curator Haig Halen
lead:
Haig Halen is the Curator of the Varrock Museum. He can be found on the ground floor. When asked about treasure, he'll tell the player that the museum is "full of treasures" and that anything the museum found took some time to acquire. You can trade him 250 cut rubies, 100 cosmic runes, 500 fire runes and a Digsite pendant for a curator's medallion.

You may speak to him after gaining 50 Kudos to complete an easy achievement diary task. He is also overseeing the construction of the barge, which requires 100 Kudos to assist with.

label: Curling plant
title: Curling plant
lead: Curling plants are scenery highly prominent across southern Karamja, though a single plant may also be found at Musa Point, being the only one that can be interacted with by free-to-play players.

label: curry
title: curry
lead:
Curry is a type of food that restores 19 Hitpoints when eaten. An empty bowl will remain after consumption. It can be obtained by cooking uncooked curry on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 60 Cooking and granting 280 experience when successful. When cooking, there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt curry. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 74.

At 50 Construction, a Demon butler can be hired, who can serve curry in Player-owned houses. The number of curries served is equal to the number of people in the house, up to 10.

label: Curse
title: Curse
lead: Curse is a level 19 Magic spell. When cast on an opponent, their defence is reduced by 5%. The spell gives 29 experience whether it hits or misses, making it a popular way to gain experience cheaply. The spell can only be cast if the target's stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you can not stack stat reduction with multiple spells in a row.

label: Cursed
title: Cursed
lead:
Cursed is a music track that is unlocked during the Underground Pass quest.

It plays in the entrance section of the Underground Pass dungeon. It is also played in the Wrath Altar and in the unmarked cave with the rabbit boss, just north of the Gwenith Hunter area.

label: Customs officer
title: Customs officer
lead:
A customs officer is found on Karamja at the port at Musa Point. The player must talk to her in order to take a boat back to Port Sarim. It costs 30 coins to depart. If a player is wearing the Karamja gloves, the cost is lowered to 15 coins.

Before the player leaves, she will search the player for any banned substances, such as Karamjan rum. If the player has any on themselves, it will be confiscated. Since this item is necessary in the Pirate's Treasure quest, the player must find some way to smuggle it past her.

label: Cyclops (Ardougne Zoo)
title: Cyclops (Ardougne Zoo)
lead:
A solitary cyclops is located in a cage in the Ardougne Zoo. Unlike all other cyclopes, this cyclops has the same drop table as a regular hill giant.

According to the Zoo keeper, this cyclops was brought to the zoo by an explorer from a far away land, but little else is known because the explorer died shortly thereafter.

label: Da Vinci
title: Da Vinci
lead:
Da Vinci is one of three individuals used to smuggle chemicals into Varrock during the Biohazard quest. In the quest, he should be given the ethenea.

Prior to the quest, Da Vinci can only be found near the Chemist's house in Rimmington, working on a painting of a nearby island. After the quest, he can be found in both Rimmington and the Dancing Donkey Inn in Varrock. He is always accompanied by his associates Hops and Chancy.

label: Daconia rock
title: Daconia rock
lead:
A daconia rock is a magical rock that has been hidden in the roots of the Grand Tree in order to poison it.

The Daconia rocks were created by Hazelmere - allegedly as a precaution in case the Grand Tree should grow out of control, and are the only thing that can kill it. Players discover this precaution has been subverted in The Grand Tree quest.

label: Daconia rocks
title: Daconia rocks
lead: Daconia rocks are a scenery object found beneath the Grand Tree, and are a focal point in the quest The Grand Tree. They were created by Hazelmere - allegedly as a precaution in case the Grand Tree should grow out of control, and are the only thing that can kill it.

label: Dad
title: Dad
lead:
Dad is an abnormally large troll that players must fight during the Troll Stronghold quest to gain access to northern Troll Country. After the quest, he can be re-fought in the Nightmare Zone minigame.

If a player tries to open the arena exit without fighting Dad, he will shout "No human pass through arena without defeating Dad!" and attack the player. He will also ignore the player if talked to. Once Dad is defeated, the player can no longer attack him. Trying to attack him yields the message "You don't need to fight him again."

label: Dairy cow
title: Dairy cow
lead:
A dairy cow is a cow that the player can milk with an empty bucket in their inventory to receive a bucket of milk. For more information, Gillie Groats by the northern Lumbridge cow pen will explain more about milking. Dairy cows were introduced because players could attack and kill a cow whilst another player was milking it, preventing them from receiving milk.

Unlike the other cows, dairy cows cannot be attacked or killed. A dairy cow does "talk" to the player during the quest Cold War. During and after completing Cold War, players can steal cowbells from them.

label: Daisies
title: Daisies
lead: Daisies are a common form of scenery found in various areas across Gielinor.

label: Dal's General Ogre Supplies
title: Dal's General Ogre Supplies
lead: Dal's General Ogre Supplies is a general store in Gu'Tanoth owned by an ogre trader named Dal. Dal is the only ogre trader in the area that allows players to trade with him, and accessing the shop requires starting the Watchtower quest.

label: Dalal
title: Dalal
lead: Dalal is one of the people observing the fights at the Emir's Arena, along with Ima.

label: Damaged armour
title: Damaged armour
lead:
Damaged armour is an item that can be found by digging at the digsite, from the Fishing Trawler minigame, or from pick-pocketing certain monsters (including H.A.M. members). It is also found in ogre coffins (see ogre coffin key), can be telegrabbed inside the Ranging Guild's archery competition spot, and is found in the Uzer Mastaba by searching the first skeleton directly east of the stairs. Players may use the drop trick as a free and quick way to obtain lots of the damaged armour item from this skeleton.

Players may also find damaged armours scattered throughout the world in the form of scenery. However, these may not be picked up.

label: Damaged dagger
title: Damaged dagger
lead:
The damaged dagger is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest and it can be found after the quest's completion. The player can find it by searching the bushes surrounding the Watchtower outside the north wall of Yanille. It serves no purpose during the quest and is there as a red herring.

While it cannot be used as a weapon, it can be used to slash webs.

label: Damaged Earth
title: Damaged Earth
lead: Damaged Earth is earth that has been damaged after an unsuccessful attempt at growing a Yommi tree in one of the 6 patches of Fertile Soil in the Kharazi Jungle during the Legends' Quest. It takes about one minute for the earth to become fertile again.

label: Damp sticks
title: Damp sticks
lead: Damp sticks are used with broken glass to make dry sticks in the Sea Slug Quest. The dry sticks can then be used to light a torch. They can be found on the Fishing Platform.

label: Dance
title: Dance
lead: Dance is the thirteenth listed emote, and is unlocked automatically for all accounts. Performing the emote causes the player to swing both arms back and forth in the air and kick their legs one at a time. Performing the emote while wearing flared trousers will instead cause players to perform a disco move and then a split.

label: Dancing Donkey Inn
title: Dancing Donkey Inn
lead: The Dancing Donkey Inn is a small bar found in south-eastern Varrock. Chancy, Hops, and Da Vinci, non-player characters who are involved in the Biohazard quest, are found there. The bar sells beer for 2 coins each.

label: Danger sign (Death Plateau)
title: Danger sign (Death Plateau)
lead: A danger sign is located at the main entry path of Death Plateau. When read a short cutscene plays, pointing the camera at the nearest Thrower Troll, with the troll noticing the camera and throwing a rock at it.

label: Danger sign (Wilderness)
title: Danger sign (Wilderness)
lead:
Danger sign is located outside the entrance to Lava Dragon Isle, all over the Fight arena, near the entrance to the Sheep herder incinerator, on the Khazard Battlefield, and various other locations that seem suitable to warn people of danger.

This is the oldest Danger sign in RuneScape, having been originally added 13 August 2001 to mark the border of the Wilderness. The job of marking the border of the wilderness was given to a redesigned Wilderness Sign on 24 April 2006, but this original sign is still used in many places. It has even been used in newer content, such as its use north of Prifddinas, where a simpler sign was desired.

label: Dangerous
title: Dangerous
lead:
Dangerous is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays in the Wilderness north of Edgeville, and south of the Demonic Ruins.

label: Dargaud's Bow and Arrows.
title: Dargaud's Bow and Arrows.
lead: Dargaud's Bow and Arrows is a shop where Dargaud the Bow and Arrow salesman sells arrow shafts, arrows and arrowheads up to runite, as well as shortbows. He will also buy brutal arrows up to runite. His shop is located in the Ranging Guild.

label: Dark
title: Dark
lead:
Dark is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and plays in the Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays north-east of the Wilderness Chaos Temple.

label: Dark cavalier
title: Dark cavalier
lead:
The dark cavalier is a piece of headwear. There are no requirements for wearing this cavalier and they do not confer combat bonuses upon the player.

A cavalier of any colour is a potential reward from hard Treasure Trails.

label: Dark dagger
title: Dark dagger
lead:
The dark dagger is a quest item obtained during Legends' Quest. It is given to the player by the entity Echned Zekin. The dagger can then either be given to Ugandulu for a one-use Holy force spell, or used to kill Viyeldi which converts the dagger into a glowing dagger. It is then given to Echned, who turns out to be the demon.

If players have misplaced their glowing dagger after the quest, it can be reclaimed from Radimus Erkle, and can be investigated via-right click afterwards to switch its appearance between a dark or glowing dagger.

label: Dark Mage
title: Dark Mage
lead: The Dark Mage is a Zamorakian mage that lives in a tower east of the entrance to the Underground Pass in West Ardougne. He provides various services related to Iban's staff.

label: dark warrior
title: dark warrior
lead:
Dark warriors are mainly found in the Dark Warriors' Fortress, a castle in level 12 to 16 Wilderness north-west of Edgeville. Some dark warriors can also be found in Great Kourend, accompanying necromancers. The warriors in Great Kourend are different combat levels than those found in the Wilderness.

Dark warriors found in the fortress come in both level 8 and 145 variants, the latter of which only appears in members' worlds. The area is multi-combat and a Dwarf multicannon can be set up in the center of the inner courtyard of the fortress. To speed up a Krystilia Slayer task, it is recommended that the player kills the Level 8 Dark warriors roaming the corridors of the fortress, while leaving the cannon to deal with the Level 145 ones inside the courtyard, making sure to close the courtyard doors so that the warriors don't get out of range of the cannon by going inside the corridors.

label: Dark Warriors' Fortress
title: Dark Warriors' Fortress
lead: The Dark Warriors' Fortress is a castle in level 14 to 16 multi-combat Wilderness, north of Falador. It is populated with level 8 and 145 dark warriors in members worlds, but only level 8 dark warriors in non-members worlds. Caution should be used as these warriors can overwhelm lower level players who don't use Protect from Melee.

label: Dark wizard
title: Dark wizard
lead:
Dark wizards are Zamorakian mages that attack with low-level magic. They can be primarily found around the Varrock stone circle and in the Dark Wizards' Tower, and are notable for frequently dropping runes, as well as black robes and wizard hats. They are also notable for being a considerable threat to very low level players due to their relatively high max hit for their combat level and position next to the southern entrance of Varrock.

They play a small role in the Demon Slayer quest, performing a ritual to summon the demon Delrith.

label: Dark Wizards' Tower
title: Dark Wizards' Tower
lead:
The Dark Wizards' Tower is a tower to the west of Falador in a members-only area. It is due west of Falador, north-west of the Makeover Mage, and south of Taverley and the entrance to the Taverley Dungeon. Level 23 dark wizards occupy all three floors of the tower, and Zandar Horfyre is located on the top floor.

The Tower is involved in Fairytale I - Growing Pains, during which the player must talk to Zandar Horfyre to help cure the Fairy Queen in Zanaris.

label: Dark Wizards' Tower Portal
title: Dark Wizards' Tower Portal
lead: The Dark Wizards' Tower portal is one of the three teleportation portals found on the top floor of the Wizards' Guild. Located on the southern wall of the guild, entering the portal will teleport the player to Dark Wizards' Tower, which is west of Falador and south of Taverley.

label: David (Murder Mystery)
title: David (Murder Mystery)
lead:
David Sinclair is one of Lord Sinclair's children. He is a suspect during the Murder Mystery quest. He is also involved in King's Ransom.

According to the Gossip, he has anger management problems, shouting at the household servants when he is angry. As much as they fear his anger, they do not dare to report his behaviour to his father as it would get him kicked out of the house.

label: David's barrel
title: David's barrel
lead: David's barrel can be found inside the Sinclair Mansion in David's bedroom. During the Murder Mystery quest, the player must search the barrel to find his silver book.

label: David's print
title: David's print
lead: David's print is a quest item in the Murder Mystery quest. It is created by using flypaper on the silver book after dusting it with a pot of flour. If the prints match those of the unknown print, it will become a killer's print, meaning David is the killer.

label: Davon
title: Davon
lead: Davon is a merchant found standing along the southern shore of Brimhaven towards the fence. He runs Davon's Amulet Store - apparently out of his pockets (in true underworld style), because he has neither a building nor a stall. The price of items is affected by wearing Karamja gloves.

label: Davon's Amulet Store.
title: Davon's Amulet Store.
lead:
Davon's Amulet Store is a jewellery store in Brimhaven, owned by Davon. It stocks enchanted gem amulets, as well as holy symbols. It has a higher buying price and lower selling price to players wearing Karamja gloves 1 or higher.

The shop has no inventory of its own to sell, making it useful for getting rid of enchanted amulets as it will buy them for a higher price than other shops. Ironmen cannot buy from this shop because any amulets that he has available for purchase will always be overstocked.

label: Dead Man's Chest
title: Dead Man's Chest
lead: The Dead Man's Chest is a bar in Brimhaven. (located in northern Karamja) Players can buy grog for 3 coins and Karamjan rum for 27 coins from the Bartender. It also plays a role in Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest, in which the player must drink Supergrog. There are some beer and empty beer glass as well as a bronze axe respawns on some of the tables. There are some barrels located by the north wall and in the south-west corner that beer glasses can be refilled at.

label: dead orb
title: dead orb
lead:
A dead orb is an unobtainable item released alongside the Underground Pass quest. Previously, it was a fifth orb of light that could not be obtained, and it was silently renamed to "Dead orb" in an update on 15 June 2017.

During the Underground Pass quest, the player is required to collect four orbs of light. The first three spawn on the ground and can easily be picked up, however the fourth is in front of a swinging log that must be disarmed. The item that appeared on the ground was a fake orb that was actually an object, and was programmed to trigger the trap if players attempted to pick it up. To give the illusion of being real, an invisible Orb of light item was set to spawn on the same tile, so a red dot would appear on the minimap.

label: Dead Quiet
title: Dead Quiet
lead:
Dead Quiet is a music track that is unlocked in the Mort Myre Swamp. It can also be unlocked while Temple Trekking, during the Bog puzzle, when battling the Swamp snakes, or during combat events with two escape routes. In the Mort Myre Swamp area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Stagnant and Waterlogged.

In Classic mode, the unlock area in the Mort Myre Swamp is limited to the south-eastern part of Mort Myre Swamp. With this setting, it is also possible to unlock it at the shore east of the Digsite.

label: dead tree
title: dead tree
lead:
Dead trees can be chopped down to provide logs and 25 Woodcutting experience. They are the same as normal trees but with a different look.

There are a few special types of dead trees. Some types of burnt dead trees provide charcoal when chopped down, instead of logs. Some undead trees at Draynor Manor attack unsuspecting players for up to 3 damage.

label: Dead tree (snowy)
title: Dead tree (snowy)
lead:
Snowy dead trees are a variant of dead trees that be chopped down to provide logs and 25 Woodcutting experience. They are the same as normal trees but with a different appearance.

When chopped down, the tree is replaced by a tree stump. After a few seconds, it will respawn into a dead tree.

label: Dead tree (weathered)
title: Dead tree (weathered)
lead:
Weathered dead trees are a variant of dead trees that can be chopped down to provide logs, awarding 25 Woodcutting experience. They are the same as normal trees but with a different appearance.

When chopped down, the tree is replaced by a tree stump. After a few seconds, it will respawn into a dead tree.

label: deadly red spider
title: deadly red spider
lead: Deadly red spiders are an aggressive species of spider. Their eggs can usually be found nearby. The spiders found in Varrock Sewers are a popular training spot for free-to-play, as they reside in a multicombat area and are aggressive to low levels (up to level 68 combat). Bringing a knife or slash weapon is mandatory to access the area.

label: Death Plateau
title: Death Plateau
lead: Death Plateau is a short quest wherein you are to help the Burthorpe Imperial Guard gain access to the Death Plateau in order to defeat the hostile trolls.

label: Death Plateau (location)
title: Death Plateau (location)
lead:
The Death Plateau is a tall, flat land formation, surrounded by steep ascents, north-west of Burthorpe and directly north of the Warriors' Guild. This area is inhabited by various trolls. Though the plateau is not a multi-combat area, the path leading around the plateau is riddled with thrower trolls and is multi-combat. Extreme caution is advised here, and players should take advantage of Protection prayers as certain monsters can hit very high here.

A Dwarf multicannon may be used here.

label: Death rune
title: Death rune
lead:
Death runes are one of the runes used to cast spells in the Magic skill. They are required to cast medium-level missile spells, like Wind Blast, Water Blast, Earth Blast, and Fire Blast. Members with 65 Runecraft and who have completed Mourning's End Part II can craft death runes at the Death Altar by using pure essence on it, with each essence yielding one death rune. Each death rune yields 10 Runecraft experience. Players with 99 Runecraft will always craft two death runes per essence. Crafting death runes from essence is a requirement for the Hard Ardougne Diary.

Death runes can be bought from most Magic shops. Several monsters, such as ankous, nechryael, and dark beasts, commonly drop death runes. They can also be found in the Barrows Chest with at least 631 rewards potential.

label: Death wing
title: Death wing
lead:
Death wings are flying monsters that appear in the Legends' Quest. The death wings are located in a remote area, and have no drops, so very few players train on them. Killing a death wing is one of the hard tasks in the Karamja Diary.

Death wings can only be found in the Shaman Caves, which is unlocked during the Legends' Quest. To reach them, players should bring one or more lockpicks, a machete, any axe and any pickaxe. The dungeon can be found in the north-west of the Kharazi Jungle by searching the mossy rocks, after which the player should search the bookshelf north of Ungadulu and choose to squeeze through there, picklock the ancient door, mine the rocks and open another door to reach the death wings. Death wings can also sometimes be found inside barrels in the dungeon.

label: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
title: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
lead:
The Deep Wilderness Dungeon can be found in level 51 Wilderness. The entrance is via stairs in a broken house west of the Mage Arena. It is entirely single-way combat and covers level 49 to 56 Wilderness.

The main attractions here are the wine of Zamorak spawn found at the end of the dungeon, which respawns every 3-7 ticks (and are obtained in noted form if players have completed the hard Wilderness Diary), as well as the fire giants which can be assigned as a Wilderness Slayer task by Krystilia, this being their only location in the Wilderness. A cannon can be used within the dungeon.

label: Deep Wildy
title: Deep Wildy
lead:
Deep Wildy is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays near the Chaos Temple or south of the Ice Plateau in the Wilderness.

label: Defence
title: Defence
lead: Defence is a skill that grants players protection in all forms of combat. Defence level also determines which equipment players are able to wear, as most pieces of armour or other equipment have a Defence level requirement.

label: Defence Level Up!
title: Defence Level Up!
lead: Defence Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling defence.

label: Defence Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Defence Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Defence Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Defence.

label: defence potion
title: defence potion
lead:
A Defence potion is a potion made by using white berries on a ranarr potion (unf), requiring 30 Herblore, yielding a Defence potion(3) and 75 Herblore experience. A dose of Defence potion provides a temporary skill boost to Defence equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down. This is less than the super Defence's boost of 5 + 15% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down.

After Barbarian Herblore Training, caviar can be added to a Defence potion(2), requiring 33 Herblore, yielding a Defence mix and 25 Herblore experience. A Defence mix has 2 doses, boosts Defence equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down, and heals 6 Hitpoints.

label: Delrith
title: Delrith
lead:
Delrith is a Zamorakian demon summoned by dark wizards from a stone table during the Demon Slayer quest. Delrith is relatively easy to kill and players can evade the wizards if they take their time. Low-levelled players should exercise caution, however as the wizards will deal significant damage against them.

All damage dealt to Delrith is doubled when Silverlight is equipped. Ring of recoil damage will therefore always inflict 2 on Delrith when he lands a successful hit on the player. When using a ring of recoil to lower Delrith's hitpoints, it's not necessary to deal any damage to him directly in order to finish the quest; you must simply have Silverlight equipped.

label: Demon Slayer
title: Demon Slayer
lead: Demon Slayer is one of six quests released with the launch of RuneScape Classic. In it, players are tasked with protecting Varrock from a powerful demon.

label: Demonic Ruins
title: Demonic Ruins
lead:
The Demonic Ruins, originally known as Annakarl during the rule of Zaros, is a desecrated temple that is located in level 44-48 Wilderness. Players within range of the ruins will have their Prayer points passively recharged. As with all locations in the Wilderness, . The entire area is multicombat.

The ruins are notable for being the only place to find greater demons on free-to-play worlds. All four demons are level 92.

label: Denulth
title: Denulth
lead:
Commander Denulth is the forefront of the Burthorpe Imperial Guard in the Principality of Burthorpe, and acting leader during Prince Anlaf's sudden illness, as well as a commander in the Burthorpe–Troll Country War.

Talking to him is required to start the Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold quests. He can be found at the training grounds by a rectangular tent, near The Toad and Chicken inn.

label: Desert boots
title: Desert boots
lead:
Desert boots are boots suitable for desert environments such as the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. Wearing the boots delays the desert heat effect by 6 additional seconds. The boots have no other bonuses.

A full set of desert clothing is needed for the The Tourist Trap quest. They are given to a slave miner in exchange for a set of slave robes which permit the player to access a deeper area of the mining camp.

label: Desert Mining Camp
title: Desert Mining Camp
lead:
The Desert Mining Camp is a slave camp located south of Al Kharid in the Kharidian Desert. It features prominently in The Tourist Trap quest.

Run by Captain Siad, prisoners from Al Kharid are sent to the mining camp to serve out their sentences in the mines.

label: Desert robe
title: Desert robe
lead:
Desert robes are suitable for desert environments, like the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. When worn, this clothing item delays the desert heat effect by 12 additional seconds. It has no other bonuses.

A full set of desert clothing is needed for the The Tourist Trap quest. They are given to a slave miner in exchange for a set of slave robes to allow the player access to a deeper area of the mining camp.

label: Desert shirt
title: Desert shirt
lead:
Desert shirts are suitable for desert environments, like the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. When worn, this clothing item delays the desert heat effect by 12 additional seconds. It has no other bonuses.

A full set of desert clothing is needed for the The Tourist Trap quest. They are given to a slave miner in exchange for a set of slave robes to allow the player access to a deeper area of the mining camp.

label: Desert Voyage
title: Desert Voyage
lead:
Desert Voyage is a music track unlocked in members parts of Kharidian Desert. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Arabian 3, Desert Heat, The Desert, Egypt, Scarab, Sphinx and Sunburn.

In Classic mode, the track plays around the Desert Mining Camp, or the entrance to the Smoke Dungeon.

label: Desert Wolf
title: Desert Wolf
lead:
A desert wolf is a type of wolf that is located all over the north-west of the Kharidian Desert, as well as in the Necropolis. Players who wish to kill desert wolves should bring protection from desert heat, such as waterskins, the circlet of water, or the Desert amulet 4.

They are aggressive to players level 54 Combat and below.

label: Deserted Keep
title: Deserted Keep
lead:
The Deserted Keep is an abandoned surrounded by lava, located deep in the Wilderness. It spans level 50 to 54, and is found to the east of the Mage Arena. A web blocks the entrance to the keep, so unless someone else has slashed it recently, players will need a knife or a weapon with a slash attack style to enter or exit the keep.

East of the keep lies the Resource Area and the Chaos Elemental.

label: Desk (Shaman Caves)
title: Desk (Shaman Caves)
lead: A Desk is found inside the octagram of Fire Walls in the Shaman Caves. Looking at the desk results in the message: It's a very old rickety desk made of bamboo. The desk can be used as a safespot while fighting Nezikchened during the Legends' Quest. Searching it produces the Shaman's tome.

label: Diamond
title: Diamond
lead:
Diamonds are precious gems used mainly in Crafting. They can be cut from uncut diamonds with a chisel at level 43 Crafting, yielding 107.5 experience.

A diamond is required to enter the Zanaris marketplace.

label: Diamond amulet
title: Diamond amulet
lead:
A diamond amulet is an amulet created by using a ball of wool on a diamond amulet (u). The unstrung diamond amulet is created by using a gold bar and a diamond on a furnace with an amulet mould in the inventory. It is the fourth highest level amulet that can be created. This requires a Crafting level of 70 and provides 100 Crafting experience when made.

It can be turned into an amulet of power with Lvl-4 Enchant.

label: Diamond amulet (u)
title: Diamond amulet (u)
lead:
A diamond amulet (u) is the unstrung version of the regular diamond amulet. It is made by using a gold bar on a furnace, while having a cut diamond and an amulet mould in the inventory.

Level 70 Crafting is required to make one, yielding 100 experience. When used with a ball of wool, it becomes a diamond amulet, giving 4 experience. After it is strung, it can be enchanted into an amulet of power, requiring level 57 Magic and yielding 67 experience.

label: Diamond necklace
title: Diamond necklace
lead:
A Diamond necklace is made by using a gold bar, a diamond, and a necklace mould on a furnace. This requires level 56 Crafting and gives 90 Crafting experience.

A diamond necklace can be enchanted into a phoenix necklace by using the Lvl-4 Enchant spell. This requires level 57 Magic, one cosmic rune, and ten earth runes.

label: Diamond ring
title: Diamond ring
lead:
The diamond ring is made by using a gold bar, a cut diamond and a ring mould on a furnace. Making it requires a Crafting level of 43, and gives 85 experience.

The diamond ring can be enchanted into a ring of life by members through the use of the Lvl-4 Enchant spell.

label: Diango
title: Diango
lead:
Diango is a merchant located in Draynor Village who sells toys and other commemorative items in his store, Diango's Toy Store. He is able to replace lost holiday items that the player has previously earned from holiday events.

He was originally added as part of an April Fools' joke. Players had been requesting horses in the game for some time, and were excited to find out that Diango was to be added to sell "horses" in his store. However, Diango actually sells toy horseys, which are not rideable and are mostly useless. He has since been a part of several holiday events, such as the 2013 Halloween event.

label: Diango's Toy Store
title: Diango's Toy Store
lead: Diango's Toy Store is located in Draynor Village market, run by Diango next to his Toy Stall. Many holiday events are centred around Diango and his store. Players who have lost a non-tradeable holiday item can visit this store to have it replaced free of charge.

label: Diary (Witch's House)
title: Diary (Witch's House)
lead:
The witch's diary is a quest item used only in Witch's House. It is found on the desk on the of Nora T. Hagg's house.

It reveals information on some of the witch's experiments, giving the player clues on how to get into the back yard and what to expect during the fight.

label: Digsite
title: Digsite
lead:
The Digsite is an archaeological excavation area just east of Varrock. Players need to proceed far enough into the Dig Site quest in order to fully use it. This area is a members-only location. It is visited during several quests.

During The Dig Site quest, players learn that the area was once Senntisten, the capital of the Zarosian Empire during the Second Age. During the quest, players find an ancient talisman and a stone tablet telling all mortals to tremble before the power of Zaros. This area is said to be part of a city three times bigger than Varrock which supposedly reached to Edgeville (then known as Paddewwa). It was destroyed during the God Wars and replaced by Saranthium, which was destroyed several hundred years before Avarrocka was established in 700 of the Fourth Age.

label: Digsite Dungeon
title: Digsite Dungeon
lead:
The Digsite Dungeon is below the Digsite and can only be accessed during and after The Dig Site quest. It appears to have once been a temple of Zaros.

Players rarely use the dungeon after the quest, because of the dungeon's distance from a bank, though it has several iron pickaxe and bucket spawns and five silver rocks.

label: Digsite workman
title: Digsite workman
lead:
The Digsite workmen can be found in and around the Digsite, as well as carrying rocks to the Varrock Museum. They can also be pickpocketed, giving 10.4 Thieving experience if successful.

They play an important role in The Dig Site quest as one may steal an animal skull from them. Also, players who come to work at the Digsite without the necessary tools can pickpocket the workmen and eventually gain most of the items needed, although this can take some time.

label: Dimintheis
title: Dimintheis
lead: Dimintheis Fitzharmon is a noble of Varrock. He is featured heavily in the quest Family Crest, and plays a crucial role in the quest Defender of Varrock. He is a descendant of an important Elder of Avarrocka, and is the father of Avan, Caleb, and Johnathon Fitzharmon. His house is located south of Varrock's east gate, north of the Fancy dress shop in the fenced off area.

label: Disciple of Iban
title: Disciple of Iban
lead:
Disciples of Iban are cultists who worship Iban, and are located in the Underground Pass. They drop Zamorak monk robes, which must be worn to enter Iban's temple during the Underground Pass quest. After Iban is killed, they disappear permanently.

Formerly, Disciples of Iban would drop a broken Iban's staff if the player lost theirs. With the release of Song of the Elves, this is no longer the case. To retrieve a new staff, you must now talk to Koftik at the entrance of the Underground Pass.

label: Disk of returning
title: Disk of returning
lead:
The disk of returning is an item purchased from Diango's Toy Store for coins. Players can activate the disk, which requires them to be inside the Dwarven Mine; when activated, the player is teleported into the Blackhole, where Thordur resides. To leave, simply activate the disk again. This will cause players to reappear in the Dwarven Mine, next to Boot and the sign in the north-western corner of the mine. This means it could conceivably be used to quickly travel from the south-eastern part of the mine to the north-western part. This can be useful for Free-to-play Ultimate Ironmen to train their Smithing with Superheat Item in the mines, by accessing the anvils next to the respawn location after leaving the black hole, or for players running from Falador to the Ruins of Camdozaal.

The 'blackout' option on the disk may also be used in the easternmost part of the White Knights' Castle Crypt, although the 'activate' option does not work. This may be used to quickly reach certain clue step locations by teleporting to Falador, entering the crypt, and then entering and leaving the blackhole.

label: Distillator
title: Distillator
lead:
The distillator is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is found in a crate within the storeroom on the of the Mourner Headquarters. Players are able to access the storeroom after killing the level 13 Mourner to obtain a key used to unlock the gate.

It is returned to Elena in order to run some tests.

label: Doctor Orbon
title: Doctor Orbon
lead:
Doctor Orbon is located in the East Ardougne chapel, and is involved in the Sheep Herder Quest. He sells the plague set, consisting of a plague jacket and a pair of plague trousers, that protects players from the poisonous sheep. He seems to be a scientist who has invented a suit that helps protect people from the infected sheep around the north of East Ardougne. The quest cannot be completed without his help.

If talked to while wearing full mourner clothes, he will ask for his payment, saying 'he won't keep the charade any longer for free', and asks to tell the head mourner about it. This implies that he is part of the Mourners or is working for them.

label: dog
title: dog
lead:
A dog can be found on the farm south of Falador, and in the caves under The Hollows. The dog in Falador farm is kept as a pet by Sarah, the farm's owner, along with Sadie and a sheepdog that lives inside the house. He roams the chicken pen on the farm's western side. Two additional dogs are located within a small cave accessible after entering the tunnels during In Search of the Myreque. Take the middle tunnel on the western wall to see them.

Players can pet the dog, resulting in the player saying and a chatbox message stating He tries to lick your hands as you pet him.

label: Doll of iban
title: Doll of iban
lead:
The doll of iban is a quest item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is initially obtained by searching the chest belonging to Kardia the witch in her house deep in the underground pass, west of West Ardougne.

The doll is turned into an effigy of Iban by using Iban's shadow, Iban's ashes, Iban's blood and Iban's dove on it, all of which have to be obtained by completing various tasks in the dungeon. Progress on the doll is saved if it is lost. At the end of the quest, the doll is thrown down the Well of Voyage to banish Iban from Gielinor.

label: Dolmen
title: Dolmen
lead: Dolmens are burial tombs used by gnomes, that can be found south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold and inside the Tree Gnome Village. Due to the gnomes' smaller size, the dolmen resembles a table for humans.

label: Dommik
title: Dommik
lead:
Dommik is the owner of Dommik's Crafting Store., a Crafting shop in Al Kharid. Most players use him to purchase needles and thread used in the Crafting skill.

Due to the fact that a cow field is nearby, he's useful for running the dropped cowhides from Lumbridge to the tanner in Al Kharid, to his crafting shop to buy supplies for making items out of leather.

label: Dommik's Crafting Store.
title: Dommik's Crafting Store.
lead:
Dommik's Crafting Store is a Crafting supplies store owned by Dommik located in north-eastern Al Kharid. It is a convenient place to buy Crafting supplies due to its close proximity to a bank and a tanner.

Dommik's Crafting Store has an identical stock to that of Rommik's Crafty Supplies in Rimmington.

label: Donny the lad
title: Donny the lad
lead: Donny the lad is one of the three Bandits that lead the Wilderness Bandit Camp. Players cannot talk to Donny, any attempt to will give the player a message that states: "Donny the Lad is not interested in talking". Speedy Keith and Black Heather are the other two leaders of the Wilderness Bandit Camp.

label: Donovan the Family Handyman
title: Donovan the Family Handyman
lead: Donovan the Family Handyman is one of the murder suspects in Murder Mystery. He can be found on the top floor of the Sinclair Mansion, wandering around.

label: Doogle leaves
title: Doogle leaves
lead:
Doogle leaves are herbs that players can use on a raw sardine to make a seasoned sardine. They then feed the seasoned sardine to Fluffs, a cat in the Gertrude's Cat quest. After the quest, players may still season sardines with the leaves, but the doogle sardines can not be used to feed player-owned kittens.

It may also be needed for the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest as a possible seasoning for Fycie, Bugs or Rantz.

label: Doomion
title: Doomion
lead:
Doomion is a demon encountered during the Underground Pass quest. When killed, it drops the amulet of doomion, which is needed to obtain Iban's shadow. Protect from Melee should be used during this part of the quest to save hitpoints for coping with its attacks.

It is possible to use the small bridges connecting the platforms as a safespot to attack using Ranged, Magic, or with a halberd. In the quest, the player must also kill the other demons, Othainian and Holthion.

label: Door (Ardougne Castle)
title: Door (Ardougne Castle)
lead: The doors in the north and south wings of the Ardougne Castle's require a Thieving level of 61 to open. They guard entrance to rooms containing the Ardougne Castle chests, and a black scimitar also spawns behind the southern door.

label: Door (Chaos Druid Tower)
title: Door (Chaos Druid Tower)
lead: The door is the entrance to the Chaos Druid Tower. Unlocking the door requires level 46 Thieving and grants 37.5 experience.

label: Door (Magic axe hut)
title: Door (Magic axe hut)
lead: The door is the entrance to the Magic axe hut located in the Wilderness. A lockpick and level 23 Thieving are required to unlock the door.

label: Door (McGrubor's Wood)
title: Door (McGrubor's Wood)
lead:
The door in the shack in McGrubor's Wood can be opened after completion of the Temple of Ikov quest by using the shiny key on the door, or by left-clicking the door while having the key in the inventory.

In the shack is an entrance to the Temple of Ikov dungeon leading to the section with lesser demons.

label: Door (Nulodion)
title: Door (Nulodion)
lead:
The Door is the entrance to the western house at the entrance to the Dwarven Mine on Ice Mountain. It is locked until the Dwarf Cannon quest has progressed until the player has been ordered to pick up items from Nulodion, the cannon engineer. The door automatically closes after the player walks through it.

Nulodion is inside and gives the player an ammo mould and Nulodion's notes to bring back to Captain Lawgof during the quest. After the quest, he sells the Dwarf multicannon.

label: Door (Pirates' Hideout)
title: Door (Pirates' Hideout)
lead: The door is the entrance to the Pirates' Hideout located in the Wilderness. A lockpick and level 39 Thieving are required to unlock the door.

label: Door (Ross' House)
title: Door (Ross' House)
lead:
The door is the entrance to Ross' house. Unlocking the door requires level 13 Thieving and grants 15 experience. Whether you succeed or fail in unlocking the door, there is a chance (between ~77% at level 13 and ~2% at level 99) that you will lose 10% (rounded down) of your current Hitpoints. You will not receive any damage if you have ten Hitpoints or less. The chance to both avoid damage and unlock the door scales between 0.7% at level 13 and 15% at level 99.

When given a Mahogany Homes contract for Ross' house, the player can open the door without needing to unlock it.

label: Door (Yanille Dungeon)
title: Door (Yanille Dungeon)
lead: The door is an alternate entrance to the Yanille Agility Dungeon located in the basement of a house in south-east Yanille. To pick the lock and open the door, players must have a lockpick and a Thieving level of 82. Picking this lock is a requirement of the Ardougne Elite Diary. There seems to be about a 10-15% chance of success to open the door every attempt.

label: Door key (Witch's House)
title: Door key (Witch's House)
lead:
The Door key is a quest item used in Witch's House, Grim Tales, and Mourning's End Part II. It is found by searching under a potted plant left of the front door of the witch's house in Taverley. Additionally, another key spawns on the of Nora T. Hagg's house. In Grim Tales, a key may be obtained from Princess Miazrqa after Rupert has been freed.

In Witch's House and Grim Tales, it is used to open the front door of Nora T. Hagg's house. In Mourning's End Part II, it may be needed to obtain the death talisman.

label: Door man
title: Door man
lead: Door men are unused NPCs who could originally be found guarding the entrance to the marketplace in Zanaris. In 2006, Zanaris was graphically updated, and the door men were replaced by Gatekeepers. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Doorways
title: Doorways
lead:
Doorways is a music track that can be unlocked at locations outside Varrock city walls, including the Cooks' Guild, Champions' Guild, and Jolly Boar Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Expanse, Greatness, and Still Night. It can also be unlocked on the Isle of Souls.

If using Classic music mode in free-to-play area, it only plays at the Jolly Boar Inn or the Lumberyard.

label: Doric
title: Doric
lead:
Doric is a dwarf that lives in a small hut north of Falador and directly east of the Taverley gate. He plays a minor role in the Devious Minds quest but is mostly known for his quest called Doric's Quest. His hut contains an anvil and a whetstone.

Doric's anvils are the closest to the Dwarven Mine. He has a steel pickaxe on his back. He is the self-proclaimed best maker of pickaxes in Gielinor, but he has a running order with Nurmof and will not sell the player any.

label: Doric's hut
title: Doric's hut
lead:
Doric's hut is a small hut located south of Goblin Village, just east of the gate to Taverley. There is a small wheat field just south of it. The only inhabitant, Doric, is a dwarf who specialises in the Smithing skill.

As the name implies, this hut is the starting location of Doric's Quest, and can be started by talking to Doric. After the quest, players can use the 2 anvils inside the hut; currently the closest anvils to any banks in Falador.

label: Doric's Quest
title: Doric's Quest
lead: Doric's Quest is a quest involving Doric the dwarf, who is happy to let the player use his anvils but first requests an errand.

label: Dr Harlow
title: Dr Harlow
lead:
Dr Randulf Harlow is a retired vampyre slayer in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. If a player has started Vampyre Slayer, they must buy him a beer in order to convince him to teach them how to kill Count Draynor. Dr Harlow will then give players a stake. After completing the quest, Dr Harlow will go back to what he was saying before ("Buy me a beer pleash").

During the 2021 Halloween event, he and other bar attendants respond with fear to the arrival of Death in a cutscene.

label: dragon battleaxe
title: dragon battleaxe
lead:
The dragon battleaxe is the third strongest battleaxe, behind the leaf-bladed battleaxe and the zombie axe. It requires 60 Attack and the completion of Heroes' Quest to wield.

The battleaxe is not commonly used as a primary weapon, however it has a useful strength-boosting special attack that can be activated before switching to a more powerful weapon to attack with.

label: Dragon bitter
title: Dragon bitter
lead: Dragon bitter is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Strength by 2 while draining Attack by 5% + 2. It can be obtained through brewing at level 39 Cooking granting 347 experience. It is brewed using 4 krandorian hops, 2 buckets of water, 2 lots of barley, and a pot of ale yeast. The stronger, mature version of the ale is the dragon bitter(m).

label: dragon bones
title: dragon bones
lead:
Dragon bones are bones dropped by most adult dragons, which give 72 Prayer experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 216 XP when casting Sinister Offering.
* 216 XP when offered at the sacred bone burner after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 252 XP when offered at a gilded altar with two burners lit or at the Chaos Temple. The Temple additionally has a 50% chance to not deplete the bones; effectively doubling the XP to 504 per bone.
* 288 XP when offered at the Ectofuntus in the form of dragon bonemeal.
* 290 XP when blessed and broken down into blessed bone shards and offered at the libation bowl, or 348 XP when offered with a jug of blessed sunfire wine. Virilis outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.

The relative ease of collecting dragon bones, combined with the amount of experience earned from them, makes them widely viewed as a fast, cost-effective way to train Prayer.

label: dragon chainbody
title: dragon chainbody
lead:
The dragon chainbody is the highest tier of chainbody in the game, requiring a Defence level of 60 to equip. As with most dragon armour, players cannot make this item using the Smithing skill.

Prior to the release of Barrows armour, the chainbody was an extremely rare item, and was a status symbol for accomplished players. Today, the chainbody is not nearly as prestigious as it once was, and its lack of a strength bonus means it is often substituted with armour such as the fighter torso for Slayer tasks and general melee training, where maximising one's damage output takes precedence over defensive bonuses.

label: Dragon dagger
title: Dragon dagger
lead:
The dragon dagger is the second-strongest dagger available in Old School RuneScape, behind the abyssal dagger. It can be wielded by players with at least 60 Attack after completion of the Lost City quest. As with most daggers, it can be poisoned.

If casting either of the alchemy spells on a dragon dagger, use a cleaning cloth on poisoned versions to make more profit, as the value of the unpoisoned dagger is higher than any of the poisoned versions: compared to .

label: Dragon Inn
title: Dragon Inn
lead:
The Dragon Inn is the only bar in Yanille. It is located in the south-west of the city, between the Hunter store and a small lake. The bar is one of the two places in RuneScape where you can buy dragon bitter and one of four places you can buy a Greenman's ale. The sign out the front of the inn is a picture of a red dragon head from front on. The name of the inn probably comes from the two stuffed dragon heads mounted about the counter of the bar.

The of the inn is the bar. The bar is furnished with a table and chairs and four barstools around the bar. The bar has barpumps, though the bartender never uses them. There are stairs to the in the south-west corner of the room. The of the inn contains two room for people staying in the inn. Each room contains a bed and a bedside table, with the north room also containing a hat stand.

label: Dragon Slayer I
title: Dragon Slayer I
lead:
Dragon Slayer I is a quest that focuses on the player's journey to slay Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor. Often described as the hardest, yet most rewarding quest available to free-to-play players, those who successfully complete it gain the ability to equip the rune platebody and green d'hide body (as well as their many variations), in addition to the dragon platebody.

Starting this quest is required to use any dragonfire protection, although it does not need to be completed. It also allows dragons to be received as a Slayer task.

label: dragon longsword
title: dragon longsword
lead:
The dragon longsword is the third-strongest longsword available in Old School RuneScape, and can only be wielded by players who have at least 60 Attack and have completed the Lost City quest.

As with all dragon weapons, players cannot make this item using the Smithing skill. However, it can be purchased in the Zanaris marketplace from Jukat for 100,000 coins (requires a Diamond for entry). The weapon can also be received as a reward from elite Treasure Trails.

label: Dragon mace
title: Dragon mace
lead:
The dragon mace is the fifth-strongest mace stat-wise after the Tzhaar-ket-em, Sarachnis cudgel, Viggora's chainmace, and Inquisitor's mace. It can only be wielded by players who have an Attack level of at least 60 and who have completed the Heroes' Quest.

The mace can be purchased for 50,000 coins at the Happy Heroes' H'emporium in the Heroes' Guild, or from other players.

label: Dragon med helm
title: Dragon med helm
lead:
The dragon med helm is a piece of armour which requires 60 Defence to equip. It was the first piece of dragon armour to be released.

Zulrah, revenants, Sarachnis and some dragons can drop the dragon med helm. Any monster that has access to the standard rare drop table can also drop the dragon med helm. It can also be found in the Barrows chest as a separate item with 1012 rewards potential and all brothers killed.

label: Dragon necklace
title: Dragon necklace
lead:
A dragon necklace, also known as a dragonstone necklace is a necklace made by using a gold bar, a dragonstone and a necklace mould on a furnace, requiring a Crafting level of 72 and providing 105 experience when made. It can also be obtained as a reward from elite clue scrolls.

The dragon necklace can be enchanted into a skills necklace with the Lvl-5 Enchant spell. This requires level 68 Magic, one cosmic rune, fifteen earth runes and fifteen water runes.

label: Dragon scale dust
title: Dragon scale dust
lead:
Dragon scale dust is the result of using a pestle and mortar on a blue dragon scale. It is used in Herblore for mixing weapon poisons and antifire potions.

Wesley (in Nardah) will crush unnoted or noted herblore secondary items for 50 coins per item.

label: Dragon spear
title: Dragon spear
lead:
The dragon spear is a two-handed melee weapon that requires level 60 Attack to wield. It does not require the completion of a quest to equip. Like most spears, it can be poisoned.

The spear is a rare drop from both the rare and gem drop tables. On the gem drop table, the spear will only drop if the Legends' Quest has been completed, otherwise a talisman will be dropped in its place. However, the rare drop table does not require the quest's completion in order to be able to receive it as a drop. Wearing a ring of wealth will increase the chances of receiving one from both tables.

label: Dragon sq shield
title: Dragon sq shield
lead:
The dragon sq shield is the strongest square shield in Old School RuneScape. It requires 60 Defence to wield, along with completion of Legends' Quest. The dragon square shield is created by combining the shield left half, a mega-rare drop from the rare drop table, and the shield right half, which must be purchased for 750,000 coins from Siegfried Erkle in the Legends' Guild or Erdan in the Myths' Guild. The two shield halves are combined at any anvil with a hammer in the inventory to produce the dragon square shield, a process that requires level 60 Smithing and grants 75 experience.

Smithing this shield in West Ardougne is a task required in the hard set of the Ardougne Diary.

label: Dragonhide Leather
title: Dragonhide Leather
lead:
The Dragonhide Leather is an unreleased scenery object that was meant to be in the Ranging Guild.

It is possible that it was meant to appear in a room alongside the Leatherworker. However, when the Weapon poison salesman was removed (before release), the Leatherworker was moved to his stall instead, and the Dragonhide Leather was never included in the game.

label: Dragonstone
title: Dragonstone
lead:
Dragonstones are rare gems which can be cut from uncut dragonstones, requiring 55 Crafting and yielding 137.5 experience. It can then be made into dragonstone jewellery by using a furnace along with a gold bar and a mould.

Monsters with access to the rare drop table have a chance to drop cut dragonstones.

label: Dragonstone amulet
title: Dragonstone amulet
lead:
The dragonstone amulet is an amulet worn in the neck slot. It is made by stringing an unstrung dragonstone amulet with a ball of wool or the String Jewellery spell. The unstrung amulet requires 80 Crafting and is made by using a gold bar on a furnace with a cut dragonstone and an amulet mould in the inventory.

Crafting one in the Neitiznot furnace is a task in the Elite Fremennik Diary.

label: Dragonstone amulet (u)
title: Dragonstone amulet (u)
lead:
A dragonstone amulet (u) is the unstrung version of the regular dragonstone amulet. It is made by using a gold bar on a furnace, while having a cut dragonstone and an amulet mould in the inventory.
