Level 80 Crafting is required to make one, and crafting this item grants 150 experience. Stringing this item using a ball of wool gives 4 experience.

label: Dragonstone ring
title: Dragonstone ring
lead:
The dragonstone ring is made by using a gold bar, a dragonstone, and a ring mould on a furnace. It requires a Crafting level of 55 and provides 100 Crafting experience when made.

The dragonstone ring can be enchanted into a ring of wealth through the use of the Lvl-5 Enchant spell at level 68 Magic, requiring 15 earth runes, 15 water runes, and 1 cosmic rune.

label: Drain (Demon Slayer)
title: Drain (Demon Slayer)
lead:
The drain is located outside the north-eastern corner of Varrock Palace's kitchen. During the Demon Slayer quest, the player must use a bucket of water on the drain in order to flush Sir Prysin's lost key in to the sewer below.

Searching the drain prior to flushing out the key results in the player mentioning that they can see a key inside the drain.

label: Dramen branch
title: Dramen branch
lead:
The Dramen branch is cut from the Dramen tree found in the dungeon below Entrana island. Cutting it from the Dramen tree requires 36 Woodcutting. It can be crafted into a Dramen staff with a knife and 31 Crafting, allowing access to the lost city of Zanaris and to the fairy ring transportation network.

The branch can only be obtained after starting the Lost City quest and having Shamus the leprechaun explain the Dramen Staff. Otherwise, the player will receive the message, "The tree seems to have an ominous aura to it. You do not feel like chopping it down," when attempting to chop it down.

label: Dramen staff
title: Dramen staff
lead:
The dramen staff allows players to enter Zanaris from the shed in the Lumbridge Swamp after completion of the Lost City quest. Players can obtain the staff by using a knife on a dramen branch, which requires a Crafting level of 31. It is possible to return to Entrana and cut more branches from the Dramen tree, although it is advised players make multiple staves upon completion of the quest, as this prevents the need for a return trip should the staff be lost. It is a blunt weapon and cannot autocast spells.

The dramen staff is required to use the fairy ring transport system, which requires partial completion of the Fairytale II - Cure a Queen quest. Players who have completed the Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary can use them without the staff.

label: Dramen tree
title: Dramen tree
lead: The Dramen tree is a special tree which is featured in the Lost City and Recipe for Disaster quests. It is located in the Entrana Dungeon, a location where players cannot bring any weapons or armour. It requires level 36 Woodcutting to cut.

label: Drawers (white)
title: Drawers (white)
lead: White drawers are scenery found in the hospital at Emir's Arena as well as in western Great Kourend. The drawers can be searched for a small chance to receive an uncut red topaz. No other items can be obtained from searching.

label: Draynor bank
title: Draynor bank
lead:
The Draynor bank is the only bank in Draynor Village. It was added alongside the Varrock east bank.

The bank is a popular location for free-to-play players who are fishing or chopping the nearby willows. Note that this bank may not always be safe for players under level 15 combat, due to the fact it is possible for other players to lure the nearby dark wizard into the bank.

label: Draynor farm
title: Draynor farm
lead: The Draynor farm is a large farm field in eastern Draynor, just west of Mill Lane Mill. The farm features a large wheat field, a large potato field, two un-interactable farmers, and a barn with many goblins. The barn is commonly used by players hoping to use a cannon to quickly obtain the goblin champion scroll.

label: Draynor jail
title: Draynor jail
lead:
The Draynor jail is a small jail run by Lady Keli, patrolled by several aggressive jail guards who will attack anyone under level 53. The jail is a multi-combat area, which makes it a very dangerous place for lower levels. Approaching from the east normally allows a quicker entry to the jail, with less exposure to the guards. The jail is mainly featured in the Prince Ali Rescue quest.

Within the jail compound are a few nettles growing on the eastern and southern sides of the building, which can be picked when wearing some form of gloves. Just west of the jail building, a second trapdoor entrance to the Draynor Sewers can also be found. There is an inaccessible guard tower found on the southern side. Osman's daughter, Leela, can be found north-west just beyond the compound by the wheat field.

label: Draynor Manor
title: Draynor Manor
lead:
Draynor Manor is a large, haunted, mansion located north of Draynor Village owned by Count Draynor Drakan. The manor contains 4 floors and is a central location for 4 quests: Ernest the Chicken, Vampyre Slayer, Animal Magnetism, and is visited briefly during Fairytale I - Growing Pains. It also holds a portal that grants access to the dimension where killerwatts reside.

There is a Belladonna patch outside the manor, towards the west and within the fence.

label: Draynor Village
title: Draynor Village
lead: Draynor Village, often shortened to Draynor, is a small village located between Falador and Lumbridge. The village is featured in many quests, and is a popular training location due to its willow trees and master farmers.

label: Dream (music track)
title: Dream (music track)
lead:
Dream is a music track that is unlocked when the player first arrives in Lumbridge. It can also be heard around the Lumbridge Swamp and farmlands. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Autumn Voyage, Book of Spells, Flute Salad, Harmony, and Yesteryear.

In Classic mode, the track plays on the path from Lumbridge to Draynor Village.

label: Drezel
title: Drezel
lead:
Drezel is a monk who lives in Silvarea, the passage bordering Morytania and the forest east of Varrock, under Paterdomus. He is heavily involved with the Priest in Peril quest, where you must help him escape from jail, and once Priest in Peril and The Restless Ghost are completed, players can talk to him to start the Nature Spirit quest.

Players can quickly reach him by taking a fairy ring to or using a Salve Graveyard Teleport, and then running northwest across the bridge and into the trapdoor.

label: Drogo dwarf
title: Drogo dwarf
lead: Drogo is a dwarf in the Dwarven Mine, who runs Drogo's Mining Emporium, which sells pickaxes. In the past, Drogo's store often had a large stock of iron and other ores on free worlds, primarily because his store is in close proximity to two iron rocks.

label: Drogo's Mining Emporium.
title: Drogo's Mining Emporium.
lead: Drogo's Mining Emporium is located in the Dwarven Mines, run by Drogo. Although labelled as a mining shop, it only sells hammers and bronze pickaxes. It does provide a place for players to sell their ores or bars, but it is relatively unpopular due to its inconvenient location.

label: Druid
title: Druid
lead: Druids are level 33 non-player characters found in the druidic village of Taverley, a small settlement in western Asgarnia. They attack with both Melee and Magic (similar in appearance to Entangle). These druids are sometimes fought for the herbs that they carry, although chaos druids are a better source of herbs.

label: Druid pouch
title: Druid pouch
lead:
The druid pouch is an item first obtained during the Nature Spirit quest. Its main use is to protect the player against the ghasts that haunt the Mort Myre Swamp.

If lost, an empty druid pouch can be reclaimed from the inside of the Nature Spirit's grotto - one respawns near the grotto pool.

label: Druid's robe
title: Druid's robe
lead: The druid's robe (bottom) is part of the druid's robes set. Pieces of the druid robes can be obtained by killing druids in Taverley.

label: Druid's robe top
title: Druid's robe top
lead: The druid's robe top is part of the druid's robes set. Pieces of the druid robes can be obtained by killing druids in Taverley.

label: Druidic Ritual
title: Druidic Ritual
lead: Druidic Ritual is a novice quest that serves as the introduction to the Herblore skill. It takes place entirely in the vicinity of Taverley and is a fairly short quest.

label: Druidic spell
title: Druidic spell
lead:
The druidic spell is a spell scroll that can cast Bloom on rotten logs in Mort Myre Swamp to grow Mort myre fungi.

The spell is given to the player by Filliman Tarlock during the Nature Spirit quest and can be used only once, after which it turns into a used spell. The spell can only be used once the player has been blessed by Drezel during the quest. Attempting to use the spell before receiving Drezel's blessing will yield the message, "You need to be blessed before you can cast this spell." However, after completing the quest, the player can cast Bloom using a Silver sickle(b), or any of: Emerald sickle (b), Enchanted emerald sickle (b), Ruby sickle (b), Enchanted ruby sickle (b), Blisterwood sickle, Ivandis flail, or Blisterwood flail. For collectors, be cautious about dropping this item inside the grotto right before the quest's end. If left on the ground, it will disappear when the grotto shifts.

label: Drunk dragon
title: Drunk dragon
lead:
Drunk dragon is a drink that can be made at level 32 Cooking, granting 160 Cooking experience.

It heals 5 Hitpoints, lowers your Attack by 2% - 3 levels, and raises your Strength by 5% + 2 levels.

label: Drunken Dwarf
title: Drunken Dwarf
lead: The drunken dwarf is a random event who occasionally appears and talks to players. If the player responds, the dwarf will give them a kebab and a beer.

label: Dry sticks
title: Dry sticks
lead: Dry sticks are the result of using broken glass on damp sticks. They are used in the Sea Slug quest to light a torch on the Fishing Platform. They can be kept after the quest, and with 30 Firemaking can be used at any time to light a torch by selecting the "rub-together" option. Unlike a tinderbox, clicking to use the sticks on an unlit torch has no effect.

label: Dryad (unused)
title: Dryad (unused)
lead:
Dryads are a cut race planned to be added to RuneScape 2. Unlike other cut creatures, they were most likely scrapped very early on. They lack any interaction options and their combat level is the default, while they were not mentioned as one of the planned updates in March 2004.

Their model was later reused for the Tree spirit random event, while Wood Dryads were eventually released in July 2006. The original Dryads have never been present in Old School RuneScape, but remain in the game files.

label: duck
title: duck
lead:
Ducks are small animals that can be found in rivers or lakes. They are a fairly good way to start training the Magic skill with low-level Curse spells and even Strike spells.

If ducks are next to the shore, it is possible to hit with a long-range melee weapon such as a halberd; however, it is uncommon for them to be there with the exception of the Fishing Guild docks, Falador Park, and the River Lum in Lumbridge.

label: duckling
title: duckling
lead: Ducklings are smaller versions of ducks found swimming in the pond north-west of Lumbridge, by Farmer Fred's farm, and in the western wing of the Farming Guild. They will only follow female ducks. Occasionally, the female duck will say: , to which any following ducklings respond with: . If the female duck they're following is killed, the ducklings will say: , followed by: and attempt to swim away.

label: Duel Arena
title: Duel Arena
lead:
The Al Kharid Duel Arena was a place where players could go to engage in one-on-one Combat. The Duel Arena was available to both members and free-to-play, though there was a limit to how much you can stake in both members and free-to-play.

Duel Arena challenge areas were identified upon entering by a battleaxe ( ) which appeared in the bottom right hand corner of the interface, during a duel this was changed to a skull ( ).

label: Duke Horacio
title: Duke Horacio
lead: Duke Horacio is the duke of Lumbridge and the surrounding area. He lives on the of the Lumbridge Castle in a room with a quest marker in it. He also hands out anti-dragon shields to players during the Dragon Slayer I quest. More shields can be obtained via the drop trick.

label: Dummy
title: Dummy
lead:
A dummy is a sandbag that players can train on. Different types of dummy provide different amounts of Attack experience per hit, but it does not deal any damage and does not provide any hitpoints experience. This makes it ideal for players just starting out, if they are trying to keep their hitpoints level as low as possible.

Dummies in Varrock can be found in the building north of Varrock's East Bank, as well as on the top floor of Varrock Castle. Similar types of dummies can be found in Burthorpe, with soldiers training on them, as well as in the Kualti Headquarters in Civitas illa Fortis. All of these dummies will provide 5 Attack experience per hit, up to and including level 7. Players with level 8 or higher in Attack will receive no experience, instead receiving the message There is nothing more you can learn from hitting a dummy..

label: Dung
title: Dung
lead:
Dung is a troll chef found on Death Plateau. He stands next to Ash at the centre of the plateau, just in front of the cooking pot they both maintain.

When the player searches the cooking pot in My Arm's Big Adventure, the troll cooks will attack with weak ranged attacks, hoping to put you in the stew for dinner.

label: Dungeon rat
title: Dungeon rat
lead: Dungeon rats are rare monsters found only in select members' dungeons. They play a key role in the Clock Tower quest in which players poison their food trough so that they attempt to escape by chewing away a railing, which allows the player to grab the white cog.

label: Dunjun
title: Dunjun
lead: Dunjun is a music track that is unlocked in Taverley Dungeon after passing the Magic axe room or by entering the Crypt under the White Knights' Castle.

label: Dunstan
title: Dunstan
lead: Dunstan is the local smith for Burthorpe. He can be found near the anvil symbol.

label: dusty key
title: dusty key
lead:
The dusty key is a key that unlocks a gate to the Taverley Dungeon, allowing passage into the deeper parts of dungeon from the Lesser demon area to the Blue dragon area.

The player can get the key from Velrak the explorer, who is imprisoned in the Black Knight headquarters in the southern part of the Taverley Dungeon. Kill the jailer to get a key to enter Velrak's cell and talk to him, but do not ask for a reward!

label: dwarf
title: dwarf
lead: Dwarves are low-levelled monsters often found in mines and dwarven settlements. They can occasionally be assigned as Slayer tasks by Turael and Spria.

label: Dwarf (Dwarven shopping store)
title: Dwarf (Dwarven shopping store)
lead: A dwarf is the shopkeeper of the Dwarven shopping store in the Dwarven Mine. He wears red clothes and is always holding a pickaxe. He sells some basic items in his store.

label: Dwarf (Mining Guild)
title: Dwarf (Mining Guild)
lead: Dwarves are located by the entrances to the Mining Guild, both on the surface in Falador alongside Gadrin, and within the Dwarven Mine. They are also located inside the guild, by the entrances to the members' area of the guild.

label: Dwarf brew
title: Dwarf brew
lead:
Dwarf brew is a potent spirit made by Kamen. It is used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by using an empty bucket on the brew barrel inside Klank's house, found deep inside the Underground Pass.

The brew is used to light a pyre over the tomb of Iban, cremating his remains and turning them into Iban's ashes which must then be used on the doll of iban to create his effigy. The brew only needs to be used once on the tomb, after which it can be lit as many times the player likes as long as they don't possess the ashes in their inventory or have used such ashes on the doll.

label: Dwarf Cannon
title: Dwarf Cannon
lead: Dwarf Cannon is a short quest about the conflict between the dwarven outpost at the Coal truck mining site and local goblins. The quest provides access to the Dwarf multicannon, a powerful Ranged weapon.

label: Dwarf multicannon
title: Dwarf multicannon
lead:
The dwarf multicannon (or simply cannon) is a unique type of Ranged weapon that acts as a deployable turret using steel cannonballs or granite cannonballs as ammunition. Once deployed and loaded with ammunition, the cannon will fire at targets within its line-of-sight and range. The cannon acts as a supplemental source of damage alongside the player, and is commonly used to speed up Slayer tasks. Damage with the cannon gives reduced experience. The cannon's accuracy depends heavily on the player's current equipment, attack style and levels.

The cannon has four parts which it can be assembled from. A player may only have one cannon assembled at a time. There are many locations where setting up a cannon will be automatically prevented, as well as bosses which will destroy the cannon. If a cannon is destroyed, Nulodion will provide a free replacement.

label: Dwarf remains
title: Dwarf remains
lead:
Dwarf remains are a quest item used only in Dwarf Cannon. The remains are those of Gilob, and are given to Captain Lawgof after recovering them during the quest. It is found on the of the watchtower south of the Coal Trucks.

Duplicates cannot be obtained, as it does not respawn after the player has picked it up for the first time.

label: Dwarf statue (Falador)
title: Dwarf statue (Falador)
lead: Dwarf statue is a scenery object found in Falador near the entrance of the Mining Guild. Players cannot interact with this statue, but they can examine it.

label: Dwarf statue (Underground Pass)
title: Dwarf statue (Underground Pass)
lead: Dwarf statue is a scenery object found in the dwarf settlement beneath Iban's Temple in the Underground Pass. Two of these statues stand outside of the main building of the dwarf settlement. Players cannot interact with these statues, but they can examine them.

label: Dwarf Theme
title: Dwarf Theme
lead:
Dwarf Theme is a music track that is unlocked near the surface camp above the Dwarven Mine.

In Classic mode, the track plays in a wider area around the Dwarven Mine, on the path between Falador and the Barbarian Village.

label: Dwarf weed
title: Dwarf weed
lead:
Dwarf weed is the second highest level herb. Cleaning dwarf weed requires level 70 herblore and yields 13.8 Herblore experience. It is used with wine of Zamorak to create ranging potions. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a dwarf weed potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

One way to obtain dwarf weed is by planting dwarf weed seed in a herb patch at level 79 Farming. This gives you grimy dwarf weed which you can clean to obtain clean dwarf weed.

label: Dwarf weed potion (unf)
title: Dwarf weed potion (unf)
lead: A dwarf weed potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a dwarf weed on a vial of water, requiring 72 Herblore. Using a wine of zamorak on a dwarf weed potion (unf) with 72 Herblore yields a ranging potion(3) and 162.5 Herblore experience. Using nihil dust on a dwarf weed potion (unf) with 85 Herblore yields an ancient brew(3) and 190 Herblore experience. Using a lily of the sands on a dwarf weed potion (unf) with 88 Herblore yields a Menaphite remedy(3) and 200 Herblore experience.

label: Dwarven Mine
title: Dwarven Mine
lead:
The Dwarven Mine is a large mine ran by dwarves located beneath Asgarnia. It contains a variety of ores and can be accessed from the entrance south of Ice Mountain or from the two entrances located in Falador. The Dwarven Mine also connects to both the Mining Guild and the Motherlode Mine, which are located at the southern end of the mine.

At the southern end of the mine, there is a severe infestation of scorpions and King Scorpions that will trouble those with lower combat levels. You need a combat level of 65 in order to be left alone by the King Scorpions. North of the scorpions is an Agility shortcut (narrow crevice in the wall) requiring level 42 Agility. The Mining Guild can be found in the southern part of the mine, requiring 60 Mining to access. The entrance to the Motherlode Mine can be found in the south-eastern section of the Dwarven Mine marked by a dungeon icon ( ). To make use of the Motherlode Mine, players require a minimum of 30 Mining, with 57 Mining required to access the upper level.

label: Dwarven Shopping Store
title: Dwarven Shopping Store
lead: The Dwarven shopping store is a general store run by a dwarf in the Dwarven Mine. It is almost never visited, mainly because of its location; there are many general stores nearby (such as the ones in Falador or Edgeville) which are much easier to reach.

label: dwarven stout
title: dwarven stout
lead:
Dwarven stout is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Mining and Smithing by 1 while draining Attack, Strength and Defence by 4% + 2. It can be obtained through brewing at level 19 Cooking, granting 215 experience. It is brewed using 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, 4 hammerstone hops, and a pot of ale yeast. The stronger, mature version of the ale is the dwarven stout(m).

Drinking a dwarven stout will give the messages: You drink the Dwarven Stout. It tastes foul. It tastes pretty strong too.

label: Dwellberries
title: Dwellberries
lead:
Dwellberries can be harvested from a bush patch after planting dwellberry seeds. They are used in quests and gnome cooking.

Dwellberries heal 2 hitpoints when eaten. Adding them to a compost bin makes regular compost.

label: Eadburg
title: Eadburg
lead: Eadburg is the Burthorpe Castle chef, and can be found wandering around the of the castle. She will sometimes wander outside the castle and into the courtyard.

label: Eadgar
title: Eadgar
lead:
"Mad" Eadgar lives in a cave at the top of Trollheim. He plays a very small part in the Troll Stronghold quest, where players free him from his cell. He also plays a central role in Eadgar's Ruse, acting as an advisor to the player, helping them craft a ruse with a parrot to fool the trolls into believing it to be a human.

Eadgar will give players a bowl of mountain goat stew in exchange for some logs that he can use for firewood. The mountain goat stew heals 20 Hitpoints after you exit the chatbox; it is not a physical item.

label: Earth Altar
title: Earth Altar
lead:
The Earth Altar is a runic altar upon which earth runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 6.5 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 9 Runecraft is required to craft earth runes.

Players may create an earth tiara here by using either an earth talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 32.5 Runecraft experience. An elemental tiara can also be created here by using an elemental talisman and gold tiara, granting 40 Runecraft experience.

label: Earth battlestaff
title: Earth battlestaff
lead:
The earth battlestaff is an elemental staff requiring 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of earth runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created at level 58 Crafting by combining an earth orb and battlestaff. It can also be upgraded to a mystic earth staff by paying Thormac 40,000 coins to upgrade it (less with the completion of certain Kandarin Diaries). The mystic earth staff is an even stronger alternative, providing better melee and magic stat bonuses.

label: Earth Blast
title: Earth Blast
lead:
Earth Blast is an earth-based blast spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 53 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

It is the strongest earth spell available to free-to-play players.

label: Earth Bolt
title: Earth Bolt
lead: Earth Bolt is an earth-based bolt spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 29 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

label: Earth elemental
title: Earth elemental
lead:
Earth elementals are found beneath Seers' Village during the Elemental Workshop I and Elemental Workshop II quests. There are several roaming around in the quest area, but the player can also cause one to appear by mining a rock in the earth room.

There are two types of Earth elementals: the ones roaming around and the ones that can be mined. Only the latter will drop elemental ores.

label: Earth orb
title: Earth orb
lead:
An earth orb is a glass orb that has been charged at the Obelisk of Earth by using the Charge Earth Orb spell, requiring 60 Magic, on the obelisk. The spell requires an unpowered orb, 30 earth runes, and 3 cosmic runes, yielding 70 Magic experience. The Earth Obelisk is located in the Edgeville Dungeon, south of the black demons beyond the poison spiders and Chronozon.

An earth orb can be used on a battlestaff, requiring 58 Crafting, yielding an earth battlestaff and 112.5 Crafting experience.

label: Earth rune
title: Earth rune
lead: Earth runes are one of the four elemental runes. They are used to cast earth-based combat spells in the standard spellbook, as well as many spells found in other spellbooks; Earth runes are used especially often for spells in the Lunar spellbook. The Confuse, Weaken, and Curse spells, often regarded as an inexpensive source of Magic experience, require earth runes in conjunction with body and water runes to cast. Some items, such as a staff of earth, provide infinite earth runes while equipped.

label: Earth Strike
title: Earth Strike
lead: Earth Strike is an earth-based strike spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 9 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

label: Earth talisman
title: Earth talisman
lead: An earth talisman is a type of talisman that lets the player access the Earth Altar. Use the talisman on the altar to get inside to create earth runes. You can also access the Earth Altar by using an earth tiara, which can be equipped to save inventory space and is made using the earth talisman. When you make an earth tiara, you are granted 32.5 Runecraft experience. If you are a member, it can be used to runecraft dust runes at the Air Altar, mud runes at the Water Altar, or lava rune at the Fire Altar. The earth talisman is consumed in the process.

label: earth warrior
title: earth warrior
lead:
Earth warriors are a type of humanoid earth elemental found in a dirt-lined chamber in the Edgeville Dungeon. This area is in the Wilderness so it is advised to come prepared for player killers. Earth warriors can be safe-spotted in the bottom right corner or top of the first chamber.

Their chamber requires the player to climb across a set of monkey bars, which requires 15 Agility. It is not possible to fail the set of monkey bars.

label: Earth Wave
title: Earth Wave
lead:
Earth Wave is an earth-based wave spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 70 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

It is the second-strongest earth spell in the game, with the strongest being Earth Surge.

label: East Ardougne
title: East Ardougne
lead:
East Ardougne is the eastern of the two districts that form Ardougne, the capital of Kandarin. It is in the members area of Gielinor.

Its neighbour, West Ardougne, governed by King Tyras, is closed off to the general public because of a plague affecting the inhabitants, but players may gain access by finishing parts of the Plague City quest. East Ardougne is most known for its wealth, zoo and the theft-stricken marketplace. East Ardougne is currently governed by King Lathas.

label: Easter egg
title: Easter egg
lead:
Easter eggs are edible holiday items. Two easter eggs can be obtained by completing one of the Easter holiday events that occur once per year. This also rewards the player with all other holiday items associated with Easter.

Consuming an easter egg will restore 14 hitpoints, which is the same amount of hitpoints as swordfish and pumpkins. Due to their limited availability and resulting price, easter eggs are not recommended as food.

label: Edgeville
title: Edgeville
lead:
Edgeville is a small town located at the border of the Wilderness. Edgeville is a popular town to trade player killing-related items, and the bank is popular among players training Runecraft via the Abyss. Edgeville is also popular with members who own amulets of glory, as it is a fast bank to get to via a teleport.

In the early development of RuneScape Classic, Edgeville only had empty buildings; it was commonly referred to as "Ghost Town" until items were placed in the buildings and the town was given its official name.

label: Edgeville bank
title: Edgeville bank
lead:
The Edgeville bank, also known as edge bank, is a popular bank found in Edgeville, east of the Grand Exchange and just below the Wilderness ditch.

On the north wall of the Edgeville bank players can find the Wilderness Statistics board, displaying their kill to death ratio in the Wilderness, as well as the ratios of nearby players. There is also a loot chest for player killers.

label: Edgeville Dungeon
title: Edgeville Dungeon
lead:
The Edgeville Dungeon is a dungeon in Edgeville. It contains a large variety of monsters spanning across a wide range of levels, as well as the Slayer master Vannaka. It can be accessed by a trapdoor south of the Edgeville bank, or a locked shed (requiring a Brass key to open) west of the Cooks' Guild.

The southern half of the dungeon is free-to-play, and is a popular location for killing Hill Giants on free-to-play worlds. The northern half is members-only, and is in the Wilderness, so anyone who wishes to explore the deeper parts of this dungeon should watch out for PK'ers and only bring items that they are willing to lose. The Members' area is a popular location for killing Chaos druids.

label: Edgeville Dungeon mine
title: Edgeville Dungeon mine
lead:
The Edgeville Dungeon mine is a mine near the centre of the Edgeville Dungeon. The mine itself is north of the hill giants and the ladder near the brass key. It is south of Vannaka and the Agility shortcut to Varrock Sewers. It is sometimes called the Skeleton Mine by some; similar to how several other mines guarded by skeletons are called the same, such as the Southern Wilderness mine. Due to being so far out of the way, the mine is almost never used by non-Free-to-play players.

It is a compact mine with a variety of ores. The resident skeletons and the occasionally visiting hobgoblin may be dangerous for players with low combat levels.

label: Edgeville General Store
title: Edgeville General Store
lead: The Edgeville General Store is a general store located in Edgeville.

label: Edgeville Mausoleum
title: Edgeville Mausoleum
lead:
The Edgeville Mausoleum is a ruin of a mausoleum just south of the village of Edgeville.

The Edgeville Mausoleum contains an entrance to the Edgeville Dungeon as well as two yew trees in the garden on the left side of the building. There is also a lever here that can teleport players to the Deserted Keep in the deep Wilderness, much like East Ardougne's lever. The lever in the Deserted Keep teleports the player to Ardougne, not back to Edgeville, unless the player has completed the easy Wilderness Diary.

label: Edgeville Monastery
title: Edgeville Monastery
lead:
The Edgeville Monastery is a two-story building north-east of Falador, east of the Black Knights' Fortress and west of Edgeville. A combat bracelet can be used to teleport inside the monastery, and is the fastest method to get there. Five monks wander inside, both in the courtyard and inside the building.

The four monks that spawn around the courtyard are an extremely popular training spot for Defence pures due to the monks' high health and low Defence, as well as their healing powers; pures could train indefinitely without food. It is recommended for most free-to-play pures as a safe and effective training method.

label: edible seaweed
title: edible seaweed
lead:
Edible seaweed is an edible version of seaweed that restore 4 Hitpoints. Edible seaweed can be cooked on a range or fire to create soda ash (an ingredient in molten glass), granting no experience.

The item is one of the possible random items required during the quest Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Edmond
title: Edmond
lead:
Edmond is a civilian of East Ardougne, the husband of Alrena, and the father of Elena. He lives north of the Flying Horse Inn.

His daughter was captured by mourners during the Plague City quest. Players start this quest by speaking to him, and he plays a large role in the quest's storyline.

label: Eerie statue
title: Eerie statue
lead: Eerie statues can be found just outside Iban's temple, inside the Underground Pass. They resemble a dark beast. Players cannot interact with them, only examine them.

label: Egg
title: Egg
lead: An egg is an item used mainly in Cooking to make cakes and egg potatoes. Eggs spawn near most chicken coops and searching coops will always yield an egg. The Culinaromancer's Chest in Lumbridge Castle basement sells varying amounts depending on the number of Recipe for Disaster subquests completed.

label: Egypt
title: Egypt
lead:
Egypt is a music track unlocked in members parts of Kharidian Desert. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Arabian 3, Desert Heat, Desert Voyage, The Desert, Scarab, Sphinx and Sunburn.

In Classic mode, the track plays in and around the Shantay Pass. As such, free-to-play players can only unlock the track while on Classic mode.

label: Elemental metal
title: Elemental metal
lead:
Elemental metal is a metal bar that is used in the quests Elemental Workshop I and Elemental Workshop II. It is made by using one elemental ore and four coal on the furnace on the south side of the first floor of the Elemental Workshop. Each bar must be made individually.

The elemental metal can be used to make an elemental shield or an elemental helmet. During Elemental Workshop II, it is also used to make an elemental claw and is processed into a primed bar in the second level of the Elemental Workshop.

label: Elemental ore
title: Elemental ore
lead:
Elemental ore is an ore that may only be obtained by killing a level 35 earth elemental after trying to mine the elemental rock. This ore can only be obtained during and after the Elemental Workshop I quest, and turned into elemental metals. Elemental ore is only found in the Elemental Workshop dungeon beneath the Seers' Village, in the house with the anvil, next to the bank. Earth elementals are found in the western area on the first level of the workshop.

The second level is to make bars, and repairs are needed here too. One elemental ore and four coal may be smelted into a bar of elemental metal using the blast furnace in the southern area of the Elemental Workshop (level 20 Smithing is required). This bar is used to smith the elemental shield and helmet.

label: elemental shield
title: elemental shield
lead:
The elemental shield may be made during and after the Elemental Workshop I quest in the Elemental Workshop dungeon.

To make the shield, players must have a Smithing level of 20, an elemental metal, a hammer, and either a battered book or slashed book in their inventory. Use the elemental metal on a workbench in the elemental workshop to make the shield. Smithing the shield grants the player 20 Smithing experience. To equip the shield, players must have completed the Elemental Workshop I quest.

label: Elemental Workshop (location)
title: Elemental Workshop (location)
lead: The Elemental Workshop is a dungeon that players can progressively explore more of as they complete the Elemental Workshop quest series. It is accessed by opening the odd looking wall, by using battered key, in the building west of the Seers' Village bank with the anvil icon and going down the stairs.

label: Elemental Workshop I
title: Elemental Workshop I
lead: Elemental Workshop I is a quest in which you find a mysterious book in Seers' Village, guiding along the rediscovery of the eponymous workshop and the lost magical elemental ore.

label: Elena
title: Elena
lead: Elena is a healer from Ardougne, particular skilled in (bio)chemistry and epidemiology, and heavily involved in the Elf quest series. In Plague City, the player is to save her from her entrapment by the mourners in West Ardougne. In Biohazard, you are to aid her deliver 3 different chemicals and a sample of the West Ardougne plague to her mentor in south-east Varrock. After Plague City, you may find her in her house in north-west of East Ardougne. After the Ardougne Revolution and the escape from Lord Iorwerth during Song of the Elves she can be found by the pond and farming patch in the south-western corner of Lletya. Following the events of Song of the Elves, Elena can be found among the Meilyr Clan within Prifddinas, being the first human to have settled in the elven capital.

label: Elizabeth
title: Elizabeth
lead:
Elizabeth Sinclair is one of Lord Sinclair's children. She is a suspect during the Murder Mystery quest.

According to the Gossip, it is hinted she suffers from kleptomania and stole her father's silver needle.

label: Elizabeth's barrel
title: Elizabeth's barrel
lead: Elizabeth's barrel can be found inside the Sinclair Mansion in Elizabeth's bedroom. During the Murder Mystery quest, the player must search the barrel to find her silver needle.

label: Elizabeth's print
title: Elizabeth's print
lead: Elizabeth's print is a quest item in the Murder Mystery quest. It is created by using flypaper on the silver needle after dusting it with a pot of flour. If the prints match those of the unknown print, it will become a killer's print, meaning Elizabeth is the killer.

label: Elkoy
title: Elkoy
lead: Elkoy is a gnome from the Tree Gnome Village who guides people through the Tree Gnome Maze both to and from the Tree Gnome Village after starting the Tree Gnome Village quest. To start the quest you have to speak to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village. If you right click on him it will say "follow", click it and you will be escorted through the maze quickly and safely. He can be found at the north-west entrance to the maze.

label: Elvarg
title: Elvarg
lead: Elvarg is the dragon that players have to kill in the Dragon Slayer I quest. She resides in the dungeon below Crandor. She is a green dragon, and is considerably stronger than the usual kind. Unlike other chromatic dragons, Elvarg has a ranged dragonfire attack. Despite being a dragon, she is not vulnerable to dragonbane weapons.

label: Emerald
title: Emerald
lead: Emeralds are precious gems used mainly in Crafting. They can be cut from uncut emeralds with a chisel at level 27 Crafting, yielding 67.5 experience.

label: Emerald amulet
title: Emerald amulet
lead:
The emerald amulet is created by using a gold bar on a furnace while also carrying a cut emerald and an amulet mould. This requires 31 Crafting and grants 70 Crafting experience. The resulting unstrung amulet is then used with a ball of wool, granting an additional 4 experience.

It has no stat bonuses, but can be enchanted with the Lvl-2 Enchant spell to become an Amulet of defence which gives some defensive bonuses.

label: Emerald amulet (u)
title: Emerald amulet (u)
lead:
An emerald amulet (u) can be made at level 31 Crafting by using a gold bar on a furnace while carrying a cut emerald and an amulet mould. This grants the player 70 Crafting experience. The amulet can then be strung with a ball of wool to create a strung emerald amulet, granting an additional 4 experience. The strung amulet can be enchanted into an amulet of defence using the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, requiring level 27 Magic.

This amulet can also be strung with a magic string instead, turning it into a pre-nature amulet. This amulet can then be enchanted into an amulet of nature.

label: Emerald necklace
title: Emerald necklace
lead:
The emerald necklace is made by using a gold bar on a furnace with an emerald and a necklace mould in your inventory. It requires a Crafting level of 29 and provides 60 experience when made.

The emerald necklace can be enchanted into a binding necklace by casting Lvl-2 Enchant. This requires a Magic level of 27, a cosmic rune and three air runes.

label: Emerald ring
title: Emerald ring
lead:
The Emerald ring is made by using a gold bar on a furnace whilst having an emerald and ring mould in the inventory. Making it requires a Crafting level of 27, and gives 55 experience.

The ring has no stats but can be enchanted using Lvl-2 Enchant ( ) to make a ring of dueling.

label: Emotion
title: Emotion
lead: Emotion is a music track that is unlocked at the Tree Gnome Village maze, and in the corrupted version of the Fisher Realm. It also plays in the Nightmare Zone when facing the Black Knight Titan in Practice or Endurance mode.

label: Emperor
title: Emperor
lead:
Emperor is a music track that unlocks around Rimmington. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Attention.

In Classic mode, the track plays around Melzar's Maze and (since an update in 2022) at a small area south-west of Rommik's Crafty Supplies. The map below represents post-2022 unlock area on Classic mode. The area before 2021 and on Classic mode in 2021-2022 only covers excluding Melzar's Maze.

label: Empty cup
title: Empty cup
lead: An empty cup is an item that is obtained after drinking a cup of tea or a cup of nettle tea. To obtain an empty cup, players can buy or steal a cup of tea from the tea stall in east Varrock. Having a conversation with Galahad will also involve him giving the player a cup of tea, after which it can be drunk to get an empty tea cup.

label: Empty oyster
title: Empty oyster
lead: An empty oyster is an oyster which has been opened and does not contain a pearl. It has no known use, but is collected by some players who like accumulating large amounts of difficult to obtain items such as burnt food and crushed gems. These items are not traded on the Grand Exchange, and are often discarded by players because they serve no real purpose.

label: Enchanted bear
title: Enchanted bear
lead:
Enchanted bear is a quest item used only in Druidic Ritual. It is made by dipping raw bear meat into the Cauldron of Thunder.

It is given to Sanfew to create a potion.

label: Enchanted beef
title: Enchanted beef
lead:
Enchanted beef is a quest item used only in Druidic Ritual. It is made by dipping raw beef into the Cauldron of Thunder.

It is given to Sanfew to create a potion.

label: Enchanted chicken
title: Enchanted chicken
lead:
Enchanted chicken is a quest item used only in Druidic Ritual. It is made by dipping raw chicken into the Cauldron of Thunder.

It is given to Sanfew to create a potion.

label: Enchanted rat
title: Enchanted rat
lead:
Enchanted rat meat is a quest item used only in Druidic Ritual. It is made by dipping raw rat meat into the Cauldron of Thunder.

It is given to Sanfew to create a potion.

label: Enchanted vial
title: Enchanted vial
lead:
An enchanted vial is made when using the binding book on an empty glass vial. The vial can be filled with water from the golden bowl (provides enough water to fill ten vials) to make holy water. They cannot be used as normal water vessels, nor for Herblore. Holy water is a usually weak ranged weapon, and is only effective on demons.

The process of making enchanted vials drains 5 Prayer and Magic levels. It is therefore recommended to make them near an altar and a bank (for stat restore potions). The free-for-all portal in the Clan Wars building of the Ferox Enclave may also be used. Exiting the portal will recharge one's Prayer and stats, and the Ferox Enclave bank is close by.

label: Enclave guard
title: Enclave guard
lead:
Enclave guards are ogres that guard the Ogre Enclave dungeon in the heart of Gu'Tanoth. During the Watchtower quest, players must use a cave nightshade on them twice (on different occasions) in order to be able to enter the enclave. After the quest, a cave nightshade does not have to be used to enter the cave, but the following message will appear: You run past the guard while he's busy.

Players can kill enclave guards towards an ogre Slayer task. Due to their lacklustre drops and being more difficult to kill compared to standard ogres, players usually avoid killing them.

label: energy potion
title: energy potion
lead:
An Energy potion restores 10% of the player's run energy.

It can be purchased from the Apothecary in Varrock for 1 chocolate dust and 2 limpwurt roots. Members can also make them using the Herblore skill by mixing Harralander in a vial of water and then adding chocolate dust. This requires level 26 Herblore, and gives 67.5 Herblore experience.

label: Enfeeble
title: Enfeeble
lead: Enfeeble is a level 73 Magic spell. When cast on an opponent, their Strength level is reduced by 10%. Casting Enfeeble grants 83 Magic experience and requires 1 Soul, 8 Earth, and 8 Water runes to be cast. The spell can only be cast if the opponent's stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you cannot stack the 10% Strength reduction with multiple spells in a row.

label: Ent (random event)
title: Ent (random event)
lead:
Ents were a RuneScape 2 random event. When a player tried to chop a tree, the tree had a chance of becoming an ent, also known as a "dancing tree" to some players. Like most random events, its purpose was to stop macro users. Since the ent could appear for each player chopping the tree, the odds of it showing up increased when woodcutting with more players. However, once it appeared, it influenced all players chopping that tree.

If the character continued chopping at the ent, the woodcutting axe became broken and useless. Once broken, a player could go to Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge to get the broken axe fixed. Bob fixed bronze, iron, and steel axes free of charge, and other woodcutting axe types (mithril and above) for a small fee. The stronger the woodcutting axe, the higher the repair cost. Alternately, the axe could be repaired in a player-owned house, reducing the cost.

label: Entangle
title: Entangle
lead:
Entangle is a members-only spell that requires level 79 Magic to cast. Casting Entangle will hold your target in place for 24 ticks (14.4 seconds) and grants 89 Magic experience (in addition to 2 experience per damage dealt). A successful hit, without any damage boosting items, can deal up to 5 damage. When used on a player and the entanglement is about to wear off, the entangled player will receive this message in their chatbox: The holding effect is beginning to fade. Players can increase the binding duration by equipping swampbark armour; the helm, body, and legs will increase the duration by 2 ticks (1.2 seconds) each, up to a maximum of 30 ticks (18.0 seconds).

Once the spell wears off, the target has 5 ticks (3 seconds) of immunity before they can be entangled again.

label: Entrana
title: Entrana
lead: Entrana is a large island south-west of Taverley, occupied by Saradominist monks. When entering Entrana, adventurers are prohibited from bringing most weapons or armour with them.

label: Entrana church
title: Entrana church
lead:
The Entrana church is a Saradomin church led by the High Priest and is the focal point of Entrana. In addition to offering an altar and characters who play roles in such quests as Desert Treasure I, if you are injured, you can talk to a level 5 monk and select the option "Can you heal me? I'm injured" to be nursed back to full health. From the candle stall, you can steal candles, granting 20 Thieving experience each. You may fail, giving the message "A high power smites you" and inflicting 1 damage.

Upstairs, the player can find an organ on which they can play a melody.

label: Entrana Dungeon
title: Entrana Dungeon
lead:
The Entrana Dungeon is found on the north-west corner of Entrana. After entering the dungeon, it is not possible to climb back up to Entrana.

It is used during the Lost City and Recipe for Disaster quests.

label: Entrana firebird
title: Entrana firebird
lead: The Entrana firebird is a unique bird found only on the holy isle of Entrana, on the northern part of the island. During Heroes' Quest, the player must kill it to receive the fire feather. You must have ice gloves to pick up the feather it drops.

label: Entrana homestead
title: Entrana homestead
lead: The Entrana homestead is a small farm on the island of Entrana. It is surrounded by unicorns.

label: Eohric
title: Eohric
lead: Eohric is the head servant for Prince Anlaf. He is located on the top floor of Burthorpe castle.

label: Equa leaves
title: Equa leaves
lead:
Equa leaves are ingredients utilised in gnome cooking that heal 1 hitpoint each. They are used in almost all gnome food, and have little other use, besides possibly in the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest.

They can be purchased at the two food stores on the of the Grand Tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Several respawn points are located in the south-east of Feldip Hills.

label: Equa toad's legs
title: Equa toad's legs
lead:
Equa toad's legs was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Toad batta. It could be made by adding Equa leaves to Toad's legs. Gnome spice was then added to these in order to create Seasoned legs, an ingredient in the Toad batta.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the toad's legs, equa leaves and gnome spice are all automatically added at once to create a Half made crunchy. If the player attempts to add equa leaves to toad's legs, nothing happens.

label: Ernest
title: Ernest
lead:
Ernest is the fiancé of Veronica and a central character in the quest Ernest the Chicken. While travelling to Falador, they got lost and ended up outside Draynor Manor. Ernest went inside to ask for directions and ended up testing Professor Oddenstein's latest invention, being turned into a chicken. After an hour Veronica begged a passing adventurer to look for Ernest. The machine was damaged by poltergeists, rendering Professor Oddenstein incapable of reverting the results of the experiment. The adventurer managed to retrieve all the pieces needed to restore Ernest to human form, much to the delight of Veronica.

After completing Ernest the Chicken he will give you 300 coins as a reward. He is not seen after completion of the quest, Veronica states that he went off to speak with a "green warty guy", but that she's expecting him to return soon.

label: Ernest the Chicken
title: Ernest the Chicken
lead:
Ernest the Chicken is a free-to-play quest where players must discover what happened to the missing Ernest, who went into Draynor Manor to ask for directions and never returned.

It was one of the first quests developed and the first quest released after RuneScape's initial launch.

label: Escape
title: Escape
lead: Escape is a music track that can be unlocked within the Witchaven Dungeon.

label: Escaping slave
title: Escaping slave
lead: An escaping slave is a male slave that has been given a set of desert robes during the Tourist Trap quest. After you pick the male slave's handcuffs, he will trade you his slave robes for the desert robes, and he will put them on. After a few minutes, or after talking to the escaping slave, he will turn back into a male slave, having been caught.

label: ethenea
title: ethenea
lead:
Ethenea is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is obtained from Elena after returning her distillator to her.

It is first given to Da Vinci, who will smuggle it into the Dancing Donkey Inn, past the Guard conducting body searches. After retrieving it from Da Vinci, it is given to Guidor in south-east Varrock, alongside plague sample, liquid honey, sulphuric broline, and touch paper.

label: evergreen tree
title: evergreen tree
lead:
Evergreen trees can be chopped down to provide logs and 25 Woodcutting experience.

Buckets of sap can be acquired by using a knife on an evergreen tree while having a bucket in your inventory. This is required for The Eyes of Glouphrie and Icthlarin's Little Helper quests.

label: Exam Centre
title: Exam Centre
lead:
The Exam Centre is a location in Misthalin (found south-east of Varrock, directly south of the Digsite) that is central to several quests. Its access is limited to members only.

Players can identify a liquid, collected from the barrel in the Digsite by giving it to Terry Balando here. The identified liquid - Nitroglycerin - is commonly used with Dharok the Wretched's equipment in the Pest Control minigame.

label: Examiner
title: Examiner
lead: Examiner is a worker in the Exam Centre. They can be found in the east building.

label: Excalibur
title: Excalibur
lead:
Excalibur is a one-handed sword and a quest item obtained from the Merlin's Crystal quest and used in the Holy Grail quest. It requires 20 Attack to wield and has similar stats to the adamant longsword, except for 6 less strength bonus and 1 more magic defence.

In the Merlin's Crystal quest, the player must use Excalibur on the crystal to smash and free Merlin. It is obtained from Lady of the Lake after she tests the purity of the player's spirit when giving a beggar bread at Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim.

label: Exit door
title: Exit door
lead: An exit door is in the north-east corner on the ground floor of Melzar's Maze. Opening the door leads to a ladder that players can use to exit the maze.

label: Expanse
title: Expanse
lead:
Expanse is a music track that can be unlocked at locations outside Varrock city walls, including the Cooks' Guild, Champions' Guild, and Jolly Boar Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Doorways, Greatness, and Still Night.

In Classic mode, this track plays south of Varrock and in the Phoenix Gang Hideout.

label: Expecting
title: Expecting
lead: Expecting is a music track that is unlocked near the Ourania Altar, underneath the Chaos Druid Tower, or by falling through the swamp or from the rope swing in the Underground Pass.

label: Expedition
title: Expedition
lead: Expedition is a music track that can unlocked in the Observatory Dungeon. It can also be unlocked in the passage between the Troll arena and Trollheim.

label: Exploding vial (animation item)
title: Exploding vial (animation item)
lead: The Exploding vial is an animation item used during the Watchtower. It is temporarily wielded during an animation if the player makes a mistake while creating the Magic ogre potion. Aside from this, it cannot be obtained.

label: Eye decoration
title: Eye decoration
lead: The eye decoration is the symbol of the Order of Wizards. It can be found on the outside wall of the Wizards' Tower and on the of Zeke's Superior Scimitars in Al Kharid. Another can be found atop the portal leading to the Temple of the Eye from the Wizards' Tower.

label: Eye of newt
title: Eye of newt
lead: An eye of newt is used in Herblore to make attack potions and super attack potions. One eye of newt is needed for the Witch's Potion and Recipe for Disaster quests. After completing Tower of Life, it can be used in the Creature Creation minigame together with a feather to create a newtroost.

label: Fadli
title: Fadli
lead:
Fadli is the banker at the Emir's Arena. He is also the owner of the Shop of Distaste, where you can buy rotten tomatoes for 1 coin each, these can be thrown at other players. Fadli also serves as a collection point for your Grand Exchange items.

According to Fadli, he is the best warrior in Al Kharid. He wears leather gloves, leather boots, and a hardleather body.

label: Faerie
title: Faerie
lead:
Faerie is a music track that is unlocked anywhere in Zanaris, other than the Fairy Resistance Hideout. To get there, the player must have completed the Lost City quest.

Playing this song to Cecilia may be required for a Medium Clue step.

label: Fairy
title: Fairy
lead: Fairies are small race of winged humanoids that occupy Zanaris, along with the mindslayers and otherworldly beings.

label: Fairy (Zanaris market)
title: Fairy (Zanaris market)
lead: The fairy explains the nearby fairy ring's use. It is a one-way teleport to slightly west of the Al Kharid bank.

label: Fairy bank
title: Fairy bank
lead: Fairy bank can be found in the bank of Zanaris. Players cannot interact with the object, but they can examine it.

label: fairy market stall
title: fairy market stall
lead:
Fairy market stalls are stalls which are only found in the Zanaris market place. They can be found next to Jukat and Irksol. To be able to enter the marketplace, players must pay a fee of one diamond.

Although these are stalls, they cannot be thieved from.

label: Fairy Queen
title: Fairy Queen
lead:
The Fairy Queen is the ruler of Zanaris and the fairies, and she plays a key role in the Fairy Tale quest series.

In Fairytale I - Growing Pains the Fairy Godfather has stolen the Queen's secateurs. Players must save the Queen by returning her secateurs which Tanglefoot (a level 111 tree-like monster) drops.

label: Fairy shop assistant
title: Fairy shop assistant
lead: The fairy shop assistant runs the Zanaris General Store together with the fairy shop keeper.

label: Fairy shop keeper
title: Fairy shop keeper
lead: The fairy shop keeper runs the Zanaris General Store together with the fairy shop assistant.

label: Falador
title: Falador
lead: Falador is the capital city of the Kingdom of Asgarnia. It is home to the iconic White Knight's Castle, and is one of the largest and most major cities, only slightly smaller than Varrock. It plays a key role in the Gielinor ore trade because it houses the Mining Guild, the Motherlode Mine, and a portion of the large Dwarven mine underground.

label: Falador east bank
title: Falador east bank
lead:
The Falador east bank, also known as Falador east or fally east, is a bank found in east Falador, south of the Falador Park. The bank was popular prior to the introduction of the Grand Exchange, and is commonly used before and after drop parties.

There is a Deadman chest in the bank.

label: Falador General Store
title: Falador General Store
lead:
The Falador General Store mainly consists of useful low level items. It is the first building on the west side when entering through the north gate. The ground floor of the general store contains the shop keeper and the shop assistant.

There is a ladder in the store that players can climb up to find Perdu. There are two more floors above him that can be reached by ladders, both of which contain nothing.

label: Falador Park
title: Falador Park
lead: The Falador Park is a large, fenced-in park found in Falador. Several gardeners maintain the plants and ponds located here. It is the entrance to the lair of the Giant Mole, and is a key location in the members' quest Wanted!, as well as the free-to-play quest Pirate's Treasure which requires the player to dig the ground at Falador Park. Multiple Treasure Trails clue scrolls will also lead the player to Falador Park in order to talk to Wyson the gardener or play music for Cecilia. Sir Tiffy Cashien can also be found in the park. He is involved in several quests.

label: Falador Teleport
title: Falador Teleport
lead:
Falador Teleport is a Magic spell that teleports the caster to Falador.

Like most teleports, this spell cannot be used past level 20 Wilderness.

label: Falador west bank
title: Falador west bank
lead:
The Falador west bank, also known as Falador west, fally west, and formerly Falador bank, is a popular bank found in north-west Falador.

The bank has a , although there is no way for players to access it. There is a Deadman chest in the bank.

label: Fallen tree
title: Fallen tree
lead: Fallen trees are found in various locations across Gielinor. The tree north of Draynor Village serves as a replacement for Sarah's damaged cart after the quest A Porcine of Interest is completed.

label: Family Crest
title: Family Crest
lead: Family Crest is a quest in which the player must retrieve three family crest pieces from the Fitzharmon brothers and return the crest to their father.

label: Family crest (item)
title: Family crest (item)
lead:
The Family crest is a quest item obtained during the Family Crest quest. It is made by combining the three crest parts given to the player by the Fitzharmon brothers, Avan, Caleb, and Johnathon, in return for performing a set of tasks for each brother.

If a player tries to put the crest back together with only two pieces, they will receive a message saying You still need one more piece of the crest.

label: Fancy Clothes Store
title: Fancy Clothes Store
lead: The Fancy Clothes Store is a shop in south-eastern Varrock. It is owned and run by Asyff. The shop sells needles and thread and different kinds of clothes such as gloves, boots, capes and hats. The store is also one of the places where players can obtain hunter clothing, through the Custom Fur Clothing panel, some of which increases one's Thieving abilities or provides weight reduction.

label: Fanfare
title: Fanfare
lead:
Fanfare is a music track that can be unlocked inside Falador city walls. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Arrival and Workshop.

In Classic mode, the track plays in western Falador.

label: Fanfare 2
title: Fanfare 2
lead:
Fanfare 2 is a music track unlocked in the Karamja Ship Yard. The song has a cheerful sound.

In Classic mode, the track plays in a larger area around the Ship Yard.

label: Fanfare 3
title: Fanfare 3
lead: Fanfare 3 is a music track that is unlocked in and around Port Khazard.

label: Farmer
title: Farmer
lead: Farmers are level 7 humans found on farms. Farmers are fairly weak and can be fair melee training for lower levels. Players with level 10 Thieving can pickpocket farmers, gaining 14.5 experience.

label: Farmer (Misthalin)
title: Farmer (Misthalin)
lead: Farmers are non-player characters located in Misthalin. They can be found tilling the soil of various crop fields such as wheat or potatoes in Lumbridge and Draynor Village.

label: Farmer Brumty
title: Farmer Brumty
lead:
Farmer Brumty is involved in the Sheep Herder quest. He is the owner of the sick-looking sheep and will aid players in their attempt to combat the plague. Like the other normal citizens in East Ardougne, he is oblivious to the plague hoax that King Lathas has created.

In order to enter Farmer Brumty's enclosure players must be wearing both a plague jacket and plague trousers.

label: Farmer's fork
title: Farmer's fork
lead:
The Farmer's fork is an unobtainable item added to the game with the release of RuneScape 2. Although it is classified internally as a weapon, it lacks a wield option and does not have any equip animations defined.

It is very similar, but not identical, to the forks that are wielded by farmers.

label: Fat Tony
title: Fat Tony
lead: Fat Tony is the owner of Tony's Pizza Bases, he is located in the Wilderness Bandit Camp. He is an outlaw after being accused of giving the king food poisoning. He denies it and fled the kingdom of Misthalin. The bandits give him refuge so long as he cooks for them.

label: Father Aereck
title: Father Aereck
lead:
Father Aereck is a Saradominist priest who maintains the over 230-year-old church of Lumbridge.

He is the person players must speak with to start The Restless Ghost quest.

label: Father Lawrence
title: Father Lawrence
lead: Father Lawrence Lambare is a priest who worships Saradomin in his church in north-east Varrock. He is often drunk when talked to and also claims that he is holding a congregation, although both of his followers, Martina Scorsby and Jeremy Clerksin, are asleep in their seats. He is a close friend to Romeo and he knows a lot about the struggles between Romeo's and Juliet's families. Father Lawrence is the person who suggests that you make a cadava potion during the Romeo & Juliet quest to help Romeo marry the love of his life, Juliet.

label: Father Urhney
title: Father Urhney
lead:
Father Urhney is an irritable priest who lives as a hermit in the Lumbridge Swamp. He has left Lumbridge to perform a full two-years meditation and retreat. Father Urhney never stops meditating, however, since he is constantly interrupted by people asking for amulets or claiming they have come to repossess his house. He suspects they are part of 'a bizarre conspiracy by some fiendish cult.'

Father Urhney plays a role in The Restless Ghost, giving the player a Ghostspeak amulet, which is required to speak to the Restless ghost in Lumbridge. If the player loses the Ghostspeak amulet, even after the quest is done, he will provide the player with a new amulet.

label: feather
title: feather
lead:
Feathers are used in the Fishing and Fletching skills. In Fishing, feathers are used as lures for fly fishing. Feathers may also be used as bait for barbarian heavy-rod fishing, as a cheaper alternative to fishing bait. In Fletching, feathers are used to make arrows, darts, and bolts. Feathers cannot be noted, as they are stackable.

These are the only feathers that can be used to summon a newtroost during the Creature Creation activity in the Tower of Life, as coloured feathers are not accepted by the altar.

label: Feldip Hills
title: Feldip Hills
lead: The Feldip Hills are positioned to the south of Yanille and south-east of the Castle Wars arena. The main city of Feldip Hills is Gu'Tanoth—to the west of Gu'Tanoth is Jiggig. Jiggig is filled with zogres and skogres. In the southern areas is a Hunter training area. After completing the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting, the hunting area can be used to hunt chompy. After speaking to Haris with Dragon Slayer I completed, the Corsair Cove Resource Area in the south-west of Feldip Hills can be unlocked and used as a spot to harpoon fish for tuna and swordfish, cage fish for lobster, or cut yew and maple trees.

label: Female slave
title: Female slave
lead:
Female slaves can be found working the mines at the Desert Mining Camp.

The generic female slaves (along with male slaves) complain a lot about being there and about their work. They can be spoken to, but no dialogue pops up, they will exclaim and the player will get thrown in jail if done enough times. After completion of The Tourist Trap, it's no longer possible to get thrown in the jail and the slaves can be talked to freely.

label: Femi
title: Femi
lead:
Femi is a gnome trader located outside the gate leading into the Tree Gnome Stronghold. When attempting to enter the gate for the first time, Femi will ask the player if they can help load some boxes into her cart. If the player helps load the boxes, she will later smuggle the player into the Tree Gnome Stronghold for free during The Grand Tree quest. If the player declines to help load the boxes, she will require a fee of 1,000 coins to smuggle the player in during the quest.

If the player has never spoken to Femi before The Grand Tree quest (by always entering the Tree Gnome Stronghold via a spirit tree), she will act as if the player had already assisted her and allow entry for free.

label: Fence (Biohazard)
title: Fence (Biohazard)
lead: A fence can be found at the back of the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. Players must squeeze-through the fence during the Biohazard quest to throw a rotten apple in the cauldron located in the garden of the headquarters.

label: Fern (scenery)
title: Fern (scenery)
lead: Ferns can be found almost anywhere with plant life. The common fern is ubiquitous throughout Gielinor, and can be found as far as Zeah and even on Zanaris. There is no way to interact with ferns other than to examine them. Ferns prevent fires from being lit on tile which they occupy, but are otherwise simply decorative.

label: Fernahei
title: Fernahei
lead: Fernahei runs Fernahei's Fishing Hut in Shilo Village. Players often buy feathers from him, and sell him fish. Shop prices are affected by the use of Karamja gloves.

label: Fernahei's Fishing Hut.
title: Fernahei's Fishing Hut.
lead: Fernahei's Fishing Hut is a fishing shop in Shilo Village run by Fernahei. The shop is filled with items related to fly Fishing, which is what Shilo Village is most popular with players for aside from the highest level Slayer Master, Duradel. It is common for players preparing to begin fly Fishing in the village to purchase the feathers here, unless they have purchased beforehand.

label: Fertile Soil (scenery)
title: Fertile Soil (scenery)
lead: Fertile Soil refers to 6 patches of soil in the Kharazi Jungle which are suitible for planting a Yommi tree during the Legends' Quest. Before planting, Fertile Soil must be treated by a golden bowl filled with holy water from the Kharazi water pool.

label: Fidelio
title: Fidelio
lead: Fidelio is the owner of the general store in Canifis. Like all the residents of Canifis, he is a werewolf, but is not aggressive to the player. He claims that the items he sells are "rare human artefacts which I went to great lengths of danger to acquire!" He speaks with a stutter.

label: Fight Arena
title: Fight Arena
lead: Fight Arena is an intermediate quest. The quest is started south of Ardougne by the titular Fight Arena by talking to Lady Servil.

label: Fight Arena (location)
title: Fight Arena (location)
lead:
The Fight Arena is a large structure south of Ardougne. It is here that General Khazard forces captured creatures and people (called fight slaves) to fight in violent clashes that always result in death. Some of these creatures were most likely imported by ship through Port Khazard from other regions.

The Fight Arena plays a large role in the quest Fight Arena. The only useful facilities that can be found here are the 4 water supplies and the bar to the west. Khazard armour can be obtained here by searching the armoury in the north-eastern house. Other than this, the area has no other use and cannot be accessed again after completing the quest. If attempted, the doorman will say "You're [him/her/them]! The one who murdered the General's pet. Leave this place at once!".

label: Fight Arena Bar
title: Fight Arena Bar
lead:
The Fight Arena Bar is a single-floored pub located in the south-western corner of the Fight Arena. The pub heavily relies on the Arena for its business, as it draws many customers ranging from spectators to guards.

The bar is the only place in RuneScape where players can purchase the Khali brew, which sells for 5 coins each. However, it has no drink option so players cannot consume it, and it is also untradeable. Regular beer is also available for 2 coins each.

label: Fight Arena mine
title: Fight Arena mine
lead: The Fight Arena mine is a mining area located between Port Khazard and Yanille, near the Fight Arena. It has a large variety of rocks, and it is close to the nearby Yanille bank as well as a bank deposit box and chest at Port Khazard. Also, the mine is a good source for iron ore.

label: Filled Recess
title: Filled Recess
lead: The Filled Recess is created when the player uses the activated heart crystal on the recess next to the shimmering field in order to pass through it. This can only be done during Legends' Quest.

label: Filliman Tarlock
title: Filliman Tarlock
lead:
Filliman Tarlock is the central character of the Nature Spirit quest. Players must wear the ghostspeak amulet to speak to him. During the quest, the player helps him transform from a ghost into a nature spirit. After the quest, he will disappear and reemerge during the quests, Fairytale I - Growing Pains and A Night at the Theatre.

He lives in his grotto in Mort Myre Swamp where an Altar of nature can be found after completing the quest. To reach his grotto, the most efficient way is to run all the way south of the western coast of the swamp.

label: Financial Advisor
title: Financial Advisor
lead:
The financial advisor was a man found in the Tutorial Island's bank. He taught players about ways to make money.
He told you that there were three basic ways of making money in Old School RuneScape:
*Combat, by picking up monster drops.
*Quests, by receiving their rewards.
*Trading with other players.
He said that he had to run through it quickly so you wouldn't get much out of him.

As he was not deemed useful, he was fired and replaced by the Account Guide in an update on 18 October 2018, although they both share the same appearance.

label: Fine Fashions
title: Fine Fashions
lead:
Fine Fashions is a store in the Grand Tree that is owned by Rometti. He can be found north-east on the . He sells an assortment of gnome robes sets in five pastel colours. These colours are pink, green, blue, cream, and turquoise.

Some of these items are used in Treasure Trails emote clues.

label: Fingernails
title: Fingernails
lead:
Fingernails is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest. During the quest, the player can find it by searching the bushes surrounding the Watchtower outside the north wall of Yanille.

The fingernails must be given to the wizard in the Watchtower in order for him to be able to identify who stole the power crystals that make the tower operate.

label: Fionella
title: Fionella
lead:
Fionella is a non-player character that can be found on the of the Legends' Guild. She runs the Legends Guild General Store.

In a letter from the Postbag from the Hedge, it is revealed that she is the wife of Radimus Erkle. Despite selling items within the Legends' Guild, she is not an actual member as with the bankers in the guild.

label: fire
title: fire
lead: A fire is a pile of burning logs lit on fire using the Firemaking skill. Many foods can be cooked on a fire, given the player has the required Cooking level.

label: Fire (Goblin Settlement)
title: Fire (Goblin Settlement)
lead: Fire is located in the Goblin settlement east of the Observatory. The fire is being tended by the goblins Greasycheeks and Smellytoes, but players may still use it for cooking.

label: Fire Altar
title: Fire Altar
lead:
The Fire Altar is a runic altar upon which fire runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 7 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 14 Runecraft is required to craft fire runes.

Players may create a fire tiara here by using either a fire talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 35 Runecraft experience. An elemental tiara can also be created here by using an elemental talisman and gold tiara, granting 40 Runecraft experience.

label: Fire battlestaff
title: Fire battlestaff
lead:
The fire battlestaff is an elemental staff requiring 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created at level 62 Crafting by combining a fire orb and battlestaff. It can also be upgraded to a mystic fire staff by paying Thormac 40,000 coins to upgrade it (less with the completion of certain Kandarin Diaries). The mystic fire staff is an even stronger alternative, providing better melee and magic stat bonuses.

label: Fire Blast
title: Fire Blast
lead:
Fire Blast is a fire-based blast spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 59 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

It is the strongest fire spell available to free-to-play players.

label: Fire Bolt
title: Fire Bolt
lead: Fire Bolt is a fire-based bolt spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 35 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

label: Fire elemental
title: Fire elemental
lead:
Fire elementals are one of the elementals featured in the Elemental Workshop quest series, along with the air, earth, and water elementals. They reside within the Elemental Workshop and the Smoke Dungeon.

Killing one is a requirement for an Easy Kandarin Diary task.

label: Fire feather
title: Fire feather
lead:
The fire feather is a quest item dropped by the Entrana firebird. Players need to obtain the fire feather as part of Heroes' Quest. In order to pick up the feather, the player must be wearing the Ice gloves, or else the player will fail to pick it up and take about 1/8 of their current HP in damage. After Heroes' Quest is completed, the fire feather cannot be re-obtained. If a player tries to pick up the fire feather before starting Heroes' Quest, they will receive the message: "It looks dangerously hot, and you have no reason to take it."

It is impossible to telegrab this item, even if the player is wearing the ice gloves. When a player attempts to telegrab the feather, they will receive the message: "I can't use Telekinetic Grab on this object.".

label: Fire Giant
title: Fire Giant
lead:
Fire giants are powerful giants that are popular for training Ranged and Slayer. They are also the strongest of the standard giants, being significantly stronger than their Ice, Moss, and Hill giant relatives.

Fire giants are assigned by a multitude of Slayer Masters, providing fairly decent experience for both combat and Slayer. They're also frequently killed by Ironman players early on due to their signature rune scimitar drop, as they are fairly easy to access with numerous safespots. Low-level players may find enchanted pearl bolts helpful when training Ranged against these enemies. Although there are many locations where cannons can be used, only the Charred Dungeon spawns are in a multicombat area.

label: Fire orb
title: Fire orb
lead:
A fire orb is a glass orb that has been charged at the Obelisk of Fire by using the Charge Fire Orb spell, requiring 63 Magic, on the obelisk. The spell requires an unpowered orb, 30 fire runes, and 3 cosmic runes, yielding 73 Magic experience. The Fire Obelisk is located at the end of Taverley Dungeon, west of the black dragons.

A fire orb can be used on a battlestaff, requiring 62 Crafting, yielding a fire battlestaff and 125 Crafting experience.

label: Fire rune
title: Fire rune
lead: Fire runes are one of the four elemental runes. They are used to cast fire-based combat spells in the standard spellbook, as well as casting many spells from other spellbooks. Some notable use cases for fire runes include casting alchemy spells to convert items into coins, charging a trident of the seas or trident of the swamp, and resurrecting high level thralls. Several items throughout the game, such as the staff of fire, provide infinite fire runes while equipped. Fire runes or packs can be bought from Magic shops, such as Aubury's Rune Shop in Varrock. Non-ironman players can also purchase them from the Nightmare Zone using 25 reward points.

label: Fire Strike
title: Fire Strike
lead: Fire Strike is a fire-based strike spell in the standard spellbook, available at level 13 Magic. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

label: Fire talisman
title: Fire talisman
lead:
The fire talisman is a talisman used in the Runecraft skill to enter the Fire Altar north of Al Kharid. It can also be combined with a tiara to create a fire tiara, which grants you 35 Runecraft experience.
