It is dropped by a variety of monsters, including skeletons, fire wizards (1/20), dark wizards, creatures in the Abyss and lava dragons. The drop rate is noted to be slightly higher from dark wizards than regular wizards but more commonly by fire wizards and creatures in the Abyss.

label: Fire wall
title: Fire wall
lead: Fire Walls are found in the Shaman Caves in the form of an octagram, sealing Ungadulu inside. During the Legends' Quest, the player must obtain a bowl of pure water and use it on the fire wall in order to extinguish a part of it and walk through. After the player has defeated Nezikchened inside the octagram of fire, Ungadulu casts a spell on the player, allowing them to freely walk through the fire wall by either attempting to touch it or by investigating it.

label: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
title: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
lead:
Leka, the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus, is a temple guardian encountered while exploring during the Temple of Ikov quest. He guards a door leading to Winelda the witch.

When a player attempts to open the door, he will appear and demand to know their identity. If the player chooses to identify themselves as a humble pilgrim, he will comment that no pilgrims have been to the temple for thousands of years, and will tell the player that the temple is closed. Otherwise, if the player instead states that they are a mighty hero, he will become enraged and attack. He uses fire-based magic attacks. If the player takes too long to kill him, he will simply disappear and the player will have to make him appear again.

label: Fire Wave
title: Fire Wave
lead:
Fire Wave is a fire-based wave spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 75 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

It is the second-strongest fire spell in the game, with the strongest being Fire Surge.

label: Firemaking
title: Firemaking
lead:
Firemaking is a skill used to light fires, among other things. It is the artisan companion skill of Woodcutting. Firemaking is trained by players to complete quests or participate in minigames. Several quests with quality rewards require Firemaking levels, such as Recipe for Disaster and Desert Treasure I. Similarly, Firemaking-oriented minigames with useful rewards include Shades of Mort'ton and the Wintertodt boss. Firemaking allows players to light logs to cook food anywhere, albeit with a higher burn chance than with a range. Wintertodt is a solid way to train Firemaking whilst also being profitable. Subduing the Wintertodt is the only way to obtain the pyromancer outfit.

Burnt-out fires leave behind ashes which some members may use to train Herblore with by making Serum 207. Players can turn a profit from burning cheaper logs and collecting the ashes, though at the cost of experience per hour.

label: Firemaking Level Up!
title: Firemaking Level Up!
lead: Firemaking Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Firemaking.

label: Firemaking Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Firemaking Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Firemaking Level Up! (Unlocks) is a Jingle for leveling Firemaking.

label: Firework
title: Firework
lead: A firework is an unobtainable potion released alongside snapdragon and the Brimhaven Agility Arena. It was presumably intended to be a cosmetic potion created from snapdragons, but was scrapped for unknown reasons.

label: Fish food
title: Fish food
lead:
Fish food is used in the Ernest the Chicken quest, used to feed fish that members can obtain as pets, and used in a step as part of Crack the Clue III. The poison found in the kitchen of Draynor Manor can be combined with the fish food to create poisoned fish food, which is used to kill the piranhas in the fountain south-west of Draynor Manor, allowing the player to retrieve a pressure gauge needed for the quest.

It can be found on the second level of Draynor Manor in the room with the ghost, south of the stairs.

label: Fisher Realm
title: Fisher Realm
lead:
The Realm of the Fisher King is the name given to a small kingdom located on an inter-dimensional plane alongside that of Gielinor's. The area plays a key role in the Holy Grail quest, in which the player is tasked with returning the grail to The Knights of the Round Table following Sir Galahad's choice to pardon himself from the order so he could become a monk.

Prior to completion of the quest, the area is ruled by The Fisher King; however, he is eventually succeeded by Sir Percival upon completion of the quest.

label: Fisherman (Fishing Platform)
title: Fisherman (Fishing Platform)
lead:
The Fishermen of the Fishing Platform were attacked and possessed by sea slugs, they have yellowish skin and make bizarre comments.

During the Sea Slug quest, they scare Kennith into hiding.

label: Fisherman (Holy Grail)
title: Fisherman (Holy Grail)
lead: The Fisherman is a subject of the Fisher Realm and one of the few people present that follow The Fisher King. During the quest Holy Grail, you must ask him how to enter the Grail Castle, which is by ringing the grail bell found outside. He disappears after Percival has become king for reasons unknown. He wears an eyepatch.

label: fishing
title: fishing
lead: Fishing is a skill which involves catching fish from selected spots around Gielinor. Higher Fishing levels enable different mechanisms of Fishing, the ability to catch a larger selection of fish and increases a player's catch rate. Caught fish may be cooked through the Cooking skill to create food which may be used later to regain hitpoints during combat. Alternatively, many players sell their excess stock of catches for gold.

label: Fishing (music track)
title: Fishing (music track)
lead:
Fishing is a music track that is unlocked in Catherby. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Lightwalk.

In Classic music mode, this track only plays on the east side of Catherby or on the northern shore of Entrana.

label: Fishing bait
title: Fishing bait
lead:
Fishing bait is an item used with the fishing rod. It is used to fish in any fishing spot as long as the spot has the Bait Fishing Spot option. Each successful catch uses up one piece of bait, so bring an appropriate amount in your inventory if you wish to catch a lot of fish.

Fishing bait can also be used for barbarian fishing, replacing feathers as bait.

label: Fishing Contest
title: Fishing Contest
lead: Fishing Contest is a quest in which the player has to earn the friendship of two dwarven brothers by securing a fishing trophy for them. Afterwards, they allow the player to use the dwarven passage underneath the mountain.

label: Fishing Guild
title: Fishing Guild
lead:
The Fishing Guild is a members-only guild located in a fenced area north of East Ardougne; west of Hemenster, which was released on 17 June 2002. To enter, players must have a Fishing level of 68; temporary boosts can be used to boost one's level in order to enter the guild, making the lowest level to possibly enter 62 using a super fishing potion.

Historically, aside from Catherby, the Fishing Guild has been one of the most popular places to fish because of the nearby bank.

label: Fishing Guild bank
title: Fishing Guild bank
lead:
The Fishing Guild bank is a bank located in the Fishing Guild. It was the first bank to be added in RuneScape 2.

Players must have to enter the guild, although it can be boosted from as low as 63 with an admiral pie. The bank is commonly used by ironmen, as well as for people completing the Fishing Guild Treasure Trails step.

label: Fishing Guild Shop.
title: Fishing Guild Shop.
lead: The Fishing Guild Shop is a store located in the Fishing Guild, owned by Roachey. It sells fishing bait and feathers, and will buy fish from players. The guild requires 68 Fishing to enter.

label: Fishing Level Up!
title: Fishing Level Up!
lead: Fishing Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Fishing.

label: Fishing Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Fishing Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Fishing Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Fishing.

label: Fishing pass
title: Fishing pass
lead:
The fishing pass is a quest item used only in Fishing Contest. It is obtained from Austri or Vestri upon starting the quest.

It is shown to Morris to enter the competition area each time.

label: Fishing Platform
title: Fishing Platform
lead: The Fishing Platform is located in the ocean due east of Witchaven. Players can travel here during and after the Sea Slug quest.

label: fishing potion
title: fishing potion
lead:
A Fishing potion is a potion made by using snape grass on an avantoe potion (unf), requiring 50 Herblore, yielding a Fishing potion(3) and 112.5 Herblore experience. A dose of Fishing potion provides a temporary skill boost to Fishing of +3. It can be stored in a tackle box.

After Barbarian Herblore Training, caviar can be added to a Fishing potion(2), requiring 53 Herblore, yielding a Fishing mix and 38 Herblore experience. A Fishing mix has 2 doses, boosts Fishing by 3, and heals 6 Hitpoints.

label: Fishing rod
title: Fishing rod
lead:
The fishing rod is an item used to catch fish through the Fishing skill. It can be bought from various fishing shops. To use a fishing rod, one will need fishing bait (except sandworms for anglerfish) to catch fish. It can be bought from fishing stores for 5 coins. There is also a fishing rod spawn in a house on south-eastern side of Entrana.

The equipable version of the fishing rod, the pearl fishing rod, can be bought with molch pearls from Alry the Angler.

label: Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)
title: Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)
lead: Fishing spots can be found throughout Gielinor typically along coastal areas. They can be fished for raw mackerel, raw cod, raw bass, big bass, raw shark, and big shark. There are also non-fish items such as casket, leather boots, leather gloves, oyster, and seaweed.

label: Fishing spot (cage, harpoon)
title: Fishing spot (cage, harpoon)
lead: Fishing spots can be found throughout Gielinor typically at coastal areas or docks. They can be fished at with lobster pots or harpoons for raw lobster, raw tuna, raw swordfish or Big Swordfish depending on the tool used.

label: Fishing spot (Hemenster)
title: Fishing spot (Hemenster)
lead: Fishing spots can be found in Hemenster during the Fishing Contest quest. These spots are used to catch a raw giant carp.

label: Fishing spot (lava eel)
title: Fishing spot (lava eel)
lead: Fishing spots can be found in three locations. These spots are used to fish Lava eels which are primarily used for the completion of the Heroes' Quest.

label: Fishing spot (small net, bait)
title: Fishing spot (small net, bait)
lead: The fishing spot with small net and bait options is commonly found in many fishing locations. Fish can be caught at them with either a small net or a fishing rod and bait.

label: Fishing spot (Tutorial Island)
title: Fishing spot (Tutorial Island)
lead: Fishing spots can be found on Tutorial Island. These spots are used to introduce the player to fishing and only shrimps can be caught.

label: Fishing Trawler
title: Fishing Trawler
lead:
Fishing Trawler is a Fishing minigame run by Murphy in Port Khazard. It can be played at any level, but 15 Fishing is required to receive any rewards. To play, board Murphy's trawling boat and work to prevent it from sinking for 5 minutes as it trawls the sea.

It can be played solo or in small groups for higher non-unique rewards (and therefore higher Fishing experience), but it is slightly faster and much more relaxed to obtain the angler's outfit working with others, especially on the official Fishing Trawler worlds.

label: Fishing trophy
title: Fishing trophy
lead:
The fishing trophy is a quest item used only in Fishing Contest. It is obtained from Bonzo after catching a raw giant carp.

It is given to either Austri or Vestri to complete the quest.

label: fissure
title: fissure
lead:
The fissure entrance to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon in Karamja is revealed by using a spade on the mound of earth during the Shilo Village quest.

Once revealed, a lit torch or candle can be used on it to drop it into the fissure to see that is a large drop and to find an anchor point for a rope. Once a rope is used on it and attached, the fissure can be searched to crawl through the hole and down below into the temple.

label: Flagpole
title: Flagpole
lead: Flagpoles are scenery objects found in various towns and cities throughout Gielinor. Players cannot interact with these flagpoles, but they can examine them.

label: Flames of Zamorak
title: Flames of Zamorak
lead:
Flames of Zamorak is a combat spell in the standard spellbook, requiring 60 Magic and the completion of Mage Arena I to cast. In addition, players must also be wielding a Zamorak staff, staff of the dead, Thammaron's sceptre (a), accursed sceptre (a), or toxic staff of the dead; all except the Zamorak staff are able to autocast the spell.

Initially, the spell can only be cast within the Mage Arena against the battle mages. Upon casting the spell 100 times (regardless of whether it was a successful hit or not), the spell becomes usable outside the arena.

label: Flat rock
title: Flat rock
lead:
Flat rocks are an obstacle that can be found within Underground Pass dungeon. During the Underground Pass quest, players must use a plank on the flat rocks in order to traverse the obstacle and reach the orb of lights. A set of flat rocks are also encountered further into the dungeon.

The plank remains in the player's inventory after use, eliminating the need to pick it up again or have multiple planks.

label: Flat rock (trap)
title: Flat rock (trap)
lead: A flat rock is a trap that can be found within the Underground Pass dungeon. Players will encounter the trap during the Underground Pass quest whilst collecting the four orbs of light. Players must first search the flat rock to disarm the trap before taking the orb of light on top of it. It is possible to fail disarming the trap, triggering a swinging log, which can damage 6 to 13 Hitpoints.

label: flax
title: flax
lead:
Flax is a resource that can be picked from plants in various locations around Gielinor. Multiple can be collected from the same plant. Flax can also be harvested from a hops patch after planting flax seeds with 18 Farming.

It is used to make bow strings at a spinning wheel, requiring 10 Crafting, yielding 15 Crafting experience. Flax can also be spun via the Spin Flax Lunar spell. It is also used to spin linen yarn or as payment to protect hemp plants (x6). Linen yarn can be used to build a linen trawling net or woven into bolts of linen, which can be used to upgrade masts and sails on a player's boat.

label: Flax (plant)
title: Flax (plant)
lead:
Flax plants can be picked to obtain flax, which can then be spun into bowstrings and linen yarn. There are six flax fields where many flax plants are located, in addition to many isolated plants.

There is a 3/16 (18.75%) chance that flax will disappear when picked, after which the plant will respawn after 10 game ticks (6 seconds).

label: Fletching
title: Fletching
lead:
Fletching is a skill which allows the player to create various types of ranged weapons and their ammunition. The products of this skill are primarily used in the combat skill, Ranged. It also provides some of the most popular materials used for High Alchemy, which is a commonly used method for training the Magic skill.

At a higher Fletching level, the skill can be trained without losing any coins, although a decent amount of working capital is very useful. Money can usually be generated at higher Fletching levels. Alternatively, it can be extremely fast with more expensive methods.

label: Fletching Level Up!
title: Fletching Level Up!
lead: Fletching Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling Fletching.

label: Fletching Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Fletching Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Fletching Level Up! (Unlocks) is a Jingle for leveling Fletching.

label: Flighted ogre arrow
title: Flighted ogre arrow
lead:
Flighted ogre arrows are made by using a knife on achey logs to make ogre arrow shafts, and then using 4 feathers per arrow shaft made. Doing so requires level 5 Fletching, granting 0.9 Fletching experience per flighted arrow.

Adding wolfbone arrowtips makes ogre arrows, while adding nails with a hammer will make brutal arrows instead.

label: Floor spikes (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Floor spikes (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The floor spikes are an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to jump across the spikes successfully will cause the player to take damage. Players will no longer fail this obstacle at level 50 Agility.

The amount of damage is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below:

label: Flour (unobtainable item)
title: Flour (unobtainable item)
lead:
Flour was an item that could be obtained by killing black knights in RuneScape Classic. It could not normally be picked up, and players were intended to use a pot on it in order to obtain a pot of flour. However, it was possible to obtain the heap of flour by casting Telekinetic Grab. Upon the release of RuneScape 2, knights were changed to drop a regular pot of flour instead, initially making it one of the rarest discontinued items in the game.

Flour was inadvertently made obtainable again with the release of Player-owned Houses, as the Teak larder gave this item instead due to an oversight. Since it was useless in cooking, players could only bake by dropping the flour and picking it up with a pot.

label: Flower (original scenery)
title: Flower (original scenery)
lead: Flowers are a common form of scenery decoration found all throughout Gielinor, with these being the most common having over 1200 collectively logged individual flowers.

label: Fluffs' kitten
title: Fluffs' kitten
lead:
Fluffs' kitten is a quest item used only in Gertrude's Cat. It is found in one of the mewing crates in the Lumber Yard.

The kitten must be used on Fluffs to progress. If the player drop the kitten, it will become an NPC and run off into crates again, forcing the player to search for it again.

label: Flute Salad
title: Flute Salad
lead:
Flute Salad is a music track that is unlocked when the player first arrives in Lumbridge. It can also be heard around the Lumbridge Swamp and farmlands. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Autumn Voyage, Book of Spells, Dream, Harmony, and Yesteryear.

In Classic mode, the track plays around Mill Lane Mill and Fred the Farmer's house.

label: Fly fishing rod
title: Fly fishing rod
lead:
A fly fishing rod can be used to fish trout, salmon (both with feathers), and rainbow fish (with stripy feathers). They can be bought from various fishing shops. Fly fishing rods are used at fishing spots with the lure option. Popular fishing spots include the Barbarian Village, the Grand Tree, and Shilo Village. Fly fishing rods use feathers as bait. Feathers are dropped frequently from chickens or purchased from fishing shops.

The equipable version of the fly fishing rod, the pearl fly fishing rod, can be bought with molch pearls from Alry the Angler.

label: Fly trap
title: Fly trap
lead:
A fly trap is a stationary, carnivorous plant found only on Karamja. Like undead trees, they can attack players next to them every 5 ticks for up to 2 damage. They cannot be attacked and inflict melee damage that can be prevented with Protect from Melee.

Their stats are: 15 Attack, 15 Strength, 30 Defence, 100 Hitpoints with 45 crush defence, 30 stab defence, and 8 slash defence.

label: Flyer
title: Flyer
lead:
A flyer is a virtually useless item that, when examined, advertises Bob's Brilliant Axes. It is one of the possible required items that must be traded for a Kelda seed in the Forgettable Tale... quest. Additionally, it is one of the items that can be requested by Gunslik or the rowdy dwarf when doing Keldagrim tasks.

It can be dropped by barbarians and imps or obtained as a reward from a mystery box from the Quiz Master random event. Talking to men or women has a 1/128 chance of being offered a flyer.

label: Flying Horse Inn
title: Flying Horse Inn
lead:
The Flying Horse Inn is a bar found north of Ardougne Castle, in the north-western part of East Ardougne. The bartender sells beer to thirsty adventurers for two coins per pint, and there are several small rooms to rest in upstairs (though these are non-functional).

Lucien can be found around the inn; he serves as the start point of the Temple of Ikov quest. Two-pints can also be found at the inn, where she acts as the taskmaster for the Ardougne Diary.

label: Flynn
title: Flynn
lead:
Flynn is the owner of the Flynn's Mace Market in Falador.

His shop is located between the barbershop and the general store which is just west of Falador's town square. He sells bronze, iron, steel, mithril, and adamant maces.

label: Flynn's Mace Market.
title: Flynn's Mace Market.
lead: Flynn's Mace Market is a mace shop owned by Flynn in Falador. It is located between the Falador General Store and the Hairdresser in the north-western part of the city.

label: flypaper
title: flypaper
lead: Flypaper can be taken from sacks in the gardening shed on the west end of Sinclair Mansion. It is used during the Murder Mystery quest to lift fingerprints from a number of silver items that belong to the people suspected of committing the murder of Lord Sinclair.

label: Font (scenery)
title: Font (scenery)
lead: Fonts are decorative water bowls found in many different places. Players cannot interact with the fonts but they can examine them.

label: Food Store
title: Food Store
lead:
The Food Store, operated by Wydin, sells a variety of fresh food, and is located in Port Sarim. It plays a notable role in the Pirate's Treasure quest - it is the drop off point between Karamja and Asgarnia to find the otherwise illegal beverage Karamjan rum, after smuggling it from Karamja.

Starting the quest is not required to access the store. However, to access the back room of the store, the player must have progressed far enough into the quest and be wearing a white apron (which can be taken from the Fishing shop to the north). The back room contains various crates: a crate of cabbages, crate of potatoes, crates of raw chicken, and a crate of bananas.

label: Food trough (Clock Tower)
title: Food trough (Clock Tower)
lead:
Food trough is a part of the Clock Tower quest, and is located in Clock Tower Dungeon, inside the room with dungeon rats.

During the quest, in order to obtain the white cog, the player has to put rat poison inside the food trough. After doing so, the rats inside the room will eat from the trough and die, after which the player will find the gate guarding the white cog unhinged.

label: Food Trough (Troll Stronghold)
title: Food Trough (Troll Stronghold)
lead: The Food Trough is located in the Mountain goat pen in the Burntmeat's Troll kitchen, in the Troll Stronghold.

label: Footprints (The Tourist Trap)
title: Footprints (The Tourist Trap)
lead: Footprints can be seen in the sand between the Shantay Pass and the Desert Mining Camp. During The Tourist Trap, it is revealed that these are the tracks of Ana and her captors, a fact all but confirmed by Ana's red scarf on a cactus near the footprints.

label: Forbidden
title: Forbidden
lead:
Forbidden is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track could be unlocked near the Wilderness ditch, north of the Lumber Yard.

label: Foreman
title: Foreman
lead:
The foreman looks after the Ship Yard on Karamja. He can be found walking around on the southern tip of the docks.

During The Grand Tree, players need to either talk to him or kill him to get the lumber order. His combat level is 23. If the player decides to talk to him, he will ask three questions to which players must answer correctly to proceed.

label: Forester (McGrubor's Wood)
title: Forester (McGrubor's Wood)
lead: The forester outside the entrance to McGrubor's Wood prevents people from entering. Although he has a talk-to option, attempting to do so displays the message He doesn't seem interested in talking to you.. He will yell at players if they attempt to enter the gate.

label: Forester (Woodcutting Guild)
title: Forester (Woodcutting Guild)
lead: Foresters can be found throughout the Woodcutting Guild. They can either be fought or spoken to by players.

label: Forester's Arms
title: Forester's Arms
lead:
Forester's Arms is the tavern in Seers' Village. The place is featured in the Bar Crawl, selling a Liverbane Ale for 18 coins; the ale temporarily lowers Attack, Defence, Fletching, Firemaking and Woodcutting by 6 levels, so don't plan to pursue those skills after running the Bar Crawl here. In addition to beer, the bartender sells meat pie for 16 coins and bowls of stew for 20 coins. These are good prices but there's a bit of dialogue to go through for each one bought, so it's rather slow if large quantities are wanted. Buying a bowl of stew is also an easy task for the Kandarin Diary.

The Poison salesman works his trade here; he features in the Murder Mystery and Fremennik trials quests. There are a number of NPCs (men and women) to train on.

label: Forever
title: Forever
lead: Forever is a music track that is unlocked in Edgeville and the Edgeville Dungeon.

label: Fountain
title: Fountain
lead:
Fountains are decorative scenery that can be found throughout Gielinor. Players may use various containers on them, such as buckets, vials, or waterskins in order to fill them with water. They are usually indicated on the map by a symbol.

While the vast majority of fountains have the common appearance, some towns and cities have different styled fountains. A unique golden fountain can be found in the Ratcatchers Mansion, that has an identical appearance to the Fountain of Heroes.

label: Fountain (Draynor Manor)
title: Fountain (Draynor Manor)
lead:
Fountain is used in Ernest the Chicken quest, and is located outside Draynor Manor in the south-west corner.

During the quest, a pressure gauge can be found inside the fountain. However, it is guarded by piranhas that are inside the fountain, and in order to obtain the pressure gauge players must kill the piranhas by using poisoned fish food on the fountain.

label: Fountain (witch's house)
title: Fountain (witch's house)
lead: A fountain can be found in the garden of the witch's house. During the quest, players must search this fountain in order to find the key to the witch's shed. Unlike other fountains, it cannot be used as a water source.

label: Fountain of Heroes
title: Fountain of Heroes
lead:
The Fountain of Heroes is a magical fountain found in a small side passage of the Heroes' Guild, downstairs inside the mine, near the runite ore rocks.

Using an amulet of glory on the fountain will cause all unnoted amulets of glory that players have in their inventory or equipped on their character to be recharged to an amulet of glory (4). Amulets can be recharged even if they are not completely depleted.

label: Frank
title: Frank
lead:
Frank Sinclair is one of Lord Sinclair's children. He is one of the suspects during the Murder Mystery quest. Frank is not involved in King's Ransom.

According to the Gossip, he is a chronic gambler and in order to cover his debts, Frank has stolen and sold a couple of his father's rare paintings.

label: Frank's barrel
title: Frank's barrel
lead: Frank's barrel can be found inside the Sinclair Mansion in Frank's bedroom. During the Murder Mystery quest, the player must search the barrel to find his silver pot.

label: Frank's print
title: Frank's print
lead: Frank's print is a quest item in the Murder Mystery quest. It is created by using flypaper on the silver pot after dusting it with a pot of flour. If the prints match those of the unknown print, it will become a killer's print, meaning Frank is the killer.

label: Fred the Farmer
title: Fred the Farmer
lead:
Fred the Farmer is an agriculturalist that features in the Sheep Shearer, One Small Favour, and Cold War quests. Players can find Fred at the farmhouse north-west of Lumbridge, south of the windmill and to the west of the Lumbridge sheep pen. His farm is where you can find onions, which can be hard to find, especially for non-members.

If the player talks to him and says that they have seen the "Thing" (which is actually just two penguins), he will start to go on about grabbing chickens and running to the hills. In the end, the player will say that it is two penguins disguised as a sheep. He will ask if the player is feeling alright.

label: Fred's farm
title: Fred's farm
lead: Fred's farm, also known as the Lumbridge farm, is a large farm in Lumbridge found north of the Lumbridge Castle. The farm is owned by Fred the Farmer, and is worked by Fred and several farmers.

label: Frenita
title: Frenita
lead: Frenita runs Frenita's Cookery Shop in Yanille. She sells various cooking utensils and some ingredients for advanced recipes such as cakes and pies. Her shop also houses a range, a sink and a churn.

label: Frenita's Cookery Shop.
title: Frenita's Cookery Shop.
lead: Frenita's Cookery Shop is a Cooking shop in Yanille run by Frenita. There is also a range, sink, and churn inside the building and dairy cows just north of Yanille.

label: Frincos
title: Frincos
lead: Frincos is a monk who runs Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store on south-western Entrana. His shop sells Herblore supplies such as eyes of newt and vials, as well as packs of them.

label: Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store.
title: Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store.
lead: Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store is a Herblore shop on Entrana. Frincos sells eyes of newt and vials both individually and in packs. He also sells pestle and mortars. His shop contains a sink and two vial respawns. The shop is also next to a hops patch.

label: Frozen Waste Plateau
title: Frozen Waste Plateau
lead:
The Frozen Waste Plateau, also known as Ice Plateau (or historically Ghorrock), is located in the north-west corner of the Wilderness. The area spans both free-to-play and members areas. It contains ice giants and ice warriors in the free-to-play area. In the member's area, ice spiders can also be found. There are also spawns of water runes and cosmic runes.

Notably, three runite rocks can be found in the members' only area of the plateau.

label: Fruit batta
title: Fruit batta
lead:
A fruit batta is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 11 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade fuit battas are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 120 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make a fruit batta via gnome cooking with 25 Cooking, yielding 150 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Fruit blast
title: Fruit blast
lead:
A fruit blast is a type of drink that restores 9 Hitpoints when consumed. It can be obtained by mixing 1 pineapple, 1 orange, and 1 lemon. You must then finish the cocktail by adding lemon slices as a garnish, requiring level 6 Cooking to complete. To create the cocktail, click "Mix-cocktail" on a cocktail shaker. All ingredients and tools can be bought from Funch's Fine Groceries just east of the Blurberry Bar.

Ashes can be added to a fruit blast to create a dirty blast, which is a requirement for the first part of Recipe for Disaster.

label: Full fishing net
title: Full fishing net
lead: Full fishing nets are mainly found in Port Sarim. They can also be found in the ports of Brimhaven, Fishing Guild, Corsair Cove, Lunar Isle, and Fishing Hamlet.

label: Funch's Fine Groceries
title: Funch's Fine Groceries
lead: Funch's Fine Groceries is a shop owned by Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree. It sells items needed for Gnome cooking. The store is located on the east side of the Grand Tree's , east of Blurberry's Bar.

label: Fungus (common)
title: Fungus (common)
lead: Fungus is a common scenery decoration found in many places all across Gielinor.

label: Fungus covered Cavern wall
title: Fungus covered Cavern wall
lead:
Fungus covered Cavern walls are located within the Pothole Dungeon on Karamja, and can be searched for a Grimy rogue's purse. In the Jungle Potion quest, these walls must be searched for a rogue's purse, as Trufitus will not accept one obtained as a drop. Players must be told by Trufitus about where to find rogue's purse first, or else searching the walls will yield nothing.

After the rogue's purse has been picked, the wall becomes a Fungus pattern and cannot be picked from again until it turns back after about 100 ticks, or 60 seconds.

label: Fur stall
title: Fur stall
lead:
A fur stall is a stall that requires 35 Thieving to loot and grants 45 experience. Successfully looting a fur stall will give the player a piece of grey wolf fur. The thievable stalls are located in Ardougne, Rellekka, and Civitas illa Fortis.

In Civitas Illa Fortis, players can safely steal from the stall by luring Molossus (the dog) to the west-side corner of the stall. This prevents the guards from attacking the player as the guards will be blocked by Molossus.

label: Fur stall (Varrock)
title: Fur stall (Varrock)
lead: Fur stall is a decorative stall found in Varrock Square near Baraek. Unlike other fur stalls, the stall in Varrock cannot be stolen from.

label: Fur trader (East Ardougne)
title: Fur trader (East Ardougne)
lead:
The Fur trader runs the Ardougne Fur Stall. in the East Ardougne market. If stock is stolen from his stall, he refuses to do business for 10 minutes. He buys bear furs for 3 coins each.

He appears alongside other residents of East Ardougne in the Ratcatchers mansion.

label: furnace
title: furnace
lead:
A furnace is an interactive scenery object primarily used in Smithing to smelt various ores into metal bars. Furnaces around Gielinor are identified with the furnace icon on the world map and minimap.

Furnaces are also used for Crafting from metal bars. With the appropriate mould in their inventory and the required Crafting level, players can use the furnace to craft gold or silver bars into jewellery such as rings or holy symbols, assuming they have the appropriate mould in their inventory and the required Crafting level. Players may also make molten glass by smelting soda ash and a bucket of sand.

label: Furnace (Elemental Workshop)
title: Furnace (Elemental Workshop)
lead:
The furnace found in the elemental workshop near the fire elementals is used to melt elemental ore into elemental metal during the Elemental Workshop I and Elemental Workshop II quests.

For the furnace to work properly, the bellows and Water wheel need to be working as well.

label: Furnace (Viyeldi caves)
title: Furnace (Viyeldi caves)
lead: A Furnace can be found in the Viyeldi caves. During the Legends' Quest the player must use the lump, hunk, and chunk of crystal on it, in order to combine them into a Heart crystal which can then be activated by using it on the mossy rock.

label: Fycie
title: Fycie
lead: Fycie is the daughter of Rantz. She has a brother named Bugs. She lives in Rantz's Cave, and sells feathers during Big Chompy Bird Hunting. In Recipe for Disaster, both Fycie and her brother Bugs use the ogre boat ride to get to Karamja. During some Treasure Trails, she has to be talked to. When doing so, she says 'Human done good!', and gives you your next clue, or the reward. One method of getting to her is to take a fairy ring to and running east.

label: Gaius
title: Gaius
lead: Gaius is a male non-player character who is located in Taverley. He owns a shop called Gaius' Two-Handed Shop, which sells two-handed swords.

label: Gaius' Two Handed Shop.
title: Gaius' Two Handed Shop.
lead: Gaius' Two Handed Shop is a shop in Taverley owned by Gaius that has a variety of two-handed swords ranging from bronze to adamant. This store does not sell the rune or dragon two-handed sword. It can be used as an easy source for the adamant two-handed sword needed for a hard emote clue scroll.

label: Galahad
title: Galahad
lead:
Brother Galahad was formerly a knight of King Arthur's Round Table and one of the three achievers of the Holy Grail. He now lives in a house west of McGrubor's Wood and does not mind somebody stopping by to talk to once and a while, stating that it is rare that this happens. During the conversation he may give players a cup of tea.

During the Holy Grail quest, he will give the player the holy table napkin which is used to get the magic whistle in Draynor Manor. The whistle is used to go to the Fisher Realm. The alternative to go to Fisher Realm is by use of the fairy ring code . Letting him make you a cup of tea is a task in the Kandarin Easy Achievement Diary.

label: Galarpos Mountains
title: Galarpos Mountains
lead:
The Galarpos Mountains are part of a mountain range in Western Kandarin and Eastern Tirannwn, which separates Tirannwn from the rest of the mainland. For a long time, the mountains were largely thought to be impassable. The only routes available past the mountains are either through the Underground Pass or through the Arandar mountain pass.

Arposandra, translating in ancient gnomish to "Rock City", is located somewhere beneath the mountain range.

label: Gaol
title: Gaol
lead: Gaol is a music track that is unlocked either in Gu'Tanoth or in the Skavid caves. Prior to the track's removal from an area north of the Bandit Camp in the Wilderness in 2021, this track was accessible to free-to-play players.

label: Gap (Gu'Tanoth)
title: Gap (Gu'Tanoth)
lead:
The gap is a hole in a bridge inside Gu'Tanoth. Partial completion of the Watchtower quest along with a rock cake is necessary to access this bridge for the first time. Jumping the gap from the south will grant the player 5 experience in Agility at the cost of coins each time. Level 25 Agility is required to do so. No experience is awarded when jumping the gap in the opposite direction.

While players no longer will have to bribe the ogre guards at the second checkpoint with a rock cake on subsequent visits to Gu'Tanoth, jumping back over the gap after having crossed it will reset the player's payment status, leading the guards to demand another bribe the following visit. However, if the player teleports out rather than jump back across, they will not be prompted to pay a bribe on their next attempt to cross the bridge. It is possible that this behaviour is the result of a misconception when the ogre city was converted from RuneScape Classic.

label: Garden (music track)
title: Garden (music track)
lead:
Garden is a music track that can be unlocked inside Varrock city walls, excluding the Grand Exchange. It also plays in the Phoenix Gang Hideout and in the basement of the Blue Moon Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Adventure, Medieval, and Spirit. This track was one of the first released in RuneScape.

In Classic mode, this track plays in the centre of Varrock and in the basement of the Blue Moon Inn.

label: Garlic
title: Garlic
lead: Garlic is an item used in several quests. Although it cannot be eaten on its own, it is used in Cooking in making Spicy sauce and in Herblore in making Guthix balance potions.

label: Garv
title: Garv
lead: Garv guards Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven. Only players who are aligned with the Black Arm Gang can infiltrate this hideout by disguising themself as Hartigen via black knight's armour and Id papers from Trobert, which is done during the Heroes' Quest.

label: Gas mask
title: Gas mask
lead:
The gas mask is a quest item used in Plague City and Biohazard. It is made by giving dwellberries to Alrena in East Ardougne. The mask is required to be worn to enter West Ardougne before completion of Biohazard. Gas masks are also dropped by the mourners who are present in Mourning's End Part I.

Gas masks serve as a way to protect player from damage in the Smokey Dungeon and Smoke Devil Dungeon. The mask also reduces damage from the clouds whilst sulphur mining in Lovakengj, and prevents infection from Nex's virus attack, which makes them useful even after their intended quest use.

label: Gate (Al Kharid)
title: Gate (Al Kharid)
lead: The Al Kharid gate is the gate between Lumbridge and Al Kharid. Four border guards are guarding the gate, two on each side.

label: Gate (Ardougne Sewers)
title: Gate (Ardougne Sewers)
lead: The gates in the Ardougne Sewers block the path to the Ardougne Sewers mine and the Rat Pits. Unlocking the gate requires level 31 Thieving and grants 25 experience.

label: Gate (Biohazard)
title: Gate (Biohazard)
lead: Gates can be found on the of the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. The gates are locked and require a key that is automatically obtained after killing the Mourner positioned outside the gates. During the Biohazard quest, players must access the storeroom behind the gates in order to obtain a distillator from one of the crates.

label: Gate (Desert Mining Camp)
title: Gate (Desert Mining Camp)
lead: The gate is the entrance to the Desert Mining Camp. Players must have the metal key in their inventory to open the gate. The metal key is obtained in the Tourist Trap quest by fighting the Mercenary Captain. Players can also search the gate to find out more information about the Desert Mining Camp.

label: Gate (Ship Yard)
title: Gate (Ship Yard)
lead: A gate is the entrance to the Ship Yard. To pass through the gate, players must speak the password (Ka, Lu, Min) they learn during The Grand Tree quest. During the Monkey Madness I quest, the player must have a gnome royal seal to enter the Ship Yard. After completing the quest the gnome royal seal is no longer required.

label: Gate (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
title: Gate (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
lead: The gate is the entrance to the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Prior to partial completion of The Grand Tree quest, on the first time the player attempts to open the gate, Femi will ask for assistance to lift some boxes on to her cart. If the player helps load the boxes, she will smuggle the player in to the Tree Gnome Stronghold for free when they are stopped from entering during The Grand Tree. If she wasn't helped with loading her boxes, she will require a fee of 1,000 coins to be smuggled in during the quest. Players are freely allowed to enter the gate without interruption outside of that section of the quest once the initial dialogue is completed.

label: Gate (Underground Pass Shortcut)
title: Gate (Underground Pass Shortcut)
lead: Two gates are located in the Underground Pass that block the entrance and exit of a path around an obstacle maze. These gates can only be successfully unlocked with level 50 Thieving.

label: Gate (witch's house)
title: Gate (witch's house)
lead: The gate in the basement of the witch's house can only be opened with certain gloves. During the Witch's House quest, it must be passed in order to get the magnet from the cupboard. Without the correct gloves, attempting to open the gate will deal 20% of your current Hitpoints.

label: Gem merchant
title: Gem merchant
lead:
The gem merchant runs the Ardougne Gem Stall. in East Ardougne. He sells sapphires, emeralds, rubies, and diamonds.

He appears alongside other residents of East Ardougne in the Ratcatchers mansion.

label: gem rocks
title: gem rocks
lead:
Gem rocks can be mined through the Mining skill. A Mining level of 40 is required to mine gem rocks, granting 65 Mining experience per gem.

Normal gem rocks can be mined in Shilo Village after a player has completed the Shilo Village quest, in the Lunar Isle mine after Lunar Diplomacy, or on The Onyx Crest after 47 Sailing. The rocks regenerate 99 ticks (59.4 seconds) after being mined. Wearing a charged amulet of glory triples the success rate of mining these gem rocks. There is also another kind of gem rock which randomly appears during the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame with a 5% chance per event. These rocks can be mined three times before they despawn.

label: Gem stall
title: Gem stall
lead:
A gem stall is a stall, which may be stolen from at level 75 Thieving, granting 408 Thieving experience. There is a respawn time of 60 seconds.

Thieving from the Green Gemstone Gems stall is a requirement for the Fremennik Hard Diary.

label: Gem stall (Al Kharid)
title: Gem stall (Al Kharid)
lead: Gem stall is scenery found in northern Al Kharid near the Gem trader. Unlike standard gem stalls, the Al Kharid variant cannot be stolen from.

label: Gem trader
title: Gem trader
lead:
The gem trader runs the Gem Trader stall in Al Kharid. He buys and sells sapphires, emeralds, rubies, and diamonds and their uncut versions as well. His shop isn't frequently used by most players due to the predominance of the Grand Exchange, where sellers can receive more money for the gems, cut or uncut. However, it is popular with ironmen. In the Family Crest quest, he directs the player to Avan at the Al Kharid mine.

Prior to the release of the Grand Exchange pre-late 2007, it was common for the gem trader to have a fairly full stock on free-to-play worlds as his shop was the easiest way for newer players to sell their gems. Newer players were also able to make small profits by buying uncut gems from the gem trader, cutting them, then selling back for a higher price.

label: Gem Trader.
title: Gem Trader.
lead: Gem Trader is a gem shop run by the Gem trader in northern Al Kharid. It is a stall, but cannot be stolen from using the Thieving skill, unlike the gem stalls in Keldagrim, Ardougne, and Mor Ul Rek.

label: General Bentnoze
title: General Bentnoze
lead:
General Bentnoze is a member of the Thorobshuun tribe and one of the two goblin generals found in the northernmost part of Goblin Village. He plays a major role in the quest Goblin Diplomacy.

He is always found standing next to his rival general, General Wartface, whom he constantly argues with over armour colours. He favours the colour red while his opponent prefers the colour green.

label: General Khazard
title: General Khazard
lead:
General Khazard, also known as Khazard, is the leader of the Khazard Army. He is a Zamorakian Mahjarrat, and the son of Palkeera. He has established a large territory between Ardougne and Yanille and is at war with the gnomes.

He may be fought during the Fight Arena quest after killing Bouncer, his pet hellhound, though it is not required. He is spoken to frequently during The General's Shadow and Secrets of the North.

label: General Store (Canifis)
title: General Store (Canifis)
lead: The Canifis General Store is located in north-western Canifis and is owned by Fidelio. Its wares are double the price of other general stores, and it always offers to buy items at the lowest price (as if the store has a full stock of the item). However, unlike other stores, the Canifis General Store also sells needles and thread.

label: General Wartface
title: General Wartface
lead:
General Wartface is a member of the Garagorshuun tribe and one of the two goblin generals found in the northernmost building in Goblin Village. He plays a major role in the Goblin Diplomacy quest.

He is always found standing next to his rival general, General Bentnoze, whom he constantly argues with over armour colours. He favours the colour green while his opponent prefers the colour red.

label: General Wartface (historical)
title: General Wartface (historical)
lead: General Wartface is an unused historical variant of General Wartface that appeared during Goblin Diplomacy. Despite the historical variant being unused since the graphics were updated in 2006, the NPC model and data remains in the game cache. The old variant retains the old graphical style.

label: Genie
title: Genie
lead:
The Genie appears as a random event. The Genie appears near players and gives them an experience lamp, which may be rubbed to raise a selected skill's experience by 10 times the current level of the particular. For example, if the player has level 30 in Herblore, they would gain 300 Herblore experience if the skill is chosen.

The lamp is generally best used on skills that take longer to level up, such as Runecraft or Agility. Alternatively, they can be used for skills that are expensive to train, such as Construction.

label: Gerald
title: Gerald
lead:
Gerald is a man wandering near the banks of the River Dougne, south of the massive chain of rapids known as Baxtorian Falls. Gerald appears to be a fisherman looking to harvest the native trout and salmon that make their home in the nearby stretch of water.

Gerald can be found very close to where a player will wash up if they attempt to traverse Baxtorian Falls' rapids without a rope. If spoken to, Gerald will discuss some of the area's tourist attractions. He also makes a brief mention of the legendary treasure said to have been left in the falls by the elven king Baxtorian some 200 years ago, in the late days of the Fourth Age. He says that, although many adventurers come searching for it, none have found any trace of Baxtorian's legendary tomb.

label: Gerrant
title: Gerrant
lead: Gerrant is the owner of Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim. He is seen wearing a white apron and toting a fishing pole around and he also wears a beige fishing hat. A white apron respawns in his shop. He sells feathers, fishing bait, fishing poles (bait and lure), harpoons, lobster pots, and all raw free-to-play fish. In the Heroes' Quest, Gerrant teaches the player how to make an oily fishing rod.

label: Gerrant's Fishy Business.
title: Gerrant's Fishy Business.
lead:
Gerrant's Fishy Business is located in Port Sarim. The shop sells Fishing supplies. It is run by Gerrant.

Near the back of the store there is a white apron respawn, potentially useful for those doing the Pirate's Treasure quest.

label: Gertrude
title: Gertrude
lead:
Gertrude Fairweather is a woman living in a house just west of Varrock. She is the starting point for both the Gertrude's Cat and Ratcatchers quests. She has four sons: Wilough, Shilop, Philop, and Kanel. Her husband, Walter Fairweather, is a travelling merchant, and is not present ingame.

Once your cat has become overgrown, she will sell you kittens for , but keep in mind you can only have one kitten at a time. When you have a normal cat in your inventory or in your bank, she won't give you a kitten. If you store your normal cats in your POH, she will sell you a new kitten. The colour of the kitten is random unless you have an activated ring of charos, then you will be able to charm Gertrude into letting you choose the colour of the kitten. Doing so the first time completes a medium Varrock Diary task.

label: Gertrude's Cat
title: Gertrude's Cat
lead: Gertrude's Cat is a short quest in which you have to find Fluffs, a lost pet cat owned by Gertrude. Completion of the quest allows you to adopt a feline companion of your very own.

label: Gertrude's cat (NPC)
title: Gertrude's cat (NPC)
lead:
Fluffs is a cat that belongs to Gertrude, and is the cat that a player must find for her within the Gertrude's Cat quest. After the quest has been completed, she can be seen in the Varrock Rat Pits or up the ladder in the Lumber Yard. According to Gertrude, she is the mother of all the kittens players can buy from her.

*If you have a cat or kitten within your bank and you talk to her it can lead to her scratching you, dealing 3 damage.
*If you use milk and fish (with the exception of cooked fish or tuna and trout) or any other type of food with Fluffs, she will eagerly devour it.
*If you speak to Fluffs while having a kitten/cat following you, they will briefly converse.

label: ghost
title: ghost
lead:
A ghost is an undead monster that is found in various places and dungeons. As they are undead, Crumble Undead and the salve amulet work well on them. Ghosts are rarely used for training, because they drop nothing in most locations.

Players must kill ghosts in Melzar's Maze to progress through a level of the maze. The ghosts in Melzar's Maze can be spoken to with a Ghostspeak amulet; their speech hints that they were victims of Elvarg the dragon.

label: Ghost's skull
title: Ghost's skull
lead:
The ghost's skull is a quest item used only in The Restless Ghost. It is found in the Wizards' Tower basement by searching the altar.

After searching the altar a skeleton will appear. Killing it is optional, and the player may run if desired. Putting the skull back into the restless ghost's coffin will complete the quest.

label: GPDT employee
title: GPDT employee
lead:
GPDT employees are, as suggested by their names, employees of the Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team, the only known postal service on Gielinor. They are involved with the Tribal Totem quest.

GPDT employees can be found south of the southern bank in East Ardougne.

label: Ghost (Grave of Scorpius)
title: Ghost (Grave of Scorpius)
lead: Several ghosts can be found near the Grave of Scorpius, where the Spirit of Scorpius can also be found. These ghosts can be talked to, even without wearing a ghostspeak amulet. Talking to them will cause them to say "We are waiting for you to join us.", and then attack the player.

label: Ghost (Melzar's Maze)
title: Ghost (Melzar's Maze)
lead:
A room full of ghosts can be found on the of Melzar's Maze. They must be killed in order to obtain the orange key, which can unlock the orange doors and progress through the maze.

The orange key is always dropped by the hooded ghost with no cape, and will never be dropped by the other ghosts.

label: Ghostspeak amulet
title: Ghostspeak amulet
lead:
A ghostspeak amulet is an item worn in the neck slot that enables the wearer to talk to ghosts. Partial completion of The Restless Ghost is required to obtain the item, as it is given to players by Father Urhney in order to speak to the ghost haunting the Lumbridge graveyard during the quest. Normally players can only get one ghostspeak amulet as Father Urhney will not give an amulet to players who have one in their possession, although the drop trick can be used to obtain more.

An enchanted ghostspeak amulet is given to players by the old crone in order to control Necrovarus during the Ghosts Ahoy quest.

label: Gianne dough
title: Gianne dough
lead: Gianne dough is an ingredient in gnome cooking used to make gnomebowls, gnome crunchies, and gnome battas. It can be bought from Hudo in the Grand Tree. Gianne dough cannot be cooked by itself; instead, players must use the dough on a crunchy tray, batta tin, or gnomebowl mould and then precook it on a range. It was probably named after Aluft Gianne snr., the gnome cook. 100 Gianne dough is also given as a reward for completing the Gnome Restaurant training.

label: Gianne's cook book
title: Gianne's cook book
lead:
Gianne's cook book is a cook book written by Aluft Gianne. It is full of Gnome recipes, and useful for the Gnome Restaurant minigame, or if players want to make gnome foods for themselves.

The cook book can be obtained from Aluft Gianne himself, Hudo the nearby grocer, or from the bookcase in a player-owned house. The book will not be available in your bookcase until completing the cooking tutorial with Aluft Gianne snr.. It mentions Pukkamay, a great Gnome cook.

label: Gianne's Restaurant
title: Gianne's Restaurant
lead:
Gianne's Restaurant is a food store located on the west side of the of the Grand Tree, owned by Aluft Gianne snr. and operated by the Gnome Waiters. It sells premade gnome food, which cannot be used for the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

All food bought from the restaurant can be combo eaten. This mechanic is shared with the cooked karambwan.

label: Giant bat
title: Giant bat
lead:
Giant bats are relatively low-level flying monsters found throughout dungeons and across the surface of Gielinor. Despite them being generally weak monsters they may sometimes pose a threat to players due to their aggressiveness toward any players level 54 or lower. Giant bats can be used as a slightly higher-level alternative for regular Bats for Slayer assignments.

Notably, the bats in Arceuus and around the Dark Altar are not aggressive to players, making it safe to traverse the area and craft runes at the nearby altars even at a low combat level.

label: Giant bat (Iban's Temple)
title: Giant bat (Iban's Temple)
lead: Giant bats are decorative NPCs that fly around Iban's Temple in the final area of the Underground Pass. Unlike regular giant bats, these ones are not monsters and can not be attacked.

label: Giant carp
title: Giant carp
lead:
Giant carp are a type of fish that restores 6 Hitpoints when eaten. They can be obtained by cooking a raw giant carp on a fire or cooking range, giving no Cooking experience. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt fish. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Giant carp is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 45, or 41 when using the Lumbridge range.

Raw giant carp can only be caught as part of the Fishing Contest quest before receiving the fishing trophy during the quest. Level 10 Fishing is required, along with a fishing rod and red vine worms for bait — the latter can be dug up in McGrubor's Wood with a spade.

label: Giant crystal
title: Giant crystal
lead:
Giant crystal is a large crystal that Merlin is trapped in. Merlin is freed from the crystal by the player during the Merlin's Crystal quest.

The crystal remains after the quest, and attempting to smash it again will give the message You have already freed Merlin from the giant crystal.

label: giant rat
title: giant rat
lead:
Giant rats are common, low-levelled monsters. They can often be found in swamps and sewers, and are sometimes killed by low-levelled players training their Combat skills as they are weak and can be easily found around Lumbridge and Varrock.

One of two giant rats found near Damis during Desert Treasure I can be used to safespot him by luring Damis and the other aggressive monsters behind it, making the fight considerably easier.

label: Giant rat (Tutorial Island)
title: Giant rat (Tutorial Island)
lead:
Giant rats are a variant of giant rats used exclusively on Tutorial Island. They are the first monster a player will defeat in Old School RuneScape, as Vannaka will task them with defeating one.

Two variants of Tutorial Island giant rats exist in the cache but are not used in-game. Another variant was used for an alternate version of Tutorial Island available to some players in 2020.

label: giant spider
title: giant spider
lead: Giant spiders are very large spiders most commonly seen around Lumbridge.

label: Gielinor
title: Gielinor
lead:
Gielinor ( ) is the fictional world in which Old School RuneScape takes place. It was discovered and given its name by Guthix. It is orbited by a single moon, which is the realm of Zanaris.

Two of its continents, the mainland and Zeah, are accessible to players. Five of its nine oceans, along with parts of a sixth ocean, are accessible through the Sailing skill.

label: Gielinor Guide
title: Gielinor Guide
lead:
The Gielinor Guide (formerly RuneScape Guide) is the first non-player character (NPC) that players meet in the game. He is found in his house on Tutorial Island. He gives a brief but informative chat about the game.

At this NPC, a player is required to choose their character's looks.
These include:
*Body type
*Hair style / colour
*Body style / colour
*Legs style / colour
*Arms style
*Feet style / colour (brown or black)

label: Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team
title: Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team
lead:
The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team (GPDT) is an organisation that specialises in delivering things. According to Wizard Cromperty, their motto is "We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us".

It is the only known postal service in Gielinor with a branch located in East Ardougne; it is south of the eastern bank. The building is scattered with boxes used in Tribal Totem quest. Their employees are extremely inefficient, as they forget to deliver a lot of their packages.

label: gilded totem
title: gilded totem
lead:
The gilded totem is a quest item obtained during the Legends' Quest quest. At the very start of the quest, the player is asked to get one from the inhabitants of Kharazi Jungle by Radimus Erkle so that it may be displayed it in the main hall of the Legends' Guild.

Gujuo of the Kharazi tribe rewards the player with the gilded totem after they successfully carve a Yommi totem and replace the corrupted totem after defeating the demon Nezikchened. After completing the quest, the gilded totem, now displayed in the Legends' Guild as the totem pole, can be used to recharge the Skills necklace and the Combat bracelet by using them on the totem pole.

label: Giles
title: Giles
lead: Giles is the brother of Miles and Niles. Like his brothers, he may appear to initiate the Certer random event, in which he will ask players to identify an item, such as a fish, with three possible choices of what the object is. If the player correctly identifies the item, Giles will give the player a reward of either coins, a gem (uncut, up to diamond), a cosmic talisman, a half key, a spinach roll, or a kebab.

label: gin
title: gin
lead:
Gin is an alcoholic drink used in making gnome cocktails. It heals 5 hitpoints, increases a player's Strength by 5% + 1, and decreases Attack by 2% + 3 when drunk.

It can be found at Blurberry's bar in the Grand Tree and Jossik's shop in the Lighthouse.

label: Glarial's amulet
title: Glarial's amulet
lead:
Glarial's amulet is used during the Waterfall Quest to grant access to the Waterfall Dungeon. Attempting to enter the dungeon during the quest without the amulet results in the player taking damage, being swept away to downstream from the door. After the quest, the amulet is not needed to enter the dungeon.

The amulet can be recovered in the western chest inside Glarial's Tomb if lost. Players may enter the tomb by having Glarial's pebble and having no armour, weapons, or runes equipped or in their inventory. Beware of the moss guardians in the tomb. Players may obtain more than one amulet through the drop trick.

label: Glarial's pebble
title: Glarial's pebble
lead:
Glarial's pebble is an item used in the Waterfall Quest and Roving Elves. It is given to the player by Golrie as a reward for freeing him from the dungeon under the Tree Gnome Village. If you lose this pebble all you have to do is go back to Golrie to obtain another.

The pebble is used to gain access to the Glarial's Tomb dungeon near the Baxtorian Falls. Note that in order to enter the dungeon, the player may not be carrying weapons, armour, runes, or various other items. See the Glarial's Tomb page for a more comprehensive list of disallowed items.

label: Glarial's Tomb
title: Glarial's Tomb
lead:
Glarial's Tomb is a dungeon underneath the tombstone near the Baxtorian Falls and the Kingdom of Kandarin. To enter, the player needs Glarial's pebble, which is obtained during the Waterfall Quest, and must not have any weapons, armour or runes either equipped or in their inventory. Level 84 moss guardians roam here.

The location is close to the Fishing Guild; use Glarial's pebble on her tombstone and you may enter. Players can get Glarial's amulet in the west chest. This location can be re-entered after the Waterfall Quest has been completed in order to obtain Glarial's amulet once again.

label: Glarial's tomb (scenery)
title: Glarial's tomb (scenery)
lead: Glarial's tomb is found within Glarial's Tomb, the player searches the tomb during Waterfall Quest to retrieve Glarial's urn.

label: Glarial's Tombstone
title: Glarial's Tombstone
lead:
Glarial's tombstone is a gravestone that serves as the entrance to Glarial's Tomb. The door can only be opened by using Glarial's pebble on it. It is located north-west of the Fishing Guild.

The tomb is involved in the Waterfall Quest and Roving Elves.

label: Glarial's urn
title: Glarial's urn
lead: Glarial's urn is an item used in the Waterfall Quest and has no known use after the quest. The urn can obtained by searching the tomb in the Glarial's tomb. After the completion of the Waterfall Quest, the urn becomes empty.

label: Glass Box
title: Glass Box
lead:
Glass Box is one of four Mime emotes unlocked as a Random event reward.

Upon completing a Mime event, players are returned to their previous location in game, with a new mime emote unlocked. Players cannot choose which of the four emotes unlock since this is random.

label: Glass Wall
title: Glass Wall
lead:
Glass Wall is one of four Mime emotes unlocked upon completing a Mime event. After the event, players are returned to their previous location with a random new mime emote unlocked.

Upon use the player pretends to be behind a glass wall.

label: Glassblowing pipe
title: Glassblowing pipe
lead: A glassblowing pipe is a tool used to make items from molten glass using the Crafting skill. It is required to make glass items. The item can be obtained from Fritz the Glassblower's house found in the south-western area of Entrana, taken from a tool store 3 in a player-owned house (required 35 Construction), from Grandpa Jack's house (from Fishing Contest quest), bought from the Piscatoris Fishing Colony after finishing Swan Song, or bought from charter ship locations (from the crew).

label: Glough
title: Glough
lead:
Glough ( ) is an ill-natured, misanthropic gnome who attempts to start a war against the humans. In The Grand Tree quest, he can be found in his house up a ladder just south-east of the ramp leading to the Grand Tree.

Glough's schemes are thwarted in The Grand Tree quest, and once again in Monkey Madness I. He was originally the head tree guardian of the Tree Gnome Stronghold until his first plot was thwarted by the player. He makes his first unsuccessful attempt on the player's life when he summons a black demon to kill them in The Grand Tree, and is indirectly responsible for the second attempt in Monkey Madness I, where he provides a powerful spell and a Jungle Demon to Awowogei, which is used in an attempt to trap the 10th Squad, but is defeated by the player. During Monkey Madness II, the player manages to break the alliance between Glough and the monkeys by sabotaging Awowogei's forces, along with his alliance between the ogres and trolls. Becoming increasingly deranged and desperate, Glough launches an attack on the Grand Tree by himself. He eventually meets his end at the hands of the player after a great skirmish, but not before killing Nieve.

label: Glough's journal
title: Glough's journal
lead:
Glough's journal is found during The Grand Tree quest by searching a cupboard within Glough's house. The journal looks a little deeper into the mind and motives of Glough the gnome. It's used as a key piece of evidence as to what he's planning.

After finishing the quest, the book can be found on the shelves in your house.

label: Glough's key
title: Glough's key
lead:
Glough's key is an item used during The Grand Tree quest. It opens a chest in Glough's home just south of the Grand Tree. The player finds invasion plans in the chest which can then be shown to King Narnode Shareen as evidence.

Players obtain this item by talking to Anita in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Her home is in the north-west of the stronghold, just west of the swamp. The key has no use after the quest.

label: glowing dagger
title: glowing dagger
lead:
The glowing dagger is a quest item obtained and used during the Legends' Quest. It has the same combat stats as an iron dagger, only lacking the +4 strength bonus.

It is created when players are given the dark dagger by Echned Zekin, requesting them to kill Viyeldi because he was the one that murdered him and wants revenge. Once the dagger is used to kill Viyeldi, it will convert into a glowing dagger. It must then be taken back to Echned Zekin, who will reveal his true form - the demon Nezikchened.

label: Glyphs
title: Glyphs
lead: Glyphs are pieces of scenery found in almost every house in Al Kharid. The symbols depict ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs, but have no relation to any Kharidian lore. They can only be examined.

label: gnome
title: gnome
lead:
Gnomes are a race of small humanoids found in various parts of Gielinor. They can be found primarily in the Kandarin region, being most common in the Tree Gnome Village, Tree Gnome Stronghold, and Battlefield of Khazard. Gnomes fight with primarily either ranged or melee attacks, depending on the weapon they wield. They have different coloured hoods.

Gnomes can be pickpocketed at level 75 Thieving yielding 133.3 Thieving experience. It is a good source of medium clue scrolls, but keep in mind that you will not receive a clue from pickpocketing an NPC if your inventory is full, and you have not completed X Marks the Spot. If you have completed X Marks the Spot and obtained at least one scroll box in your inventory, then you will continue to obtain more to your stack without emptying your inventory of other loot. Pickpocketing gnomes can also be very convenient for those doing Gnome Restaurant, so you do not need to leave to get more king worms or toad legs.

label: Gnome amulet
title: Gnome amulet
lead:
The gnome amulet is awarded to players by King Bolren after completion of the Tree Gnome Village quest. Should the player happen to lose the amulet, another can be obtained for free from King Bolren. It is made from the same material as the orbs of protection that are retrieved during the quest.

It functions as a melee-only amulet of defence, having +13 in all melee defences but no magic and ranged defence. For melee-only situations, this amulet is recommended over the amulet of defence.

label: Gnome Ball
title: Gnome Ball
lead:
Gnome Ball is a minigame in which one or more players attempt to score goals against gnomes. Goals are scored by throwing the gnomeball into the goal, and the game is won when five goals are scored. Players earn some Ranged and Agility experience upon scoring a goal and winning the game.

When a player first enters the field, they should talk to the gnome ball referee to gain the ball.

label: Gnome ball referee
title: Gnome ball referee
lead: The Gnome ball referee runs the members-only Gnome Ball minigame.

label: Gnome baller
title: Gnome baller
lead:
Gnome Ballers are gnomes found in the Tree Gnome Stronghold Gnome Ball pitch. While competing in Gnome Ball, the gnome ballers may try to tackle and take possession of the ball. The gnome ballers have a Tackle option which, when successful, knocks them to the ground and recovers possession of the ball.

The chance of getting successfully tackled by a gnome baller is dependent on a player's Agility level, but is not influenced by the colour of the uniform worn by a gnome baller. In contrast, the chance of tackling a gnome baller as a player depends on a number of factors, as described in the section below.

label: Gnome banker
title: Gnome banker
lead: Gnome bankers run the Tree Gnome Stronghold branch of the Bank of Gielinor.

label: Gnome child
title: Gnome child
lead:
Gnome children are young gnomes found in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Like adult gnomes, they can be killed or pickpocketed. All of them use melee unlike their adult counterparts.

Gnome children can be pickpocketed at level 75 Thieving; doing so yields 133.5 Thieving experience. It is recommended not to pickpocket them until the player has level 85 Thieving, because even with gloves of silence, the player will fail most of the time.

label: gnome glider
title: gnome glider
lead:
Gnome gliders are a method of transportation available after completing The Grand Tree quest. They can fly to many locations and can be used in combination with teleport spells, spirit trees, and the fairy ring network to quickly travel across Gielinor.

The fastest way to access the glider network is by either taking the royal seed pod and climbing up to the top floor with the right-click option (requiring Monkey Madness II, takes approximately 10 seconds), or using a ring of dueling to teleport to Emir's Arena and running south-west (takes approximately 13 seconds).

label: Gnome goal
title: Gnome goal
lead: The Gnome goal is the target for the Gnome Ball minigame. Shooting and making a goal will give the player's team a point.

label: Gnome guard
title: Gnome guard
lead: Gnome guards are gnome warriors in and around the Tree Gnome Stronghold, including in the Grand Tree. They have either a halberd or a sword and shield equipped. They have relatively high Hitpoints for their level and their attacks aren't very accurate.

label: Gnome King
title: Gnome King
lead: Gnome King is a music track that is unlocked in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

label: Gnome Maze
title: Gnome Maze
lead:
The gnome maze is a large hedge maze that makes up the exterior part of the Tree Gnome Village. The maze must be solved at least once in order to start the Tree Gnome Village quest.

After the first completion, Elkoy will be available as an escort through the maze both to and from the village, although only if players have started the quest. The maze is also involved in other quests, such as Waterfall Quest (where the player enters the maze dungeon) and Regicide.

label: Gnome pilot (historical)
title: Gnome pilot (historical)
lead: Gnome pilots were gnomes who could originally be found piloting the gnome gliders. With the release of the revamped Gnome Restaurant minigame, they were replaced by four updated pilots with unique names on 7 August 2006. However, one pilot remained at the crashed glider west of the Digsite, until he too was replaced by an embarrassed Captain Errdo in a hidden update in January 2007. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Gnome shop keeper
title: Gnome shop keeper
lead:
The Gnome shop keeper is an unused character who was added to the game during the RuneScape 2 beta. Presumably, he would have been a generic character in the Tree Gnome Stronghold or Tree Gnome Village, similar to the Gnome banker. He has a very similar appearance to Bolkoy, who runs the general store in the Tree Gnome Village.

The character was not added to the game since every gnome shop is run by a unique character. Most likely, he was scrapped relatively early on due to lacking any interaction options.

label: gnome spice
title: gnome spice
lead:
Gnome Spice is an ingredient used to make spicy sauce and certain gnome foods. It can be bought from Grand Tree Groceries, run by Hudo in the Grand Tree. It will never run out while making Gnome foods.

To create spicy sauce, gnome spice is used with chopped garlic. This uses up the gnome spice.

label: Gnome Statue (Port Khazard mine)
title: Gnome Statue (Port Khazard mine)
lead: This gnome statue is a scenery object found south of the Port Khazard mine. Players cannot interact with the statue, but they can examine it.

label: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course
title: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course
lead:
The Tree Gnome Stronghold Agility Course is an Agility course in which the player must traverse obstacles consisting of a log balance, obstacle nets, tightropes, and pipes. It is located south of the Grand Tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, which is north-west of East Ardougne. This Agility course is the lowest level course that can be accessed and has no requirements. It is impossible to fail any of the obstacles at this course, so it is not necessary to bring any food. Players gain 110.5 experience points for a complete circuit, and can receive marks of grace during this course.

Completing a lap of the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course is a requirement for the easy Western Provinces Diary.

label: Gnome Stronghold north bank
title: Gnome Stronghold north bank
lead:
The Gnome Stronghold north bank, also known as the Grand Tree bank, is a bank found on the second level of the Grand Tree, in the Gnome Stronghold. Players do not need to have completed The Grand Tree to enter the stronghold or use the bank.

The Grand Tree bank is popular for players teleporting from the Wilderness with a royal seed pod, as the pod takes them just one level below. There is also a loot chest, which player-killers use to cash in loot keys from players they killed.

label: Gnome Stronghold south bank
title: Gnome Stronghold south bank
lead:
The Gnome Stronghold south bank, also known as the Stronghold Cave bank or the Nieve bank, is a bank found in the southern part of the Gnome Stronghold. Players do not need to have completed The Grand Tree to enter the stronghold or use the bank.

The Nieve bank is popular for players using the nearby Stronghold Slayer Cave, as well as for players restocking during farm runs.

label: Gnome trainer
title: Gnome trainer
lead: Gnome trainers are rather unfriendly gnomes that shout insults at players training agility at the agility course in the Tree Gnome Stronghold such as "My granny is faster than you!"

label: Gnome troop
title: Gnome troop
lead:
Gnome troops are soldiers of the Gnome Army found on the Khazard Battlefield and within the Tree Gnome Stronghold. At Khazard Battlefield, they can be found swamping the Khazard troopers most of the time. When they are attacking or being attacked by Khazard troopers, they will say phrases such as "You will never get us without a fight!" and "Tally ho!"

While in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, they have a Talk-to option, and will talk to players about the Khazard Battlefield and ask to join them in their cause.

label: Gnome Village 2
title: Gnome Village 2
lead: Gnome Village 2 is a music track that is unlocked in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

label: gnome waiter
title: gnome waiter
lead:
Gnome Waiters run the shop Gianne's Restaurant that sells premade gnome cuisine, such as crunchies, battas and gnomebowls. The food they sell cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. They are located on the of the Grand Tree north of the bank.

They seem to be sad about the food being made by a human assistant chef, as it was not up to the Chef's exacting standards, and claims the food may not be accepted as the 'real' thing, which is true, as premade food cannot be used when doing Gnome Restaurant.

label: Gnome winger
title: Gnome winger
lead: Gnome wingers are found in the Gnome Ball pitch. They are on the same team as the player, and passing the Gnomeball to them will let them pass it back to you after a few seconds. This could be used to pass some Gnome ballers who will normally try to take possession of the ball.

label: gnome woman
title: gnome woman
lead:
Gnome women are female gnomes that may be found in the Gnome Stronghold. They may be pickpocketed with 75 Thieving; doing so yields 133.5 Thieving experience.

Gnome women will occasionally give the player a King worm when spoken to.

label: Gnomeball
title: Gnomeball
lead:
Gnomeballs are received by winning 5 points in a game of Gnome Ball, from the gnome restaurant minigame, or as a drop from dolphins. With the item in your inventory, you can click "Use" with it, and click another player. If that player has their right hand empty, they will catch the ball, and it will end up in their weapon slot. It is not advised that you throw it to a player you do not know, as they can very easily walk away with it.

Gnomeballs cannot be used on or by Ironman Mode players.

label: Gnomeball (music track)
title: Gnomeball (music track)
lead: Gnomeball is a music track that is unlocked at the Gnome Ball Field.

label: gnomebowl mould
title: gnomebowl mould
lead:
