A gnomebowl mould is an item used in gnome cooking. It can be bought in the Grand Tree by talking to Hudo in the north-west corner on the , or it can be acquired for free by searching the tree gnome kitchen cabinet at the northernmost part of the Grand Tree for a "gnome bowl".

Adding gianne dough to the mould will create a raw gnomebowl, the basis for gnomebowl cooking.

label: goblin
title: goblin
lead:
Goblins are one of the most common, low-level monsters found around Gielinor. They are popularly killed by low-level players training their combat skills.

Goblins are often one of the first monsters a player will encounter, as they inhabit much of the area around Lumbridge.

label: Goblin (historical)
title: Goblin (historical)
lead:
Goblins could originally be found in the Goblin Village and were encountered during the Goblin Diplomacy quest. Twice in 2005 and 2006, goblins were graphically updated and new versions were added. However, the original versions remained in the game cache.

The 2005 versions were graphically updated alongside other goblins in 2007, despite already having been removed from the game. The original versions however were not updated.

label: Goblin Cave
title: Goblin Cave
lead:
The Goblin Cave, known to the goblins as the Plain of Mud, is a dungeon filled with goblins located east of the Fishing Guild and south of Hemenster. Some of its inhabitants are aggressive no matter what level you are.

The cave contains the entrance to the Goblin Temple, built by goblin tribes for Bandos during the Fourth Age after the Battle of Plain of Mud.

label: Goblin Diplomacy
title: Goblin Diplomacy
lead: Goblin Diplomacy is the 15 th quest released in RuneScape. During the quest, the player resolves a long-standing dispute among the goblins of Goblin Village.

label: Goblin guard
title: Goblin guard
lead: The Goblin guard (known as Sleeping guard before being woken up) is a level 42 goblin with 43 hitpoints, who is guarding the kitchen gate in the dungeon near the Observatory. During the Observatory Quest players must "prod" him to wake him up, he then attacks the player while saying "Oi, how dare you wake me up!". He can be fought after the quest is complete as he respawns in the same place.

label: Goblin kitchen key
title: Goblin kitchen key
lead:
The goblin kitchen key is a quest item in the Observatory Quest. It found in a chest in the Observatory Dungeon and is used to open the Kitchen gate in the same dungeon. The chest in which the key is found is different for every player, but remains the same once found. Attempting to obtain another from the chest while one is in the inventory yields the message: Another one will be of little use. However, it is possible to obtain duplicates if it is banked. It can be reobtained after the quest.

It cannot be added to the key ring.

label: goblin mail
title: goblin mail
lead:
Goblin mail is armour for goblins. Although this item has the "Wear" option, this item cannot be equipped by players as it is too small to fit humans. However, during the Land of the Goblins quest, the player can turn into a goblin using a transmogrification potion and wear the goblin mail.

It can be dyed into various colours, in which certain colours are used for the Land of the Goblins quest.

label: Goblin settlement
title: Goblin settlement
lead:
The Goblin settlement can be found in the ruins east of the Observatory, and is home to a number of named Goblins. During the Observatory Quest, the Observatory professor tells the player that the goblins have been causing trouble in the region, and have stolen parts from the Observatory.

The goblin settlement also has one of the entrances to the Observatory Dungeon, which is similarly overrun by goblins.

label: Goblin Village
title: Goblin Village
lead: Goblin Village is the main settlement of goblins in Asgarnia. The Goblin Village is ruled by two generals, General Bentnoze and General Wartface, whose differences cause the village to fall into conflict and its inhabitants to attack each other. The only entrance to Goblin Village is from the south, along the path that runs from the gate to Taverley. To enter the village, take the path north of Doric's hut.

label: Goblin Village (music track)
title: Goblin Village (music track)
lead: Goblin Village is a music track that is unlocked at the Goblin Village. It has a tribe-ish, simple tune to emphasise to primitiveness of the goblins. The track is quoted in several other music tracks, such as Bandos Battalion.

label: Godric
title: Godric
lead:
Godric is the son of Dunstan, Burthorpe's local blacksmith and is a soldier in the Imperial Guard.

After the player finds an alternate route up the Death Plateau in the Death Plateau quest, the Imperial Guard uses it to plan a surprise attack on the trolls. However, they encounter resistance from the trolls in the area and their forces are decimated. Some of the Guard just escape with their lives. Godric isn't so lucky and is taken prisoner by the trolls to their Stronghold next to Trollheim, where they plan to make him part of their stew. The Troll Stronghold quest centres in the player rescuing Godric from the clutches of the trolls. The player can free him and a strange hermit known as Eadgar from the Stronghold. After their rescue, they take different paths: Godric returns to Burthorpe, while Eadgar returns to his cave at the top of Trollheim. He resumes his training with the Imperial Guard and is promoted to corporal.

label: Gold amulet
title: Gold amulet
lead:
Gold amulet is a piece of jewellery that is worn in the neck slot. It is made by using a gold bar on a furnace with an amulet mould, followed by using a ball of wool on the resulting Gold amulet (u). This requires level 8 Crafting and the player receives 30 experience for making the amulet and an additional 4 experience for stringing it.

The gold amulet cannot be enchanted, making it purely cosmetic. However, it can be sold to Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim for 245 coins or at the Grand Exchange.

label: Gold amulet (u)
title: Gold amulet (u)
lead:
A Gold amulet (u) is made with the Crafting skill by using a gold bar on a furnace while carrying an amulet mould. Following that, it can be strung with a ball of wool, resulting in a strung gold amulet. Making a gold amulet (u) requires level 8 Crafting and players gain 30 experience for making the amulet, and then 4 experience for stringing it.

Unlike gem amulets, gold amulets cannot be enchanted, making them purely cosmetic.

label: gold bar
title: gold bar
lead:
A gold bar is a bar of refined gold created through the Smithing skill at level 40 by using a gold ore with a furnace, or by casting Superheat Item on it. By default, this gives 22.5 Smithing experience per bar, but if the goldsmith gauntlets from the Family Crest quest are worn, the experience given is boosted to 56.2.

The primary use of gold bars is to create jewellery through the Crafting skill. To craft gold bars into jewellery, players must use a gold bar on a furnace with the proper mould in their inventory. If players wish to craft jewellery with gems inset, they must also have the respective cut gems.

label: gold bowl
title: gold bowl
lead:
The gold bowl is a quest item used during the Legends' Quest. According to Gujuo, the required vessel for holy water is a bowl "made from the metal of the sun", referring to gold. The bowl is made by using two gold bars on an anvil while holding the sketch given to the player by Gujuo; after completion of the quest, it is possible to make the bowl without the sketch, though there remains a chance of failing. This gives 30 Smithing experience per bowl. The bowl must then be blessed with Gujuo's help to turn it into a blessed gold bowl. The blessed version is the only vessel capable of holding water with holy properties; trying to fill a normal gold bowl with the pure spring's water will yield a message along the lines of having mere normal water. A successful fill will result in a message saying that "the water seems to bubble and sparkle as if alive."

There is a chance that the player will fail in making the gold bowl, causing one or two gold bars to be destroyed without a resultant bowl. When successfully made, 30 Smithing experience is gained and a message of the achievement appears in the chat box.

label: Gold necklace
title: Gold necklace
lead:
The gold necklace is a piece of gold jewellery.

It has no stats and cannot be enchanted, making it purely cosmetic. However, it can be sold for 45-315 coins to Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim, depending on how many he already has.

label: gold ore
title: gold ore
lead:
Gold ore can be mined from gold rocks at level 40 Mining, providing 65 Mining experience. After it is mined, it takes 60 seconds to regenerate. Gold ore is used to smelt gold bars at a furnace. Smelting a gold bar gives 22.5 Smithing experience, or 56.2 with goldsmith gauntlets equipped. The bar can then be used again on a furnace to craft various types of jewellery, with sufficient Crafting skill, and an appropriate mould. An anvil is only used to make a gold helmet, and golden bowl for the quests Between a Rock... and Legends' Quest respectively.

A frequently occurring item, gold ore can be acquired through various means, beyond mining. It can be bought from shops, obtained from monster drops and pick-pocketing, as a reward from a variety of chests and reward crates, through the Gnome Restaurant and Volcanic Mine minigames, and can also be obtained by handing in nuggets to Terry Balando at the Digsite.

label: Gold ring
title: Gold ring
lead:
A gold ring can be worn in the ring slot, but does not give bonuses and does not provide any functions to the player, teleports or otherwise. Like all rings, they are not visible on player characters. They can be sold for up to coins to Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim.

Gold rings can be obtained as a reward from the Casket from the Pirate's Treasure quest, as a possible reward from the Capt' Arnav's Chest random event, from bird nests, from salvaging, or from crafting.

label: gold rocks
title: gold rocks
lead:
Gold rocks are a type of rock that contains gold ore; a Mining level of 40 or higher is required to mine them, granting 65 Mining experience for each ore mined. Once mined, a gold rock takes about a minute to respawn.

The Arzinian Mine, after completing Between a Rock..., and Crafting Guild, after completing the Hard Falador Diary, are the ideal places to mine gold.

label: golden bowl
title: golden bowl
lead:
The golden bowl is a quest item used during the Legends' Quest. It is made by first smithing a gold bowl from 2 gold bars, granting 30 Smithing exp, and then giving it to Gujuo in the Kharazi Jungle to bless it, making it into a blessed gold bowl. The player must then head to the pond in the middle of the jungle, cut a hollow reed by using a machete on the tall reeds next to the pond, and use the reed on the pond to turn the bowl into a golden bowl containing sacred pure water.

Note: Filling an unblessed gold bowl from the Kharazi water pool will also create a golden bowl, but the examine information will reveal that the water is pure but no longer sacred. Filling a gold bowl or a blessed gold bowl with plain water from some other water source will likewise cause it to be renamed a golden bowl, but the examine information will reveal that the water is only plain water.

label: Golden candle
title: Golden candle
lead:
A golden candle is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a candle (extinguished) on the north-west Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It serves no purpose in the quest, and has no uses outside the quest, as it cannot be used as a light source in a dark area. However, players can cast Low Alchemy or High alchemy on it.

label: Golden feather (Priest in Peril)
title: Golden feather (Priest in Peril)
lead:
A Golden feather is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a feather on the east Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It serves no purpose in the quest, and has no uses outside the quest, as it cannot be used in Fishing or Fletching. However, players can cast Low Alchemy or High alchemy on it.

label: Golden hammer
title: Golden hammer
lead:
A golden hammer is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a hammer on the north Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It serves no purpose in the quest, and has no uses outside the quest, as it cannot be used in Smithing, Construction, or for opening the Bandos door in the God Wars Dungeon. However, players can cast Low Alchemy or High alchemy on it.

label: Golden key
title: Golden key
lead:
The golden key is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is dropped by a hooded Level 30 Monk of Zamorak in the Paterdomus Temple.

It is used to open the first gate under Paterdomus after killing the Temple Guardian and then it is exchanged for the iron key by using it on the southern monument (the one referencing to "Saradomin being the key"). After unlocking the first gate for the first time, it is not required to be in the inventory to open the gate again.

label: Golden needle
title: Golden needle
lead:
A golden needle is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a needle on the south Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It serves no purpose in the quest, and has no uses outside the quest, as it cannot be used in Crafting. However, players can cast Low Alchemy or High Alchemy on it.

label: Golden pot
title: Golden pot
lead:
A golden pot is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a pot on the west Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It serves no purpose in the quest, and has no uses outside the quest, as it cannot be used for storing any materials. However, players can cast Low Alchemy or High alchemy on it.

label: Golden tinderbox
title: Golden tinderbox
lead:
A golden tinderbox is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a tinderbox on the south-east Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It serves no purpose in the quest, and has no uses outside the quest, as it cannot be used for lighting fires. However, players can cast Low or High Level Alchemy on it.

label: Goldsmith gauntlets
title: Goldsmith gauntlets
lead:
Goldsmith gauntlets are one of the three possible glove rewards from Family Crest quest, along with Chaos gauntlets and Cooking gauntlets. They can be obtained by bringing the magical steel gauntlets (along with 25,000 coins) to Avan, who can be found in the Al Kharid mine (no cost if the gauntlets are still steel). The message "Avan takes your gauntlets, takes out a small hammer, and pounds them into a slightly new shape, then hands them to you." appears as this happens. The Goldsmith gauntlets increase the experience gained from smelting gold ore into a gold bar, from 22.5 to 56.2 experience — about 2.5 times as much as without the gauntlets.

Casting the Superheat Item spell on a gold ore while wearing the gauntlets gives 56.2 Smithing experience and 53 Magic experience.

label: Golem (unused NPC)
title: Golem (unused NPC)
lead: The Golem is a cut race originally added during the RuneScape 2 beta. Although it was never added to the game, their appearance was reused for the Rock golem random event, while the concept was later recycled for the Clay golem.

label: Golrie
title: Golrie
lead:
Golrie is a gnome found in the jail of the Tree Gnome Village dungeon. He is the grandson of King Bolrie and grand-nephew of King Bolren. He locked himself in a room to avoid some hobgoblins, but managed to leave the key to unlock the door elsewhere, outside the room. He was not planning on leaving until the hobgoblins departed, but does ask the player to help him solve his dilemma in the Waterfall Quest.

The key can be located by searching some crates on the east side of the dungeon, the crate is on the east side of the room as you first enter, and it is slightly a different colour than the others.

label: Gorad
title: Gorad
lead:
Gorad is an ogre who lives on an island north of Feldip Hills. He is killed during the Watchtower quest. He always drops the Ogre tooth required to get the second part of the Ogre relic. Upon killing Gorad, the Ogre tooth appears in your inventory and not on the ground, so you must have an empty inventory space to receive it.

Should you speak with him and insult him at any point outside the quest section for the ogre tooth, he will deal 12 damage upon the dialogue's completion (Note: if lacking sufficient hitpoints, the damage will kill you!)

label: Gossip
title: Gossip
lead: The Gossip starts the King's Ransom quest and is partially involved with Murder Mystery. He does not talk much to players. During King's Ransom, he provides important background history on the Sinclair family, as well as Anna Sinclair. He can be found just around the guard you speak to in Murder Mystery. When you speak to him in Murder Mystery, he will tell you that he saw a poison salesman who came in the village and gave a huge sale on poison to the family.

label: Goutweed Crate
title: Goutweed Crate
lead: Goutweed Crates are crates that can be searched to obtain the herb Goutweed. The crates are located in the Goutweed store accessed from the stairs going down from the Troll kitchen, located within the Troll Stronghold.

label: Grail bell
title: Grail bell
lead:
The grail bell is a quest item in the Holy Grail quest. It spawns just outside of castle in the Fisher Realm. When the bell is rung near the castle, a message will appear in the chatbox saying "Somehow you are now inside the castle." and the player will enter the castle.

Only one can be owned at a time; players cannot obtain another bell after completing the quest.

label: Grail Maiden
title: Grail Maiden
lead:
Grail Maidens are women who serve the Holy Grail. They can only be found in Grail Castle in the Fisher Realm.

They play a minor part in the Holy Grail quest, where they let the player inside the Fisher King's castle when the bell is rung.

label: grain
title: grain
lead:
Grain is obtained by picking from wheat fields growing in many places in RuneScape. They are also dropped by goblins and imps. It is used for Cooking. Six grain can be given to nearby gardeners to watch over flax grown in a hops patch.

One quick way is to get grain next to the hops patch in Yanille and go east to the bank in Yanille. Another is to use the canoe transport system on the River Lum. One could take the canoe to the Champions' Guild wheat field, then fill their inventory, then return to Edgeville to bank the wheat using the canoe. The wheat fields are also used to access Puro-Puro.

label: Grand Tree
title: Grand Tree
lead:
The Grand Tree, or Ta Quir Priw in gnomish language, is home to a gnome community and is built inside a tree in the north-east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. It contains Blurberry's Bar, Heckel Funch's Shop, Rometti's Fine Fashions, and Gulluck's weapon shop.

The Grand Tree includes two of the three banks in Tree Gnome Stronghold, several shops, and a bar and restaurant. The Gnome Restaurant minigame is on second level, and players who have completed The Grand Tree quest can access the Grand Tree Mine. There is an Agility shortcut north-east of the Grand Tree, which can be very useful for players training barbarian fishing.

label: Grand Tree Groceries
title: Grand Tree Groceries
lead: Grand Tree Groceries is a shop run by Hudo that sells food supplies used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. It is located on the in the north-western corner of the Grand Tree.

label: Grand Tree mine
title: Grand Tree mine
lead:
The Grand Tree mine is an area in the northern part of the Grand Tree Tunnels and is only accessible after The Grand Tree quest. Players can enter the mine after the quest by pushing the roots that block access from the central area. No axe or other equipment is required to push the roots aside.

Within the mine lie two slightly separated mining areas, one to the east and one to the west.

label: Grand Tree Tunnels
title: Grand Tree Tunnels
lead: The Grand Tree Tunnels is a dungeon located beneath the Grand Tree and is only accessible during and after The Grand Tree quest.

label: Grandpa Jack
title: Grandpa Jack
lead:
Grandpa Jack tells the player about his fishing experiences during the quest Fishing Contest, revealing how to win the contest. He lives in the house slightly north-east of Hemenster where a glassblowing pipe respawns.

He will also sell you his "competition winning" fishing rod for 5 coins, however it has no special properties and is just a regular rod.

label: granite shield
title: granite shield
lead:
The granite shield is a shield made of granite. It requires 50 Defence and 50 Strength to equip. It has defensive stats equal to the Toktz-ket-xil, minus the +5 strength bonus, and isn't commonly used for melee combat as a result.

It can be used in place of the rune kiteshield due to its superior ranged defence bonus. However, some players choose not to use it due to its weight and slightly lower melee defence bonuses.

label: Grapes
title: Grapes
lead:
Grapes can be produced through planting grape seeds at the Hosidius Vinery, requiring level 36 in Farming. They are also dropped in noted form by several bosses. They can also be obtained from the Vineyard foreman in Aldarin by harvesting his Grapevines for him.

They are an ingredient for making a jug of wine at level 35 Cooking by using them on a jug of water, which grants 200 Cooking experience when fermented after a short period. If fermentation fails, a jug of bad wine will be created instead. Players stop creating jugs of bad wine when they reach 68 Cooking.

label: Grave marker
title: Grave marker
lead: Grave markers are mostly found in the many graveyards of Gielinor. Players cannot interact with the markers, but they can examine them.

label: Grave of Scorpius
title: Grave of Scorpius
lead:
The Grave of Scorpius, also known as the Shrine of Scorpius, is found south of West Ardougne in some crumbling ruins atop a hill. Here the Spirit of Scorpius lurks around his gravestone. There are also some ghosts, grave scorpions, and dead trees, as well as thirteen bone spawns. The Shrine has a Celtic cross on it. The Ourania Cave (and Ourania Altar) is found north of the grave.

By talking to Scorpius, players can get an Unholy mould and have their Unholy symbols blessed. A ghostspeak amulet is not needed to talk to Scorpius, but he will only talk to players who have "seen beyond the stars" (finished the Observatory Quest).

label: Grave scorpion
title: Grave scorpion
lead: Grave scorpions are low-level monsters found by the Grave of Scorpius, south of West Ardougne. It is worth noting that their hitpoints are lower than standard scorpions, so they may be useful to kill if the player wants to finish a Slayer task of scorpions quickly.

label: Gravestone (Draynor Manor)
title: Gravestone (Draynor Manor)
lead: Gravestone can be found north of Draynor Manor. It speaks of a person called 'Guy' who was buried there.

label: Gravestone (scenery)
title: Gravestone (scenery)
lead: Gravestones are found throughout Gielinor.

label: Graveyard of Shadows
title: Graveyard of Shadows
lead: The Graveyard of Shadows, located at levels 18–21 in the Wilderness, occupies a section of what was once the Zarosian fortress of Carrallanger. This area is a large, seemingly forgotten graveyard filled with dead trees, wandering zombies, and derelict gravestones. Within the graveyard lies the Skeletal Tomb, the lair of Calvar'ion.

label: greater demon
title: greater demon
lead:
Greater demons are large demonic monsters. They are well known for their rune full helm and hard clue scroll drops.

K'ril Tsutsaroth, the Zamorakian general in the God Wars Dungeon, and his bodyguard Tstanon Karlak; Skotizo, the demi-boss in the Catacombs of Kourend; as well as Tormented Demons are considered greater demons for the purpose of a Slayer task.

label: Greatness
title: Greatness
lead:
Greatness is a music track that can be unlocked at locations outside Varrock city walls, including the Cooks' Guild, Champions' Guild, and Jolly Boar Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Doorways, Expanse, and Still Night.

In Classic mode, this track plays near the Champions' Guild.

label: Green boots
title: Green boots
lead: Green boots can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Green cape
title: Green cape
lead: A green cape can be made by using green dye on another coloured cape and can be purchased from Barkers' Haberdashery in Canifis.

label: Green d'hide body
title: Green d'hide body
lead:
The green d'hide body is a part of the green dragonhide armour set. In order to wear the body, a player must first have completed the Dragon Slayer I quest and have level 40 Ranged and Defence. It offers the best ranged accuracy bonus among all free-to-play body armours, although its defensive bonuses are surpassed by the gilded d'hide body.

Although players must complete Dragon Slayer I in order to wear a green d'hide body, completion of this quest is not required to equip blue, red, and black d'hide bodies.

label: Green d'hide chaps
title: Green d'hide chaps
lead: Green d'hide chaps, short for green dragonhide chaps, is a type of legwear designed for rangers. They are part of the green dragonhide armour set, and can be worn at level 40 Ranged. They offer the best ranged accuracy bonus out of all free-to-play leg armours, although their defensive bonuses are surpassed by the gilded d'hide chaps. Notable for no Defence requirement, this piece of armour is commonly used by the free-to-play combat pures.

label: Green d'hide vambraces
title: Green d'hide vambraces
lead:
Green d'hide vambraces is a piece of armour worn by rangers in the hand slot. They require level 40 Ranged to be worn.

This item is a considerable choice for rangers in free-to-play servers, as well as for melee combat because they have higher total defence bonuses than either leather gloves or leather vambraces while having no negative melee attack bonuses. However, they should not be used for magic combat due to the substantial negative magic attack bonus. They offer the highest ranged accuracy bonus among free-to-play hand slot items, although their defensive bonuses are surpassed by the gilded d'hide vambraces. Notable for no Defence requirement, these vambraces are commonly used by the free-to-play combat pures.

label: green door
title: green door
lead: The Green door is located in the basement of Melzar's Maze. It must be opened during Dragon Slayer I, using a green key obtained from killing the nearby Lesser demon.

label: green dragon
title: green dragon
lead:
Green dragons are the weakest of the adult chromatic dragons. They are found in various locations within the Wilderness as well as in the Corsair Cove Dungeon. Green dragons are capable of breathing dragonfire, which can hit up to 50 damage on players who are not wielding an Anti-dragon shield or Dragonfire shield. Using one of these shields will partially block the dragonfire, and using one of these shields with an antifire potion will block the dragonfire completely.

Green dragons are assignable as a Slayer task by Krystilia.

label: Green dragon leather
title: Green dragon leather
lead: Green dragon leather is used in the Crafting skill to make green dragonhide armour. It can be created by giving a green dragonhide to a tanner. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Forthos Dungeon, Canifis, and the Crafting Guild. Alternatively, green dragon leather can be made using the Tan Leather spell. Crafting any piece of green dragonhide armour will grant the player 62 experience per hide.

label: Green dragonhide
title: Green dragonhide
lead:
Green dragonhide is a 100% drop from green dragons. It can be tanned to make green dragon leather, which in turn is used to make green dragonhide armour, by paying a tanner or by using the Tan Leather Lunar spell. A tanner will charge 20 coins for each hide, or 45 in Canifis. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Forthos Dungeon, Canifis, and the Crafting Guild.

The 100% drop rate makes green dragon hunting a popular money making method for many players.

label: green dye
title: green dye
lead: Green dye is a dye made by combining blue dye and yellow dye, which can both be made from Aggie, the dye maker in Draynor. It can also be purchased from Oronwen in Lletya. Members can also use it to make a green balloon after the Enlightened Journey quest by using the dye on an origami balloon. When used with a cape, the cape becomes a green cape and gives 2.5 crafting experience.

label: Green halloween mask
title: Green halloween mask
lead:
The Green halloween mask is a tradeable cosmetic item. Green halloween masks can be obtained by completing one of the Halloween holiday events that occur once per year. This also rewards the player with all other holiday items associated with Halloween.

After player decided polls, it was decided that all tradeable rares will be distributed during their corresponding holiday events thus making them seasonal rares and not completely rare, this to prevent them from being worth hundreds of millions of coins again, like in RuneScape 3.

label: Green hat
title: Green hat
lead:
A green hat can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree. These hats are a slight upgrade from Wizard hats, as Gnome hats have 1 more Magic attack and defence.

The hat may be required to complete an emote clue during a Treasure Trail.

label: Green Sheep
title: Green Sheep
lead:
Green Sheep are sick sheep found near the East Ardougne north bank that must be prodded with the cattleprod to the sheep pen and fed the poisoned sheep feed during the Sheep Herder quest. Its wool is slightly greenish. Once killed, it drops the sheep bones (2).

After Mourning's End Part I, the sheep are of a darker green as a result of the player dyeing them with a Fixed device loaded with a Green toad. Once dyed, they can no longer be prodded or interacted with in any way. Luckily, players only need to dye one and all the sheep of the same colour turn dark. This is how players can tell they haven't missed the sheep during the quest.

label: Green partyhat
title: Green partyhat
lead:
Green partyhats are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year.

Previously, they were obtainable during the 2013 Rare Drops event (from 4 July to 14 July) as part of a rare item drop.

label: Green robe bottoms
title: Green robe bottoms
lead: Green robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions. You can find Rometti on the of the Grand Tree, in the north-eastern area.

label: Green robe top
title: Green robe top
lead: A green robe top can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Greenman's ale
title: Greenman's ale
lead:
Greenman's ale is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Herblore by 1 while also draining Attack, Strength, and Defence by 3 when consumed. It can be obtained through brewing at level 29 Cooking, granting 281 experience per batch. It is brewed using 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, 4 harralander, and a pot of ale yeast. The stronger, mature version of the ale is the Greenman's ale (m).

One is required for the quest Recipe for Disaster/Another Cook's Quest.

label: Greldo
title: Greldo
lead:
Greldo is a goblin with a speech impediment and the servant of a witch in service of the Kinshra. He looks to be wielding a steel spear and a wooden square shield, as well as wearing what looks like a bronze cap on his head. He also seems to wear a type of black goblin mail.

During the Black Knights' Fortress quest, he is assigned to obtain a certain type of cabbage from Draynor Manor for the invincibility potion, but the player foils their plan by dropping a regular cabbage in the cauldron.

label: Grew
title: Grew
lead: Grew is an ogre encountered during the Watchtower quest. He sends you to knock out a tooth from Gorad, his enemy, to annoy him, and to bring back the tooth as proof. In exchange, Grew gives the player one of the pieces of the ogre relic, as well as the yellow crystal.

label: Grey boots
title: Grey boots
lead:
Grey boots can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The boots come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. They give the same stats as leather boots.

Unlike leather boots, these cannot be crafted. Because of their stats, they are mostly worn for cosmetic purposes.

label: Grey gloves
title: Grey gloves
lead:
Grey gloves can be purchased in Canifis from Barker at his store, Barker's Haberdashery. The gloves come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. These gloves are often worn to match certain armour sets, such as gold-trimmed and god armour sets.

Their defence bonus is equal to that of leather gloves.

label: Grey hat
title: Grey hat
lead: Grey hats can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The hats come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Grey robe bottoms
title: Grey robe bottoms
lead: Grey robe bottoms can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe bottoms come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Grey robe top
title: Grey robe top
lead: Grey robe tops can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe tops come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Grey toy horsey
title: Grey toy horsey
lead:
Grey toy horseys are items made as a joke by Jagex, poking fun at the requests made by players to have horses. Toy horseys are obtainable from Diango for 150 coins, and come in 4 different colours: white, black, grey, and brown. They can also be made from a plank on any crafting table in a player-owned house, which requires level 10 or higher Crafting.

When you play with the horsey, an animation showing your character playing with it appears, and your character says

label: Grey wolf fur
title: Grey wolf fur
lead:
Grey wolf fur is an item dropped by werewolves. Grey wolf fur can also be bought, or stolen from the East Ardougne fur trader, the Port Roberts fur stall and the Rellekka fur trader (after The Fremennik Trials quest).

Grey wolf fur can also be obtained from salvaging at merchant shipwrecks and sorting the Opulent salvage recovered. Level 87 sailing is required.

label: Grill (Black Knights' Fortress)
title: Grill (Black Knights' Fortress)
lead:
The grill is a scenery object that can be found on the of the Black Knights' Fortress. Players must listen-at the grill during the Black Knights' Fortress quest to spy on a conversation between the Black Knight Captain, a witch, and a goblin.

A grill can also be found in the Black Knights' Base located within Taverley Dungeon, but cannot be interacted with due to a suit of armour blocking access.

label: Grimy ardrigal
title: Grimy ardrigal
lead:
Grimy ardrigal is the grimy form of ardrigal, a herb obtained by searching the palm trees with large leaves on the north-eastern peninsula of Karamja, on the south side of the tree grapple shortcut. It is the second herb Trufitus asks the player to bring him during Jungle Potion, and is also used during Legends' Quest in combination with snake weed to make a bravery potion.

Trufitus will buy clean ardrigals for a random amount of coins between and . This can only be done by using the herb on him, as there is no dialogue option for selling them to him. He will not buy grimy ardrigals, his reasoning being that he cannot identify what the herb is.

label: Grimy avantoe
title: Grimy avantoe
lead:
A grimy avantoe is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make an avantoe. Grimy avantoes may be grown from an avantoe seed with a Farming level of 50. It is also dropped by certain NPCs. Cleaning a grimy avantoe requires a Herblore level of 48 and gives 10 Herblore experience. Clean avantoes are used to make fishing potions, super energy potions and hunter potions, requiring levels 50, 52, and 53 Herblore respectively.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy avantoe. is displayed.

label: Grimy cadantine
title: Grimy cadantine
lead:
A grimy cadantine is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a cadantine. Grimy cadantines may be grown from a cadantine seed with a Farming level of 67, giving 120 Farming experience per herb harvested. It is also dropped by certain NPCs. Cleaning a grimy cadantine requires a Herblore level of 65 and gives 12.5 Herblore experience. Cadantines are used to make super defence potions with a Herblore level of 66.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy cadantine. is displayed.

label: Grimy dwarf weed
title: Grimy dwarf weed
lead:
A grimy dwarf weed is the second-highest level herb. A player with 70 Herblore may clean it and produce a dwarf weed for 13.8 Herblore experience. Dwarf weed is mainly used to create ranging potions.

It may be grown from a dwarf weed seed at 79 Farming, granting 192 experience per herb during harvest.

label: Grimy guam leaf
title: Grimy guam leaf
lead:
A grimy guam leaf is a herb that can be cleaned, requiring 3 Herblore, and yielding a guam leaf and 2.5 Herblore experience.

Grimy guam leaves can be harvested from herb patches after planting a guam seed, requiring 9 Farming.

label: Grimy harralander
title: Grimy harralander
lead:
A grimy harralander is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a harralander. Grimy harralanders may be grown from a harralander seed with a Farming level of 26. It is dropped by certain NPCs. Cleaning a grimy harralander requires a Herblore level of 20 and gives 6.3 Herblore experience. Clean harralanders are used to make Guthix rests, compost potions, restore potions, Guthix balance potions, Blamish oil (for the Heroes' Quest) and Energy potions with Herblore levels of 18, 21, 22, 22, and 26 respectively. Using harralander to make harralander tar is a popular and very fast method for training Herblore, without having to do many steps.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy harralander. is displayed.

label: Grimy irit leaf
title: Grimy irit leaf
lead:
A grimy irit leaf is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make an irit leaf. Grimy irit leaves may be grown from an irit seed with a Farming level of 44. It is dropped by certain NPCs. Cleaning a grimy irit requires a Herblore level of 40 and gives 8.8 Herblore experience. Clean irits are used to make super attack, super anti-poison potions, irit tar, and antidote++ with Herblore levels of 45, 48, 55, and 79 respectively. They are dropped inside the Edgeville Dungeon and Taverley Dungeon by the Chaos druids.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy irit leaf. is displayed.

label: Grimy kwuarm
title: Grimy kwuarm
lead:
A grimy kwuarm is a kwuarm that has not been cleaned yet, requiring a Herblore level of 54. Cleaning a grimy kwuarm yields 11.3 experience. Grimy kwuarms may be grown from a kwuarm seed with a Farming level of 56 or dropped by certain NPCs. Clean kwuarms are used to make super strength potion and weapon poisons with a Herblore level of 55 and a Herblore level of 60 respectively.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy kwuarm. is displayed.

label: Grimy lantadyme
title: Grimy lantadyme
lead: A grimy lantadyme is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a lantadyme. Grimy lantadymes may be grown from a lantadyme seed with a Farming level of 73. It is also dropped by certain NPCs. Cleaning a grimy lantadyme requires a Herblore level of 67 and gives 13.1 Herblore experience. Clean lantadymes are used to make antifire potions and Magic potion with a Herblore level of 69 and 76 respectively. When planting and harvesting lantadymes you will receive 134 experience for planting, and 151.5 experience for harvesting.

label: Grimy marrentill
title: Grimy marrentill
lead:
A grimy marrentill is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a marrentill. Grimy marrentills may be grown from a Marrentill seed with a Farming level of 14. It is also dropped by certain monsters. Cleaning a Grimy marrentill requires a Herblore level of 5 and gives 3.8 Herblore experience. Clean marrentills are used in the making of antipoisons at level 5 Herblore, Guthix rests at level 18 Herblore, and marrentill tar at level 31. Marrentill can also be used to light incense burners in player-owned houses.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy marrentill. is displayed.

label: Grimy ranarr weed
title: Grimy ranarr weed
lead:
A grimy ranarr weed is a herb that can be cleaned to make a ranarr weed. Grimy ranarr weeds may be grown from a ranarr seed with a Farming level of 32 and gives 30.5 Farming experience. Cleaning a grimy ranarr requires a Herblore level of 25 and gives 7.5 Herblore experience. Clean ranarr weeds are used to make defence potions and prayer potions with a Herblore level of 30 and 38, respectively.

Grimy herbs, including ranarr, are commonly found by killing chaos druids and elder chaos druids, although they reside in the Wilderness. Killing flesh crawlers and chaos druids are also a relatively good strategy to collect grimy ranarrs.

label: Grimy rogue's purse
title: Grimy rogue's purse
lead:
Grimy rogue's purse is a quest item used in Jungle Potion and Zogre Flesh Eaters. It is found by searching the walls in the Jogre Dungeon to the north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai village by the harpie bug swarms, as a drop from a jogre or tribesman or during the Shades of Mort'ton quest.

It is cleaned to make rogue's purse. In Jungle Potion, Trufitus will complain the herb is not fresh if it is dropped by a monster.

label: Grimy sito foil
title: Grimy sito foil
lead:
Grimy sito foil is a quest item used in Jungle Potion. It is found by searching the scorched earth around the campfire south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village in Karamja.

It is cleaned to make sito foil.

label: Grimy snake weed
title: Grimy snake weed
lead:
A Grimy snake weed is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a snake weed. Cleaning a grimy snake weed requires a Herblore level of 3 and gives 2.5 Herblore experience. Once cleaned, snake weed is a secondary ingredient in Herblore, used with rogue's purse to make a Relicym's balm potion and also used as a secondary ingredient to make Sanfew serum. Adding snake weed to a vial of water will produce a snakeweed mixture.

It is involved in the quest Jungle Potion, during and after which, players can find it by searching marshy jungle vines, south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai in west Karamja, just north of the Karamja Hunter area.

label: Grimy tarromin
title: Grimy tarromin
lead:
A grimy tarromin is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a tarromin. Grimy tarromins may be grown from a tarromin seed with a Farming level of 19. It is dropped by certain NPCs. Cleaning a grimy tarromin requires a Herblore level of 11 and gives 5 Herblore experience. Clean tarromins are used to make Strength potions and Serum 207s with a Herblore level of 12 and a Herblore level of 15 respectively. Clean tarromins can also be used with swamp tar to create tarromin tar at level 39 Herblore.

When cleaned, the message You clean the Grimy tarromin. is displayed.

label: Grimy torstol
title: Grimy torstol
lead:
A grimy torstol is a herb that has not yet been cleaned to make a torstol. Grimy torstols may be grown from a torstol seed with a Farming level of 85, granting 224.5 experience per herb during harvest. Cleaning a grimy torstol requires a Herblore level of 75 and gives 15 Herblore experience. Clean torstols are used to make Super combat potions with a Herblore level of 90 or Zamorak brews with a Herblore level of 78. Grimy torstol is one of the five herbs that cannot be obtained from the Sorceress's Garden.

One grimy torstol plus 8 other grimy herbs can be obtained from the Sinister chest in the Yanille Agility dungeon when unlocked with a Sinister key.

label: Grimy volencia moss
title: Grimy volencia moss
lead:
A grimy volencia moss is a herb that can be cleaned to make a volencia moss. Cleaning a grimy volencia moss requires a Herblore level of 3 and gives 2.5 Herblore experience. It is involved in the quest Jungle Potion and Fairytale I - Growing Pains, where a clean volencia moss may be one of the random items needed to obtain the magic secateurs. Players can find it in the black rocks at the Karamja Jungle mine north of Shilo Village on Karamja. In order to be able to collect the herb, the player must have started the Jungle Potion quest.

It cannot be stored in the herb sack.

label: Grinder (animation item)
title: Grinder (animation item)
lead: The Grinder is an animation item used during Herblore. It is temporarily wielded during animations where the player uses a pestle and mortar. Aside from this, it cannot be obtained.

label: Grip
title: Grip
lead:
Grip is the head guard of Scarface Pete, fought during the Heroes' Quest. He has the key you need to open the chest with the candlesticks during the thieves' armband section. He lives in Brimhaven and is found at Scarface Pete's Mansion.

In order to get his key ring you, or your partner, must kill him. A player who began the quest within the Phoenix Gang will need to kill him using ranging or maging equipment from a window on the opposite side of his yard.

label: Grip's keyring
title: Grip's keyring
lead:
Grip's keyring is a quest item that players obtain whilst doing the Heroes' Quest if they are in the Black Arm Gang. They can only obtain this item after their partner kills Grip with ranged or magic attacks.

The keyring is used to unlock the door to a treasure room in the Black Arm Gang's second hideout in Brimhaven in order to obtain the candlesticks required to continue the quest.

label: grizzly bear
title: grizzly bear
lead: Grizzly bears are large but relatively weak monsters typically found in forests. They are the stronger, aggressive cousins of the non-aggressive black bear.

label: Groats' farm
title: Groats' farm
lead: Groats' farm is a large farm in Lumbridge, on the eastern side of the River Lum. The farm is owned by Seth Groats, and is worked by Seth, several farmers, and his daughter Gillie. The farm features a potato field, a dairy pen, a chicken coop, a cooking pot, and a hops patch.

label: Grog
title: Grog
lead: Grog is a type of ale that restores 3 Hitpoints and temporarily boosts Strength by 4% + 1 and drains Attack by 5% + 3. Unlike other ales, it cannot be brewed.

label: Grotto (music track)
title: Grotto (music track)
lead: Grotto is a music track that is unlocked at the Nature Spirit's grotto in Mort Myre Swamp.

label: Grotto tree
title: Grotto tree
lead:
The Grotto tree can be seen in the southern portion of Mort Myre Swamp. The Grotto tree acts as the entrance to the Nature Grotto, which is the main focus of the quest Nature Spirit. In order to access the island where the Grotto tree is located, the player must first jump across the broken bridge, which is located on the south side of the island.

During the quest, the grotto tree can be searched to find Filliman's journal.

label: Ground bat bones
title: Ground bat bones
lead: Ground bat bones is an item used in the Watchtower quest and in the Herblore skill. They are made by using a pestle and mortar on bat bones. Provided that the player has level 14 Herblore, when combined with a Guam potion (unf) it will explode (dealing 5 damage), and will leave the empty vial only. Should the player have their hitpoints less than 8, it will not kill them and will deal less than 5 damage. Additionally, when the item is combined with a vial of water, the water will evaporate followed by a dialogue box with the player saying, "Oh dear, the mixture has evaporated." This also leaves an empty vial. The item can be created before, during, and after the quest; however, it serves no purpose outside of the quest.

label: ground charcoal
title: ground charcoal
lead: Ground charcoal is an item used during The Dig Site. It is obtained by grounding normal charcoal with a pestle and mortar. It is used in The Dig Site quest where it is necessary to make Chemical compound (along with nitroglycerin, ammonium nitrate and arcenia root) to blow up bricks blocking the path below the digsite. It can also be used in Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals when Mudknuckles asks for charcoal.

label: Grubor
title: Grubor
lead: Grubor is a Black Arm Gang contact players must meet during the Heroes' Quest. He can be found in the building south of the Brimhaven Agility Arena.

label: Grud's Herblore Stall.
title: Grud's Herblore Stall.
lead: Grud's Herblore Stall is a shop in Gu'Tanoth that sells herblore ingredients. It is run by an ogre called Grud.

label: Grum
title: Grum
lead:
Grum is a man who runs Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim. He buys and sells unenchanted rings, amulets and necklaces from sapphire up to diamond.

During the Merlin's Crystal quest, players will have to bring a loaf of bread to his gold exchange and give it to a beggar in order to receive Excalibur from The Lady of the Lake.

label: Grum's Gold Exchange.
title: Grum's Gold Exchange.
lead:
Grum's Gold Exchange is located in Port Sarim and operated by Grum. The store buys and sells many kinds of unenchanted jewellery, though it does not deal in dragonstone, onyx, or zenyte jewellery or bracelets. It is one of only two jewellery stores in RuneScape (the other being Conara's Jewels), and one of the only stores that has an automatically closing door.

The store also plays a small part in the Merlin's Crystal quest: to trigger a point in the quest, you have to open the door; this is why the door closes automatically.

label: Grumpy
title: Grumpy
lead: Grumpy is a music track that is unlocked in the Corsair Cove Dungeon west of Corsair Cove. It can also be unlocked near the swamp toad ponds in the Feldip Hills.

label: Gu'Tanoth
title: Gu'Tanoth
lead:
Gu'Tanoth is an ogre city far south of Ardougne and slightly south-west of Yanille. Players need to progress far enough into the Watchtower quest in order to enter.

Some ogres here are aggressive to players.

label: guam leaf
title: guam leaf
lead:
Guam leaves are the first herbs that a player can clean, with a Herblore level of 3, giving 2.5 Herblore experience. They are used to make attack potions, for fuelling swamp lizards in the form of guam tar, and for making Guthix rest potions, after completing the related segment of the One Small Favour quest. Guam leaves can be grown in a herb patch with a Farming level of 9. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a guam potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

Guam leaves, along with Marrentills, are used in the Lunar Diplomacy quest to make Guam-marr vial. The vial can then be destroyed and received again from Baba Yaga.

label: Guam potion (unf)
title: Guam potion (unf)
lead: A guam potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a guam leaf on a vial of water, requiring 3 Herblore. Using an eye of newt on a guam potion (unf) with 3 Herblore yields an attack potion (3) and 25 Herblore experience. In the Watchtower quest, using Jangerberries on a guam potion (unf) with 14 Herblore yields a vial (jangerberries and guam leaf) and 10 Herblore experience.

label: guard
title: guard
lead:
There are many guards in Gielinor, usually in populated, major cities, such as Falador, Varrock, Ardougne, and others. Guards also patrol the area just south of the wilderness ditch at Edgeville.

Their level ranges from 19-22, and they are quite weak. None of the guards are aggressive unless attacked first. Guards can be pickpocketed at level 40 Thieving, giving 46.8 experience and 30 coins. Besides the ones listed on this page, other guards whose pockets can be picked include the Port Sarim jail guards, Hosidius guards, Shayzien guards, along with the guard loitering east of Doric's hut.

label: Guard (Burthorpe)
title: Guard (Burthorpe)
lead:
Guards (Burthorpe) are level 37 humans. A pair of Burthorpe guards flank either side of the main entrance to the Burthorpe Castle, and a third guard can be found within the castle itself near the ground floor stairs. They have average Defence and accuracy for their combat level and have a max hit of 5.

Players would occasionally train on these three guards for experience and their uncommon mithril platebody and mithril full helm drops. As new options became available in more recent updates, that practice is now virtually nonexistent.

label: Guard (Carnillean)
title: Guard (Carnillean)
lead:
A guard watches over the Carnillean Mansion, home to the Carnillean family, in the south-west corner of East Ardougne. He looks identical to the rest of the Ardougne police force, though he lacks a weapon, and cannot be fought.

During the events of the quest Secrets of the North, the guard enlists the player to help solve the murder of Ceril Carnillean.

label: Guard (Combat Training Camp)
title: Guard (Combat Training Camp)
lead: Guards are found in the Combat Training Camp of East Ardougne, which is accessed after completing the Biohazard quest. According to them, the caged ogres in the camp are being used for target practice as punishment for terrorising the area. There are two variations, some wield crossbows and others wield a mace and square shield.

label: Guard (East Varrock)
title: Guard (East Varrock)
lead:
A guard is stationed in Varrock, east of Aubury's magic shop. He is found guarding the south-east members' section, that is blocked off by a gate running across its perimeter.

During the Biohazard quest, he will confiscate any vials that are to be delivered to Guidor, from Elena. To avoid this, they must be smuggled in by the chemist's deliverymen.

label: Guard (Goutweed)
title: Guard (Goutweed)
lead: Troll guards patrol the Troll Stronghold storeroom. The player must avoid being seen in order to reach the goutweed. If a guard sees the player, it will throw its club at the intruder with surprising accuracy, knock them unconscious, and deal 0-6 damage. The player will be thrown out of the storeroom, where they can try again. The Protect from Missiles prayer save prevent damage from the club, but will not prevent the player from being thrown out.

label: Guard (Ranging Guild)
title: Guard (Ranging Guild)
lead: Guards may be found wandering in the Ranging Guild. They welcome the player to the Ranging Guild.

label: Guard (Sinclair Mansion)
title: Guard (Sinclair Mansion)
lead: The Guards of Sinclair Mansion are law enforcers who keep the Sinclairs under house arrest, both during Murder Mystery and King's Ransom. Talking to any of them starts the quest Murder Mystery. They also play a minor role during the King's Ransom quest.

label: Guard (unused)
title: Guard (unused)
lead:
The Guard was an unused variant of the Varrock Guards who used a crossbow. Presumably, he would have been located on Varrock's western wall or one of the guard towers, but was ultimately not added for unknown reasons.

Although several players claimed to remember him being on top of the wall facing Varrock west bank, there is no reference to him on any Fansite forums or bestiary during this time. The Falador Guard and Aitan, released in 2006, were considered at the time to be the first free-to-play monsters to use Ranged.

label: Guard Bandit
title: Guard Bandit
lead: Guard Bandits can be found at the entrance to the Wilderness Bandit Camp. If the player tries to enter the camp, the guards will exclaim and attack the player. Like most Wilderness monsters, Guard Bandits are aggressive to players of all levels. Guard Bandits usually only drop bones, as opposed to the other bandits that reside in the camp.

label: Guard dog
title: Guard dog
lead:
Guard dogs are animals that can be found in various man-made locations. For lower-level players, guard dogs can be tough to defeat with melee, due to their fairly high melee accuracy. They can be slain towards a dog Slayer task, but Jackals may be much easier.

The guard dogs by the fruit stalls at Xeric's Glade will only become aggressive if they detect a player trying to steal from the stalls. When they do, they will bark "Woof! Woof! Woof!" and proceed to attack.

label: Guardian of Armadyl
title: Guardian of Armadyl
lead:
The Guardians of Armadyl are found in the Temple of Ikov. They are members of an ancient order, tasked with protecting the legendary Staff of Armadyl. If players wish to claim the Staff for Lucien, they must defeat all of the guardians in the room. Players can also talk to or kill a guardian to obtain an Armadyl pendant if they lose theirs. Like the Monkey Guards on Ape Atoll, the guardians cannot be walked through.

The Guardians of Armadyl are among the very few known human followers of Armadyl.

label: Guardians of Armadyl
title: Guardians of Armadyl
lead: The Guardians of Armadyl are an ancient order of Armadyleans tasked with protecting the legendary Staff of Armadyl. For generations, they have guarded the Temple of Ikov and the staff within. They are the only known group of human followers of the god Armadyl.

label: Guide book
title: Guide book
lead:
The guide book, or Tourist Guide to Ardougne, is an informational book found in the real estate agency near the southern bank of East Ardougne. The book details various points of interest in and around the city, and is presumably meant to help inform visitors and attract commerce to the city.

The book contains the full name of the owner of the Handelmort Mansion, Lord Francis Kurt Handelmort. This is useful in the Tribal Totem quest, during which players must use Handelmort's middle name, Kurt, to bypass the mansion's security system.

label: Guidor
title: Guidor
lead: Guidor is an old friend of Elena. He is located in the most south-east corner of the gated area in the south-east corner of Varrock, in his bedroom. During the Biohazard quest, the player is sent to give him a plague sample, touch paper and the three smuggled liquids. Upon conversing with him further, he will come to an interesting conclusion about the sample you have brought.

label: Guild Door (Crafting Guild)
title: Guild Door (Crafting Guild)
lead: The Guild Door allows access to the Crafting Guild. It can only be opened if the player is wearing a brown apron, golden apron, Crafting cape, or Max cape; otherwise the Master Crafter will tell the player to go get a brown apron.

label: Guild door (Ranging Guild)
title: Guild door (Ranging Guild)
lead: The Guild door allows access to the Ranging Guild. If the player has less than 40 Ranged, the nearby Ranging Guild Doorman will deny them access.

label: Guildmaster
title: Guildmaster
lead: The Guildmaster runs the Champions' Guild. Players can start the Dragon Slayer I quest by talking to him. He also hands out maze keys to Melzar's Maze after completion of Dragon Slayer I.

label: Gujuo
title: Gujuo
lead:
Gujuo is a native of the Kharazi Jungle and a proud member of a Kharazi tribe. He can be summoned anywhere in the Kharazi Jungle using a bullroarer during and after the Legends' Quest with the exception of introducing yourself - this must happen near one of the totems.

He plays an important part in this quest, frequently communicating with the player about his tribe and how they may be of help to them. The player must help exorcise an evil spirit called Nezikchened from one of their spiritual totems. In return Gujuo gives them a gilded totem which will buy their membership of the Legends' Guild.

label: Gull
title: Gull
lead:
Gulls are birds found flying around Gielinor. They can mostly be found near the sea. They have no use besides making the game more immersive, and can only be examined.

They seem to be flying versions of seagulls, except that they cannot be attacked.

label: Gulluck
title: Gulluck
lead:
Gulluck is the weapon salesman on the of the Grand Tree. He owns Gulluck and Sons. He sells bronze arrows, bronze bolts, shortbows, longbows, crossbows, bronze to mithril arrowtips, iron and steel axes, iron to mithril battleaxes, and bronze to adamant two-handed swords.

He is a potential easy customer in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

label: Gulluck and Sons
title: Gulluck and Sons
lead: Gulluck and Sons is a weapons shop owned and run by the gnomish trader Gulluck and his sons (though his sons do not appear in-game) on the of the Grand Tree, the large keep of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. The shop is marked as a sword shop on the map even though Gulluck sells several kinds of weapons, including arrows, bows, crossbows, battleaxes and two-handed swords.

label: Gundai
title: Gundai
lead: Gundai is the banker for the Mage Arena in the Wilderness. The areas just north of the Mage Arena were very popular among player killers in the members' section of the Wilderness due to its close proximity to the bank and a rune store, thereby facilitating the replenishment of food, runes and other supplies.

label: Gunnjorn
title: Gunnjorn
lead:
Gunnjorn is a Barbarian found at the Barbarian Outpost, located north-east of the Grand Tree. He is in charge of the outpost's Agility Course which requires 35 Agility and the completion of Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl to access.

He gives you a Lighthouse key in the Horror from the Deep quest, after you tell him that his cousin Larrissa has been locked out from the Lighthouse.

label: Gunthor the brave
title: Gunthor the brave
lead: Gunthor the Brave is a barbarian who lives in Barbarian Village. He is located in The Long Hall in the northern part of the village. Gunthor is the highest level barbarian in Barbarian Village. He is stated to be a mighty warrior and a chieftain of the barbarians. He is also the descendant of Gunnar, the Fremennik barbarian who led the Runecrafting Crusades over 100 years ago.

label: Guthix cape
title: Guthix cape
lead:
The Guthix cape is a reward from Mage Arena I miniquest. To receive the cape, the player must defeat Kolodion in his four guises, then speak to him, step through the nearby sparkling pool, and finally pray at the Statue of Guthix. Upon praying at the statue, the Guthix cape will appear next to the player and can be picked up.

The Guthix cape and the Guthix staff are required to benefit from the Charge spell, which enables the player to hit up to 50% more damage with the Claws of Guthix spell.

label: Guthix full helm
title: Guthix full helm
lead:
The Guthix full helm is a decorated rune full helm that is affiliated with the god Guthix. Like all god affiliated rune items, its bonuses are the same as its rune counterpart, but also offers a +1 Prayer bonus. Visually, the only difference is the colour of the plume which is green for the Guthix full helm and purple for the rune full helm.

The full helm requires 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill. Players can obtain a Guthix full helm as a reward from completing hard Treasure Trails.

label: Guthix kiteshield
title: Guthix kiteshield
lead:
The Guthix kiteshield is a decorated rune kiteshield that is affiliated with the god Guthix. Sharing the same stats as the rune kiteshield except for the ranged attack bonus and prayer bonus, the Guthix kiteshield also looks visually similar. Its appearance differs in that the shield features an ornamental green trim.

The shield requires 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Guthix platebody
title: Guthix platebody
lead:
The Guthix platebody is a trimmed rune platebody fashioned to praise Guthix. It has the same stats as the rune platebody but with a +1 prayer bonus. It requires 40 Defence and the completion of the Dragon Slayer I quest to wear.

It can only be obtained as a reward from hard Treasure Trails, and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Guthix platelegs
title: Guthix platelegs
lead:
Guthix platelegs are a decorated version of rune platelegs that are affiliated with the god Guthix. Sharing the same stats as rune platelegs (with the addition of a +1 prayer bonus), the Guthix platelegs also look visually similar. Their appearance differs in that they feature an ornamental green trim.

The platelegs require 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill. Players can obtain Guthix platelegs as a reward from completing hard Treasure Trails.

label: Guthix staff
title: Guthix staff
lead:
The Guthix staff is a god staff that can only be obtained by finishing Mage Arena I miniquest. Like the other God staves, this staff requires level 60 Magic to acquire and therefore wield. To get it, the player must defeat Kolodion the mage in all of his forms. Afterwards, they will have to pick a god to worship to receive a cape and the staff corresponding to that god. If the player has already chosen another god, the staff can be purchased from the Chamber Guardian for 80,000 coins.

The staff allows wielders to cast the Claws of Guthix spell, which must be cast 100 times inside the Mage Arena minigame to gain the ability to use it outside of the arena. The spell has a chance to lower the opponent's defence by 5% on a successful hit, which does not stack with subsequent hits and will not re-occur until the opponents defence has returned to their original level. The spell can also be temporarily powered up by casting the Charge spell first.

label: Hadley
title: Hadley
lead:
Hadley is a tourist guide who resides by the Lake Baxtorian. He shares information about Baxtorian Falls and the legendary elven king Baxtorian during the Waterfall Quest and helps locate the Shadow Dungeon during Desert Treasure I.

When riding out of the Ancient Cavern on a log, players end up near his house.

label: Hair of the Dog
title: Hair of the Dog
lead: The Hair of the Dog tavern is located in Canifis, south of the town square.

label: Hairdresser
title: Hairdresser
lead: The Hairdresser is located in western Falador, north of the bank. He can let players access the makeover interface free of charge.

label: Hajedy
title: Hajedy
lead: Hajedy is the cart driver that transports you to Shilo Village after you complete the Shilo Village quest. He can be found in northern Brimhaven, just to the south of the docks. He runs one end of the Shilo Village cart system that transports players between Brimhaven and Shilo Village for a fee with the other end ran by his brother, Vigroy.

label: Halberd (unobtainable item)
title: Halberd (unobtainable item)
lead:
The halberd is an unobtainable item released alongside RuneScape 2. Although it is classified internally as a weapon, it lacks a wield option and does not have any equip animations defined.

Its release predates the release of obtainable halberds by several months. Presumably it was created in order to test the implementation of the new halberd weapons in RuneScape 2 while Regicide was developed.

label: Half baked batta
title: Half baked batta
lead: A half baked batta is created by cooking a raw batta on a range. The raw ingredients can be added by selecting prepare and choosing a batta type. This creates a half made batta.

label: Half baked bowl
title: Half baked bowl
lead: The half baked bowl is an item used in gnome cooking and is obtained by using gianne dough with a gnomebowl mould, then using the resulting raw gnomebowl on a range. The raw ingredients can be added by selecting prepare and choosing a gnomebowl type. This creates a half made bowl.

label: Half baked crunchy
title: Half baked crunchy
lead: A half baked crunchy is an item created in gnome cooking by cooking raw crunchies on a range. The raw ingredients can be added by selecting prepare and choosing a crunchy type. This creates a half made crunchy.

label: Half full wine jug
title: Half full wine jug
lead:
Half full wine jugs are rewards given out during various holiday events. Drinking a half full wine jug will restore 7 Hitpoints, and like normal wine, will temporarily decrease Attack by 2.

A regular jug of wine cannot be drunk to make a half full wine jug, nor can two half full jugs be decanted to make a full jug. Interestingly, the half full wine jug heals more than half of a regular jug of wine.

label: half-soulless
title: half-soulless
lead:
The half-soulless are half-human and half-soulless beings found deep in the Underground Pass, in the cages found north of Iban's Temple, placed on the top of flat cave stalagmites. They are people that entered the Underground Pass as humans but have partially deteriorated into the soulless due to the voice of Iban.

During the Underground Pass quest, the player receives a pair of gloves from a dwarf named Klank, appropriately called Klank's gauntlets. Without the protection from the gauntlets, the half-soulless will bite players who search their cages, inflicting damage. Players search the cages as they must retrieve the dove skeleton in order to defeat Iban. Finding it might take a while, as there are many cages.

label: Hamid
title: Hamid
lead: Hamid is a monk at the altar in the Emir's Arena hospital. He is spoken to during a certain clue scroll to receive another scroll or reward. Hamid says he came to the Emir's Arena to watch the nurses, which is slightly odd for a monk. He comes from the monastery in Edgeville.

label: Hammer
title: Hammer
lead:
A hammer is a tool used for smithing items on an Anvil, and it is vital to level the Smithing skill. Hammers can be bought from most general stores and will never break. Alternatively, players can obtain a hammer by talking to the Master smithing tutor at the West Varrock anvil. A hammer is also used in the Construction skill when making furniture, and it is required for some minigames. At 15 Construction, members can make a Tool store 1 for the workshop room of their house; this tool store provides an unlimited supply of hammers.

A hammer is required to access Bandos' stronghold in the God Wars Dungeon; warhammers are an acceptable substitute.

label: Hammock
title: Hammock
lead: Hammocks can be found in various places inhabited by gnomes, including the Tree Gnome Stronghold and Tree Gnome Village.

label: Hand holds (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Hand holds (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The Hand holds are an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to cross the obstacle will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

The amount of damage dealt by the fall is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: Handelmort Mansion
title: Handelmort Mansion
lead: Handelmort Mansion is a mansion found in East Ardougne, just west of Ardougne market. It plays a large role in the Tribal Totem quest. Home to Lord Francis Kurt Handelmort, a wealthy East Ardougne noble, the mansion is richly decorated. It is also home to some artefacts that Lord Handelmort has taken. He has gone to great lengths to protect these artefacts with guard dogs, locked house, and a booby-trapped staircase.

label: Hanging meat
title: Hanging meat
lead: Hanging meat is butchered meat hanging from a rack and can be found in various locations, but primarily kitchens and food shops. The meat has no functionality and exists purely for aesthetics.

label: Hanging wheel
title: Hanging wheel
lead: Hanging wheels can be found in several locations over Gielinor that are somewhat connected to the sea, such as Port Sarim. Players cannot interact with the wheels, but they can examine them.

label: Hangover cure
title: Hangover cure
lead:
A hangover cure is made by adding chocolate dust, obtained by grinding a chocolate bar down with a Pestle and mortar (or cut with a knife), to a bucket of milk, and then mixing in snape grass to the chocolatey milk. Hangover cure is used during the Plague City quest, in which the player must give one to Bravek, city warder of West Ardougne, found in the Civic Office of West Ardougne. Players may then obtain a warrant from him which will allow the player to enter the "plague-house" in the south-east corner of the city.

A hangover cure is also given to Skippy, a washed-up fisherman on the coast of Rimmington, in the miniquest Skippy and the Mogres. Once cured, he will explain the "creature" he saw in the water, which eventually turns out to be a mogre. This miniquest is required for players to kill mogres as Slayer monsters.

label: Hans
title: Hans
lead:
Hans is the servant of Duke Horacio and can be found walking in circles around the Lumbridge Castle courtyard. He is easily scared, screaming and running away in fright when threatened. He can tell players how old their accounts are or how long they've spent online by talking to him.

Hans can also be spoken to by selecting "random contact" on the NPC Contact spell. If Hans is contacted, your character will claim you are a knight coming to kill everyone in Lumbridge Castle. Hans panics in response.

label: Happy Heroes' H'emporium.
title: Happy Heroes' H'emporium.
lead: Happy Heroes' H'emporium is a shop run by Helemos, who resides within the Heroes' Guild. As such, the shop can only be accessed after completion of the Heroes' Quest. This is one out of the two shops (the other being the Myths' Guild Weaponry shop) that sells the dragon battleaxe and dragon mace.

label: Hard leather
title: Hard leather
lead:
Hard leather is made by taking cowhides to a tanner. The lunar spell Tan Leather can also be used at level 78 Magic, and tans up to 5 cowhides at once into hard leather.

Combined with thread and a needle, it can be used to make hardleather bodies at level 28 Crafting, granting 35 crafting experience.
With a hammer and 15 bronze nails, members can attach two hard leathers onto an oak shield to create a hard leather shield. Doing so requires level 41 Crafting and grants 70 experience.

label: Hardleather body
title: Hardleather body
lead: The hardleather body is low-level ranged armour. It may be equipped in the torso slot by players with 1 Ranged and 10 Defence. It provides better protection from melee, Magic, and Ranged attacks than the leather body and grants a modest boost to one's Ranged accuracy.

label: Harmony (music track)
title: Harmony (music track)
lead:
Harmony is a music track that is unlocked when the player first arrives in Lumbridge. It can also be heard around the Lumbridge Swamp and farmlands. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Autumn Voyage, Book of Spells, Dream, Flute Salad, and Yesteryear. It can also be heard in the dining room during Recipe for Disaster.

In Classic mode, the track plays at Lumbridge Castle.

label: Harmony 2
title: Harmony 2
lead: Harmony 2 is a music track that is unlocked in the cellar of Lumbridge Castle. It also plays in the water mill cellar after Death to the Dorgeshuun.

label: Harold
title: Harold
lead:
Harold is an off-duty Burthorpe Imperial Guard featured in the Death Plateau quest.

During the quest, players must converse with him, buy him drinks, and gamble with him until he is broke, forcing him to write an IOU letter with the only available piece of paper he had on his persons, which happens to have the combination on the back.

label: Harpoon
title: Harpoon
lead:
A harpoon is an item used in the Fishing skill. It can first be used at level 35 Fishing to catch tuna. Then, at level 50, you will begin to catch an array of tuna and swordfish. Eventually at level 76, you can harpoon sharks. Swordfish and tuna are caught in Cage/Harpoon fishing spots while sharks are caught in Net/Harpoon spots. Harpoons are also used at harpoon fishing spots on Tempoross Cove to catch harpoonfish when fighting Tempoross. It can be stored in a tackle box.

For pay-to-play players, wieldable alternatives, specifically the barb-tail harpoon and dragon harpoon, can be used. The dragon harpoon also has a 20% increased catch rate compared to other harpoons. Additionally, players can learn Barbarian fishing to do barehanded Fishing (48 Fishing, 15 Agility, 15 Strength to start/55 Fishing, 35 Strength to complete).

label: Harralander
title: Harralander
lead:
Harralander is a herb that can be cleaned at level 20 Herblore. It can be obtained as a monster drop or through the Farming skill, with a level of 26, by planting a harralander seed in a herb patch. It is used to make Guthix rest potions, compost potions, restore potions, blamish oil, energy potions, Greenman's ale, combat potions, harralander tar and goading potions. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a harralander potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

According to the book Gielinor's flora - herbs, harralander naturally grows on rocky crevices, and upon reaching maturity, its root system often causes large cracks to form in the rock.

label: Harralander potion (unf)
title: Harralander potion (unf)
lead: A harralander potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a harralander on a vial of water, requiring 22 Herblore. Using a volcanic ash on a harralander potion (unf) with 22 Herblore yields a compost potion(3) and 60 Herblore experience. Using a red spiders' eggs on a harralander potion (unf) with 22 Herblore yields a restore potion(3) and 62.5 Herblore experience. Using blamish snail slime on a harralander potion (unf) with 25 Herblore yields blamish oil and 80 Herblore experience. Using a chocolate dust on a harralander potion (unf) with 26 Herblore yields an energy potion(3) and 67.5 Herblore experience. Using a goat horn dust on a harralander potion (unf) with 36 Herblore yields a combat potion(3) and 84 Herblore experience.

label: Harry
title: Harry
lead: Harry is the owner of Harry's Fishing Shop, located in Catherby. He sells fishing equipment and a wide variety of raw fish. Harry also sells pet fish. Players may use a tiny net to catch one in his shop.

label: Harry's Fishing Shop.
title: Harry's Fishing Shop.
lead:
Harry's Fishing Shop is located in eastern Catherby. It is run by Harry. It is a convenient location for players because it is close to many Fishing spots. Players can sell their unwanted fish here.

Harry sells basic fishing equipment including small fishing nets, fishing rods, Harpoons, Lobster pots, fishing bait, and big fishing nets.

label: Hat stand
title: Hat stand
lead:
Hat stands are pieces of furniture that can be found around Gielinor used to hold hats.
* Using most head-slot objects on the stand triggers a chatbox message Oops - it fell off the hatstand! and causes the item to fall to the floor.
* Most items with a destroy option instead produce It'll probably fall off if you do that., with the item staying in the inventory. Some destroyable items (including the progress hat and Shayzien helm) can be dropped.
* Using a ram skull helm on the stand gives the message That is too valuable to use here. What if it fell off?.
* Attempting to use a non-hat item on the hat stand gives the chat message You can't put that on a hatstand.

In the past, hat stands did not have the destroy restrictions. They were sometimes used to make the drop trick work for destroyable head slot items, including the hats from the 2005 Christmas event, bunny ears, and the ram skull helm.

label: Hazeel
title: Hazeel
