lead: Hazeel is a Zamorakian Mahjarrat, featured in the quests Hazeel Cult and Secrets of the North. He was recently revived after having been defeated in the early Fifth Age.

id: category:desert treasure ii - the fallen empire
label: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
Hazeel Cult
title: Hazeel Cult
lead:
Hazeel Cult is a novice quest that was released on 15 August 2002. It was the second quest to feature a Mahjarrat, and introduces Hazeel, a Zamorakian Mahjarrat that has been put into a state of torpor, and his followers are attempting to revive him in time for the next Ritual of Rejuvenation.

This quest is notable in that it has two sides, a "good" side and an "evil" side, sharing this trait with Temple of Ikov, another Mahjarrat quest. In the "good" side, the player foils the cultists in their attempt to resurrect Hazeel, and in the "evil" side, the player joins the cult and assists them in resurrecting Hazeel.

label: Hazeel Cultist
title: Hazeel Cultist
lead: Hazeel Cultists are followers of the Zamorakian Mahjarrat, Hazeel, located in the southern Ardougne Sewers. Accessing their location requires starting the Hazeel Cult quest and correctly turning the five sewer valves outside. The cultists are eager to resurrect their lord, which the player helps with or refuses.

label: Hazeel scroll
title: Hazeel scroll
lead: The Hazeel scroll is a scroll containing the incantation used to free Hazeel in the evil side of the Hazeel Cult quest. The scroll is located up in a secret room on the of the Carnillean Mansion in a locked chest which can only be opened with a chest key. It is used by Alomone to reconstruct Hazeel's body.

label: Hazeel's mark
title: Hazeel's mark
lead: Hazeel's mark is a quest item from the quest Hazeel Cult. The item is only obtained when you choose Hazeel's side. It does not give any stat bonuses and is not used in any other quests.

label: Hazelmere
title: Hazelmere
lead:
Hazelmere is a gnome who lives on the Yanille Chain just east of Yanille. Hazelmere was the last surviving creator of the Grand Tree, a massive living fortress within the Gnome Stronghold. He was also an accomplished battle mage, the third advisor to King Healthorg, tree whisperer, soothsayer, and telepath with a great knowledge of history and culture. Hazelmere plays a prominent role in The Grand Tree, The Eyes of Glouphrie, The Path of Glouphrie, and While Guthix Sleeps quests.

There is a fairy ring near his house, the code being .

label: Hazelmere's scroll
title: Hazelmere's scroll
lead:
Hazelmere's scroll is an item used during The Grand Tree. Players obtain it by using the bark sample on Hazelmere. Hazelmere writes on the scroll in gnome language, and gives it to the player.

Players must then deliver this message back to King Narnode Shareen.

label: Head chef
title: Head chef
lead:
The Head Chef is the head of the Cooks' Guild between Varrock and Barbarian Village. He will allow entrance to those with a Cooking level of 32 and wearing a chef's hat.

As the master of Cooking, he sells the Cooking cape for , along with a matching hood to players who have achieved 99 Cooking.

label: Head Guard (Fight Arena)
title: Head Guard (Fight Arena)
lead: The Head Guard is a guard found in the Fight Arena and is involved in the quest of the same name. Players must get him drunk with a Khali brew during the quest and steal the Khazard cell keys from him.

label: Head Mourner
title: Head Mourner
lead:
The head mourner is an elf pretending to be the leader of the mourners in West Ardougne. This is presumably because the real head mourner, Essyllt is located in the underground headquarters near the Mourner Tunnels.

He claims to work for King Lathas to keep the West Ardougne plague in check. He has the same authority as city warder Bravek and is mostly in charge of the "official" paperwork and administration, whereas the real head mourner leads the mining operations to the Temple of Light by slaves from the city.

label: Head Thief
title: Head Thief
lead: The Head Thief is the leader of a small band of thieves that operate in the Kandarin area, just south of Ardougne. The thief and his group are involved in the Monk's Friend quest, where it is revealed that they have stolen a Child's blanket from one of the monks' sons. When infiltrating the thieves' lair to retrieve the blanket, the Head Thief can be found guarding the blanket, though you do not need to fight him to complete the quest.

label: headless arrow
title: headless arrow
lead:
A headless arrow is used in Fletching to make arrows. Attaching 15 feathers to 15 arrow shafts, requiring 1 Fletching, yielding 15 Fletching experience and 15 headless arrows. 15 arrowtips can be attached to headless arrows to make arrows.

There are several item spawns of headless arrows in the Scorpion Pit, deep in the Wilderness.

label: Heart and Mind
title: Heart and Mind
lead: Heart and Mind is a music track that is unlocked inside the Body Altar, which is south of the Edgeville Monastery.

label: Heart crystal
title: Heart crystal
lead:
The heart crystal is a quest item used in the Legends' Quest. It's created by killing the three knights Ranalph Devere, Irvig Senay and San Tojalon in the Viyeldi caves dungeon within Kharazi Jungle to obtain a lump of crystal, a hunk of crystal and a chunk of crystal respectively, which can then be combined to form the heart crystal by using them on the furnace. Once combined, the crystal must be activated by using it on the mossy rock in the caves, before it can be used on the recess in order to fill it, which deactivates the Shimmering fields.

It is not possible to obtain the heart fragments after filling the recess, or while in possession of a either a heart crystal or a knight's respective piece drop, even if stored within the bank or the nearby furnace. However, duplicate parts as well as the full crystal can be obtained before this point in Legend's Quest by utilising the drop trick. If the player does this, they are able to create multiple (albeit useless) heart crystals even after completing the quest.

label: Heckel Funch
title: Heckel Funch
lead:
Heckel Funch is a shopkeeper who sells ingredients for gnome cooking. His shop, Funch's Fine Groceries, is on the east side of the Grand Tree on the , near Blurberry's Bar.

Heckel sells various ingredients from drinks (vodka, whiskey etc.) to fruits and berries. Players can also buy pineapples from there that can be used in the farming skill to create supercompost.

label: Helemos
title: Helemos
lead: Helemos is a retired adventurer and the owner of Happy Heroes' H'emporium., a shop located on the of the Heroes' Guild which sells dragon battleaxes and dragon maces exclusively. When talked to, he begins by welcoming the player to the Heroes' Guild.

label: hellhound
title: hellhound
lead:
Hellhounds are monsters that are often given as a Slayer task to mid-to-high level players. Hellhounds are primarily killed for their hard clue scroll drops, as they drop them at a much higher rate compared to most other non-boss/superior monsters.

In order to be assigned them as a slayer task, the player must have 75 combat (unless it is not counted). Players with 91 Slayer may also kill Cerberus as an alternative to a hellhound task. Other alternatives include the skeleton hellhounds from Calvar'ion and Vet'ion, or reanimated hellhounds spawned by using Expert Reanimation on an ensouled hellhound head.

label: Helmet Shop.
title: Helmet Shop.
lead: The Helmet Shop is a shop run by Peksa located in central Barbarian Village. The shop offers medium and full helmets ranging from bronze to adamant, with the exception of black helms. It is the only shop in the Barbarian Village. The shop also contains a permanent fire.

label: Hemenster
title: Hemenster
lead: Hemenster is a small fishing town in Kandarin, located on the road between Seers' Village and East Ardougne.

label: Hengrad
title: Hengrad
lead: Hengrad is a prisoner found in the Fight Arena. He plays a minor role in the Fight Arena quest, where he reveals that General Khazard captured him when he was just a child and he has survived the arena for almost all his living years.

label: Henryeta Carnillean
title: Henryeta Carnillean
lead: Lady Henryeta Carnillean is the wife of Sir Ceril Carnillean, a wealthy nobleman of Ardougne, and the head of the Carnillean family. Henryeta lives in Carnillean Mansion, in the south-western end of East Ardougne, where she features briefly in the Hazeel Cult. She and Ceril have a son, Philipe Carnillean, who is very spoiled.

label: Herb bowl (animation item)
title: Herb bowl (animation item)
lead: The Herb bowl is an animation item used during Herblore. It is temporarily wielded during animations where the player uses a pestle and mortar, and when creating potions. Aside from this, it cannot be obtained.

label: Herblore
title: Herblore
lead:
Herblore is a members-only skill that allows players to make their own potions from herbs and various secondary ingredients.

Potions created with the Herblore skill have a variety of effects. Most potions can be drank to give players temporary skill boosts or other status effects, such as antifire or antipoison. Effects of temporary skill boosts degrade at roughly 1 level per minute until the potion completely wears off.

label: Herblore Level Up!
title: Herblore Level Up!
lead: Herblore Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling Herblore.

label: Herblore Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Herblore Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Herblore Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Herblore.

label: Hermit
title: Hermit
lead: Hermit is a music track that is unlocked in Saba's cave during the Death Plateau quest.

label: Hero
title: Hero
lead:
Heroes can be found in East Ardougne. They wear what appears to be a lighter coloured rune platebody and platelegs. They also wear leather gloves, boots and wield a rune longsword and square shield. Heroes can be pickpocketed by players with level 80 or greater Thieving, which gives 163.3 experience plus coins or other items. Pickpocketing a hero is a requirement for the Elite Ardougne Diary.

They are often present near the marketplace in East Ardougne, or the south-east bank. One of them is also near the entrance of the Ardougne Zoo. Heroes attack players when they steal from the gem stall. They also attack when the player steals from a stall and tries to trade the stall owner. One of them is always near a bakery stall, so the player can easily steal food to heal from failed pickpocketing attempts. Unlike most thievable NPCs, players can be stunned frequently when pickpocketing heroes even at level 99 Thieving. A successful pickpocket attempt usually gains between 200 and 300 coins.

label: Heroes' Guild
title: Heroes' Guild
lead: The Heroes' Guild is located just south of Burthorpe. The guild is only accessible to members who have completed the Heroes' Quest. Dragon maces and dragon battleaxes can be purchased here, and amulets of glory can be recharged at the fountain in the basement of the guild.

label: Heroes' Guild mine
title: Heroes' Guild mine
lead:
The Heroes' Guild mine is a mine located in the basement of the Heroes' Guild. Players must have completed the Heroes' Quest to enter.

There are several non-aggressive giant bats, as well as a caged blue dragon. The nearest bank is in the Rogues' Den or the Warriors' Guild, though a teleport may be a better idea if using a Games necklace to return to Burthorpe.

label: Heroes' Quest
title: Heroes' Quest
lead:
Heroes' Quest is a quest that gives access to the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe, by completing the guildmaster's rigorous initiation test.

Note: This quest requires another player to complete. Players may use the Grouping interface's "Join" button on the Shield of Arrav category to enter a chat-channel for finding a partner.

label: Herquin
title: Herquin
lead:
Herquin owns the shop Herquin's Gems in the city of Falador. He can be found in his shop south of the western Falador bank.

Herquin was visited during the 2018 Birthday event, helping the player with finding a semi-precious blue gem to use for their prop sword.

label: Herquin's Gems.
title: Herquin's Gems.
lead:
Herquin's Gems is located on the west side of Falador, just south of the west bank. It is owned by Herquin.

This shop only stocks one uncut sapphire and one sapphire; all of its other gems are stocked when players sell them to him. Because other players will usually pay more for gems than this shop will, players tend not to sell their gems to it and as such his shop is often empty.

label: Herring
title: Herring
lead: Herring is a type of fish that restores 5 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw herring on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 5 Cooking and granting 50 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt herring. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Herring is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 41, or 38 when using the Lumbridge range.

label: Hetty
title: Hetty
lead: Hetty is a witch who can be found in Rimmington and is involved in the Witch's Potion quest, which revolves around gathering ingredients for her to complete her potion.

label: Hickton
title: Hickton
lead: Hickton is the master of Fletching, and resides in a two-story building near the bank in central Catherby. Hickton also owns an archery supplies shop called Hickton's Archery Emporium. Players with level 99 in Fletching may buy a Fletching cape from Hickton. To purchase the cape, players have to access Hickton's Archery Emporium by trading him to see the cape being sold for 99,000 coins.

label: Hickton's Archery Emporium.
title: Hickton's Archery Emporium.
lead: Hickton's Archery Emporium is located in central Catherby. Players with 99 Fletching may visit the store to buy the Fletching Cape of Accomplishment for 99,000 coins. Unlike most archery stores, Hickton's Archery Emporium stocks arrowtips for players who wish to create their own arrows using the Fletching skill.

label: High Level Alchemy
title: High Level Alchemy
lead:
High Level Alchemy (also known as high alch, hi alch, or HA) is a utility spell available in the standard spellbook. It requires level 55 Magic to cast, and grants 65 Magic experience per cast.

When cast on an item in the player's inventory, the item is converted into a number of coins equivalent to 60% of the item's value (not the item's Grand Exchange price). This is a 50% higher yield than Low Level Alchemy.

label: High Priest (Entrana)
title: High Priest (Entrana)
lead:
The High Priest of Entrana is one of the most powerful holy men in the Saradominist religion. He resides in the church on the holy island of Entrana, the most influential Saradomin-aligned settlement in all of Gielinor. He plays a role in Desert Treasure I, a large role in Devious Minds, and minor roles in the Heroes' Quest and Holy Grail quests.

Players can also give him a holy sheet to obtain an unlimited supply of Saradominist paint.

label: High Seas
title: High Seas
lead:
High Seas is a music track that is unlocked in Brimhaven, including on the island accessible by fairy ring code . In this area, the music player will shuffle between this track, Jolly R and Landlubber. It also unlocks during Pandemonium.

In Classic mode, the track only plays around the Brimhaven town centre.

label: Highwayman
title: Highwayman
lead: Highwaymen are a level five NPC which are aggressive towards players below a combat level of 11. One will always exclaim when they target a player. Players with a Combat level below 11 are advised to quickly run past when encountering them.

label: Highwayman mask
title: Highwayman mask
lead:
The highwayman mask is a black mask similar to the ones highwaymen wear. It can be obtained from Easy Treasure Trails. Some players argue that it is very different, but when shown on a player while in game, they look almost identical to the ones worn by the NPC highwaymen. However, the only highwayman to be featured in chat is Rick Turpentine, who looks like the player in chat.

These masks, like many other accessories, do not give any combat bonuses. Players who have completed the Cabin Fever quest can take the mask and a Black cavalier to Patchy on Mos Le'Harmless, and have them sewn together to create a Cavalier and mask for 500 coins. The highwayman mask can be worn along with a plain black Cape, brown Fremennik shirt, and Steel sword to resemble the highwayman himself.

label: Highwayman mask (unobtainable item)
title: Highwayman mask (unobtainable item)
lead:
The Highwayman mask is an unobtainable item that was added to the RuneScape 2 beta. It has an identical name and appearance to the Highwayman mask obtainable from Treasure Trails.

Its purpose is unknown, though it may have been accidentally added to the game early when the Highwayman mask's model was added to the level up screen for Thieving.

label: Hild
title: Hild
lead: Hild is a woman that lives in the small city of Burthorpe in the north-eastern corner. She has a small involvement in A Tail of Two Cats. She enchants the catspeak amulet for five death runes.

label: Hill Giant
title: Hill Giant
lead:
A Hill Giant is a type of giant found in several locations around Gielinor. For free-to-play, the Edgeville Dungeon offers the most spawns, while for members, the Shayzien Giant Pit also has numerous spawns. The Edgeville dungeon may be accessed through the entrance located in the house north-east of Barbarian Village and west of the Cooks' Guild if the player has a brass key. The Edgeville Dungeon area is usually very crowded in free-to-play worlds, as players like to gather big bones to bury them for Prayer experience. Another free-to-play hill giants area was added at the Giants' Plateau, near Al Kharid (located east of the Al Kharid General Store and Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar., east past the gap in the gate). They are aggressive to players below combat level 57.

There are two Hill Giants in level 17-18 Wilderness, but the area is unsuitable for training due to the possibility of player killers and its long distance from the nearest bank, found in Ferox Enclave.

label: History of iban
title: History of iban
lead:
The History of iban, or The Tale of Iban, is found in the chest found within the witch's house during the Underground Pass quest. It gives some history on Iban, how he was killed, as well as a few hints on how to defeat him.

After completion of the Underground Pass quest, the book can be found on the shelves in the player's house and it can also be found in the Grand Library in Prifddinas after completion of Song of the Elves.

label: Hitpoints
title: Hitpoints
lead: Hitpoints (also known as "health" or "HP") represent a player's health. If they reach zero, the player will die. Hitpoints is the only skill for which players start with any experience initially - with 1,154 experience points, placing them at exactly level 10 on Tutorial Island.

label: Hitpoints Level Up! (2-49)
title: Hitpoints Level Up! (2-49)
lead: Hitpoints Level Up! (2-49) is a jingle for levelling Hitpoints.

label: Hitpoints Level Up! (50-99)
title: Hitpoints Level Up! (50-99)
lead: Hitpoints Level Up! (50-99) is a jingle for levelling Hitpoints.

label: Hobbes
title: Hobbes
lead: Hobbes is the butler to the Sinclair family. He is one of the suspects in Murder Mystery, and a witness in King's Ransom.

label: Hobgoblin
title: Hobgoblin
lead: Hobgoblins are low-to-medium levelled monsters which hit fairly accurately for their combat level. They come in two variations outside of the God Wars Dungeon, with the level 28 variant usually unarmed and the level 42 variant wielding a spear, although some level 28 hobgoblins found north-east of the Vinery in Hosidius as well as one west of the Crafting Guild wield spears too. The narrow strip of land alongside the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild, and Tree Gnome Village dungeon (requires a key), contain many level 28 hobgoblins with no level 42 variants present.

label: Hobgoblin Peninsula
title: Hobgoblin Peninsula
lead:
The Hobgoblin Peninsula is an area west of the Crafting Guild.

It is crawling with several level 28 hobgoblins. On members servers, it spawns 3 snape grass in the sand pit near the end of the island. Some players gather the snape grass for a small profit, but since the peninsula is far away from a bank, this is not done by many players. The quickest way to get there is via the skills necklace teleport to the Crafting Guild.

label: Hole (Skavid caves)
title: Hole (Skavid caves)
lead:
A hole can be found in the Mad skavid's cave in the Skavid caves. Climbing down to the hole will result in the player appearing 2 tiles west of the hole in Yanille and 4 token Agility experience being granted. It will also result in two chatbox messages saying:
# You enter the tunnel.
# So that's how the skavids are getting into Yanille!

label: Hole (Yanille)
title: Hole (Yanille)
lead: A hole can be found in the northern side of Yanille. It cannot be interacted with; instead, it serves as the other end of the hole in the Skavid caves.

label: Holgart
title: Holgart
lead:
Holgart can be found north of Witchaven near Caroline and Jeb, just outside of Caroline's house, and he sails the player to and from the Fishing Platform prior to the completion of Slug Menace after the player has helped him by repairing his boat with swamp paste. If players start The Slug Menace quest, he will no longer take them to the Fishing Platform as he is replaced by the sea slug-controlled Jeb since Mayor Hobb confiscated Holgart's boat and gave it to Jeb. As Holgart's skill is only sailing, he laments that he "don't know what to do without his boat".

Throughout the entire Sea Slug quest series, he is one of the few remaining villagers of Witchaven who is not possessed by sea slugs.

label: hollow reed
title: hollow reed
lead:
A hollow reed is an item obtained by using a machete or knife on the tall reeds in various areas: in the pure water spring in the centre of the Kharazi Jungle, at the start of the blessed River Salve near Paterdomus, and from the reeds found at a pool in the Kourend Woodland.

The reed is used during the Legends' Quest, where it must be used on the pure water spring in the Kharazi Jungle to obtain a golden bowl filled with pure water.

label: Hollow reed (unobtainable item)
title: Hollow reed (unobtainable item)
lead:
A Hollow reed is an unobtainable version of the Hollow reed. Reeds could previously be traded and turned into bank notes; however, they were made untradeable in 2007 due to frequent use in scams. Any player who had a noted Hollow reed was given this now discontinued item. Originally, it was identical to the real reed, except stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Holthion
title: Holthion
lead:
Holthion is a demon encountered during the Underground Pass quest. When killed, it drops the amulet of holthion, which is needed to obtain Iban's shadow. Protect from Melee should be used during this part of the quest to save hitpoints for coping with its attacks.

It is possible to use the small bridges connecting the platforms as a safespot to attack using Ranged, Magic, or with a halberd. In the quest, the player must also kill the other demons, Othainian and Doomion.

label: Holy barrier
title: Holy barrier
lead: The Holy barrier is a barrier that allows the player to enter Morytania. It is located in the underground mausoleum north of the Paterdomus Temple and is unlocked after completion of the Priest in Peril quest.

label: Holy force
title: Holy force
lead:
Holy force is an item that players receive during the Legends' Quest by showing Ungadulu the dark dagger. Players must use it to reveal the true form of Echned Zekin (which is that of the demon Nezikchened) and to prevent him from draining their prayer.

This item does not have any use following the Legends' Quest, and can be re-obtained by using another dark dagger or glowing dagger on Ungadulu. This no longer works after quest completion.

label: Holy Grail
title: Holy Grail
lead: The Holy Grail quest is the second part of the Camelot quest series, where you must help King Arthur find the holy grail. The grail is found to be missing from its original location in Entrana, protected by the Fisher King in the Fisher Realm.

label: Holy grail (item)
title: Holy grail (item)
lead:
The Holy grail is a quest item in both the Holy Grail and King's Ransom quests.

During the Holy Grail quest, the main objective is to retrieve it from a table on the of the east side of the Fisher King's castle in the Fisher Realm. During the quest, King Arthur informs you that it has just passed between dimensions into Gielinor. Should you choose to accept the quest and retrieve the Holy grail, you must travel to the Fisher Realm. If you attempt to take it before it's time, you will receive a message saying that you're not worthy of it. It is used to finish the quest by speaking to King Arthur while in your possession.

label: Holy Lake
title: Holy Lake
lead:
The Holy Lake is a small body of water located south of Tai Bwo Wannai on the island of Karamja. It is the only place where karambwanji fish may be caught. The western end of the lake flows into a cave, on the other end of which it emerges into the Ardent Ocean. A number of hobgoblins can be found along the Holy Lake's southern shore.

The lake's name is only used by Lubufu the fisherman during Tai Bwo Wannai Trio.

label: Holy mould
title: Holy mould
lead:
A holy mould is a Crafting tool used in a furnace to make unstrung symbols from silver bars.

They can be purchased from Rasolo, north-west of East Ardougne, Jamila's Craft Stall in Sophanem, Dommik's Crafting Store in north-eastern Al Kharid, or from Rommik's Crafty Supplies in Rimmington. An unlimited amount can be taken from a player-owned house tool store 4.

label: Holy symbol
title: Holy symbol
lead:
A holy symbol is an amulet donning the symbol of Saradomin. They are made by having an unblessed symbol blessed by Brother Jered in the Edgeville Monastery, or by blessing it via using a holy book or book of balance on an unblessed symbol at 50 Prayer, requiring a few prayer points. As Brother Jered is located on the upper floor of the monastery, blessing the symbol effectively requires a minimum of level 31 Prayer due to the entry requirement.

It has the third highest prayer bonus for an amulet in game (after god stoles and the dragonbone necklace). It is cheap, easy to obtain, and is commonly used in conjunction with Proselyte armour and other high prayer granting armour when using protect prayers as a form of defence while training.

label: Holy table napkin
title: Holy table napkin
lead:
The holy table napkin is a quest item obtained from Galahad in the Holy Grail quest. It is used to see the magic whistle spawn in Draynor Manor's top floor.

If the player wants to return to the Fisher Realm, it can be safely dropped if the player has access to fairy rings or keeps the magic whistle from the quest.

label: holy water
title: holy water
lead:
Holy water is a Ranged weapon that is used just like throwing knives and darts; however, it will only deal damage against demons. Throwing holy water will cause the vial to break, dropping smashed glass on the floor. This makes holy water a single-use weapon. Holy water is non-tradeable and has a +6 Ranged attack bonus when wielded. As a demonbane weapon, it has an attribute affinity for demons; the item's max hit is increased by 60% in a similar fashion to that of Silverlight. On top of that, it gains an additional +5 damage bonus if the demon is Nezikchened. Upon a successful hit, it will drain the opponent's Defence level by 5%, provided it is a demon. Multiple holy water hits will not stack their Defence reduction.

Holy water uses a different form of damage calculation compared to how regular maximum Ranged hits are determined, which ignores some factors that normally serve to increase Ranged damage. For instance, while boosting one's visible Ranged level will result in an increased maximum hit when using holy water, the use of stat-boosting prayers such as Eagle Eye or Rigour will not, nor does the set effect of Void ranger armour apply to holy water.

label: hopper
title: hopper
lead: A Hopper can be found in a Windmill. Grain can be put in the hopper, after which the nearby hopper controls can be used to mill the grain into flour that can then be collected from the flour bin.

label: Hopper controls
title: Hopper controls
lead: Hopper controls can be found in any of the windmills in RuneScape. After putting grain in the nearby hopper, players can operate the controls to make the grain slide down into the flour bin below, where it can be collected.

label: Hops (Biohazard)
title: Hops (Biohazard)
lead:
Hops is one of the three individuals used in the Biohazard quest to deliver the dangerous chemicals to Varrock. During Biohazard, you need to give him the sulphuric broline.

Prior to the quest, Hops can only be found near the Chemist's house in Rimmington, wandering back and forth and drinking. After the quest, he can be found in both Rimmington and the Dancing Donkey Inn in Varrock. He is always accompanied by his associates Da Vinci and Chancy.

label: Horacio
title: Horacio
lead: Horacio Dobson is the gardener to Lord Handelmort, tending the grounds of his house in East Ardougne. He plays a minor role in the Tribal Totem quest.

label: Horizon
title: Horizon
lead:
Horizon is a music track that is unlocked in Taverley, or during the Bee keeper random event. In this area, the music area will shuffle between playing this track and Splendour.

In Classic music mode outside the Bee keeper random event, the music will play in southern Taverley.

label: Horvik
title: Horvik
lead:
Horvik Ravitz is an armoursmith located north-east of the Varrock square. The building he is located in is called Horvik's Smithy, and is the owner of Horvik's Armour Shop.

During One Small Favour, he is asked by the player to create some chicken cages for Seth Groats. He does this in return for a herbal antidote, for his illness, and some pigeon cages to make the chicken cages from.

label: Horvik's Armour Shop.
title: Horvik's Armour Shop.
lead: Horvik's Armour Shop is located near central Varrock. It is operated by Horvik, and he specialises in selling chainbodies and platebodies. The shop is unusual because the building also houses an anvil. This makes it a convenient place for a player to sell armour as they smith it. By default, Horvik's stock consists of bronze, iron, steel, and mithril chainbodies; bronze, iron, steel, black, and mithril platebodies; and studded body and chaps.

label: Hudo
title: Hudo
lead:
Hudo Glenfad is a gnome who operates Grand Tree Groceries. His store is located in the north-west corner of the in the Grand Tree, which is in Gnome Stronghold.

His store is essential for preparing the gnome cuisine dishes in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. He sells Gianne dough among many other food items. He is generally only used by players playing the minigame, although he provides the most food items of any food shop. On the players can find some tools in the Kitchen cabinet that needed to make Gnome cooking.

label: Hudon
title: Hudon
lead: Hudon is a child involved with the Waterfall Quest. His mother is Almera who is the starting point for the quest. He ran away from his mother's house to look for the treasure under the Baxtorian Falls. However, he is never rescued from the falls during the quest and cannot be rescued, despite this being the initial objective of the quest at first. If you talk to him after you finish the quest, he will claim that you stole his treasure.

label: hunk of crystal
title: hunk of crystal
lead:
The hunk of crystal is a quest item used during the Legends' Quest. It is obtained by defeating Irvig Senay in the Viyeldi caves beneath the Kharazi Jungle. When combined with the chunk of crystal and the lump of crystal (obtained by defeating the other two warriors) at the furnace, they form the heart crystal required to unlock a door that leads further into the caves.

It is not possible to obtain the heart fragments after completing the quest; killing the knights again does not provide the player with the fragments. However, duplicate parts of the crystal can be obtained during the quest by utilising the drop trick. If the player does this, they are able to create another (albeit useless) heart crystal after completing the quest.

label: Hygd
title: Hygd
lead: Hygd is a citizen of Burthorpe. She tells the player a little of what is going on in the town.

label: Iban
title: Iban
lead: Iban is a former Kinshra knight and self-proclaimed son of Zamorak. He rules over the Underground Pass and is the primary adversary in the quest of the same name.

label: Iban (music track)
title: Iban (music track)
lead: Iban is a music track unlocked in Iban's lair during the Underground Pass quest.

label: Iban Blast
title: Iban Blast
lead:
Iban Blast is a combat spell that can be cast at 50 Magic while on the standard spellbook. Without Magic damage boosts, it can inflict up to 25 damage. Because of its very high max hit compared to other spells on the standard spellbook, it is often recommended for casters in situations where another staff is not required.

To cast this spell, the player must be wielding Iban's staff; thus, the player must complete Underground Pass and have level 50 Attack in order to be able to cast this spell. Each cast consumes one charge from Iban's staff when cast on an NPC, or two charges if cast on another player. Thus this spell can be cast a total of 120 times (60 in PvP) before the staff must be recharged. This is increased to 2,500 (1,250 in PvP) with Iban's upgraded staff.

label: Iban's ashes
title: Iban's ashes
lead:
Iban's ashes is a quest item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by emptying a bucket of dwarf brew over Iban's tomb and lighting it on fire. This cremates Iban's remains, leaving his ashes behind.

The ashes are used on the doll of Iban, along with other things, to banish the evil wizard, Iban, from Gielinor.

label: Iban's dove
title: Iban's dove
lead:
Iban's dove is an item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by searching cages of half-soulless deep in the dungeon west of West Ardougne.

It is wise for anyone doing the Underground Pass quest to remember to wear their Klank's gauntlets while searching the cages of the soulless. They will bite players who searching the cages, however, if the player is wearing the gauntlets, the player will take no damage. Searching the cages without wearing the gloves will result in losing 10 hitpoints.

label: Iban's shadow
title: Iban's shadow
lead:
Iban's shadow is a quest item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by killing the level 91 demons Doomion, Othanian, and Holthion and then using the amulets that they drop on the chest near where they are found. Reopening the chest, while in possession of the item or having had used it on the doll, will show that it is empty.

The shadow is used on the doll of iban obtained earlier in the quest in order to banish the evil wizard, Iban, from Gielinor.

label: Iban's staff
title: Iban's staff
lead:
Iban's staff is a staff used to cast Iban Blast. It is obtained by defeating the evil mage Iban at the end of the Underground Pass quest. Iban's staff requires 50 Magic and 50 Attack to wield. Casting Iban Blast on a monster consumes one charge from the staff and casting it on another player consumes two charges. Casting other spells, like Fire Blast, does not consume any charges.

If Iban's staff is lost, Koftik will give a broken staff to the player. It must then be brought to the Dark Mage with to repair it.

label: Iban's Temple
title: Iban's Temple
lead:
Iban's Temple is a small building located at the end of the Underground Pass. It is visited briefly during the Underground Pass quest. During the quest, players must throw the Doll of Iban into the well at the centre of the temple while being hit by Iban's spells. After the quest is complete, once Regicide is started, players can use the Well of Voyage found within the temple to travel to Tirannwn, the land of the elves. Prior to Regicide, it was possible to go back to Iban's Temple and try to throw a second doll into the well, yielding the message, "Iban is already dead...", even though Iban was still in the room as if nothing had happened.

This temple was created by Iban, Zamorak's disciple, as a stronghold. It is possible he knew of the powers of the Well of Voyage, but in any case, he corrupted the well and turned it into the Well of the Damned.

label: Iban's Throne
title: Iban's Throne
lead: Iban's Throne is the throne of Iban, ruler of the Underground Pass and self-proclaimed son of Zamorak. Directly in front of the throne lies the Well of Voyage, which provides passage to Isafdar. At the end of the Underground Pass quest, the throne is destroyed when the temple collapses.

label: Ice arrows
title: Ice arrows
lead:
Ice arrows are a quest item in the Temple of Ikov quest. They have the same Ranged Strength as steel arrows, but must be fired from a yew bow or better.

In the Temple of Ikov quest, they are collected randomly when searching chests in the eastern Temple of Ikov dungeon and required to defeat the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus. While not required, ice arrows can also be used to defeat Fareed from the Desert Treasure I quest, as all other ammunition will drop to the floor as ashes, bypassing the ammo-saving effect of Ava's devices.

label: Ice Column
title: Ice Column
lead: Two Ice Columns can be found within the throne room of the Ice Queen's Lair, which is under White Wolf Mountain. They have no use outside of scenery.

label: ice giant
title: ice giant
lead:
Ice giants are tall, light blue giants that appear at certain icy areas of the game. They are the second strongest giant type out of the standard giants, weaker than Fire giants, but stronger than Moss and Hill giants.

Ice giants are assigned only by Vannaka and Krystilia, although they aren't often killed by players outside of Wilderness slayer due to their poor loot compared to the weaker moss giants and hill giants. Ice giants have separate variants where they appear to be holding different weapons; a longsword, a warhammer, or a macuahuitl.

label: Ice gloves
title: Ice gloves
lead:
Ice gloves are a piece of armour dropped by the Ice Queen under White Wolf Mountain. The gloves are required for multiple quests, as well as several skilling activities. They can be combined with Smiths gloves to combine the effects of both in Smiths gloves (i). This process is reversible.

Although the Ice Queen is a high level, she is very easy to kill, especially when using Protect from Melee. You do not need to start Heroes' Quest to obtain the ice gloves, and the gloves can be obtained as many times as desired. The gloves are obtainable at level 3; however, a boostable level of 50 Mining is required to mine an obstacle on the path to her lair.

label: Ice Light
title: Ice Light
lead: Ice lights are examinable scenery in the Ice Queen's Lair under White Wolf Mountain.

label: Ice Melody
title: Ice Melody
lead: Ice Melody is a music track that is unlocked on White Wolf Mountain.

label: Ice Mountain
title: Ice Mountain
lead: Ice Mountain is located just north-west of Barbarian Village, and the main entrance to the Dwarven Mine is located on its lower southern slope. It dominates northern Asgarnia, and is Asgarnia's only remaining region in which it snows year-round.

label: Ice Queen
title: Ice Queen
lead:
The Ice Queen is a monster found beneath White Wolf Mountain, known for dropping ice gloves. A boostable level of 50 Mining is required to reach her.

Players must fight the Ice Queen to obtain ice gloves for Heroes' Quest, but it is not required to start the quest to be able to fight her, making it possible for skillers to obtain the gloves. A method of fighting the queen while gaining minimal combat experience is shown below.

label: Ice Queen's Lair
title: Ice Queen's Lair
lead:
The Ice Queen's Lair is a dungeon located under the White Wolf Mountain. The entrance is blocked by a rock slide requiring a pickaxe and level 50 Mining to remove. The rock slide can not be mined by another player. The lair plays a major role in Heroes' Quest, where players must kill the Ice Queen to obtain ice gloves. Player can get there quickly via the gnome glider.

If a player loses their ice gloves, they may acquire a new pair by slaying the queen again, but because the dungeon is out of the way, it's recommended to get multiple pairs during the quest.

label: Ice spider
title: Ice spider
lead:
Ice spiders are one of the stronger species of spider. They are seldom killed due to having very few drops except when on a Wilderness Slayer task.

They do not appear on the player's minimap.

label: Ice Throne
title: Ice Throne
lead: Ice Throne is the throne used by the Ice Queen, found in her lair.

label: ice warrior
title: ice warrior
lead:
Ice warriors are mid-level elemental warriors. Ice warriors can be formidable foes to those with low levels. Ice warriors can be assigned by Krystilia for a Wilderness Slayer task, or by Vannaka or Mazchna for normal tasks.

Ice warriors have 100% elemental weakness to fire spells.

label: Id papers
title: Id papers
lead: The id papers is needed to get into ScarFace Pete's mansion during the Heroes' Quest. Using it while the player is dressed in full Black armour will allow the player to pass themself off as a Black Knight called Hartigen. The ID paper can be obtained by talking to Trobert.

label: Ima
title: Ima
lead: Ima is one of the people observing the fights at the Emir's Arena. He says few lines with some importance though usually just random chitchat. He also walks around Dalal.

label: imp
title: imp
lead:
Imps are amongst the smallest creatures in Gielinor. They are central in the Imp Catcher quest due to their unique bead drops. Every 30–120 seconds there is a 25% chance for an imp to disappear into a puff of smoke and teleport a short distance away. At level 71 Hunter players may catch imps with magic boxes, including imps found in the God Wars Dungeon.

Outside of the bead drops, imps are primarily killed to obtain God Wars Dungeon Zamorak kill-count, and for their extremely rare Imp champion scroll drop.

label: Imp (unused)
title: Imp (unused)
lead:
Level 3 Imps are unused non-player characters that previously appeared in the Imp Catcher quest. Originally, Wizard Grayzag had a combat level of 41 and could be fought by the player, during which he would summon stronger variants of Imps. In 2006, the quest was reworked; from now on players could only talk to Grayzag instead of fighting him. Therefore, the stronger imps could no longer be encountered in game, although they remained in the game files and were graphically updated several months later.

As they became discontinued before August 2007, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape. Ultimately, they were removed from the game files altogether on 6 January 2021.

label: Imp Catcher
title: Imp Catcher
lead: The Wizard Grayzag has summoned hundreds of little imps. They have stolen a lot of things belonging to the Wizard Mizgog including his magic beads.

label: Improved Reflexes
title: Improved Reflexes
lead:
Improved Reflexes is a prayer unlocked at level 16 Prayer. It increases the player's Attack by 10%.

Like all other Melee-boosting prayers, it cannot be used with any Ranged or Magic prayers nor can it be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Attack level, such as Incredible Reflexes.

label: In the Manor
title: In the Manor
lead: In the Manor is a music track that is unlocked south of Yanille.

label: Incinerator (Sheep Herder)
title: Incinerator (Sheep Herder)
lead:
The Incinerator is used during the Sheep Herder quest to dispose of bones from the surrounding "infected" sheep.

It is later uncovered during Biohazard that the plague was fake.

label: Incomplete pizza
title: Incomplete pizza
lead:
An Incomplete pizza is an item that players will usually make only intermittently whilst making a plain pizza. It is made by using a tomato with a pizza base.

As the examine text implies, players will usually use this with cheese to make an uncooked pizza, which they will then cook on a range to make a plain pizza. This requires level 35 Cooking, and is open to members and non-members.

label: Incomplete stew
title: Incomplete stew
lead: Incomplete stew is made by using a potato, cooked meat, or a cooked chicken on a bowl of water, requiring level 25 Cooking. The final product is the same regardless of which of the two types of meat is used. The ingredients can be added in any order. Adding the last ingredient creates an uncooked stew.

label: Incredible Reflexes
title: Incredible Reflexes
lead:
Incredible Reflexes is a prayer unlocked at level 34 Prayer. Incredible Reflexes increases the player's Attack by 15%. It is commonly used by players in mini-games, such as Castle Wars and the Emir's Arena, due to the fact that the player's prayer points are instantly refunded at the end of each scrimmage.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Attack level, such as Piety.

label: Insect Queen
title: Insect Queen
lead: Insect Queen is a music track that is unlocked in the Kalphite lair and the Kalphite cave.

label: Insect repellent
title: Insect repellent
lead:
Insect repellent is a container of bug spray that can be used on beehives, large mosquitoes, and mosquito swarms.

Using insect repellent on beehives, located in the apiary west of Catherby and in southern Seers' Village, causes the bees to leave. Using a bucket on the beehive then gives a bucket of wax, which is used in Merlin's Crystal and Troll Romance. Insect repellent must be used on the beehive every time, otherwise the bees will have returned and no wax will be collected.

label: Inspiration
title: Inspiration
lead:
Inspiration is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays north-east of the Black Knights' Fortress in the Wilderness.

label: Instruction manual
title: Instruction manual
lead:
The Instruction manual, or Dwarf Multicannon Manual, is a book that details how to set up and fire the dwarf multicannon, how to create cannonballs, and includes warranty information for the dwarf multicannon.

After completion Dwarf Cannon, it is found on a bookshelf in a player-owned house or is purchasable from Multicannon parts for sale for coins or Rasolo the Wandering Merchant for coins.

label: Intel report
title: Intel report
lead: Intel report is obtained during the Shield of Arrav quest by killing the Jonny the Beard. It needs to be taken to Straven for admission to Phoenix Gang.

label: Intrepid
title: Intrepid
lead: Intrepid is a music track that is unlocked in lower floor of Iban's lair during the Underground Pass quest.

label: Invasion plans
title: Invasion plans
lead:
The invasion plans are an item used during the The Grand Tree quest. Players obtain it by using Glough's key on the locked chest in Glough's home just south of the Grand Tree.

Along with the lumber order, players should take this to King Narnode Shareen as evidence against Glough.

label: Invitation letter
title: Invitation letter
lead:
The invitation letter is a quest item used in The Dig Site to gain access to the winches. It is obtained from Terry Balando after the player has brought him the Ancient talisman. Giving it to any digsite workman grants them access to the dig shafts.

It is possible to obtain multiple letters by using the drop trick. Should the player use another letter on a workman, they will ask "What an earth are you giving me another scroll for?"

label: Invrigar the Necromancer
title: Invrigar the Necromancer
lead: Invrigar is a necromancer found on the top floor of the Necromancer Tower. He will use magic to attack the player and will sometimes summon a level 13 Summoned Zombie to fight with him.

label: Iou
title: Iou
lead:
The iou is a quest item that appears in the Death Plateau quest. Harold gives it to the player in lieu of payment for a gambling debt he owes from a dice rolling game.

When the player inspects the back of the IOU, they will discover that it is really the combination to the equipment room in Burthorpe Castle. This item is lost at the completion of Death Plateau quest.

label: Irena
title: Irena
lead: Irena is a woman from Al Kharid, and the mother of Ana, an eager explorer/tourist. Recently, she went down into the Kharidian Desert and Irena hasn't seen her since, so she waits and sobs at the gates of the Shantay Pass, waiting for Ana to return, and waiting for an adventurer to arrive and help her. A player can talk to her to begin The Tourist Trap.

label: Irit leaf
title: Irit leaf
lead:
Irit leaf ( ) is a mid level herb that can be cleaned at level 40 Herblore. Each cleaned irit leaf yields 8.8 Herblore experience. It is commonly dropped while fighting chaos druids, but can be dropped by almost every monster capable of dropping herbs.

To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create an irit potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient. You can create super attack potions by adding an eye of newt. Creating super attack potions is considered one of the easiest methods to train Herblore, especially for ironmen, as eyes of newt are very easy to obtain, and the finished product is very useful for combat purposes. Eye of newt packs can be bought for 300 gp at various shops, and contain 100 eyes of newt. You can also create superantipoison potions by adding unicorn horn dust. In order to create an antidote++ however, you need to add the irit leaf to a vial of coconut milk, creating antidote++ (unf), and add magic roots as secondary ingredients.

label: Irit potion (unf)
title: Irit potion (unf)
lead: An irit potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using an irit leaf on a vial of water, requiring 45 Herblore. Using an eye of newt on an irit potion (unf) with 45 Herblore yields a super attack(3) and 100 Herblore experience. Using a unicorn horn dust on an irit potion (unf) with 48 Herblore yields a superantipoison(3) and 106.3 Herblore experience.

label: Irksol
title: Irksol
lead: Irksol is an otherworldly being selling ruby rings at his shop in the Zanaris market.

label: Irksol (shop)
title: Irksol (shop)
lead: Irksol is a store run by Irksol in the Zanaris marketplace. The shop only sells ruby rings, and it is decorated with fairy market stalls.

label: Iron 2h sword
title: Iron 2h sword
lead:
The iron 2h sword is a two-handed sword that is stronger than the bronze 2h sword. As with other iron weaponry, it can be wielded at level 1 Attack.

Players can make an iron 2h sword with the Smithing skill at level 29 using 3 iron bars, giving the player 75 Smithing experience.

label: Iron arrow
title: Iron arrow
lead:
Iron arrows are stronger than bronze arrows, and are compatible with most bows. Iron arrows can be made at level 15 Fletching by using 15 iron arrowtips on 15 headless arrows, granting 37.5 Fletching experience. As with most arrows, they can be poisoned.

Iron arrows can be purchased from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock.

label: Iron arrowtips
title: Iron arrowtips
lead:
Iron arrowtips are made with an iron bar requiring 20 Smithing, yielding Smithing 25 experience and 15 iron arrowtips. They are made into iron arrows when used with headless arrows, requiring 15 Fletching, yielding 37.5 experience per 15 arrows.

They are purchased for coins at the ranging shops: Hickton's Archery Emporium in Catherby, Dargaud's Bow and Arrows in the Ranging Guild, Gulluck and Sons on the of the Grand Tree, Void Knight Archery Store at the Void Knights' Outpost, and Ava's Odds and Ends in Draynor Manor. They are purchased for coins at the Armoury in the Combat Training Camp.

label: Iron axe
title: Iron axe
lead:
The iron axe is the second weakest axe in Old School RuneScape, being slightly better than the bronze axe. It can be used in combat or in Woodcutting to cut trees. An iron axe has the same level requirements as a bronze axe, making it the better choice for new players.

The success rate for chopping a log is approximately 150% that of the Bronze axe.

label: Iron axe head
title: Iron axe head
lead:
The iron axe head is an unobtainable item that was originally used in the axe handle random event. The axe head would become detached from the player's axe while Woodcutting. To fix their axe, players had to collect the axe head off the ground and reattach it to the axe handle.

A similar event used to happen to players while Mining, but with a pickaxe head and pickaxe handle.

label: Iron bar
title: Iron bar
lead:
An iron bar is a bar of refined iron. It can be created through the Smithing skill at level 15 by using iron ore on a furnace, granting 12.5 Smithing experience. When smelting iron ore, there is a 50% chance that it will be too impure; it disappears, yielding no Smithing experience nor an iron bar. However, wearing a ring of forging, casting Superheat Item, or using the Blast Furnace would give a 100% success rate.

An iron bar can be smithed on an anvil through the Smithing skill to create iron weapons and armour. When smithed, each bar grants 25 experience, with a maximum of 125 being given for the iron platebody.

label: Iron battleaxe
title: Iron battleaxe
lead:
The iron battleaxe is the second-weakest battleaxe in Old School RuneScape, being more powerful than the bronze battleaxe. Like all iron weapons, it can be wielded at level 1 Attack.

Players can make an iron battleaxe with level 25 Smithing using three iron bars, giving 75 experience. It is a slashing weapon, which makes it good for monsters with a slash weakness. Players can purchase this battleaxe from Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar in Port Sarim and Bob's Brilliant Axes shop in Lumbridge.

label: Iron chainbody
title: Iron chainbody
lead:
The iron chainbody is the second weakest chainbody, and can be worn by a player with 1 Defence. A player with 26 Smithing can make the chainbody by using three iron bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 75 Smithing experience.

An iron chainbody is required for the Black Knights' Fortress, King's Ransom, and While Guthix Sleeps quests.

label: Iron claws
title: Iron claws
lead:
Iron claws are a two-handed melee weapon. They are the second weakest claws available and can be wielded at 1 Attack.

Iron claws can be obtained by making them using the Smithing skill, or buying them from Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den. The requirements for making them are completing the Death Plateau quest and 28 Smithing. To make them, use two iron bars on an anvil with a hammer in the inventory. This will grant the player 50 Smithing experience.

label: Iron dagger
title: Iron dagger
lead:
The iron dagger is a dagger stronger than the bronze dagger. Players can make an iron dagger with the Smithing skill at level 15 using 1 iron bar, giving the player 25 Smithing experience. Members can poison this weapon, giving them an advantage in combat. Players can purchase this dagger from the Varrock Swordshop. There are also several spawn points throughout the map. As with most daggers, it can be poisoned.

Players with at least level 32 Thieving can get an iron dagger (p) by pickpocketing Rogues. Rogues are located south-west of the deep Wilderness Mage Arena.

label: iron dart
title: iron dart
lead:
Iron darts are Ranged throwing weapons made from iron. Iron darts can be wielded at level 1 Ranged. They can be obtained by using the Smithing and Fletching skills or trading with another player. Iron darts can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

To create iron darts the player must have completed the Tourist Trap quest and have at least level 19 Smithing and level 22 Fletching. Players can smith iron bars into iron dart tips. Each iron bar creates 10 iron dart tips and gives the player 25 Smithing experience. Feathers then must be added to create the iron darts. 3.8 Fletching experience is rewarded per iron dart fletched.

label: Iron dart tip
title: Iron dart tip
lead:
The iron dart tip is a dart tip made with the Smithing skill. Players can craft this item using an iron bar on an anvil with a hammer in their inventory and a Smithing level of 19. Each iron bar creates 10 iron dart tips and gives the player 25 Smithing experience. They can be fletched into iron darts at level 22 Fletching when used with feathers, granting 38 Fletching experience per 10 darts made.

To smith darts, one must complete the Tourist Trap quest.

label: Iron fire arrow
title: Iron fire arrow
lead:
Iron fire arrows are iron arrows wrapped in an oily cloth, which are then lit by using them on a tinderbox. They, along with any other fire arrow, are primarily used to pierce the rope in the Underground Pass to lower the bridge so that a player may walk across.

They have the same Ranged Strength as regular iron arrows.

label: Iron full helm
title: Iron full helm
lead:
The Iron full helm is a full helm made of iron. It is the second weakest full helmet available. While it grants greater defensive stats than its medium helmet counterpart, it has worse magic and ranged attack stats. There are no Defence requirements for wearing this helmet.

Players with level 22 Smithing can create an iron full helm by using two iron bars on an anvil while having a hammer in their inventory. Doing so will grant the player 50 Smithing experience.

label: Iron javelin
title: Iron javelin
lead:
The iron javelin is a type of member's only Ranged ammunition used by the light and heavy ballistas. They are the second weakest type of javelin. As with most javelins, they can be poisoned.

They can be fletched by attaching iron javelin tips to javelin shafts at level 17 Fletching, granting 30 experience per 15 javelins made. They can also be obtained by buying them from the Ranging Guild, the Void Knight Archery Store or from Oobapohk's Javelin Store after Monkey Madness II.

label: Iron key
title: Iron key
lead:
The iron key is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It is obtained by using a golden key on the southern Monument in the Paterdomus mausoleum.

It is used to unlock the cell Drezel is detained in.

label: Iron kiteshield
title: Iron kiteshield
lead:
The Iron kiteshield is the second-weakest smithable kiteshield, requiring 1 Defence to wield. A player with 27 Smithing can make the shield by using three iron bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 75 Smithing experience. It cannot be bought from Cassie's Shield Shop for ironmen, as there is no stock available.

The iron kiteshield yields the highest melee defence bonuses for any shield slot item at 1 Defence.

label: Iron knife
title: Iron knife
lead:
The iron knife is a throwing knife that does not require a Ranged level to wield. It is stronger than a bronze knife but weaker than a steel knife. To create iron knives, the player must have at least 22 Smithing. Each iron bar will create 5 iron knives and give the player 25 Smithing experience. They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Throwing knives are among the fastest weapons in the game (along with darts), and are commonly used for PKing or training Ranged. Iron knives can be purchased from Martin Thwait's Lost and Found shop in the Rogues' Den with 50 Thieving and 50 Agility.

label: Iron longsword
title: Iron longsword
lead: The iron longsword is a longsword stronger than the bronze longsword, but weaker than the steel longsword. Like all other iron weapons, it can be wielded at level 1 Attack. It can be created at level 21 Smithing using two iron bars, granting 50 experience. This longsword can be purchased at Varrock Swordshop.

label: Iron mace
title: Iron mace
lead:
The Iron mace is a mace made of iron. It is the second weakest mace available in the game. It requires level 1 Attack to wield, and can be created by using an iron bar on an anvil (as long as the player has level 17 Smithing). It can be bought at Flynn's Mace Market in Falador.

It can be found in the Edgeville jail and in a house to the east of the Ardougne market.

label: Iron med helm
title: Iron med helm
lead: The iron med helm is the second weakest medium helmet. A player with 18 Smithing can make the helmet by using one iron bar on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 25 Smithing experience.

label: Iron ore
title: Iron ore
lead: Iron ore can be mined from iron rocks at level 15 Mining, providing 35 Mining experience. It can be smelted at a furnace into an iron bar at level 15 Smithing, or along with two coal into a steel bar at level 30 Smithing. Smelting iron bars has a 50% success rate, unless the player is wearing a ring of forging, using the Superheat Item spell, or using the Blast Furnace. Smelting iron ore into a bar gives 12.5 Smithing experience, and smelting a steel bar gives 17.5 Smithing experience.

label: Iron pick head
title: Iron pick head
lead:
An iron pick head was obtained as part of a discontinued random event, in which the iron pickaxe head flew off the handle while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle.

If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another.

label: Iron pickaxe
title: Iron pickaxe
lead:
The iron pickaxe is a pickaxe that mines on a 7-tick cycle, 1-tick faster than the bronze pickaxe. It can be used in combat or to mine rocks.

As with all pickaxes, players cannot smith an iron pickaxe.

label: Iron platebody
title: Iron platebody
lead:
The iron platebody is an armour used in melee with stat bonuses between bronze and steel. It has no Defence requirement to equip, which makes it the best platebody for players just starting out. It also provides greater protection than an iron chainbody. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's Ranged and Magic stats.

If playing as an Ironman, an ironman platebody with equivalent stats can be acquired by talking to the Ironman tutor in Lumbridge.

label: Iron platelegs
title: Iron platelegs
lead:
Iron platelegs are melee leg armour made of iron. There is no Defence requirement to wear them, as is the same with bronze armour. As such, it is recommended to skip bronze tier items and start out with iron tier items. They have the same defensive stats as an iron plateskirt but weigh more.

They can be made at level 31 Smithing with 3 iron bars, granting 75 experience.

label: Iron plateskirt
title: Iron plateskirt
lead:
The iron plateskirt is a plateskirt made from iron. It has the same stats as iron platelegs but weighs less.

They can be made at level 31 Smithing with 3 iron bars, granting 75 experience.

label: Iron rocks
title: Iron rocks
lead:
Iron rocks are a type of protruding rock that contains iron ore. Players with a Mining level of 15 or higher can mine iron ore from rocks found in various mines, granting 35 Mining experience for each ore mined. After being mined, an iron rock takes 5.4 seconds to respawn. When inside the members' area of the Mining Guild, that time is reduced to 2.4 seconds; the faster respawn time makes it the best place to power-mine iron, with an experience rate of up to 70k xp/h.

Iron is the most popular ore that free-to-play players power-mine for experience. For locations where there are three rocks in a triangle formation suitable for proper power-mining, see here.

label: Iron scimitar
title: Iron scimitar
lead: The iron scimitar is a melee weapon that can be used in combat. It is stronger than the bronze scimitar. Players can make an iron scimitar with 20 Smithing using 2 iron bars, giving 50 experience.

label: Iron spear
title: Iron spear
lead: The iron spear is a members-only two-handed melee weapon. An iron spear can be obtained by buying one from the Fortis Blacksmith, buying one from another player, or receiving it as a monster drop. The only way it can be created using the Smithing skill is through Barbarian Training after completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. It can be poisoned.

label: Iron sq shield
title: Iron sq shield
lead: An Iron square shield is the second weakest square shield. A player with 23 Smithing can make the shield by using two iron bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 50 experience. This shield can also be bought at Cassie's Shield Shop in northern Falador.

label: Iron sword
title: Iron sword
lead: The iron sword is a low-level weapon made of iron, stronger than the bronze sword. It can be purchased from Varrock Swordshop or made at level 19 Smithing with 1 iron bar, granting 25 experience.

label: Iron thrownaxe
title: Iron thrownaxe
lead: The iron thrownaxe is a thrownaxe made of iron. They can be wielded by players at any Ranged level. They can be bought from the Tribal Weapons Salesman in the Ranging Guild. Thrownaxes cannot be smithed.

label: iron warhammer
title: iron warhammer
lead:
The iron warhammer is a warhammer stronger than the bronze warhammer. It can be wielded at level 1 Strength. Players can make an iron warhammer with the Smithing skill at level 24 using 3 iron bars, giving 75 Smithing experience.

One spawns in the ruined castle near the bandits just south-west of the Hosidius Mess.

label: Irvig Senay
title: Irvig Senay
lead: Irvig Senay is one of the three long-dead warriors alongside San Tojalon and Ranalph Devere that are required to be killed to collect a piece of the heart crystal for the Legends' Quest. He is hostile until you kill him to obtain the hunk of crystal, but you can still attack him afterwards and he will fight back. He attacks with melee.

label: Jade
title: Jade
lead:
Jade is a semi-precious gem used mainly in Crafting. It can be cut from an uncut jade with a chisel at level 13 Crafting, yielding 20 experience. There is a chance to unsuccessfully cut the jade, resulting in a crushed gem and 5 experience.

One jade is used in the Legends' Quest.

label: Jadid
title: Jadid
lead: Jadid is one of the people observing the fights at the Emir's Arena. He can be found on top of the walls and is near the Gnome Restaurant customer and drunken off-duty pilot, Captain Daerkin.

label: Jagged wall
title: Jagged wall
lead: The Jagged wall is a scenery object located at the Shaman Caves during and after the Legends' Quest. It can be jumped over to access the next part of the dungeon, which requires level 50 Agility and can be failed, dealing damage.

label: Jail guard
title: Jail guard
lead:
Jail guards are aggressive bandits found around the Draynor Village jail. They are level 26 and can be dangerous to low level players, especially in numbers, as they are able to wander quite far from the jail and may pursue players on the nearby road or partially into the village. They are equipped with a steel mace, leather body, and leather gloves.

The jail guard with blonde hair is not initially aggressive.

label: Jail key
title: Jail key
lead:
The jail key is dropped by the Jailer, found in the Black Knights' Base, deep within Taverley Dungeon. The key gives access to the jail cell containing Velrak the explorer, who will in turn give players the Dusty key which may be used to travel deeper into the dungeon. It can also be used to unlock the door that holds two dwarves, opposite to Velrak the explorer's cell.

The jail key is also one of the fifty required items to hand the dwarf in the Mourning's End Part II quest if you need a death talisman.

label: Jailer
title: Jailer
lead: The jailer is found in the Black Knights' Base in Taverley Dungeon. He guards the jail holding Velrak the explorer, who has the dusty key, required to access the deeper parts of the dungeon. Players who are navigating the dungeon for the first time must kill the jailer to obtain the jail key, which can be used to unlock Velrak's cell. The jailer can be safespotted using Ranged or Magic by standing behind the table at the eastern end of the hallway.

label: Jangerberries
title: Jangerberries
lead:
Jangerberries can be harvested from a bush patch after planting jangerberry seeds. They are used in Herblore to make Zamorak brews or as protection payment for snape grass (x5).

Jangerberries restore 2 hitpoints, 1 prayer point, temporarily boosts Attack by 2 and Strength by 1, and reduces Defence by 1. Adding them to a compost bin makes supercompost, though this is not recommended as watermelons or pineapples are far cheaper and have the same effect.

label: Jaraah
title: Jaraah
lead: Jaraah also known as "The Butcher" is one of the two surgeons at the Emir's Arena. Jaraah, along with Surgeon General Tafani, and the two nurses (Sabreen and A'abla), are able to heal players, restoring all their hitpoints for no cost, but cannot cure poison. Players must right-click (and choose "Heal" from the Choose Option menu) or talk to these NPCs to benefit from this.

label: Jatix
title: Jatix
lead: Jatix is a druid and citizen of Taverley, a small village located south of Burthorpe. He owns Jatix's Herblore Shop shop, located just west of the Tree Patch.

label: Jatix's Herblore Shop.
title: Jatix's Herblore Shop.
lead:
Jatix's Herblore Shop is a shop in Taverley owned by Jatix that sells Herblore supplies. This shop sells empty vials and eyes of newt in packs.

Sanfew, who plays a part in various quests, is upstairs on the .

label: Javelin (scenery)
title: Javelin (scenery)
lead: Javelin consist of two javelins hanging on a wall in the shape of an X. The javelins appear to be steel javelins.

label: Javelin (unobtainable item)
title: Javelin (unobtainable item)
lead:
The javelin is an unobtainable item release alongside RuneScape 2. Although it is classified internally as a weapon, it lacks a wield option and does not have any equip animations defined.

It was presumably a leftover from development, created to test the implementation of the new javelin weapons in RuneScape 2.

label: Jeed
title: Jeed
lead: Jeed is one of the people observing the fights at the Emir's Arena. You can find her on the catwalks overlooking the Emir's Arena near the south-east arena.

label: Jerico
title: Jerico
lead:
Jerico is a pigeon enthusiast living between the chapel and the northern bank of East Ardougne. He owns several pigeons, which he uses to communicate with the quarantined West Ardougne. If the player chooses to, he will eagerly engage them in conversation about pigeons.

He has several friends in Ardougne, such as Edmond, Omart, and Kilron. When Elena wanted to study the plague, he helped the adventurer who rescued her to sneak over the wall in order to retrieve her distillator, which had been stolen by the mourners. He distracted the mourners watching the gate by releasing several of his pigeons, allowing the adventurer to climb over and into the quarantined city.

label: Jethick
title: Jethick
lead: Jethick is an elderly citizen of West Ardougne unaffected by the plague. He can be found in the town square of West Ardougne or in the basement of the Rehnison household during part of the Song of the Elves quest.

label: Jiminua
title: Jiminua
lead:
Jiminua is a lady on the north side of Tai Bwo Wannai village. She runs Jiminua's Jungle Store.

Interestingly, she sells cooked beef for more money than cooked bread, although the bread heals more.

label: Jiminua's Jungle Store.
title: Jiminua's Jungle Store.
lead:
Jiminua's Jungle Store is a general store that sells many useful items for those adventuring in the Karamjan jungle, such as antipoison, pickaxes, machetes, and axes. It is also notable for being one of the few places to obtain both charcoal and papyrus. Because of the items it stocks, this shop is useful for the nearby minigame Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup.

Along with its functionality as a general store, the building houses Aisles, an NPC who will un-note players' noted items for a fee of five coins per item.

label: Joe (Fight Arena)
title: Joe (Fight Arena)
lead: Joe is a prisoner found in the Fight Arena, trapped along with Kelvin in the south-western cell. He and Kelvin are fightslaves in the arena.

label: Joe (jail)
title: Joe (jail)
lead:
Joe is Lady Keli's talkative head bodyguard in the jail east of Draynor Village. During the Prince Ali Rescue quest, the player must incapacitate him so they can then tie up Lady Keli and rescue Prince Ali. This is done by getting him drunk on beer. To do this, use three beers on him until he gets too drunk to guard the prince. Prince Ali can then be rescued if the player has the correct materials, namely some rope and a bronze key. Should the player attempt to tie up Lady Keli before Joe is drunk, he will intervene.

Joe seemed to be wearing a steel mace, steel platelegs, leather boots, leather gloves, and an iron chainbody.

label: jogre
title: jogre
lead:
Jogres are a type of ogre that live in the jungles of Karamja. Their attacks are slow but powerful, however their low defence allows them to be killed quickly. They are a threat mostly to lower-level players exploring Karamja due to their high damage hits.

Jogres can also be found within the God Wars Dungeon, located to the north of Trollheim. As with other Bandosian followers in the dungeon, wearing a piece of Bandos-aligned equipment will make them unaggressive to the player.

label: Jogre bones
title: Jogre bones
lead:
Jogre bones are bones dropped by jogres, which give 15 Prayer experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 45 XP when casting Sinister Offering.
* 45 XP when offered at the Sacred Bone Burner after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 52.5 XP when offered at a gilded altar with two burners lit or at the Chaos Temple.
* 60 XP when offered at the Ectofuntus in the form of jogre bonemeal.

They can be lit with a tinderbox at level 30 Firemaking to make burnt jogre bones, granting 90 Firemaking experience. Burnt jogre bones are used with karambwanji paste during the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest to make marinated j' bones.

label: Johnathon
title: Johnathon
lead:
Johnathon Fitzharmon is the brother of Caleb and Avan and one of the sons of Dimintheis. He can be found on the of the Jolly Boar Inn. Johnathon plays a role in the Family Crest quest: he was fighting Chronozon, a powerful demon in the Edgeville Dungeon, but began losing the fight and tried to retreat. In his way was a poison spider, which bit him, poisoning him. When the player meets him, he will ask for an antipoison to cure himself.

After the player brings him an antipoison, he tells the player that in order to beat Chronozon, the player must cast all four blast spells at least once. After the quest is complete, he offers to enchant the steel gauntlets into chaos gauntlets, which increase the maximum damage of all bolt spells by 3. If the gauntlets are already imbued with another power, Johnathon will ask for 25,000 coins to re-enchant them. If the Family Pest miniquest has been completed, Johnathon will give the chaos gauntlets directly for free instead.

label: Jolly Boar Inn
title: Jolly Boar Inn
lead:
The Jolly Boar Inn is a two-story bar and inn located north-east of Varrock, on the southern border of the Wilderness. It contains a range and a spawn point for thread. The bartender only sells (ordinary) beer for 2 coins each.

The bar contains Johnathon from the Family Crest quest. In the early days of RuneScape 2, this bar was the location of Dr Harlow, an important character in the Vampyre Slayer quest. He was moved to the Blue Moon Inn because newer players had a hard time finding the bar and would often wander into the nearby Wilderness. A man upstairs and a woman downstairs, though they both walk normally, act drunk when you talk to them, conversing with a player about how there are two of them and mumbling about "giant hairy cabbages". A Black Knight and a Thief also wander around the inn, but the knight is not aggressive, unlike those at the Black Knights' Fortress. The Bartender of the Jolly Boar Inn will say that the Bartender of the Blue Moon Inn is crazy because he thinks RuneScape is in a computer game. A quite-unfriendly Cook resides in the inn, on the south-east corner, cooking something on the range.

label: Jolly R
title: Jolly R
lead:
Jolly R is a music track that is unlocked in Brimhaven, including on the island accessible by fairy ring code . In this area, the music player will shuffle between this track, High Seas and Landlubber.

In Classic mode, the track only plays in the northern docks area of Brimhaven.

label: Jolly Roger
title: Jolly Roger
lead: Jolly Roger is a pirate flag adorning the walls of the pub Dead Man's Chest in Brimhaven.

label: Jonny the Beard
title: Jonny the Beard
lead:
Jonny the Beard is a notorious mass murderer and pirate captain who can be found in the Blue Moon Inn in southern Varrock. He came to Varrock from Port Sarim to meet with the Black Arm Gang; those who wish to join the Phoenix Gang during the Shield of Arrav quest must kill him and bring the intel report he drops to Straven.

He can only be attacked once the player is tasked by Straven to kill him, and he permanently disappears after the quest for those who killed him.

label: Joshua
title: Joshua
lead: Joshua is one of the competitors during the Fishing Contest quest. He informs the player about Grandpa Jack and his inability to keep secrets. He speaks with a younger accent calling the player "dude" and wears a yin yang amulet, but how he came to own it is unknown.

label: Journal (Filliman Tarlock)
title: Journal (Filliman Tarlock)
lead:
Filliman Tarlock's journal is one of a number of items that are simply called 'Journal' in the inventory. This particular journal is obtained by searching the tree in the middle of Filliman's grotto south of Mort Myre Swamp during the Nature Spirit quest. The player must read the journal to find vague instructions on how Filliman can transcend his current ghostly form to become a nature spirit.

The journal is not available from the tree after the quest. It is not found in the bookcase in a player-owned house.

label: Jug
title: Jug
lead:
A Jug is an item that can be filled with water to create a jug of water. Wine can also be made by adding grapes to a jug of water.

Jugs can be bought at general stores for one coin each. Jugs are not sold at the Catherby, East Ardougne, or West Ardougne general store. However, jugs are sold by the charter crew members in Catherby. Wine Shop in Draynor Village sells them for the same price as the general stores, and they can be thieved from the stall. Hassan at the Al Kharid palace may also give free jugs of water if the player has not completed Prince Ali Rescue.

label: jug of bad wine
title: jug of bad wine
lead:
A jug of bad wine is obtained when a player attempts to ferment grapes or Zamorak's grapes and fails, similar to burning food. To ferment grapes, a Cooking level of at least 35 is needed. Fermenting grapes is no longer failed at a cooking level of 68, while Zamorak's grapes cease to fail at level 98.
