A player does not receive any cooking experience when the player's unfermented wine or Zamorak's unfermented wine goes bad. Players can drink the bad wine, but this will temporarily reduce the player's Attack level by 3. This is more than the 2 level reduction from wine, and it also does not heal. Drinking more jugs of bad wine will stack this effect.

label: Jug of bad wine (unobtainable item)
title: Jug of bad wine (unobtainable item)
lead:
A Jug of bad wine is an unobtainable version of the Jug of bad wine. Bad wines could previously be traded and turned into bank notes; however, they were made untradeable in 2007 due to frequent use in scams where players conflated them with Half full wine jugs. Any player who had a noted bad wine was given this now discontinued item. It is identical to the real wine, except it is stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Jug of water
title: Jug of water
lead:
A jug of water is a jug filled up on a water source such as a fountain or sink, it cannot be filled using a well. The humidify spell will also turn any empty jugs in the player's inventory into jugs of water. Jugs of water cannot be consumed, they are only used in making of other things, such as: doughs, jugs of wine, soft clay, mud pie, and filling waterskins.

A free jug of water can be obtained by speaking with Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace.

label: Jug of wine
title: Jug of wine
lead:
A jug of wine is a type of drink that restores 11 Hitpoints and temporarily lowers Attack by 2, leaving behind an empty jug after consumption. It can be obtained by using grapes with a jug of water, requiring level 35 Cooking. The process of fermenting takes 12 seconds and restarts if another jug of wine is created. When the process is finished, all unfermented wine in the player's inventory or bank will ferment. Each jug of wine grants 200 Cooking experience, but every jug that fails to ferment becomes a jug of bad wine instead. The fail rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop failing entirely at Cooking level 68.

Jugs of wine can be blessed at the exposed altar in Ralos' Rise to create a jug of blessed wine.

label: Jukat
title: Jukat
lead: Jukat is a fairy found in the Zanaris marketplace. Her shop sells dragon longswords and dragon daggers.

label: Jukat (shop)
title: Jukat (shop)
lead: Jukat is a store run by Jukat in Zanaris that sells dragon longswords and dragon daggers. The shop can only be accessed after completion of the Lost City quest, which also gives the player the ability to wield both dragon items. The shop can only be accessed via the magic door, requiring one cut diamond to pass each time the player wishes to enter the market area. It is decorated with a fairy market stall.

label: Julie
title: Julie
lead: Julie is the wife of Elena's former teacher, Guidor. When word of a plague carrier spread, she became convinced that her husband was ill and confined him to his house and spread the word that he was dying. Being a woman of religion, she would only allow a priest into his room to cure him.

label: Juliet
title: Juliet
lead: Juliet Leptoc is a member of Varrockian nobility, and daughter to the wealthy and esteemed Lord Draul Leptoc. She resides on the of her father's estate just outside the western gates of Varrock, north of the path. She plays a major part in the Romeo & Juliet quest in which the player attempts to reunite her with her hopeless boyfriend Romeo.

label: Jungle Bush
title: Jungle Bush
lead:
The jungle bush is a bush found at the entrance of the Kharazi Jungle. A number of jungle bushes and jungle trees form a dense boundary that must chopped down in order to progress through the jungle. Chopping the bush rewards the player with 100 Woodcutting experience for each set of normal logs chopped. In order to access the jungle, the player must reach the point of Legends' Quest where Radimus Erkle provides the Radimus notes.

Jungle bushes share the same mechanics as the jungle trees in the dense Kharazi Jungle. After being chopped down, the jungle bush becomes a slashed bush for a few seconds before respawning.

label: Jungle forester
title: Jungle forester
lead:
Jungle foresters are non-player characters found near the border of the Kharazi Jungle in Karamja. They are loggers interested in selling some of Karamja's rarer woods, which can be found in abundance near Shilo Village.

Jungle foresters play small roles in the One Small Favour quest, where they ask the player to sharpen their axe, in return for some red mahogany logs. They are also involved in the Legends' Quest, where they provide players with a bullroarer, which can be re-obtained at the price of an oomlie wrap if lost.

label: Jungle Island
title: Jungle Island
lead:
Jungle Island is a music track that unlocks around Musa Point and Karamja Volcano. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Sea Shanty.

If using Classic music mode in free-to-play Karamja part, it only plays at the Karamja Volcano as well as coast north of it. With this setting, it also plays in the Kharazi Jungle.

label: Jungle Potion
title: Jungle Potion
lead: Jungle Potion is a short quest taking place on Karamja. It involves gathering a handful of different herbs for Trufitus Shakaya, in order for him to perform a ritual to communicate with the island's gods.

label: Jungle spider
title: Jungle spider
lead:
Jungle spiders are monsters that can be found on Karamja and the archipelago east of Yanille. They are not displayed on the minimap so they can be a threat to low level players who don't notice them. Jungle spiders appear in the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame.

Unlike other jungle monsters and their Ape Atoll counterpart, they are not poisonous.

label: Jungle tree (dense Kharazi Jungle)
title: Jungle tree (dense Kharazi Jungle)
lead: Jungle trees are a type of tree found at the entrance to the Kharazi Jungle. A dense wall of trees and bushes block the entrance to the jungle, and must be cut using an axe and machete to pass through. In order to access the jungle, the player must reach the point of Legends' Quest where Radimus Erkle provides the Radimus notes. The mechanics of the trees in the Kharazi Jungle are different from regular jungle trees.

label: Jungle tree (Kharazi Jungle)
title: Jungle tree (Kharazi Jungle)
lead: Jungle trees are a type of tree found within the Kharazi Jungle. The trees are similar to regular jungle trees, and can be chopped at level 1 Woodcutting to obtain regular logs. These jungle trees behave differently from the dense jungle trees that form the northern border of the Kharazi Jungle.

label: Jungle Wolf
title: Jungle Wolf
lead:
Jungle wolves are a type of wolf found in the Kharazi Jungle. They only drop wolf bones when killed. If you get wolves as a Slayer assignment, you can slay these for the task. They are aggressive to all players and will start pursuing from a distance. They are similar to regular wolves, but the main differences are their colour and location.

Their location in the jungle makes them hard to reach; if one plans to hunt jungle wolves, be aware that many other native animals are poisonous, so be sure to have antipoison.

label: Jungly 1
title: Jungly 1
lead:
Jungly 1 is a music track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. It is the first track in the series of three "Jungly" music tracks. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 2, Jungly 3, Jungle Troubles, Reggae, Reggae 2, Tribal and Tribal 2.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked at Cairn Isle or west of Shilo Village. With this mode, it can also be heard in the Tomb of Bervirius.

label: Jungly 2
title: Jungly 2
lead:
Jungly 2 is a music track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. It is the second track in the series of three "Jungly" music tracks. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 1, Jungly 3, Jungle Troubles, Reggae, Reggae 2, Tribal and Tribal 2.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked to the north-west of Brimhaven, at the entrance to the Fisher Realm.

label: Jungly 3
title: Jungly 3
lead:
Jungly 3 is a music track track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. It is the third track in the series of three "Jungly" music tracks. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 1, Jungly 2, Jungle Troubles, Reggae, Reggae 2, Tribal and Tribal 2.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked at Tai Bwo Wannai.

label: Justin Servil
title: Justin Servil
lead:
Justin Servil is the noble and well-off husband of Lady Servil and the father of Sammy Servil, who is captured during the Fight Arena quest along with Justin himself.

Both are imprisoned in the arena alongside several other weak slaves, after being waylaid by General Khazard and his men. During the quest, the player must rescue both Justin and his son from the certain death of the fights in the arena, battling a Khazard Ogre, Khazard scorpion and a Hellhound named Bouncer in order to buy the freedom of the two nobles.

label: Kaleb Paramaya
title: Kaleb Paramaya
lead:
Kaleb Paramaya runs the Paramaya Inn on the of the north-east building in Shilo Village. He sells Paramaya tickets for coins or a pack of 5 for coins. These grant access to the dormitory to sleep, however, as players do not need to sleep, this is a purely aesthetic feature.

He also sells a jug of wine for coin or two glasses of beer for coins.

label: Kalphite Lair
title: Kalphite Lair
lead:
The Kalphite Lair is located north-east of the Bedabin Camp, in the Kharidian Desert. Players will need a rope to enter the lair and another to enter the area containing the Kalphite Queen. As the name suggests, only Kalphites live in this area.

Players will need to bring a rope every time they visit the lair, and another rope should they wish to reach the Queen's lair; players who have completed the Hard Desert Diary need not do so after attaching the ropes one last time post-diary completion. There is also a crevice shortcut requiring 86 Agility and the Elite Desert Diary to use; it is a two-way shortcut and is helpful for players wishing to kill the Kalphite Queen as it will drop them off in the room leading to her chamber. Entering the Kalphite Lair, as well as collecting 5 potato cacti while inside, are required for the Easy Desert Diary.

label: Kalphite Larva
title: Kalphite Larva
lead: Kalphite larvae are the first stage of development in the lifecycle of the kalphite, a species of large scarab-like insects native to the Kharidian Desert. They are at the lowest level in the kalphite caste system and a member of the kalphiscarabeinae family. The larvae, unlike its adult forms, are completely harmless to humans, and will usually retreat when it sees one. They cannot be fought, although wily cats can catch them the same way as rats.

label: Kalphite Queen
title: Kalphite Queen
lead:
The Kalphite Queen (Kalphiscarabeinae pasha ), also called the KQ, is the strongest of the Kalphites.

She is a powerful opponent that makes use of protection prayers, though they only function as an indicator to players of which attack styles may be most effective rather than outright blocking damage from them. She can use all three combat styles, of which her ranged and magic attacks always land as successful hits, and has two forms.

id: category:monsters that do not become tolerant
label: Monsters that do not become tolerant
Kalphite Soldier
title: Kalphite Soldier
lead:
Kalphite soldiers can be found in the Kalphite Lair south-west of Shantay Pass and in the Kalphite Cave east of the Shantay Pass, although the latter requires having a Slayer task to kill. They guard the entrance to the lair of the Kalphite Queen. These are highly dangerous because of their ability to poison starting at 4 damage without dealing melee damage, and they inhabit a multi-combat area.

A player can choose to hunt these for Slayer when given the task to kill kalphites. When given this task, a player can choose to kill any of the kalphite family (workers, soldiers, guardians, or the queen). Killing kalphite soldiers will grant 90 Slayer XP per kill. Using a dwarf multicannon in their chamber yields one of the best XP rates next to Lighthouse dagannoths, and therefore many players use cannons to train here.

label: Kalphite Worker
title: Kalphite Worker
lead:
Kalphite workers are worker kalphites that serve the kalphite queen. They are found throughout the Kalphite Lair and Kalphite Cave west and east of the Shantay Pass, respectively. They cannot poison, unlike the majority of kalphite.

Kalphite workers, like all other kalphites, are affected by Keris and its variants. They can also be assigned to players as a Slayer task. Killing kalphite workers will grant 40 Slayer XP per kill. A dwarf multicannon can be used to fight them, as they are in a multi-combat area.

label: Kalrag
title: Kalrag
lead:
Kalrag is a giant spider encountered during Underground Pass and only needs to be fought during the quest. It must be slain in order to soak a player's doll of Iban with Iban's blood, thus progressing the quest. Although players were able to kill it after the quest, this is no longer possible due to an update as the spider will no longer spawn upon progressing Iban's doll.

When players kill her a message appears saying "Kalrag slumps to the floor..." and the blessed spiders in the room will become aggressive and attack with melee.

label: Kalron
title: Kalron
lead: Kalron is a lost Gnome in the maze part of the Tree Gnome Village and can be found one maze row due north of the village itself.

label: Kamen
title: Kamen
lead:
Kamen is a dwarf trapped in the Underground Pass. He came to the pass along with Klank and Niloof seeking rare ore, but was trapped there by the evil created by the mage Iban. He helps you during the quest by giving you food.

After the first free gift of food, and during subsequent quests, he will charge 75 coins for a 'dinner' of meat pie, bread, and stew (these 3 items, when consumed, heal 28 hitpoints in total). Alternatively, during the Underground Pass quest, you could accept his offer to drink his homemade brew, which will boost Strength by 1, but temporarily drain 4 Agility levels.

label: Kandarin
title: Kandarin
lead:
Kandarin is a region in the realm of Gielinor ruled by King Lathas of East Ardougne. Unlike most other human nations, there is a democratic government in Ardougne, the Ardougne city council. The council, however, has little sway compared to the monarchy. It encompasses most of the lands west of White Wolf Mountain. Kandarin is bordered by another mighty kingdom, Asgarnia, to the east, the Fremennik Province to the north, the forests of Tirannwn to the west and the Feldip Hills to the south. Kandarin is one of the largest kingdoms in Gielinor, nearly as large as Great Kourend.

Kandarin is a wealthy kingdom, and nearly as powerful as the Kingdom of Misthalin. It gathers much of its wealth through industries in places such as the Seers' Village and Yanille. It also trades with many of its bordering nations.

label: Kandarin windmill
title: Kandarin windmill
lead:
The animation of the windmill stutters between the end and beginning animation, allowing a half second to pass before starting the animation over

The Kandarin windmill is a windmill located north of East Ardougne and east of the Fishing Guild. The windmill can be used to grind grain into flour. There is a wheat field located at the nearby farm to the south of the windmill.

label: Kanel
title: Kanel
lead:
Kanel Fairweather is one of Gertrude's four children. Kanel can be found with his brother Philop inside Gertrude's house. The two older children, Wilough and Shilop, are found in Varrock Square. He appears to be playing with his toy horse.

Although the player may attempt to talk to him, there is no dialogue other than a message in the chat stating that the boy is busy playing.

label: Kangai Mau
title: Kangai Mau
lead: Kangai Mau is the leader of the Rantuki Tribe. He can be found in the Shrimp and Parrot, a food store, in central Brimhaven. Speaking to him starts the Tribal Totem quest.

label: Kaqemeex
title: Kaqemeex
lead:
Kaqemeex (pronounced "cake mix") is a Guthixian druid who can be found in the Druid's circle in Taverley.

Kaqemeex is the start point of the quest Druidic Ritual, the quest required to start learning the skill of Herblore. During the quest, players learn that he is the master for Herblore. Players with level 99 in Herblore may buy the Herblore cape from him for 99,000 coins.

label: Karamja
title: Karamja
lead: Karamja (pronounced ) is a large island in Gielinor. It is located to the south of the major kingdoms of Asgarnia and Kandarin. The island contains mostly jungle and tropical geography. You can reach Karamja using the fairy ring code , or by charter ship. Different tribes of Karamja speak different Karamjan languages.

label: Karamja General Store
title: Karamja General Store
lead:
The Karamja General Store is a general store located on Karamja carrying average general store stock. The store is also able to buy items at high alch value if the user is wearing Karamja Gloves 3 or above, which implicitly makes either 100 Combat level or 99 Slayer a requirement for this perk.

The store almost always has cooked and uncooked fish due to the fishing pier nearby. Karamjan rum is not for sale here, but is available next door in the pub.

label: Karamja Jungle mine
title: Karamja Jungle mine
lead:
The Karamjan Jungle mine is a mine located just north of Shilo Village. The mine features one each of iron, silver, and coal rocks, as well as two each of mithril and adamantite rocks. The mine is also called the Nature Altar mine due to its close proximity to the altar.

Banking is quite difficult here. The nearest bank is Shilo Village, but players will have to walk in a huge semi-circle. Alternatively, players can bank in Edgeville via an Amulet of glory, run north to the Abyss in low-level Wilderness, enter the Nature Rift, exit the altar, and lastly, head a bit north-west to the mine. Another method of travel to here is fairy ring code .

label: Karamja Volcano
title: Karamja Volcano
lead: The Karamja Volcano is located on the island of Karamja between Brimhaven to Musa Point. An entrance at the top leads to the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon, providing passage to Mor Ul Rek and Crandor.

label: Karamja Volcano mine
title: Karamja Volcano mine
lead: The Karamja Volcano mine is a small mine in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon, inside the Karamja Volcano. The mine contains four gold rocks. Although it is the second largest gold mine in the free-to-play version of RuneScape, it is rarely used due to its distance to a bank. The advantage of members is that this mine is quite close to the northern Mor Ul Rek bank using the city entrance on the surface. Using this mine can also be combined with a lobster fishing trip, or some monster killing in the dungeon. It is a mine where the world switching tactic can be useful.

label: Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers.
title: Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers.
lead: Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers is a shop run by Zembo that sells beer, Karamjan rum, and jugs of wine. According to Zembo, they are all brewed locally on the island.

label: Karamjan rum
title: Karamjan rum
lead:
Karamjan rum is the local drink of Karamja. It can be bought from Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers shop on Karamja and the Dead Man's Chest in Brimhaven. Members can use the rum on a piece of silk to create a cleaning cloth, which is used to remove poison from weapons. Drinking the rum heals 5 Hitpoints and also boosts Strength equal to 1 + 5% of the player's base Strength level, rounded down. Drinking it also temporarily lowers the drinker's Attack equal to 3 + 2% of the player's current Attack level, rounded down. Upon drinking the rum, the chatbox displays the message You drink the rum. You feel slightly reinvigorated... ...and slightly dizzy too..

Smuggling Karamjan rum off Karamja and giving it to Redbeard Frank is the primary focus of the Pirate's Treasure quest. It plays a smaller role in the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest, where it needs to be combined with sliced banana to create a special banana rum requested by Tinsay. Note that if a player does not slice the banana before placing it in the bottle, they will in fact place the entire banana in it and receive the amusing line, "You stuff the banana in the neck of the bottle. You begin to wonder why." This makes the rum into a useless item. The only thing the player can do at this point is drop the rum, as the banana cannot be removed, and the rum can no longer be consumed. Alternatively, a player can attempt to sail through the Customs officer, which will result in the rum being confiscated.

label: Kardia
title: Kardia
lead:
Kardia is an old witch who lives in the Underground Pass and has lost her cat. She is the only person that knows how to destroy Iban, and the doll used to do so is inside her house. She is also immensely powerful, as she is the one who resurrected Iban in the first place.

The bridge to her house is on the east side of the maze, near the south end.

label: Karim
title: Karim
lead:
Karim is the kebab salesman in Al Kharid. He is west of Osman, between the bank and the furnace.

Karim sells kebabs for 1 coin each. As kebabs heal quite a bit, these may seem like ideal food for anything. The only problem with buying kebabs is that he doesn't have an actual store interface, or a buy x option, so it takes quite a long time to get a considerable amount of kebabs.

label: Katrine
title: Katrine
lead: Katrine Raven (also known as Lady Katrine) is the leader of the Black Arm Gang. She has quite a temper and is the sister of Lady Keli. She is located in the Black Arm Gang Headquarters, just to the west in an alleyway as you enter Varrock via its southern gate.

label: Kebab
title: Kebab
lead:
Kebabs are a camel meat delicacy which can be purchased in Al Kharid and Keldagrim-East for 1 coin each, or at Pollnivneach for 3 coins each. The Drunken Dwarf, Mysterious Old Man, Sandwich Lady, and Rick Turpentine random events may also grant the player a free kebab.

Unlike normal food which restores a fixed amount of Hitpoints, kebabs have varied healing quantities when consumed. A player with 93–99 Hitpoints can expect to be healed 12 health on average.

label: Kebab (scenery)
title: Kebab (scenery)
lead: Kebab is a being cooked on a vertical rotisserie. They can be found in both Ali the Kebab seller and Karim's kebab shops.

label: Kebab mix
title: Kebab mix
lead: Kebab mix is an intermediate product towards making an ugthanki kebab. Combining it with pitta bread makes an ugthanki kebab, yielding 40 Cooking experience.

label: Keep Le Faye
title: Keep Le Faye
lead: Keep Le Faye is a tower south of Camelot Castle, and directly east of Sorcerer's Tower. It plays a large role in the Merlin's Crystal and King's Ransom quests. The keep is the home of Morgan Le Faye.

label: Kelvin
title: Kelvin
lead: Kelvin is a prisoner found in the Fight Arena, trapped along with Joe in the south-western cell. He and Joe are fightslaves in the arena.

label: Kennith
title: Kennith
lead:
Kennith is a boy who features in the Sea Slug quest. During the quest, the player is enlisted by Kennith's mother, Caroline, to find him after he and his father went to the fishing platform and did not return.

After the quest, he can be found at his house in Witchaven with his parents Kent and Caroline. He and his parents, as well as Holgart and Ezekial Lovecraft are the only people in Witchaven who are not possessed by sea slugs by the end of Slug Menace.

label: Kent
title: Kent
lead: Kent features in the Sea Slug quest. During the quest he is found on an unknown island; when the quest is done he is back at Witchaven. He has a wife Caroline and a son Kennith.

label: Key (Biohazard)
title: Key (Biohazard)
lead:
The Key is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is automatically placed into the player's inventory after killing the level-13 Mourner on the of the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne.

It is used to open a gate to access a stockroom full of crates, one of which holds a distillator.

label: Key (blue)
title: Key (blue)
lead:
The blue key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is dropped by one of the two zombies in the basement of Melzar's Maze.

Is it used to unlock the blue door, where it will disintegrate upon being used.

label: Key (Ernest the Chicken)
title: Key (Ernest the Chicken)
lead:
The Key is a quest item used only in Ernest the Chicken. It is found by using a spade on the compost heap inside Draynor Manor's west wall during the quest.

It is used to open the door to the room containing a skeleton and the rubber tube. It can only be obtained during the quest and is kept upon completion.

label: Key (green)
title: Key (green)
lead:
The green key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is dropped by the lesser demon in the basement of Melzar's Maze.

Is it used to unlock the green door, where it will disintegrate upon being used.

label: Key (magenta)
title: Key (magenta)
lead:
The magenta key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is dropped by Melzar the Mad in the basement of Melzar's Maze.

Is it used to unlock the magenta door, where it will disintegrate upon being used.

label: Key (orange)
title: Key (orange)
lead:
The orange key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is dropped by the ghost wearing a hood and no cape on the floor of Melzar's Maze.

Is it used to unlock the orange doors, where it will disintegrate upon being used.

label: Key (red)
title: Key (red)
lead:
The red key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is dropped by the small zombie rat with the long tail on the floor of Melzar's Maze.

Is it used to unlock the red doors, where it will disintegrate upon being used.

label: Key (Treasure Trails)
title: Key (Treasure Trails)
lead:
A key is an item needed to unlock a chest or drawer during a Treasure Trail.

There will be a clue telling you where to get it. The key is a drop only when carrying the clue scroll. It disappears when used to open the chest or drawer. Keys are non-tradeable objects, specific to the player who finds them. They are used on all levels of treasure trails.

label: Key (Tree Gnome Village Dungeon)
title: Key (Tree Gnome Village Dungeon)
lead:
The key is an item found in the Tree Gnome Village Dungeon. Prior to starting the Roving Elves quest, it can be found in a crate in the storeroom to the north-east of the dungeon entrance. It opens the door to the jail, found north-west of the dungeon entrance. Upon finding it, the player will receive the message "You found a large key". The crate can be searched for another key if the player loses it. It cannot be stored on a Steel key ring.

Note that if a player has a low combat level, they will likely receive damage from the surrounding monsters whilst searching the crates for the key.

label: Key (Waterfall Dungeon)
title: Key (Waterfall Dungeon)
lead:
Key is an item found in the Waterfall Dungeon by searching a crate in the eastern chamber of the dungeon. It is used to open the two doors in western part of the dungeon, towards the Chalice of Eternity. It also spawns in the chamber between these two doors, allowing the player to pass back through the door if they were to drop it.

The key is used in several quests. It cannot be stored on a steel key ring.

label: Key (Witch's House)
title: Key (Witch's House)
lead:
The key is a quest item used during the Witch's House quest to open the shed door and retrieve the ball. It is found by searching the fountain in Nora T. Hagg's garden.

Duplicates can be drop tricked by searching the fountain to obtain another. This key cannot be added to a steel key ring.

label: Key (yellow)
title: Key (yellow)
lead:
The yellow key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is dropped by the skeleton wielding a round shield on the floor of Melzar's Maze.

Is it used to unlock the yellow doors, where it will disintegrate upon being used.

label: Key print
title: Key print
lead:
A key print is a quest item in the Prince Ali Rescue quest. It is obtained by pressing Lady Keli's cell key into soft clay. The key print is used to make a bronze key that unlocks the cell door.

If lost, you must speak to Lady Keli again with soft clay, pink skirt, paste, and a dyed yellow wig in your inventory to obtain a new key print.

label: Khali brew
title: Khali brew
lead: Khali brew is a quest item in the Fight Arena quest. Once the player has spoken to the Head Guard in the south-eastern room of the jail, it is possible to buy the beer for coins from the Khazard barman in the bar in the south-west corner of the Fight Arena. The Khazard barman suggests lying down before drinking it so there is less distance to collapse; however, there is no option for the player to drink it. Giving it to the Head Guard will get him drunk and allow you to steal the Khazard cell keys.

label: Kharazi Jungle
title: Kharazi Jungle
lead:
The Kharazi Jungle is an area south of Shilo Village on Karamja. This is where most of the Legends' Quest takes place, and it is necessary to start the quest in order to enter the jungle (you only have to talk to Radimus Erkle and receive Radimus notes). A machete and a Woodcutting axe are required to hack through the dense jungle blocking the path along with the notes. Radimus notes is required to navigate it if players have not completed Legends' Quest.

The jungle often serves as the location for Treasure Trail co-ordinates.

label: Kharazi tribe
title: Kharazi tribe
lead:
The Kharazi Tribe is a large and spread-out tribe of warriors located in the Kharazi Jungle, located in the south of the large island Karamja. During the Legends' Quest, players commune with the Kharazi Tribe in order to gain access to the Legends' Guild, though the task proves much greater when a proud member of the tribe, Gujuo, tells the player that they must exorcise an evil demon called Nezikchened who has taken to dwelling in their totems.

The members of the Kharazi Tribe meet around these various totems, which are made from a valuable and rare tree called the Yommi tree, which are grown only in patches of fertile soil in the Kharazi Jungle. In addition to their sacred trees, they regard a small pool of water in the middle of the jungle as holy, and it is worthy of note that they consider the metal gold as blessed, calling it "sun-metal". This attitude toward gold mirrors that of the real-world Aztecs and Incas.

label: Kharid Scorpion
title: Kharid Scorpion
lead:
Kharid Scorpions are a rare species of scorpion native to the Kharidian Desert. They play a prominent role in the Scorpion Catcher quest, during which players must capture three that escaped from the wizard Thormac. Players can catch them during the Scorpion Catcher with a scorpion cage. Locations are as follows:
*One roams freely on the of the Edgeville Monastery.
*Another can be found in the beginning of the Taverley Dungeon. The scorpion in Taverley Dungeon is behind a disguised wall that can only be opened after starting the quest.
*The final one is found in the Barbarian Agility area at the Barbarian Outpost.

None of these scorpions are attackable. If players attempt to pick them up, they will always suffer 3 Hitpoints of typeless damage, and the message The scorpion stings you! will be displayed. This damage can kill the player if they have 3 HP or less when attempting to pick one up. The scorpion damage is not poisonous, though it is typeless (similar to damage from failing to pickpocket) and therefore unaffected by protection prayers. Some players may use them as a form of suicide when they have low Hitpoints or are in need of stat healing.

label: Kharidian cactus
title: Kharidian cactus
lead:
Kharidian cacti can be found around the Kharidian Desert. They can be used to fill waterskins, increasing them by one dose, but not other types of containers. Similar to webs, a knife or a slash weapon is needed to cut them open.

Successfully cutting a cactus and filling a waterskin will display the text You top up your skin with water from the cactus and award 10 Woodcutting experience. Failing to do so will display the text You fail to cut the cactus correctly and it gives no water this time and award 0.4 Woodcutting experience. If the player successfully cuts a cactus but has no waterskin, the chatbox will display You have no empty waterskins to put the water in.. There is currently no way to increase the chance of success. A dry cactus will become healthy again after 1 minute. Refilling a waterskin this way is a requirement for the Easy Desert Diary.

label: Kharidian Desert
title: Kharidian Desert
lead:
The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania. The desert becomes a dangerous region south of the Shantay Pass, requiring a player to drink from waterskins or other sources of water to avoid dehydration. The player will automatically drink every 90 seconds if they have a waterskin with charges in their inventory; the time between drinks can be extended by wearing heat-resistant gear. Failing to drink will cause the player to periodically lose hitpoints. Within the boundaries of towns, players are immune to the desert heat and do not need to drink.

Players may quickly travel to certain locations by using magic carpet rides, though some destinations are unavailable until certain quests have been completed.

label: Khazard armour
title: Khazard armour
lead:
A Khazard armour is a quest item in the Fight Arena quest. It is a dark coloured platebody that is part of the Khazard armour set. It has stats worse than a bronze platebody, but unlike most melee armours, it does not have a penalty to Magic or Ranged accuracy, nor does it interfere with Ava's devices, making it a viable choice for mages and rangers. It also weighs far less than a typical platebody. Another nearby quest item, Carnillean armour, has over double the stab defence and +3 slash defence bonuses, at the cost of -2 crush defence and nearly 20x the weight.

In the Fight Arena quest, a Khazard helmet and Khazard armour can only be found by searching the chest in a building north of the Fight Arena. They both must be worn to enter the Khazard prisons. Unequipping either the helmet or armour inside the jail causes the guards to kick the player out.

label: Khazard Barman
title: Khazard Barman
lead: Angor, the Khazard Barman, runs the Fight Arena Bar in Khazard. The barman sells beer and Khali brew, which is needed for the Fight Arena quest.

label: Khazard cell keys
title: Khazard cell keys
lead: Khazard cell keys are a quest item in the Fight Arena quest. They are obtained by giving a Khali brew to the Head Guard in the south-eastern room of the jail at the Fight Arena, north of Yanille. The keys are used to unlock the door to the cell that holds Sammy Servil prisoner.

label: Khazard commander
title: Khazard commander
lead: The Khazard commander can be found in the Battlefield of Khazard (located south of West Ardougne). He is encountered during the Tree Gnome Village quest. To be able to get to him, players must have fired the ballista during the Tree Gnome Village quest. By firing the ballista, it will break the stronghold allowing the player to climb over the wall to attack him. The commander can not be attacked from outside of the stronghold, even with ranged or magic.

label: Khazard General Store
title: Khazard General Store
lead: The Khazard General Store is a general store with two locations sharing the same stock in Port Khazard. The store has stock consistent with other general stores, as well as a few items that are unique to the Fishing Trawler minigame.

label: Khazard Guard
title: Khazard Guard
lead: Khazard Guards are members of the Khazard Army found in and around General Khazard's Fight Arena, south of Ardougne. Talking to them after killing Bouncer in the Fight Arena quest will cause them to exclaim and start attacking.

label: Khazard Guard (Arena escort)
title: Khazard Guard (Arena escort)
lead:
The Khazard Guard was a member of the Khazard Army that appeared in the Fight Arena quest. After players were captured by General Khazard and forced to become one of his fight slaves, this guard would escort players to the Fight Arena prison.

Despite not being attackable, he had a combat level of 25.

label: Khazard Guard (Off duty)
title: Khazard Guard (Off duty)
lead: The Khazard Guard is an off-duty member of the Khazard Army living in the north-eastern house at the Fight Arena. The chest in his house can be opened and searched for the Khazard armour and helmet during the Fight Arena quest.

label: Khazard helmet
title: Khazard helmet
lead:
A Khazard helmet is a quest item in the Fight Arena quest. It is a dark coloured medium helmet that is part of the Khazard armour set. It has stats similar to an iron med helm, except unlike most medium helmets, it does not have a penalty to Magic, making it a viable choice for mages and rangers.

In the Fight Arena quest, a Khazard helmet and Khazard armour can only be found by searching the chest in a building north of the Fight Arena. They both must be worn to enter the Khazard prisons. Unequipping either the helmet or armour inside the jail causes the guards to kick the player out.

label: Khazard Ogre
title: Khazard Ogre
lead: The Khazard Ogre is a monster fought during Fight Arena. After it is defeated, General Khazard will send out a Khazard Scorpion to fight next. This is General Khazard's 4th best creature who is used to fight against the Slave fighters along with Bouncer and the Khazard Scorpion.

label: Khazard Scorpion
title: Khazard Scorpion
lead: The Khazard Scorpion is a monster fought during Fight Arena. After it is defeated, General Khazard will send out Bouncer to fight next. This is General Khazard's 3rd best creature who is used to fight against the Slave fighters along with Bouncer and the Khazard Ogre.

label: Khazard trooper
title: Khazard trooper
lead:
Khazard troopers are the foot soldiers of the Khazard Army. They can be found fighting gnomes in the Khazard Battlefield near West Ardougne and spectating at the Fight Arena.

While fighting gnomes, the troopers will say phrases such as "Get off of me, ya little pest!" and "Arrgh! Get the gnome!".

label: Khazard warlord
title: Khazard warlord
lead:
The Khazard warlord is fought during the Tree Gnome Village quest. After he is defeated, players can search his satchel to find the the remaining orbs of protection needed for the spirit tree. The player must then these bring back to King Bolren to complete the quest. Players can fight him in the Nightmare Zone after the quest is complete.

Even though the warlord attacks with a warhammer, he has the attacking speed of a scimitar, meaning that low-level players can take a lot of damage very quickly. Protect from Melee will render him harmless, and he can also be bound with magic. Players choosing to use melee and can't use Prayers are advised to have adamant armour or better when fighting him, as well as good food.

label: killer's print
title: killer's print
lead: The killer's print is an item used in Murder Mystery, found by using the criminal's dagger on a pot of flour and some flypaper. Players compare this item to the prints of the Sinclair family, and find out who the killer is.

label: Kilron
title: Kilron
lead:
Kilron is found on the south-west side of the wall separating east and West Ardougne.

He plays a minor role in the Biohazard quest by helping the player leave West Ardougne without alerting the mourners by using a rope ladder to climb over the wall.

label: King Arthur
title: King Arthur
lead:
King Arthur is the king of Camelot Castle which is east of Seers' Village. Arthur is the leader of the Knights of the Round Table and an ally of the White Knights. King Arthur is found on the ground floor and is involved in three quests: Holy Grail, Merlin's Crystal, and King's Ransom.

After completing the Holy Grail, players can mount a painting of King Arthur on a wall in their player-owned house.

label: King Black Dragon
title: King Black Dragon
lead:
The King Black Dragon, commonly referred to as KBD, is a three-headed dragon located in his lair, accessible only through the deep Wilderness. Although the lair itself is not in the Wilderness, KBD is still considered a Wilderness boss by designation, as players must enter the Wilderness to fight him. The King Black Dragon has a combat level of 276, which makes him one of the strongest dragons in Old School RuneScape. Players should not take this foe lightly, and they should always take an anti-dragon shield as his dragonfire breath is very deadly without protection. The King Black Dragon can also be killed as an alternative for a black dragon Slayer task, except when assigned by Krystilia.

Although he will always fight back when attacked, he has gotten bored over the centuries from adventurers attacking him, as he revealed to his good friend Bob the cat. If you're going there for the first time, please note that KBD is aggressive and will aggro you, dealing damage from a distance through even super antifire potions, dragonfire shields, and protect from magic.

label: King Black Dragon (PvM Arena)
title: King Black Dragon (PvM Arena)
lead: King Black Dragon is one of the bosses fought in the PvM Arena, originally added for the 2015 Clan Cup. He has the same stats as his standard version.

label: King Black Dragon Lair
title: King Black Dragon Lair
lead:
The King Black Dragon Lair, abbreviated as the KBD lair, is a multi-combat area, allowing groups of players to fight him simultaneously. The lair can be accessed via the western entrance to the Lava Maze Dungeon in level 42 Wilderness near the Lava Maze, however the lair itself is not the Wilderness. The lair is additionally visited by players completing an elite or master clue scroll step; the elite one requires players to kill the dragon, while the master clue has an emote clue that must be performed in the cave.

: Watch out for player-killers on the way to the lair. The dungeon may be accessed via a ladder in a fenced area on the west end of the Lava Maze containing four lesser demons. The ladder leads to an area with poison spiders, and a lever which will teleport the player to the King Black Dragon's lair. The lair itself isn't in the Wilderness, but players are in the Wilderness until they pull the lever. As with all Wilderness levers, if a player is teleblocked, they can't pull the lever. As the lair itself is not considered the Wilderness, players can use any means of teleportation to leave.

label: King Bolren
title: King Bolren
lead:
King Bolren is the king of the Tree Gnome Village. He is the younger brother of the village's former king, Bolrie, who abdicated after being deceived by Glouphrie the Untrusted, after which Bolren was elected as the new king.

He plays a large role in the Tree Gnome Village quest, asking for you to recover the orbs of protection to help protect his people, and maybe stop the endless war with General Khazard's army. During the quest, agents of Khazard break into the village and kill his family. He is a possible customer (a hard order) in the Gnome Restaurant minigame and players must speak to him for the Treasure Trail anagram 'GOBLIN KERN'.

label: King Lathas
title: King Lathas
lead: King Lathas Ardignas is the king of East Ardougne, the capital of Kandarin. As the sons of King Ulthas, he and his younger brother Tyras are responsible for the division of the city between West and East. Lathas rules the eastern part of the city, although the existence of the Ardougne City Council leaves the extent of his power uncertain. He and his brother are the great-grandsons of the first King of Kandarin, who founded the kingdom after the Great Battle, leading the Ardignas bloodline to rise to power.

label: King Narnode Shareen
title: King Narnode Shareen
lead:
King Narnode Shareen is the king of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, part of the Gnome Empire. He is found on the ground floor of the Grand Tree of Tree Gnome Stronghold and features in the following quests: The Grand Tree, The Eyes of Glouphrie, Monkey Madness I and its sequel, Monkey Madness II.

King Narnode is known to have an affection toward humans, but his high regard for the race can often be tainted and contorted through lies, as he once had the player temporarily imprisoned under false accusations.

label: King Roald
title: King Roald
lead: King Roald Remanis III is the current ruler of the prosperous kingdom of Misthalin. His residence is within Varrock Palace, where the Varrock Palace Secret Guard work to keep him safe. He is located in the south-east side of the Palace on the ground floor. He is notable for being one of the least controversial kings, as he is a very straightforward, stable ruler. He has a wife, Ellamaria, who rules alongside as queen.

label: King Scorpion
title: King Scorpion
lead: King Scorpions are aggressive monsters found in the Dwarven Mine, the Lava Maze, in the Wilderness, and some areas on Crandor. They typically wander around the mineable rocks. They stop being aggressive at level 65 outside Wilderness.

label: king worm
title: king worm
lead:
King worms are used in gnome cooking to make worm crunchies, worm holes, and worm battas. They can be eaten to heal 2 Hitpoints. When eaten, the message You eat the king worm. It's a bit chewy. is displayed. It is a possible item chosen randomly from a list in the Fairytale I - Growing Pains and Forgettable Tale... quests, to enchant the Secateurs, and trade for the Rowdy dwarf's kelda seed.

When talking to a gnome woman, they occasionally give king worms.

label: Kingdom (music track)
title: Kingdom (music track)
lead:
Kingdom is a music track that is unlocked in Burthorpe. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Principality.

In Classic music mode, this track plays on the west side of Burthorpe outside the Warriors' Guild and on the path to Death Plateau.

label: Kinshra
title: Kinshra
lead: The Kinshra, often referred to as the Black Knights, are a Zamorakian military order based primarily in and around northern Asgarnia, founded in the early Fifth Age. The Kinshra were official defenders of the Kingdom of Asgarnia for roughly 155 years, although their presence within the nation was, and continues to be, a constant point of political tension. The group is currently led by Lord Daquarius Rennard.

label: Kitchen Drawers
title: Kitchen Drawers
lead: A pair of Kitchen Drawers are found on the middle level of the Troll Stronghold. They're located next to My Arm and are able to be opened and searched for a storeroom key used during the Eadgar's Ruse quest.

label: kitten
title: kitten
lead:
Kittens are young pet cats that can follow the player. In order to obtain a pet kitten, a player must complete the Gertrude's Cat quest, after which Gertrude will give them a kitten as part of the reward. The first kitten is free, and each kitten after that is 100 coins, but players cannot own more than one kitten at a time. If a fully grown cat is put into the player-owned house Menagerie, another kitten can be obtained from Gertrude. The kitten itself cannot be stored in the Menagerie. If players have an activated ring of charos(a), they are able to charm Gertrude into allowing them to choose a specific colour kitten. Otherwise, players will be given a kitten of a random colour.

Kittens appear as either the player's follower or as an item in the inventory. To change the kitten from an item to a follower, drop the kitten from your inventory. Once it is following you, selecting "Pick-up" with right click will return the kitten back to the inventory.

label: kitten (Gertrude's Cat)
title: kitten (Gertrude's Cat)
lead:
A Kitten is the offspring of Fluffs that appears during the Gertrude's Cat quest. It was separated from its mother within the Lumber Yard, and must be retrieved from a crate to obtain it as an item, which must then be taken to Fluffs. If the item is instead dropped, the kitten will appear on the ground and run back to a crate.

If players speak to Fluffs after Icthlarin's Little Helper with a catspeak amulet, she will thank them for finding her kitten, and admits she has a difficult time keeping track of them.

label: Klank
title: Klank
lead:
Klank is part of a group of dwarves trapped in the Underground Pass. Although he originally came seeking ore, he has become trapped by the evils of the pass, created by Iban.

Klank gives the player a free pair of his specialist gauntlets during the Underground Pass quest. If lost, the gauntlets must be re-bought for 5,000 coins if the player requires another pair. They are used to search the half-soulless' cages for a dove without being bitten.

label: Klank's gauntlets
title: Klank's gauntlets
lead: Klank's gauntlets are a pair of gauntlets obtained during the Underground Pass quest to prevent the half-soulless from biting the player when searching their cages for Iban's dove. If lost, they can be recovered during and after the quest from Klank for coins. Klank's gauntlets have the same stats as steel gauntlets.

label: Klarense
title: Klarense
lead:
Klarense is a sailor involved in the Dragon Slayer I quest and he is found on the second most southern dock of Port Sarim. He sells players his boat, the Lady Lumbridge, for 2,000 coins, which is needed to sail to Crandor.

Players can only buy the Lady Lumbridge during Dragon Slayer I. If players ask him before embarking on the quest, they cannot board to fix the Lady Lumbridge. He will also tell players that "The ship is not ready yet and Port Sarim's workers are slow so there's no telling how long the ship will take to fix."

label: Knife
title: Knife
lead:
A knife is a multi-functional tool used for a large variety of tasks, primarily used for fletching logs in the Fletching skill and cutting food in the Cooking skill. It sees secondary usage in the Crafting skill. Additionally, it can be used to cut through webs and setup Hunter traps.

They are sold in many general stores, at Trader Stan's Trading Post on Karamja, or the Ardougne Spice Stall. A knife can also be found by searching a sack between two webs in front of the lever to the Mage Arena bank, if the player does not have a knife in their inventory.

label: Knight (Falador Party Room)
title: Knight (Falador Party Room)
lead:
The dancing knights are a fun extra feature of the Falador Party Room, available for the price of 500 coins. They can be summoned to dance on the tabletop and sing by using the lever on the wall near the treasure chest.

The knights sing a short song in parody of a similar scene in . If the player attempts to talk with one of the knights, they are told "He is too busy dancing to talk!"

label: Knight of Ardougne
title: Knight of Ardougne
lead:
The Knights of Ardougne are found in the East Ardougne market place. One is also found in the courtyard of the East Ardougne Castle. Most are found attempting to chase away thieves. They will protect all stalls from the silk stall and up by attacking players that they observe stealing from them. After completion of the Song of the Elves, knights of Ardougne can be found patrolling the streets of West Ardougne as well.

Knights of Ardougne can be pickpocketed at level 55 Thieving, giving the player a coin pouch worth 50 coins and 84.3 Thieving experience. The gloves of silence or the medium Ardougne Diary increase success rate by 5% and 10%, respectively. Failing to pickpocket will result in being hit for 3 points of damage. They are a good source of Thieving experience with a theoretical maximum of 3,000 pickpockets per hour for a total of 252,900 experience per hour.

label: Knight of Ardougne (unused)
title: Knight of Ardougne (unused)
lead:
The Knight of Ardougne is an unused monster that was added to the game files in the RuneScape 2 beta. Presumably, it was supposed to be a variant of the Knight of Ardougne that would be found in East Ardougne marketplace. Like the regular Knight, players had the option to either fight or pickpocket it.

It was most likely scrapped very early in development, as both the jaw model and the animations are broken. If given a jaw with a beard, the beard colour changes to match the purple of their armour.

label: Knightly
title: Knightly
lead: Knightly is a music track that is unlocked in the centre of Ardougne. It can also be heard in the Ardougne city prison during Song of the Elves.

label: Koftik
title: Koftik
lead:
Koftik is a human that serves as a guide through the Underground Pass during the quest. He teaches players how to make fire arrows to enter the pass and also appears throughout the dungeon. During the quest, he will give the player some food at most of his locations in the dungeon because "it is a dangerous area". However if you've recently claimed some food from him, you will have to wait for some time for more.

Throughout the quest, he slowly loses his mind to Iban's influence. Once Iban is slain at the end of the quest, he regains his sanity. After starting the Regicide quest, he can also be found in the Well of Voyage in the Underground Pass. At this location, he will give the player a small amount of food as a one-time offering, and a broken Iban's staff as a repeatable offering.

label: Kolodion
title: Kolodion
lead:
Kolodion is the shape-shifting master of the Mage Arena. He is fought to gain entrance to the arena, where players fight for their god of choice.

When a player fights him during the Mage Arena I miniquest, he first starts out as a man, then transforms into an Ogre, a giant ice blue spider, a large ghost, and finally a black demon.

label: Kortan
title: Kortan
lead: Kortan, along with Aemad, runs Aemad's Adventuring Supplies. in East Ardougne. The store acts as a General store, but it sells some items not found in other stores such as papyrus and cooked meat. It does not sell some common items found in nearly all other general stores, such as bowls.

label: Kraka
title: Kraka
lead: Kraka is a level 91 troll found on Death Plateau. Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as Stick, Pee Hat, and Rock, he drops a rune warhammer or granite shield, and as such is commonly hunted by ironmen looking to upgrade their armour.

label: kwuarm
title: kwuarm
lead:
Kwuarm is a medium level herb requiring 54 Herblore to clean. It can be grown from kwuarm seeds at a herb patch at level 56 Farming and is used in the making of weapon poison and the super strength potion. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a kwuarm potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

According to the book Gielinor's flora - herbs, the herb was originally native to Kourend, with the name being given to it by dwarves, meaning warm death. The name is due to the plant's poisonous sap which is said to cause a burning fever when ingested. Since its discovery, it has often been used as a main ingredient in poison for various pests.

label: Kwuarm potion (unf)
title: Kwuarm potion (unf)
lead: A kwuarm potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a kwuarm on a vial of water, requiring 55 Herblore. Using a limpwurt root on a kwuarm potion (unf) with 55 Herblore yields a super strength(3) and 125 Herblore experience. Using a dragon scale dust on a kwuarm potion (unf) with 60 Herblore yields weapon poison and 137.5 Herblore experience.

label: Ladder (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
title: Ladder (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
lead: The ladder is an Agility obstacle found within the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. Passing the obstacle requires 35 Agility although no experience is awarded.

label: Lady Keli
title: Lady Keli
lead:
Lady Keli is a bandit leader and the main antagonist in the Prince Ali Rescue quest. She is found in the jail area (usually inside the jail proper but sometimes within the jail's compound) in Draynor Village.

Lady Keli kidnapped Prince Ali and had plotted to ransom for the prince's release. Keli is vain and arrogant - she likes showing off and being praised, and claims to have killed three men before she was six. The player exploits these traits to outwit her - tricking her into showing the key to Prince Ali's cell, which allows the player to get a clay imprint and make a bronze copy of the key. The player incapacitates her head guard, Joe, before tying Keli up with a rope, locking her in a closet, and freeing Prince Ali.

label: Lady Servil
title: Lady Servil
lead:
Lady Servil is a minor noble of Kandarin, the mother of Sammy Servil and wife of Justin Servil. All three are characters in the Fight Arena quest, in which the player must rescue both Justin and Sammy from the clutches of General Khazard, a maniacal Mahjarrat who delights in fights between his creatures and unfortunate slave fighters.

Lady Servil is located just outside the north-east corner of the hedge-maze surrounding the Tree Gnome Village, and is spoken to in order to begin the quest. You may also need to talk to her about a clue scroll, and some coordinate clues lead to the general area she is in.

label: lamp
title: lamp
lead:
The lamp is a reward obtained from several random events or by opening an Intricate Pouch that differs from those awarded by quests. While these lamps cannot be traded or banked, rubbing one gives the option of adding experience to any skill a player chooses. The amount given is ten times their skill level of choice (e.g. a skill at level 21 would give 210 experience).

Lamps are converted to if lost on death in the Wilderness.

label: Landlubber
title: Landlubber
lead:
Landlubber is a music track that is unlocked in Brimhaven, including on the island accessible by fairy ring code . In this area, the music player will shuffle between this track, High Seas and Jolly R.

In Classic mode, the track only plays in the jungle west of Brimhaven, at the South Brimhaven mine.

label: lantadyme
title: lantadyme
lead:
Lantadyme is a high level herb requiring a Herblore level of 67 to clean. It is obtained by cleaning grimy lantadyme which can be grown from a lantadyme seed with a Farming level of 73.

Lantadymes are used to make anti-fire potions (with ground blue dragon scales) and magic potions (with potato cactus). To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a lantadyme potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

label: Lantadyme potion (unf)
title: Lantadyme potion (unf)
lead: A lantadyme potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a lantadyme on a vial of water, requiring 69 Herblore. Using dragon scale dust on a lantadyme potion (unf) with 69 Herblore yields an antifire potion (3) and 157.5 Herblore experience. Using a potato cactus on a lantadyme potion (unf) with 76 herblore yields a magic potion (3) and 172.5 Herblore experience.

label: Large bone (Demonic Ruins)
title: Large bone (Demonic Ruins)
lead: The large bone is a piece of examinable scenery found in the Demonic Ruins.

label: Large bone (scenery)
title: Large bone (scenery)
lead: The large bone are examinable scenery located all around Gielinor.

label: Large cupboard
title: Large cupboard
lead: A large cupboard is located on the of the Sorcerer's Tower. Players may open the large cupboard to search it.

label: Large grave
title: Large grave
lead: Large graves are scenery objects that can be found in graveyards. There are five large graves in Ardougne with four of these being in West Ardougne. Another is located east of the Goblin Village and just west of Ice Mountain. Two are located close to Paterdomus. The last one is located on Ape Atoll.

label: Large grave stone
title: Large grave stone
lead: The Large grave stone is an unused object that was added in the RuneScape 2 beta. Presumably, it would have been found in several graveyards alongside the Tombstone, but was ultimately never added. As a result, it has never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Large sewer pipe
title: Large sewer pipe
lead: Large sewer pipes can be found in the numerous sewers players can encounter. Players cannot interact with the pipes, but they can examine them.

label: Large urn
title: Large urn
lead: A large urn is located just south of The Dig Site and south-east of Varrock. It has no use and is not involved in any quests.

label: Lasting
title: Lasting
lead: Lasting is a music track unlocked at Hemenster and the Ranging Guild.

label: Laugh
title: Laugh
lead:
Laugh is the tenth listed emote. Upon use the player puts their hands to their stomach and laughs.

This emote is unlocked by default upon making an account.

label: Lava battlestaff
title: Lava battlestaff
lead:
A lava battlestaff is a lava elemental staff which provides unlimited amounts of earth and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.

The mystic lava staff is an even stronger alternative, providing better melee and magic stat bonuses. It is obtained by taking the lava battlestaff and to Thormac. (Reduced to or with completion of the hard and elite Kandarin diaries respectively.)

label: Lava Dragon Isle
title: Lava Dragon Isle
lead: The Lava Dragon Isle is a members-only section of the Wilderness which stretches from level 36 to level 42. It is a Multicombat area, and the only place where lava dragons spawn.

label: lava eel
title: lava eel
lead: Lava eel is a type of untradeable fish that restores 11 Hitpoints when eaten. During Heroes' Quest, guild master Achietties will ask players to obtain a cooked lava eel to prove that they are worthy of membership to the Heroes' Guild. It can be obtained by cooking raw lava eel on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 53 Cooking and granting 30 experience when successful. There is no chance of burning a lava eel.

label: Lava Maze
title: Lava Maze
lead:
The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45. In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are spiderwebs that must be cut with a slash weapon or a knife. Should players somehow lose their slash weapon or knife while inside the maze, there are a couple of knife item spawns.

An Agility shortcut (stepping stone) on the north side of the maze allows you to go to the centre of the maze with 82 Agility.

label: Lava Maze Dungeon
title: Lava Maze Dungeon
lead:
The Lava Maze Dungeon is a dungeon beneath the Lava Maze in high level Wilderness. The dungeon is entirely single-way combat and has two ladder entrances.

The dungeon's western entrance is west of the Lava Maze, level 42 Wilderness in a metal fenced area containing lesser demons. This entrance leads to a small area containing only poison spiders and the lever to enter the King Black Dragon's lair. This part of the dungeon covers level 42 to 43 Wilderness.

label: Lava Maze Dungeon mine
title: Lava Maze Dungeon mine
lead:
The Lava Maze Dungeon mine is a small mining site found in the deep Wilderness. To reach the mine, players must travel to the centre of the Lava Maze, where the Lava Maze Dungeon's eastern entrance can be found.

Once players enter the eastern entrance, they will be in the dungeon's western side. A single runite rock can be found here. However, the mine is extremely dangerous as several greater demons wander the dungeon, and two black dragons can also be found nearby. The dragons can easily be trapped behind the rock, but players will likely be attacked and poisoned by the poison spiders wandering near the rock. With some manoeuvring, however, the spiders can be trapped behind stalagmites. As well as this, due to being located in the Wilderness, players may attack and kill each other here.

label: Lava Maze runite mine
title: Lava Maze runite mine
lead:
Located north-west of the Lava Maze in level 46 Wilderness, the Lava Maze Runite Mine is the only mining site in free-to-play worlds with runite ore to be mined. Therefore, the runite ore is rarely left undepleted, as rune miners often time the spawns and wait for the ore to respawn in anticipation. The mine is located north of both the Bandit Camp Mine and the Lava Maze in the Wilderness. There are two rocks here which contain runite ore. Although the area around the rune rocks is crawling with aggressive deadly red spiders, players will rarely be attacked by the spiders when standing next to the runite. If you are attacked by a spider, run to the other side of the rock. World switching is useful here to fill the inventory with ore, as it takes 12 minutes for the runite to respawn.

Player killers are often found around this mine, as foes cannot teleport until they reach a Wilderness Obelisk, the Mage Arena, or level 20-30 Wilderness. To complement this, it is easy to attack and kill unsuspecting players who are looking for runite ore to mine as they often forego armour in order to reduce weight and item loss upon death. To reduce the risk of being killed while mining, it is recommended that players bring a few pieces of high-healing food, such as sharks.

label: Lava trough
title: Lava trough
lead: The Lava trough is found in the elemental workshop near the fire elementals. During the Elemental Workshop I quest, players must take lava from the trough using a stone bowl and then use it to light the nearby furnace.

label: Law Altar
title: Law Altar
lead:
The Law Altar is a runic altar upon which law runes are crafted from pure essence, providing 9.5 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 54 Runecraft and completion of the quest Troll Stronghold is required to craft law runes. The altar is believed to have been built upon the very spot where Saradomin first set foot upon Gielinor in the Second Age.

Players may create a law tiara here by using either a law talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 47.5 Runecraft experience. A catalytic tiara can also be created here by using a catalytic talisman and gold tiara, granting 42.5 Runecraft experience.

label: Law rune
title: Law rune
lead: The law rune is a rune used in all teleportation and telekinesis spells, as well as in many of the supportive and utility spells on the Lunar Spellbook. For non-members, the main source of law runes is from monster drops, as most monsters that drop runes may occasionally drop law runes. For members, they may be purchased in the Mage Arena Rune Shop or in the Wizards' Guild, requiring 66 Magic and completion of The Hand in the Sand. They can also be purchased from Ali Morrisane after partial completion of the Rogue Trader miniquest (after completing The Feud quest), from the magic store on Ape Atoll after obtaining the greegree as part of the Monkey Madness I quest, or from the magic store in Prifdinnas after completing Song of the Elves. Guardians of the Rift offers an efficient and affordable way of acquiring law runes.

label: Law talisman
title: Law talisman
lead:
The law talisman is a talisman used to access the Law Altar located on Entrana for the purpose of runecraft. It can also be combined with a silver tiara by using the tiara on the Law Altar with the talisman in your inventory, resulting in a law tiara. Once inside the altar a player can make law runes. This requires 54 Runecraft.

The law talisman is a reward for completing the Troll Stronghold quest, and can be acquired again from Dunstan in Burthorpe for 1000 coins each if lost or if you want to have spare talismans. Dunstan will not sell you another law talisman if there are already five in your inventory or bank.

label: leafy palm tree
title: leafy palm tree
lead:
Leafy Palm Trees are found only in the Kharazi Jungle. They are spaced sporadically around the jungle but have a fair concentration around the water pool, which is near teak trees marked by the western tree symbol on the map. There is also one near the totem pole in the west of the jungle.

Leafy palm trees cannot be cut, but shaking one causes a palm leaf to drop from it. There is a cool-down period of about 35 seconds before another leaf can be obtained from the same tree. To save a small amount of time on the Karamja Diary, you can shake a leafy palm tree, then drop and pick up the leaf five times.

label: Lean
title: Lean
lead:
Lean is one of four Mime emote unlocked as a Random event reward. Via the loop option, the player character will lean on the air continuously until they interact with the overworld or perform another emote.

Upon completing a Mime event, players are returned to their previous location in game, with a new mime emote unlocked. Players cannot choose which of the four emotes unlock since this is random.

label: Leather
title: Leather
lead:
Leather, or soft leather, is obtained from tanning a cowhide. Leather can be used with a needle and thread to be crafted into leather gloves, leather boots, leather cowl, leather vambraces, leather body, a coif or leather chaps, granting Crafting experience. On every fifth piece of leather used, one thread will be consumed, effectively necessitating a 1/5 ratio of thread needed per leather when creating armour.

A single piece of leather can be found on top of a table in the Shayzien Encampment. You must use telekinetic grab to pick it up.

label: Leather body
title: Leather body
lead: Leather body is a part of leather armour and is the weakest ranged torso in the game. It requires 1 Ranged to equip. By using steel studs on a leather body, members can turn them into a studded body at level 41 Crafting.

label: leather boots
title: leather boots
lead: Leather boots is a part of leather armour worn on the foot slot that offer slight bonuses to defence. They can also be found while big net fishing.

label: Leather chaps
title: Leather chaps
lead: Leather chaps is a part of leather armour that is worn in the legs slot, most commonly by low-level rangers. Low-levelled player mages also often wear these chaps, since they give a slight defence bonuses without a magic attack penalty.

label: Leather cowl
title: Leather cowl
lead: Leather cowls are leather armour worn on the head, most commonly by low-levelled rangers.

label: Leather gloves
title: Leather gloves
lead: Leather gloves are basic gloves worn in the hands slot, offering slight defensive bonuses. Making them requires 1 Crafting, 1 leather, 1 thread, and a needle, yielding 13.8 Crafting experience.

label: Leather vambraces
title: Leather vambraces
lead:
Leather vambraces are leather armour worn on the hands. With no requirements to equip, they are most commonly used by low-level rangers, and often mages (as there is no magic penalty). Overall they are generally a superior alternative to leather gloves with a notable exception of the crush defence, and could be considered the best "gloves" for free-to-play users who lack 40 Ranged to equip green dragonhide vambraces, as well as the best-in-slot mage gloves due to their lack of negative penalties.

Kebbit claws can be used on these vambraces to make spiky vambraces, requiring a Crafting level of 32.

label: Leatherworker
title: Leatherworker
lead:
The Leatherworker is a Tanner and a member of the Ranging Guild. Found on the north-eastern side of the guild, she can cure and tan hides into leather. Her shop is marked with the tanning icon ( ).

Unlike other tanners, she does not have a specific Option to access the tanning interface. It is instead accessed through a dialogue option when talking to her.

label: Leela
title: Leela
lead: Leela is a spy from Al Kharid and daughter of Osman, the head spymaster. She can be found just north of the jail in Draynor Village. She is involved in the Prince Ali Rescue quest, where she helps the player organising Prince Ali's escape from Lady Keli's clutches.

label: Legends Guild door
title: Legends Guild door
lead: The Legends Guild doors are the entrance to the Legends' Guild. The doors can only be opened after the player has completed the majority of the Legends' Quest.

label: Legends Guild General Store.
title: Legends Guild General Store.
lead: The Legends Guild General Store is a general store located on the of Legends' Guild, owned by Fionella.

id: page:legends guild shop of useful items.
label: Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items.
title: Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items.
lead: The Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items is a store located on the of Legends' Guild, owned by the Guildmaster's brother, Siegfried Erkle. The shop is the only source of the Cape of legends and Mithril seeds (except the quest reward from Waterfall Quest).

label: Legends' Guard
title: Legends' Guard
lead:
Legends' Guards are unattackable guards outside the Legends' Guild. They wear what appears to be blurite armour and carry an iron spear.

The two guards will greet you when you go through the gate. Their message varies based on your status in the Legends' Quest: during the quest they say "I hope the quest is going well [sir/madam]", while after the quest they say "Attention! Legends' guild member approaching!".

label: Legends' Guild
title: Legends' Guild
lead:
The Legends' Guild is the second most exclusive of the quest-based guilds in Old School RuneScape (with the Myths' Guild being the first). It is located to the north-east of East Ardougne, east of Hemenster and the south of Seers' Village. To enter the grounds of the Legends' Guild, players must have started the Legends' Quest. However, to enter the actual building, players must have completed the entire quest. Radimus Erkle is the grand vizier of the guild, and he is also the start point of the Legends' Quest.

A number of NPCs are implied to be members of the guild, by the fact they themselves wear a cape of legends.

label: Legends' Guild bank
title: Legends' Guild bank
lead: The Legends' Guild bank is a bank found on the top floor of the Legends' Guild. Players must have completed Legends' Quest to enter.

label: Legends' Guild mine
title: Legends' Guild mine
lead:
The Legends' Guild mining site, also called the East Ardougne Mine, is located just south-west of the Legends' Guild and east of Ardougne's east entrance. Both places have a bank that can used for depositing ores. This mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining. It can be accessed using Fairy ring code and then walking south and slightly west.

This site contains many coal rocks, and some players may find it more useful than the Mining Guild as it is less crowded and is closer to a bank. Players can bank their ores at Ardougne, the Legends' Guild (requires completion of the Legends' Quest), or Zanaris (requires completion of Lost City and partial completion of Fairytale II - Cure a Queen), which can be accessed by the fairy ring near the Legends' Guild.

label: Legends' Quest
title: Legends' Quest
lead:
Legends' Quest is a quest in which the player is sent by Guildmaster Radimus Erkle to explore and map the Kharazi Jungle on the southern part of Karamja, establish relations with the natives and obtain a gift from them.

Legends' Quest was the 50th quest to be released, and the last quest to be released before the launch of the RuneScape 2 beta. It was the first quest to be rated Master.

label: Legion
title: Legion
lead: Legion is a music track that is unlocked at Barbarian Outpost. It can also be heard underneath the Barbarian Agility Course and the lobby of Barbarian Assault. Prior to tracks removal from Wilderness Bandit Camp in 2021, this track was accessible to free-to-play players.

label: lemon
title: lemon
lead:
A lemon is a food item that heals 2 hitpoints when eaten. It is generally used as an ingredient in gnome cooking, in cocktails such as the fruit blast, pineapple punch, the wizard blizzard, and the blurberry special. Players can use a knife to cut the lemon into lemon chunks or lemon slices, which are also used in making cocktails.

Lemons cannot be produced through the Farming skill. However, they can be used to make regular compost.

label: lemon chunks
title: lemon chunks
lead:
Lemon chunks are used in gnome cooking. One can obtain them by using a knife on a lemon and choosing the option to dice the lemon.

Lemon chunks are used as an ingredient in a Blurberry special. It is used in the second step of preparing the drink, and must be in the inventory along with orange chunks, equa leaves and a sliced lime to be able to pour a mixed special into a cocktail glass.

label: Lemon slices
title: Lemon slices
lead:
Lemon slices are used in gnome cooking. Players can obtain them by using a knife on a lemon.

Lemon slices are used as an ingredient in a fruit blast. It is used in the second step of preparing the drink, and must be in the inventory to be able to pour a mixed blast into a cocktail glass.

label: Lens mould
title: Lens mould
lead:
The lens mould is a quest item in the Observatory Quest. It is obtained by searching a stove in a locked kitchen in the Observatory Dungeon. The kitchen is accessed by killing the goblin guard nearby and then using the goblin kitchen key on the gate.

The mould must be given to the Observatory professor along with a piece of molten glass to make a new observatory lens for the telescope. He will be unable to make the lens and will return the mould and glass so the player can make it.

label: Lesser Demon
title: Lesser Demon
lead:
Lesser demons are the second weakest standard demon, above the imp. They are sometimes killed by Free-to-play players, as they are one of the strongest monsters on those servers and can drop the desirable rune med helm. Lesser demons have a somewhat low Defence, which can make them a good source of combat experience. They are susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons.

The Chasm of Fire is one of the best locations for slaying lesser demons. The fairy ring ( ) is very close, and a Dwarf Multicannon can be used to speed up the task; players can also safespot in this location. Although combat experience per hour can be above average, lesser demons' sparse drops make them a below average Slayer task.

label: Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)
title: Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)
lead:
A Lesser demon is found in the basement of Melzar's Maze, past Melzar the Mad. It must be killed to obtain the green key, which can unlock the green door and complete the maze.

According to Melzar's notes, Melzar summoned and subdued the demon to channel its magic to help perform necromancy to bring back the Crandorian refugees (including his wife) that were slain by Elvarg. However, as Melzar's sanity dwindled due to the numerous repeated failures to resurrect his fellow countrymen, the demon continued to encourage him, which led to Melzar becoming completely insane and obsessed with cabbages.

label: Level 1 certificate
title: Level 1 certificate
lead:
The level 1 certificate is a quest item used during The Dig Site. Players may obtain one after completing the first archaeology exam. The certificate allows players to dig at level 1 sites in the Digsite.

After completing the quest, players may bring the certificate to the Varrock Museum curator who will take it for safekeeping. This is not required to claim the reward from giving in the Level 3 certificate. You will not get the certificate back.

label: Level 2 certificate
title: Level 2 certificate
lead:
The level 2 certificate is a quest item used during the Digsite Quest. Players may obtain one after completing the second archaeology exam. The certificate allows players to dig at level 2 sites in the Digsite.
