After completing the quest, players may bring the certificate to the Varrock Museum curator, who will take it for safekeeping. This is not required to claim the reward from giving in the Level 3 certificate. You will not get the certificate back.

label: Level 3 certificate
title: Level 3 certificate
lead:
The level 3 certificate is a quest item used during The Dig Site. Players may obtain one after completing the third archaeology exam. The certificate allows players to dig at level 3 sites in the Digsite.

After completing the quest, players may bring the certificate to the Varrock Museum curator to get a Fruit blast or a Chocolate cake. Note: the item will be consumed once given to the museum's curator.

label: Lever (Ardougne)
title: Lever (Ardougne)
lead: The Ardougne teleport lever is located in the west section of East Ardougne, just north of the gate separating the two cities. Along with the Edgeville teleport lever, this is the lever that transports players to the lever located in deep Wilderness in the Deserted Keep when pulled. Doing this is a requirement for the Easy Ardougne Diary. When pulled, the messages You pull the lever... and ... and teleport into the Wilderness. will be displayed.

label: Lever (Deserted Keep)
title: Lever (Deserted Keep)
lead:
The lever, also known as the wilderness lever, can be found in the Deserted Keep, located within the deep Wilderness. The lever can be pulled to teleport to the lever in East Ardougne, and after completion of the easy Wilderness Diary, can also be used to teleport near the lever in Edgeville. Players can set the default left-click teleport option by using the swap-options option on the lever, or in the settings menu.

When pulled, the messages You pull the lever... and ... and teleport out of the Wilderness. will be displayed.

label: Lever (Elemental Workshop I)
title: Lever (Elemental Workshop I)
lead: Levers can be found on the first floor of the Elemental Workshop, operating various machinery in parts of the workshop. A lever in the water room can be pulled to turn the waterwheel once the water controls have been operated. A lever in the air room is used to start the bellows once they have been repaired.

label: Lever (Family Crest)
title: Lever (Family Crest)
lead: Levers can be found at three locations within Witchaven Dungeon. During the Family Crest quest, players must pull the levers in a set sequence. Doing so unlocks a door that leads to room where the player can mine 'perfect' gold ore. Once the door is unlocked, it does not require the lever puzzle to be solved again.

label: Lever (King Black Dragon Lair)
title: Lever (King Black Dragon Lair)
lead:
A lever can be found on the southern wall of the King Black Dragon Lair. Players can pull the lever to exit the lair and teleport to the Lava Maze Dungeon.

: Using the lever to exit the lair will teleport the player to level 42 Wilderness. It is recommended to use an alternative teleportation method to exit the lair if returning to the Lava Maze Dungeon is not necessary.

label: Lever (Lava Maze Dungeon)
title: Lever (Lava Maze Dungeon)
lead:
A lever can be found in the Lava Maze Dungeon, accessible by climbing down the ladder on the west side of the Lava Maze. Players can pull the lever to teleport to the King Black Dragon Lair. However, if a player is teleblocked, they cannot teleport via the lever. Additionally, players have the option to open a private instance of the lair for 50,000 coins; payment for the instance can be deducted directly from their bank. The 'commune' option on the lever allows players to see the number of other players currently within the lair.

: While the lair itself is not in the Wilderness, players are in the Wilderness until they pull the lever.

label: Lever (Temple of Ikov)
title: Lever (Temple of Ikov)
lead:
The lever is a quest item in the Temple of Ikov quest. It is found in the eastern room in the Temple of Ikov after crossing the bridge which requires the player's weight to be below 0 kg (using boots of lightness or other weight-reducing clothing) to successfully cross. It is used to operate a broken lever which opens a door leading further into the temple.

After the quest, the item is still obtainable, but has no further use beyond the quest.

label: Lever (Watchtower)
title: Lever (Watchtower)
lead: Lever is an interactive scenery object that can be found on the of the Watchtower located north-east of Yanille. Players must pull the lever during the Watchtower quest once all the power crystals have been obtained and are in their correct places in order to power the magic shield protecting Yanille from the Ogres.

label: Lever bracket
title: Lever bracket
lead:
The Lever bracket is a broken lever located in the Temple of Ikov, on the south-west wall from the leader near the entrance. The lever has to be repaired first, by using the lever piece on the bracket. The lever can then be pulled.

Warning: If you place the lever but do not pull it and then leave the area, the lever will not be there when you return. You will have to cross the bridge again to collect it.

label: Lightness
title: Lightness
lead:
Lightness is a music track that is unlocked in the north-east of Asgarnia, around Ice Mountain or the Monastery or east of Falador. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Scape Soft.

In Classic mode, the track plays at an area around Goblin Village and in the south-west slope of Ice Mountain. Playing at the latter is presumably unintentional due to Alone playing there before 2021.

label: Lightwalk
title: Lightwalk
lead:
Lightwalk is a music track that is unlocked in Catherby. In this area, the music track will shuffle between playing this track and Fishing.

In Classic music mode, this track plays at Keep Le Faye and western Catherby.

label: lime
title: lime
lead:
A lime is a members-only green fruit used in Gnome Cuisine, most often used in Gnome cooking. It can be diced with a knife into lime chunks, or sliced with a knife into lime slices. These both heal 2 Hitpoints each.

Unlike most other fruits, it cannot be grown using the Farming skill. Instead, they must be bought from Hudo's groceries and Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree. It is also available from the market seller in Pollnivneach, gotten as drop from gnomes throughout Tree Gnome Stronghold or it can be stolen at the fruit stall in Hosidius or in the Kourend Castle courtyard.

label: lime chunks
title: lime chunks
lead: Lime chunks are a food item that are obtained by using a knife on a lime and selecting "Dice". When eaten, they heal 2 hitpoints. After being diced, lime chunks may be used in gnome cooking to make either a fruit batta or pineapple punch.

label: Lime slices
title: Lime slices
lead: Lime slices are food obtained by using a knife on a lime. They are an ingredient in gnome cocktails.

label: limpwurt root
title: limpwurt root
lead:
Limpwurt roots are a Herblore secondary ingredient that can be grown through the Farming skill at level 26 with limpwurt seeds. 15 limpwurt roots are used to protect growing teak trees.

They are useful in free-to-play to make strength potions (or super strength for members). The Apothecary in Varrock will exchange them for four-dose antipoison, energy potions, and strength potions. Adding them to a compost bin makes regular compost.

label: liquid honey
title: liquid honey
lead:
Liquid honey is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is obtained from Elena after returning her distillator to her.

It is first given to Chancy, who will smuggle it into the Dancing Donkey Inn, past the Guard conducting body searches. After retrieving it from Chancy, it is given to Guidor in south-east Varrock, alongside plague sample, sulphuric broline, ethenea, and touch paper.

label: Lit candle (unobtainable item)
title: Lit candle (unobtainable item)
lead:
A lit candle is an unobtainable version of the Lit candle. Candles were previously tradeable and could be turned into banknotes. However, they were made untradeable due to an unfixable bug where trading a lit candle in a dark area would not update the lighting for either player. Any player who had a noted Lit candle was given this now discontinued item. Originally, the item was identical to the real lit candle, except being stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Lobster
title: Lobster
lead:
Lobster is a type of fish that restores 12 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw lobster on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 40 Cooking and granting 120 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt lobster. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 74.

When eaten, the message You eat the lobster. is displayed.

label: Lobster pot
title: Lobster pot
lead:
Lobster pots are items that can be bought from major fishing shops for 20 coins each and are used to fish lobsters from cage/harpoon fishing spots with 40 Fishing, which are a common healing food that restores 12 Hitpoints. A lobster pot spawn is found within the Fishing Guild.

They are also used in dark crab fishing. Dark crab fishing spots are only in the Wilderness and require level 85 fishing,

label: Local Gnome
title: Local Gnome
lead: Local gnomes are gnomes found around King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village. Unlike other gnomes, they can not be attacked.

label: Locating crystal
title: Locating crystal
lead:
The locating crystal is a quest item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by searching the dolmen in the Tomb of Bervirius. It is used to locate the tomb of Rashiliyia. In order for it to function the player is required to have at least 10 prayer points. After the quest is finished, it no longer functions but can be sold to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 500 coins.

If the player tries to drop the crystal, it will break and may damage the player for 1-10 Hitpoints. In case a player has less than 15 points of health however, dropping a locating crystal will inflict an amount of damage equal to half their Hitpoints instead.

label: Locating crystal (unobtainable item)
title: Locating crystal (unobtainable item)
lead: The locating crystal is an unobtainable item that appears during the Shilo Village quest. When the player obtains the Locating crystal, they can use it to locate the tomb of Rashiliyia. A different coloured version of the crystal will appear in the chatbox, depending on how close the player is to the tomb. The actual recoloured crystals, however, cannot be obtained by the player.

label: Locked gate
title: Locked gate
lead: Locked Gates are cosmetic scenery found in Seers' Village, south-east to the Bank, as well as the Ogresses' Bank Vault at Corsair Cove Dungeon.

label: Locked Ogre chest
title: Locked Ogre chest
lead: The Locked Ogre chest is located in Rantz's cave and is unlocked during the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. The chest is closed and weighted shut with a large rock. During the quest, the player has to unlock the chest to obtain ogre bellows.

label: lockpick
title: lockpick
lead:
A lockpick is an item used with the Thieving skill that can be used on certain locked objects. While some objects require a lockpick to be unlocked, certain objects are instead only made easier to open.

Lockpicks can be obtained by pickpocketing bandits (with 53 Thieving) and rogues (31 Thieving), or as drops from young implings and scavenger beasts. They can also be purchased from Martin Thwait, though this requires level 50 Thieving and Agility, or level 99 Thieving.

label: Log balance (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
title: Log balance (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
lead: The log balance is an Agility obstacle found within the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. Passing the obstacle requires 35 Agility and will award 13.7 Agility experience.

label: Log balance (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Log balance (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The log balance is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to cross will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

The amount of damage dealt by the fall is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: Log balance (Coal Trucks)
title: Log balance (Coal Trucks)
lead: The log balance is an Agility shortcut found near the coal trucks west of Seers' Village. Crossing requires 20 Agility and will grant 8.5 Agility experience. Crossing the log is an easy task for the Kandarin diary.

label: Log balance (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
title: Log balance (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
lead: The log balance is an Agility obstacle found within the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. An Agility level of one is required to pass the obstacle, which will then grant the player 10 Agility experience. It is not possible to fail this obstacle.

label: Log balance (Wilderness Agility Course)
title: Log balance (Wilderness Agility Course)
lead:
The log balance is an Agility obstacle found within the Wilderness Agility Course. Passing the obstacle grants 20 Agility experience, and failing it causes the player to fall into the dungeon below and take damage based on their current health, according to the expression below.

\left\lfloor\text{Hitpoints}\times\frac{3}{20}\right\rfloor + 1

label: Log pile
title: Log pile
lead: Log piles are examinable scenery.

label: Logs
title: Logs
lead:
Logs, also called normal logs, are obtained from cutting regular, evergreen, jungle, dying and dead trees, and uncommonly from infected roots. Players can burn these logs using the Firemaking skill. Cutting the logs gives 25 Woodcutting experience, and burning them gives 40 Firemaking experience. These logs have no requirement to be cut or burnt.

Members training Construction can bring logs to a sawmill to make planks at a cost of 100 coins each. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes.

label: Logs (Tutorial Island)
title: Logs (Tutorial Island)
lead:
Logs are a unique variant of logs that can only be obtained on Tutorial Island. They are obtained by cutting down a Tutorial Island tree. The Survival Expert teaches the player how to cut down the trees using a bronze axe; they must obtain some logs and burn them in order to 
proceed to the next part of the tutorial.

A second variant of the logs can be obtained from the alternate Tutorial Island available to some players in 2020.

label: Lollk
title: Lollk
lead: Lollk is a young dwarf, son of Gilob. He is in the Goblin Cave south-east of the Fishing Guild, north of East Ardougne. He is involved in the Dwarf Cannon quest. To find him, take the centre path when first entering the cave, and head to the north-western most room of the cave. He will be in one of the crates in the north-eastern part of this room.

label: Lonesome
title: Lonesome
lead: Lonesome is a music track that is unlocked in the Desert Mining Camp during The Tourist Trap quest.

label: Long Ago
title: Long Ago
lead: Long Ago is a music track that is unlocked on the Yanille Chain south-east of Yanille.

label: Long Way Home
title: Long Way Home
lead:
Long Way Home is a music track that can be unlocked outside Falador city walls, at the Falador Farm, Crafting Guild, and the Dark Wizards' Tower. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Miles Away and Nightfall.

In Classic mode, the track plays in Rimmington.

label: Longbow
title: Longbow
lead:
The basic longbow is a bow made from regular logs. It can be equipped at any Ranged level and can fire arrows up to iron. It has a longer range than its shortbow counterpart, but fires at a slower speed.

A longbow can be made at level 10 Fletching by using a knife on some logs to create a longbow (u), granting 10 experience, and then using a bowstring on the unstrung bow, granting another 10 experience.

label: Longbow (u)
title: Longbow (u)
lead: A longbow (u) is made using a knife with logs, requiring 10 Fletching and yielding 10 Fletching experience. Stringing a longbow (u) with a bowstring makes a longbow, also requiring 10 Fletching and yielding an additional 10 Fletching experience.

label: loop half of key
title: loop half of key
lead:
The loop half of key is an item dropped by any monster that has access to the gem drop table or the rare drop table. It is also a reward from various random events, the gnome restaurant, from Managing Miscellania, caskets, looting magpie implings, and unlocking the crystal chest in Taverley. It can also be found in the Barrows chest as a separate item if the player has 100% rewards potential.

The loop half of a key is used with a tooth half of key to make a crystal key, which is used to unlock the crystal chest, which contains a dragonstone and an assortment of other items.

label: Loose Mud
title: Loose Mud
lead: Loose Mud is located under Gnocci the Cook's hut and in the south-east prison cell of the Underground Pass. It plays a role in the Underground Pass quest where players can either use a spade on it or dig near it, but Loose Mud itself has no right-click interact options.

label: Loose Railing (McGrubor's Wood)
title: Loose Railing (McGrubor's Wood)
lead: The loose railing is a piece of scenery used to enter McGrubor's Wood. The railing and the nearby fairy ring (code ) are the only ways to enter the wood, as the player is prevented from opening the front gates by the Forester.

label: Loose Railing (Tree Gnome Village)
title: Loose Railing (Tree Gnome Village)
lead: The loose railing is a part of the Gnome Maze that surrounds the Tree Gnome Village. Players must reach it through the maze at least once in order to enter the interior location and start the Tree Gnome Village quest, after which they can follow Elkoy.

label: loose rocks
title: loose rocks
lead: Loose rocks can be found in the Ah Za Rhoon temple during the Shilo Village quest. If searched, the player will obtain the tattered scroll. After quest completion, subsequent searches will result in the chat message, "You notice nothing significant about this.".

label: Lord Daquarius
title: Lord Daquarius
lead:
Lord Daquarius Rennard is the current lord of the Kinshra, also known as the Black Knights. Daquarius is held in high regard by ally and enemy alike, and is generally seen as a fair and noble leader.

He was unanimously elected Lord of the Kinshra after the death of his predecessor Lord Shadwell, becoming the youngest to ever gain leadership. Since then, he has been involved in many Kinshra affairs, several of which involved attempts to conquer Falador.

label: Lost City
title: Lost City
lead: Lost City is a quest about the fairy land Zanaris. A group of adventurers have set up camp in Lumbridge Swamp, claiming to be searching for the mystical lost city. You must find the truth of this claim, and gain entrance to the moon of Gielinor, Zanaris.

label: Louie Legs
title: Louie Legs
lead: Louie Legs is a shopkeeper who owns Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar located in the south-eastern corner of Al Kharid. Louie sells platelegs from bronze to adamant in his shop. If you bring him one acorn and one set of bones, he will give you the corrupted platelegs and skirt.

label: Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar.
title: Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar.
lead: Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar is a shop in Al Kharid which sells various platelegs. It is run by Louie Legs.

label: Louisa
title: Louisa
lead: Louisa is the cook to the Sinclair family. She is a witness during King's Ransom.

label: Low Level Alchemy
title: Low Level Alchemy
lead:
Low Level Alchemy (also known as low alch or LA) is a utility spell available in the standard spellbook. It requires level 21 Magic to cast, and grants 31 Magic experience per cast.

Casting Low Level Alchemy on an item in the player's inventory will convert that item into a number of coins equal to 40% of the item's value (not the item's Grand Exchange price).

label: Low wall (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Low wall (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead: The low wall is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. It is possible to fail this obstacle at very low Agility levels, although no damage is dealt as the player stumbles back to the starting square.

label: Lowe
title: Lowe
lead:
Lowe is the owner of Lowe's Archery Emporium, found in Varrock just east of the general store. He sells ranging equipment including bronze through adamant arrows, bronze bolts, crossbows, and a variety of shortbows and longbows. The higher level equipment there is, the less there will usually be in stock, since it is higher in demand.

On Deadman Mode worlds, he additionally sells Dorgeshuun crossbows, bone bolts, and bone bolt packs.

label: Lowe's Archery Emporium
title: Lowe's Archery Emporium
lead:
Lowe's Archery Emporium is located near central Varrock just east of the main square. This store is operated by Lowe.

Ironman players who intend on buying arrows here should note that the shop very frequently experiences a shortage of arrows, due to other players purchasing them in large amounts. In Deadman mode it also sells bone bolts, and Dorgeshuun crossbow.

label: Lozar's house
title: Lozar's house
lead:
Lozar's house, also known as the Goblin house, is a small house in Lumbridge found across the river from The Sheared Ram and south of the Groats' farm.

Recently goblins raided the house, killing Lozar, the house's previous inhabitant . The dead trees surrounding the house, the charred bones inside, and the colour of the ground outside the house suggest that the goblins set the place on fire. The goblins have since taken up residence in the house.

label: Lucien
title: Lucien
lead:
Lucien is a Mahjarrat and a powerful mage and necromancer. He sided with Zamorak in his rebellion against Zaros.

Speaking with Lucien starts the Temple of Ikov quest, and he gives you the pendant of lucien needed in the quest. During the quest, the player is tasked with stealing the Staff of Armadyl from the Temple of Ikov. However, the player is later given the choice to side with the Guardians of Armadyl or continuing aiding Lucien.

label: Lucky Win (Death Plateau)
title: Lucky Win (Death Plateau)
lead:
Lucky Win (Death Plateau) is a Jingle that plays when:
* Winning a dice gamble with Harold during Death Plateau.
* Leveling up Sailing during the 2014 April Fools event.

label: Lucy
title: Lucy
lead:
Lucy is a barmaid and employee of the Falador Party Room, a large venue in the north-eastern part of Falador. When spoken to, she will serve the player beer.

Like all employees of the Party Room, she wears a red partyhat.

label: Lullaby
title: Lullaby
lead:
Lullaby is a music track that is unlocked on the path to Rellekka and in the Digsite. In the Digsite area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Venture.

In Classic mode, the area around the Digsite where it can be unlocked is reduced to just the northern half of the Digsite. This track will also play on the path to Rellekka in Classic mode.

label: Lumber order
title: Lumber order
lead:
The lumber order is a quest item that is part of The Grand Tree quest.

It is an order from Glough, who intends to build up a gnome army to wipe out humans. Players obtain it from a foreman in the Karamja ship yard, either by talking to him or killing him.

label: Lumber Yard
title: Lumber Yard
lead:
The Lumber Yard is a location north-east of Varrock. It is only accessible to members. Its main feature is the Sawmill operator, who is located in a small room along the yard's south-west wall. He is involved in the Construction skill: he can turn logs into planks for a fee, and he also sells bolts of cloth, three kinds of nails, and saws.

Players can get here the quickest by using the Lumberyard teleport scroll. They can also take the balloon transport system or teleport to the Earth Altar with the ring of the elements to end up right below the Lumber Yard. Alternatively, they can use the digsite pendant to get close by, or simply walk from Varrock.

label: Lumbridge
title: Lumbridge
lead:
Lumbridge is a large town where players begin their Old School RuneScape journey. New players are sent here from Tutorial Island to further learn the game from various tutors across the town. Lumbridge gets its name from the bridge that crosses the River Lum.

After a player's death, Lumbridge is the player's default respawn point, although players can change their respawn location to other locations. The main point of interest of Lumbridge is the Lumbridge Castle, where players can start several quests and access its bank at the top floor.

label: Lumbridge cabbage patch
title: Lumbridge cabbage patch
lead: The Lumbridge Cabbage Patch was a small fenced area directly north of Lumbridge which contained cabbages. It was replaced by a pasture containing cows with the release of permanent free-to-play on 19 February 2015 to accommodate for the influx of new free-to-play players.

label: Lumbridge Castle
title: Lumbridge Castle
lead:
Lumbridge Castle is a large castle located in Lumbridge and home of Duke Horacio. The courtyard enclosed by the outer walls features two decorative fountains and two statues, one of an ancient king and one of an ancient hero. A short flight of three steps joins this to the castle's front entrance. Another entrance is behind the castle.

The Lumbridge Home Teleport and Lumbridge Teleport spells take players to the courtyard of the castle.

label: Lumbridge Church
title: Lumbridge Church
lead:
The Lumbridge church, referred to in-game as the Church of Holy Saradomin by Father Aereck, is the official church of Lumbridge. The church is the starting place for the Restless Ghost quest, and also contains the Prayer tutor. There's a playable organ behind the altar.

According to Father Aereck, the church was built over 230 years ago.

label: Lumbridge cow field
title: Lumbridge cow field
lead:
The Lumbridge cow field is a field containing level 2 cows and cow calves. Located in the north-east of Lumbridge, the field is managed by Gillie Groats, and is part of the larger Groats' farm. Also present are dairy cows, which can be milked if you have a bucket in your inventory. This is a good place to train either Magic or Ranged at a low combat level due to the fact that you can safely kill them from the other side of the fence, and run in to loot between kills. There are 2 cow fields in Lumbridge: north of the windmill and east of the town.

This field is a very popular training spot for low levels of both free players and members because of the 100% cowhide drop, as well as raw beef and bones to train Cooking and Prayer with respectively. It is also an extremely good place to train Prayer and Cooking as bones and beef are often left in the rush to collect cow hides. This is also the closest cow field to a bank as well as a Tanner in Al Kharid, which also makes it crowded.

label: Lumbridge General Store
title: Lumbridge General Store
lead:
The Lumbridge General Store is the general store located north of the Lumbridge Castle in Lumbridge. When new players arrive in Old School RuneScape, they start in Lumbridge and tend to have a look around, and thus the store is a popular place for new players.

Players can spectate teams attempting the Theatre of Blood raid by speaking to Abigaila upstairs.

label: Lumbridge Graveyard
title: Lumbridge Graveyard
lead:
The Lumbridge Graveyard is located in the south-eastern portion of Lumbridge behind the Lumbridge Church. The graveyard contains various gravestones as well as a mausoleum housing the coffin of the restless ghost. During the The Restless Ghost quest, players must speak with the restless ghost inside the mausoleum. The graveyard also features Nigel and Count Check, as well as an entrance to Death's Office.

A yew tree is located in the north-eastern corner of the graveyard.

label: Lumbridge pasture
title: Lumbridge pasture
lead: The Lumbridge pasture is a large cow field in Lumbridge, north of Fred's farm and bordering the River Lum. Players can find a dairy cow, cow calves, cows, and a level 7 farmer. The only way to enter the pasture is through a gate on the southern side.

label: Lumbridge pond
title: Lumbridge pond
lead: The Lumbridge pond is a small body of water found amongst the farms of Lumbridge and Draynor. The pond features two ducks and two ducklings, all of whom are attackable, as well as two more ducks outside of the pond that can only be examined.

label: Lumbridge Swamp
title: Lumbridge Swamp
lead:
The Lumbridge Swamp is located south of Lumbridge and is east of Draynor Village. It can be accessed via a small gateway at the back of the graveyard behind Lumbridge Church. You can also access it via an entry south-east of Draynor Village, or you can swing across an Agility shortcut from Al Kharid. Zandar Horfyre will also teleport the player here, away from the Dark Wizards' Tower, if they refuse to leave when going through his dialogue. It is also possible to get to the Lumbridge swamp by using a ring of the elements to teleport to the water altar, or alternatively by travelling to the altar through the Abyss and exiting the portal.

There are several fishing spots on the east end of the swamps that are ideal for novice anglers. There are two mining sites in the swamps.

label: Lumbridge Teleport
title: Lumbridge Teleport
lead:
Lumbridge Teleport teleports the caster to Lumbridge. Unlike the free Lumbridge Home Teleport spell, this is fast and cannot be interrupted by combat, though like most other teleports, it is unusable above level 20 Wilderness or when the player is teleblocked. Players returning to Lumbridge may save runes by using the free teleport instead, if they are not in danger.

Casting this spell is a requirement for the medium Lumbridge & Draynor diary.

label: lump of crystal
title: lump of crystal
lead:
The lump of crystal is a quest item used during the Legends' Quest. It is obtained by defeating Ranalph Devere in the Viyeldi caves beneath the Kharazi Jungle. When combined with the chunk of crystal and the hunk of crystal (obtained by defeating the other two warriors) at the furnace, they form the heart crystal required to unlock a door that leads further into the caves.

It is not possible to obtain the heart fragments after completing the quest; killing the knights again does not provide the player with the fragments. However, duplicate parts of the crystal can be obtained during the quest by utilising the drop trick. If the player does this, they are able to create another (albeit useless) heart crystal after completing the quest.

label: Lundail
title: Lundail
lead:
Lundail sells runes in his store Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop in the Mage Arena bank, beneath the Mage Arena in a safe area of the Wilderness. He sells air, water, fire, earth, body, mind, nature, chaos, law, cosmic, and death runes.

After completing the easy Wilderness Diary, players can claim-runes from him to receive one type of catalytic rune, selected randomly from the seven kinds he sells. The number of runes increases according to the tier of Wilderness Diary completed:

label: Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop.
title: Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop.
lead:
Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop, owned by Lundail, is located in the Mage Arena bank dungeon. To enter the dungeon, players must traverse the deep Wilderness and pull the teleportation lever. Although this Mage Arena is located in the Wilderness, this area is a safe zone. Be sure to bring a knife or slash weapon in order to slash the webs blocking the lever.

The store sells different kinds of runes. This is a good place to restock runes if you run out when playing the Mage Arena minigame. This store is very popular for ironman accounts as this shop is one of the few Magic shops that sells law runes and cosmic runes, and the only one accessible with no requirements. The other stores are Magic Guild Store (Runes and Staves), Baba Yaga's Magic Shop, and Ali Morrisane's Catalytic Rune Shop.

label: Lunderwin
title: Lunderwin
lead:
Lunderwin is a fairy found near Irksol, who buys cabbages (both the normal and Draynor Manor variant) from the player for 100 coins each. The cabbages cannot be noted. This is not a recommended way for players to make money as it will come at a low profit due to the entrance fee of one diamond to enter the marketplace.

If a player took one diamond and 27 cabbages they could enter the marketplace and sell all of the cabbages to Lunderwin for a profit of .

label: Luthas
title: Luthas
lead:
Luthas is the banana plantation owner on Karamja who plays a small role in the Pirate's Treasure quest. He can be found in his living quarters next to the plantation.

Luthas will pay 30 coins to players that fill a crate with 10 bananas. The trip back to Port Sarim costs 30 coins, so if a player is out of money they can fill up a crate. During the Pirate's Treasure quest, players must put a bottle of Karamjan rum in the banana crate to be shipped over to mainland. Luthas carries a monkey on his back all the time.

label: Lvl-1 Enchant
title: Lvl-1 Enchant
lead:
Lvl-1 Enchant is a utility spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 7 Magic to cast and granting 17.5 experience. The spell enchants sapphire and opal items, primarily jewellery.

This spell can be transferred to a magic tablet by bringing the required runes and a piece of soft clay to a lectern in the study of a player-owned house, granting the same experience as casting the spell.

label: Lvl-2 Enchant
title: Lvl-2 Enchant
lead:
Lvl-2 Enchant is a utility spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 27 Magic to cast. The spell enchants emerald and jade items, primarily jewellery, granting 37 Magic experience when doing so.

This spell can be transferred to a magic tablet by bringing the required runes and a piece of soft clay to a lectern in the study of a player-owned house, granting the same experience as casting the spell.

label: Lvl-3 Enchant
title: Lvl-3 Enchant
lead:
Lvl-3 Enchant is a utility spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 49 Magic to cast. The spell enchants ruby and red topaz items, primarily jewellery, granting 59 Magic experience when doing so.

This spell can be transferred to a magic tablet by bringing the required runes and a piece of soft clay to a lectern in the study of a player-owned house, granting 44.3 Magic experience.

label: Lvl-4 Enchant
title: Lvl-4 Enchant
lead:
Lvl-4 Enchant is a utility spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 57 Magic to cast. The spell enchants diamond jewellery, granting 67 Magic experience when doing so.

This spell can be transferred to a magic tablet by bringing the required runes and a piece of soft clay to a lectern in the study of a player-owned house, granting the same experience as casting the spell.

label: Lvl-5 Enchant
title: Lvl-5 Enchant
lead:
Lvl-5 Enchant is a utility spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 68 Magic to cast. The spell enchants dragonstone jewellery, granting 78 Magic experience when doing so.

This spell can be transferred to a magic tablet by bringing the required runes and a piece of soft clay to a lectern in the study of a player-owned house, granting 58.5 Magic experience.

label: Machete
title: Machete
lead:
The machete is an item used in the Woodcutting skill. It can be obtained from the mainland Karamja general store and Shilo Village general store or by trading with another player. It can also be found by looking in Radimus Erkle's cupboard in the Legends' Guild; however, after the quest is complete you may no longer search the cupboard for a machete and are given the message "You don't think Radimus Erkle would be very pleased if he caught you rifling through his possessions".

The machete can be used as a weapon but is primarily used to cut Jungle during the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame. It has no requirements to wield though cutting Light, Medium, and Dense jungle requires 10, 20, and 35 Woodcutting to harvest respectively. A machete is also required to gain access to Kharazi Jungle if the player doesn't have access to the level 79 agility shortcut to the south-east of Shilo Village.

label: Machine (Watchtower)
title: Machine (Watchtower)
lead: A machine is scenery that can be found inside the Watchtower building. It is used during the Watchtower quest to activate the shield generator.

label: Mackerel
title: Mackerel
lead: Mackerel is a type of fish that restores 6 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw mackerel on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 10 Cooking and granting 60 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt fish. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Mackerel is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 45, or 41 when using the Lumbridge range.

label: Mad Eadgar
title: Mad Eadgar
lead: Mad Eadgar is a music track that is unlocked in Eadgar's cave on top of Trollheim.

label: Mad skavid
title: Mad skavid
lead:
The Mad skavid is a Skavid that has become deranged, either through being worked too hard by his Ogre masters or through some torture, and is found in a cave in the heart of Gu'Tanoth.

During the Watchtower quest, the player must speak to the Skavid in his native language, at which point he will say "Hehe! So you speak a little Skavid, eh? I'll give you a prize for that!" and give the player one of the crystals needed to power the Watchtower and complete the quest.

label: Mage Arena
title: Mage Arena
lead:
The Mage Arena is a members-only combat area located deep in the Wilderness. Inside the arena are battle mages affiliated with the gods, which must be fought to unlock the god spells. 
The arena is involved in the miniquest Mage Arena I.

label: Mage Arena (music track)
title: Mage Arena (music track)
lead:
Mage Arena is a music track that is unlocked at the Mage Arena and its bank.

Prior to an update on 28 April 2021, the track was also unlocked in an area outside the Mage Arena.

label: Mage Arena bank
title: Mage Arena bank
lead:
The Mage Arena bank, also known as the mage bank or wildy bank, is a bank located deep within the Wilderness underneath a crumbling building north of the Mage Arena.

In addition to offering a safe area for banking, the bank room connects to a secondary cave through the sparkling pool, where players can acquire god capes and staves. Players do not need to complete Mage Arena I to access this area.

label: Mage Arena I
title: Mage Arena I
lead: Mage Arena I is a miniquest in which the player tests their mettle with a shapeshifting wizard. Players with level 60 Magic may begin the miniquest by speaking to Kolodion in the Mage Arena.

label: Mage Arena Staffs.
title: Mage Arena Staffs.
lead: Mage Arena Staffs is a store found in the Wilderness Mage Arena, owned by the chamber guardian. It can only be accessed after completion of the Mage Arena I miniquest by entering the Sparkling pool, and sells the three god staves for 80,000 coins.

label: Magenta door
title: Magenta door
lead: The magenta door in the basement of Melzar's Maze is opened with the magenta key dropped by Melzar the Mad during Dragon Slayer I.

label: Magic
title: Magic
lead:
Magic is a skill which allows players to cast different kinds of spells for various purposes, and forms one of the three combat classes in Old School RuneScape. There are broadly three categories of spells: combat spells used in combat, teleportation spells enabling efficient travel across the world of Gielinor, and utility spells which assist the player in non-combat settings. Players gain access to a wider variety of spells as they level up the skill.

As a combat class, Magic behaves slightly differently to Melee and Ranged. While Strength and Ranged levels influence a player's damage output in the respective combat styles, a player's Magic level generally does not affect the damage done by spells. Instead, having a higher Magic level increases both a player's accuracy when casting combat spells as well as a player's defence against magical attacks.

label: Magic axe
title: Magic axe
lead:
Magic axes are monsters that resemble translucent iron battleaxes.

The axes in the magic axe hut can be given as a wilderness Slayer assignment by Krystilia. Players require 23 Thieving for magic axes to be assigned as a task.

label: Magic axe hut
title: Magic axe hut
lead:
The magic axe hut is a small hut located in the north of the Wilderness at level 54 Wilderness. A lockpick and level 23 Thieving are required to unlock either of the doors to the hut. It is infested with aggressive magic axes and also contains three chests which may be searched for traps, then looted.

Looting a chest grants 8 thieving experience and 10 coins.

label: Magic Dance
title: Magic Dance
lead:
Magic Dance is a music track that is unlocked in east Yanille.

It is a slow and peaceful track. This track has a very similar chord progression to Sea Shanty.

label: Magic door
title: Magic door
lead:
The magic door is a special door found within the Entrana Dungeon. It is the only exit from the dungeon aside from teleportation as once the player enters the dungeon from Entrana, they are unable to return as it is one-way.

Opening it transports the player to level 32 Wilderness, between the entrance to Vet'ion's Rest and the south Escape Caves entrance. This entire area is a multicombat area, meaning that players can potentially be attacked by several others if unfortunate. There is no warning prompt upon interacting with the door, and players are recommended to use other forms of teleportation rather than using this door.

label: magic door (Thalzar's room)
title: magic door (Thalzar's room)
lead:
The magic door in the Dwarven mine is used in the Dragon Slayer I quest. Thalzar built the door and made it difficult to open in order to prevent anyone from awakening Elvarg. To open the door, players first have to solve a riddle by the oracle.

After solving the riddle and obtaining the correct items, these items have to be used on the door. When all correct items are placed in the door, players can open it. The door remains unlocked after the items have been used for the first time, allowing players to re-enter without having to get more.

label: Magic gold feather
title: Magic gold feather
lead:
The magic gold feather is a quest item used in the Holy Grail quest given to the player by King Arthur to help find Sir Percival.

Blowing on the feather will cause the feather to point either north, east, south, or west until the player reaches Goblin Village. Once the quest is completed, the feather has no use and can be safely dropped.

label: Magic guild door
title: Magic guild door
lead: The Magic guild doors allow access to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. If the player has less than level 66 Magic, Wizard Distentor will deny them access.

label: Magic Guild Store (Runes and Staves)
title: Magic Guild Store (Runes and Staves)
lead:
The Magic Guild Store is located on the of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. One must have a Magic level of 66 to enter the guild. The store is owned by the Wizard Akutha. The store sells all runes except cosmic, astral, wrath, and combination runes.

Due to the high amount sold by this store, restocking takes a long time.

label: Magic Instructor
title: Magic Instructor
lead:
The Magic instructor, whose real name is Terrova, is the last instructor new players meet on Tutorial Island. He teaches players about Magic and how to cast spells, and provided them with 5 air runes and 5 mind runes.

The Magic instructor is found in the building at the end of the dirt road on Tutorial Island. He has a large cage with chickens in it for players to train with the runes he provides to them (you could only use ranged or magic attacks on the chickens because the cage is only made of walls and a metal fence, which doesn't have a gate).

label: Magic Level Up!
title: Magic Level Up!
lead: Magic Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling Magic.

label: Magic Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Magic Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Magic Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Magic.

label: magic logs
title: magic logs
lead:
Magic logs are logs that can be acquired using the Woodcutting skill from magic trees. Cutting magic trees requires a Woodcutting level of 75 or higher and yields 250 Woodcutting experience per log cut. Due to the slow speed at which magic trees are cut at this level, it is advised that players wait until they have a Woodcutting level of at least 85 before chopping magic trees. Players can expect to gain up to 130 magic logs per hour using a dragon axe.

Magic logs can be fletched into unstrung magic shortbows with a Fletching level of 80, granting 83.3 Fletching experience, or into unstrung magic longbows with a Fletching level of 85, granting 91.5 Fletching experience.

label: Magic longbow
title: Magic longbow
lead:
The magic longbow is a longbow fletched from magic logs. It requires a Ranged level of 50 to wield and can fire arrows up to amethyst.

Players can make a magic longbow with a Fletching level of 85 by cutting an unstrung magic longbow from magic logs, granting 91.5 Fletching experience, and then stringing unstrung magic longbow with a bow string, granting a further 91.5 experience.

label: Magic longbow (u)
title: Magic longbow (u)
lead: A magic longbow (u) is made using a knife with magic logs, requiring 85 Fletching and yielding 91.5 Fletching experience. Stringing a magic longbow (u) with a bowstring makes a magic longbow, also requiring 85 Fletching and yielding an additional 91.5 Fletching experience.

label: Magic ogre potion
title: Magic ogre potion
lead:
The magic ogre potion is a quest item in the Watchtower quest. It is used to kill ogre shamans in the Ogre Enclave below Gu'Tanoth.

It is made by adding to a vial of water a guam leaf, jangerberries, and ground bat bones, in that order, and then bringing the resulting potion to the Watchtower Wizard to enchant. Making the potion requires 14 Herblore. This item will disappear when dropped. Before dropping the item, it will ask for confirmation, stating: "This item will likely break if you put it down here, and you will have to go looking for another."

label: magic potion
title: magic potion
lead:
Magic potions are made by mixing lantadyme and then potato cactus in a vial of water, giving 172.5 Herblore experience. It requires level 76 Herblore to make.

Using a magic potion temporarily raises the player's Magic level by 4.

label: Magic shortbow
title: Magic shortbow
lead:
The Magic shortbow is a bow that requires level 50 Ranged in order to use and can fire arrows up to amethyst. It is one of the few shortbows in the game with a Special attack. The bow has an attack range of 7, with longrange increasing attack range by 2.

To make this bow, players must use a magic shortbow (u) on a bow string. This requires 80 Fletching, and grants 83 experience. They can also be received from hard clue scrolls, or as a rare drop from spiritual rangers.

label: Magic shortbow (u)
title: Magic shortbow (u)
lead: A magic shortbow (u) is made using a knife with magic logs, requiring level 80 Fletching and yielding 83.3 Fletching experience. Stringing a magic shortbow (u) with a bowstring makes a magic shortbow, also requiring 80 Fletching and yielding an additional 83.3 Fletching experience.

label: Magic staff
title: Magic staff
lead:
A magic staff is a magic weapon providing standard magical bonuses and the autocast option when equipped. It is an improvement over the basic staff, with over double the magical bonuses and higher melee bonuses. Due to not possessing any elemental features, it is a very unpopular weapon of choice.

The staff can most easily be purchased from Zaff's Superior Staffs! in Varrock, dropped by various enemies, or obtained as a reward from the Shades of Mort'ton minigame.

label: Magic tree
title: Magic tree
lead: A magic tree is a rare type of tree that requires 75 Woodcutting to chop down, granting 250 Woodcutting experience per set of magic logs received. The chop rate of magic logs is noticeably slower than that of yew trees. Thus, there is a low supply for the logs due to how long it takes to chop them. They are mainly cut by players looking to gain an income through a very low intensity method, rather than gaining experience due to their slow experience rate. Magic trees are unique among trees as the only tree with an area sound.

label: Magic whistle
title: Magic whistle
lead:
The magic whistle is a quest item in the Holy Grail quest which is originally obtained in the southern room on the top floor of Draynor Manor. This spawn can only be seen and picked up while the player has a holy table napkin in their inventory. In this spawn location, there are two whistles, one for the player and one which must be given to Sir Percival.

Blowing the magic whistle while standing in the location where all of the mysterious statues point, under the tower north-west of Brimhaven, allows players to access the Fisher Realm. Blowing the magic whistle in the Fisher Realm returns the player to Karamja. Attempting to blow the whistle anywhere else will display the following message: The whistle makes no noise. It will not work in this location.

label: Magical Journey
title: Magical Journey
lead: Magical Journey is a music track that is unlocked at the Sorcerer's Tower.

label: Magical shield
title: Magical shield
lead: The magical shield is a barrier found on the of the Watchtower in northern Yanille. It surrounds the machine that is fixed during the Watchtower quest.

label: Magnet (Witch's House)
title: Magnet (Witch's House)
lead:
The magnet is a quest item used only in Witch's House. It is found in a cupboard in the basement of the witch's house behind an electrified gate.

It is used on the back of a mouse to unlock the elaborate locking mechanism on the door into her garden.

label: Makeover Mage
title: Makeover Mage
lead:
The Makeover Mage, also known as Pete or Peta depending on whether they are currently male or female, is a wizard who possesses the magical knowledge to change the player's body type, skin colour or pronouns, completely free of charge. Approximately every 10 seconds, they will switch genders.

They obtained their powers from an amulet they obtained after killing a nest of gazulibirds.

label: Male slave
title: Male slave
lead:
Male slaves can be found working the mines at the Desert Mining Camp. One particular slave, the one who isn't mining, is involved in The Tourist Trap quest and provides information on the deeper parts of the camp. The player initially helps him by breaking his chains, then he trades them his robes for desert robes and becomes an escaping slave.

The generic male slaves (along with female slaves) complain a lot about being there and about their work. They can be spoken to, but no dialogue pops up, they will exclaim and the player will get thrown in jail if done enough times. After completion of The Tourist Trap, it's no longer possible to get thrown in the jail and the slaves can be talked to freely.

label: Mammoth (unused NPC)
title: Mammoth (unused NPC)
lead:
Mammoths were an unused monster first added to the RuneScape 2 beta. A Behind the Scenes article from March 2004 promised that one of the upcoming updates would be "A large 'frozen lands' area including penguins, mammoths, polar bears and more." Presumably, they would have been found alongside penguins and the Yeti. For unknown reasons, the mammoths were ultimately never added.

They later appeared at an exhibit in Prifddinas during Old School RuneScape's first anniversary, and updated mammoths were added to the Wilderness with the Wilderness Rejuvenation update of 13 March 2014. Eventually, the original mammoths were deleted from the game cache in 2017.

label: Man
title: Man
lead:
Men are generic NPC civilians of Gielinor. They can be found in most large cities and towns, especially those in Misthalin, such as Lumbridge, Falador, and Varrock. While less common, they can also be found in remote areas such as the Wilderness.

Men can be pickpocketed by members at level 1 Thieving, yielding 8 experience points and 3 coins. They often drop low-level herbs when killed on members-only servers.

label: Man (Canifis bridge)
title: Man (Canifis bridge)
lead:
A man could be found at the flooded bridge to the north-east of Canifis when the area was first released in June 2004. When spoken to, he told players that the bridge and the swamps to the east were flooded, preventing access to eastern Morytania. When the Haunted Woods were released in October, the swamp water receded, and the man was removed. Mazchna took his spot on the bridge when Slayer was released in January 2005.

He was deleted from the game cache and overwritten by Prissy Scilla with the release of the Tree Gnome Stronghold tree patch on 6 November 2006. As such he has never existed in any form in Old School RuneScape.

label: Man (Canifis)
title: Man (Canifis)
lead:
Men were formerly the citizens of Canifis. If players were not wielding a wolfbane dagger when attacking them, they would turn into wolfmen.

In 2007, werewolves were graphically updated. The men were replaced by new named citizens, while the Wolfmen were replaced by werewolves. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Man (East Ardougne)
title: Man (East Ardougne)
lead: A unique man wearing a tan cavalier can be found upstairs with Jess in a house in East Ardougne. He can be pickpocketed and fought like normal, but unlike regular men, he only drops bones.

label: Man (level 4)
title: Man (level 4)
lead:
Men are citizens of West Ardougne. They are similar to men found throughout Gielinor, but can only be attacked and talked to, and not pickpocketed. Their appearance is slightly different, in keeping with the theme of West Ardougne supposedly being afflicted with a plague, and their dialogue is slightly different, reflecting their plight under Mourner rule.

They are found near the civilians, children, and women, as well as other non-attackable men.

label: Man (West Ardougne)
title: Man (West Ardougne)
lead: Men of West Ardougne are citizens who can be found among other civilians and women who live West Ardougne. Their appearance and dialogue reflect the poor living conditions in the city. These men in particular only have a Talk-to option, compared to attackable men also found in West Ardougne.

label: Manhole
title: Manhole
lead: Manholes can be found just south of Varrock Palace's eastern outer exit, and south of Handelmort Mansion in Ardougne. The manholes provide access to Varrock Sewers and Ardougne Sewers, respectively.

label: manhole (West Ardougne)
title: manhole (West Ardougne)
lead: A manhole can be found in West Ardougne. Is it primarily used in the Plague City quest to traverse between Alrena and Edmond's house, and West Ardougne via the sewer below, in order to rescue Elena.

label: Manhole cover
title: Manhole cover
lead: The manhole cover is a scenery object that can be found in West Ardougne. The manhole cover appears when opening the manhole.

label: manta ray
title: manta ray
lead:
The manta ray is a type of food that restores 22 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw manta ray on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 91 Cooking and granting 216.3 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt manta ray. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. It will only stop burning entirely when the Cooking cape is worn.

The manta ray is the second highest instant-health single consumption food, behind the marlin, alongside the dark crab, bluefin, anglerfish, and tuna potato. It is recommended to check the prices before using manta rays as a primary source of healing, as they are often more expensive than the other fish that heal the same amount.

label: Map part (Lozar)
title: Map part (Lozar)
lead:
Lozar's Crandor Map part is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. This map part is either dropped by Wormbrain, arrested in the Port Sarim jail, after killing him and obtaining the part with telekinetic grab or paying him 10,000 coins.

When all three map parts are in the inventory, using any two pieces on each other will combine all three into the Crandor map, which is given to Ned.

label: Map part (Melzar)
title: Map part (Melzar)
lead:
Melzar's Crandor Map part is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. This map part is found in a chest in Melzar's Maze south of the Crafting Guild. The maze key is required to enter the building, while coloured keys dropped by monsters allow passage through the maze.

When all three map parts are in the inventory, using any two pieces on each other will combine all three into the Crandor map, which is given to Ned.

label: Map part (Thalzar)
title: Map part (Thalzar)
lead:
Thalzar's Crandor Map part is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. This map part is found in a chest sealed behind a magic door in the Dwarven Mines under the foothills of Ice Mountain. This door and room is located east of Drogo's Mining Emporium. To open the door to this room, a lobster pot, silk, an unfired bowl, and a wizard's mind bomb must be used on the door to open it.

When all three map parts are in the inventory, using any two pieces on each other will combine all three into the Crandor map, which is given to Ned.

label: Maple logs
title: Maple logs
lead:
Maple logs are received from cutting maple trees requiring a Woodcutting level of 45 and yield 100 Woodcutting experience (110 with Kandarin Medium Diary) per log. Maple logs can be burned with a Firemaking level of 45, giving 135 experience per log. Maple logs can also be fletched into different items: arrow shafts, maple shortbow (u), maple longbow (u), maple stock and maple shield.

Because of their low price and the moderate experience they provide, maple logs are commonly used for training Firemaking.

label: Maple longbow
title: Maple longbow
lead:
A maple longbow is created by attaching a bow string to a maple longbow (u) with at least level 55 Fletching. Fletching from a maple log yields a total of 116.5 experience (58.3 for fletching and 58.2 for stringing). The bow can use arrows up to adamant.

The maple longbow differs from the shortbow only in terms of speed and range, they share the same Ranged bonus. However, the shortbow is usually preferred over the longbow due to its faster attack speed. It can also be a reward for the Observatory Quest.

label: Maple longbow (u)
title: Maple longbow (u)
lead: A maple longbow (u) is made using a knife with maple logs, requiring 55 Fletching and yielding 58.3 Fletching experience. Stringing a maple longbow (u) with a bowstring makes a maple longbow, also requiring 55 Fletching and yielding an additional 58.2 Fletching experience.

label: Maple shortbow
title: Maple shortbow
lead:
A maple shortbow is a two-handed Ranged weapon that can be created with the Fletching skill at level 50 by using a bow string on a maple shortbow (u), granting 50 experience. A Ranged level of 30 is required to wield it. The bow can use arrows up to adamant. However, this bow isn't powerful enough for the use of broad arrows.

It is notable for being the best bow that free-to-play players can use.

label: Maple shortbow (u)
title: Maple shortbow (u)
lead: A maple shortbow (u) is made using a knife with maple logs, requiring 50 Fletching and yielding 50 Fletching experience. Stringing a maple shortbow (u) with a bowstring makes a maple shortbow, also requiring 50 Fletching and yielding an additional 50 Fletching experience.

label: maple tree
title: maple tree
lead: A maple tree is an amber-coloured tree that requires level 45 Woodcutting to cut, granting 100 Woodcutting experience for each set of maple logs received. Maple trees have moderately high cut difficulty and maple logs only have moderate value, making cutting maple trees unfavourable for money making. Maple trees can be cut as an AFK Woodcutting training method for F2P players. Completion of the Medium Kandarin Diary give players 10% additional experience when cutting Maple trees in Seers' Village, granting 110 Woodcutting experience per log received.

label: March
title: March
lead: March is a music track unlocked in and around King Lathas's Combat Training Camp.

label: Marked wall
title: Marked wall
lead:
The marked wall can be found in the Shaman Caves during the Legends' Quest. Interacting with it will give the riddle

:"Place five stones of magical power - but place them wrong, and your fate will sour. First is the spirit of man or beast (Soul rune), second the place where fools tread least (Mind rune). Third is the soil where plants do grow (Earth rune) - and four and five are the rules you must know (two Law runes). Solve this riddle, and overcome your ignorance; arranged correct, it should make sense."

label: Marrentill
title: Marrentill
lead:
Marrentill is the second lowest level herb. It can be cleaned at level 5 Herblore, giving 3.8 experience. It is used for making antipoison, marrentill tar and Guthix rest potions. Marrentill is also used to light incense burners, in player-owned houses, to boost Prayer experience when sacrificing bones (usually dragon bones).

Marrentill is rarely used for Herblore purposes. Guthix rests and marrentill tar have limited uses and demand among players, and antipoison requires unicorn horn dust as a secondary ingredient, which is costly, due to its use in superantipoison potions. As well as this, antipoison potions can be easily obtained from Jiminua's Jungle Store, further decreasing the demand. If you want to create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a marrentill potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

label: Marrentill potion (unf)
title: Marrentill potion (unf)
lead: A marrentill potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a marrentill on a vial of water, requiring 5 Herblore. Using a unicorn horn dust on a marrentill potion (unf) with 5 Herblore yields an antipoison(3) and 37.5 Herblore experience. In the Bone Voyage quest, a marrentill potion (unf) and 2 vodka are given to the Apothecary for a potion of sealegs.

label: marshy jungle vine
title: marshy jungle vine
lead:
Marshy jungle vine is a plant found in Karamja. Searching ripe vines is the only way players can obtain grimy snake weed (and subsequently its clean version), which is needed for some quests like Jungle Potion and Legends' Quest. Snake weed is also an ingredient in making Sanfew serum. The vines can only be searched after regrowing every 60 seconds.

The fastest way to access the vines is by running west from fairy ring . Twenty vines can be found growing near the coast, just north of the Horned graahk hunter area.

label: Martha Rehnison
title: Martha Rehnison
lead: Martha Rehnison lives in the Rehnison household in north-eastern West Ardougne. She is the wife of Ted Rehnison. She has two children, Billy and Milli. Her family sells cooking apples and are known friends of Elena.

label: Mary (Murder Mystery)
title: Mary (Murder Mystery)
lead: Mary is the maid to the Sinclair family. She is a witness during King's Ransom.

label: Marzipan
title: Marzipan
lead: Marzipan is a music track unlocked in the tunnel to Keldagrim, the Troll Stronghold, or more rarely in the ice cave that leads to Trollweiss Mountain.

label: Master Chef
title: Master Chef
lead:
Lev the Master Chef is the third non-player character players meet in Old School RuneScape. He lives on Tutorial Island. He teaches new players how to cook more sophisticated food and how the Music Player works.

Until the point in the tutorial when new players meet the master chef, the only thing they would have cooked are shrimps on a log fire. He teaches new players how to bake bread by combining a flour with water to make bread dough, and then baking it on a range.

label: Master Crafter
title: Master Crafter
lead:
The Master Crafter is one of the non-player characters who can be found south-west of Falador inside the Crafting Guild. He teaches many advanced crafters how to use the facilities within the guild, such as the mines, the potter's wheels, and the pottery ovens.

The eldest Master Crafter is the master of Crafting, and wears the Crafting cape. This crafter sells the Crafting cape to members with level 99 in Crafting for 99,000 coins.

label: Master fisher
title: Master fisher
lead:
The Master fisher is the head of the Fishing Guild and can be found by the guild's entrance building.

As the head of the guild, the master fisher watches the entrance to the guild to make sure that only players with at least level 68 in Fishing are allowed to enter. If a player with less than level 68 talks to him, he says: Hello, I'm afraid only the top fishers are allowed to use our premier fishing facilities.

label: Mausoleum (music track)
title: Mausoleum (music track)
lead: Mausoleum is a music track unlocked underneath Paterdomus.

label: Maze
title: Maze
lead:
The maze is a random event initiated randomly by the appearance of the Mysterious Old Man, who offers the player a chance to complete a maze. It is favourable to complete over most other random events because the rewards it gives tend to be much more valuable than those given by other events despite taking longer to complete.

The maze itself is a large square area full of "walls" made of floating cubes. The goal is to navigate through the maze to the centre and touch the rotating shrine found there; once the player does so, they will be teleported back to where they spoke to the Mysterious Old Man and will receive a reward. Run energy doesn't deplete at all in the maze.

label: Maze Centre
title: Maze Centre
lead: Maze Centre is a Jingle that plays when completing the Maze random event. It is based upon Time Out.

label: Maze key
title: Maze key
lead:
The Maze key is a quest item used only in Dragon Slayer I. It is obtained from the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild when the player has returned to him after speaking to Oziach.

It is used to open the front door of Melzar's Maze.

label: McGrubor's Wood
title: McGrubor's Wood
lead:
McGrubor's Wood is a wooded, fenced-in area north of Hemenster and west of Seers' Village, used primarily for quests. There are two ways in and out: a loose section of the northern railing, and a fairy ring with code .

The loose section of the railing is immediately to the north-east of the small building that borders the fence, and is shown on the map in red, similarly to how a door is portrayed.

label: Meat pie
title: Meat pie
lead:
Meat pie is a type of pie that restores 12 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 6. A pie dish will remain after both bites are consumed. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked meat pie on a cooking range, requiring level 20 Cooking and granting 110 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt pie. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Meat pie is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 54, or 49 when using the Lumbridge range. Alternatively, casting the Bake Pie spell from the lunar spellbook will always create a pie without burning it.

Meat pie is a possible task from Romily Weaklax in the Cooks' Guild. Three meat pies are given to the player when starting Nature Spirit.

label: Meat pizza
title: Meat pizza
lead:
Meat pizza is a type of pizza that restores 16 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 8. It can be obtained by using cooked meat or cooked chicken on a plain pizza, requiring 45 Cooking and granting 26 experience.

When the first bite is eaten, the message You eat half of the meat pizza.is displayed. The second bite gives the message You eat the remaining meat pizza..

label: Medical gown
title: Medical gown
lead:
The medical gown is a quest item used in Biohazard and A Tail of Two Cats. It is found in the cupboard of Nurse Sarah's house, south-west of the west Ardougne church.

While it is equipped, the player is allowed to enter the Mourners' Headquarters in the north-east corner of West Ardougne after poisoning the stew in the back yard with a rotten apple. This item may also be used as part of a medical disguise in A Tail of Two Cats.

label: Medieval
title: Medieval
lead:
Medieval is a music track that can be unlocked inside Varrock city walls, excluding the Grand Exchange. It also plays in the Phoenix Gang Hideout and in the basement of the Blue Moon Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Adventure, Garden, and Spirit.

In Classic mode, this track plays east of Varrock and the hint referred to "near the Varrock East guarded area".

label: Megan
title: Megan
lead: Megan is an employee of the Falador Party Room and can be found on the . She will dance with the player upon request or serve beer. Like Party Pete and the other barmaids in the Party Room, she wears a red partyhat.

label: Mellow
title: Mellow
lead: Mellow is a music track that is unlocked at the Fishing Guild.

label: Melzar the Mad
title: Melzar the Mad
lead:
Melzar the Mad is one of the three wizards, along with Thalzar and Lozar, who escaped from Crandor when the dragon Elvarg destroyed it, and is the only one of them that is still alive. He has since lost his sanity, leading to his nickname, and has secluded himself and his piece of the map to Crandor in his maze north-west of Rimmington. He is fought during the Dragon Slayer I quest.

In combat, Melzar can kick, punch, cast Fire Strike or a Curse spell, or cast a spell that produces a cabbage in a random spot in the room. (Note that the cabbages CAN be used for food.)

label: Melzar's Maze
title: Melzar's Maze
lead:
Melzar's Maze is a large, three-story building with a basement located north-west of Rimmington. It is the home of Melzar the Mad and contains Melzar's map part required for the Dragon Slayer I quest. To enter the building, players must obtain the Maze key from the Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild during the quest. The building was built by Melzar atop the remains of the Crandorian refugee camp that was destroyed by Elvarg.

Once inside the building, players must go through mazes on each floor and in the basement. However, to proceed to the next floor, players must kill the creature that is holding the key to one of the many doors on the floor. Only one door leads players to the next floor; the rest will send them back to the previous floor.

label: Mercenary
title: Mercenary
lead: Mercenaries are guards hired by Captain Siad, the head of the Desert Mining Camp, to guard it. The four of them are led by a Mercenary Captain and their duty is to protect said captain and the entrance to the camp. They will attack the player if they are wielding a weapon or wearing armour outside the Desert Mining Camp. After completion of The Tourist Trap, they are no longer aggressive outside the camp regardless if the player wears any armour or weapons. However, if the player stands inside the camp right next to the gate, they can call out the player and attempt to attack them, but will fail due to the gate being in the way,

label: Mercenary Captain
title: Mercenary Captain
lead:
The Mercenary Captain is the captain of the mercenaries outside the Desert Mining Camp, and was hired to guard the entrance of it to prevent unauthorised people from going in. The Mercenary Captain plays a role in the quest The Tourist Trap, in which he is portrayed as a hot-headed and angry individual, and must be provoked to the point of outrage so that he initiates combat with the player himself, rather than having his mercenaries do his dirty work for him.

Once killed, the captain 'drops' the Metal key, which is automatically added to the player's inventory with the message "The mercenary captain drops a metal key on the floor. You quickly grab the key and add it to your inventory." appearing in the chatbox.

label: Merlin
title: Merlin
lead:
Merlin can be found on the of Camelot castle in his workshop, accessed via stairs in the entry room. Note that his (yellow) minimap icon does not show up until you are in his workshop. If the player has not completed the Merlin's Crystal quest, he will be imprisoned within a block-shaped crystal on the top floor of the south-east tower.

After successful completion of the Camelot training room, a player can speak to Merlin in order to change spawning point to Camelot instead of Falador or Lumbridge.

label: Merlin's Crystal
title: Merlin's Crystal
lead: Merlin's Crystal is the first quest in the Camelot quest series, and involves the player rescuing the wizard Merlin from a crystal.

label: Message (Romeo & Juliet)
title: Message (Romeo & Juliet)
lead:
The Message is a quest item used only in Romeo & Juliet. It is obtained from Juliet after talking to her for the first time.

The player must deliver the letter to Romeo to progress the quest. It is possible to get another message and complete the quest by drop tricking. Only one copy of the message is taken when the player gives it to Romeo.

label: Metal key
title: Metal key
lead:
The metal key is gained during and after the Tourist Trap quest. During the quest, it is first obtained by killing the Mercenary Captain in order to gain access to the main gate of the Desert Mining Camp.

This key can be placed on the steel key ring.

label: Miles
title: Miles
lead: Miles is the brother of Giles and Niles. Like his brothers, he may appear to initiate the Certer random event, in which he will ask players to identify an item, such as a fish, with three possible choices of what the object is. If the player correctly identifies the item, Miles will give the player a reward of either coins, a gem (uncut, up to diamond), a cosmic talisman, a half key, a spinach roll, or a kebab.

label: Miles Away
title: Miles Away
lead:
Miles Away is a music track that can be unlocked outside Falador city walls, at the Falador Farm, Crafting Guild, and the Dark Wizards' Tower. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Long Way Home and Nightfall. It can also be unlocked in the Fisher Realm after partial completion of Holy Grail quest.

In Classic mode outside the Fisher Realm, the track plays at the Crafting Guild.

label: Mill (scenery)
title: Mill (scenery)
lead: Mills are animated scenery found on the middle floor of some windmills. Mills grind wheat into flour when the player interacts with the hopper controls.

label: Mill Lane Mill
title: Mill Lane Mill
lead:
Mill Lane Mill is a windmill on the road from Lumbridge to Draynor Village, just south of the Champions' Guild across the River Lum. Inside is Millie Miller who teaches the player how to make flour, for help during the Cook's Assistant quest.

On the of the mill is a flour bin where up to 30 pots worth of flour is collected after being milled, ready to be put in an empty pot. On the are millstones, which automatically grind grain into flour before sending it to the flour bin below. The has a hopper which is where grain is added. Hopper controls nearby must be operated to start the process for each grain in the hopper, sending it down to the millstones, then to the collection flour bin.

label: Milli Rehnison
title: Milli Rehnison
lead:
Milli Rehnison is a girl found upstairs of the Rehnison house in north-eastern West Ardougne. She is the daughter of Ted Rehnison and Martha Rehnison. She has a brother named Billy.

Players must speak to her for information on Elena during the Plague City quest.

label: millstones
title: millstones
lead: Millstones are animated scenery found on the middle floor of most windmills. Canonically, the millstones are there in order to grind wheat into flour. However, the player is not required to directly interact with millstones, other than noticing they exist on their way to the top floor, where there is a hopper.

label: mime
title: mime
lead: The Mime is an NPC that plays a role in the Mime random event. The player has to copy his movements to complete the event. He appears to be wearing the mime clothing with a beret mask.

label: Mime (Random Event)
title: Mime (Random Event)
lead:
The Mime is a random event in which the Mysterious Old Man appears and offers to teleport players to the mime artist's stage. The player must copy the mime's actions to complete the event. The mime will perform one of 8 emotes (Think, Laugh, Cry, Dance, Climb Rope, Lean, Glass Box, and Glass Wall) that the player will need to copy. If the player gets it right, they will Cheer, and if wrong, they will Cry. If the player takes too long to make a decision, then the mime will perform another emote for the player to guess.

Once the player has completed the event, they will be returned to the place they were before and will be rewarded with either one or two pieces of the mime outfit or one of the four mime emotes. If the player already has all of these, they will be rewarded with an experience lamp instead.

label: Mime boots
title: Mime boots
lead: Mime boots are an item gained from the Mime random event and are part of the mime outfit. They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

label: Mime gloves
title: Mime gloves
lead: Mime gloves are an item gained from the Mime random event and are part of the mime outfit. They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

label: Mime legs
title: Mime legs
lead: Mime legs is an item gained from the Mime random event and is part of the mime outfit. It gives no bonuses apart from its cosmetic appeal.

label: Mime mask
title: Mime mask
lead:
Mime mask is a head item gained from the Mime random event and is part of the mime outfit. It gives no bonuses apart from its cosmetic appeal.

It can be sewn with a black beret to make a beret mask by talking to Patchy, along with 500 coins. Doing so requires the completion of Cabin Fever and a book o' piracy. Once the mask has been sewn to a beret, completion of the Mime random event will once again reward players with a mime mask.

label: Mime top
title: Mime top
lead: Mime top is a reward from the Mime random event and is part of the mime outfit. It gives no bonuses apart from its cosmetic appeal.

label: Mind Altar
title: Mind Altar
lead:
The Mind Altar is a runic altar upon which mind runes are crafted from rune essence or pure essence, providing 5.5 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 2 Runecraft is required to craft mind runes.

Players may create a mind tiara here by using either a mind talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 27.5 Runecraft experience. A catalytic tiara can also be created here by using a catalytic talisman and gold tiara, granting 60 Runecraft experience.

label: Mind rune
title: Mind rune
lead:
The mind rune is used for the strike spells including Wind Strike, Water Strike, Earth Strike, and Fire Strike, as well as the Magic Dart spell.

Mind runes are craftable at level 2 Runecraft. Crafting mind runes provides 5.5 Runecraft experience per rune or pure essence used. Using mind cores in place of essences will yield an increased amount of mind runes.
