Members can also use Warped extracts to increase the quantity of crafted mind runes by 250 per pure essence, requiring partial completion of Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire and access to the Scar essence mine.

label: Mind talisman
title: Mind talisman
lead:
The mind talisman is a talisman used to access the Mind Altar located between Ice Mountain and Goblin Village. It can be combined with a tiara to make a mind tiara for 27.5 Runecraft experience at the Mind Altar by using the tiara on the altar. This makes the talisman disappear, but the tiara can be used in just the same way and can be worn.

One is required to create a mind tiara for the Easy Falador Diary.

label: Mine Cart (Desert Mining Camp)
title: Mine Cart (Desert Mining Camp)
lead:
The Mine Cart is a scenery object found at the Desert Mining Camp Underground during and after the Tourist Trap quest, used to rescue Ana. Players can use it as a means of transportation by clicking the Search option.

When riding the cart, it temporarily occupies the feet slot, seemingly making your boots disappear. They will reappear at the end of the ride.

label: mine cart driver
title: mine cart driver
lead: The Mine cart driver is in the Desert Mining Camp, near the camel cart. He plays a role in The Tourist Trap quest. The player will ride his mine cart with Ana in a barrel in order to save her from the mines. The player will have to compliment him in order to not get caught with Ana.

label: Mining
title: Mining
lead: Mining is a skill that allows players to obtain ores and gems from rocks. The higher a player's Mining level is the more likely they are to successfully extract ore. With ores, a player can then either smelt bars and make equipment using the Smithing skill or sell them for profit. Mining areas are identified with a regular pickaxe icon, and mining shops are identified with a gold pickaxe icon on the minimap and world map.

label: Mining Guild
title: Mining Guild
lead:
The Mining Guild, located in and beneath Falador, is a guild for expert miners available to players with at least 60 Mining (can be boosted). The mine is accessible from either the Mining Guild's above-ground complex in the south-east of the city, or through the gate at the southern end of the Dwarven Mine. Both of these entrances are guarded by dwarves who will answer questions about the guild and stop players without the requirements from entering the guild. The guildmaster, Gadrin, also sells the Mining cape to those who have achieved level 99 Mining.

This mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining.

label: Mining Instructor
title: Mining Instructor
lead: The Mining instructor on Tutorial Island (named Dezzick) is the fifth NPC that a beginning player meets in Old School RuneScape. He informs players about Mining and Smithing skills by teaching them how to make bronze items.

label: Mining Level Up!
title: Mining Level Up!
lead: Mining Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Mining.

label: Mining Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Mining Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Mining Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Mining.

label: Miracle Dance
title: Miracle Dance
lead: Miracle Dance is a music track unlocked at the Mind Altar.

label: mirror
title: mirror
lead: A mirror is used in the Nature Spirit quest to prove to Filliman Tarlock that he is dead. It can be found under the washing bowl on a bench near the entrance to the Nature Grotto south of the Mort Myre Swamp. It is also obtainable after the quest, but it serves no purpose.

label: Miscellaneous key
title: Miscellaneous key
lead: Miscellaneous key is a quest item obtained during the Heroes' Quest from Grip. It is used to access the windowed room in Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven. From here a second player can kill Grip using a Ranged attack, and the first player, the one doing the quest, is then able to retrieve Grips' key from the body. This is one of the keys that cannot be held on a steel key ring.

label: Misthalin
title: Misthalin
lead: Misthalin ( ) is a major kingdom within Gielinor and is currently ruled by King Roald III and Queen Ellamaria. Misthalin is the most powerful human nation and by far the oldest, having existed prominently since the late Fourth Age, and its capital, Varrock, having existed in some form since soon after the end of the God Wars. It is divided in half by the River Lum, and its eastern border with Morytania is the River Salve.

label: Mithril 2h sword
title: Mithril 2h sword
lead:
The mithril 2h sword is a two-handed sword made of mithril. As with all mithril weaponry, it requires 20 Attack to wield.

At level 64 Smithing, players can make one from three mithril bars, granting 150 Smithing experience. Players can also purchase one from a few shops, including Gaius' Two Handed Shop in Taverley and Gulluck and Sons in the Grand Tree.

label: Mithril arrow
title: Mithril arrow
lead:
Mithril arrows are arrows made of mithril, are stackable, and can be used with any standard bow of willow or stronger. Stronger than steel arrows, mithril arrows can be made at level 45 Fletching by using mithril arrowtips on headless arrows. Doing so grants 112.5 experience for every batch of 15 arrows made. As with most arrows, they can be poisoned.

Mithril arrows can be purchased from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock, or Brian's Archery Supplies in Rimmington.

label: Mithril arrowtips
title: Mithril arrowtips
lead:
Mithril arrowtips are made with a mithril bar requiring 55 Smithing, yielding 50 Smithing experience and 15 mithril arrowtips. They are made into mithril arrows when used with headless arrows, requiring 45 Fletching, yielding 112.5 experience per 15 arrows.

They are purchased for coins at the ranging shops: Hickton's Archery Emporium in Catherby, Dargaud's Bow and Arrows in the Ranging Guild, Gulluck and Sons on the of the Grand Tree, and Void Knight Archery Store at the Void Knights' Outpost. They are purchased for coins at the Armoury in the Combat Training Camp.

label: Mithril axe
title: Mithril axe
lead:
A mithril axe is an axe stronger than the black axe, and weaker than the adamant axe. Like all mithril weapons, it requires level 20 Attack to wield. It can be used in combat or in Woodcutting to cut trees. To cut a tree with this axe, a player must have 21 Woodcutting.

The success rate for chopping a log is approximately 250% that of the Bronze axe, or 11% better than a Black axe.

label: Mithril axe head
title: Mithril axe head
lead:
The mithril axe head is an unobtainable item that was originally used in the axe handle random event. The axe head would become detached from the player's mithril axe while Woodcutting. To fix their axe, players had to collect the axe head off the ground and reattach it to the axe handle.

A similar event used to happen to players while Mining, but with a pickaxe head and pickaxe handle.

label: Mithril bar
title: Mithril bar
lead:
A Mithril bar is a bar of refined mithril ore. It can be created through the Smithing skill by using a mithril ore and 4 pieces of coal on a furnace, granting 30 experience. The Superheat Item spell can also be used to make mithril bars. Both ways of creating mithril bars require level 50 Smithing. It can also be created in the Blast Furnace, which can be considerably cheaper as it halves the amount of coal needed.

A mithril bar can be smithed on an anvil by using the Smithing skill to create mithril weapons and armour, granting 50 Smithing experience per bar used. A list of mithril items that can be smithed from mithril bars and the Smithing levels required can be found at Smithing tables.

label: Mithril battleaxe
title: Mithril battleaxe
lead:
A mithril battleaxe is a battleaxe made from 3 mithril bars, requiring 60 Smithing, yielding 150 Smithing experience. 20 Attack is required to wield it. It is stronger than the black battleaxe, but weaker than the adamant battleaxe.

Players can purchase it from Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar in Port Sarim, Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge, or Gulluck and Sons in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

label: Mithril chainbody
title: Mithril chainbody
lead:
The Mithril chainbody is a chainbody made out of mithril. As with all mithril armour, it requires 20 Defence to wear.

Like all chainbodies, it provides better Crush defence than a platebody made of the same material, at the cost of lower Stab and Slash defence.

label: Mithril claws
title: Mithril claws
lead:
Mithril claws are a two-handed melee weapon that are member's only. To wield them the player must have at least level 20 Attack.

Mithril claws can be created by using 2 mithril bars on an anvil with a hammer in the inventory after completing the Death Plateau quest. This requires level 63 in Smithing, and grants the player 100 Smithing experience.

label: mithril dagger
title: mithril dagger
lead: The mithril dagger is a dagger made out of mithril. Mithril daggers can be smithed from a single mithril bar at level 50 Smithing. Each mithril dagger created grants 50 experience. Mithril daggers are the fifth strongest daggers, the next strongest being the adamant dagger. Like all mithril weapons, mithril daggers require 20 Attack to wield. As with most daggers, this weapon can be poisoned. Players can purchase this dagger from the Varrock Swordshop.

label: mithril dart
title: mithril dart
lead:
Mithril darts are Ranged throwing weapons made from mithril that are only available to members. Mithril darts require level 20 Ranged to wield. They can be obtained by either using the Smithing and Fletching skills or trading with another player. Mithril darts can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Mithril darts are one of the most cost effective Ranged training weapons for lower level players, as they have an extremely quick rate of fire and cost very little compared to similar training methods like throwing knives or arrows. They can be bought in large numbers from the Grand Exchange, costing less than half of what similar tier ranged ammunition costs.

label: Mithril dart tip
title: Mithril dart tip
lead:
A mithril dart tip is a dart tip made with the Smithing skill. Players can smith this item when using a mithril bar on an anvil with a hammer in the inventory and 54 Smithing. Each bar makes 10 mithril dart tips and yields 50 experience. They can be fletched into mithril darts at level 52 Fletching when used with feathers, granting 112 Fletching experience per 10 darts made.

To smith darts, the Tourist Trap must be started and progressed to the point where the player returns to the Bedabin Camp with the weapon plans.

label: Mithril fire arrow
title: Mithril fire arrow
lead:
Mithril fire arrows are mithril arrows wrapped in an oily cloth, which are then lit by using them on a tinderbox. They, along with any other fire arrow, are primarily used to pierce the rope in the Underground Pass to lower the bridge so that a player may walk across.

They have the same Ranged Strength as regular mithril arrows.

label: Mithril full helm
title: Mithril full helm
lead: The mithril full helm is the fourth best full helmet. It requires 20 Defence to equip. It offers better defensive stats than its med helm counterpart, at the cost of having lower magic and ranged attack, and greater weight. One can be made by a player with level 57 Smithing at any anvil with a hammer and 2 mithril bars.

label: Mithril javelin
title: Mithril javelin
lead:
The mithril javelin is a type of member's only Ranged ammunition used by the light and heavy ballistas. As with most javelins, they can be poisoned.

They can be fletched by attaching mithril javelin tips to javelin shafts at level 47 Fletching, granting 120 experience per 15 javelins made. They can also be obtained by buying them from the Ranging Guild, the Void Knight Archery Store or from Oobapohk's Javelin Store after Monkey Madness II.

label: Mithril kiteshield
title: Mithril kiteshield
lead: The mithril kiteshield is the third best smithable kiteshield, requiring 20 Defence to wield. A player with 62 Smithing can make the shield by using three mithril bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 150 Smithing experience.

label: Mithril knife
title: Mithril knife
lead:
The mithril knife is a throwing knife that requires a Ranged level of 20 to wield. It is stronger than a black knife but weaker than an adamant knife. To create mithril knives, the player must have at least 57 Smithing. Each mithril bar will create 5 mithril knives and give the player 50 Smithing experience. They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Throwing knives are among the fastest weapons in the game (along with darts), and are commonly used for PKing or training Ranged.

label: Mithril longsword
title: Mithril longsword
lead: The mithril longsword is a longsword that is stronger than the black longsword/White longsword, but weaker than the adamant longsword. Like all other mithril weapons, it requires an Attack level of 20 to wield. Players can make a mithril longsword with a Smithing level of 56 using two mithril bars, granting 100 experience. Players can purchase this longsword from the Varrock Swordshop.

label: Mithril mace
title: Mithril mace
lead:
The mithril mace is a mace made of mithril. Like all mithril weapons, it requires 20 Attack to wield, and is exclusively used in melee combat.

Players can make a mithril mace with the Smithing skill at level 52 by using a mithril bar on an anvil with a hammer in their inventory, giving the player 50 Smithing experience.

label: Mithril med helm
title: Mithril med helm
lead: The mithril med helm is a medium helmet made of mithril. This helm requires 20 Defence to wear. It provides more protection than its bronze, iron and steel counterparts. It can be made at level 53 Smithing using a mithril bar.

label: mithril ore
title: mithril ore
lead:
Mithril ore can be mined at level 55 Mining providing 80 Mining experience. After mithril rocks are mined, it will take two minutes until it reappears. Mithril ore is used with four coal to smelt mithril bars. Smelting a mithril bar gives 30 Smithing experience.

Wearing either superior mining gloves or expert mining gloves while mining a mithril rock makes the rock not deplete upon mining mithril, allowing you to mine one or two additional ore, respectively, before depleting.

label: Mithril pick head
title: Mithril pick head
lead:
A mithril pick head was obtained as part of a discontinued random event, in which the mithril pickaxe head flew off the handle while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle.

If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another.

label: Mithril pickaxe
title: Mithril pickaxe
lead:
The mithril pickaxe is a pickaxe that is weaker than the adamant pickaxe. It requires an Attack level of 20 to wield, and a Mining level of 21 to mine with. It mines on a 5-tick cycle, 1-tick faster than the steel pickaxe and the same speed as the black pickaxe.

It is also one of the lightest pickaxes in the game (although heavier than the black pickaxe), making it ideal for activities such as training Runecraft via the Abyss.

label: Mithril platebody
title: Mithril platebody
lead:
The mithril platebody is an armour used in melee with stat bonuses between steel and adamant (not including the black and white platebodies). It requires 20 Defence to equip and provides greater protection than a mithril chainbody. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's Ranged and Magic stats.

Players with level 68 Smithing can make one by using 5 mithril bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 250 Smithing experience. Alternatively, they can be bought from a handful of armour shops.

label: Mithril platelegs
title: Mithril platelegs
lead: Mithril platelegs are the third best free-to-play platelegs. They require level 20 Defence to equip. A player with 66 Smithing can make it by using three mithril bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 150 Smithing experience. Mithril platelegs offer similar stats to a mithril plateskirt but weigh more.

label: Mithril plateskirt
title: Mithril plateskirt
lead: Mithril plateskirts give the fifth best stat bonuses of all plateskirts. This piece of armour can be made with Level 66 Smithing by using 3 mithril bars on an anvil, therefore granting the player with 150 smithing experience. At least 20 Defence is required to wear it. Mithril plateskirts have similar stats to mithril platelegs but weigh less.

label: Mithril rocks
title: Mithril rocks
lead:
Mithril rocks are a rock that can be mined through the Mining skill to obtain mithril ore in various places throughout Gielinor. Mithril rocks can be mined with a Mining level of 55 or higher, granting 80 Mining experience and one mithril ore.

Hobgoblin Mine in level 30-35 Wilderness contains the greatest amount of mithril rocks. It also has several adamantite rocks, but like all Wilderness locations, player killers are always on the prowl, so take necessary precautions, and never bring anything you can't afford losing.

label: Mithril scimitar
title: Mithril scimitar
lead: The Mithril scimitar is a scimitar stronger than the black scimitar. Like all mithril weapons, it requires 20 Attack to wield. It can only be used in combat. Players can make a mithril scimitar with the Smithing skill at level 55 using 2 mithril bars, giving 100 experience.

label: Mithril seeds
title: Mithril seeds
lead:
Mithril seeds are a magical type of seed that can be planted almost anywhere to grow some flowers in the ground, and are purchasable from the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items.

Upon planting the seeds, the player will move one adjacent square west if possible; if there's an obstacle preventing movement to the west, the flowers will attempt to move the player to the east first, then south, then north. Once the flower is grown, players are then given the option to pick them, producing one of nine different colours of flowers.

label: Mithril spear
title: Mithril spear
lead: The mithril spear is a two-handed melee weapon made from mithril requiring 20 Attack to wield. Mithril spears are a members-only weapon. It can be bought from the Mount Karuulm Weapon Shop or Fortis Blacksmith, or obtained as a drop from monsters. Using the Smithing skill, players can create mithril spears on one of the barbarian anvils in either Otto's Grotto or Barbarian Village. However, players must have begun Barbarian Smithing training to be able to smith these spears. Like most spears, the mithril spear can be poisoned.

label: Mithril sq shield
title: Mithril sq shield
lead:
A mithril square shield is the fourth strongest square shield. Players with level 58 Smithing can make the shield by using two mithril bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 100 Smithing experience.

This shield can be bought from Raum Urda-Stein on Jatizso. This shield provides less defence than the mithril kiteshield, but is much lighter. As with all pieces of mithril armour, it requires 20 Defence to wield.

label: Mithril sword
title: Mithril sword
lead:
The Mithril sword is a sword stronger than the black sword. It requires 20 Attack to wield.

Players can make this sword at level 54 Smithing by using one mithril bar and a hammer on an anvil, granting 50 experience. It can also be purchased from the Varrock Swordshop.

label: Mithril thrownaxe
title: Mithril thrownaxe
lead: The mithril thrownaxe is a Ranged throwing weapon. To wield a mithril throwing axe the player must have at least 20 Ranged. They can be obtained either by buying from the Tribal Weapons store at the Ranging Guild or trading with another player. The mithril throwing axe can be wielded with a shield or prayer book for protection.

label: Mithril warhammer
title: Mithril warhammer
lead:
The mithril warhammer is a warhammer stronger than the black warhammer, being made out of mithril. It may be used as an effective way of killing monsters weak to crush, such as earth warriors. Unlike other mithril weapons, it requires level 20 in Strength to wield.

Players can make a mithril warhammer with the Smithing skill at level 59 using 3 mithril bars, giving the player 150 Smithing experience. Members can purchase this warhammer from Skulgrimen's Battle Gear in Rellekka, and Vigr's Warhammers in Keldagrim.

label: Mixed chemicals
title: Mixed chemicals
lead: Mixed chemicals are used in the The Dig Site to create the chemical compound. It is made by combining nitroglycerin with ammonium nitrate, granting 2 Herblore experience. The chemicals can then be combined with ground charcoal, granting 2.5 Herblore experience, to make step 2 of the compound. Finally, it can be combined with an arcenia root to make the chemical compound, granting 3 Herblore experience. Due to the nitroglycerin, dropping the mixed chemicals will cause an explosion that destroy the item and deals a significant amount of damage to the player. The chemicals deal 45 damage after step 1, or 55 damage after the addition of ground charcoal in step 2, but the damage is not lethal.

label: Mixed flowers
title: Mixed flowers
lead:
Mixed flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds. They can also be purchased from the Flower Girl in Miscellania.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Molten glass
title: Molten glass
lead:
Molten glass is used in the Crafting and Construction skills, as well as some quests, to form glass items. It is created through the Crafting skill by using a bucket of sand and soda ash on a furnace, granting 20 Crafting experience. This only requires level 1 Crafting. Alternatively, players can use the Lunar spell Superglass Make, which combines all buckets of sand and all seaweed or soda ash in the player's inventory into molten glass, granting 10 Crafting experience per pair of items.

Molten glass is used in some quests such as Observatory Quest, Horror from the Deep, Wanted!, Desert Treasure I, Another Slice of H.A.M. and The Fremennik Exiles. Although molten glass cannot be bought in any shop, buckets of sand and soda ash are available from the charter ship shops. This is especially useful for ironmen, who could buy both items and then smelt them in a furnace. For larger amounts, giant seaweed and sandstone are efficient sources of the materials required; as a result, making and blowing glass is a common method of training Crafting.

label: Monarch Waltz
title: Monarch Waltz
lead: Monarch Waltz is a music track that is unlocked at Sinclair Mansion. This track is similar to Medieval.

label: Monk
title: Monk
lead:
Monks are worshippers of Saradomin who live in monasteries, churches, and on the island of Entrana. Monks will heal the player 2 + 20% of their Hitpoints if the player talks to them and asks them to do so, unless on a PvP world. Monks at the Ardougne Monastery do not provide this option.

Monks will occasionally heal themselves 2 Hitpoints at random intervals in combat. They are useful for training on at lower combat levels, as players can talk to another monk and request healing. Because monks can survive small amounts of damage, it's possible for a defence pure to train on the same monk indefinitely.

label: Monk (Lost City)
title: Monk (Lost City)
lead: The Monk is part of a band of adventurers searching for Zanaris. The Monk and his three companions, an archer, a wizard, and a warrior, can be found in the north-west part of the Lumbridge Swamp, near the Draynor bank. He is a part of the Lost City quest.

label: Monk of Entrana
title: Monk of Entrana
lead:
Monks of Entrana are NPCs that must be talked to in order to sail back and forth between Port Sarim and Entrana, as long as the player has no weapons or armour.

They will allow you to carry magic secateurs, as they do not count them as a weapon. They cannot be talked to on a non-member account.

label: Monk of Zamorak
title: Monk of Zamorak
lead:
Monks of Zamorak are evil clerics that follow Zamorak, god of chaos. They are found in several locations, including the Asgarnian Chaos Temple, Taverley Dungeon, Paterdomus Temple, Battlefield mine and Deep Wilderness Dungeon. A level 17 monk of Zamorak is in a cage under the stairs on the of Varrock Palace. He is often used in free-to-play servers to train magic using the Curse spell.

Despite them being feared, they are extremely useful for Ranged training as they are weak towards Ranged and there are many safespots. The Chaos Temple is also a useful spot because there is an altar located in the temple for Prayer. The monks in Paterdomus Temple provide less experience than regular monsters, providing players with only a quarter of the usual experience gained from dealing damage.

label: Monk's Friend
title: Monk's Friend
lead: Monk's Friend is a short novice quest in which the monks of the Ardougne Monastery ask you to do them a couple of favours, allowing them to throw a party without any setbacks.

label: monk's robe
title: monk's robe
lead: Monk's robe is a part of Monk's robes and is found lying on the table upstairs in the Edgeville Monastery, which requires a Prayer level of at least 31 to enter. The monk's robe bottom provides a +5 Prayer bonus while having no requirements to wear.

label: monk's robe top
title: monk's robe top
lead: Monk's robe top is a part of Monk's robes and can be found lying on the table upstairs in the Edgeville Monastery, which requires a Prayer level of 31 to enter. The monk's robe top is useful in that it provides a +6 Prayer bonus while having no requirements to wear.

label: Monkey (monster)
title: Monkey (monster)
lead:
Monkeys are small, level 3 monsters that may be found in a variety of locations. They are not ideal for training combat, as they have a low amount of hitpoints and have few useful drops. However, monkey bones do give slightly more Prayer experience than regular bones.

During the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest, all monkeys located on Karamja cannot be damaged by Melee attacks (with the exception of using a halberd to attack from beyond the monkey's melee range) as the player will be unable to touch them, rendering Magic and Ranged as the only ways to kill them. This only occurs during the quest; before and after the quest they can be damaged by all attacks. It is not possible to kill them using rings of recoil as they do not attack back during the quest.

label: Monkey bars (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Monkey bars (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead: The Monkey bars are an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to cross will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

label: Monkeybars (Edgeville Dungeon)
title: Monkeybars (Edgeville Dungeon)
lead:
The monkeybars is an Agility shortcut found within the Edgeville Dungeon. An Agility level of 15 is required to traverse these monkey bars. This obstacle allows access to the part of the Edgeville dungeon that contains earth warriors, the area is mostly used by people doing Earth warriors as their Wilderness Slayer task. Some people use the monkey bars as a low-intensity way to train Agility, as with the right camera placement it is possible to keep the mouse cursor in one spot and continuously click. This obstacle can not be failed. Players can gain up to 13,000 experience per hour.

Be aware that the monkey bars are located in the Wilderness, and as such the player may be attacked by other players while using them.

label: Monkeybars (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
title: Monkeybars (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
lead:
Monkeybars are an Agility shortcut located inside the Yanille Agility Dungeon. An Agility level of 57 is required to use the shortcut. It provides access to the Chaos druids deeper in the dungeon, as well as a lockpick respawn down the nearby stairs. There's a chance of failing this shortcut and falling into a lower level crawling with poisonous spiders.

Clicking the Monkeybars without moving the camera is an Idle training method and can gain you up to 13,333xp per hour.

label: Monument
title: Monument
lead:
The Monuments plays a role in the Priest of Peril quest, located under Paterdomus. Using the golden key on the southern monument containing the key will give the player the iron key, which is used to free Drezel from his prison.

Furthermore, for souvenir purposes only, golden variants of common tools can be obtained by swamping them with their respective monument. This can only be done once during the quest ; specifically, before using the blessed water on the coffin! Attempting to use normal tools again on the already swapped monuments during this part of the quest will output a dialogue box, "You have already taken the Golden ".

label: Moody
title: Moody
lead:
Moody is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in the Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, it plays east of Ferox Enclave as well as at Deserted Keep in Deep Wilderness.

label: moonlight mead
title: moonlight mead
lead:
Moonlight mead is a type of ale that restores 4 Hitpoints. It can be obtained through brewing at level 44 Cooking, granting 380 experience. It is brewed using 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, 4 mushrooms, and a pot of ale yeast. The stronger, mature version of the ale is the moonlight mead(m).

It can be bought for 5 coins from Roavar in the Hair of the Dog tavern, located in Canifis.

label: Morgan
title: Morgan
lead:
Morgan is a worried citizen you talk with to start the Vampyre Slayer quest. He can be found in his house north of Ned's house in Draynor Village.

Garlic can be found in his house upstairs.

label: Morgan Le Faye
title: Morgan Le Faye
lead: Lady Morgan Le Faye is King Arthur's nemesis, and owner of Keep Le Faye. Her son is Sir Mordred. She is involved with Merlin's Crystal and King's Ransom, as she turns King Arthur into stone and works with the Sinclairs and the Black Knights. She has many magical powers, including some that surpass even Merlin's ability, as she was capable of imprisoning him within a crystal.

label: Morris
title: Morris
lead: Morris is a resident of Hemenster. He acts as a gatekeeper for the Fishing Contest, only allowing those who have a fishing pass onto the contest grounds.

label: Mort myre fungus
title: Mort myre fungus
lead:
Mort myre fungi can be obtained in Mort Myre Swamp. It can be used to add 1 charge to a Druid pouch or used in the Herblore skill to make super energy potions.

It is obtained by casting Bloom with a Druidic spell (given to the player by Filliman Tarlock during the Nature Spirit quest), or blessed silver sickle (created during the same quest), or any of: Emerald sickle (b), Enchanted emerald sickle (b), Ruby sickle (b), Enchanted ruby sickle (b), Blisterwood sickle, Ivandis flail, or Blisterwood flail near rotting logs. Each cast of Bloom will drain 1-6 Prayer points from the player and may cause two mort myre fungus to spawn on each surrounding rotting log. Prayer drain is completely random and unaffected by the player's Prayer level or how many items are actually made. Alternatively, they can be obtained as a [[#Dropping monsters|drop]] from certain monsters or by chopping sulliuscep mushrooms.

label: Mort myre pear
title: Mort myre pear
lead:
A Mort myre pear is obtained during or after the Nature Spirit quest. It appears when the Bloom spell is cast, using a silver sickle(b) near certain small bushes in the Mort Myre Swamp. Each pear can be used to add 3 charges to a druid pouch for use as protection from Ghasts. However, they are not common, and it is generally easier to find Mort myre fungi or Mort myre stems.

It is a possible item requirement in Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Mort myre stem
title: Mort myre stem
lead:
Mort myre stems can be obtained by operating a silver sickle (b) near rotting branches on the ground in Mort Myre Swamp. Each stem can be used to add 2 charges to a druid pouch for use as protection from ghasts.

It is a possible item requirement in Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Mort Myre Swamp
title: Mort Myre Swamp
lead: The Mort Myre swamp, also known simply as Mort Myre and once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. Players first unlock the gate to the swampland by starting Nature Spirit, but the swamp can also be accessed by Barrows or Mort'ton teleport scrolls. Much of the swamp is plagued by ghasts, which attack players and rot food, aswell as a swamp decay effect, hitting the player periodically. Both can be avoided by building a Fire of Dehumidification after completion of Making Friends with My Arm.

label: Morytania
title: Morytania
lead:
Morytania (pronounced ) is a members-only area in the easternmost part of Gielinor. Players must complete the Priest in Peril quest to enter. Often described as a land of evil, the land is filled with many aggressive creatures such as vampyres, werewolves, ghasts, and the undead. It is currently ruled by Lord Drakan.

Prior to the God Wars, Morytania was marked by fertile land and thriving cities, and was occupied by Saradominists and Zarosians. In the Third Age, the vampyre Lord Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan betrayed the Zarosians in the name of Zamorak, ousting the Saradominists and turning the land to a swamp in the process. Lord Drakan then erected a wall around the former Saradominist capital of Hallowvale, turning it into a dense concentration camp and committing genocide against the Icyene race.

label: Morytania (music track)
title: Morytania (music track)
lead:
Morytania is a music track that is unlocked in the northern parts of Morytania, outside the Mort Myre Swamp and the Haunted Woods.

In Classic mode, the track only plays in the area directly around the Paterdomus, including in the part that is not part of Morytania itself.

label: Mosol Rei
title: Mosol Rei
lead: Mosol Rei is a warrior and inhabitant of Shilo Village, and involved in the Shilo Village quest. After completion of the quest, he offers a way into the village past the Undead ones.

label: Moss Giant Island
title: Moss Giant Island
lead:
Moss Giant Island is a small island located west of Brimhaven, accessed by using a rope swing (Rope not needed) requiring 10 Agility. There are five moss giants on the island. Players can use safespots when fighting them.

There are two slice of cake spawns, which have a respawn time of 45 seconds. Players with 40+ Defence do not need to bring much food because of this resource. Lower-level players should, however, be cautious of the Poison Scorpions near the island.

label: moss giant
title: moss giant
lead:
Moss giants are large giants, found in areas that are tied to nature. Moss giants are very commonly trained on, since their Defence level is rather low in comparison to other monsters of the same combat level, and they are vulnerable to Fire spells.

They can drop the mossy key, which is required to access the moss giant boss Bryophyta's lair for the first time, and loot her chest thereafter.

label: mossy rock
title: mossy rock
lead: Mossy rocks are found in the north-west corner of the Kharazi Jungle. Any of the rocks can be searched in order to enter the Shaman Caves and deeper Viyeldi caves, requiring an Agility level of 50.

label: Mossy rock (Viyeldi caves)
title: Mossy rock (Viyeldi caves)
lead: A Mossy rock can be found in the Viyeldi caves. During the Legends' Quest the player must use the Heart crystal on the mossy rock in order to activate it, such that it can be used on the Recess, turning it into a Filled Recess, and deactivating the Shimmering fields.

label: Mound of earth
title: Mound of earth
lead: The mound of earth must be dug up during the Shilo Village quest to find a fissure. It is located east of Shilo Village, just across the river.

label: Mountain Dwarf (historical)
title: Mountain Dwarf (historical)
lead:
The Mountain Dwarf was a former character who could previously be found guarding the entrance to the White Wolf Tunnel. Players spoke to him in order to start the Fishing Contest quest. He later appeared in his own subquest during Recipe for Disaster.

In 2006, the Fishing Contest quest was reworked, and the Mountain Dwarf was replaced by two new characters named Austri and Vestri. As a result, he has never normally been present in Old School RuneScape, but remains in Recipe for Disaster.

label: Mountain goat
title: Mountain goat
lead:
Mountain goats are animals that can be in the mountains around Troll Country, specifically the top of Trollheim; south of Mount Quidamortem; the cliff overlooking Death Plateau; around the ice troll settlement of Weiss; and inside a cage in the troll kitchen, ready to be cooked (although Burntmeat the troll cook prefers to cook humans if he gets the chance).

Eadgar, through a dialogue option, will turn them into goat stew if the player gives him some logs for his fire. This heals 20 Hitpoints.

label: Mountain troll
title: Mountain troll
lead:
Mountain trolls are aggressive creatures which can be found patrolling various mountainous areas. They are commonly killed as part of an assigned Slayer task of "trolls".

Trolls regenerate health twice as quickly as other monsters, but are still vulnerable to poison. They usually use crush weapons, which, combined with their relatively high Strength, can hit rather hard. However, they attack slowly and are quite inaccurate, so it's not strictly necessary to use protection prayers for players that have high Defence. A good strategy for conserving supplies is to use Bones to Peaches on the big bones that they drop; this will almost always cover any damage they manage to deal. Bringing a staff of fire (or similar item) and nature runes is recommended in order to alchemise their frequent low-level armour and weapon drops.

label: Mounted terrorbird gnome
title: Mounted terrorbird gnome
lead: Mounted terrorbird gnomes are gnomes riding terrorbirds. They are stronger than regular unmounted terrorbirds. They are found spread around and to the south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold and the Battlefield. They may be killed for the bird Slayer task. They attack with melee and have mediocre combat stats for their level, and consequently pose little threat.

label: Mourner (boss)
title: Mourner (boss)
lead: A level 13 Mourner is fought during Biohazard. When the player infiltrates the Mourner Headquarters, they will encounter a mourner on the top floor who sees through their disguise. After he is killed, he drops a key used to unlock a gate, which can be used to access the crate containing the Distillator required for the quest.

label: Mourner Headquarters
title: Mourner Headquarters
lead:
The Mourner Headquarters, also known as the Mourner HQ, is the headquarters for the Mourners, who are secretly the Death Guard of Prifddinas and members of the Iorwerth Clan. It is located in the north-eastern part of West Ardougne and plays a major role throughout the elf quest line.

During the Elven Civil War, the headquarters serves as a base of military and strategic operations for the Iorwerth Clan. After completion of Song of the Elves, the building is taken over by the paladins and knights of Ardougne, and the Iorwerth warriors relocate to the Iorwerth Dungeon.

label: Mouse (Witch's House)
title: Mouse (Witch's House)
lead:
The mouse plays a minor role in the Witch's House quest as part of the security system in Nora T. Hagg's house. The mouse must be lured out of its hole with a piece of cheese, then given a magnet in order to open the door from the house to the garden.

This convoluted security system was installed by Professor Oddenstein, and is described in the witch's diary.

label: Mouse hole (scenery)
title: Mouse hole (scenery)
lead: The mouse hole is a piece of scenery found in the witch's house north of Taverley. During the Witch's House quest, the hole is the home of a large mouse that the player lures out with cheese to unlock a door. In and after Grim Tales, the hole serves as the entrance to the mouse hole dungeon, where Miazrqa's pendant can be found. A (seemingly) large mouse hole also serves as the exit out of the dungeon.

label: Mubariz
title: Mubariz
lead:
Mubariz gives introductions to the Emir's Arena. He will teach how the Emir's Arena works. You can ask him for a fight through a dialogue about asking 'This place looks really old, where did it come from?'. However, he will just laugh at you if you try to challenge him.

He runs the PvP Arena Rewards shop, where players can trade in points obtained from fighting in the arena for rewards.

label: Mud pile
title: Mud pile
lead: A Mud pile serves as the exit to the Goblin Cave and is found in the south-east corner of the cave.

label: Mud pile (Ardougne Sewers)
title: Mud pile (Ardougne Sewers)
lead: A mud pile can be found in the western section of the Ardougne Sewers, located under Alrena and Edmond's house in Ardougne. Players can climb the mud pile to leave sewers and arrive at the dug hole in Alrena and Edmond's garden.

label: muddy chest
title: muddy chest
lead:
The muddy chest is a locked chest located in the centre of Lava Maze. It can only be opened with a muddy key, consuming one key each time the chest is opened. A slash weapon is necessary to cut through the web that allows access to the maze centre (Aranea boots may also be used), or 82 Agility to use the stepping stone shortcut north of the fenced area.

Opening the chest is a task in the Medium Wilderness Diary.

label: Muddy key
title: Muddy key
lead:
The muddy key is a key that can be used to open the muddy chest in the centre of the Lava Maze in the Wilderness. You will need a knife or sword to access it. It can be obtained as a drop from chaos dwarves (in both the Wilderness and Taverley Dungeon), and the crazy archaeologist.

Using a muddy key to open the muddy chest is a medium Wilderness Diary task.

label: mugger
title: mugger
lead:
Muggers are weak human non-player characters that have a combat level of 6. Because of their low combat level, they are generally more of a nuisance, but they can still be a threat for brand-new players.

Muggers are aggressive, which means that they attack players who are two times the mugger's combat level or less. Thus, muggers are aggressive against players who have a combat level between 3 and 12.

label: Multicannon parts for sale
title: Multicannon parts for sale
lead:
Multicannon parts for sale is a store located in the dwarven industrial area of Ice Mountain, owned by Nulodion. It sells dwarf multicannon parts, ammo moulds, and the instruction manual. The Dwarf Cannon quest must be completed to access the store.

It is cheaper to buy the cannon parts through Nulodion's dialogue, as he will sell a full set of four parts together for 750,000 coins, whereas buying them individually would cost a total of 802,500 coins.

label: Mummy (historical)
title: Mummy (historical)
lead:
Mummies were an unused monster first added to the RuneScape 2 beta. A Behind the Scenes article from March 2004 promised that one of the upcoming updates would be "A pyramid quest in the desert full of traps, treasure and mummys ." Presumably, the mummies were created as part of this planned update.

Though this idea was used for a planned update in 2004, development was halted after the intern was dismissed. The mummies were deleted from the game files with the release of Slayer. Ultimately, new mummies were released with Desert Treasure I in April 2005, who had a similar appearance.

label: Murder Mystery
title: Murder Mystery
lead: Murder Mystery is a quest that investigates the murder of Lord Sinclair. The culprit is random for each player, so some investigation must be done to determine the murderer. However, there are plenty of clues to be found around the Sinclair Mansion.

label: Murky water
title: Murky water
lead:
The murky water is a quest item used only in Priest in Peril. It can only be made during the quest by using a bucket on the well in the Paterdomus mausoleum to obtain water from the River Salve.

It is used to make blessed water by speaking to Drezel.

label: Murphy
title: Murphy
lead:
Murphy is a sailor who is located at Port Khazard. To reach him quickly, use the Minigame teleport to Fishing Trawler. Players must speak to him during the Freeing Pirate Pete subquest of Recipe for Disaster, in order to obtain a diving apparatus to go diving. He runs the Fishing Trawler minigame and also gives players a sextant which is 1 of 3 items that the observatory professor tells you is needed to solve a coordinate in a Treasure Trail.

In order to go diving to the Mogre Camp, the player must weigh less than 28 kg. This is required for an elite clue step.

label: Musa Point
title: Musa Point
lead: Musa Point is the north-eastern edge of Karamja, located west of Port Sarim. It hosts a dungeon for members, as well the only spots to harpoon fish for free players aside from the Corsair Cove Resource Area.

label: Mushroom (mountain troll)
title: Mushroom (mountain troll)
lead:
Mushroom is a sleeping mountain troll found near the entrance to the Troll Stronghold. He has no interactions, although players can hear a snoring sound if they stand near him.

There is a treasure trail clue which leads the player just next to him.

label: Mysterious Old Man
title: Mysterious Old Man
lead:
The Mysterious Old Man teleports players to the Maze and Mime random events, or simply hands out items in a similar way to Rick Turpentine, because he was feeling lonely. In the Maze random event, complete the labyrinth as quickly as possible, faster for better rewards. In the Mime random event, copy the emotes of the mime artist.

The Mysterious Old Man can also appear underwater, in which case he will always award an item straight away, rather than offer the player a chance to participate in an event.

label: Mysterious ruins
title: Mysterious ruins
lead:
Mysterious ruins are ruins found throughout Gielinor that will transport players to various Runic altars. Clicking 'locate' on a talisman will point the player in the direction of the corresponding ruins. They can then use the talisman on the ruins to be transported to the altar.

If the player is wearing an imbued tiara or correctly attuned Hat of the eye, the ruins will have a left-click option of "Enter".

label: Mysterious statue
title: Mysterious statue
lead: A mysterious statue is a large ancient stone statue with a peculiar appearance. There are 6 statues in total, and they are used during the Holy Grail quest to triangulate the entrance to the realm of the Fisher King.

label: Mysterious stone
title: Mysterious stone
lead: Mysterious stones can be found next to some runecraft altars. Players cannot interact with the mysterious stones, but they can examine them.

label: Mystic air staff
title: Mystic air staff
lead:
The mystic air staff is an elemental staff requiring 40 Attack and 40 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of air runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created after the completion of the quest Scorpion Catcher by taking an air battlestaff and to Thormac. After completion of the Hard Kandarin Diary and Elite Kandarin Diary, Thormac will only require or respectively.

label: Mystic earth staff
title: Mystic earth staff
lead:
The mystic earth staff is an elemental staff requiring 40 Attack and 40 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of earth runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created after the completion of the quest Scorpion Catcher by taking an earth battlestaff and to Thormac. After completion of the Hard Kandarin Diary and Elite Kandarin Diary, Thormac will only require or respectively.

label: Mystic fire staff
title: Mystic fire staff
lead:
The mystic fire staff is an elemental staff requiring 40 Attack and 40 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created after the completion of the quest Scorpion Catcher by taking a fire battlestaff and to Thormac. After completion of the Hard Kandarin Diary and Elite Kandarin Diary, Thormac will only require or respectively.

label: Mystic lava staff
title: Mystic lava staff
lead:
The mystic lava staff is an elemental staff requiring 40 Attack and 40 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of earth and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This type of elemental staff is the best (once you've reached or surpassed level 87 Magic) for getting enchantment points when training Magic at the Mage Training Arena. It is also useful for Enfeeble-alching.

label: mystic water staff
title: mystic water staff
lead:
The mystic water staff is an elemental staff requiring 40 Attack and 40 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of water runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

This staff can be created after the completion of the quest Scorpion Catcher by taking a water battlestaff and to Thormac. After completion of the Hard Kandarin Diary and Elite Kandarin Diary, Thormac will only require or respectively.

label: Mystical wall chart
title: Mystical wall chart
lead:
Mystical wall charts were wall decorations that could be found in various locations throughout Gielinor. They depict a pentagram.

They were removed from the game in a hidden update in January 2006 and replaced with Demonic symbols. Presumably this was due to Jagex wishing to avoid controversy, because of the pentagram's associations with Satanism.

label: Natural
title: Natural
lead:
Natural is a music track that is unlocked on the island of the the Nature Grotto in Mort Myre Swamp. It can also be heard on the island in the River Salve, or during Temple Trekking in combat events with one escape route.

In Classic mode, the track plays in a large area around the Nature Grotto, as well as on a small part of the shore of the Digsite.

label: Nature Altar
title: Nature Altar
lead:
The Nature Altar is a runic altar upon which nature runes are crafted from pure essence, providing 9 Runecraft experience per essence imbued. Level 44 Runecraft is required to craft nature runes.

Players may create a nature tiara here by using either a nature talisman or a tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 45 Runecraft experience. A catalytic tiara can also be created here by using a catalytic talisman and gold tiara, granting 42.5 Runecraft experience.

label: Nature Grotto
title: Nature Grotto
lead:
Nature Grotto is a small cave located deep within the Mort Myre Swamp. It is located north-west of the village of Mor'ton and directly east of the Exam Centre, though of course across the river. You may pray at the altar of nature in the cave, earning you 2 extra Prayer points until spending them.

The Nature Grotto first appears in the quest Nature Spirit, of which it is a vital part of the quest. Jumping across the broken bridge will bring you to the cave entrance – a black hole in the mound – and Filliman Tarlock.

label: Nature rune
title: Nature rune
lead:
Nature runes are runes used for transmutation spells such as Low and High Alchemy and Superheat Item. They are also used for the spells Bind, Snare, and Entangle, and several spells on the Lunar and Arceuus spellbooks. They can be purchased from many magic shops.

Nature runes can be crafted from pure essence by members with level 44 Runecraft at the Nature Altar, granting 9 experience per pure essence used. Players with 91 Runecraft will always craft two nature runes per essence.

label: Nature Spirit
title: Nature Spirit
lead: Nature Spirit is a quest that takes place deep in the Mort Myre Swamp. The nature spirit Filliman Tarlock needs help restoring the Nature Grotto, his home, to its previous glory.

label: Nature talisman
title: Nature talisman
lead:
The nature talisman is a talisman used to gain access to the Nature Altar, located north of Shilo Village on the island of Karamja, where players can craft nature runes. The talisman can also be combined with a tiara at the Nature Altar by having both the nature talisman and tiara in your inventory, and using the tiara on the altar. This action grants the player 45 Runecraft experience; some players choose to do this in order to save an extra inventory space and make quicker trips when crafting nature runes, as the Nature Altar may be accessed simply by left-clicking on it while the player is wearing the nature tiara.

A good way to obtain the talisman is to kill abyssal leeches in the abyss after completing the Enter the Abyss miniquest. Keep in mind that the abyss is very dangerous and you may find yourself quickly overwhelmed without proper armour and food. Always bring a teleport in case you need a quick escape. The nature talisman is also a part of the rare drop table, therefore any monster with access to the rare drop table has a chance of either dropping this talisman or a chaos talisman (with a couple of exceptions being able to drop both, such as fire giants and abyssal demons).

label: Nazastarool
title: Nazastarool
lead:
Nazastarool is an undead encountered during the Shilo Village quest after searching a dolmen in Rashiliyia's Tomb. He has three forms; the first being a level 91 Zombie, second a 68 Skeleton and finally a 93 Ghost. All three forms have to be fought during the quest. A very easy way to kill him is to either range or use magic on him, as he can get stuck behind obstacles. All three forms may also be safespotted with a Halberd.

When defeated, he curses the player and disappears.

label: Necklace mould
title: Necklace mould
lead: A necklace mould allows a player to make necklaces through the Crafting skill out of gold bars and possibly gems by using them on a furnace. It can be bought at various crafting shops, and an unlimited amount can also be taken from a tool store 4 in a player-owned house.

label: Necromancer
title: Necromancer
lead: The Necromancer is found on the of the Necromancer Tower just south of East Ardougne. He will attack with his fists, curse spells, and by summoning Summoned Zombies to aid him. He has a long respawn time.

label: Necromancer Tower
title: Necromancer Tower
lead: The Necromancer Tower is a tower south of East Ardougne where a few necromancers reside.

label: Ned
title: Ned
lead:
Captain Ned is an old sailor who lives in a small house in eastern Draynor Village. He plays a part in the Dragon Slayer I and Prince Ali Rescue quests. Players can bring him 15 coins or four balls of wool to make a rope. Alternatively, he sells rope (for 18 coins) at his store, Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool).

After The Fremennik Isles, players who buy rope from him will notice that his rope seems funny, and Ned will confess that he actually gets the ropes from Neitiznot by trading balls of wool and doesn't actually make them himself. He will give the player another rope for free in exchange for them keeping quiet about it. He will also rename his store to Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool - not yak, honest!) in an attempt to cover up his past deceit.

label: Ned (historical)
title: Ned (historical)
lead:
Ned was a character who could previously be encounted during Dragon Slayer I. He could be found on the Lady Lumbridge after the ship was repaired, and on Crandor where the ship had crashed.

During Dragon Slayer I, Ned from Draynor Village is recruited to help sail the player to Crandor. Due to game limitations in 2001, a second version of Ned had to be created specifically for use during Dragon Slayer. He has a different appearance to the Draynor Village Ned, as he was not graphically updated alongside the other in 2005.

label: Needle
title: Needle
lead:
A Needle is an item used along with thread to create armour out of leather and dragon leather through the Crafting skill. It can be bought in crafting stores, such as Dommik's Crafting Store. in Al Kharid. They can also be bought from Moon Clan Fine Clothes on Lunar Isle, the Canifis General Store and Fancy Clothes Store in Varrock (Members). After completion of Death on the Isle, a Costume needle can be used for crafting without needing thread.

Needles can also be found from digging in the Digsite. They can also be found with a 10% probability by searching haystacks or hay bales - this is a reference to the idiom "finding a needle in a haystack", meaning something that is almost impossible to find because it is hidden among so many other things. When your character finds one this way, they will remark on how rare an occurrence it is.

label: Nettles (scenery)
title: Nettles (scenery)
lead:
Nettles are plants that can be picked to obtain nettles. Though nettle plants can be found in nonmembers regions, nettles can only be picked on members worlds.

Players must wear gloves in order to pick nettles. If no gloves are worn, no nettles will be obtained and the player will be dealt up to 2 Hitpoints of damage. Although the resulting hitsplat is green, similar to poison, the player will not be poisoned. After picking nettles, they disappear and will respawn after a few seconds.

label: Neverland
title: Neverland
lead: Neverland is a music track that is unlocked at the entrance to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and on Chinchompa Island.

label: Newbie Melody
title: Newbie Melody
lead: Newbie Melody is a music track that is unlocked on Tutorial Island. This is the first track that all new players will hear.

label: Newcomer map
title: Newcomer map
lead:
A Newcomer map is a map sold at many general stores for one coin. It is also sold by Rasolo and Trader crewmembers for 2 coins.

The map helps new players of the game find their way around Gielinor. The map does not give clear directions, but shows a general view of eastern Asgarnia and western Misthalin, being the main Free-to-play area of the game. The map will also display the rough location of the player with a blinking X on the map. This item is not particularly useful anymore due to the world map interface serving a similar purpose.

label: Nezikchened
title: Nezikchened
lead:
Nezikchened is a level 187 black demon that has to be defeated three different times during the Legends' Quest. He is also among the strongest demons in the game. At the start of each fight he drains the player's prayer points. Like all demons, he is also vulnerable to the effects of demonbane weapons. He has a very peculiar habit of calling the player 'Vacu.' According to Gujuo, 'Vacu' was the name for shamans who could summon powerful and wise spirits, but were enslaved by the spirits for asking too much of them.

Despite being a black demon, he is not considered one for the purpose of a Slayer task. He can be fought in the Nightmare Zone after the quest is complete.

label: Nightfall
title: Nightfall
lead:
Nightfall is a music track that can be unlocked outside Falador city walls, at the Falador Farm, Crafting Guild, and the Dark Wizards' Tower. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Long Way Home and Miles Away.

In Classic mode, the track plays north of Rimmington.

label: Niles
title: Niles
lead: Niles is the brother of Giles and Miles. Like his brothers, he may appear to initiate the Certer random event, in which he will ask players to identify an item, such as a fish, with three possible choices of what the object is. If the player correctly identifies the item, Niles will give the player a reward of either coins, a gem (uncut, up to diamond), a cosmic talisman, a half key, a spinach roll, or a kebab.

label: Niloof
title: Niloof
lead: Niloof is a dwarf trapped in the Underground Pass. He came to the pass along with Klank and Kamen seeking rare ore, but was trapped there by the evil created by the mage Iban. The first time you speak to him during Underground Pass, he will give you two meat pies and a meat pizza.

label: Nitroglycerin
title: Nitroglycerin
lead:
Nitroglycerin is a vial of chemicals used in The Dig Site quest which, when combined with ammonium nitrate, ground charcoal and an arcenia root, create a chemical compound. Unidentified liquid may be obtained by using an empty vial on the barrel with a skull & crossbones symbol, to the west of the tent south of the Digsite, before being brought to Terry Balando for identification. After Terry has identified the liquid, all vials in your inventory will be converted to Nitroglycerin. If the barrel has not previously been opened, a trowel may be used on it in order to do so.

When dropped, a vial of unidentified liquid does 25 damage to the player and causes them to say . This damage is increased to 35 if dropping a vial of nitroglycerin and the message is changed to However, neither can kill the player in the event that the player's Hitpoints are already 25 or below (35 or below for nitroglycerin). They may be alchemised or destroyed using the incinerator to safely dispose of them.

label: No
title: No
lead:
No is the second listed emote. Upon use the player shakes their head left and right.

This emote is unlocked automatically upon making an account.

label: Nomad (music track)
title: Nomad (music track)
lead: Nomad is a music track that used to play in northern Tai Bwo Wannai, but now plays in the Ruins of Unkah.

label: Nora T. Hagg
title: Nora T. Hagg
lead:
Nora T. Hagg is a witch who lives in a house located in Taverley. She is the central figure in the Witch's House quest, during which the player must retrieve the boy's lost ball from her garden.

She has a pet experiment that she hides in her shed, along with other experiments of hers that live in the sewers beneath her house.

label: North Brimhaven mine
title: North Brimhaven mine
lead:
The North Brimhaven mine (also known as the horseshoe mine or Karamja north-western mine) is located on the peninsula north-west of Brimhaven. The mine has ten gold rocks from which players may mine gold ore as well as a single gold ore spawn. The mine is in a members-only area. It is worth noting that there are several Poison Scorpions in the area (they will automatically attack you unless you are combat level 41 or higher).

Players may get to this area quickly from the Fisher Realm by blowing a magic whistle and then walking a few steps south.

label: North Crandor mine
title: North Crandor mine
lead: North Crandor mine is a mining site scattered across the northern area of Crandor. Access to this mine is obtained by traversing the tunnel entered from the Karamja Volcano, or as a one-time deal, through a ship from the Dragon Slayer I quest. The closest bank to these mines are in Draynor Village for free players and in Mor Ul Rek for members. Beware of the lesser demons lurking around the dungeon entrance.

label: Noterazzo
title: Noterazzo
lead: Noterazzo is the owner of the Bandit Duty Free, he is located in the Wilderness Bandit Camp. He purportedly gives players the best deals they will find. When asked why, he says it is due to the heavy taxes on general stores in Asgarnia and Misthalin and because of that it is hard for them to run an effective business, while he claims that the taxmen do not visit him. This is reflected in his buying prices, which at empty stock are the same as High Level Alchemy value, a trait shared with Martin Thwait's Lost and Found.

label: nuggets
title: nuggets
lead: Nuggets are pieces of gold found at the Digsite when panning with a panning tray. Players can trade three of them to Terry Balando at the Exam Centre for one gold ore.

label: Nulodion
title: Nulodion
lead:
Nulodion is the official Dwarf Cannon engineer and Weapons Development Chief of the Dwarven Black Guard. During the Dwarf Cannon quest, he gives the player an ammo mould and Nulodion's notes to bring back to Captain Lawgof. Nulodion's Multicannon parts for sale is the only place that sells the parts of the dwarf multicannon (once the player has completed the Dwarf Cannon quest). The store also sells the cannon instruction manual, and ammo moulds to make your own cannonballs. Ammo moulds are used in the Between a Rock... quest.

If your cannon decays or you log out while your cannon is set up you can talk to him, selecting the dialogue option "I've lost my cannon" will allow you to retrieve it free of charge. If you had Shattered cannon ornament kits attached to your cannon, they will also be retrieved.

label: Nulodion's notes
title: Nulodion's notes
lead:
Nulodion's notes are a quest item used only in Dwarf Cannon. It is obtained from Nulodion after speaking to Captain Lawgof after repairing his broken dwarf multicannon.

It is given to Captain Lawgof alongside Ammo mould to complete the quest.

label: Nurmof
title: Nurmof
lead:
Nurmof is the owner of Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop, where he sells bronze through rune pickaxes. He resides in the back of the Dwarven Mines, near the Keldagrim train cart and dwarven gang members.

Nurmof can also repair broken dragon pickaxes for a fee of . This is useful for ironmen accounts who don't yet have one, but is not always worth it for players wishing to sell the pickaxe on the Grand Exchange. At current prices, repairing a broken dragon pickaxe and then selling it on the Grand Exchange will bring the player a profit of .

label: Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop.
title: Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop.
lead:
Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop is located in the north-west cul-de-sac of the Dwarven Mine, accessed through the alley with the anvil, south-west from the north entrance. Alternatively, a disk of returning can be used anywhere within the mine to teleport players south west of the cul-de-sac entrance.

Nurmof stocks all pickaxes from bronze up to normal rune, except for black.

label: Nurse Sarah
title: Nurse Sarah
lead:
Nurse Sarah is a nurse running the medical clinic in West Ardougne, and she's the only medical professional in the city. She is involved in the Biohazard quest, where the player acquires the medical gown needed to access the mourners' hideout in the cupboard in the northern part of her house.

She may also be involved in Song of the Elves, where the player, disguised as a mourner, claims that all medical practitioners must undergo more training to deal with the "plague", which increases the public's hostility towards King Lathas.

label: Oak logs
title: Oak logs
lead:
Oak logs are logs obtained from cutting oak trees at level 15 Woodcutting and give 37.5 experience points each. Players can burn these logs using the Firemaking skill at level 15 for 60 experience each. Members can also fletch these logs.

Members training Construction can bring oak logs to a sawmill to make oak planks at a cost of 250 coins each. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes. The use of oak planks in Construction increased the price of oak logs.

label: Oak longbow
title: Oak longbow
lead:
An oak longbow is a longbow made from oak. It can be made at level 25 Fletching by using a knife on oak logs to cut them into an oak longbow (u), granting 25 experience, and then using a bowstring on the unstrung bow, granting another 25 experience. It requires level 5 Ranged to wield and can fire arrows up to and including steel.

It has identical stats to the oak shortbow, but fires at a slower speed.

label: Oak longbow (u)
title: Oak longbow (u)
lead: An Oak longbow (u) is made using a knife with oak logs, requiring level 25 Fletching and yielding 25 Fletching experience. Stringing an oak longbow (u) with a bowstring makes an oak longbow, also requiring 25 Fletching and yielding an additional 25 experience.

label: Oak shortbow
title: Oak shortbow
lead:
The oak shortbow is a shortbow stronger than the standard shortbow that can use arrows up to steel. It requires a Ranged level of 5 or higher to wield.

Oak shortbows can be made at level 20 Fletching by using a knife on oak logs to cut them into an oak shortbow (u), granting 16.5 Fletching experience. Then, the player must string the unstrung oak shortbow with a bow string, granting another 16.5 experience.

label: Oak shortbow (u)
title: Oak shortbow (u)
lead: An oak shortbow (u) is made using a knife with oak logs, requiring 20 Fletching and yielding 16.5 Fletching experience. Stringing an oak shortbow (u) with a bowstring makes an oak shortbow, also requiring 20 Fletching and yielding an additional 16.5 Fletching experience.

label: oak tree
title: oak tree
lead: An oak tree is a lumber tree requiring level 15 Woodcutting to cut, granting 37.5 experience for each set of oak logs received. It is the lowest level tree capable of providing more than one log from each tree. Oak trees are commonly cut to train Woodcutting after normal trees.

label: Oak tree (Tutorial Island)
title: Oak tree (Tutorial Island)
lead:
Oak trees are a type of scenery found on Tutorial Island that are distinct from regular oak trees. The appearance of these oak trees is slightly darker than the oak trees found on the mainland.

Because skills can only be trained to level 3 while on Tutorial Island and chopping oaks has a Woodcutting requirement of 15, the oak trees found on the island are impossible to cut. Attempting to do so will print the message: You won't be able to chop oak trees until you have a Woodcutting level of 15. You'll advance to higher Woodcutting levels by chopping down normal trees. At higher Woodcutting levels you will find even more trees you can cut.

label: Obelisk of Air
title: Obelisk of Air

label: Obelisk of Earth
title: Obelisk of Earth
lead:
The Obelisk of Earth (aka Earth Obelisk) is used to cast the Charge Earth Orb spell at level 60 Magic. The spell is cast on the obelisk in order to charge an Unpowered orb into an Earth orb. The Obelisk is located in the Wilderness area of Edgeville Dungeon, south of the Black demons in the area where Chronozon is found. In order to avoid taking damage from Chronozon while casting the spell, stand on the south side of the obelisk.

When using this obelisk it is recommended to have a method of curing poison in your bank as the poison spiders can poison you even if you have Protect from Melee prayer on. If you are low combat level and afraid that the poison may kill you, you can bring a method of curing poison with you at the price of having fewer orbs in your inventory. Alternatively, an Antipoison potion that grants immunity can be sipped at the bank right before you head to the obelisk as well. For instance, an Antidote++ dose will grant 12 minutes of immunity, which is roughly 3-4 trips.

label: Obelisk of Fire
title: Obelisk of Fire
lead: The Obelisk of Fire (referred to as fire obelisk in the standard spellbook) is used to cast the Charge Fire Orb spell; the spell must be cast on the obelisk, not on an orb. It is used for enchanting an unpowered orb into a fire orb, requiring level 63 Magic, granting 73 Magic experience. The obelisk is located at the end of Taverley Dungeon, west of the black dragons.

label: Obelisk of Water
title: Obelisk of Water
lead:

The Obelisk of Water (referred to as water obelisk in the standard spellbook) is used to cast the Charge Water Orb spell; the spell must be cast on the obelisk, not on an orb. It is used for enchanting an unpowered orb into a water orb, requiring level 56 Magic, granting 66 Magic experience. The obelisk is located on the island across from the shore of Catherby, reached by climbing a ladder at the end of Taverley Dungeon by the black dragons.

label: Obli
title: Obli
lead: Obli runs Obli's General Store in Shilo Village. His shop does not have the normal stock of a general store, but rather has the same items available for purchase as Jiminua's Jungle Store in Tai Bwo Wannai. The price of items in the store change if the player wears Karamja gloves.

label: Obli's General Store.
title: Obli's General Store.
lead:
Obli's General Store is a general store run by Obli in Shilo Village on Karamja. This general store has the largest stock of general stores with items varying from Machetes to Candles, and Charcoal to Spades.

Unlike other general stores on the island of Karamja, Obli offers better prices with Karamja Gloves 1 instead of needing Karamja Gloves 3.

label: Observatory
title: Observatory
lead: The Observatory is a complex mostly used during the Observatory Quest. It consists of four parts. The area was overrun by goblins, who have damaged the telescope, and players must fix it during the quest. The original bridge to the Observatory has been destroyed, so you must go underground at the ruined buildings and through the Observatory Dungeon to get to it. Alternatively, players who have completed the Observatory Quest can use the grapple shortcut with 23 Agility, 24 Ranged, and 28 Strength. It should be noted that players who use this shortcut forfeit their mith grapple, but in doing so create a permanent shortcut.

label: Observatory Dungeon
title: Observatory Dungeon
lead: The Observatory Dungeon leads from the Goblin settlement found north-east of the Observatory, to the Observatory. The dungeon is a giant maze, infested with low-levelled goblins and a few high-levelled goblin guards.

label: Observatory Quest
title: Observatory Quest
lead: The Observatory Quest is a quest where you must help the professor of the observatory repair the structure and restore it to its former glory.

label: Observatory assistant
title: Observatory assistant
lead:
Patrick, the Observatory assistant, can be found in the reception building just north of the Observatory.

He and Professor Gronigen do not get along, but Patrick meekly follows along with the Professor's demands. If you talk to Patrick after completing the Observatory Quest, he will thank you and hand you a Jug of wine. Additionally, he will tell you Scorpius would be proud, at which your character is confused. He tells you to look at a book or "Check out old graveyards" referring to where you can find Scorpius.

label: Observatory lens
title: Observatory lens
lead: The observatory lens is a quest item made and used during the Observatory Quest. During the quest, a lens mould and a piece of molten glass must be given to the professor in the Observatory. The professor will then attempt to craft the lens but be unable to do so. He will then return the mould and glass to the player and request it be crafted. Once made, the lens should be given to the professor so that the telescope can be repaired.

label: Observatory professor
title: Observatory professor
lead: Professor Mambo-duna-roona Gronigen (labelled as Observatory professor) is a scholar found in the Observatory reception (north of Castle Wars). He is the main NPC for the Observatory Quest. After the quest, he is found in the observatory itself. He and his assistant often bicker. In Recipe for Disaster, he is referred to as Professor Gronigen during the short quiz for the Enchanted egg and also in the update in which Observatory Quest was released.

label: Obstacle net (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
title: Obstacle net (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
lead: The obstacle net is an Agility obstacle found within the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. Passing the obstacle requires 35 Agility and will award 8.2 Agility experience.

label: Obstacle net (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
title: Obstacle net (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
lead: The Obstacle net is an Agility obstacle found within the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. An Agility level of one is required to pass the obstacle, which will then grant the player 10 Agility experience. It is not possible to fail this obstacle.

label: Obstacle pipe (Barbarian Outpost)
title: Obstacle pipe (Barbarian Outpost)
lead:
The Obstacle pipe is an Agility shortcut that connects the Barbarian Outpost to the agility course. Passing through the pipe awards the player 10 Agility experience.

Clicking the pipe without moving the camera is an Idle training method and can gain you up to 10,000xp per hour.

label: Obstacle pipe (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
title: Obstacle pipe (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
lead: The obstacle pipe is the final Agility obstacle on the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. It requires 1 Agility to pass which grants 10 Agility experience. It is not possible to fail this obstacle.

label: Obstacle pipe (Wilderness Agility Course)
title: Obstacle pipe (Wilderness Agility Course)
lead: The obstacle pipe is an Agility obstacle found within the Wilderness Agility Course. An Agility level of 49 is required to pass the obstacle, which will then grant the player 12.5 Agility experience.

label: Obstacle pipe (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
title: Obstacle pipe (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
lead: An obstacle pipe is an Agility shortcut. It is the second obstacle in the Yanille Agility Dungeon, and traversing it leads to a group of skeletons. Failing the pipe obstacle will cause the player to take damage, and become stuck for a short time.

label: Ocga
title: Ocga
lead: Ocga is an attackable citizen of Burthorpe with many dialogues when spoken to, often welcoming the player. He may also speak about the Burthorpe Imperial Guard, White Knights, and Trolls, who unfortunately took his baby son.

label: Odd batta
title: Odd batta
lead:
An odd batta was previously obtained during Gnome cooking. If a player added incorrect ingredients to a Half baked batta, they would receive this item.

As the cooking process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added via the reworked interface, which eliminated the possibility of any mistakes by the player. As a result, the odd batta was discontinued.

label: Odd cocktail
title: Odd cocktail
lead: An odd cocktail was the result of a player error when making a gnome cocktail. An update in 2006 eliminated this with an improved cocktail interface; as a result, it has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape. The odd cocktail healed some health, increased Strength, but reduced Attack, making it similar to certain beers.

label: Odd crunchies
title: Odd crunchies
lead:
Odd crunchies were previously obtained during Gnome cooking. If a player added incorrect ingredients to a Half baked crunchy, they would receive this item.

As the cooking process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added via the reworked interface, which eliminated the possibility of any mistakes by the player. As a result, the odd crunchies were discontinued.

label: Odd gnomebowl
title: Odd gnomebowl
lead:
An odd gnomebowl was previously obtained during Gnome cooking. If a player added incorrect ingredients to a Half baked bowl, they would receive this item.

As the cooking process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added via the reworked interface, which eliminated the possibility of any mistakes by the player. As a result, the odd gnomebowl was discontinued.
