label: Odd looking wall
title: Odd looking wall
lead: The Odd looking wall is the entrance to the Elemental Workshop dungeon. You need a battered key to open it, which can be found in the battered book that starts the elemental workshop quest series.

label: Odd looking wall (Edgeville Dungeon)
title: Odd looking wall (Edgeville Dungeon)
lead:
The odd looking wall is a piece of interactive scenery found in the Edgeville Dungeon, north west of the Edgeville entrance.

Pushing the wall gives access to a room containing some coin spawns, two giant rats level 3 and 6, as well as some chests, crates and barrels.

label: Odd markings (Underground Pass)
title: Odd markings (Underground Pass)
lead: The odd markings are a trap found within the Underground Pass dungeon. Players must first search the odd markings to disarm the trap before safely passing through it. It is possible to fail disarming the trap, accidentally triggering it, which can damage 3 to 14 Hitpoints. Passing through the trap without disarming first will damage the player based on a percentage of their current health.

label: Og
title: Og
lead: Og is an ogre encountered during the Watchtower quest. During the quest he sends you to get his gold that the ogre chieftain Toban took from him. Surprisingly, Og seems to be one of the few ogres that can speak the common language rather fluently. He can be located north-west of Yanille within debris remains along with other ogres. After the quest, he cannot be spoken to.

label: ogre
title: ogre
lead:
Ogres are a monster found throughout Gielinor, most notably the ogre city of Gu'Tanoth.

The best place to kill ogres for Slayer is directly west of Yanille, near where Og is situated and the small island, although the location may be crowded with cannon users that can make training there inhospitable; if that's the case, it is possible to kill the ogres camping in the ruins immediately to the north, behind a line of trees, as those are not affected by the cannon.

label: ogre arrow
title: ogre arrow
lead:
Ogre arrows are used for hunting large game birds such as Chompy birds and Jubbly birds. These arrows can only be fired from ogre bows or composite ogre bows. Ogre arrows are required in Big Chompy Bird Hunting and the Freeing Skrach Uglogwee sub-quest of Recipe for Disaster.

They can be created through the Fletching skill at level 5, by using wolfbone arrowtips on flighted ogre arrows. 6 arrows can be made at a time with 1.0 Fletching experience granted per arrow made.

label: Ogre arrow shaft
title: Ogre arrow shaft
lead: Ogre arrow shafts are components used in making ogre arrows and brutal arrows. They require level 5 Fletching and starting the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting to make. They are made by cutting an Achey tree and using a knife on the Achey tree logs. The amount of shafts given is random; between two and six will be made. 1.6 Fletching experience is gained per shaft made. Adding 4 feathers to each shaft makes flighted ogre arrows.

label: Ogre bellows
title: Ogre bellows
lead:
Ogre bellows are obtained by "unlocking" the Locked Ogre chest (i.e. pushing a boulder off from on top of it) in the north-west part of the cave near Rantz (not on worldmap) in eastern Feldip Hills where the ogre Rantz and his son and daughter live, directly north from the quest start icon where Big Chompy Bird Hunting is started (fairy ring code is nearby). Multiple ogre bellows can be taken from Rantz's chest.

This item is also needed for obtaining various Chompy bird hats, a section of the quest Recipe for Disaster, Mourning's End Part I and the western provinces diary.

label: Ogre bench
title: Ogre bench
lead: Five Ogre benches are located in Rantz's cave, which is inhabitted by Rantz's children, Bugs and Fycie. The cave is part of the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest.

label: Ogre bow
title: Ogre bow
lead:
The ogre bow is a weapon requiring 30 Ranged to wield. Along with the comp ogre bow, it is used to kill chompies. The bow cannot be fletched, and it can fire ogre arrows as well as brutal arrows up to mithril brutals.

The ogre bow is obtained from Rantz during the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. If the bow is lost, another can be purchased from him for an amount which changes each time, but is in the range of 500-550 coins. The bow is also required for Freeing Skrach Uglogwee in the Recipe for Disaster quest.

label: Ogre chieftain
title: Ogre chieftain
lead:
Ogre chieftains are ogres that can be found in the Feldip Hills and inside the Ogre Enclave. Players can kill ogre chieftains towards an ogre Slayer task.

Due to their lacklustre drops and being more difficult to kill compared to standard ogres, players usually avoid killing them.

label: Ogre Enclave
title: Ogre Enclave
lead:
The Ogre Enclave, located south-west of Yanille and accessed via the cave in the market of Gu'Tanoth, is one of several locations containing Blue dragons, and is visited during the Watchtower Quest.

In the centre of the cave is the Rock of Dalgroth, which you can mine during the Watchtower Quest for the grey crystal.

label: Ogre guard
title: Ogre guard
lead:
Ogre guards can be found all over Gu'Tanoth. To gain access to the ogre city, you must present the Ogre relic to a guard.

In the city, the Ogre Guards will ask you to bring them something like a gold bar or, from the market (a rock cake). If you haven't got it the second time you meet them, they punch you down the hill and you will lose a varied amount of Hitpoints.

label: Ogre merchant
title: Ogre merchant
lead: Grud, named Ogre merchant in game, is an inhabitant of the ogre city of Gu'Tanoth. He owns Grud's Herblore Stall in Gu'Tanoth, which sells various Herblore items. The Watchtower quest is required to get to him.

label: Ogre relic
title: Ogre relic
lead:
An ogre relic is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest. During the quest, it is given as a gift to the ogre guards, who stand at the gates of Gu'Tanoth. In return, they grant the player permanent access to the city. It should also be noted from a lore point of view that upon gifting the relic to the guards, they recognise it as a statue of the ogre warrior, Dalgroth.

The player can make the ogre relic by giving the three individual pieces to the Watchtower Wizard and having him combine them, each of which is obtained by performing tasks for ogres who live in and around Gu'Tanoth. Attempting to use the pieces on each other in order to combine the pieces will only result with the game message, "The pieces look like they would fit together, but you can't work out how to do it. Maybe someone with more experience of ogres could help."

label: Ogre spit-roast
title: Ogre spit-roast
lead: Two ogre spit-roasts are located in Feldip Hills where most ogres live. There is one at the entrance of Jiggig and another north of Rantz. Ogre spit-roasts can be used to cook raw chompy, raw jubbly or raw chicken. Any other types of food cannot be cooked on the spit-roast, simply giving Nothing interesting happens.. The "Cook-X" interface is not available when cooking here, so the individual birds need to be used on the spit-roast manually. They are the only place where raw jubbly can be cooked for the Recipe for Disaster subquest, Freeing Skrach Uglogwee.

label: Ogre tooth
title: Ogre tooth
lead:
The ogre tooth is obtained from the corpse of Gorad when he is killed by the player during the Watchtower quest.

The player must then bring the tooth to Grew, as proof that his request for Gorad's death was fulfilled.

label: Ogre trader
title: Ogre trader
lead:
Ogre traders are traders located in Gu'Tanoth. There are 3 ogre traders which can be found in Gu'Tanoth, the ogre city south-west of Yanille.

The only ogre traders that will trade with the players are Dal, the general store owner, and Grud, the ogre merchant. The other two traders will not trade with the player, saying things like "Trade with me? Who do you think you are?" and will attack the player.

label: Ogre trader (Dal)
title: Ogre trader (Dal)
lead: Dal, named Ogre trader in game, is one of three ogre traders within Gu'Tanoth. He is one of two ogre traders that do not attack if asked to trade by humans, the other being Grud. He sells basic supplies seen in most general stores.

label: Oh Dear!
title: Oh Dear!
lead: Oh Dear! is a Jingle that plays during the Ceril side of Hazeel Cult, when the player returns the Carnillean armour to Ceril Carnillean and a fake "quest complete" interface appears.

label: Oil can
title: Oil can
lead:
The oil can is a quest item used only in Ernest the Chicken. It is found in the basement of Draynor Manor at the end of a maze puzzle.

It is one of three items needed to repair Professor Oddenstein's machine along with a pressure gauge and a rubber tube, so he can turn Ernest back into a human. Duplicates can be obtained after the quest, but it serves no further use.

label: Oily cloth
title: Oily cloth
lead:
Oily cloth can be obtained by searching the abandoned equipment next to the fire in the Underground Pass.

It is used to wrap around any standard arrows, which, in turn, can then be lit on fire to become fire arrows. This is only necessary during the Underground Pass quest, however, all types of fire arrows can be made with the oily cloth and used outside the quest, although they do not give extra benefits.

label: Oily fishing rod
title: Oily fishing rod
lead:
The oily fishing rod is a unique fishing rod made during the Heroes' Quest by using blamish oil with a normal fishing rod. However, players do not need to have started the quest to make this item. An oily fishing rod can be used with fishing bait to catch raw lava eels and infernal eels, which is required during the Heroes' Quest itself, as well as the Hard Wilderness Diary.

The equipable version of the fishing rod, the oily pearl fishing rod, can be made by using blamish oil on the pearl fishing rod (bought with molch pearls from Alry the Angler).

label: Old boot
title: Old boot
lead: An old boot is an untradeable, useless item. It cannot be worn, nor can it be used with another old boot or any other item.

label: Old journal
title: Old journal
lead:
The old journal, or The Journal of Randas, is found during the Underground Pass quest near the first well. It is written by the adventurer Randas and tells of the creation of the Orbs of Light that the player has to destroy to get farther inside.

After finding the book, it can be found on the shelves in the player's house. It can also be found on one of the bookshelves in the Grand Library after Song of the Elves.

label: Old robe
title: Old robe
lead:
Old robe is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest and it can be found after the quest's completion. The player can find it by searching the bushes surrounding the Watchtower outside the north wall of Yanille.

This item serves no purpose and is most likely there as a red herring. It cannot be worn.

label: Old sacks
title: Old sacks
lead: The old sacks in Ah Za Rhoon can be searched during the Shilo Village quest to find a crumpled scroll. After the quest, they don't contain anything and searching them will produce the chat message, "You notice nothing significant about this.".

label: Old tooth
title: Old tooth
lead: An old tooth can be found while digging at the digsite using a trowel, obtained from the Varrock Museum or an Examiner, on the digging area west of the animal skull or panning in the panning area with a panning tray. When shown to Terry Balando, he says "Oh, an old tooth. It looks like it has come from a mighty being. Pity there are no tooth fairies around here!" There are currently no uses for the old tooth. It is considered a useless item because it can't be traded, gives no coins when alchemised, and can't be used in any way.

label: Old wall
title: Old wall
lead: An Old wall is located in the Taverley Dungeon. It is the entrance to a small room in the dungeon, which contains the first scorpion in the Scorpion Catcher quest.

label: Omart
title: Omart
lead:
Omart is an NPC encountered during the Biohazard quest. He helps you to cross the wall between West and East Ardougne. He can be found on the south end of the wall.

In the Song of the Elves, he is part of the Resistance and he and Kilron suggest riling up citizens by announcing that all doctors and nurses have to retrain.

label: onion
title: onion
lead:
Onions are a food item that can be picked from fields around Gielinor or grown through the Farming skill at level 5 with onion seeds. They heal 1 hitpoint when eaten. When eaten, the message You eat the onion. is displayed. If eaten at full health, a message will appear saying, It's always sad to see a grown [man/woman/person] cry.. If eaten below full health, the message It makes your eyes water, but it does heal some health. is displayed instead. When picking onions from fields, members may randomly receive 1 onion seed.

They are used in the following recipes:
* Mushroom potato
* Ugthanki kebab
* Vegetable batta, veg ball, worm hole (Gnome cooking)
* Garden pie (temporarily boosts Farming level by 3)

label: Onion (scenery)
title: Onion (scenery)
lead: Onion plants are scenery that can be picked to obtain onions. On members worlds, rarely an onion seed is awarded in place of an onion. Onions picked up in a field will respawn after 50 ticks (30 seconds). Unlike onions picked from a Farming allotment, picking onions from fields provides no experience.

label: Onion & tomato
title: Onion & tomato
lead: Onion & tomato is a type of food that restores 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by using chopped onion with a tomato or using chopped tomato with an onion. Creating Onion & tomato is one of multiple steps needed to create the ugthanki kebab which requires level 58 Cooking and restores 19 Hitpoints.

label: oomlie bird
title: oomlie bird
lead:
Oomlie birds are found within the Kharazi Jungle. Like tormented warriors, these enormous version of chickens are not aggressive (however using the bullroarer near them will cause them to attack you with the message "A nearby Oomlie bird takes a dislike to the sound you are making" appearing in your chatbox). They can be killed for their oomlie meat, the main ingredient of oomlie wraps. To create one, the player needs the raw oomlie and a palm leaf found in the surroundings by shaking leafy palm trees.

The Legends' Quest needs to be started in order to kill this monster. However, it can be ranged and then the Telekinetic Grab spell can be used to get the meat before starting Legends Quest.

label: Opal
title: Opal
lead:
Opals are semi-precious gems used mainly in Crafting. They can be cut from uncut opals with a chisel, yielding 15 experience. There is a chance to unsuccessfully cut the opal, resulting in a crushed gem and 3.8 experience.

Opals are the lowest level gemstone.

label: Opal bolt tips
title: Opal bolt tips
lead:
Opal bolt tips are created by using a chisel on a cut opal with 11 Fletching, yielding 1.5 Fletching experience and 12 opal bolt tips.

They are made into opal bolts when used with bronze bolts, requiring 11 Fletching, yielding 16 Fletching experience per 10 bolts. They can also be made into opal dragon bolts, requiring 84 Fletching, yielding 16 Fletching experience per 10 bolts. Both of these can then be enchanted into opal bolts (e) and opal dragon bolts (e) respectively.

label: Opal bolts
title: Opal bolts
lead:
Opal bolts are bronze bolts tipped with opal bolt tips. Opal bolts can be created through the Fletching skill for players of level 11 or above. Use a chisel on a cut opal to make 12 opal bolt tips. Attaching opal bolt tips also requires a Fletching level of 11, and for each opal bolt tip attached to a bronze bolt, a player is granted 1.6 Fletching experience. Once the opal bolt tips have been attached, the bronze bolts become opal bolts.

Opal bolts can be enchanted through the spell Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Opal) by a player with level 4 Magic. The spell enchants 10 opal bolts at a time, and once they are enchanted they become enchanted opal bolts and gain a special ability.

label: Oracle
title: Oracle
lead:
The Oracle is a strange woman who lives atop Ice Mountain. She is an important figure in the Dragon Slayer I quest, as she provides a clue as to how to access one of the map pieces. Occasionally, she will be visited by Postie Pete. One of the Wise Old Man's tasks involves taking a message to her.

To reach the Oracle, use the Ice Mountain pathway just below Edgeville Monastery.

label: orange
title: orange
lead: An orange is a fruit that can be grown as part of the Farming skill. Oranges are used in several gnome cooking recipes, and can be used with a knife to create orange slices or orange chunks. You can give a basket of oranges to a farmer as payment to protect a maple tree (farming). It heals 2 hitpoints regardless of the state the orange is in (whole, sliced or chunks). Oranges can be added to a compost bin to make regular compost. 3 spawns are present on an inaccessible island populated by pygmy hippos east of Kastori, the northernmost spawn can be Telegrabbed from the western coast of the Avium Savannah.

label: Orange cape
title: Orange cape
lead: An orange cape is made by using orange dye on another coloured cape.

label: orange chunks
title: orange chunks
lead:
Orange chunks are used in gnome cooking. You can obtain them by using a knife on an orange and selecting the "Dice" option.

Orange chunks are used when making a fruit batta. They are added to a half baked batta along with 4 equa leaves, 1 lime chunks and 1 pineapple chunks to create an unfinished batta (fruit).

label: Orange door
title: Orange door
lead: The Orange doors are located on the of Melzar's Maze. They must be opened during Dragon Slayer I, using an orange key obtained from killing the nearby Ghost with a hood, and no cape.

label: orange dye
title: orange dye
lead: Orange dye is a dye made by combining red dye and yellow dye. Its main use is in the quest Goblin Diplomacy, when the player must use the dye on goblin mail. This item can also be bought from the Lletya Seamstress for 6 coins. In order to access the shop, one must have at least started the Mourning's End Part I quest. Players can also obtain red and yellow dye from Aggie in Draynor Village provided she is given the ingredients needed and 5 coins per bottle of dye. Players can then combine the red and yellow dye to make orange dye.

label: Orange flowers
title: Orange flowers
lead:
Orange flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Orange goblin mail
title: Orange goblin mail
lead:
Orange goblin mail is made by using orange dye on a goblin mail. Like all goblins mail, it is too small for players to normally wear as armour.

It is used during the Goblin Diplomacy quest, along with a blue and un-dyed goblin mail with Generals Bentnoze and Wartface fighting over what colour they prefer.

label: orange slices
title: orange slices
lead:
Orange slices are a food item that players can obtain by using a knife on an orange. Eating orange slices will heal 2 hitpoints. Orange slices are needed in the Goblin part of Recipe for Disaster.

Orange slices are used in gnome cooking as an ingredient in a pineapple punch cocktail. They are used in the final step of creating the drink, and must be in the inventory along with 1 lime chunks and 1 pineapple chunks to pour a mixed punch into a cocktail glass.

label: Orb of light
title: Orb of light
lead:
An orb of light, also known as a Sphere of Light, is a magical orb used in Underground Pass quest. The player destroys four of these orbs in the furnace found in the dungeon in order to progress into the next part (note: one cannot destroy the orbs in another furnace outside the underground pass). Destroying an orb yields the message, You feel a cold shudder run down your spine as the light of the orb fades.

According to the old journal, they were placed in the Underground Pass by the warrior, Randas, in a failed attempt to ward off the darkness prior to the player's involvement.

label: Orb of light (scenery)
title: Orb of light (scenery)
lead:
Orb of light is scenery found in the Underground Pass that is used to provide item spawns of four orbs of light during the quest. The orb has the appearance of a regular item, including the colour of the name and red dot on the minimap. After an orb has been destroyed by using it on the furnace, the spawn will no longer be visible.

When Underground Pass was first added to RuneScape 2 in 2004, the northern three orb spawns used actual item spawns. The southernmost spawn instead used this scenery object to handle the special behaviour with the log trap that must be disarmed, with an invisible dead orb item spawn placed at the same position to make a red dot appear on the minimap. After a bug was discovered in 2017 that caused the dead orb to be picked up , the dead orb was removed and the red dot was changed to instead be a map icon on the orb of light scenery. With the release of Song of the Elves in 2019, the northern three orb spawns were also replaced with the scenery object and are no longer visible after destroying the orbs.

label: Orb of protection
title: Orb of protection
lead:
The orb of protection is a quest item that the player must recover during the Tree Gnome Village. At the start of the quest the orb has been stolen by Khazard troops and this one is currently being held in the Khazard stronghold north-east of the Tree Gnome Village.

To recover this orb the player must break a hole in the stronghold's defences using a nearby ballista, climb in and either kill the Khazard commander or loot the chest upstairs.

label: Orbs of protection
title: Orbs of protection
lead:
The orbs of protection are a quest item that players must recover during the Tree Gnome Village quest. They are stolen by a Khazard warlord during the quest and the player must find and defeat him in order to reclaim the orbs.

Once the orbs have been recovered the player must return them to King Bolren in the centre of the Tree Gnome Village maze.

label: Order of Wizards
title: Order of Wizards
lead:
The Order of Wizards is a Saradominist organisation specialising in magic and runecraft, headquartered in the Wizards' Tower. Archmage Sedridor, the chief of research at the Tower, currently leads the Order.

The Order of Wizards was founded at the start of the Fifth Age, following the rediscovery of runecrafting. Initially, the Order was welcoming of all researching wizards, regardless of their religion or race, though it has been claimed that Zamorakian wizards were barred from certain research topics.

label: Oriental
title: Oriental
lead: Oriental is a music track that is unlocked in the top floor of the temple of Ah Za Rhoon, east of Shilo Village.

label: Osman
title: Osman
lead:
Osman is the spymaster of Al Kharid and can be found just outside the palace. He plays a significant role in the quests Prince Ali Rescue and Contact!. He also makes an appearance in the first cutscene in the Recipe for Disaster quest. He is very skilled at espionage and subterfuge and politically very astute. Additionally, Osman has shown himself capable of holding his own in combat against dangerous creatures, armed with a scimitar.

Replacement Keris daggers can be bought from him for 20,000 coins after finishing Contact!, if the one initially picked up at the end of the quest be lost. If the dagger was never claimed during the quest in the first place, Osman will supply it free of charge. He also rewards players with Thieving experience in exchange for Sq'irk juice, which players can obtain in the Sorceress's Garden minigame. In order to start the minigame, one is required to first speak to Osman about it.

label: Othainian
title: Othainian
lead:
Othainian is a demon encountered during the Underground Pass quest. When killed, it drops the amulet of othanian, which is needed to obtain Iban's shadow. Protect from Melee should be used during this part of the quest to save hitpoints for coping with its attacks.

It is possible to use the small bridges connecting the platforms as a safespot to attack using Ranged, Magic, or with a halberd. In the quest, the player must also kill the other demons, Holthion and Doomion.

label: Otherworldly being
title: Otherworldly being
lead:
Otherworldly beings are unusual Zanarian monsters. They are commonly assigned as Slayer tasks by Vannaka. They are found south of the bank in Zanaris and can be safespotted by standing next to the flower pond and attacking the ones on the other side, however they move around quite a lot and players may find them difficult to safespot. An alternate and more consistent safespotting method is standing on the north or south of the pond and corner trapping the mobs on the pond corners.

More specifically, five of the six otherworldly beings have a wander radius which permits safespotting without having them retreat as long as the player stands right next to the pond. One of these five will retreat if attacked horizontally across the pond, and another will retreat when attacked vertically. The other three will not retreat as long as you stay next to the pond.

label: Overhanging rock
title: Overhanging rock
lead: Overhanging rocks are along the Baxtorian Falls near the start of the River Dougne.

label: Overture
title: Overture
lead: Overture is a music track that is unlocked in Seers' Village.

label: Oyster
title: Oyster
lead: An oyster has a chance to contain an oyster pearl or be an empty oyster. They can sometimes be obtained by fishing with a big fishing net (requires 16 Fishing), by drift net fishing, or through panning at the Digsite. They can also be obtained as a drop from various monsters. The pearls found from an oyster can be made into pearl bolt tips at level 41 Fletching by using a chisel on them.

label: Oyster pearl
title: Oyster pearl
lead:
An oyster pearl is a small, round, milky-coloured semi-precious gem obtained by opening oysters. They can also be collected by fishing with a big fishing net, participating in the Fishing Trawler minigame, panning in the river at the Digsite, sorting large salvage, or by killing various monsters.

Players with 41 Fletching can use a chisel on this item to gain 6 pearl bolt tips, which can be attached to iron bolts or dragon bolts to make pearl bolts or pearl dragon bolts.

label: Oyster pearls
title: Oyster pearls
lead: Oyster pearls are a reward from the Sea Slug quest. They can also be dropped by some monsters or obtained through shipwreck salvaging. Players with 41 Fletching can use a chisel on this item to gain 24 pearl bolt tips, which can be attached to iron bolts or dragon bolts to make pearl bolts or pearl dragon bolts.

label: Oziach
title: Oziach
lead:
Oziach is a master smith with ties to the Champions' Guild. He lives just north-west of Edgeville and, during Dragon Slayer I, informs applicants to the Guild where the three map parts to Crandor can be found. Afterwards, he sells rune platebodies, green dragonhide bodies and anti-dragon shields from his shop.

Oziach appears to wear a bulkier version of the rune platebody with alternate colouring. Along with the Hero, he is the only other NPC wearing alternatively coloured Rune armour.

label: Oziach (shop)
title: Oziach (shop)
lead: Oziach is an armour shop located in Edgeville, just south of the Wilderness ditch. The completion of the Dragon Slayer I quest is required to access the shop. Oziach sells rune platebodies, green d'hide bodies, and anti-dragon shields.

label: Paddewwa
title: Paddewwa
lead: Paddewwa was once a fortress of the Zarosian Empire. It was destroyed by Saradomin's forces following the Betrayal of Zaros.

label: Painting (scenery)
title: Painting (scenery)
lead: Paintings are found in many locations, they serve no purpose other than aesthetics.

label: paladin
title: paladin
lead:
Paladins are found in East Ardougne, wandering near the castle and market. Upon completion of the Song of the Elves, paladins will patrol the streets of West Ardougne as well. They are from Ardougne's Holy Order of Paladins, and wear the symbol of Saradomin. Three unique paladin variants – Sir Carl, Sir Harry, and Sir Jerro – are found in the Underground Pass, all of whom must be killed during the quest in order to obtain their badges.

Players can pickpocket paladins at level 70 Thieving to gain 131.8 experience, 80 coins and 2 chaos runes.

label: Paladin's badge (Sir Carl)
title: Paladin's badge (Sir Carl)
lead: Paladin's badge is a green coloured coat of arms held by Sir Carl in the dungeon west of West Ardougne. During the Underground Pass quest the player must kill the three paladins, Sir Carl, Sir Harry and Sir Jerro, in order to obtain their badges and then throw the badges and a unicorn horn down a well in order to progress to the next part of the dungeon.

label: Paladin's badge (Sir Harry)
title: Paladin's badge (Sir Harry)
lead: Paladin's badge is a red coloured coat of arms held by Sir Harry in the dungeon west of West Ardougne. During the Underground Pass quest the player must kill the three paladins, Sir Carl, Sir Harry and Sir Jerro, in order to obtain their badges and then throw the badges and a unicorn horn down a well in order to progress to the next part of the dungeon.

label: Paladin's badge (Sir Jerro)
title: Paladin's badge (Sir Jerro)
lead: Paladin's badge is a blue coloured coat of arms held by Sir Jerro in the dungeon west of West Ardougne. During the Underground Pass quest the player must kill the three paladins, Sir Carl, Sir Harry and Sir Jerro, in order to obtain their badges and then throw the badges and a unicorn horn down a well in order to progress to the next part of the dungeon.

label: Palm leaf
title: Palm leaf
lead:
Palm leaves may be obtained by 'shaking' the leafy palm trees located around the small pool of water in the middle of the Kharazi Jungle or on Remote Island. This is a primary ingredient in the oomlie wrap made for the Karamja Hard Diary, as they protect the delicate meat of the oomlie bird from burning. This item is also used during Troubled Tortugans to craft makeshift bandages.

There is a hard Karamja Diary task to collect five palm leaves, though one can drop and pick up the same leaf multiple times to complete the task.

label: Palm leaf (unobtainable item)
title: Palm leaf (unobtainable item)
lead:
A Palm leaf is an unobtainable version of the Palm leaf. Palm leaves could previously be traded and turned into bank notes; however, they were made untradeable in 2007 due to frequent use in scams. Any player who had a noted palm leaf was given this now discontinued item. It is identical to the real leaf, except it is stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Palm tree (Ardrigal)
title: Palm tree (Ardrigal)
lead:
Palm tree is a scenery object found growing north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai near the harpie bug swarms. The palm tree is searchable in order to obtain a grimy ardrigal. The ardrigal has uses during Jungle Potion and Legends' Quest.

After picking, the palm tree is searchable again after 60 seconds.

label: Palm tree (Shilo Village)
title: Palm tree (Shilo Village)
lead: Palm trees are scenery objects that can be found north-west of the Ship Yard on Karamja. Players must search a tree during the Shilo Village quest in order for a set of doors used to enter Rashiliyia's Tomb to appear.

label: Panning guide
title: Panning guide
lead: The Panning guide can be found in the south-east section of the Digsite, near the River Salve. He helps teach players how to pan for gold nuggets during The Dig Site quest.

label: Panning point
title: Panning point
lead:
A Panning point is a location found at the Digsite where players can pan for nuggets, uncut opal, uncut jade, oysters or coins. It also plays a role in The Dig Site quest, where the panning point is used to find a special cup in the river for one of the students.

Panning at these points will fill the panning tray with mud, which must then be inspected to obtain the item rewards.

label: Panning tray
title: Panning tray
lead:
The panning tray is a quest item used during The Dig Site quest to retrieve a special cup. One spawns in the tent near the south-eastern short of the Digsite east of Varrock.

To use it, the panning guide must be bribed with a cup of tea. This can be done before the quest is started.

label: Panning tray (unobtainable item)
title: Panning tray (unobtainable item)
lead:
The panning tray is an unobtainable item that is used during The Dig Site. In the quest, the player is required to use the panning tray to retrieve a special cup. There is a chance of finding gold nuggets when searching the panning tray, causing this item to appear in the chatbox. The actual panning tray full of gold cannot be obtained by the player however.

In RuneScape Classic, the item could be obtained after searching the muddy panning tray. It is unknown what happened to these items on the transition to RuneScape 2.

label: Papyrus
title: Papyrus
lead:
Papyrus is an item used in building various furniture in a player-owned house. Additionally, after completing Enlightened Journey, using a ball of wool and unlit candle on a papyrus results in an origami balloon.

Papyrus is notably required for the following quests:
*Darkness of Hallowvale (given during quest)
*Three for Enlightened Journey
*At least three for Legends' Quest to map the Kharazi Jungle
*One for The Golem quest to write him a new program
*Zogre Flesh Eaters (given during quest)
*Shilo Village
*While Guthix Sleeps

label: Papyrus (unobtainable item)
title: Papyrus (unobtainable item)
lead:
Used papyrus is an unobtainable item that was released during the RuneScape 2 beta. It is a version of papyrus that has been used to write something using charcoal. Presumably, it was intended to be used during Shilo Village, which had been slightly reworked during the transition to RuneScape 2. However, for unknown reasons the used papyrus was never added to the game.

If the player loses the Bervirius notes at any point during the quest, they must recreate them using both Papyrus and Charcoal. It is possible therefore that the used papyrus would have either been a product of this action, or merely appear as a chatbox message similar to the Locating crystal.

label: Parade
title: Parade
lead:
Parade is a music track that is unlocked at Silvarea and the Paterdomus Temple.

In Classic mode, it unlocks in a more limited area around the Silvarea Limestone Mine.

label: Paramaya Inn
title: Paramaya Inn
lead:
The Paramaya Inn is an inn in Shilo Village. It is run by Kaleb Paramaya, who used to give players a reward for completing the medium Karamja Diary. Pirate Jackie the Fruit is now solely responsible for that task.

Players can purchase wine for one coin and beer for two coins. Also if players want to, they can purchase a Paramaya ticket for 35 coins and rent a room for the night. On the top floor (the area requiring a Paramaya ticket to enter) are only some beds and cabinets. The Inn was useful during RuneScape Classic, as beds were necessary for players to rest on to restore their Fatigue; however, as fatigue is not present in Old School RuneScape, this area is useless during normal gameplay.

label: Paramaya ticket
title: Paramaya ticket
lead:
A paramaya ticket is a ticket that allows a player to spend the night in the dormitory of the Paramaya Inn. It looks identical to an Archery ticket. Gaining access to the dormitory is a purely aesthetic feature which has no function, as players cannot actually sleep in the beds there.

One ticket may be purchased from Kaleb Paramaya for 35 coins or a pack of five can be bought for 175 coins. This item was made untradeable in an update on 22 January 2007 because of its use in scams.

label: Paramaya ticket (unobtainable item)
title: Paramaya ticket (unobtainable item)
lead:
A Paramaya ticket is an unobtainable version of the Paramaya ticket. Tickets could previously be traded and turned into bank notes; however, they were made untradeable in 2007 due to frequent use in scams. Any player who had a noted Paramaya ticket was given this now discontinued item. It is identical to the real ticket, except it is stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Party Balloon
title: Party Balloon
lead:
Party balloons are interactable decorations most commonly found in the Falador Party Room and Clan Halls. A player can choose to burst a balloon that is on the ground, doing so has a chance of an item from the nearby chest dropping to the ground. A balloon will remain on the ground for 2 minutes before despawning.

In the case of the Falador Party Room, balloons will begin to fall evenly across the room after a player pulls the lever next to the chest, and opts to pay 1000 coins to start a Balloon Bonanza. A similar process exists for the Clan Hall by pulling the lever present in that location.

label: Party Pete
title: Party Pete
lead:
Party Pete is the founder and owner of the Falador Party Room, and the first offspring of the Pete Family. He features in several events, the most notable being the 2017 Birthday event.

Talking to him reveals more information about the Party Room. Additionally, you can purchase Party Pete's Bumper Book of Games. He is one of the few non-player characters to adorn a partyhat.

label: Paste
title: Paste
lead:
Paste is a quest item used in Prince Ali Rescue to disguise Prince Ali so he can escape from Lady Keli's prison.

Aggie can make it from ashes, redberries, flour, and water for free.

label: pastry dough
title: pastry dough
lead:
Pastry dough is used to make pies. It is made from a pot of flour and either a bucket of water, bowl of water, or jug of water. It can then be used on a pie dish to make a pie shell. The pie shell is then used with the filling, which varies according to which pie is to be made.

Pastry dough can also be made as a source of money. By buying or making one pot of flour, and one bucket of water or jug of water, then mixing the ingredients together, selling the dough will give profit.

label: Paterdomus Temple
title: Paterdomus Temple
lead: The Paterdomus Temple is the temple marking Misthalin's eastern border. It acts as the gateway into Morytania, and is located in eastern Silvarea, along the River Salve. The priest Drezel is the owner of the temple, although Monks of Zamorak have taken it over during Priest in Peril quest, trying to take down the Salve's magical barrier.

label: Pearl bolt tips
title: Pearl bolt tips
lead:
Pearl bolt tips are created by using a chisel on an oyster pearl or oyster pearls with 41 Fletching, yielding 3.2 Fletching experience both, but 6 and 24 pearl bolt tips respectively.

They are made into pearl bolts when used with iron bolts, requiring 41 Fletching, yielding 32 Fletching experience per 10 bolts. They can also be made into pearl dragon bolts, requiring 84 Fletching, yielding 32 Fletching experience per 10 bolts. Both of these can then be enchanted into pearl bolts (e) and pearl dragon bolts (e) respectively.

label: Pearl bolts
title: Pearl bolts
lead:
Pearl bolts are iron bolts tipped with pearl bolt tips. Pearl bolts can be created through the Fletching skill by attaching pearl bolt tips to iron bolts. Attaching pearl bolt tips requires 41 Fletching. Once the pearl bolt tips have been attached, the iron bolts become pearl bolts.

Pearl bolts can be enchanted through the spell Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Pearl) with level 24 Magic. The spell enchants 10 bolts at a time. Once they are enchanted they become enchanted pearl bolts and gain a special ability.

label: Peasant
title: Peasant
lead: Peasants are men that serve The Fisher King who rules the Fisher Realm and guards the Holy Grail. They can not be attacked.

label: Pee Hat
title: Pee Hat
lead: Pee Hat is a level 91 troll found on Death Plateau. Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as Stick, Kraka, and Rock, he drops a rune warhammer or granite shield, and as such is commonly hunted by ironmen looking to upgrade their armour.

label: Peksa
title: Peksa
lead: Peksa is a barbarian who owns the Helmet Shop in the Barbarian Village. Players can purchase a variety of helmet from him. He also plays a small part in the Scorpion Catcher quest where he hid a scorpion in his brother Ivor's room.

label: Pelican
title: Pelican
lead: Pelicans are non-interactive birds that are found alongside cormorants. They are found on Fossil Island and south of the Isle of Serpents.

label: Penda
title: Penda
lead: Penda is a citizen in Burthorpe, a bar patron and hangs out more at The Toad and Chicken than his own house.

label: Pendant of lucien
title: Pendant of lucien
lead:
The pendant of lucien is a quest item in the Temple of Ikov quest. Lucien gives the player the pendant immediately after starting the quest. Equipping it allows access to the northern dungeon door in the Temple of Ikov dungeon because it is imbued with Lucien's courage.

If lost it can be reobtained by:
* Talking to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in Ardougne north of the Ardougne Castle.
* Talking to Lucien in his house east of Edgeville, once he has moved there and only if you sided with him.
* Pickpocketing Movario.

label: Penguin (monster)
title: Penguin (monster)
lead: Penguins are low-levelled monsters found on Here Be Penguins, only accessible by using the fairy ring, and also inside an exhibit in the Ardougne Zoo. They have no drops apart from bones, and are therefore rarely killed.

label: Pestle and mortar
title: Pestle and mortar
lead:
The pestle and mortar is a tool used to crush items for use in Herblore and many quests, as well as the Sorceress's Garden minigame.
It can be bought from Herbalists and certain general stores. If used to auto-crush items, it will do so every three game ticks.

label: Pete's candlestick
title: Pete's candlestick
lead: Pete's candlestick is a quest item used in Heroes' Quest. The player must work collaboratively with another player to kill Grip in order to obtain his keyring and can then use this to access a treasure room that contains the candlesticks. However, players cannot complete the quest if they trade someone else's candlestick, they must obtain their own.

label: Pew
title: Pew
lead: Pews are seating located in the Entrana church and Paterdomus Temple. They feature a symbol of Saradomin on either side.

label: Philipe Carnillean
title: Philipe Carnillean
lead: Philipe Carnillean is the son of Sir Ceril Carnillean and Henryeta Carnillean, and the heir of the Carnillean family, featured in the Hazeel Cult quest.

label: Philop
title: Philop
lead:
Philop Fairweather is one of Gertrude's four children. He can be found with his brother Kanel inside Gertrude's house. The two older children, Wilough and Shilop, are found in Varrock Square. He appears to be playing with his red dragon toy.

Although the player may attempt to talk to him, there is no dialogue other than a message in the chat stating that the boy is busy playing.

label: Phoenix crossbow
title: Phoenix crossbow
lead:
The Phoenix crossbow is a quest item, although it can be traded. It has the same stats as a regular Crossbow except for attack range, but weighs significantly less. It can be obtained and is used in the quest Shield of Arrav. The Phoenix crossbow has no requirements to wield, and can only fire bronze bolts. It can also be used with a mith grapple for agility shortcuts.

The Phoenix crossbow is not often used, as the Bronze crossbow requires the same Ranged level to equip, but gives a Ranged accuracy of +18, whilst the Phoenix crossbow only gives +6. However, the Phoenix crossbow is essentially free, and since Bronze crossbows and above are members-only items, the Phoenix crossbow is the second-best crossbow available to free-to-play players. While the Phoenix crossbow is lighter than and has the same +6 range bonus as the standard Crossbow, the Phoenix crossbow has a maximum range of 7 tiles, whereas the standard Crossbow has a range of 10 tiles.

label: Phoenix Gang
title: Phoenix Gang
lead:
The Phoenix Gang is a gang at war with the Black Arm Gang. Their base is situated in the south-east of Varrock, between the city's southern entrance and the altar of Zamorak to the east. The gang operates under a front known as the VTAM Corporation, , which stands for Varrock Thieves and Muggers.

According to their leader, Straven, the Black Arm Gang is a splinter group of the Phoenix Gang that mutinied. During the process, the Shield of Arrav was broken in two. Only the left half remains with the gang.

label: Phoenix Gang Hideout
title: Phoenix Gang Hideout
lead:
Located in the south-eastern alleys of Varrock, the Phoenix Gang Hideout is a meeting place for the notorious gang members of the Phoenix Gang.

The Phoenix Gang Hideout is known to the people of Varrock as the headquarters of the VTAM Corporation, an alias used by the Phoenix Gang to hide their identity. During the Shield of Arrav quest, the Phoenix Gang Hideout is accessible to members of the gang. Upon joining the gang, players are given a key to the weapons store room, which is next door to the hideout. If the player kills the weaponsmaster, they can steal a Phoenix crossbow. This crossbow can only use bolts up to bronze. The store room also contains a spawn of grapes which respawn roughly every 43 seconds if taken.

label: piano
title: piano
lead: Pianos are scenery objects found in various locations throughout Gielinor. Players cannot interact with most pianos, but they can examine them. Piano stools are often found nearby.

label: Piano stool
title: Piano stool
lead: Piano stools are scenery objects found throughout Gielinor and always located next to a piano. Regular piano stools appear next to both the regular grand and upright pianos, while the ornate stools appear next to grand pianos with pedals and the Clan Hall piano. Players cannot interact with piano stools, but they can examine them.

label: pickaxe handle
title: pickaxe handle
lead:
A pickaxe handle was the handle of a pickaxe. When players were mining, a random event may have caused the pickaxe head to fly off. Players had to pick it up and attach it back onto the handle. A similar thing used to happen to players while woodcutting, only with an axe head and axe handle.

After random events were voted to be reworked in late 2014, they were subsequently removed from the game with the next update.

label: Picnic bench
title: Picnic bench
lead: Various Picnic benches can be found scattered across Gielinor. They're purely decorational, and trying to use an item on a picnic bench will result in a game message in the chatbox saying "The table appears to be in use."

label: Picture
title: Picture
lead:
The picture is a quest item used only in Plague City. It is found in Edmond and Arlena's house in the north-west of East Ardougne.

It is shown to Jethick, who will direct the player to the Rehnison house in West Ardougne.

label: Pie dish
title: Pie dish
lead:
A pie dish is used in Cooking to bake pies. Players must add a pastry dough (a pot of flour and either a jug of water, a bucket of water, or a bowl of water combined) to the pie dish to form a pie shell. It then can be filled by the filling of choice. Afterwards, the pie can then be baked in an oven. Players can create this in a pottery oven.

Despite unfired pie dishes requiring 7 Crafting to make, turning an unfired pie dish into a pie dish has no Crafting requirement and can be done at level 1.

label: Pie shell
title: Pie shell
lead:
A pie shell is used to make various kinds of pie. It is made by using a pastry dough on a pie dish. Players can fill a pie shell with any of several fillings to make a raw pie which must be cooked on a range.

Possible fillings include: redberries for redberry pie, cooked meat or cooked chicken for meat pie, or cooking apple for an apple pie and many more. Members have access to a wider variety of fillings from mud pies to summer pies.

label: Piece of railing
title: Piece of railing
lead:
A piece of railing is a quest item in the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by searching a cage that contains a unicorn. The railing is used to lever a rock off of a ledge so that it crashes down and breaks the cage open, killing the unicorn in the process. The player can then search the broken cage to obtain a withered unicorn horn.

It can be safely dropped after obtaining the horn, as it serves no other purpose during the quest.

label: Pierre
title: Pierre
lead: Pierre is the Sinclair dog handler. He is called as a witness during the King's Ransom quest. When he is called up, players should ask him about the poison bought for the disappearance.

label: Pigeon cage
title: Pigeon cage
lead:
A pigeon cage is a quest item used in Biohazard and One Small Favour. It can be found in the garden behind Jerico's house, immediately south of the northern bank in East Ardougne.

In Biohazard, it is used to distract the mourner guards on the watchtower with bird seed. In One Small Favour, five of them are turned into chicken cages by using a steel bar.

label: Pike
title: Pike
lead: Pike is a type of fish that restores 8 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw pike on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 20 Cooking and granting 80 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt pike. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Pike is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 54, or 49 when using the Lumbridge range.

label: Pile of rocks
title: Pile of rocks
lead:
Pile of rocks are found in the Underground Pass when the player fails the rope swing. Failing the rope swing will bring the player to a large area where the player must follow the path to reach the pile of rocks to exit the area.

A second pile of rocks were added alongside a very small cavern with the release of Song of the Elves. It is not currently known how to access this cavern, or what happens when the rocks are climbed.

label: Pile of rubble (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
title: Pile of rubble (Yanille Agility Dungeon)
lead: The pile of rubble is an Agility shortcut in the Yanille Agility Dungeon. It provides access to an area with 4 chaos druids and Salarin the twisted.

label: Pillar (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Pillar (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The pillar is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to cross will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

The amount of damage dealt by the fall is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below:

label: Pillar (Runic altar)
title: Pillar (Runic altar)
lead: Pillars can be found at the Runic altars as part of the temples surrounding the altars. They are also found in the Eastern Ruins in the Wilderness. They are non-interactive.

label: Pillars of Zanash
title: Pillars of Zanash
lead:
The Pillars of Zanash are a shrine to Saradomin found in the vicinity of East Ardougne and Witchaven. The pillars, known to be made of marble, are mentioned by name only in the Tourist's Guide to Ardougne. The book can be found in the real-estate agency within the city, though it incorrectly states they are found west of Ardougne.

According to Brother Maledict, the shrine is over 150 years old, and predates the founding of Witchaven. When the village came into being, the shrine was abandoned and has fallen into disrepair. In addition, Mayor Hobb (while possessed by sea slugs) says that the shrine is "ancient beyond knowledge" and that its history "should not be overlooked."

label: pineapple
title: pineapple
lead:
A pineapple is a fruit that can be found growing just south of Brimhaven or on a player grown Pineapple plant. Additionally, they may be purchased from Trader Crewmembers operating Trader Stan's Trading Post, Funch's Shop from Heckel Funch, or from Hudo Glenfad in the Grand Tree Groceries store.

found south of Brimhaven.]]
Pineapples provide an easy way to make supercompost by putting it into a compost bin, as they are relatively cheap and easy to obtain. It can be sliced or diced with a knife. Slicing the pineapple will yield 4 pineapple rings, each healing 2 Hitpoints. Dicing the pineapple yields one pineapple chunks, an ingredient used in gnome cooking, which also heals 2 Hitpoints when consumed. When slicing the pineapple into pineapple rings if you don't have enough space in your inventory, the rings will drop to the ground instead.

label: Pineapple chunks
title: Pineapple chunks
lead:
Pineapple chunks are a food item that heals 2 hitpoints when consumed. Players can make pineapple chunks by using a knife on a pineapple or a tenti pineapple by choosing "Dice".

The main use for pineapple chunks is as an ingredient in other foods; for example, members can use them to make a pineapple pizza with level 65 Cooking.

label: Pineapple pizza
title: Pineapple pizza
lead:
Pineapple pizza is a type of pizza that restores 22 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 11. It can be obtained by using pineapple chunks or pineapple rings on a cooked plain pizza, requiring 65 Cooking and granting 45 experience. It is recommended to cut the pineapple into rings, as this yields four rings for use on multiple pizzas, compared to the single chunk if dicing it. Pineapple pizza is one of the highest healing foods in the game and are also a type of fast food.

100 noted pineapple pizzas can be given to Yama to initiate a fight that is identical to the aether catalyst, oathplate shard, and diabolic worm acquisition contract fights, as a way to practice these fights in exchange for standard loot rolls.

label: Pineapple Plant (wild)
title: Pineapple Plant (wild)
lead:
Pineapple Plants are wild plants found on Karamja and Ape Atoll. The wild pineapple plants found near Brimhaven can grow up to five pineapples at a time, while the variants found on Ape Atoll will only ever grow one pineapple at a time. Picking wild pineapples will not give any Farming experience. Unlike the pineapple plants found in farming patches, picking pineapples from the wild Pineapple Plants will only take a single game tick, meaning that these can be picked much faster. Once picked, the plant takes 5 minutes to regrow.

found south of Brimhaven.]]
The fact the Ape Atoll plants only grow up to one pineapple at a time should be taken into account when running laps on the Ape Atoll Agility Course. Very close to the course's end, a single plant can be found, which can be used to help recover some health from running laps on the course. Once the pineapple regrows on this plant, it is beneficial to pick it as soon as conveniently possible, due to no further food growing there until it is picked again. Picking this pineapple should be enough health restoration to sustain players with mid to high Agility levels indefinitely, provided they bring a knife to cut the pineapples up into pineapple rings. For lower levels, however, this single pineapple may not be sufficient to sustain them.

label: Pineapple punch
title: Pineapple punch
lead:
Pineapple punch is a drink that can be made at level 8 Cooking, granting 70 experience points. It heals 9 hitpoints. To mix a pineapple punch, a player needs a lemon, 2 oranges, 3 pineapples, a lime, a cocktail shaker, a knife, and a cocktail glass.

To make it: 
# Use the "mix-cocktail" option on the shaker, and select pineapple punch.
# Use the knife on the remaining pineapple and select "dice".
# Use the knife on the lime and select "dice".
# Use the knife on the orange and select "slice."
# Use the cocktail shaker on the glass or select "pour mixed punch" on the cocktail shaker.

label: Pineapple ring
title: Pineapple ring
lead:
Pineapple rings are a members-only Cooking ingredient that are used on plain pizzas to create pineapple pizzas.

Pineapple rings are obtained by using a knife on a pineapple or a tenti pineapple and choosing the "slice" option. 4 pineapple rings are obtained for each pineapple that is sliced. If the "dice" option is chosen, the player will receive Pineapple chunks instead.

label: Pink boots
title: Pink boots
lead: Pink boots can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree. Their stats are identical to Leather boots.

label: Pink hat
title: Pink hat
lead: A pink hat is a piece of headwear that can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store Fine Fashions, located to the north-east on the of the Grand Tree. The hats are a slight upgrade from wizard hats, offering one more Magic attack and defence.

label: Pink robe bottoms
title: Pink robe bottoms
lead: Pink robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions. You can find Rometti on the of the Grand Tree, in the north-eastern area.

label: Pink robe top
title: Pink robe top
lead: A pink robe top can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Pink skirt
title: Pink skirt
lead:
A pink skirt is one of several skirts available to free players. It is used in the quest Prince Ali Rescue as part of the disguise Prince Ali wears in order to impersonate Lady Keli and escape from prison. The rowdy dwarf may ask for this item in the quest Forgettable Tale... in return for a Kelda seed.

It can be stored in the STASH unit outside the southern entrance to the Grand Exchange together with a pink robe top and a body tiara.

label: Pipe (Plague City)
title: Pipe (Plague City)
lead:
A pipe can be found in the western section of the Ardougne Sewers. During the Plague City quest, players must climb up the pipe in order to gain access to West Ardougne. Access to the pipe is initially blocked by a grill, which players must remove by first by attaching a rope to the grill, followed by asking Edmond for assistance in pulling it off.

Players must have a gas mask equipped before being allowed to climb up the pipe.

label: Pirate
title: Pirate
lead:
Pirates are non-player characters that can be found in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and the Pirates' Hideout at level 55 Wilderness or around Brimhaven, Port Piscarilius, in the Port Sarim jail, and around the Pirates' Cove at level 23. They are also fought during Cabin Fever.

The pirates at Brimhaven, the Pirates' Cove, and Port Piscarilius can also be spoken to, although they will only respond with short phrases consisting of seemingly nonsensical pirate slang. Unlike the pirates found on Mos Le'Harmless, carrying a book o' piracy does not change their dialogue in any way.

label: Pirate Guard
title: Pirate Guard
lead:
Pirate guards are posted just west of the Brimhaven Agility Arena, and are also found in Scarface Pete's mansion. Pirate guards resemble the old Varrock town guards, but with black equipment instead of bronze equipment.
You can speak to Pirate guards, but they do not provide you with any useful information.

Pirate guards do not drop anything when killed apart from bones.

label: Pirate Jackie the Fruit
title: Pirate Jackie the Fruit
lead:
Pirate Jackie the Fruit can be found at the Brimhaven Agility Arena entrance. She runs the Agility Arena Store, exchanging the tickets and vouchers obtained in the arena for various rewards, consisting of valuable herbs, amylase packs, Agility experience, and the expensive pirate's hook. The amount of Agility experience received can be increased by 10% by wearing Karamja gloves 2 or higher. Players can also use graceful outfit pieces that have been recoloured blue on her to revert them to their default colouring, although this does not refund any tickets.

She also awards players the Karamja gloves for completing easy, medium, hard and elite Karamja Diary tasks. After the completion of the elite diary she lets the player switch whether bars from the metal dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon drop noted or not.

label: Pirate map
title: Pirate map
lead:
Pirate map is a decorative piece of scenery that can be found in various locations across Gielinor. Players cannot interact with the pirate map, but they can examine it.

Three pirate maps are in the Wise Old Man's house in Draynor, one on the bottom floor and two on the top floor. One map is located on the western wall of the Dead Man's Chest in Brimhaven. Two can also be found in the Pirates' Hideout in the Wilderness. Lastly, one pirate map is on the wall of Amelia's house in Shayzien.

label: Pirate message
title: Pirate message
lead:
The Pirate message is a quest item used only in Pirate's Treasure. It is found in a locked chest, that is unlocked with a key, on the of the Blue Moon Inn.

The message informs the player of the buried treasure's location somewhere in Falador Park. It is kept upon quest completion, but has no use.

label: pirate's hat
title: pirate's hat
lead: A Pirate's hat is a possible reward from completing hard Treasure Trails. Players who have completed Cabin Fever can pay Patchy to attach a pirate's hat to an eye patch to create a hat eyepatch.

label: Pirate's hook
title: Pirate's hook
lead:
The pirate's hook is a reward from the Brimhaven Agility Arena that occupies the glove slot. It can be purchased from Pirate Jackie the Fruit for 800 Brimhaven vouchers.

Without the completion of the elite Karamja diary, it takes a minimum of 800 minutes (or 13 hours 20 minutes) to earn enough tickets for this item, assuming no dispensers are missed. Players with the diary completed have a 10% chance to gain double tickets, which lowers the time to 728 minutes (12 hours 8 minutes).

label: Pirate's Treasure
title: Pirate's Treasure
lead: Pirate's Treasure is a quest in which you help the pirate Redbeard Frank obtain some Karamjan rum in return for the location of the treasure of One-Eyed Hector, his old captain.

label: Pirates' Hideout
title: Pirates' Hideout
lead:
The Pirates' Hideout is a building located in deep Wilderness. A lockpick and 39 Thieving are required to pick the door lock, gaining entry.

Many aggressive pirates are located here. There are also 4 Thieving chests that have to be searched for traps before the player can loot them, and half of a redberry pie (5 hitpoints healing) spawns in the hideout. This is a single-way combat area.

label: Pirates' Hideout mine
title: Pirates' Hideout mine
lead: The Pirates' Hideout mine, or Pirates' Mine, is a mining site located east of the Pirates' Hideout in the deep Wilderness. Player killing in the Wilderness greatly increases the risk of mining at this site along with all Wilderness mines, so mining at this site can be very dangerous. There are also a number of giant bats around this mine. The closest bank is in the Mage Arena; however, players will need a sharp object (like a knife) to cut through the webs blocking its entrance.

label: Pit Scorpion
title: Pit Scorpion
lead: Pit scorpions are scorpions found in the dungeon of the Legends' Guild and Ardougne Zoo.

label: Pitta bread
title: Pitta bread
lead:
Pitta bread are a type of food used to make Ugthanki kebabs, and can be obtained by baking pitta dough on a cooking range, requiring level 58 Cooking and granting 40 experience when successful. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 37 on ranges. However, since the Cooking requirement is level 58, it can never be burned.

Players can make pitta dough with level 58 Cooking by combining a pot of flour with a jug or bucket of water. They can then use the cooked pitta bread with kebab mix to complete an ugthanki kebab.

label: Pitta dough
title: Pitta dough
lead:
Pitta dough is created by mixing a pot of flour with either a bucket of water, bowl of water, or jug of water. It can be cooked on a range (not a fire) to make pitta bread.

Unlike many cooking recipes, this item cannot be burned, even though the burnt version exists. This is because players can no longer burn it by the time they have the level required to cook it.

label: pizza base
title: pizza base
lead: A pizza base is an ingredient used to make pizza. It can be made by using either a bucket of water, bowl of water, or jug of water with a pot of flour. With a Cooking level of 35 it can be used with a tomato and cheese to make an uncooked pizza, which can then be cooked. Tomato must be added first, then cheese to make an uncooked pizza. Pizza bases can also be purchased from Tony's Pizza Bases in the Bandit Camp.

label: Plague City
title: Plague City
lead: Plague City is the first quest of the Elf quest series. The quest investigates a plague that has affected West Ardougne.

label: Plague jacket
title: Plague jacket
lead:
The plague jacket is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It and the plague trousers are obtained from Doctor Orbon by purchasing it from him for 100 coins. It cannot be obtained again after completing the quest.

It must be worn when prodding the sick-looking sheep into the pen. It forms half of the plague suit set, the other half being the plague trousers.

label: plague sample
title: plague sample
lead:
The plague sample is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is obtained from Elena after returning her distillator to her.

It is given to Guidor in south-east Varrock, alongside liquid honey, sulphuric broline, ethenea, and touch paper.

label: Plague trousers
title: Plague trousers
lead:
The plague trousers is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It and the plague jacket are obtained from Doctor Orbon by purchasing it from him for 100 coins. It cannot be obtained again after completing the quest.

It must be worn when prodding the sick-looking sheep into the pen. It forms half of the plague suit set, the other half being the plague jacket. It appears visually identical to the Mourner trousers.

label: plain pizza
title: plain pizza
lead:
Plain pizza is a type of pizza that restores 14 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 7. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked pizza on a cooking range, requiring level 35 Cooking and granting 143 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt pizza. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 68.

Toppings can be added to the plain pizza in order to create meat pizza (meat or chicken), anchovy pizza (anchovies), or pineapple pizza (chunks or ring).

label: Plank
title: Plank
lead: A plank is a common Construction item and is used in several quests. Made from normal logs, it is the lowest-level type of plank. Each plank used while training Construction yields 29 experience. They are also used to repair fishing cranes, which yields Crafting and Construction experience equal to 4 times the player's current level.

label: Plank (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Plank (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The plank is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to choose the correct plank, the smooth one, will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course. Players with 99 Agility will be able to successfully cross any of the 3 planks, however, choosing a broken plank takes 1 extra tick to cross.

The amount of damage dealt by the fall is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: Plant (Dwarven Mine)
title: Plant (Dwarven Mine)
lead: Plants can be found growing on the floor surrounding the chest that holds Thalzar's map part used in the Dragon Slayer I quest. Players cannot interact with the plant, only examine them.

label: Plaque (Varrock Palace)
title: Plaque (Varrock Palace)
lead:
A plaque could previously be found in Varrock Palace next to the cage containing the imprisoned Monk of Zamorak. Players had the option to read the plaque, which would give the message "Witness the fate of those who serve Zamorak the master of evil..."

With the graphical update of Varrock in 2007, the plaque was removed. As a result, it has never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: player character
title: player character
lead: The Player, also known as the Adventurer, is the avatar of someone playing Old School RuneScape. The Player is a human, may be either body type and may be freely customised. Their adventuring career begins in the year 169 of the Fifth Age on Tutorial Island, and thereafter involves a number of quests until they become a well-known hero.

label: Poison (item)
title: Poison (item)
lead:
Poison is an item used during the Ernest the Chicken and Hazeel Cult quests. It can be found as a spawn inside Draynor Manor, or purchased from Rasolo near the Baxtorian Falls or Jossik in the Lighthouse.

It is used to poison the fish food and the piranhas found in the fountain on the grounds of Draynor Manor during the Ernest the Chicken quest. Finally, it is used to poison the Carnillean household's food in Hazeel Cult. You can try to use the poison obtained from the Hazeel Cult to poison the sheep in Sheep Herder, but a message will appear saying: "The sheep isn't going to drink the poison from the bottle. Perhaps you should try feeding it something else more appropriate."

label: poison chalice
title: poison chalice
lead: A poison chalice is a cocktail obtained for free from Stankers, a dwarven miner near the Coal Trucks west of Seers' Village. Drinking a poison chalice applies a random effect, and leaves behind an empty cocktail glass. Drinking the poison chalice cannot lower your Hitpoints past 4.

label: Poison Salesman
title: Poison Salesman
lead: The Poison Salesman is a non-player character who can be found near the bar in Seers' Village, and is involved in The Fremennik Trials and Murder Mystery quests.

label: Poison Scorpion
title: Poison Scorpion
lead:
Poison Scorpions are found in the Taverley Dungeon and Brimhaven. They are poisonous, and their poison starts at 3 Hitpoints per hit. As such, a form of antipoison is recommended when fighting them.

They are considered a scorpion for the purpose of a Slayer task.

label: poison spider
title: poison spider
lead:
Poison spiders are monsters that can be found in many locations, including the Wilderness. They are aggressive and attack with Melee, being fairly accurate and able to inflict a poison that starts at a 6. Contrary to popular belief, Protect from Melee does not prevent them from causing poison.

The level 31 variant may be encountered during the Observatory Quest when searching chests for the goblin kitchen key. These spiders will immediately poison the player similar to cave slime, where simply being in combat with them will inflict poison.

label: Poisoned dagger (unobtainable item)
title: Poisoned dagger (unobtainable item)
lead:
The Poisoned dagger is an unobtainable item that was added during the RuneScape 2 beta. It uses the default untextured model for poisoned daggers. Its purpose is unknown; however, it may have been created in order to test poisoned daggers in RuneScape 2, or as part of an interface.

With the release of Weapon poison(+) and Weapon poison(++), extra strong and super strong poison variants of the dagger were added too.

label: Poisoned dart(p)
title: Poisoned dart(p)
lead:
The Poisoned dart(p) is an unobtainable item that was added during the RuneScape 2 beta. Its purpose is unknown; however, it may have been created in order to test poisoned darts in RuneScape 2, or as part of an interface.

The item briefly appeared in the search interface of the trading post. Aside from this, it has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Poisoned fish food
title: Poisoned fish food
lead:
Poisoned fish food is a quest item used in Ernest the Chicken, and in Crack the Clue III. It is made by using poison with fish food (both found in Draynor Manor).

Poisoned fish food is used to kill the piranhas in the fountain in order to retrieve the pressure gauge.

label: Port Khazard
title: Port Khazard
lead: Port Khazard is a port located south of Ardougne and north of Yanille. It is one of the most convenient Sailing ports, as it offers a bank chest, shipwright, and an anvil within close proximity of the gangplank, which can be used from level 30 Sailing. Apart from that, it offers charter ships to other locations, the Fishing Trawler minigame, and other minor facilities.

label: Port Khazard mine
title: Port Khazard mine
lead:
Port Khazard mine is a mining site found in Port Khazard. The mine actually consists of two smaller areas, which occupy the northern and southern parts of the port, but the proximity and small sizes of the two has generally led to them being considered as part of the same site.

The northern portion of the mine possesses one mithril rock and two tin rocks, as well as two exhausted rocks which never contain any ore, while the southern one has one mithril and two copper rocks. A deposit box can be found near the Fishing Trawler minigame, which makes it an ideal spot for players in need of tin and copper. The port also houses an anvil that can be used in conjunction with the Superheat Item spell in order to smith mined ore. The area's charter ships can also be used to reach various other ports.

label: Port Sarim
title: Port Sarim
lead: Port Sarim is a small port in south-eastern Asgarnia. The port connects to a number of other ports, including Entrana, Karamja, Crandor, Great Kourend, Corsair Cove, and the Void Knights' Outpost, as well as even more destinations via charter ship.

label: Port Sarim jail
title: Port Sarim jail
lead: The Port Sarim jail is a top security prison located in Port Sarim, commonly referred to as the worst jail in Gielinor. Players can get sent to the jail by Shantay should they declare themselves an outlaw and refuse to pay his fine of five coins twice, although they can escape quite easily by picking the lock on the door or teleporting out. Picking the lock to get out awards 4 Thieving experience on members' worlds, while not providing any experience on free-to-play worlds.

label: Portal (Runecrafting)
title: Portal (Runecrafting)
lead: Runecrafting portals are portals found within various runic altars which allows one-way transportation to its corresponding mysterious ruins in the overworld. Apart from teleports, the portals are the only exit from the altar.

label: Portcullis (Underground Pass)
title: Portcullis (Underground Pass)
lead: Portcullises can be found within the Underground Pass.

label: Portrait
title: Portrait
lead:
The Portrait is a quest item used only in The Knight's Sword. It is found in a cupboard on the of the White Knights' Castle in Falador after talking to the Squire.

It is given to Thurgo so he can study the sword design.

label: Portrait (scenery)
title: Portrait (scenery)
lead: Portraits are found in many locations, they serve no purpose other than aesthetics. The portrait of a vampyre found in Slepe looks identical to the portrait that must be slashed open to reveal the Large ornate key in the Darkness of Hallowvale quest.

label: Pot
title: Pot
lead:
A pot is an item that can be used to hold a variety of liquids or powdery substances, such as flour. It is one of the most common items, so players will often simply drop them and buy new ones when needed, as they are very inexpensive.

Players can find them on various counters and tables through Gielinor, including the ground-floor kitchen in Lumbridge Castle. Alternatively, they can be made by forming soft clay on a potter's wheel, then firing the resulting unfired pot in a pottery oven.

label: pot of cream
title: pot of cream
lead:
A pot of cream can be made by using a bucket of milk on a dairy churn at 21 Cooking. It provides 18 Cooking experience. They can also be purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest in the Lumbridge Castle cellar, after you're at a certain point in the Recipe for Disaster quest as well as from Hudo or Heckel Funch at the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

Pots of cream can be further churned into a pat of butter. When eaten, the pot of cream heals 1 hitpoint.

label: Pot of flour
title: Pot of flour
lead:
A pot of flour is a Cooking ingredient used to produce several types of dough when combined with water.

Using an empty pot on a barrel of flour is a faster alternative to having to get grain and use a windmill. One barrel is in the kitchen of Sinclair Mansion after starting the Murder Mystery quest and another barrel is located on the of Gordon and Mary's farm.

label: Pot of flour (Tutorial Island)
title: Pot of flour (Tutorial Island)
lead:
The Pot of flour is a unique variant of the pot of flour that can only be obtained on Tutorial Island. Lev the Master Chef gives the player the pot of flour and a bucket of water, and teaches them how to combine the two to make bread dough. Players must bake the bread in order to proceed with the tutorial.

The pot of flour was not available in the alternative Tutorial Island experienced by some players in 2020, as the Master Chef was replaced with the Master Navigator.

label: Potato
title: Potato
lead:
Raw potatoes are a food item that can be picked from fields around Gielinor or grown through the Farming skill at level 1 with potato seeds. They heal 1 hitpoint when eaten raw. When picking potatoes from fields, members may randomly receive 1 potato seed.

They are used in the following recipes:
* Baked potato (must be cooked on a range, not a fire)
* Veg ball (Gnome cooking)
* Stew
* Curry
* Fish pie (admiral and regular, which temporarily boost Fishing level by 5 and 3, respectively)

label: Potato (scenery)
title: Potato (scenery)
lead: Potato plants are scenery that can be picked to obtain potatoes. Rarely a potato seed is awarded in place of a potato. Potatoes picked up in a field will respawn after 50 ticks (30 seconds). Unlike potatoes picked from a Farming allotment, picking potatoes from fields provides no experience.

label: Potato cactus
title: Potato cactus
lead: Potato cactus is an item that is used with the Herblore skill as a secondary ingredient when creating magic potions and battlemage potions. Potato cactus can also be selected as one of the 3 of 31 items needed for Fairytale I - Growing Pains as well as 1 of 50 items for Mourning's End Part II. They can be grown in a cactus patch by planting potato cactus seeds, requiring level 64 Farming. Eight are also used to pay Taylor to look after a player's Celastrus tree. Collecting 5 of them while inside the Kalphite Lair is a requirement for the Easy Desert Diary.

label: Pothole Dungeon
title: Pothole Dungeon
lead:
The Pothole Dungeon (also known as the Jogre Dungeon) is located on Karamja, south of Brimhaven and north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. Level 53 Jogres live here. This is the only place where rogue's purse herbs grow, and they can be found by searching the Fungus covered Cavern walls.

It is located directly south across the bay from the Karamja volcano near Musa Point, at the end of a curved cliffside beach accessible only from the east end.
