There are multiple harpie bug swarms at the start of the beach, which may be aggressive depending on combat level. Search the pile of rocks near the end of the beach, and you will be asked if you want to climb down into the dungeon.

label: Potion (Apothecary)
title: Potion (Apothecary)
lead:
A potion is given to a player by asking the Apothecary in Varrock for a free sample. The Apothecary will give it roughly half the time, otherwise refusing to do so. Multiple potions can be obtained using the drop trick. It can also be obtained as a rare drop from killing Imps, or failing The Gauntlet.

The Apothecary indicates that the potion is a spot cream. If used on various citizens in Sophanem before completing Beneath Cursed Sands, it is revealed that the potion is used to relieve itching.

label: Potion (Watchtower)
title: Potion (Watchtower)
lead:
The potion is a quest item that is created during the Watchtower quest. It is used to kill the ogre shaman that lives in the caves below Gu'Tanoth.

To make the potion the player must mix guam leaf, jangerberries, and ground bat bones into a vial of water. This specific order must be followed or the potion will explode, damaging the player. Then, it needs to be enchanted by the Watchtower Wizard, to turn it into a Magic ogre potion. This item will disappear when dropped. Before dropping the item, it will ask for confirmation, stating: "This item will likely break if you put it down here, and you will have to go looking for another."

label: Potted flower
title: Potted flower
lead: Potted flowers are common decorative scenery, found all across Gielinor.

label: Potted plant
title: Potted plant
lead: Potted plants are a decorative form of vegetation which can be found as examinable pieces of scenery all around Gielinor, with notable concentrations to be found in Al Kharid, Pollnivneach, Catherby, Taverley, Brimhaven, Ardougne, and the Gnome Stronghold.

label: Potted plant (Bamboo)
title: Potted plant (Bamboo)
lead: Potted plants inside a bamboo pot are a decorative form of vegetation which can be found as examinable pieces of scenery all around Gielinor.

label: Potted plant (witch's house)
title: Potted plant (witch's house)
lead: A potted plant stands outside of the house of Nora T. Hagg in Taverley. The player can look under the plant to find the house's door key, which is necessary for the quests Witch's House and Grim Tales.

label: Potter's Wheel
title: Potter's Wheel
lead:
A Potter's Wheel is used to mould soft clay, obtainable by mixing water and clay, into other objects. With the relevant Crafting level, the player can make unfired versions of clay items, gaining Crafting experience. The player sits down, operates the pedals with their feet and uses their hands to shape the malleable clay. The unfired items produced in this way can then be further refined by placement in a pottery oven.

Free-to-play players can make unfired bowls, pie dishes, and pots while members can also create cups, pot lids, and plant pots.

label: pottery oven
title: pottery oven
lead:
A pottery oven (also known as a kiln) is used in crafting clay items that have been moulded from soft clay on a potter's wheel or with a mould. Unfired versions of clay items can be placed inside a pottery oven to harden them, producing a usable clay item and granting Crafting experience. Unlike shaping the soft clay, firing it has no Crafting level requirement.

The player places the unfired clay item in the oven, waits for a few seconds, then removes the fired clay object. There is, however, a small chance that the unfired items may break in the pottery oven. The chance of cracking a piece of pottery decreases with higher Crafting levels, resulting in a guaranteed success rate at level 14 Crafting for all types of earthenware.

label: Prayer
title: Prayer
lead:
Prayer is a non-members combat skill, trained by using remains in various ways.

Bones can be buried, offered to gilded altars with incense burners, offered to the altar in the Chaos Temple, converted into Ectofuntus, converted to Blessed bone shards and offered at the Libation bowl, or have Sinister Offering cast on them. Demonic ashes can be scattered or converted into experience with Demonic Offering. Players can also kill monsters that were reanimated with reanimation spells, or cremate shade remains to unlock chests. These chests can drop pieces of the zealot's robes, a skilling outfit which gives a 1.25% chance per piece to save most remains when used.

label: Prayer Level Up!
title: Prayer Level Up!
lead: Prayer Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Prayer.

label: Prayer Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Prayer Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Prayer Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Prayer.

label: prayer potion
title: prayer potion
lead:
A Prayer potion is a potion made by using snape grass on a ranarr potion (unf), requiring 38 Herblore, yielding a Prayer potion(3) and 87.5 Herblore experience. A dose of Prayer potion restores Prayer points equal to 7 + 25% of the player's current Prayer level, rounded down. If a Prayer cape, Max cape or ring of the gods (i) is equipped or a Prayer cape, Max cape or holy wrench is in the player's inventory, the restore increases to 7 + 27% of the player's current Prayer level, rounded down. It provides less Prayer point restoration than a super restore potion by 1 point per dose.

Prayer potions are always in high demand due to use of Prayers during combat and a need to restore points without travelling to an altar.

label: Premade blurb' sp.
title: Premade blurb' sp.
lead:
A premade blurb' sp. is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. It can also be found on the table next to the gnome glider on Karamja (Take the gnome glider to Karamja, Gandius/Palm Tree location).

It functions exactly the same as the blurberry special drink that can be made with the Cooking skill, healing 7 Hitpoints, increasing Strength by 5% + 2 levels, and reducing Attack by 2% - 3 levels.

label: Premade c+t batta
title: Premade c+t batta
lead:
A premade c+t batta is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade c+t battas can only be used to heal 11 hitpoints, just like the Cheese+tom batta that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade ch' crunch
title: Premade ch' crunch
lead:
A premade ch'crunch is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade ch' crunches can be used to heal 8 hitpoints, just like the Chocchip crunchies that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade choc bomb
title: Premade choc bomb
lead:
A premade choc bomb is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade choc bombs can only be used to heal 15 hitpoints, just like the Chocolate bomb food that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade choc s'dy
title: Premade choc s'dy
lead:
A premade choc s'dy is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

Drinking it heals 5 Hitpoints, lowers Attack by 2% - 3 levels and increases Strength by 5% + 2 levels, just like the chocolate saturday drink that can be made with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade dr' dragon
title: Premade dr' dragon
lead: A premade dr' dragon is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant activity. When drunk, It heals 5 Hitpoints, lowers your Attack by 2% - 3 levels, and raises your Strength by 5% + 2 levels, just like the drunk dragon drink that can be made with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade fr' blast
title: Premade fr' blast
lead:
A premade fr' blast is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

Pineapple punches, fruit blasts, and their premade versions are the only gnome cocktails that do not affect stats, and heal 9 hitpoints.

label: Premade fr't batta
title: Premade fr't batta
lead:

Premade fr't battas can only be used to heal 11 hitpoints, just like the Fruit batta that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade p' punch
title: Premade p' punch
lead:
A premade p' punch is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

Pineapple punches and fruit blasts, along with their premade versions, are the only gnome cocktails that do not affect stats, and heal 9 hitpoints.

label: Premade s'y crunch
title: Premade s'y crunch
lead:
A premade s'y crunch is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade s'y crunches can only be used to heal 7 hitpoints, just like the Spicy crunchies that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade sgg
title: Premade sgg
lead:
A premade sgg is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

Like the short green guy, a premade sgg heals 5 hitpoints, boosts Strength by 5% + 1 levels, and reduces Attack by 2% - 3 levels when drunk.

label: Premade t'd batta
title: Premade t'd batta

title: Premade t'd crunch
lead:

Premade t'd crunches can be used to heal 8 hitpoints, just like the Toad crunches that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade ttl
title: Premade ttl
lead:
A premade ttl is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade ttls can only be used to heal 15 hitpoints, just like the Tangled toad's legs that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade veg ball
title: Premade veg ball
lead:

Premade veg balls can only be used to heal 12 hitpoints, just like the Veg ball that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade veg batta
title: Premade veg batta
lead:

Premade veg battas can only be used to heal 11 hitpoints, just like the Vegetable batta that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade w'm batta
title: Premade w'm batta
lead:
A premade w'm batta is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade w'm battas can only be used to heal 11 hitpoints, just like the Worm batta that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade w'm crun'
title: Premade w'm crun'
lead:
Premade w'm crun is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant minigame.

Premade w'm crun's can only be used to heal 8 hitpoints, just like the Worm crunchies that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Premade wiz blz'd
title: Premade wiz blz'd
lead: A premade wiz blz'd is a drink that can be bought at Blurberry Bar in the south-east corner of the of the Grand Tree. Pre-made drinks cannot be used in the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Like the wizard blizzard, the premade wiz blz'd heals 5 hitpoints and boosts Strength by 6% + 1 levels, but reduces Attack by 2% - 3 levels.

label: Premade worm hole
title: Premade worm hole
lead:
A premade worm hole is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in Gianne's Restaurant in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree. Premade foods cannot be used in the Gnome restaurant activity.

Premade worm holes can only be used to heal 12 hitpoints, just like the Worm hole that can be made by players with the Cooking skill.

label: Pressure gauge
title: Pressure gauge
lead:
The pressure gauge is a quest item used only in Ernest the Chicken. It is found submerged in the waters of the piranha-infested fountain in the south-western area of Draynor Manor. To get this item, the player must kill the piranhas using poisoned fish food. If the player does not use poisoned fish food, the piranhas will deal 1 hitpoint of damage.

It is one of three items needed to repair Professor Oddenstein's machine along with an oil can and a rubber tube, so he can turn Ernest back into a human. Duplicates can be obtained with the drop trick and searching the fountain again. Upon completion of the quest duplicates are destroyed and it can no longer be obtained.

label: Pressure pad (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Pressure pad (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The pressure pad is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to jump across the pad will cause the player to take damage.

The amount of damage is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: Priest (East Ardougne)
title: Priest (East Ardougne)
lead: The priest of East Ardougne is a cleric who can be found in the church north of the zoo. He resides in the church along with Doctor Orbon and Councillor Halgrive.

label: Priest (West Ardougne)
title: Priest (West Ardougne)
lead:
A Priest can be found in the spacious Saradominist chapel in the south-east of West Ardougne, the plague-infested western half of Ardougne, the capital of Kandarin. He plays a small role in Song of the Elves when the player visits him disguised as a mourner to collect taxes and destroy food supplies to spark the Ardougne Revolution.

If the player chooses to speak to the Priest, he will lament at how helpless he is against the plague and how little he can do in the way of comforting or curing the populace of the city, saying "I wish there was more I could do for these people."

label: Priest gown (bottom)
title: Priest gown (bottom)
lead:
Priest gown (bottom) is the bottom half of the Priest gown set. A priest gown set is used in the Biohazard quest.

It can be bought from Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.

label: Priest gown (top)
title: Priest gown (top)
lead:
Priest gown (top) is top half of the Priest gown set. A priest gown set is used in the Biohazard quest.

It can be bought from Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.

label: Priest in Peril
title: Priest in Peril
lead: Priest in Peril is the first quest to take place in Morytania, and is required to enter the region. At the command of King Roald, you must head to the temple of Paterdomus to aid the monk Drezel with recovering the temple.

label: Prince Ali
title: Prince Ali
lead:
Prince Ali of Al Kharid is the son of the town's Emir and an important political character. The prince was kidnapped by Lady Keli and the player must help rescue him from the Draynor Village jail during the Prince Ali Rescue quest. Lady Keli's plan is to hold him for ransom, but this is to be foiled by the player.

Prince Ali has a dark skin tone and wears a top similar to Lady Keli when captive in the jail area. During the escape, he disguises himself by covering up his black eye using paste, and donning a fair wig and a pink skirt to make himself resemble Lady Keli. He then returns to Al Kharid Palace with Leela, the daughter of spymaster Osman sent to free him.

label: Prince Ali (disguised)
title: Prince Ali (disguised)
lead: During Prince Ali Rescue, Prince Ali escapes from jail by lightening his skin using paste, donning a wig, and wearing a pink skirt in order to make himself resemble Lady Keli. Due to a change in the quest released alongside Beneath Cursed Sands, the skin paste is instead used to cover a black eye rather than to lighten his skin, while the rest now happens off-screen, so the NPC is no longer used.

label: Prince Ali Rescue
title: Prince Ali Rescue
lead: Prince Ali Rescue is a free-to-play quest, and one of the first released. It's notable for allowing entry through the Al Kharid/Lumbridge gate without the fee of 10 coins. It also introduces characters who are a part of the Kharidian quest series.

label: Principality
title: Principality
lead:
Principality is a music track that is unlocked in Burthorpe, including on Mac's island. In this area, the music track shuffles between playing this track and Kingdom.

In Classic music mode, this track plays on the east side of Burthorpe.

label: Prison door (Desert Mining Camp)
title: Prison door (Desert Mining Camp)
lead: The prison door in the Desert Mining Camp can be opened with the cell door key. Without it the bars in the window of the jail cell must be bent to escape.

label: Prison Door (Fight Arena)
title: Prison Door (Fight Arena)
lead: There are several prison doors located within the Fight Arena prison. These are the cells where the player is locked in during the Fight Arena quest.

label: Prison Door (Sammy Servil's cell)
title: Prison Door (Sammy Servil's cell)
lead: The prison door to Sammy Servil's cell is located inside of the prison in the Fight Arena. During the Fight Arena quest, the cell door is unlocked with the Khazard cell keys, which are obtained after getting a guard drunk.

label: Prison door (Shantay Pass)
title: Prison door (Shantay Pass)
lead:
The prison door is for the Shantay Pass jail. Players are freely allowed to enter and leave jail cell, however when talking to Shantay and asking "What is this place?" followed by "I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!", they are thrown into the jail cell with the door locked. Shantay will immediately ask the player to pay the fine, or if cancelled, attempting to open the door will cause him to ask. The fine of five coins must be paid to Shantay before he will unlock the door.

If the fine is not paid by refusing to pay it twice, Shantay to send the player to Port Sarim jail. Teleporting out is also an option. In either case, returning to the prison door in Shantay Pass and attempting to open it will cause Shantay to say "You should be in Jail! Well, no doubt the authorities in Port Sarim know what they're doing. But if you get into any more trouble, you'll be stuck back in jail."

label: Prison key (Troll Stronghold)
title: Prison key (Troll Stronghold)
lead:
The prison key is a quest item used only during Troll Stronghold. It opens the door to the troll prison and is a drop from both the level 113 Troll generals in Troll Stronghold. Players must kill a general to get the key.

As Troll generals may hit high (up to 38 hitpoints), it is recommended to use a safespot or protect from melee when trying to kill one for the key. Once the key is dropped, players may enter the locked door to continue the quest.

label: Professor Oddenstein
title: Professor Oddenstein
lead:
Professor Oddenstein is a mad scientist who lives on the top floor of Draynor Manor. He is a central character of the Ernest the Chicken quest, and minder of the Interdimensional rift for the Killerwatt plane. Ava works as his assistant.

As a mad scientist, he is responsible for creating various things:
*The strange machine, which has transformed Ernest into a chicken.
**Although it is currently a transmutation machine, Oddenstein claims that at various points it used to be a time travel machine, a dramatic lightning generator, and a "thing for generating monsters".
**Aggie, the witch who lives in Draynor Village, says that the machine was turning people into flying fish a few years ago.
*The portal machine, which has created an interdimensional rift to the Killerwatt plane.
*The Phantasmic Destabiliser Mark 500, used to get rid of ghosts, and later retrofitted into the Easter blaster.
*The security system in Nora T. Hagg's basement.

label: Protect from Magic
title: Protect from Magic
lead:
Protect from Magic is a protection prayer unlocked at level 37 Prayer that places a diagonal Magic spell bolt graphic above the player's head. Protect from Magic grants players 100% resistance to almost all NPC magic attacks, and 40% resistance to magic attacks dealt by players. With a prayer bonus of 0, It depletes prayer at a rate of 1 point per 3 seconds (or 5 game ticks).

If the player has this prayer active when they were hit by Tele Block, its potency is reduced by 50% making it last two minutes and thirty seconds compared to five whole minutes; but the chance of Tele Block splashing is unaffected.

label: Protect from Melee
title: Protect from Melee
lead:
Protect from Melee is an overhead Melee protection prayer accessible to players with a Prayer level of at least 43. The prayer allows the player to resist 100% of the incoming melee damage dealt by monsters and 40% of melee damage by other players. It depletes prayer at a rate of 1 point per 3 seconds (or 5 game ticks).

Tougher monsters, mainly PvM or certain quest bosses, are able to hit through this prayer or deal reduced damage (for example, Kruk from Monkey Madness II).

label: Protect from Missiles
title: Protect from Missiles
lead:
Protect from Missiles is an overhead Ranged protection prayer unlocked at level 40 Prayer. It offers players 100% resistance to most NPC ranged attacks, and 40% resistance to player-dealt ranged attacks. It depletes prayer at a rate of 1 point per 3 seconds (or 5 game ticks).

Certain NPCs may still ignore or partially bypass Protect from Missiles, such as Scions spawned during the Abyssal Sire fight, which will deal reduced damage with the prayer active.

label: Protect Item
title: Protect Item
lead:
Protect Item is a prayer unlocked at level 25 Prayer. If the player is skulled, it will allow the player to keep one item upon death, in most other situations it will allow four.

It cannot be used in high-risk worlds. Though Ultimate Ironmen can activate this prayer, they will not benefit from it.

label: Prototype dart
title: Prototype dart
lead:
The prototype dart is a quest item made during the Tourist Trap quest. It is made by smithing a prototype dart tip on an experimental anvil that is not visible on the Minimap. 10 Fletching experience is given after attaching the feather.

Should the player have a spare (via the drop trick) and speak to Al Shabim (after the quest section is complete or after completing the quest), he will confiscate the item and exclaim: Where did you get this from Effendi! I'll have to confiscate this for your own safety!

label: Prototype dart tip
title: Prototype dart tip
lead: A prototype dart tip is a quest item used in Tourist Trap. It can be made by using a bronze bar on an experimental anvil in the Bedabin Camp. If used on a feather, it will create a prototype dart.

label: Pumpkin
title: Pumpkin
lead:
Pumpkins are the first holiday food rare and second holiday rare to be dropped, the first being the scythe. Pumpkins can be obtained by completing one of the Halloween holiday events that occur once per year. This also rewards the player with all other holiday items associated with Halloween.

If you plan to sell your pumpkin, it is recommended that you put it in note form to avoid accidentally eating it.

label: Pungent pot
title: Pungent pot
lead:
The pungent pot is a quest item found at the murder scene during the Murder Mystery quest. It is later used as evidence during the murder investigation.

Using the pot on a barrel of flour will result in a message stating You probably shouldn't use evidence from a crime scene to keep flour in...

label: Purple boots
title: Purple boots
lead:
Purple boots can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The boots come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. They give the same stats as leather boots.

Unlike leather boots, these cannot be crafted. Because of their stats, they are mostly worn for cosmetic purposes.

label: Purple cape
title: Purple cape
lead: A purple cape is made by using purple dye on another coloured cape.

label: purple dye
title: purple dye
lead:
Purple dye is a dye made by combining blue dye and red dye, both of which may be made by Aggie in Draynor Village. It is used for colouring capes, granting 2.5 Crafting experience in the process, and for dying orange slices during Recipe for Disaster.

It respawns to the north of the Clock Tower, near the spirit tree, south of East Ardougne, as well as on a table on the top floor of the church in Hosidius. It can also be bought at Lletya Seamstress in Lletya. Players must have at least started the Mourning's End Part I quest to access this shop.

label: Purple flowers
title: Purple flowers
lead:
Purple flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Purple gloves
title: Purple gloves
lead:
Purple gloves can be purchased in Canifis from Barker at his store, Barker's Haberdashery, and are also dropped by Crawling Hands. The gloves come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. These gloves are often worn to match certain armour sets, such as gold-trimmed and god armour sets.

Their defence bonus is equal to that of leather gloves.

label: Purple hat
title: Purple hat
lead: Purple hats can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The hats come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Purple partyhat
title: Purple partyhat
lead:
Purple partyhats are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year.

Previously, they were obtainable during the 2013 Rare Drops event (from 4 July to 14 July) as part of a rare item drop.

label: Purple robe bottoms
title: Purple robe bottoms
lead: Purple robe bottoms can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe bottoms come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Purple robe top
title: Purple robe top
lead: Purple robe tops can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe tops come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Puzzle box
title: Puzzle box
lead:
Puzzle boxes can be obtained by doing hard, elite, and master Treasure Trails. Before you are able to continue with your clue scroll, you will have to complete the puzzle.

A puzzle box is always scrambled 101 times before being handed to the player, by randomly sliding a piece into the empty position starting from the solved state.

label: Quest (music track)
title: Quest (music track)
lead: Quest is a music track that is unlocked at the Fire Altar or Drumstick Isle.

label: Quest Complete 1
title: Quest Complete 1
lead: Quest Complete 1 is a Jingle that usually plays on Master Level quests.

label: Quest Complete 2
title: Quest Complete 2
lead: Quest Complete 2 is a Jingle that usually plays on Intermediate and Expert level quests.

label: Quest Complete 3
title: Quest Complete 3
lead: Quest Complete 3 is a Jingle that usually plays on Beginner or Easy level quests.

label: Quest Guide
title: Quest Guide
lead: The Quest Guide is the fourth non-player character whom players meet in Old School RuneScape. He gives players information about quests and the quest journal. He also explains the differences between free quests and members quests. He is only found on Tutorial Island, and can never be encountered again. During his lecture, he makes references to the quests Imp Catcher and Dragon Slayer I.

label: Radimus Erkle
title: Radimus Erkle
lead:
Radimus Erkle is the Grand Vizier of the Legends' Guild and is in charge of admissions into the guild. He is also the brother of Siegfried Erkle, who owns the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items.

He will send players off to complete the Legends' Quest as proof that they are worthy enough to enter the guild. After the quest, dark daggers can be freely reclaimed from him.

label: Radimus notes
title: Radimus notes
lead:
Radimus notes is a quest item given to the player by Radimus Erkle during the Legends' Quest and is needed to enter the Kharazi Jungle. The notes consist of an incomplete map of the Kharazi Jungle, which Radimus wants to have fully charted. The player must take the notes to the western, central and eastern parts of the jungle, and use the notes at each location with 3 papyrus and a piece of charcoal in their inventory. If you lose the notes at any time during the quest then you can talk to Radimus Erkle and pay 30 coins to get them back, though regardless of any previous progress they will be incomplete.

Once the map is completed, the player should give the notes to a Jungle Forester in exchange for a bullroarer. The Jungle Forester will copy them and return them so you can turn them in to Radimus at the end of the quest.

label: Raft (Hazeel Cult)
title: Raft (Hazeel Cult)
lead: The Raft is a transport object inside the Ardougne Sewers. It is used during the Hazeel Cult quest in order to travel through the sewer system.

label: Railing
title: Railing
lead:
A railing is a quest item used only in Dwarf Cannon. In the quest, six railings are obtained from Captain Lawgof and used to replace six bent railings in the fence surrounding the Coal Trucks. A hammer is also needed to repair the fence.

There is a chance to fail when repairing sections of the fence, and the player may receive small amounts of damage which will deal 1-2 Hitpoints. The player will also receive a message saying either You cut your hand on the rusty old railing., You strain your back trying to handle the railings., or You accidentally crush your hand in the railing.

label: Ranael
title: Ranael
lead: Ranael is a shopkeeper who runs a shop in Al Kharid that sells plateskirts in her shop, Ranael's Super Skirt Store, located in south-eastern Al Kharid.

label: Ranael's Super Skirt Store.
title: Ranael's Super Skirt Store.
lead: Ranael's Super Skirt Store is located in south-eastern Al Kharid. It sells plateskirts up to adamant. It is run by Ranael.

label: Ranalph Devere
title: Ranalph Devere
lead: Ranalph Devere is one of the three long-dead warriors alongside San Tojalon and Irvig Senay that are required to be killed to collect a piece of the heart crystal for the Legends' Quest. He is hostile until you kill him to obtain the lump of crystal, but you can still attack him afterwards and he will fight back. He attacks with melee.

label: Ranarr potion (unf)
title: Ranarr potion (unf)
lead: A ranarr potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a ranarr weed on a vial of water, requiring 30 Herblore. Using white berries on a ranarr potion (unf) with 30 Herblore yields a defence potion(3) and 75 Herblore experience. Using a snape grass on a ranarr potion (unf) with 38 Herblore yields a prayer potion(3) and 87.5 Herblore experience. In the Eadgar's Ruse quest, using ground thistle on a ranarr potion (unf) yields a troll potion and 77.5 Herblore experience.

label: Ranarr weed
title: Ranarr weed
lead:
Ranarr weed, commonly referred to simply as ranarr, is a herb that can be cleaned at level 25 Herblore. The herb can be grown by players with level 32 in Farming by planting ranarr seeds in herb patches. It's also an uncommon drop from various monsters. Despite being one of the lowest-level herbs available, ranarr is one of the most valuable herbs in the game, due to its role in making prayer potions.

Ranarr is one of three herbs with "weed" in its title, alongside snake weed and dwarf weed. According to Gielinor's Flora, the plant's name comes from the word "rana," meaning "eye-catching" in an ancient Kharidian language, and is considered a weed due to how fast it grows.

label: range
title: range
lead:
A range is used to cook food through the Cooking skill. Except for special cases, any food that can be cooked on a fire can be cooked on a range. To cook food, simply 'use' it on the range. Ranges are marked on a player's map by the icon. Clay ovens and ovens also serve the same function as a range.

Cooking on a range reduces the burn chance for certain foods. The range in Lumbridge Castle (referred to as the "Cook-o-matic 100"), which requires completion of Cook's Assistant to use, has an even lower burn rate for certain foods. Lastly, the clay ovens in the Hosidius Kitchen give the best reduction in burn rates, provided the player has completed the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary.

label: Ranged
title: Ranged
lead:
Ranged is one of the three combat classes in Old School RuneScape. It involves using bows, crossbows, blowpipes, and thrown weapons to damage opponents from a distance, and Ranged armour can mostly be made from animal hides. Players who specialise in this skill are known as rangers or archers.

The combat triangle dictates that rangers are strong against mages but weak against melee fighters.

label: Ranged Level Up!
title: Ranged Level Up!
lead: Ranged Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Ranged.

label: Ranged Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Ranged Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Ranged Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Ranged.

label: Ranger boots
title: Ranger boots
lead:
Ranger boots are a rare reward received from the completion of medium Treasure Trails. It is part of the ranger kit, and requires 40 Ranged to wear; it can also be stored in a treasure chest. Ranger boots are the third best Ranged footwear in terms of ranged attack bonus.

The drop rate of ranger boots is 1/1,133 per slot. With each medium clue reward, a player will receive 3-5 slots of items; this makes the effective drop rate ~1/283.6 per casket. The ranger boots are the most valuable drop from medium clues.

label: Ranging Guild
title: Ranging Guild
lead: The Ranging Guild is an encampment located between Seers' Village and East Ardougne. Level 40 Ranged is required to enter, though this can be boosted. Inside, there are several shops, a minigame, and a training area.

label: Ranging Guild Doorman
title: Ranging Guild Doorman
lead: The Ranging Guild Doorman is a man who stands outside the entrance to the Ranging Guild. He makes sure that no-one can enter the guild unless they have at least level 40 Ranging. He looks identical to the guards found throughout the Ranging Guild.

label: Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange
title: Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange
lead:
The Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange is an archery shop in the Ranging Guild that sells Ranged equipment in exchange for Archery tickets.

You buy the whole quantity of items for the indicated price. That is, for example, you buy 30 Barb bolttips at once for 140 Archery tickets.

label: ranging potion
title: ranging potion
lead:
A ranging potion is a potion made by using a wine of Zamorak on a dwarf weed potion (unf), requiring 72 Herblore, yielding a ranging potion(3) and 162.5 Herblore experience. A dose of ranging potion provides a temporary skill boost to Ranged equal to 4 + 10% of the player's current Ranged level, rounded down, and will wear off at a rate of 1 level every 60 seconds (90 with preserve).

Crystal dust may be added to ranging potion, 1 dust per dose of potion, to make a divine ranging potion, requiring 74 Herblore.

label: Rantuki Tribe
title: Rantuki Tribe
lead:
The Rantuki Tribe is one of many elusive and nomadic tribes native to the tropical island of Karamja, found in the central Ardent Ocean. The Rantuki are mostly jungle-dwellers, living primarily in the isolated jungles of the island's southern regions, remaining out of sight.

The Rantuki have managed to remain hidden for decades without problems, and a member of the tribe, Kangai Mau, only recently revealed the tribe's existence as he needed help to reclaim a totem stolen by the East Ardougne noble Lord Kurt Francis Handelmort. This event plays a central role, as does Kangai Mau, in the Tribal Totem quest.

label: Rantz
title: Rantz
lead: Rantz is an ogre who lives in a cave in the eastern part of Feldip Hills with his children, Fycie and Bugs. He is located at the only quest start icon in that area, and is first encountered during the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. After the quest, players can kill chompies to claim Rantz's feather hats.

label: Rantz's cave
title: Rantz's cave
lead:
Rantz's cave is a cave in which Rantz and his children Fycie and Bugs live. It's located in the eastern part of the Feldip Hills, north-east of the fairy ring (code ). The cave is featured in the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest.

The Locked Ogre chest can be found inside the cave, which players can open and search for ogre bellows.

label: Rapid Heal
title: Rapid Heal
lead:
Rapid Heal is a prayer unlocked at level 22 Prayer. Rapid Heal doubles the natural regeneration rate of the player's Hitpoints to 1 Hitpoint per 30 seconds instead of the natural rate of 1 Hitpoint per minute. This does not stack with the Hitpoints cape perk, but does stack with the regen bracelet to regenerate 2 Hitpoints per 30 seconds.

Activating or deactivating Rapid Heal resets the countdown timer natural health regeneration to 30 seconds or 60 seconds, respectively. This effect can be useful in places such as Nightmare Zone, to prevent health regeneration, or to reset the timer for overhealing (such as with anglerfish) to prevent Hitpoints from decreasing.

label: Rapid Restore
title: Rapid Restore
lead:
Rapid Restore is a prayer unlocked at level 19 Prayer that doubles the restore rate of all reduced stats except for Hitpoints and Prayer.

The prayer will restore reduced stats every 60 seconds starting from the moment it is activated. Its timer is completely independent from the normal timer used to restore reduced stats. Rapid Restore can be useful for restoring stats that are reduced by a small amount, such as the Attack penalty after drinking beer. For quickly restoring heavily reduced stats, restore potions or super restores may be a more effective choice.

label: Rashiliyia
title: Rashiliyia
lead:
Queen Rashiliyia, wife of King Danthalas, mother of Bervirius, is the ghost who sent the undead ones to Shilo Village. 
Rashiliyia was a powerful sorceress and queen of an unknown kingdom on Karamja during the Third Age. Rashiliyia was in love with Zadimus, a high priest of Zamorak, who resided in the magnificent temple of Ah Za Rhoon. When Zadimus rejected her, she tortured and hanged him before collapsing the entire temple.

After her son Bervirius was killed in battle, she swore fealty to Zamorak, the god of chaos, if he would return her son to her. Zamorak returned her son as an undead, who terrorised her and her husband and apparently went on a rampage, killing several guards, before being killed by fire.

label: Rashiliyia corpse
title: Rashiliyia corpse
lead: The rashiliyia corpse is a quest item used in the Shilo Village quest. It is obtained near the end of the quest by defeating the three forms of Nazastarool in the tomb of Rashiliyia. The corpse must then be placed upon the dolmen within the Tomb of Bervirius, located underneath Cairn Isle, to complete the quest.

label: Rashiliyia's Tomb
title: Rashiliyia's Tomb
lead: Rashiliyia's Tomb is the final burial ground for the zombie queen, Rashiliyia. The tomb is visited during the Shilo Village quest, where it was taken over by Nazastarool. After the quest, the dungeon is filled with undead ones. If you are inside without wearing Beads of the Dead, Rashiliyia will appear, briefly attack, and summon two level 68 and one level 73 undead ones.

label: Rat
title: Rat
lead:
Rats are small animals commonly found throughout Gielinor, mostly in cities, sewers, and dungeons. They respawn rapidly, and are not marked on the minimap.

Although most rats have no drops, the rats in the Stronghold of Security have a 100% chance to drop bones when killed by the player.

label: rat poison
title: rat poison
lead:
Rat poison is a quest item used in Clock Tower and Ratcatchers.

In the Clock Tower quest, players can pick up the rat poison spawn in the basement of the Clock Tower before retrieving the white cog. It is used on the rats' feeding trough to poison them, killing them, thus opening the western door to pick up the white cog.

label: Rat's tail
title: Rat's tail
lead:
A Rat's tail is a quest item used in the Witch's Potion quest. It can be obtained by killing any standard rat after the player has begun Witch's Potion. The item has a 100% chance to drop once you begin the quest.

Brian's Archery Supplies, a store that sells Ranged supplies, has a couple of rats which are very convenient for the player, since the store is located near Hetty the Witch's house.

label: Raw anchovies
title: Raw anchovies
lead: Raw anchovies are a fish that require a Fishing level of at least 15 to be caught. Doing so requires a small fishing net, and grants 40 Fishing experience. This makes anchovies a useful source of Fishing experience for players looking to train Fishing from level 15 to 20. Raw anchovies can be bought from Charley in Mos Le'Harmless for 16 coins.

label: Raw bass
title: Raw bass
lead:
A raw bass can be caught by players with a Fishing level of 46 or higher using a big fishing net at a fishing spot, this cannot be boosted. Doing so yields 100 Fishing experience per bass caught. They can be cooked into bass with a Cooking level of 43.

It is also possible for players to catch a big bass which can be stuffed by the taxidermist in Canifis and subsequently displayed in the Skill Hall of one's player-owned house.

label: Raw batta
title: Raw batta
lead:
A raw batta is created by adding gianne dough to a batta tin. It can be cooked on a range to create a half baked batta.

Unlike other items requiring a range, raw batta cannot be cooked using Mor Ul Rek sulphur vents.

label: Raw bear meat
title: Raw bear meat
lead:
Raw bear meat can be obtained by killing any bear (except Callisto or Artio), or by purchasing it from Rufus in Canifis. It is dipped in the Cauldron of Thunder during the Druidic Ritual quest. It can be cooked at level 1 Cooking, granting 30 Cooking experience if successful. After successfully cooking it, it will simply be cooked meat, burning it will result in burnt meat (burning can be achieved at any level by cooking it twice). The raw bear meat can also be made into sinew at level 1 Cooking by using it on a range.

Bears can be found throughout Gielinor, mainly in woodland areas such as near Castle Wars, south of Yanille and in a cage in Varrock castle. To get to this a player must go through the Varrock Sewers. A single black bear can be found south of the South-east Varrock mining site, along with two unicorns. Another good place to kill bears is north-east of Ardougne, near the Legends' Guild.

label: Raw beef
title: Raw beef
lead: Raw beef is an uncooked food. Raw beef is one of the requirements of the Druidic Ritual quest. Players require only level 1 Cooking to cook raw beef. It gives 30 Cooking experience when cooked. When cooked, the raw beef may become cooked meat or burnt meat. Players can buy it from Rufus' Meat Emporium in Canifis and from Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim. Raw beef is always dropped from cows. Members can convert raw beef into sinew by using it on a range and choosing the "Make sinew" option.

label: Raw chicken
title: Raw chicken
lead:
A Raw chicken is an uncooked food item dropped by chickens or roosters. They are also sold at Rufus' Meat Emporium in Canifis and Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim.

There is also a crate in Wydin's shop in Port Sarim that provides unlimited raw chicken. A white apron is required to enter the room which contains the crate.

label: Raw chompy
title: Raw chompy
lead:
A raw chompy is obtained by killing a chompy bird. It can be cooked on an iron spit or at the ogre spit-roast near Rantz's cave, to make cooked chompy. Failure to cook it properly will result in a ruined chompy. Raw chompy is one of the three main ingredients in a wild pie.

The ability to hunt chompies is unlocked during the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. They are also used in the quest Recipe for Disaster during the portion where Skrach Uglogwee needs to be freed.

label: Raw cod
title: Raw cod
lead:
Raw cod is a fish that can be caught with a big fishing net at any fishing spot. It requires a Fishing level of 23 to catch and grants 45 fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into cod with level 18 Cooking. The most common spot to fish cod is Catherby.

Raw cod is used for the Freeing Pirate Pete section of the Recipe for Disaster quest. It is also used for the Cold War quest, but it can be substituted with the use of the activated Ring of Charos.

label: Raw crunchies
title: Raw crunchies
lead:
Raw crunchies are obtained by using gianne dough on a crunchy tray. They can be used on a range to make half baked crunchies.

Unlike other items requiring a range, raw crunchies cannot be cooked using Mor Ul Rek sulphur vents.

label: Raw giant carp
title: Raw giant carp
lead:
A raw giant carp is a quest item used only in Fishing Contest. It requires Level 10 Fishing and is caught with a fishing rod and red vine worms after stuffing the pipe with a garlic.

It is given to Bonzo in order to win the Fishing trophy.

label: Raw gnomebowl
title: Raw gnomebowl
lead:
Raw gnomebowls are the base of gnomebowl cooking and are obtained by using gianne dough on a gnomebowl mould. They can be used on a range to make half baked bowls.

Unlike other items requiring a range, raw gnomebowls cannot be cooked using Mor Ul Rek sulphur vents.

label: Raw herring
title: Raw herring
lead:
Raw herring is an item that is obtained through the Fishing skill by using a fishing rod with fishing bait on a net/bait fishing spot using the bait option. Herrings can only be caught in fishing spots by the sea. Catching a raw herring grants 30 Fishing experience. It can be cooked into herring with a Cooking level of 5, granting 50 Cooking experience.

This fish can be caught at level 10 Fishing and cooked at level 5 Cooking.

label: Raw lava eel
title: Raw lava eel
lead:
Raw lava eels require level 53 Fishing to catch, and a Cooking level of 53 to cook. Raw lava eels may be caught using an oily fishing rod and bait in the lava rivers found in Taverley Dungeon, the Wilderness Lava Maze, or the Charred Dungeon (level 60 Sailing).

Players who wish to reside in Taverley Dungeon for extensive periods of time can bring equipment (logs, tinderbox, oily fishing rod and bait) to fish and cook the lava eels to produce food for combat. This is especially true for players on a Slayer task for black demons or blue dragons.

label: Raw lobster
title: Raw lobster
lead:
A raw lobster is a type of crustacean which can be caught at level 40 Fishing with a lobster pot, resulting in 90 Fishing experience. It can be cooked into lobster at level 40 Cooking, yielding 120 Cooking experience. Starting at level 74 Cooking, raw lobsters will no longer burn; wearing cooking gauntlets reduces this threshold to 64 Cooking instead.

Raw lobster is also used in Creature Creation together with a raw jubbly to make a jubster.

label: Raw mackerel
title: Raw mackerel
lead: Raw mackerel is a fish that can be caught with a big fishing net at any big net fishing spot. It requires a Fishing level of 16 to catch and can be cooked into mackerel with level 10 Cooking. The most common spot to fish mackerel is Catherby. There's a possibility that 10 raw mackerel will be required for a part in the quest In Aid of the Myreque.

label: Raw manta ray
title: Raw manta ray
lead:
Raw manta ray are fish that can be obtained with level 81 Fishing. They can be caught while playing the Fishing Trawler, from the Tempoross Reward pool, or while drift net fishing at Fossil Island with 90 Fishing, which cannot be boosted. They are also a possible reward from a bowl of fish bought from Mairin's Market. They can be cooked into manta rays with 91 Cooking, giving 216.3 experience.

Wearing the Cooking cape while cooking manta rays will prevent players from burning them.

label: Raw oomlie
title: Raw oomlie
lead:
Raw oomlie may be obtained by killing the oomlie birds found in the depths of the Kharazi Jungle, south of Shilo Village. To get into the Kharazi Jungle, the player must have started Legends' Quest. At 50 Cooking, it can be wrapped in a palm leaf to get a wrapped oomlie, which can then be cooked to get a cooked oomlie wrap.

Wrapping it in a palm leaf is required to cook it; the raw oomlie cannot be cooked on its own. Attempting to do so will always fail (even with a cooking cape), resulting in a burnt oomlie, with the message You cook the Oomlie Meat on the fire..., and after the player burns it, "The meat is far too delicate to cook like this. Perhaps you should wrap it up to protect it from the heat."

label: Raw pike
title: Raw pike
lead:
Raw pike are fish that can be caught with a Fishing level of 25, granting 60 fishing experience per catch. They can be cooked into pike with a Cooking level of 20. Successfully cooking a raw pike gives 80 Cooking experience. Raw pike are caught through bait fishing, which requires a fishing rod and bait.

The fish are caught with the bait option at lure/bait fishing spots found in rivers. While fishing there, a roll is made every 5 ticks (3 seconds) to catch a pike, although there is a 1/5 chance the interval is increased by 1 tick to 6 ticks (3.6 seconds) instead with the casting animation happening twice, one tick apart.

label: Raw rat meat
title: Raw rat meat
lead:
Raw rat meat is usually obtained by killing a giant rat. It can be cooked on a range or on a fire. It requires level 1 Cooking to be turned into Cooked meat, granting 30 Cooking experience if successful. It is one of the four raw meats needed in the Druidic Ritual quest. It can be used as bait when trapping sabre-toothed kebbits. Raw rat meat can be bought from Rufus in Canifis. Unlike raw beef, raw boar meat, and raw bear meat, raw rat meat cannot be turned into sinew.

If looking for a giant rat to kill, level 3 giant rats are common in Lumbridge Swamp and always drop raw rat meat. The level 6 giant rat in Lumbridge Swamp, the giant rat near the mine south-east of Varrock and the giant rats in the Stronghold of Security rarely drop rat meat.

label: Raw salmon
title: Raw salmon
lead: Raw salmon are fish that can be caught with a Fishing level of 30, granting 70 Fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into salmon with a Cooking level of 25. Players will stop burning salmon unaided at a Cooking level of 58 or 55 when using the Lumbridge Castle range. Successfully cooking a salmon yields 90 Cooking experience. Raw salmon are caught through fly fishing, which requires a Fishing level of 30, a fly fishing rod, and feathers. The fish are caught with the lure option at Lure/Bait fishing spots found in rivers. Fly fishing trout and salmon is a very common way for players to train Fishing quickly.

label: Raw sardine
title: Raw sardine
lead:
Raw sardines are fish that require a Fishing level of 5 to catch by using a normal fishing rod on a bait fishing spot, by the sea. Fishing bait is required in the inventory, one being used for each catch, which yields 20 Fishing experience. Raw sardines may be cooked at level 1 Cooking to produce cooked sardines.

In the quest Gertrude's Cat, players have to rub a sardine with doogle leaves to feed Gertrude's lost cat. This creates a seasoned sardine.

label: Raw sea turtle
title: Raw sea turtle
lead:
Raw sea turtle are fish that can be obtained with level 79 Fishing. They can be caught while playing the Fishing Trawler minigame, from the Tempoross Reward pool, or while drift net fishing at Fossil Island with 80 Fishing, which cannot be boosted. They are also a possible reward from a bowl of fish bought from Mairin's Market. They can be cooked into sea turtles with 82 Cooking, giving 211.3 experience.

With level 99 Cooking, about 23% of sea turtles will be burnt. Wearing the Cooking cape while cooking sea turtles will prevent players from burning them.

label: Raw shark
title: Raw shark
lead:
Raw sharks can be fished with a harpoon with level 76 Fishing. They require level 80 Cooking to cook into sharks and heal 20 Hitpoints each. Raw sharks can be caught at many net/harpoon fishing spots with locations including the Fishing Guild, Catherby, Burgh de Rott, Rellekka, Iorwerth Camp, East of Hosidius, Jatizso, Isle of Souls, Gwenith, and Salvager Overlook. Raw sharks can also be caught without using a harpoon at level 96 Fishing and 76 Strength by starting the second part of barbarian fishing with Otto Godblessed. The rate at which they are caught can be increased with the use of shark lure, but doing so will reduce the experience gained.

A single raw shark can also be bought at Rufus' Meat Emporium in Canifis for 221 coins. 25 raw sharks can be bought at Frankie's Fishing Emporium starting at 170 coins.

label: Raw shrimps
title: Raw shrimps
lead: Raw shrimps can be caught at 1 Fishing with a small fishing net at a net fishing spot, granting 10 experience per catch. They can be cooked into shrimps at level 1 Cooking, granting 30 Cooking experience when successful. Raw shrimps can be used as a source of food for a growing kitten.

label: Raw shrimps (Tutorial Island)
title: Raw shrimps (Tutorial Island)
lead:
Raw shrimps are a unique variant of raw shrimps that can only be obtained on Tutorial Island. They are obtained by fishing at a Tutorial Island fishing spot. The Survival Expert teaches the player how to fish for shrimp using a small fishing net; they must catch and cook some shrimp in order to proceed to the next part of the tutorial.

A second variant of the raw shrimps could be obtained from the alternate Tutorial Island available to some players in 2020.

label: Raw swamp paste
title: Raw swamp paste
lead:
Raw swamp paste can be made by mixing flour with swamp tar. Raw swamp paste can be cooked on a fire (not a range) to create swamp paste, giving 2 Cooking experience. It is possible to burn the paste, resulting in the player discarding the burnt tar.

Swamp tar can be found in Lumbridge Swamp and in Mort Myre Swamp.

label: Raw swordfish
title: Raw swordfish
lead:
A raw swordfish is a type of fish that players can catch at level 50 Fishing with a harpoon at cage and harpoon fishing spots, and can be cooked at level 45 Cooking. It also can be obtained at level 60 fishing while drift net fishing which cannot be boosted.

Catching a swordfish grants 100 Fishing experience. Fishing for swordfish takes longer than lobsters because Tuna is caught along with it. Free players fishing on Karamja generally drop their tuna (often cooking it first for the experience), but the members-only fishing spots in Catherby, Port Piscarilius, Jatizso, and the Fishing Guild are close enough to banks that it is actually faster for players to bank the raw tuna than to drop it, additionally, the Fishing Guild gives an invisible +7 fishing boost. Cooking Swordfish will grant 140 experience.

label: Raw trout
title: Raw trout
lead:
Raw trout are fish that can be caught by luring Lure/Bait fishing spots with a Fishing level of 20, granting 50 Fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into trout with a Cooking level of 15. Players will stop burning trout at level 49 if using a range, or 50 if using a fire. Successfully cooking a raw trout gives 70 Cooking experience.

Raw trout are caught through fly fishing, which requires a fly fishing rod and feathers. This method can also net salmon at the appropriate Fishing level. The fish are caught with the lure option at Lure/Bait fishing spots found in rivers.

label: Raw tuna
title: Raw tuna
lead:
Raw tuna is a type of fish, obtained by harpoon fishing at a cage/harpoon fishing spot. Raw tuna require 35 Fishing to catch and award the player 80 experience when caught. They can be sold, or cooked with a Cooking level of 30 to produce tuna, granting 100 experience in Cooking and will no longer be burned after level 63. The cooked version is often used by mid-levelled players when training combat.

Raw tuna can also be bought from Flosi Dalksson in Jatizso or thieved from the Fish stalls in The Warrens, Rellekka, Miscellania, and Etceteria, requiring a Thieving level of 42.

label: Raw ugthanki meat
title: Raw ugthanki meat
lead: Raw ugthanki meat can be obtained by killing an ugthanki. It can be cooked at level 1 Cooking, granting 40 Cooking experience if successful. After successfully cooking it, it will be ugthanki meat. Burning it will result in burnt meat. The raw ugthanki meat cannot be made into sinew, and cannot be cooked twice to create burnt meat.

label: recess
title: recess
lead:
The recess is a scenery object found in the Viyeldi Caves during and after the Legends' Quest. It is located to the right of the shimmering field which connects with the area containing 3 lesser demons.

If the heart crystal is used on it, it will turn into the Filled Recess, and the shimmering field can be passed through.

label: Recruiter
title: Recruiter
lead:
The Recruiter is found in the city square of West Ardougne. He tries to recruit the citizens of West Ardougne into King Tyras's army. Due to Tyras being unpopular and hated among the people of West Ardougne, his job has been a really tough one as he is pelted with tomatoes whenever he mentions Tyras. Apparently, the Recruiter is not aware of the death of King Tyras, which occurs during Regicide.

After the events of the Ardougne Revolution and Song of the Elves, he can no longer be found anywhere.

label: red bead
title: red bead
lead:
The red bead is a bead used in Imp Catcher quest. It is a drop from Imps and is returned to Wizard Mizgog in the Wizards' Tower along with Black bead, White bead and Yellow bead to finish the quest.

The bead can also be used to bait traps when hunting imps.

label: Red boots
title: Red boots
lead:
Red boots can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The boots come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. They give the same stats as leather boots.

Unlike leather boots, these cannot be crafted. Because of their stats, they are mostly worn for cosmetic purposes.

label: Red cape
title: Red cape
lead: A red cape can be made by using red dye on another coloured cape, or purchased from Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock or Barkers' Haberdashery in Canifis.

label: Red cog
title: Red cog
lead:
The red cog is a quest item used only in Clock Tower. It is found in a room with three ogres in the Clock Tower's basement.

It is used to repair the northern red clock spindle on the .

label: Red d'hide body
title: Red d'hide body
lead:
A red d'hide body is red dragonhide armour equipped in the body slot, requiring 60 Ranged and 40 Defence.

Although the Dragon Slayer I quest must be completed to equip the green d'hide body, it is not required to equip the blue d'hide body, red d'hide body, or black d'hide body.

label: Red d'hide chaps
title: Red d'hide chaps
lead:
Red d'hide chaps are a piece of the red dragonhide armour set, and require level 60 Ranged to wear. Similarly to other dragonhide chaps, they have no Defence level requirement.

A player with 75 Crafting can make them using 2 red dragon leather and 1 thread with a needle, granting 156 experience.

label: Red d'hide vambraces
title: Red d'hide vambraces
lead:
Red d'hide vambraces are a piece of red dragonhide armour worn in the hand slot that requires a Ranged level of 60 to equip.

Kebbit claws can be used on these vambraces to make red spiky vambraces, requiring a Crafting level of 73.

label: Red door
title: Red door
lead: The Red doors are located on of Melzar's Maze. They must be opened during Dragon Slayer I, using a red key obtained from killing the nearby Zombie rat with a long tail.

label: red dragon
title: red dragon
lead:
Red dragons are second-to-most powerful of the adult chromatic dragons. As with all adult dragons, an anti-dragon shield and/or antifire potion is essential when fighting them to mitigate damage from their dragonfire. The red dragonhides and dragon bones that they drop are worth substantial amounts of money.

The ability to be assigned red dragons can be purchased for 50 Slayer reward points. Once unlocked, they can be disabled, but players must spend another 50 points to unlock them again. Killing brutal red dragons in the Catacombs of Kourend will also count toward a red dragon task. One Red Dragon is fought during Dragon Slayer II.

label: Red dragon leather
title: Red dragon leather
lead: Red dragon leather is used in the Crafting skill to make red dragonhide armour. It can be created by giving a red dragonhide and 20 coins to a tanner. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Canifis, Forthos Dungeon, Crafting Guild, Kebos Lowlands, and Auburnvale. The last two tanners require the completion of Getting Ahead and children of the Sun, respectively. Alternatively, red dragon leather can be made using the Tan Leather spell. Crafting any piece of red dragonhide armour will grant the player 78 experience per hide.

label: Red dragonhide
title: Red dragonhide
lead:
Red dragonhide (also called Red d'hide by tanners) is a 100% drop from red dragons when they die. The hide can be tanned to become red dragon leather by paying a tanner or by using the Tan Leather lunar spell. A tanner will charge 20 coins for each hide, or 45 in Canifis. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Canifis, Forthos Dungeon, and the Crafting Guild.

Players can then make red dragonhide armour from red dragon leather via the Crafting skill if they have a high enough level.

label: red dye
title: red dye
lead:
Red dye is a dye created by taking 3 redberries to Aggie in Draynor Village along with 5 coins or Ali the dyer in Pollnivneach along with 25 coins. It can also be bought in Lletya from Oronwen for 6 coins. It can also be found in the Sisterhood Sanctuary in Slepe, as well as in the farmhouse featured in Getting Ahead, south of the Farming Guild, located in the shelves next to the stairs in the house.

Red dye can be combined with yellow dye to make orange dye, or with blue dye to make purple dye. It can be used to dye normal capes red. Red dye is used in Enlightened Journey, Getting Ahead, Song of the Elves, and Goblin Diplomacy if making orange dye. It is also a possible required item for Ghosts Ahoy because the colour needed is random.

label: Red flowers
title: Red flowers
lead:
Red flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Red gloves
title: Red gloves
lead:
Red gloves can be purchased in Canifis from Barker at his store, Barker's Haberdashery, and are also dropped by Crawling Hands. The gloves come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. These gloves are often worn to match certain armour sets, such as gold-trimmed and god armour sets.

Their defence bonus is equal to that of leather gloves.

label: Red halloween mask
title: Red halloween mask
lead:
The Red halloween mask is a tradeable cosmetic item. Red halloween masks can be obtained by completing one of the Halloween holiday events that occur once per year. This also rewards the player with all other holiday items associated with Halloween.

After the playerbase was polled, it was decided that all tradeable rares will be distributed during their corresponding holiday events thus making them seasonal rares and not completely rare, this to prevent them from being worth hundreds of millions of coins again, like in RuneScape 3.

label: Red hat
title: Red hat
lead: Red hats can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The hats come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Red headband
title: Red headband
lead: The red headband is a members only item worn on the head. There are no requirements to wear it and it does not offer any combat bonuses.

label: Red partyhat
title: Red partyhat
lead:
Red partyhats are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year.

Previously, they were obtainable during the 2013 Rare Drops event (from 4 July to 14 July) as part of a rare item drop.

label: Red robe bottoms
title: Red robe bottoms
lead: Red robe bottoms can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe bottoms come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Red robe top
title: Red robe top
lead: Red robe tops can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe tops come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Red Sheep
title: Red Sheep
lead:
Red Sheep are sick sheep found near the East Ardougne north bank that must be prodded with the cattleprod to the sheep pen and fed the poisoned sheep feed during the Sheep Herder quest. Its wool is slightly reddish. Once killed, it drops the sheep bones (1).

After Mourning's End Part I, the sheep are of a darker red as a result of the player dyeing them with a Fixed device loaded with a Red toad. Once dyed, they can no longer be prodded or interacted with in any way. Players only need to dye one, and all the sheep of the same colour turn more saturated. This is how players can tell they haven't missed the sheep during the quest.

label: Red spiders' eggs
title: Red spiders' eggs
lead:
Red spiders' eggs are a Herblore ingredient that members can use to make one of three different potions. Those with level 22 Herblore can combine them with a harralander potion (unf) (made by adding harralander to a vial of water) to make a restore potion and gain 62.5 experience points. Those with level 63 Herblore can combine the eggs with a snapdragon potion (unf) (made by adding snapdragon to a vial of water) to make a super restore potion and gain 142.5 experience. Those with level 73 herblore can combine the eggs with coconut milk and a cactus spine to make weapon poison(+) and gain 190 experience.

All players can give red spiders' eggs along with a limpwurt root and 5 coins to the apothecary in Varrock, and he will give them a 4-dose strength potion in return.

label: Red topaz
title: Red topaz
lead:
Red topaz is a semi-precious gem used mainly in Crafting. It can be cut from uncut red topaz with a chisel at level 16 Crafting, yielding 25 experience. There is a chance to unsuccessfully cut the red topaz, resulting in a crushed gem and 6.3 experience.

3 red topaz can be given to Safta Doc alongside a gout tuber and 1,200 trading sticks in exchange for a red topaz machete.

label: Red vine worm
title: Red vine worm
lead:
The red vine worm is used in the Fishing Contest quest to catch the giant carp that wins the contest. They also may be needed to make a pair of magic secateurs in the quest A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains, and can be possible a clue for finding Solus Dellagar in the quest Wanted!.

They are obtained by digging with spade near the red vines that can be found in McGrubor's Wood. The fairy ring code can be used to quickly reach the vines.

label: Redbeard Frank
title: Redbeard Frank
lead: Redbeard Frank is a pirate featured in Pirate's Treasure. During the quest, players must smuggle Karamjan rum onto the mainland for Frank, who has offered them access to Hector's old treasure in exchange. Players must smuggle the illegal drink in on a banana shipment from Luthas's plantation in Musa Point, Karamja.

label: Redberries
title: Redberries
lead:
Redberries can be harvested from a bush patch after planting redberry seeds or picked from wild redberry bushes. They are used in Cooking to make redberry pies or to create dyes.

Redberries themselves cannot be eaten, despite being used in Cooking. Adding them to a compost bin makes regular compost.

label: Redberry pie
title: Redberry pie
lead:
Redberry pies are a type of pie that restores 10 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 5. A pie dish will remain after both bites. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked berry pie on a cooking range, requiring level 10 Cooking and granting 78 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt pie. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Redberry pie is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 45, or 42 when using the Lumbridge range. Alternatively, casting the Bake Pie spell from the lunar spellbook will always create a pie without burning it.

A redberry pie is required in the quests The Knight's Sword, The Giant Dwarf, and Prying Times and is a possible task from Romily Weaklax in the Cooks' Guild.

label: Regal
title: Regal
lead:
Regal is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the Rogues' Castle.

label: Reggae
title: Reggae
lead:
Reggae is a music track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 1, Jungly 2, Jungly 3, Jungle Troubles, Reggae 2, Tribal and Tribal 2.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked in the south-east of the Kharazi Jungle.

label: Reggae 2
title: Reggae 2
lead:
Reggae 2 is a music track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 1, Jungly 2, Jungly 3, Jungle Troubles, Reggae, Tribal and Tribal 2.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle west of the Ship Yard.

label: Reldo
title: Reldo
lead: Reldo Trimmly is the librarian of Varrock Palace. He starts the Shield of Arrav quest, and plays small roles in other quests, such as The Knight's Sword, Defender of Varrock, The Lost Tribe, and Dragon Slayer II.

label: Relic part 1
title: Relic part 1
lead:
The relic part 1 is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest. When combined with Relic part 2 and Relic part 3 it forms an Ogre relic which can be used to access the ogre town of Gu'Tanoth.

To obtain Relic part 1 the player must retrieve a bar of gold that Toban stole from Og.

label: Relic part 2
title: Relic part 2
lead:
The relic part 2 is a quest item in the Watchtower quest. Combining it with the relic part 1 and relic part 3 makes the ogre relic required to access the ogre town of Gu'Tanoth.

To obtain it, the player must defeat Gorad and return his Ogre tooth to Grew.

label: Relic part 3
title: Relic part 3
lead: The relic part 3 is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest. When combined with Relic part 1 and Relic part 2 it forms an Ogre relic which can be used to access the ogre town of Gu'Tanoth. To obtain Relic part 3 the player must give the ogre Toban a dragon bone.

label: Remsai
title: Remsai
lead: Remsai is a gnome in the Tree Gnome Village. He is not involved in any quests. After completing Tree Gnome Village, however, he will tell the player that they are a legend within the Tree Gnome Village.

label: Renegade knight
title: Renegade knight
lead: Renegade knights are knights devoted to serving the evil sorceress Morgan Le Faye. They imprisoned the Knights of the Round Table and Merlin during King's Ransom. They can be accessed by taking the crate behind the candle shop in Catherby after the quest Merlin's Crystal.

label: Repaired leak
title: Repaired leak
lead: Repaired leaks are found all the way along the sides of the hull of the Fishing Trawler. When the hole leaks, a swamp paste can be used on the hole to repair it, so that it is again a repaired leak.

label: Research notes (Rune Mysteries)
title: Research notes (Rune Mysteries)
lead: Research notes are obtained in Rune Mysteries from Aubury after players give them the research package. They must then be given to Archmage Sedridor to complete the quest. There is no other use for this item.

label: Research package
title: Research package
lead:
A Research package is an item that players must deliver to Aubury in the quest Rune Mysteries. It is obtained from Archmage Sedridor. If a player dies while having the research package in their inventory, Sedridor will give the player a replacement.

If the player leaves the item in their bank and asks Sedridor for another, he will provide one and the copy in the bank will be removed.

label: Restless ghost
title: Restless ghost
lead: The restless ghost is the ghost main character of The Restless Ghost quest. Talking to him requires a ghostspeak amulet obtained from Father Urhney, who lives in a shack on the other side of the Lumbridge Swamp. He will say that a warlock stole his skull from the coffin. The ghost's skull is on an altar in the basement of the Wizards' Tower. Upon returning his skull to coffin, he will thank the player and disappear into the River Lum. Should the player see the ghost after that, he will not be interested in talking.

label: Restore potion
title: Restore potion
lead:
A restore potion is a potion made by using red spiders' eggs on a harralander potion (unf), requiring 22 Herblore, yielding a restore potion(3) and 62.5 Herblore experience. A dose of restore potion restores levels of temporarily reduced stats in Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, and Magic equal to 10 + 30% of the related maximum level, rounded down, for each skill. It does not restore Prayer points or any other skill that is not listed like a super restore. Restore potions will not boost any skill above its base level, even if the listed restore is greater than the current reduction.

After partial completion of the In Aid of the Myreque quest, garlic can be added to a restore potion(3), requiring 22 Herblore, yielding a Guthix balance (unf) and 25 Herblore experience.

label: Right eye patch
title: Right eye patch
lead:
A right eye patch is an item commonly worn by pirates, and can be obtained as a drop from them. An eye patch can be bought from the Fancy Dress Shop or Trader Stan's Trading Post. When equipped, the eye patch takes place in the head slot, which means players may not wear a helmet or any other headgear at the same time.

Players who have completed Cabin Fever can pay Patchy 500 coins to sew together an eye patch and pirate bandana to create a bandana eyepatch. Players can also bring Patchy an eye patch and pirate's hat, to create a hat eyepatch, or a big pirate hat and eye patch to create a pirate hat & patch. It is also possible to ask Patchy to combine this item with a left eye patch to create a double eye patch. A book o' piracy is not required.

label: Righteousness
title: Righteousness
lead: Righteousness is a music track that is unlocked at the Law Altar.

label: Rimmington
title: Rimmington
lead: Rimmington is a small village in south-west Asgarnia. In addition to playing a role in several quests, the village is popular for its player-owned house portal, which players use to train Prayer by un-noting bones with Phials and then using them on a gilded altar.

label: Rimmington church
title: Rimmington church
lead:
The Rimmington church, often called the Port Sarim church due to its proximity to the Port Sarim jail, is a church visited by the residents of Rimmington. There is a small graveyard attached to the church.

The church is very small, with one altar and four pews. It isn't known who runs the church; it appears completely abandoned, but there are lit candles inside. Father Urhney may be partially responsible for the church, as he keeps the key to the church's crypt.

label: Rimmington General Store
title: Rimmington General Store
lead: The Rimmington General Store is a general store in Rimmington. It is run by the shop keeper and his assistant. The shop is most notable for being the location of Phials, who is often used in conjunction with the nearby POH portal for fast Construction and Prayer training.

label: Rimmington mine
title: Rimmington mine
lead:
The Rimmington mine is located north-east of Rimmington, west of Port Sarim and south-west of Falador. The mine is a huge pit about as large as the town of Rimmington itself. Its major advantage is that it has no aggressive monsters. The mine contains 2 tin rocks, 5 copper rocks, 6 iron rocks, 2 clay rocks, and 2 gold rocks.

Many non-members use the gold rocks here, as they are the best way to mine gold ore until access to the Crafting Guild is acquired. Many members also use the clay rocks in this mine as a quick way to train Construction, by having their player-owned houses just down the road in Rimmington. This makes it a good way to get soft clay for furniture, as there is a well in Rimmington. Players can bank their ore in Falador or at the bank deposit box in Port Sarim.

label: Ring mould
title: Ring mould
lead: A ring mould allows a player to make rings through the Crafting skill out of gold bars and possibly gems by using them on a furnace. It can be bought at various crafting shops, and an unlimited amount can also be taken from a tool store 4 in a player-owned house.

label: Ring of dueling
title: Ring of dueling
lead:
The ring of dueling is a teleportation ring that may be made by casting Lvl-2 Enchant on an emerald ring, granting 37 Magic experience. A full ring of dueling will provide 8 teleports before it crumbles away into nothing.

When teleporting using the ring, the message You rub the ring... will be displayed, followed by a message with the number of charges remaining, ex. Your ring of dueling has four uses left. If using the last charge on the ring, the message Your ring of dueling crumbles to dust. will be displayed instead.

label: ring of forging
title: ring of forging
lead:
A ring of forging gives smelting iron ore a 100% success rate of creating an iron bar while it is worn. It can be made by casting Lvl-3 Enchant on a ruby ring, or by paying 250 coins with a ruby ring to Murky Matt in the south-east quadrant of the Grand Exchange.

A newly-enchanted ring has 140 charges. Each time the player smelts an iron ore while wearing the ring, one charge is consumed; after all charges are consumed, the ring crumbles to dust. If the player auto-smelts more iron ores than the number of remaining charges, the smelting will stop once the ring crumbles. The number of charges is specific to the player, not the ring, so swapping, dropping, or alching rings before 140 charges are used will not reset the number of smelts the player has left before a ring breaks. Players can right-click a ring of forging to either "check" how many charges remain in it or "break" it and reset the next one they use to its maximum charges.

label: Ring of life
title: Ring of life
lead:
The ring of life is a diamond ring that has been enchanted with Lvl-4 Enchant.
