While worn, if the wearer is attacked and has 10% or less of their Hitpoints remaining, the ring automatically teleports the wearer to their respawn point. The ring crumbles to dust after one use. A Defence cape can be worn for the same effect, which does not destroy itself on activation. An Escape crystal can be configured to provide the same effect and more.

The ring does not guarantee total safety, as a player wearing one will still die if they are hit from above 10% of their maximum Hitpoints to zero (for example, being hit 15 while at 15 hitpoints), and it will not cure poison. Self-inflicted damage, such as guzzling a dwarven rock cake or using a locator orb, can also activate the effect. If it is worn along with a phoenix necklace, the necklace effect will trigger first. In PvP, the Tele Block spell will prevent a player's ring of life from activating.

label: ring of recoil
title: ring of recoil
lead:
A ring of recoil is created by using Lvl-1 Enchant on a sapphire ring. When worn, 10% + 1 of the damage received by the player (rounded down) is dealt to the attacker - the attacking entity must cause damage before the recoil effect takes place. This effect applies to both players and NPCs. The ring of recoil is capable of dealing up to 40 hitpoints of damage before shattering.

To see the remaining damage the ring can deal, the player can check it, while equipped, in the Worn Equipment interface. The amount of damage left is kept track of for each player, not each ring; thus, a newly-equipped ring will have the same number of charges remaining as any other ring the player wears. If the player wishes to obtain a ring with 40 charges remaining, the player must use any ring of recoil completely until it shatters, or use the right-click "Break" option on a ring while in the inventory.

label: Ring of wealth
title: Ring of wealth
lead:
The ring of wealth is a dragonstone ring that has been enchanted by the Lvl-5 Enchant spell. Like other enchanted dragonstone jewellery, it can be charged to provide teleports. Unlike the other pieces, the ring can only be charged by the Fountain of Rune. Wearing this ring (whether charged or not) while killing monsters will automatically pick up coins, Tokkul, or numulites dropped by monsters. This effect can be toggled off in the right-click menu when held in the inventory. When worn it also removes the chance to receive a "nothing" drop when accessing the rare drop table and gem drop table. See [[#Rare drop enhancement|below]] for more information about this feature.

The price difference between a fully charged ring and an uncharged ring is , so each charge costs about .

label: Rising Sun Inn
title: Rising Sun Inn
lead:
The Rising Sun Inn can be found on the west end of Falador, across from the bank. The bar is run by three barmaids: Kaylee, Emily, and Tina. All three barmaids will sell any player a wizard's mind bomb, dwarven stout, or Asgarnian ale. This bar does not sell ordinary beer. It does, however, offer the unusual service of buying back (noted or unnoted) empty beer glasses for 2 coins each.

This bar is also a stop on the miniquest, Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl, and is involved in the quests Below Ice Mountain and Recipe for Disaster. It is also the place where many players obtain a wizard's mind bomb for the Dragon Slayer I quest. On the top floor of the bar you can find Tina and a drunken man, who has some mildly amusing dialogue.

label: River Dougne
title: River Dougne
lead:
The River Dougne ( ) is the longest river in Gielinor.

The river begins at the Baxtorian Falls and runs south-east through Kandarin. It passes through Ardougne, turning west to pass through Castle Wars before draining into the Shrouded Ocean east of the Poison Waste.

label: River Lum
title: River Lum
lead: The River Lum is a river flowing through mostly Misthalin and the Wilderness, moving north-to-south. It is the second longest river in Gielinor. Its source is in the Wilderness. It runs as an underground stream until it briefly emerges at the Ferox Enclave, before it reemerges just north of the Wilderness border. It filters through the Lum Lagoon and Lumbridge Basin into the Ardent Ocean on the Misthalin-Kharidian border. The town of Lumbridge is named after the river.

label: river Salve
title: river Salve
lead: The River Salve is a river marking the border between Misthalin and Morytania. The river was blessed by the seven priestly warriors at the end of the Misthalin - Morytania War during the Fourth Age. Some legends claim it was blessed by Saradomin himself, making it a holy barrier between the two kingdoms which, according to legend, will not allow any evil from Morytania to cross its banks. Through unknown means, the blessing was bypassed by several werewolves during the Darkness of Hallowvale quest.

label: River troll (random event)
title: River troll (random event)
lead:
River trolls were a random event that used to appear when attempting to fish. On appearance, it would say . As with similar guardian random events, the river troll's combat level and stats scaled with the player's combat level, as well as only being attackable by the targeted player.

They were removed from the game with the random event update in 2014. Similar River trolls can now be found in the Enchanted Valley.

label: Riverside
title: Riverside
lead: Riverside is a music track that is unlocked to the west of Tyras Camp.

label: Roachey
title: Roachey
lead: Roachey is the Fishing Guild Shop owner. He sells some types of fish and fishing gear. The guild requires 68 Fishing to enter.

label: Roavar
title: Roavar
lead:
Roavar is a werewolf who owns the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis, the Village's tavern and community centre. In the bar they sell moonlight mead and pickled brain, the latter being an item needed during the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest.

If you talk with him, you will have the option to either buy a drink, hear a story, or hear some gossip about various things. You can ask him about Canifis, about Morytania, about some of the shopkeepers, or about Paterdomus. From this you can discover many things, such as the average age of werewolves (Roavar is over 400 and he is not considered an "old" werewolf), and that werewolves like serving Lord Drakan, unlike much of the populace. If you right-click him, then select Trade, he takes 5 coins from you and gives you moonlight mead, an alcoholic beverage.

label: Robin hood hat
title: Robin hood hat
lead:
The Robin hood hat is an item worn in headgear slot, requiring level 40 Ranged. It is part of the ranger kit, and can be obtained as a reward from hard Treasure Trails. This item provides the fifth best-in-slot Ranged attack bonus for headgear, at +8.

The Robin hood hat has the highest Ranged attack bonus for headgear that has no Defence requirement, making it popular among 1 Defence pures.

label: Rock (elemental)
title: Rock (elemental)
lead:
Rocks are received when killing earth elementals, mining rocks in the Feldip Hills, smashing boulders in the Shaman Caves, or picked up from the ground after failing some of the first traps in the Underground Pass and dropping into a pit. The tool leprechaun by the Troll Stronghold herb patch also sells them.

Rocks are mainly used in the quest Recipe for Disaster when freeing Skrach Uglogwee, where they are used for jubbly hunting. It can be also used to turn an ore-attuned rock golem pet back into its original state.

label: Rock (limestone)
title: Rock (limestone)
lead:
Rocks are items created when a chisel is used on a piece of limestone in an attempt to craft a limestone brick unsuccessfully. 12 Crafting is required to do so, but there is a chance to fail. Failing to craft a limestone brick yields 1.5 experience. Players stop failing at level 40 Crafting.

Rocks can also sometimes be found inside barrels in the Shaman Caves.

label: Rock (The Tourist Trap)
title: Rock (The Tourist Trap)
lead: Rocks are items that can be mined only from Rocks during the Tourist Trap quest yielding 1 mining exp. If caught by the guards while in the Desert Mining Camp mine, players will be sent to the jail, where they have to mine 15 rocks to leave. Upon completing the quest, players will no longer be sent to the jail mine.

label: Rock (Troll)
title: Rock (Troll)
lead:
Rock is the strongest troll on Death Plateau. He possesses a higher max hit and attacks 2 ticks faster than Stick, who spawns next to him.

Since he only attacks with melee, Protect from Melee is recommended, as he can hit up to 30 without it. Like the other named trolls on the plateau, such as Stick, Pee Hat, and Kraka, he may drop a Rune warhammer or Granite shield.

label: rock (volencia moss)
title: rock (volencia moss)
lead:
The rocks are a scenery object found within the Karamja Jungle mine located north of Shilo Village. Players can search the rocks to find a grimy volencia moss, which is primarily used during the Jungle Potion quest. Players may also require a volencia moss as one of the random items requested by Malignius Mortifer during the Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest.

After being searched, the rock becomes searchable again after 60 seconds.

label: Rock cake
title: Rock cake
lead:
A rock cake is a strange ogre delicacy. It is a cake made of stone. Players cannot buy rock cakes from the ogres. Instead, they are stolen from the market stall in the ogre town of Gu'Tanoth. Stealing a rock cake requires a Thieving level of 15 and yields 6.5 Thieving experience.

Rock cakes cannot be gained until the relevant part of the Watchtower quest. A rock cake is required as a bribe in order to access the central parts of the Gu'Tanoth, which is necessary during the Watchtower quest. The player must give a rock cake to an ogre guard in order to be allowed to climb over a rampart that blocks the way to a rope bridge.

label: Rock golem (monster)
title: Rock golem (monster)
lead:
Rock golems can be found in the Enchanted Valley, accessible only by use of the fairy ring . They appear when the player attempts to mine a rock, and will use a ranged attack; Protect from Missiles will negate all damage.

Before the random event update in 2014, the rock golem used to appear randomly when Mining. Upon appearing, it would say . As with similar guardian random events, the rock golem's combat level and stats scaled with the player's combat level, as well as only being attackable by the targeted player.

label: Rock of Dalgroth
title: Rock of Dalgroth
lead:
The mysterious Rock of Dalgroth stands in the middle of the Ogre Enclave. It is named after the ogre warrior Dalgroth. Here players can mine the fourth crystal needed in the Watchtower quest. The enclave is filled with high levelled blue dragons, greater demons, and ogres, so players must be cautious while inside.

In the quest, players must bring a pickaxe and a potion used to kill the ogre shamans, in order to mine the rock. The rock can also be prospected to check for ore, however all that appears on screen is "The rock contains a crystal!" (before completing the Watchtower quest) or "The rock has a gap in which the crystal used to sit." (after the Watchtower quest). After the quest has been completed, the rock no longer serves any purpose.

label: Rock pick
title: Rock pick
lead: A rock pick is needed to dig for items in the Level 2 Digs in the Digsite and to clean finds at the Varrock Museum. They can be found at the Exam Centre in a cupboard on the northern wall of the same room with Terry Balando or on the tool rack on the southern wall of the roped-off archaeology area in the museum. The rock pick cannot be equipped nor can it be used as a pickaxe for Mining.

label: Rock sample
title: Rock sample
lead:
Rock samples were items originally obtained during The Dig Site. Players were required to find three rock samples and give them to the Students, who in return would provide the correct answers to the Digsite exam.

* The first sample could be obtained by pickpocketing Digsite workmen
* The second sample could be found while panning
* The third sample could be found searching some bushes

label: Rock Skin
title: Rock Skin
lead:
Rock Skin is a prayer unlocked at level 10 Prayer. Rock Skin increases the player's Defence by 10%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Defence level, such as Steel Skin, with the notable exceptions of Deadeye and Mystic Vigour which allow for simultaneous use.

label: Rockpile
title: Rockpile
lead: A Rockpile can be found at the start of the cages and the obstacle maze portion of the Underground Pass quest, or the second part of the Underground Pass dungeon. It can be used to return to the previous section of the dungeon.

label: Rocks (Climbing boots)
title: Rocks (Climbing boots)
lead:
The rocks are Agility shortcut in the area north of Death Plateau and on Trollheim, requiring 15 Agility to use. They allow players to reach the troll arena from the Death Plateau, as well as being part of the series of shortcuts available on Trollheim. Failing this shortcut deals 1-3 damage.

They can only be used after starting Troll Stronghold. The westernmost and southernmost rocks require climbing boots to be worn when attempting to pass them, when going in the direction towards Troll Stronghold. When going down the mountains (i.e. heading outside of troll country), no climbing boots need to be worn. The other locations of these rocks do not require climbing boots to be worn.

label: Rocks (Death Plateau)
title: Rocks (Death Plateau)
lead: The rocks are an obstacle allowing players to reach the Death Plateau without being attacked by Thrower Trolls. Climbing these rocks in either direction requires climbing boots to be worn.

label: Rocks (Karamja Volcano)
title: Rocks (Karamja Volcano)
lead: Rocks can be found on top of the Karamja Volcano, located in western Musa Point. The rocks can be climbed down to enter the Karamjan section of the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon. Low-level players must take caution when climbing down the rocks as there are aggressive skeletons and giant bats near where the player enters the dungeon.

label: Rocks (The Tourist Trap)
title: Rocks (The Tourist Trap)
lead: Rocks can be found in the deepest part of the Desert Mining Camp, where the player is imprisoned if caught by the guards. Mining the rocks will give an otherwise useless rock item. To get out of the punishment area, the player must mine 15 of these rocks before the guards will let them leave.

label: Rocks (Troll arena)
title: Rocks (Troll arena)
lead: The rocks are Agility shortcut north of the Death Plateau requiring 15 Agility to use allowing players to reach the troll arena from the Death Plateau. Failing this shortcut deals 1-5 damage depending on the player's current hitpoints.

label: Rocks (Trollheim medium)
title: Rocks (Trollheim medium)
lead: The rocks are Agility shortcut on Trollheim requiring 43 Agility to use allowing faster climbing of Trollheim mountain. Failing this shortcut deals 1-4 damage.

label: Rocks (Wilderness Agility Course)
title: Rocks (Wilderness Agility Course)
lead: The rocks are an Agility obstacle found within the Wilderness Agility Course. Passing the obstacle will grant the player 498.9 Agility experience. Experience is only gained on this obstacle after the previous obstacles within the course have been finished. Missing an obstacle will cause zero experience to be earned.

label: Rockslide (Underground Pass)
title: Rockslide (Underground Pass)
lead: Rockslides serve as minor obstacles within the Underground Pass (dungeon), blocking the way until the player climbs over them. They were also reused in one section of Kruk's Dungeon, as decoration underneath a set of monkeybars.

label: Rocky Ledge
title: Rocky Ledge
lead:
Rocky ledges and rocks are found on the elevated part at the entrance of the Viyeldi caves. They must be climbed over to proceed further into the caves. Depending on their Agility level, the player can fail to cross the obstacle unharmed, leading to one of the following outcomes:
#The fall is avoided by grabbing a handhold at the last second, incurring a small amount of damage and draining Agility by some levels.
#The player slips and falls:
##All damage is avoided, owing to one's Agility.
##A light amount of damage is taken, equal to around 10% of the player's Hitpoints.
##A major amount of damage is taken, equal to 50% of one's Hitpoints, or up to 49 points of damage at level 99.

label: Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)
title: Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)
lead: Rod Fishing spots can be found throughout Gielinor along rivers. They can be fished for raw pike, raw trout, raw salmon or raw rainbow fish depending on the bait and fishing rod you use.

label: Rogue
title: Rogue
lead:
Rogues are human monsters that can also be pickpocketed, with level 32 Thieving. Pickpocketing a rogue grants 36.5 Thieving experience. It is the only pickpocketing target found exclusively in the Wilderness. The level 135 variant cannot be pickpocketed.

Unlike many other NPCs found in the Wilderness, rogues are not hostile and will only attack players if provoked or if they try to loot the chests within their castle.

label: Rogue's purse
title: Rogue's purse
lead:
Rogue's purse is a quest item used in Jungle Potion and Zogre Flesh Eaters. It is made by cleaning grimy rogue's purse, obtained from the walls in the Pothole Dungeon.

In Jungle Potion, it is the fifth and final herb given to Trufitus. In Zogre Flesh Eaters, it is used to make Relicym's balm or Unfinished potion (Rogue's Purse).

label: Rogues' Castle
title: Rogues' Castle
lead:
The Rogues' Castle is a building located in the deep Wilderness, specifically in levels 52-56. It is one of the few places that rogues reside in (they can be fought and pickpocketed). An aggressive boss monster, the Chaos Elemental, can be found lurking around or inside the castle. It is also part of the Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest.

This area is considered to be highly dangerous, as it is in high level Wilderness which runs the risk of PKers, and has the nearby Chaos Elemental, who can bind and unequip players, cutting off possible escape routes. Additionally, there are aggressive rogues located within the castle. There is a Wilderness Obelisk nearby which can be used to escape the immediate vicinity, though it is not a surefire way to reach safety.

label: Romeo
title: Romeo
lead:
Romeo Gontamue is a citizen of Varrock who is part of the Romeo & Juliet quest.

He can be found in Varrock Square, but he seems to have an incredibly large wander range, especially for a quest NPC. He can often be found in the general store, but sometimes wanders over to inside the east bank or even the courtyard of Varrock Palace.

label: Romeo & Juliet
title: Romeo & Juliet
lead: Romeo & Juliet is one of the original six quests released with the launch of RuneScape Classic. The quest roughly follows the storyline of the tragedy of the same name by William Shakespeare.

label: Rometti
title: Rometti
lead:
Rometti, the well dressed gnome, is a shop keeper on the of the Grand Tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. His shop, Fine Fashions, is located to the north-east section of the Grand Tree. It is marked with a clothing shop icon .

He is a potential easy customer in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

label: Rommik
title: Rommik
lead: Rommik is a craftsman who runs the Rommik's Crafty Supplies store in Rimmington. Rommik has brown hair with a brown beard and wears an apron.

label: Rommik's Crafty Supplies.
title: Rommik's Crafty Supplies.
lead:
Rommik's Crafty Supplies is located in Rimmington and owned by Rommik. It is a convenient place to buy Crafting supplies due to its close proximity to the Crafting Guild.

Rommik's Crafty Supplies has an identical stock to that of Dommik's Crafting Store. in Al Kharid.

label: Rooster
title: Rooster
lead:
A rooster is a low-level monster that is very similar to a chicken, and indeed they are found together.

Specifically, players can find at least one in Tenzing's yard on Death Plateau. There is also a rooster in the chicken pen in Rellekka and in Miscellania market.

label: Root (The Grand Tree)
title: Root (The Grand Tree)
lead:
The roots of the Grand Tree are found in the Grand Tree Tunnels and must be searched for the Daconia rock at the end of The Grand Tree quest. The root which contains the Daconia rock is randomised.

There is a small chance to receive an uncut red topaz whilst searching the roots.

label: rope
title: rope
lead:
Rope is an item used for many things, such as quests and the creation of certain items. It can be obtained by purchasing at a shop, trading with Ned in exchange for 4 balls of wool, or by a player spinning yak hair on a spinning wheel.

The best store to buy rope, without requirements, is at Ned's shop in Draynor Village. However, you can get a full inventory of rope for free from the Tempoross minigame in the ropes container. A convenient place to get rope is in the Ardougne general store (helpful for those doing the Waterfall Quest and Plague City) where there is a stock of 20, but Martin Thwait's Lost and Found at Rogues' Den is a far better option since it stocks 50 and is next to a bank (although it requires 50 Thieving and 50 Agility to access his shop). Khazard General Store is also within close proximity of a bank.

label: Rope swing (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Rope swing (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The rope swing is an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing the obstacle will cause the player to fall and take damage; they will need to go up a nearby climbing rope to get back onto the course.

The amount of damage dealt by the fall is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: Rope swing (Underground Pass, north)
title: Rope swing (Underground Pass, north)
lead:
A rope swing can be made by attaching a rope to a rock overhanging a dark pit, which must be crossed during the events of the Underground Pass quest in order to progress through the dungeon of the same name. There is no Agility level requirement to swing on the rope, and a successful crossing does not grant any experience.

Upon using a rope on one of the overhanging rocks, a brief animation will play of the adventurer throwing aloft the rope to create the swing (briefly wielding the throwing rope animation item while doing so). The rope will be lost during the crossing, whether the player makes it to the other side or not, meaning a new one must be brought for each repeated attempt or future visit. This is in contrast to the small water crossing immediately to the south, which features a permanently attached rope swing that can be crossed eastwards back towards West Ardougne (but not westwards in the direction of Tirannwn).

label: Ropeswing (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
title: Ropeswing (Barbarian Outpost Agility Course)
lead: The ropeswing is an Agility obstacle found within the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. Passing the obstacle requires 35 Agility and will award 22 Agility experience.

label: Ropeswing (Brimhaven)
title: Ropeswing (Brimhaven)
lead: The ropeswings are an Agility shortcut in west Brimhaven used to access Moss Giant Island, as well as get back to Brimhaven. 10 Agility is required to use them.

label: Ropeswing (Ogre island)
title: Ropeswing (Ogre island)
lead: The ropeswing is a rope hanging from a long branched tree on an Ogre island located west of Yanille. Grew, Ogres, and several jangerberries can be found on the island. Players can access the island by using a rope on the branch on the western long branched tree. This will require an Agility level of 10. The rope will not be returned and no experience will be awarded. The island can be left by using the northern ropeswing with a permanent rope. Doing so will grant the player 3 experience in Agility.

label: Ropeswing (Wilderness Agility Course)
title: Ropeswing (Wilderness Agility Course)
lead:
The ropeswing is an Agility obstacle found within the Wilderness Agility Course. Passing the obstacle grants 20 Agility experience, and failing it causes the player to fall into the dungeon below and take damage based on their current health, according to the expression below.

\left\lfloor\text{Hitpoints}\times\frac{3}{20}\right\rfloor + 1

label: Rosebush
title: Rosebush
lead: Rosebushes can be found around Falador, one on the south side of Falador east bank and one on the west side of Falador west bank. There is also one located south of Baxtorian Falls, near Rasolo. Players cannot interact with Rosebushes, but they can be examined.

label: Rotten apple
title: Rotten apple
lead:
The rotten apple is a quest item used only in Biohazard and Mourning's End Part I. Although they have an "Eat" option, rotten apples may not be eaten, attempting to do so will result in the message Nothing interesting happens..

In Biohazard, it is used to poison the stew to enter the Mourner's Headquarters while wearing a medical gown.

label: Rotten food
title: Rotten food
lead:
Rotten food is food that has been attacked by ghasts in Mort Myre Swamp. It is inedible and almost useless, where the only use is to have it converted to stew by Abidor Crank encountered rarely during the Temple Trekking minigame.

Players can prevent ghasts rotting their food by:
*Travelling direct to the desired location mitigating the need to travel through Mort Myre Swamp.
*Fill the druid pouch obtained during the quest Nature Spirit, to turn all ghasts who attempt to attack the player into attackable foes who can simply be walked past without risk of rotting the player's food.
*Lighting the fire of dehumidification in the Mort Myre Swamp following the completion of Making Friends with My Arm will give the player permanent protection against ghasts rotting food (Outside Temple Trekking / Burgh de Rott Ramble).
*Equipping Morytania legs 4 completely blocks the attack that Ghasts use.

label: Rotten tomato
title: Rotten tomato
lead:
Rotten tomatoes are inedible items obtained by filling a compost bin entirely with tomatoes and letting them rot, or by purchasing them from one of the several Pelters' Veg Stalls found in various cities. They can be thrown at players stuck in a pillory or anywhere snowballs can be thrown.

They are used in the Recipe for Disaster and Mourning's End Part II quests.

label: Rotting branch
title: Rotting branch
lead: Rotting branches are found throughout Mort Myre Swamp in Morytania. After starting Nature Spirit players may cast Bloom whilst standing adjacent to these branches to turn them into budding branches, afterwards they can be picked to receive mort myre stems.

label: Rotting log
title: Rotting log
lead: Rotting logs are found throughout Mort Myre Swamp in Morytania. After starting Nature Spirit players may cast Bloom whilst standing adjacent to these logs to turn them into fungi on logs, afterwards they can be picked to receive mort myre fungi.

label: Rotting tree
title: Rotting tree
lead: Rotting trees can be found in north-west Morytania, most commonly in Mort Myre Swamp. The player can examine them but not chop them or otherwise interact with them.

label: Rowdy Guard
title: Rowdy Guard
lead: Rowdy Guards are unused NPCs who could previously be found in the Desert Mining Camp disciplining the Rowdy slaves. In 2006, The Tourist Trap was reworked, and the rowdy guards were replaced by a new NPC simply named Guard who fulfilled much the same purpose. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Rowdy slave
title: Rowdy slave
lead: A rowdy slave is a human slave found at the Desert Mining Camp south of the Shantay Pass where players must go for the quest The Tourist Trap. Note that they will only drop slave robes if you do not already have them. They are the only attackable slaves and will attack you if you talk to them. If you want to get the Slave clothes back, you can kill one near the guard in the first section of the underground mining camp.

label: Royale
title: Royale
lead: Royale is a music track that is unlocked in the Black Knights' base in the Taverley Dungeon.

label: Rubber tube
title: Rubber tube
lead:
The rubber tube is a quest item used only in Ernest the Chicken. It is found in the main floor of Draynor Manor inside a locked room, which is guarded inside by a level 22 skeleton. The locked room can be opened using a key, which is dug out using a spade on the compost heap.

It is one of three items needed to repair Professor Oddenstein's machine along with an oil can and a pressure gauge, so he can turn Ernest back into a human. Duplicates can be obtained after the quest if the key is kept, but it serves no further use.

label: Ruby
title: Ruby
lead:
Rubies are precious gems used mainly in Crafting. They can be cut from uncut rubies with a chisel at level 34 Crafting, yielding 85 experience.

A one-time reward of 2 cut rubies can be obtained by using a chisel and hammer on Thammaron's throne during The Golem quest. Completing Olaf's Quest rewards 4 cut rubies.

label: Ruby amulet
title: Ruby amulet
lead:
A ruby amulet is made by using a gold bar on a furnace with a ruby and an amulet mould in the inventory. It requires a Crafting level of 50 or higher and provides 85 Crafting experience when made. The amulet must be strung before wearing or enchantment by using a ball of wool or the String Jewellery spell. Stringing provides 4 Crafting experience. A total of 174 Crafting experience is granted when cutting the ruby, making the amulet at a furnace and stringing the amulet.

The ruby amulet can be enchanted into an amulet of strength by players through the use of the Lvl-3 Enchant spell, which requires 5 fire runes, 1 cosmic rune, and a Magic level of 49 or higher. Ruby amulets can be sold to Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim starting at 1,417 coins if there are none in stock.

label: Ruby amulet (u)
title: Ruby amulet (u)
lead:
A ruby amulet (u) is made by using a gold bar on a furnace, while having a cut ruby and an amulet mould in the inventory.

Level 50 Crafting is required to make one, giving 85 experience. When used with a Ball of wool, it becomes a ruby amulet, giving 4 experience. The ruby amulet can also be strung using the lunar spell String Jewellery, giving 83 Magic and 4 Crafting experience.

label: Ruby necklace
title: Ruby necklace
lead:
A ruby necklace is made by using a gold bar, a ruby and a necklace mould on a furnace. It requires a Crafting level of 40 and gives 75 experience when made.

The ruby necklace may be enchanted into a Digsite pendant after learning the enchantment spell from one of the archaeologists in the find-cleaning area of the Varrock Museum. The spell is learned by participating in cleaning samples until a clean necklace is extracted from a sample. When brought to an expert, they will teach the player how to enchant ruby necklaces. After this, the player can enchant them with the Lvl-3 Enchant which requires level 49 Magic.

label: Ruby ring
title: Ruby ring
lead:
A ruby ring is a jewellery item that players can make by using a gold bar, a cut ruby, and a ring mould at a furnace. Making it requires a Crafting level of 34, and grants 70 Crafting experience.

A ruby ring can be enchanted into a ring of forging using the spell Lvl-3 Enchant, which requires one cosmic rune, five fire runes, and level 49 Magic, or by paying 250 coins to Murky Matt at the Grand Exchange.

label: Rufus
title: Rufus
lead:
Rufus runs the Rufus' Meat Emporium in Canifis. He is also involved in the quest The Great Brain Robbery. He is a werewolf, but is never seen outside of his humanoid form.

In The Great Brain Robbery, you have to talk to him wearing a Ring of charos, so he'll agree to let you use a crate and gives you crate parts for use in the quest. His connection with the meat store gives rise to comments about the werewolves' preference for raw meat.

label: Rufus' Meat Emporium
title: Rufus' Meat Emporium
lead: Rufus' Meat Emporium is a food shop located in Canifis, run by Rufus. Raw meat and fish can be bought and sold here.

label: Ruined chompy
title: Ruined chompy
lead:
Ruined chompy is the result of accidentally burning a raw chompy while attempting to make a cooked chompy. The burn rate while cooking these will decrease as players reach higher Cooking levels, stopping entirely at level 99.

Cooking chompy on a fire alone is not possible - it needs to either be used on one of the ogre spits, or used with an iron spit and then cooked on a fire.

label: Ruined Pillar
title: Ruined Pillar
lead: Ruined Pillars are scenery found at the Mysterious ruins across Gielinor, as well as at the ruined Cosmic Altar in Zanaris. They have no interaction options and are purely decorative.

label: Ruined Pillar (unused)
title: Ruined Pillar (unused)
lead: Ruined Pillars are unused scenery similar to the ruined pillars found near the ruined runic altars scattered across Gielinor. They have no interaction options and are purely decorative.

label: Ruins (east)
title: Ruins (east)
lead:
The Eastern Ruins, more commonly referred to simply as the Ruins or the Farm, are the remains of a settlement in the eastern Wilderness. They lie in roughly level 26 to 29 Wilderness, and are Single-way combat on the surface. The Web Chasm can be found here, where players can fight Spindel.

The Ruins contain item spawns for a gold ore and steel platelegs, as well as a furnace that can be used for Smithing.

label: Ruins (west)
title: Ruins (west)
lead:
The ruins are all that remain of the Zarosian fortress and village once known as Dareeyak. The ruins are located in the Wilderness west of the Bandit Camp and south of the Forgotten Cemetery. These ruins have many tiles and about 10 planks scattered about and are infested with many giant spiders and bears. A lone anvil is one of the few usable artefacts remaining. There is also a hammer and a cake tin. The building in the north-east also contains a small fishing net and fishing bait.

The Crazy archaeologist can be found roaming the northern area of the ruins. Passing players should be careful as he is aggressive and will attack players on sight. It is advised that low-level players who wish to explore this area for reasons other than clue scrolls or bossing should use Free-to-play worlds, as he is not present in F2P.

label: rune 2h sword
title: rune 2h sword
lead:
The rune 2h sword is a two-handed sword that is made of rune. It is stronger than the Adamant 2h sword, while being weaker than the Dragon 2h sword. It can be made using the Smithing skill at level 99 using 3 runite bars and a hammer on an anvil granting 225 Smithing experience. It requires 40 Attack to wield.

The rune 2h sword is often used on free-to-play worlds in player-killing to finish players off because it has the highest strength bonus, equal to the hill giant club, and the highest slash bonuses of all free-to-play equipment.

label: rune arrow
title: rune arrow
lead:
Rune arrows are stronger than adamant arrows, are stackable, and can be used on any bow of yew or stronger. They can be created through the Fletching skill at level 75 by using 15 rune arrowtips on 15 headless arrows, granting 187.5 Fletching experience. As with most arrows, they can be poisoned.

Rune arrows with a Magic shortbow (i) are a powerful weapon for Ironmen before obtaining the Toxic blowpipe, however they are outclassed by Karil's crossbow.

label: Rune arrowtips
title: Rune arrowtips
lead:
Rune arrowtips are made with a runite bar requiring 90 Smithing, yielding 75 Smithing experience and 15 rune arrowtips. They are made into rune arrows when used with headless arrows, requiring 75 Fletching, yielding 187.5 experience per 15 arrows.

They are purchased for coins at the ranging shops: Hickton's Archery Emporium in Catherby, Dargaud's Bow and Arrows in the Ranging Guild, and Void Knight Archery Store at the Void Knights' Outpost.

label: rune axe
title: rune axe
lead:
The rune axe is in the third-best tier of Woodcutting axes available to members and in the best tier axe available to free-to-play players. It is outclassed by the crystal axe, infernal axe, 3rd age axe, and dragon axe, and is equivalent to the gilded axe (which is also available in free-to-play). Level 41 Woodcutting is required to use this axe.

Like any Woodcutting axe, its primary use is as a tool to cut trees in order to obtain logs and gain experience in the Woodcutting skill. As with all axes, it does not need to be wielded to cut down trees, but will work from the inventory. The success rate for receiving a set of logs when chopping a tree with a rune axe is approximately 350% that of a bronze axe, or 17% better than an adamant axe. It can also be used as a weapon for melee combat; the player must have an Attack level of 40 to wield this axe.

label: Rune axe head
title: Rune axe head
lead:
The rune axe head is an unobtainable item that was originally used in the axe head (random event). The axe head would become detached from the player's axe while Woodcutting. To fix their axe, players had to collect the axe head off the ground and reattach it to the axe handle.

A similar event used to happen to players while Mining, but with a pickaxe head and pickaxe handle.

label: Rune battleaxe
title: Rune battleaxe
lead:
The rune battleaxe is the fourth strongest battleaxe, with zombie axe being the strongest, followed by the leaf-bladed battleaxe and the dragon battleaxe. Like most rune weapons, it requires 40 Attack to wield.

Players may make a rune battleaxe with 95 Smithing by using 3 rune bars at an anvil with a hammer, giving the player 225 Smithing experience.

label: Rune chainbody
title: Rune chainbody
lead:
A rune chainbody is a chainbody made of runite. To wear this chainbody, a player needs at least level 40 Defence. This piece of body armour is less resistant than the rune platebody in all stats except crush and magic and wearing it does not require completion of Dragon Slayer I. For this reason it is commonly worn by players who have not finished said quest or who are fighting against monsters that use crush attacks. It is also useful for rangers since it has higher defence bonuses than the green d'hide body and it does not penalise ranged attack.

A player with 96 Smithing can make the chainbody by using three runite bars on an anvil, granting 225 Smithing experience. It can also be bought at Scavvo's Rune Store in the Champions' Guild, or for members, at Seddu's Adventurer's Store in Nardah.

label: Rune claws
title: Rune claws
lead:
Rune claws are a two-handed melee weapon, requiring 40 Attack to wield. They are the third strongest pair of claws.

Rune claws can be obtained either through smithing, as a drop from the Shellbane Gryphon, or looting ninja implings. They can be made at level 98 Smithing with two runite bars after completion of the Death Plateau quest, granting 150 Smithing experience.

label: Rune dagger
title: Rune dagger
lead: The rune dagger is a dagger made from rune. Rune daggers can be made from a single rune bar at level 85 Smithing. Each rune dagger created grants 75 experience. Rune daggers are the third-strongest daggers, behind the dragon dagger and the abyssal dagger. Like most rune weapons they require 40 Attack to wield. As with most daggers, this weapon can be poisoned.

label: rune dart
title: rune dart
lead:
Rune darts are Ranged throwing weapons that are only available to members. Rune darts require level 40 Ranged to wield. They can be obtained by either using the Smithing and Fletching skills or trading with another player. Rune darts can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

To create rune darts the player must have completed the Tourist Trap quest and have at least level 89 Smithing and level 81 Fletching. Players can smith rune bars into rune dart tips. Each rune bar creates 10 rune dart tips and gives the player 75 Smithing experience. Feathers then must be added to create the rune darts. 18.8 Fletching experience is rewarded per rune dart.

label: Rune dart tip
title: Rune dart tip
lead:
The rune dart tip is a dart tip made with the Smithing skill. Players can craft this item by using a rune bar on an anvil with a hammer in the inventory and a Smithing level of 89. Each bar creates 10 dart tips, yielding 75 experience. They can be fletched into rune darts at level 81 Fletching when used with feathers, granting 188 Fletching experience per 10 darts made.

To smith darts, one must have completed the Tourist Trap quest.

label: rune essence
title: rune essence
lead:
Rune essence is a raw material used in the Runecraft skill that can be crafted into low-level runes, namely air, mind, water, earth, fire, and body runes. Unlike runes, rune essence does not stack. Players need pure essence to craft any other type of rune, which can only be mined in members worlds.

There are a few ways of obtaining rune essence, other than by trading with other players.

label: Rune Essence (music track)
title: Rune Essence (music track)
lead: Rune Essence is a music track that is unlocked at the Rune Essence mine.

label: Rune Essence (rock)
title: Rune Essence (rock)
lead: Rune Essence is a rock that is mined to gather rune essence. There are no requirements to mine the rocks, however, in members' worlds, players with at least 30 Mining will instead mine pure essence. Free players may mine rune essence in the rune essence mine, unlocked after completing the Rune Mysteries quest. To reach these mines, players need to be teleported by one of several NPCs. Each essence gives 5 Mining experience. The rocks have an unlimited supply of essence and never deplete. A pickaxe is needed to mine essence from the rock. The speed at which you mine rune essence is only dependent on the pickaxe you use and not the mining level.

label: Rune essence mine
title: Rune essence mine
lead: The rune essence mine is a mine only accessible by being teleported there by various NPCs, and it is one of two locations where rune and pure essence can be mined; the other being the Lunar Isle Mine. It is only accessible after Rune Mysteries. Unlike the one located on Lunar Isle, this mine cannot be reached manually by players, due to it being sealed from all access except a specific spell.

label: Rune fire arrow
title: Rune fire arrow
lead:
Rune fire arrows are rune arrows wrapped in an oily cloth, which are then lit by using them on a tinderbox. They, along with any other fire arrow, are primarily used to pierce the rope in the Underground Pass to lower the bridge so that a player may walk across.

They have the same Ranged Strength as regular rune arrows.

label: rune full helm
title: rune full helm
lead: The rune full helm is the best full helmet available to free-to-play players (excluding Rune god armour full helmets, which provide an additional +1 Prayer bonus). Equipping this helmet requires 40 Defence. It can be made at 92 Smithing with two runite bars, granting 150 Smithing experience.

label: Rune full helm (g)
title: Rune full helm (g)
lead: Rune full helm (g) is a part of rune gold-trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Rune full helm, and requires level 40 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune full helm (t)
title: Rune full helm (t)
lead: Rune full helm (t) is a part of rune trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Rune full helm, and requires level 40 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune javelin
title: Rune javelin
lead:
The rune javelin is a type of members ranged ammunition used by ballistae. They are the third strongest type of javelin, surpassed only by the amethyst javelin and dragon javelin. As with most javelins, they can be poisoned.

They can be fletched by attaching rune javelin tips to javelin shafts at level 77 Fletching, granting 187.5 experience per 15 javelins made. They can also be obtained by buying them from the Ranging Guild, the Void Knight Archery Store or from Oobapohk's Javelin Store after Monkey Madness II.

label: rune kiteshield
title: rune kiteshield
lead:
The Rune kiteshield is the second best smithable kiteshield, surpassed only by the Dragon kiteshield. The rune kiteshield requires 40 Defence to wield. A player with 97 Smithing can make the shield by using three runite bars and a hammer on an anvil, granting 225 Smithing experience.

The rune kiteshield is often used as a tank shield by low-risk and void rangers; despite the negative ranged attack bonus, it is much cheaper, and provides a substantial melee defence bonus, which the Odium ward lacks.

label: Rune kiteshield (g)
title: Rune kiteshield (g)
lead: Rune kiteshield (g) is a part of rune gold-trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Rune kiteshield except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 40 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune kiteshield (t)
title: Rune kiteshield (t)
lead: Rune kiteshield (t) is a part of rune trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Rune kiteshield except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 40 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune knife
title: Rune knife
lead:
The rune knife is a throwing knife that requires a Ranged level of 40 to wield. It is the second strongest throwing knife in the game. To create rune knives, the player must have at least 92 Smithing. Each runite bar will create 5 rune knives and give the player 75 Smithing experience. They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Throwing knives are among the fastest weapons in the game (along with darts), and are commonly used for PKing or training Ranged.

label: Rune longsword
title: Rune longsword
lead: The rune longsword is a longsword requiring 40 Attack to wield. It can be made using 2 runite bars at level 91 Smithing. It is the strongest longsword in free-to-play, surpassing the adamant longsword. Even though it has better melee strength and attack, it underperforms compared to the Rune scimitar due to its attack speed being 25% slower (5 ticks compared to 4). Its higher attack bonus may outperform rune scimitar and rune sword against higher defence monsters.

label: Rune mace
title: Rune mace
lead:
A rune mace is a mace made of runite. It requires 40 Attack. It can be made at level 87 Smithing using one Rune bar.

It is currently the sixth-strongest mace in the game, surpassed by the Void knight mace, Barronite mace, Dragon mace, Tzhaar-ket-em, and the Inquisitor's mace. It is the second strongest free-to-play mace, behind the Barronite mace which has a higher crush and strength bonus, but a lower prayer bonus.

label: Rune med helm
title: Rune med helm
lead: The rune med helm is a medium helmet made out of rune, requiring a Defence level of 40 to wear. A Smithing level of 88 is required to smith one from a runite bar, granting 75 experience. It can also be obtained as a drop from a variety of monsters.

label: Rune Mysteries
title: Rune Mysteries
lead: Rune Mysteries is a novice level Free-to-play quest, and a requirement for mining rune essence within the Rune essence mine or using lamps and books on runecraft.

label: Rune pick head
title: Rune pick head
lead:
A rune pick head was obtained as part of a discontinued random event, in which the rune pickaxe head flew off the handle while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle.

If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another.

label: Rune pickaxe
title: Rune pickaxe
lead: The rune pickaxe is the third best pickaxe, after the crystal pickaxe and the dragon pickaxe variants. It mines on a 3-tick cycle and is the best pickaxe in free-to-play. The rune pickaxe requires 41 Mining to use, and 40 Attack to equip. Players lacking 40 Attack can still use it for mining. Like all pickaxes, it cannot be smithed, so it must be obtained from other players or from a shop, as a monster drop, or as a reward from the quest Between a Rock....

label: rune platebody
title: rune platebody
lead:
The rune platebody is an armour used in melee and the strongest of all free-to-play platebodies. It requires 40 Defence and completion of the quest Dragon Slayer I to equip. It also provides greater protection than a rune chainbody, with the exception of a slightly lower crush defence. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's Ranged and Magic stats.

Players with level 99 Smithing can make one by using 5 runite bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 375 experience.

label: Rune platebody (g)
title: Rune platebody (g)
lead: Rune platebody (g) is a part of rune gold-trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Rune platebody, and requires level 40 Defence and the completion of Dragon Slayer I to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune platebody (t)
title: Rune platebody (t)
lead: Rune platebody (t) is a part of rune trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Rune platebody, and requires level 40 Defence and the completion of Dragon Slayer I to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: rune platelegs
title: rune platelegs
lead:
Rune platelegs are platelegs made of runite. They require level 40 Defence to wear. Rune platelegs are identical in function to the rune plateskirt, but is 1kg heavier. Players may receive these from the crystal chest if they are a body type A character.

They can be created with the Smithing skill by using 3 runite bars and a hammer on an anvil; this requires level 99 Smithing and yields 225 Smithing experience.

label: Rune platelegs (g)
title: Rune platelegs (g)
lead: Rune platelegs (g) is a part of rune gold-trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. They have the same stats as regular Rune platelegs, and require level 40 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune platelegs (t)
title: Rune platelegs (t)
lead: Rune platelegs (t) is a part of rune trimmed armour and a reward from hard Treasure Trails. They have the same stats as regular Rune platelegs, and require level 40 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Rune plateskirt
title: Rune plateskirt
lead:
The rune plateskirt is a plateskirt made out of runite. It requires level 40 Defence to wear. The rune plateskirt is identical in function to rune platelegs, but is 1 kg lighter.

It can be created with the Smithing skill by using 3 runite bars and a hammer on an anvil; this requires level 99 Smithing and yields 225 Smithing experience.

label: Rune scimitar
title: Rune scimitar
lead:
The rune scimitar is a scimitar requiring level 40 Attack to wield. It can be created with 2 runite bars at level 90 Smithing, or dropped by various monsters such as Zamorak warriors or Fire giants.

It is the second strongest scimitar available behind the Dragon scimitar, and the strongest scimitar in free-to-play. Furthermore, it is considered the strongest melee weapon in most situations in free-to-play due to its unmatched attack and strength bonuses for its attack speed.

label: Rune spear
title: Rune spear
lead:
The rune spear is a two-handed melee weapon requiring 40 Attack to wield. Unlike most other rune equipment, rune spears are members-only. Rune spears can be created at a barbarian anvil with 90 Smithing, requiring one runite bar and one magic log, as well as partial completion of the Barbarian Training miniquest. Like most spears, the rune spear can be poisoned.

A rune spear is also a requirement for a hard clue scroll. Ironmen can acquire it by completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio for a rune spear (kp) then using a cleaning cloth on it, or by buying it from Mount Karuulm Weapon Shop.

label: Rune sq shield
title: Rune sq shield
lead:
The rune square shield is the second strongest square shield in Old School RuneScape, requiring a Defence level of 40 to wield. It is obtainable via the rare drop table. A player with level 93 Smithing can make the shield by using two rune bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 150 experience. Rune square shields can also be obtained from Magpie impling jars as well as a common drop from a Greater Nechryael.

Any monster that has access to the rare drop table can also drop the rune square shield.

label: Rune sword
title: Rune sword
lead:
A rune sword is a medium-level sword made out of rune. Like all rune weapons, it requires 40 Attack to wield.

A rune sword can be created at level 89 Smithing using 1 rune bar, giving the player 75 Smithing experience.

label: Rune thrownaxe
title: Rune thrownaxe
lead:
The rune thrownaxe, like all throwing axes, is a members-only Ranged throwing weapon and is the second most powerful type of throwing axe, behind the dragon thrownaxe. To wield a rune throwing axe the player must have at least 40 Ranged.

The door-supports that block access to lower floors of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon can be destroyed using a rune thrownaxe special attack on the middle support. As the doors usually require another player to open, players without level 85 Agility for the rocks shortcut to skip the doors often use one to reach the Dagannoth Kings conveniently.

label: rune warhammer
title: rune warhammer
lead:
The rune warhammer is the second strongest type of warhammer in the game, better than the adamant warhammer but weaker than the dragon warhammer. Players can make a rune warhammer with the Smithing skill at level 94 using 3 runite bars, giving 225 Smithing experience.

Unlike other rune weapons, it requires 40 Strength to wield and has no Attack requirement, making it popular as a knockout weapon for free-to-play strength pures.

label: Runecraft
title: Runecraft
lead:
Runecraft, also called Runecrafting, is a skill that allows players to craft their own runes for Magic spells. This classically involves bringing essence to various runic altars, which can be located and entered using their respective talismans.

The experience earned from making runes is small, and due to the need for constant running and banking, it is fairly click and attention intensive. That being said, the constant demand for different types of runes can make it reasonably profitable to train the skill.

label: Runecraft Level Up!
title: Runecraft Level Up!
lead: Runecraft Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Runecraft.

label: Runecraft Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Runecraft Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Runecraft Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Runecraft.

label: RuneScape 2
title: RuneScape 2
lead:
RuneScape 2 was the name given to when Jagex released a beta version of what is now known as RuneScape, on 1 December 2003 ( ). The working name was RuneScape 3D., to distinguish it from what is now known as RuneScape Classic, which used 2D graphics for several entities. The finished version was launched on 29 March 2004 ( ). It is one of the largest updates since the game's initial launch. It saw the introduction of a more powerful game engine, three-dimensional graphics, a combat system refresh, improved sound including the addition of the music panel, and many other new features.

Compared with its predecessor, this three-dimensional version featured a vast improvement to the game engine as well as improving on the sound and interfaces. The core engine allowed Jagex to expand the game to levels previously not possible.

label: RuneScape Classic
title: RuneScape Classic
lead:
RuneScape Classic (also known as RSC, RS1 or RS Classic) was the first official release of ( being the precursor). RuneScape Classic was publicly released on 4 January 2001. It was replaced on 29 March 2004, with what was then known as RuneScape 2, which formed the basis for Old School RuneScape.

On 23 May 2018, Jagex announced that RuneScape Classic would be permanently closing on 6 August 2018.

label: runite bar
title: runite bar
lead:
Runite bars are used in the Smithing skill to smith various runite weaponry and armour. At level 85 Smithing, players can smelt a runite bar by using runite ore and 8 pieces of coal with a furnace, granting 50 Smithing experience for smelting and 75 Smithing experience for smithing, yielding a net of 125 experience.

For free-to-play, apart from smelting, the chest in Bryophyta's lair is the only way of obtaining runite bars.

label: Runite ore
title: Runite ore
lead:
Runite ore can be mined at level 85 Mining providing 125 Mining experience. After runite rocks are mined, it will take twelve minutes until it reappears. Runite ore is used with eight coal to smelt runite bars. Smelting a runite bar gives 50 Smithing experience.

Wearing expert mining gloves while mining a runite rock grants a guaranteed extra gather before depleting.

label: Runite rocks
title: Runite rocks
lead:
Runite rocks are the second-highest level rock, requiring 85 Mining to mine. When successfully mined, the player receives a runite ore and 125 Mining experience. After being mined, runite rocks take 12 minutes to respawn (6 minutes within the Mining Guild). The long respawn times make world switching practically mandatory to collect any reasonable amount of runite.

Due to competition from players and bots, some strategy is required to mine runite in popular areas. Rather than world hopping continuously forward, it is useful to keep track of the time that you mine the ores on a specific world, then returning to that world shortly before it respawns. Alternately, rocks with quest requirements are much less popular and do not require such world hopping strategies. Examples are the Fossil Island mine requiring Bone Voyage, the Central Fremennik Isles mine requiring starting The Fremennik Isles, or Mourner Tunnels requiring starting Mourning's End Part II.

label: Rusty Anchor Inn
title: Rusty Anchor Inn
lead:
The Rusty Anchor Inn is a bar in Port Sarim, located just north of the docks.

It is one of the bars visited during the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest.

label: Rusty sword
title: Rusty sword
lead:
A rusty sword is a broken sword that can be repaired by bringing it to Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard and paying 100 coins or repaired on a whetstone or on an armour stand in a Player-owned house workshop. All three options have a chance to break the sword, however the chance of it breaking on the whetstone or armour stand decreases with Smithing level. Successfully repairing a rusty sword yields 25 Smithing experience.

The easiest way for low-level players to obtain a rusty sword is by pickpocketing H.A.M. Members (requires 15 Thieving, reached by picking the H.A.M. Hideout trapdoor), killing H.A.M. Guards (levels 12, 18, 22, reached by the same method), or by playing Fishing Trawler (Requires 15 Fishing). Alternatively, it can be obtained from [[#Item sources|monster drops]] or at the Digsite after partial completion of The Dig Site quest.

label: Saba
title: Saba
lead: Saba is an elderly hermit who resides in a cave on the path to Death Plateau, north of the Warriors' Guild. He grumpily agrees to help players continue the Death Plateau quest to find a secret way to the offending, noisy trolls in return for some peace and quiet.

label: Sabeil
title: Sabeil
lead: Sabeil is one of the people observing the fights at the Emir's Arena.

label: Sabreen
title: Sabreen
lead: Sabreen is one of the two nurses at Emir's Arena who heals injured players. With her healing ability she can restore one's hitpoints.

label: sacks (Digsite)
title: sacks (Digsite)
lead: Sacks are a scenery object found at various locations around the Digsite and Digsite Dungeon. Some sacks can be searched to obtain a specimen jar, if the player does not already own one. Searching the other sacks will result in the player finding nothing of interest.

label: Sacks (Holy Grail)
title: Sacks (Holy Grail)
lead:
Sacks are a pair of sacks containing Sir Percival, they are found inside one of the buildings in Goblin Village. During the Holy Grail quest, the player must free Sir Percival by opening the sacks. Blowing on the Magic gold feather tells the player which direction the sacks are in.

After the completion of the Holy Grail quest the sacks can still be prodded, resulting in a muffled groan and the sacks wiggling slightly, presumably indicating that another person has been captured by the goblins since Sir Percival was freed.

label: Sacks (Murder Mystery)
title: Sacks (Murder Mystery)
lead: Sacks can be found in the Sinclair Mansion's gardener shed, just outside the main building. During the Murder Mystery quest, the sacks are searched for flypaper, which is then used to lift fingerprints from various items in the mansion.

label: sacred water
title: sacred water
lead: The Sacred water can be found by pushing any of the three boulders in the Viyeldi caves. Revealing the sacred water results in the Polluted water in the Kharazi Jungle being restored again. Looking at the water results in the message: "You see some sparkling effervescent water, it looks somehow similar to the water above ground."

label: Sad Meadow
title: Sad Meadow
lead: Sad Meadow is a music track that is unlocked in West Ardougne during the Plague City quest. Prior to release of Song of the Elves, it could be unlocked without starting the quest.

label: Sailing Journey
title: Sailing Journey
lead: Sailing Journey is a Jingle that plays when sailing via a non-charter ship. It is based upon Scape Original.

label: Sails (windmill)
title: Sails (windmill)
lead: Sails are animated scenery found on the top floor of most windmills. Canonically, they harness wind energy to power millstones in order to grind flour.

label: Salarin the twisted
title: Salarin the twisted
lead:
Salarin the twisted is a chaos druid found at the end of the Yanille Agility Dungeon. Reaching his cave requires level 67 Agility; this can be boosted from as low as 62 with a summer pie. Additionally, players will need to bring a blade to cut the webs near the dungeon entrance.

Salarin is one of the two NPCs that drop the sinister key on death, alongside the Chaos Fanatic. This key opens the Sinister chest, located nearby, which rewards the player with a guaranteed noted drop of nine grimy herbs (see below), including a torstol. The key is dropped at a rate of 7.8%, making him a common target for low-level ironmen who can't yet grow the herbs.

label: Salmon
title: Salmon
lead:
Salmon is a type of fish that restores 9 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw salmon on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 25 Cooking and granting 90 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt fish. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Salmon is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 58, or 55 when using the Lumbridge range.

Salmon is one of the fish required by Caleb during the quest Family Crest.

label: Salve Graveyard
title: Salve Graveyard
lead: The Salve Graveyard is located east of the River Salve and north of Mort Myre Swamp. The graveyard contains six dead trees, various gravestones, and a number of ghouls. Players can use the Salve Graveyard Teleport spell or fairy ring code to quickly reach the graveyard.

label: Salve Island
title: Salve Island
lead:
An island could originally be found in the middle of the River Salve. It was added with the release of The Dig Site in 2003. It was possibly added as a placeholder to ensure there was terrain on the other side of the river, as otherwise the player would have appeared to be panning for gold in the ocean.

With the release of RuneScape 2, the island was expanded to the east.

label: Sammy Servil
title: Sammy Servil
lead: Sammy Servil is the only son of Lady Servil and Justin Servil, two minor nobles of Kandarin. During the Fight Arena quest, he is kidnapped by the forces of General Khazard and imprisoned in the Fight Arena; the player must rescue him during the quest by fighting in the arena.

label: San Tojalon
title: San Tojalon
lead: San Tojalon is one of the three long-dead warriors alongside Irvig Senay and Ranalph Devere that are required to be killed to collect a piece of the heart crystal for the Legends' Quest. He is hostile until you kill him to obtain the chunk of crystal, but you can still attack him afterwards and he will fight back. He attacks with melee.

label: Sand (pile)
title: Sand (pile)
lead:
Sand is a piece of interactable scenery. Players are able to fill up buckets with the sand, making buckets of sand. Due to the distance from the bank, collecting buckets of sand from sand piles is inefficient and not suggested over using available sand pits. Using the sand's "Look" option will give the player a message telling them how large the pile is, such as This looks like a large pile of sand.

Buckets cannot be filled with sand on free-to-play worlds.

label: Sand pit
title: Sand pit
lead:
Sand pits are mostly used in glassblowing to train Crafting. Sand pits are located in Entrana, Yanille, Rellekka, Dorgesh-Kaan, Prifddinas, Zanaris, Sunset Coast, and The Great Conch.

Molten glass that can be blown with Glassblowing pipe is made by using Soda ash and a bucket of sand with a Furnace. Buckets of sand can be obtained simply by using an empty bucket on a sand pit. Soda ash can be obtained by burning Seaweed on a Range or a fire.

label: Sanfew
title: Sanfew
lead: Sanfew is the leader of the druids and resides in Taverley, on the of Jatix's Herblore Shop. He plays a part in several quests, including Druidic Ritual, Eadgar's Ruse, and One Small Favour. He is also the inventor of the Sanfew serum.

label: Santa hat
title: Santa hat
lead: Santa hats are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year.

label: Sapphire
title: Sapphire
lead: Sapphires are precious gems used mainly in Crafting. They can be cut from uncut sapphires with a chisel at level 20 Crafting, yielding 50 experience.

label: Sapphire amulet
title: Sapphire amulet
lead:
A sapphire amulet can be created with 24 Crafting by using a gold bar on a furnace while also carrying a cut sapphire and an amulet mould. This will grant 65 Crafting experience and create a sapphire amulet (u), which may not be worn. A ball of wool must be used on the unstrung amulet to complete it, which gives 4 Crafting experience.

Sapphire amulets provide no bonuses, but casting Lvl-1 Enchant on a sapphire amulet will turn it into an amulet of magic.

label: Sapphire amulet (u)
title: Sapphire amulet (u)
lead: A sapphire amulet (u) can be created with level 24 Crafting by using a gold bar on a furnace while also carrying a cut sapphire and an amulet mould. This will grant 65 Crafting experience. A ball of wool can be used on the unstrung amulet to create a strung sapphire amulet, which can then be enchanted at level 7 Magic using the Lvl-1 Enchant spell to create an amulet of magic.

label: Sapphire necklace
title: Sapphire necklace
lead:
The sapphire necklace is made by using a gold bar, a sapphire and a necklace mould on a furnace. This requires a Crafting level of 22 and gives 55 experience when made.

Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim buys at a higher price than High Alchemy, if he has no sapphire necklaces for sale. He will buy the first for 735 coins, compared with the High Alchemy value of 630 coins. However, his price decreases in relation to the amount he has in stock, going below High Alchemy value when his stock goes above five.

label: Sapphire ring
title: Sapphire ring
lead:
The sapphire ring is made by using a gold bar on a furnace while having a sapphire and a ring mould in one's inventory. Making it requires a Crafting level of 20, and gives 40 experience.

Grum's Gold Exchange in Port Sarim buys at better price than High Alchemy, depending on his current stock. If he has no sapphire rings for sale, he buys the first for 630 coins.

label: Saradomin cape
title: Saradomin cape
lead:
The Saradomin cape is a reward from Mage Arena I miniquest. To receive the cape, the player must defeat Kolodion in his four guises, then speak to him, step through the nearby sparkling pool, and finally pray at the Statue of Saradomin. Upon praying at the statue, the Saradomin cape will appear next to the player and can be picked up.

The Saradomin cape and the Saradomin staff are required to benefit from the Charge spell, which enables the player to hit up to 50% more damage with the Saradomin Strike spell.

label: Saradomin full helm
title: Saradomin full helm
lead:
The Saradomin full helm is a decorated rune full helm that is affiliated with the god Saradomin. Sharing the same stats as the rune full helm with a +1 prayer bonus, the Saradomin full helm also looks visually similar. Its appearance differs in that the helm features an ornamental white trim around the symbol of Saradomin. The full helm requires 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill. Players can obtain a Saradomin full helm as a reward from completing hard Treasure Trails.

Wearing any piece of this armour set will cause followers of Saradomin to become unaggressive upon entering the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Saradomin kiteshield
title: Saradomin kiteshield
lead:
The Saradomin kiteshield is a decorated rune kiteshield that is affiliated with the god Saradomin. Sharing the same stats as the rune kiteshield except for the ranged attack bonus and prayer bonus, the Saradomin kiteshield also looks visually similar. Its appearance differs in that the shield features an ornamental white trim.

The shield requires 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Saradomin platebody
title: Saradomin platebody
lead:
The Saradomin platebody is a trimmed Rune platebody fashioned to praise Saradomin. It has the same stats as the Rune platebody but provides protection from followers of Saradomin in the God Wars Dungeons as well as a +1 prayer bonus. It requires 40 Defence and the completion of the Dragon Slayer I quest to wear.

It can only be obtained as a reward from hard Treasure Trails, and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Saradomin platelegs
title: Saradomin platelegs
lead:
The Saradomin platelegs are a decorated version of rune platelegs that are affiliated with the god Saradomin. Sharing the same stats as rune platelegs (with the addition of a +1 prayer bonus), the Saradomin platelegs also look visually similar. Their appearance differs in that they feature an ornamental white trim around the symbol of Saradomin. The platelegs require 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill. Players can obtain Saradomin platelegs as a reward from completing hard Treasure Trails.

These platelegs are a constituent of the Saradomin armour set which consists of the following items: Saradomin full helm, Saradomin platebody, Saradomin platelegs or Saradomin plateskirt, and Saradomin kiteshield—all of which are decorative versions of their respective rune armour counterparts. Wearing any piece of this armour set causes followers of Saradomin to become unaggressive to the player.

label: Saradomin staff
title: Saradomin staff
lead:
The Saradomin staff is a god staff that can only be obtained by finishing the Mage Arena minigame. Like the other God staves, this staff requires level 60 Magic to acquire and therefore wield. To get it, the player must defeat Kolodion the mage in all of his forms. Afterwards, they will have to pick a god to worship to receive a cape and the staff corresponding to that god. If the player has already chosen another god, the staff can be purchased from the Chamber Guardian for 80,000 coins.

The staff allows wielders to cast the Saradomin Strike spell, which must be cast 100 times inside the Mage Arena minigame to gain the ability to use it outside of the arena. The spell can deal a maximum of 20 damage. Saradomin Strike lowers the target's Prayer level by one point on each successful cast.

label: Saradomin Strike
title: Saradomin Strike
lead:
Saradomin Strike is a combat spell in the standard spellbook, requiring 60 Magic and the completion of Mage Arena I to cast. In addition, players must also be wielding a Saradomin staff or staff of light; only the staff of light is able to autocast the spell.

Initially, the spell can only be cast within the Mage Arena against the battle mages. Upon casting the spell 100 times (regardless of whether it was a successful hit or not), the spell becomes usable outside the arena.

label: Sardine
title: Sardine
lead: Sardine is a type of fish that restores 4 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw sardine on a fire or cooking range, granting 40 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt sardine. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Sardine is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 38, or 34 when using the Lumbridge range.

label: Sbott
title: Sbott
lead: Sbott is the werewolf tanner on the northern side of Canifis. His shop is marked with the tanning icon ( ). His tannery is more expensive than average, charging a bit more than double what most other tanners charge to tan a hide. However his shop is very close to the fairy ring in Canifis as well as a bank, so some players find the convenience to be worth the few coins extra cost.

label: Scaffold
title: Scaffold
lead: Scaffolds are bits of decorative scenery, usually found at remote locations or construction sites.

label: Scape Cave
title: Scape Cave
lead: Scape Cave is a music track that is unlocked on the cave on Tutorial Island, making it the second track heard by all new players. It can also be heard in Varrock Sewers and parts of Edgeville Dungeon, the basement of the Woodcutting Guild, and Pandemonium Cave.

label: Scape Original
title: Scape Original
lead:
Scape Original is a music track from the early days of RuneScape 2. It was the first login screen music track before being replaced with Scape Main. It is now unlocked automatically by all players upon their first login. It was also the track that played in the Realm of Memories during the 20th and 25th Anniversary events.

This music track is considered to be the "theme song" of RuneScape. Many of RuneScape s other songs make references to it, including Scape Main.

label: Scape Sad
title: Scape Sad
lead:
Scape Sad is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness or during the ending cutscene of Dragon Slayer II. It also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the Fountain of Rune and at the Demonic Ruins in the Wilderness.

label: Scape Soft
title: Scape Soft
lead:
Scape Soft is a music track that is unlocked in the north-east of Asgarnia, around Ice Mountain or the Monastery or east of Falador. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Lightness.

In Classic mode, the track plays in a smaller area just north of Falador.

label: Scape Wild
title: Scape Wild
lead:
Scape Wild is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays north of the Chaos Temple, and north of Lava Dragon Isle.

label: Scared skavid
title: Scared skavid
lead: The Scared skavids can be found in various places throughout the Skavid caves all around Gu'Tanoth and the Feldip Hills, which the player must go to during the Watchtower quest in order to retrieve one of the Watchtower crystals. In order to get them to cooperate, players must speak with the Scared Skavids in their native language.

label: Scavvo
title: Scavvo
lead: Scavvo runs Scavvo's Rune Store on the of the Champions' Guild. He can be found on the south side of the room. Players can purchase rune plateskirts, rune platelegs, rune maces, rune chainbodies, rune longswords, rune swords, green d'hide vambraces, green d'hide chaps, and coifs from him. Unlike Oziach, Scavvo does not sell the rune platebody or the green d'hide body.

label: Scavvo's Rune Store.
title: Scavvo's Rune Store.
lead:
Scavvo's Rune Store is located on the of the Champions' Guild and operated by Scavvo. This means players will need to acquire 32 quest points before they can access his shop.

The shop is noteworthy because it is the only place for free-to-play players to acquire green dragonhide armour apart from other players. It is also one of the few shops in the game to stock rune armour.

label: Scorched earth
title: Scorched earth
lead:
Scorched earth is a scenery object found within and just south of Tai Bwo Wannai. Players can search the scorched earth to find a grimy sito foil, which is primarily used during the Jungle Potion quest.

After being searched, the earth becomes searchable again after 60 seconds.

label: Scoreboard (Duel Arena)
title: Scoreboard (Duel Arena)
lead: There are two Scoreboards around the Duel Arena. These scoreboards show the last 50 fights that have been fought in the arena.

label: Scorpion
title: Scorpion
lead:
Scorpions are monsters historically iconic for inhabiting free-to-play areas, but have been increasingly more widespread in modern updates. They can be dangerous to low level players training Mining.

Scorpions are a relatively weak variety of monster, with the strongest being located in the Stronghold of Security (level 59).

label: Scorpion cage
title: Scorpion cage
lead:
The scorpion cage is an item obtained from Thormac at the beginning of Scorpion Catcher. This item is used in the quest to capture the scorpions which are obtainable from: Taverley Dungeon, Barbarian Outpost and Edgeville Monastery. According to Thormac, these scorpions are rare. If you lose the cage, you can get another by talking to Thormac again. After losing the cage, you will need to recapture any previously caught scorpions.

It's possible to get this item from Thormac without starting Scorpion Catcher. It's also possible to obtain duplicates by having a full backpack when Thormac attempts to give the player a cage. However, the cage serves no purpose outside the quest.

label: Scorpion Catcher
title: Scorpion Catcher
lead: Scorpion Catcher is a quest in which Thormac, a wizard in the Sorcerer's Tower, has lost three of his scorpions. He tasks you with finding them for him.

label: Scorpion Pit
title: Scorpion Pit
lead:
The Scorpion Pit is a valley in the northern portion of the Wilderness extending from level 53 to 55. The surface of the pit is infested with many level 14 Scorpions. With the Wilderness Rejuvenation update, multiple cave entrances (3 in the north and south) can now be interacted with, which takes the player into an underground cavern which contains Scorpia and her offspring.

On the valley itself, there are several headless arrow and bone spawns, along with many level 14 Scorpions. The Scorpion Pit (both inside and outside), along with the surrounding area is multi-combat, and is a hotspot for PKers who come to kill Scorpia hunters.
