Players should take caution around the pit as the Chaos Elemental can also wander into the Scorpion Pit, dealing high damage to lower-levelled players.

label: Scrawled note
title: Scrawled note
lead: The scrawled note is an item obtained while searching the crate in Viyeldi caves during Legends' Quest. It cannot be reobtained after completing the quest.

label: Screen
title: Screen
lead: Two screens can be found in southernmost tent of the desert Bandit Camp and one in Falador, upstairs of Cassie's Shield Shop. Players cannot interact with the screens but are able to examine them.

label: Scrumpled note
title: Scrumpled note
lead: The scrumpled note is an item obtained while searching the bed in the Shaman Caves during Legends' Quest. It cannot be reobtained after completing the quest.

label: Scrumpled paper
title: Scrumpled paper
lead:
A scrumpled paper is a recipe for Ugthanki kebabs that is dropped by Shantay (found in the Shantay Pass) when a player talks to him. To get one quickly, players can spam the "Talk-to" option until one is dropped.

When one is dropped on the ground, the message Something drops out of Shantay's pocket onto the floor. It looks like a piece of paper. is given.

label: Scythe (Halloween event)
title: Scythe (Halloween event)
lead:
The scythe is an untradeable event reward. It can be obtained by completing one of the Halloween holiday events that occur once per year.

The scythe is not particularly powerful, as it is intended to be a decorative weapon. It has very low bonuses and a slow attack speed. Notably, it has several unique attack animations.

label: Sea Shanty
title: Sea Shanty
lead:
Sea Shanty is a music track that unlocks around Musa Point and Karamja Volcano. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track and Jungle Island.

In Classic mode, the track plays at Musa Point and its docks.

label: Sea Shanty 2
title: Sea Shanty 2
lead:
Sea Shanty 2 is a music track that is unlocked in Port Sarim. It can also be unlocked by going to the docks west of Prifddinas or on Tempoross Cove after defeating Tempoross.

The track has become arguably one of the most iconic tracks in Old School RuneScape; Ian Taylor, the track's composer, would later comment on its fame in an interview in late 2018:

label: Sea Slug
title: Sea Slug
lead: Sea Slug is the first quest in the Sea Slug series, and is the only piece of content to prominently feature the Fishing Platform.

label: Sea slug (item)
title: Sea slug (item)
lead:
A Sea slug is an item that players can pick up using the Telekinetic Grab spell on a sea slug that Kent knocks off the player during the Sea Slug quest.

Without Telekinetic Grab, it will merely damage the player for 3 hitpoints, causing them to exclaim "Ouch!" If dropped, players can only pick it up again using another Telekinetic Grab spell.

label: Sea slug (race)
title: Sea slug (race)
lead: Sea slugs (Opisthobranchia alucinor) are a race of slug-like creatures which are able to control the minds of humans by latching on to them. They are ruled by the Mother Mallum.

label: Sea turtle
title: Sea turtle
lead:
Sea turtles are a type of food that restores 21 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw sea turtle on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 82 Cooking and granting 211.3 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt sea turtle. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Sea turtles never stop burning altogether even at level 99, unless the player is wearing a Cooking cape.

Players without the cooking cape are encouraged to cook sea turtles on the clay oven within the Hosidius Kitchen, as this provides the player the best chances to successfully cook them.

label: Sealed letter
title: Sealed letter
lead: The sealed letter is a quest item used in The Dig Site. It is obtained by taking the unstamped letter to the Curator in Varrock's museum. He will then add his seal to the letter and the player can then return to the digsite exam centre to continue the quest. If you happen to lose your sealed letter, you can acquire a replacement for free from the Curator.

label: Seaman Lorris
title: Seaman Lorris
lead:
Seaman Lorris is one of the three sailors in Port Sarim, along with Captain Tobias and Seaman Thresnor.

For the price of 30 coins he will sail players to Musa Point on Karamja or The Pandemonium.

label: Seaman Thresnor
title: Seaman Thresnor
lead:
Seaman Thresnor is one of the three sailors in Port Sarim, along with Captain Tobias and Seaman Lorris.

For the price of 30 coins he will sail players to Musa Point on Karamja or The Pandemonium.

label: Seasoned chompy
title: Seasoned chompy
lead: A seasoned chompy is used in the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. It is made by obtaining the seasonings specified by Rantz, Fycie and Bugs and then cooking a raw chompy on the ogre spit roast with the seasoning items in your inventory. It is given to Rantz to complete the quest.

label: Seasoned legs
title: Seasoned legs
lead:
Seasoned legs were previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Toad batta. It could be made by adding Equa leaves and Gnome spice to some Toad's legs. They were then added to a Half baked batta alongside Cheese, which was baked to create the Toad batta.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the toad's legs, equa leaves and gnome spice are all automatically added at once to create a Half made batta. If the player attempts to add gnome spice or equa leaves to toad's legs, nothing happens.

label: Seasoned sardine
title: Seasoned sardine
lead:
A seasoned sardine is a quest item used only in Gertrude's Cat. It is made by using doogle leaves on a raw sardine.

It is given to Fluffs to calm her down.

label: seaweed
title: seaweed
lead: Seaweed is an item dropped by creatures near water, like rock crabs. It can also be obtained from Fishy salvage. It can be used with a filled fishbowl to catch a fish in the Catherby aquarium, or be cooked on a range or fire to create soda ash. Seaweed may also be used in place of soda ash in the superglass make Lunar spell, skipping the need to convert it to soda ash. Seaweed can be used for normal compost.

label: Secret Door
title: Secret Door
lead: The Secret Door is a door situated in a mountain passage between Burthorpe and the Fremennik Province. Climbing boots are required to access the area where the entrance is. This door grants access to the stronghold's lowest level, where the trolls keep their prisoners.

label: Secret way map
title: Secret way map
lead: The Secret way map is a quest item used in the Death Plateau quest. It can be obtained by travelling to Tenzing's mountain-side cabin near Burthorpe and giving him a pair of spiked boots made by Dunstan the blacksmith earlier in the quest. The map should then be taken to Denulth, the leader of the Imperial Guard to complete the quest. If the map is lost before completion of the quest, Tenzing will draw another map for the player without requiring another pair of spiked boots.

label: Seer
title: Seer
lead: Seers are the original settlers of Seers' Village north-east of Ardougne. Seers have the ability to see the future and are heavily involved in the Elemental Workshop quests and play a role in other quests such as Scorpion Catcher.

label: Seers' Village
title: Seers' Village
lead: Seers' Village is a small settlement to the west of Camelot. The mighty city of Ardougne is to the south, and Rellekka and Sinclair Mansion are to the north.

label: Seers' Village bank
title: Seers' Village bank
lead:
The Seers' Village bank, sometimes known simply as Seers bank, is a bank in Seers' Village.

The bank has an upper level, which contains a locked section with chests, crates, and some statues. The Seers' Village Agility Course starts on top of the bank, by climbing the south-eastern wall on the outside of the building. Players on the top floor can see other players who are starting a lap of the Agility course while they do the climbing animation.

label: Seers' Village church
title: Seers' Village church
lead:
The Seers' Village church is the church of Seers' Village. It features no priests. The courtyard has an entrance to Death's Domain, and is surrounded by wooden graves, as well as three yew trees.

It is also the end of the Seers' Village Agility Course.

label: Senntisten
title: Senntisten
lead:
Senntisten was the capital city of the Zarosian Empire, which existed during the Second and Third Age. According to archaeologists, it was home to a massive temple complex, and occupied roughly the area east of modern-day Varrock and parts of Silvarea, making it one of the largest known cities in Gielinor's history.

The city continued to act as the capital after the fall of Zaros at the hands of his general Zamorak, surviving throughout most of the God Wars until it was eventually conquered by Zamorakian forces. Under Zamorakian occupation, the city was destroyed, and was later conquered by Saradominists. They built the city Saranthium where the Zarosian capital once stood.

label: Seravel
title: Seravel
lead: Seravel is a ticket salesman who is found upstairs of Fernahei's Fishing Hut in Shilo Village. He sells ship tickets to the Lady of the Waves, which sails to either Port Sarim or Port Khazard.

label: Serenade
title: Serenade
lead:
Serenade is a music track that is unlocked at the areas north west and west of Yanille, including the Castle Wars Lobby.

When music area type is set to Classic, it is unlocked at the Observatory.

label: Serene
title: Serene
lead: Serene is a music track that is unlocked at the Air Altar.

label: Sergeant
title: Sergeant
lead: Sergeants are found on the Burthorpe training ground, training soldiers. Their appearance is similar to the soldiers they train, the difference being a yellow trim in the capes sergeants wear. They cannot be spoken to due to them being busy training soldiers.

label: Servant (Burthorpe)
title: Servant (Burthorpe)
lead: The servant is one of Prince Anlaf's helpers, found within Burthorpe Castle. He tells players he is busy with his duties and redirects them to Eohric if they want to ask questions.

label: Seven Priestly Warriors
title: Seven Priestly Warriors
lead:
The Seven Priestly Warriors is a term widely applied to Ivandis Seergaze, Iriandul Caistlyn, Sarl Dunegun, Derygull Templeton, Erysail the Pious, Friar Twiblick, and Essiandar Gar, Temple Knights that defended Misthalin and Asgarnia from invading Morytanian forces during the Misthalin - Morytania War, in roughly 1200 of the Fourth Age. They fought at Silvarea, upon which the Paterdomus was constructed after their death in battle. Of them, only Ivandis Seergaze of Lumbridge survived the direct conflict with Lord Drakan's forces, although he himself died during a later venture into the region.

The warriors also blessed the River Salve during the final battle of the Misthalin - Morytania War, creating a barrier to prevent Morytanian invasion in the future. This blessing has held, although there have been several instances of crossing through various methods. The warriors remain some of humanity's most universally celebrated historical figures, although they are most frequently referenced in Misthalinian lore and history.

id: category:characters that do not appear in-game
label: Characters that do not appear in-game
Sewer valve
title: Sewer valve
lead:
Sewer valves are water-controlling devices found just south of Ardougne. They are used in the Hazeel Cult quest. There are 5 sewer valves total. Each has a "turn-right" and "turn-left" option.

Just east of the Clock Tower is a dungeon entrance. Inside there is a raft. When boarded, this raft goes to different places based on the positions of all 5 sewer valves.

label: sextant
title: sextant
lead:
A sextant is an item used for solving coordinate clues whilst on a Treasure Trail. It does not need to be brought with the player if the exact coordinate is known beforehand.

A chart can be obtained by first talking to the Observatory professor (who may be at the Observatory or the nearby Observatory reception building to the north-east, depending upon whether the player has completed the Observatory Quest), then, speaking to Murphy in Port Khazard, who will give you a sextant. Murphy is found on the dock near the trawler for the Fishing Trawler. Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower can then give the player a watch.

label: shade
title: shade
lead:
Shades are monsters that reside on the fourth level of the Stronghold of Security (the Sepulchre of Death) and in the Catacombs of Kourend.

The shades in the Stronghold of Security are found next to the ladder leading to the fourth floor, while the ones in the Catacombs of Kourend are found in the northernmost area of Reeking Cove, south from the steel dragons. Shades in the Catacombs of Kourend are next to the Twisted Banshee and Deviant spectre and you will have to pass them to get to the shades, so ensure you have suitable protection, for example a Slayer helmet, otherwise it is easy to die to the banshee or spectres special attacks.

label: Shade robe
title: Shade robe
lead: Shade robe is a part of Shade robes and is dropped by shades. It provides +1 higher Prayer bonus than a priest gown, but 1 less than a monk's robe.

label: Shade robe top
title: Shade robe top
lead: Shade robe top is a part of Shade robes and is dropped by shades. It provides 2 higher Prayer bonus than a priest gown, but 1 less than a monk's robe top.

label: Shadow spider
title: Shadow spider
lead:
Shadow spiders are one of few monsters that are hidden on the player's minimap. If a player initiates combat, it will drain the player's Prayer points by half of the current amount, rounded up. If a player is in combat with them over a long period, they will continue to drain the player's Prayer at regular intervals. Wearing a spectral spirit shield reduces the Prayer drain by half.

They can never take away a player's last prayer point.

label: Shadow warrior
title: Shadow warrior
lead: Shadow warriors are one of few monsters that are hidden on the player's minimap. They are not considered undead, so the salve amulet has no effect on them. Shadow warriors appear to be wielding battleaxes, but they attack at the same speed as scimitars. After completion of Legends' Quest, Shadow warriors are a possible Slayer task from Chaeldar and Vannaka.

label: Shaman Caves
title: Shaman Caves
lead:
The Shaman Caves are the upper floor of a cave system located in the Kharazi Jungle in southern Karamja. They play a large role in Legends' Quest, which must be started in order to access the caves. The entrance to the cave is in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle and is accessed by squeezing into the mossy rock, which requires 50 Agility.

The first room of the caves has a fire wall containing Ungadulu, a shaman possessed by the black demon Nezikchened. Ungadulu later helps the player reach the deeper sections of the cave, including the deeper Viyeldi caves accessed via a winch at the end of the dungeon. There is a shortcut on the western wall near the entrance that bypasses a majority of the cave, requiring 96 Agility.

label: Shaman robe
title: Shaman robe
lead: The shaman robe is an item that can be found during or after the Watchtower Quest on the ground inside the Ogre Enclave. The robe cannot be worn. It only serves for the purpose of retrieving the cyan crystal if during the quest the player has lost it. The crystal can be found by searching the robe. After doing so, it has no other use and it can be safely dropped.

label: Shaman's tome
title: Shaman's tome
lead:
Shaman's tome can be found in the Shaman Caves during the Legends' Quest. It can be obtained by searching the desk inside the octogram of Fire walls. It doesn't give much useful information, more just the mental state of the shaman inside the flaming octagon and a mention of the fact he's actually being controlled by a demon.

After finding the book, another copy can be found on the shelves in your house.

label: Shamus
title: Shamus
lead:
Shamus is a leprechaun whom the player is required to talk to during the Lost City quest. He lives in a tree in Lumbridge Swamp, which the player must chop in order to get him to appear. When spoken to, he tells the player where to find Zanaris and how to enter.

The tree he lives in is located due west from the adventurers that start the player on the Lost City quest. The player can find it easily, because its left-click option is "Chop Tree" instead of "Chop down Tree".

label: Shantay
title: Shantay
lead:
Shantay is a merchant who runs the Shantay Pass. He owns the Shantay Pass Shop, and sells Shantay passes. Shantay also provides some information about desert survival, as the effects of the desert heat starts taking its toll south of Shantay Pass, which can be useful for new players going into the desert.

If a player declares being an outlaw, Shantay will call upon his guards to have the player arrested and demands the player pay a fine of 5 coins. If the player pays, they will be released. If the player refuses twice, Shantay will then transport the player to be locked in Port Sarim "High-security" jail.

label: Shantay disclaimer
title: Shantay disclaimer
lead: The Shantay disclaimer was an item that was given to players passing through the Shantay Pass, saying that no responsibility is taken if the player dies in the desert. By retaining one, players were able to skip a long-winded dialogue explaining the dangers of entering the desert. This system was replaced with the Doomsayer in July 2007, and the shantay disclaimers were removed. As a result, they have never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Shantay Guard
title: Shantay Guard
lead: Shantay Guards can be found guarding the Shantay Pass in southern Al Kharid. There are 3 attackable level 22 guards, and one who manages who passes through the gate. The attackable guards only drop bones, and are not often fought.

label: Shantay Pass
title: Shantay Pass
lead: The Shantay Pass is a small area that separates Al Kharid from the Kharidian Desert. Players will need to have 5 coins to buy a pass from Shantay, or have completed the elite Desert Diary, if they wish to enter the desert.

label: Shantay pass (item)
title: Shantay pass (item)
lead:
The Shantay pass is an item used to exit Al Kharid through the southern gate at the Shantay Pass. Players can buy one for 5 coins from Shantay, who stands near the gate. One pass is required for each entrance into The Kharidian Desert from Al Kharid or the Ruins of Unkah, but is not required for passage vice versa.

After completing the Elite Desert Diary, players no longer need to buy a pass and can enter the desert free of charge.

label: Shantay pass (scenery)
title: Shantay pass (scenery)
lead: Shantay passes can be found at Shantay Pass as well as the Ruins of Unkah. In both locations, the scenery acts as a gateway to the rest of the Kharidian Desert, where its desert heat will quickly drain a player's health unless they have a source of water on them. These gateways require a shantay pass to cross, which can be bought from Shantay or his guards at the Ruins of Unkah.

label: Shantay Pass Shop
title: Shantay Pass Shop
lead:
The Shantay Pass Shop is a shop owned by Shantay in the Shantay Pass. It sells items players might need in the Kharidian Desert, such as waterskins, knives, and desert clothing.

The shop can also be accessed from the Ruins of Unkah by trading the Shantay guards there. The stock is shared between Shantay and the two Shantay guards.

label: Shark
title: Shark
lead:
Shark is a type of fish that restores 20 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw shark on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 80 Cooking and granting 210 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt shark. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. It will only stop burning entirely if the player is wearing a Cooking cape, or using Cooking gauntlets at level 94 (84 if elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is completed while cooking at the Hosidius kitchen).

When eaten, the message You eat the shark. is displayed.

label: Shark (ocean)
title: Shark (ocean)
lead: Sharks are predatory fish found in and around Karamja, more specifically near the Ship Yard. They can also be encountered during the Enlightened Journey quest when failing a balloon trip over the ocean, and in a similar situation in the Fishing Trawler minigame.

id: category:non-player characters with a combat level
label: Non-player characters with a combat level
Shears
title: Shears
lead:
Shears can be bought in almost any general store for 1 gp. They are required to shear wool from sheep, and are needed for the Sheep Shearer quest if you choose to gather the wool yourself. They are also needed for the quest A Tail of Two Cats.

They can be picked up off of the table in Fred the Farmer's house for the quest Sheep Shearer. It can also be found in Hosidius, in the building just north of the estate agent.

label: Shed (Lumbridge Swamp)
title: Shed (Lumbridge Swamp)
lead:
The Lumbridge Swamp shed is a seemingly inconspicuous storage shed located at the heart of the swamp, east of the mysterious runes for the water altar. Entering the shed can only be done on members worlds, and entering without wielding either a Dramen staff or Lunar staff will simply allow the player to enter the building. However, while wielding either of the staves, the player will be teleported to the entry fairy ring of Zanaris.

There are frogs, big frogs, and giant frogs as well as giant rats that spawn outside the shed.

label: Sheep
title: Sheep
lead: Sheep are mammals found throughout Old School RuneScape. Players can use shears on most sheep to gain a piece of wool, which they can make into a ball of wool.

label: Sheep bones (1)
title: Sheep bones (1)
lead:
Sheep bones (1) is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It is dropped by a Red Sheep that is in the pen and after feeding it sheep feed.

The bones cannot be buried but are instead incinerated.

label: Sheep bones (2)
title: Sheep bones (2)
lead:
Sheep bones (2) is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It is dropped by a Green Sheep that is in the pen and after feeding it sheep feed.

The bones cannot be buried but are instead incinerated.

label: Sheep bones (3)
title: Sheep bones (3)
lead:
Sheep bones (3) is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It is dropped by a Blue Sheep that is in the pen and after feeding it sheep feed.

The bones cannot be buried but are instead incinerated.

label: sheep bones (4)
title: sheep bones (4)
lead:
Sheep bones (4) is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It is dropped by a Yellow Sheep that is in the pen and after feeding it sheep feed.

The bones cannot be buried but are instead incinerated.

label: Sheep feed
title: Sheep feed
lead:
Sheep feed is a quest item used only in Sheep Herder. It is obtained from Councillor Halgrive at the start of the quest.

It is used on sick-looking sheep that the player has herded into the slaughterhouse set up by Farmer Brumty.

label: Sheep Herder
title: Sheep Herder
lead: Sheep Herder is a novice quest associated with the Elf quest series. It begins with the revelation that some sheep have been infected with plague. The target of the quest is to herd the sick sheep, kill them and dispose of their remains to prevent the plague from spreading to the town. Herding the sheep can prove challenging, since they are not very cooperative.

label: Sheep Shearer
title: Sheep Shearer
lead: Sheep Shearer is one of the six quests available when RuneScape Classic first launched. In it, players help Fred the Farmer shear his sheep.

label: shield left half
title: shield left half
lead:
The shield left half is an item that can be joined with the right half to create the dragon square shield with level 60 Smithing. Joining the right half with the left half nets 75 Smithing experience. The other half of the shield is sold by Siegfried Erkle in the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items for 750,000 coins.

This item is a rare drop from the rare drop table. Wearing a ring of wealth will increase the chances of receiving one from the rare drop table. Goraks fought in the Gorak Plane are likely droppers of the shield left half, with a drop rate of 1/243.75 (with a ring of wealth equipped) if Fairytale II - Cure a Queen and Legends' Quest have been completed.

label: Shield of Arrav
title: Shield of Arrav
lead: Shield of Arrav is a quest where the shield of the famous Arrav of Avarrocka has been stolen by organised crime syndicates in Varrock.

label: Shield right half
title: Shield right half
lead:
The shield right half is an item which can be bought in the Legends' Guild or the Myths' Guild for 750,000 coins. It can be combined with the shield left half (provided that you have 60 Smithing) to form the dragon square shield. A hammer and anvil is needed to combine the shield.

Creating a Dragon square shield from the two halves in West Ardougne is a hard task in the Ardougne Diary.

label: Shilo Village
title: Shilo Village
lead: Shilo Village is a quest in which the player lays to rest a vengeful spirit that is attacking Shilo Village, a town located in southern Karamja. The quest unlocks access to the village and its cart system.

label: Shilo Village (location)
title: Shilo Village (location)
lead: Shilo Village is a small village in southern Karamja, accessible after completing the Shilo Village quest.

label: Shilo Village bank
title: Shilo Village bank
lead:
The Shilo Village bank is a bank found in Shilo Village. Players must have completed the Shilo Village quest to enter the village and use the bank.

The Shilo Village bank is popular for players training Smithing, as the furnace is directly across from the bank, and the closest furnace to a bank in the game. Many players prefer the bank in Prifddinas, as it is only one tile further from a furnace, and does not require the payment to Yohnus for each use. Players who have not completed Song of the Elves can put coins into a coffer to keep a full inventory of ore.

label: Shilo Village mine
title: Shilo Village mine
lead:
The Shilo Village mining site is one of only three places in Gielinor where players can find gem rocks, others being the mine on Lunar Isle, and the mine on the Onyx Crest. It is located in the north-west corner of Shilo Village. It contains seven gem rocks, which give one random gem when mined, either an opal, jade, red topaz, sapphire, emerald, ruby, or diamond. There are no monsters or any other rocks at the mine.

Players who have completed the Medium Karamja Diary are able to access the underground portion of the gem mine, which contains an additional 48 gem rocks and a bank deposit chest. Players may use the Karamja gloves 3 to teleport directly to the underground mines an unlimited number of times.

label: Shilop
title: Shilop
lead:
Shilop Fairweather is one of Gertrude's children; the others being Wilough, Philop and Kanel.

During Gertrude's Cat, he tells the player information about Fluffs (Gertrude's cat).

label: Shimmering field
title: Shimmering field
lead: The shimmering field is a scenery object found in the Viyeldi Caves during and after the Legends' Quest. It can be passed through after using the heart crystal on the recess. It connects with the area containing 3 lesser demons.

label: Shine
title: Shine
lead: Shine is a music track that is unlocked north of the Emir's Arena facilities, around the Mage Training Arena. In Classic music mode, it plays in a wider area including Emir's Arena hospital, bank and western side of cliffs west from Mage Training Arena.

label: Shining
title: Shining
lead:
Shining is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays in the Bone Yard north-east of the Graveyard of Shadows in the Wilderness, at the Wilderness Agility Course and its dungeon.

label: Shiny key
title: Shiny key
lead: The shiny key is obtainable after partial completion of the Temple of Ikov quest, found at the end of the Temple of Ikov dungeon. It is used to take the shortcut from the house in McGrubor's Wood to the lesser demon area of the Temple of Ikov dungeon. It can be placed on the steel key ring.

label: Ship ticket
title: Ship ticket
lead:
Ship tickets are tickets for the Lady of the Waves. It can be exchanged to Captain Shanks for a boat ride to Port Khazard or Port Sarim.

They can be purchased in Shilo Village from Seravel above the fishing shop north of the entrance. They can also be purchased from Captain Shanks who sells it for a varying price (usually between 26-45 coins).

label: Shipyard (Karamja)
title: Shipyard (Karamja)
lead:
The Shipyard is a ship-building facility on the east shore of Karamja, built under the discreet supervision of Glough to raise a navy capable of attacking the human population of Gielinor. It is first visited by players completing The Grand Tree, and it subsequently plays a role in the Monkey Madness I quest. Entering the Shipyard requires the player to speak the password (Ka, Lu, Min), which is obtained during The Grand Tree quest. The player must have a gnome royal seal in their inventory to enter through the western gate. A new seal can be obtained from the gnome king.

The seal is no longer needed once you have finished the quest.

label: Shipyard worker
title: Shipyard worker
lead:
This Article is about shipyard workers in eastern Karamja. For Sailing related npcs, see Shipyard Worker (Sailing)

Shipyard workers are men employed by the gnome Glough to work in his large Ship Yard in eastern Karamja. They can be attacked. They feature in the the Grand Tree and Monkey Madness I quests.

label: Shop assistant (Al Kharid)
title: Shop assistant (Al Kharid)
lead: The Shop assistant helps the Shop keeper run the Al Kharid General Store.

label: Shop assistant (Edgeville)
title: Shop assistant (Edgeville)
lead: The Shop assistant is the second in command to the Shop keeper for the Edgeville General Store.

label: Shop assistant (Falador)
title: Shop assistant (Falador)
lead: The Shop assistant helps the shop keeper run the Falador General Store.

label: shop assistant (Lumbridge)
title: shop assistant (Lumbridge)
lead: The Shop assistant helps run the Lumbridge General Store.

label: Shop assistant (Musa Point)
title: Shop assistant (Musa Point)
lead: The Shop assistant helps run the Karamja General Store.

label: Shop assistant (Rimmington)
title: Shop assistant (Rimmington)
lead: The Shop assistant helps run the Rimmington General Store.

label: Shop assistant (Varrock Swordshop)
title: Shop assistant (Varrock Swordshop)
lead: The Shop assistant helps the shop keeper run the Varrock Swordshop.

label: Shop assistant (Varrock)
title: Shop assistant (Varrock)
lead: The Shop assistant is the second in command to the Shop keeper for the Varrock General Store.

label: Shop keeper (Al Kharid)
title: Shop keeper (Al Kharid)
lead: The shop keeper in Al Kharid is in charge of the Al Kharid General Store, with help from his assistant.

label: Shop keeper (Combat Training Camp)
title: Shop keeper (Combat Training Camp)
lead: Shop keeper is the shopkeeper for King Lathas's Armoury, found in the Combat Training Camp. He differs greatly in appearance to the shop keepers found in most general stores. He has no dialogue other than to open his shop. His shop sells a variety of weapons and ammo.

label: Shop keeper (Edgeville)
title: Shop keeper (Edgeville)
lead: The Shop keeper is in charge of the Edgeville General Store with the help of his shop assistant.

label: Shop keeper (Falador)
title: Shop keeper (Falador)
lead: The Shop keeper runs the Falador General Store with the help of their assistant.

label: Shop keeper (Lumbridge)
title: Shop keeper (Lumbridge)
lead: The shop keeper is in charge of the Lumbridge General Store in Lumbridge. He is assisted by the shop assistant (Lumbridge). The shop keeper plays a minor role in the Death to the Dorgeshuun. He is one of the humans Zanik meets while visiting Lumbridge. He sells her a wooden bucket, a wood hammer, and a newcomer map.

label: Shop keeper (Musa Point)
title: Shop keeper (Musa Point)
lead: The Shop keeper is in charge of the Karamja General Store.

label: Shop keeper (Port Khazard)
title: Shop keeper (Port Khazard)
lead: The two shop keepers are in charge of the Khazard General Store.

label: Shop keeper (Rimmington)
title: Shop keeper (Rimmington)
lead: The Shop keeper is in charge of the Rimmington General Store.

label: Shop keeper (Varrock Swordshop)
title: Shop keeper (Varrock Swordshop)
lead: The Shop keeper is in charge of the Varrock Swordshop with the help of his assistant. He only has one arm.

label: Shop keeper (Varrock)
title: Shop keeper (Varrock)
lead: The Shop keeper is in charge of the Varrock General Store.

label: Shop of Distaste
title: Shop of Distaste
lead:
The Shop of Distaste is a shop in the Emir's Arena, right next to the bank. All they sell is rotten tomatoes, which can be bought from the shopkeeper, Fadli, for one coin each. The rotten tomatoes can be thrown at player characters while they're fighting, but not when they are fighting you. They can only be thrown at people from the sides of the Emir's Arena, at people within the arena. The shop also has a counterpart person over at the banking, with whom you can bank, collect, or trade for rotten tomatoes. This shop serves a similar purpose to the Pelters' Veg Stall found near pillories.

Although of limited use, rotten tomatoes are used in the quest Recipe for Disaster. It is one of the easier ways to obtain rotten tomatoes, the easiest being buying them from the crate in Varrock.

label: Short green guy
title: Short green guy
lead: Short green guys (commonly abbreviated to SGG) are drinks that can be made at level 20 Cooking, granting 120 Cooking experience. They heal 5 hitpoints, boost Strength by 5% + 1 levels, and reduce Attack by 2% - 3 levels. Short green guys are a good way to cheaply train without leaving the Gnome Stronghold, since they require only one type of fruit, have cheap ingredients, and only require one chopped/sliced item.

label: Shortbow
title: Shortbow
lead:
The shortbow is the weakest bow in Old School RuneScape and can use arrows up to iron. Players can purchase this bow from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock.

Players are supplied with this bow along with several bronze arrows as their first ranged weapon on Tutorial Island.

label: Shortbow (u)
title: Shortbow (u)
lead: A shortbow (u) is made using a knife with logs, requiring 5 Fletching and yielding 5 Fletching experience. Stringing a shortbow (u) with a bowstring makes a shortbow, also requiring 5 Fletching and yielding an additional 5 Fletching experience.

label: Shrimps
title: Shrimps
lead:
Shrimp is a type of fish that restores 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw shrimp on a fire or cooking range, granting 30 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt shrimp. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Shrimp is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 34, or 31 when using the Lumbridge range.

Shrimp are one of the fish required by Caleb in the quest Family Crest.

label: Sickle mould
title: Sickle mould
lead:
A sickle mould is a type of mould that can be used together with a silver bar to create a silver sickle. One can make a silver sickle at a Crafting level of 18.

The sickle mould can be purchased from the following shops:
*Dommik's Crafting Store in Al Kharid
*Jamila's Craft Stall in Sophanem
*Rasolo the Wandering Merchant west of the Fishing Guild
*Rommik's Crafty Supplies in Rimmington

label: Siegfried Erkle
title: Siegfried Erkle
lead:
Siegfried Erkle can be found on the of the Legends' Guild. He runs the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items, which is the only source of the cape of legends.

He is the brother of Radimus Erkle, the Grand Vizier of the Legends' Guild.

label: Sigbert the Adventurer
title: Sigbert the Adventurer
lead:
Sigbert the Adventurer is located in the Yanille Agility Dungeon. When talked to, he warns the player about the power of Salarin the twisted.

He once tried to fight the chaos druid but failed before learning that he can only be killed with "attacks from the mind", although Sigbert did not understand what this means.

label: Sign (Bank)
title: Sign (Bank)
lead: Signs are scenery found hanging outside most banks. Instead of a traditional sign with words on it, bank signs are a 3D representation of a bank chest. Most of the signs cannot be examined, but some variants can be examined if standing on the upper floor.

label: Sign (Blue Moon Inn)
title: Sign (Blue Moon Inn)
lead: Signs can be found in front and behind the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. They serve as decorative scenery that provide the name of the bar when examined.

label: Sign (Fancy Clothes Store)
title: Sign (Fancy Clothes Store)
lead: A sign depicting a multi-coloured spool of yarn hangs outside the Fancy Clothes Store in Varrock. It has no name and cannot be examined, but if it could the text would read Fancy Dress shop.

label: Sign (Flying Horse Inn)
title: Sign (Flying Horse Inn)
lead: A Sign can be seen at the front entrance of The Flying Horse Inn. It cannot be interacted with, but can be examined.

label: Signpost (Digsite)
title: Signpost (Digsite)
lead: Signposts are scenery objects found at various locations around the Digsite. When read, they provide a message denoting the level of certification required to dig at the site they are marking.

label: Signpost (Exam Centre)
title: Signpost (Exam Centre)
lead: A signpost can be found at the north-west entrance to the Exam Centre. When read, the signpost provides the message: Digsite information and exam centre.

label: Silk
title: Silk
lead:
Silk can be bought from various silk traders around Gielinor.

Silk can be stolen from silk stalls with a Thieving level of 20, yielding 24 experience. The Silk merchant who runs the silk stall in Ardougne will buy silk from the player for as much as 60 coins through his dialogue, if the player first offers to sell them for 120 coins each.

label: Silk merchant
title: Silk merchant
lead:
The Silk merchant is a non-player character in East Ardougne and Great Kourend that buys silk. Silk cannot be sold to him by players who recently stole from his stall. The silk merchant will remember thieves for 10 minutes since last stealing from the silk stall. Logging out will not reset the duration, and the player will have to wait 10 minutes after logging back in.

The price that each silk is worth can be bargained through the merchant's dialogue. The best price is 60 coins, which is accessed by first offering 120 and then countering the merchant's offer of 50 coins. Selling the silk for 60 coins is an easy Ardounge Diary task. Other possible sell values are 20, 40, or 50 coins each. After the price is decided, the merchant will buy all silks in the inventory at the same time.

label: Silk stall
title: Silk stall
lead: A silk stall is a stall that players can steal silk from at level 20 Thieving. Players earn 24 Thieving experience every time they steal some silk (around 16,500 experience per hour), and it restocks every 5.4 seconds (9 ticks). Players may sell silk to the Silk merchant for 60 coins after they barter with him, provided they have not recently stolen from the stall (in the last 20–30 minutes). Players risk the possibility of being spotted by a guard or Knight of Ardougne while thieving. Players may choose to fight them, trap them inside a nearby building, or find a spot where they are unable to be attacked to resume thieving.

label: Silk stall (Al Kharid)
title: Silk stall (Al Kharid)
lead: Silk stall is a decorative stall in Al Kharid near the Silk trader. Unlike other silk stalls, the stall in Al Kharid cannot be stolen from.

label: Silk trader
title: Silk trader
lead:
The silk trader can be found north of the Al Kharid palace. He provides a slow but reliable way for newer members to gain some money. If the player is prepared to click through a lengthy dialogue, they can buy some silk for just 3 coins, which may then be sold for a small profit at any general store excluding the general store in Al Kharid. It is also possible to sell it at the Grand Exchange for a bigger profit.

It is possible for players to lower the purchase price of the silk by refusing the original offer by the Silk Trader and instead settling for a price of 2 coins.

label: Silvarea
title: Silvarea
lead: Silvarea is a small area in the north-eastern corner of Misthalin. Primarily consisting of a path between two mountain ranges, it ends at the Paterdomus Temple, behind which is the River Salve.

label: Silver bar
title: Silver bar
lead:
A silver bar is a bar of metal, refined through the Smithing skill by smelting a silver ore in a furnace, requiring 20 Smithing and granting 13.7 Smithing experience. It may also be bought (or stolen) from a silver merchant, such as the one in Ardougne market, or from other players.

The primary use of a silver bar is to create jewellery with the Crafting skill. To craft silver bars into jewellery players must use a silver bar on a furnace with a proper mould in their inventory. If players wish to craft jewellery with gems inset, the cut gems must be present in the player's inventory before crafting the jewellery. One silver bar is used during the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest, and another during Shadow of the Storm.

label: Silver book
title: Silver book
lead:
The silver book is a quest item used in the Murder Mystery quest. It is obtained from a barrel in David's bedroom in the Sinclair Mansion. It has David's fingerprints on it and is used to determine if David is the murderer or not. If it is used on the flour barrel, it will create the dusted silver book, and flypaper is used on it, it will create David's print, which can be compared with the unknown print to see if David is the killer.

The book cannot be placed in a player-owned house bookshelf.

label: Silver bottle
title: Silver bottle
lead: The silver bottle is a quest item used in the Murder Mystery quest. It is obtained from a barrel in Carol's bedroom in the Sinclair Mansion. It has Carol's fingerprints on it and is used to determine if Carol is the murderer or not. If it is used on the flour barrel, it will create a dusted silver bottle, and if flypaper is used on it, it will create Carol's print, which can be compared with the unknown print to see if Carol is the killer.

label: Silver cup
title: Silver cup
lead: Silver cup is a quest item used only in Murder Mystery quest. It is obtained from a barrel in Bob's bedroom in the Sinclair Mansion during the quest. It can be dusted with flour and used with flypaper to obtain Bob's print, which can be compared with the unknown print to see if Bob is the killer.

label: Silver merchant
title: Silver merchant
lead:
Erin, the Silver merchant, runs the Ardougne Silver Stall in East Ardougne. He plays a fairly large part in the Making History quest. The enchanted key is obtained from Erin during and after the quest; it is used in a miniquest to obtain the god Mjolnir weapons. He sells silver bars, silver ore, and unstrung symbols on his stall, buying unstrung symbols for more coins than usual shop owners.

Players with 50+ Thieving can steal from his silver stall. Failure will result in Erin calling for a guard, disallowing you to buy anything from him for a certain amount of time.

label: Silver necklace
title: Silver necklace
lead:
The silver necklace is a quest item used in the Murder Mystery quest. It is obtained from a barrel in Anna's bedroom in the Sinclair Mansion during the quest. It can be dusted with flour and used with flypaper to obtain Anna's print, which can be compared with the unknown print to see if Anna is the killer.

This item will disappear if a player has it in their bank or inventory upon finishing the quest. It is a unique cosmetic item, so if a player wishes to keep it, they must drop it before finishing the quest and pick it up again afterwards. It cannot be obtained again after the quest is finished.

label: Silver needle
title: Silver needle
lead:
The silver needle is a quest item used in the Murder Mystery quest. It is obtained from a barrel in Elizabeth's bedroom in the Sinclair Mansion. It has Elizabeth's fingerprints on it and is used to determine if Elizabeth is the murderer or not. If it is used on the flour barrel, it will create a dusted silver needle, and flypaper is used on it, it will create Elizabeth's print, which can be compared with the unknown print to see if Elizabeth is the killer.

If you save a copy by using the drop trick, you can not use it as a needle, making it worthless to keep after the quest. Silver needles cannot be obtained from Sinclair mansion after Murder Mystery has been completed.

label: Silver ore
title: Silver ore
lead:
Silver ore can be mined at level 20 Mining, providing 40 Mining experience. After silver rocks are mined, it takes 60 seconds for them to respawn. Smelting silver ore will turn it into a silver bar, requiring 20 Smithing and giving 13.7 Smithing experience. The bar can then be crafted into various types of jewellery through the Crafting skill at a furnace, rather than at an anvil like other metallic bars. Doing so requires the usage of a mould, depending on the type of jewellery desired.

Wearing mining gloves, superior mining gloves, or expert mining gloves allows 1, 2, or 3 additional ores (respectively) to be mined before depletion.

label: Silver pot (Murder Mystery)
title: Silver pot (Murder Mystery)
lead:
The silver pot is a quest item used in the Murder Mystery quest. It is obtained from a barrel in Frank's bedroom in the Sinclair Mansion. It has Frank's fingerprints on it and is used to determine if Frank is the murderer. If it is used on the flour barrel, it will create a dusted silver pot, and flypaper is used on it, it will create Frank's print, used to see if Frank is the killer.

Using the pot on a barrel of flour will result in a message stating You probably shouldn't use evidence from a crime scene to keep flour in...

label: silver rocks
title: silver rocks
lead:
Silver rocks are a rock containing silver ore. A player with a Mining level of 20 can mine silver ore, yielding 40 Mining experience.

Wearing mining gloves, superior mining gloves, or expert mining gloves makes the rock not deplete upon mining silver, allowing you to mine one, two, or three additional ore, respectively, before depleting.

label: Silver sickle
title: Silver sickle
lead: A silver sickle can be made at 18 Crafting with a silver bar and a sickle mould at a furnace, granting 50 Crafting experience. It can be turned into a Silver sickle (b) during Nature Spirit quest, and can also be blessed after the quest by dipping it in the pool of water in the nature spirit's grotto. A blessed sickle can be used to cast Bloom; when cast, this spell drains your prayer slightly, and if you are in the Mort Myre Swamp, it may grow fungi, saplings and golden pears on rotting logs, branches, and small bushes respectively, which can be used to fill a druid pouch.

label: Silver sickle (b)
title: Silver sickle (b)
lead:
The silver sickle (b) is a silver sickle that was blessed by dipping it in the grotto water after completion of Nature Spirit. It protects the player from the swamp's decaying effects when wielded or in the inventory. This item can be used during the quest In Aid of the Myreque. There is a possibility of this item being needed for Fairytale I - Growing Pains. The sickle can be obtained again after the quest by using a silver sickle on the altar of nature found in the Nature Grotto.

The sickle has a right-click "bloom" option which can be used next to rotten logs, branches, or bushes in Mort Myre swamp to obtain Mort myre fungi, stems, and pears. This costs 1-6 prayer points per cast, and cannot be used if the player has no prayer points remaining. These items can be used to fill the Druid pouch which allows the player to fight Ghasts. Bloom can also be cast on dead vines in the Ancient Guthixian Temple to grow them into flowering vines which can be picked to obtain a vine flower.

label: Silver stall
title: Silver stall
lead: A silver stall is a stall, which may be stolen from at level 50 Thieving, granting 205 Thieving experience. The stall refreshes after 20 seconds.

label: Silver stall (unused)
title: Silver stall (unused)
lead: Silver stall is an unused variant of thievable silver stalls. The unused stalls have no Steal-from option, but are otherwise identical to the standard thieving stalls. The first variant may have been intended for use in free-to-play areas, and the second may have been intended for use in a cutscene during A Kingdom Divided.

label: Silverlight
title: Silverlight
lead:
Silverlight is a quest item used in Demon Slayer and Shadow of the Storm. It is a demonbane sword that is very effective against demonic creatures. It is obtained by bringing three Silverlight keys to Sir Prysin during Demon Slayer.

In Demon Slayer, it is used to defeat Delrith. In Shadow of the Storm, it is dyed black using black dye, and later transforms into Darklight, after it is stained with the blood of Agrith-Naar.

label: Silverlight key (Captain Rovin)
title: Silverlight key (Captain Rovin)
lead:
Silverlight key is one of the three keys needed to open the three locks of the sealed box which contains the sword Silverlight, a crucial item in the quest Demon Slayer. It is acquired from Captain Rovin after the player has started the quest and has asked Sir Prysin for the location of the keys. This key is the easiest of the three to acquire. Captain Rovin is on the topmost tower on the west side of the castle. Choose the correct phrases to say, then Captain Rovin will give the key. Select the option that says "Sir Prysin said you would give me the key" and then select the option that says "Then why did he give you the key?" After bringing up Sir Prysin's clumsiness he will hand it to you. It will take some arguing, though.

If destroyed, the player has to repeat the entire dialogue to obtain another one.

label: Silverlight key (Sir Prysin)
title: Silverlight key (Sir Prysin)
lead:
Silverlight key is one of the three keys needed to unlock Silverlight from its sealed casing during the Demon Slayer quest. During the start of the quest the player learns that Sir Prysin dropped his key down a drain. Using a bucket of water on the drain outside of the Varrock Palace kitchen will make the key fall down into Varrock Sewers.

This key unlike the other Silverlight keys is rusted, most likely due to it being stuck in the drain for a long time.

label: Silverlight key (Wizard Traiborn)
title: Silverlight key (Wizard Traiborn)
lead:
Silverlight key is one of the three keys needed to unlock Silverlight from its sealed casing during the Demon Slayer quest. At the start of the quest, this key is in the possession of a wizard named Traiborn, who is residing at the of the Wizards' Tower.

Traiborn will ask the player for 25 bones in order for him to summon his secret wardrobe (Examine reads, "A wardrobe brought forth by magic"), which contains this key. Once he summons his wardrobe, Traiborn will hand over this key to the player.

label: Sinclair family beehive
title: Sinclair family beehive
lead: The Sinclair family beehive is an interactive piece of scenery used during the Murder Mystery quest. Bob informs the player that he used poison on the beehive; if he is guilty then the player will discover that no poison was used.

label: Sinclair family compost heap
title: Sinclair family compost heap
lead: Sinclair family compost heap is an interactive piece of scenery used during the Murder Mystery quest. Anna informs the player that she used poison on the compost heap, if she is guilty then the player will discover that no poison was used.

label: Sinclair family crest
title: Sinclair family crest
lead: Sinclair family crest is an interactive piece of scenery used during the Murder Mystery quest. Frank informs the player that he used poison on the crest; if he is guilty then the player will discover that no poison was used.

label: Sinclair family fountain
title: Sinclair family fountain
lead: The Sinclair family fountain is an interactive piece of scenery used during the Murder Mystery quest. Elizabeth informs the player that she used poison on the fountain; if she is guilty then the player will discover that no poison was used.

label: Sinclair Guard dog
title: Sinclair Guard dog
lead:
The Sinclair Guard dog lives in the dog pen at the Sinclair Mansion, north of Seers' Village. He is indirectly involved in the Murder Mystery quest. When asking the Sinclair Mansion residents about the murder, Hobbes will mention that he didn't hear the dog barking, suggesting that it wasn't a stranger who committed the murder of Old Man Sinclair.

Players can verify Hobbes' statement by attempting to enter the dog pen; the guard dog will always notice and bark loudly.

label: Sinclair Mansion
title: Sinclair Mansion
lead: Sinclair Mansion is a large mansion owned by the Sinclair family that plays a significant role in the Murder Mystery quest. It is located north of Camelot, along the path that leads from Seers' Village to Rellekka. The fairy ring is located just west of the mansion. An Agility shortcut north of the mansion leads to Fremennik Province (48 Agility required).

label: Sinclair mansion drain
title: Sinclair mansion drain
lead: The Sinclair mansion drain is an interactive piece of scenery used during the Murder Mystery quest. Carol informs the player that she used poison on the drain; if she is guilty then the player will discover that no poison was used.

label: Sinister chest
title: Sinister chest
lead: The sinister chest is a locked chest located in the Agility Dungeon in Yanille. It is in a part of the dungeon that requires 49 Agility to access, north of the Chaos Altar. The chest can only be unlocked with the sinister key, which is a drop from Salarin the twisted and the Chaos Fanatic or a possible loot from a magpie impling jar/magpie impling. If opened, the chest will emit a toxic gas, which poisons the player so it is advised to bring an antipoison or other method of curing or preventing poison. However, repeatedly using keys on the chest stalls the poison effect, thus retaining your health until you leave (assuming the skeletons are not aggressive). Using a key purchased from the Grand Exchange is a profit of coins.

label: Sinister key
title: Sinister key
lead:
The sinister key is used to open the sinister chest in the Yanille Agility dungeon. The sinister chest contains nine noted grimy herbs: 2 harralanders, 3 ranarr weeds, 1 irit leaf, 1 avantoe, 1 kwuarm, and 1 torstol. The sinister key is dropped by Salarin the twisted and the chaos fanatic and can also be looted from a magpie impling.

The value of the sinister key is linked to the value of the herbs contained in the sinister chest. Buying a key, opening the chest, and selling the grimy herbs from it currently produces a profit of .

label: Sinister Stranger
title: Sinister Stranger
lead:
The Sinister Stranger, also known as Vlad, is one of the competitors during the Fishing Contest quest. He claims to not be a vampyre, despite very obviously acting like one.

During the quest, he is using the best fishing spot, which the player must use to win, so the player has to hide a garlic next to him, which causes him to swap places allowing them to win.

label: Sir Amik Varze
title: Sir Amik Varze
lead:
Sir Amik Varze is Asgarnia's current ruler, in the stead of King Vallance, and the leader of the White Knights of Falador. He has association with the Temple Knights. He is located on the of the western section of the White Knights' Castle in Falador.

Players may start the following quests by speaking to Sir Amik Varze:
*Black Knights' Fortress
*Recruitment Drive

label: Sir Carl
title: Sir Carl
lead:
Sir Carl is a paladin sent by King Lathas into the Underground Pass to look for a safe route through. He must be killed during the Underground Pass quest to collect the green paladin's badge. He gives the player food if they talk to him before killing him.

When initially killed, he will only drop his badge. If the player kills him again with the badge in their inventory, he will reward loot according to his loot table. After throwing his badge into the well, he will no longer respawn.

label: Sir Gawain
title: Sir Gawain
lead:
Sir Gawain is the one of King Arthur's knights. Players must help him break out of jail in the King's Ransom quest.

Sir Gawain is the sixth of the Knights of the Round Table to appear in the Knight Waves Training Grounds minigame. His attacks will temporarily lower the player's Attack level. Sir Gawain is based on the Arthurian character of the same name, featuring prominently in works such as .

label: Sir Harry
title: Sir Harry
lead:
Sir Harry is a paladin sent by King Lathas into the Underground Pass to look for a safe route through. He must be killed during the Underground Pass quest in order to collect the red paladin's badge. He gives the player food if they talk to him before killing him.

When initially killed, he will only drop his badge. If the player kills him again with the badge in their inventory, he will reward loot according to his loot table. After throwing his badge into the well, he will no longer respawn.

label: Sir Jerro
title: Sir Jerro
lead:
Sir Jerro is a paladin sent by King Lathas into the Underground Pass to look for a safe route through. He must be killed during the Underground Pass quest to collect the blue paladin's badge. He will give the player food if they talk to him before killing him.

When initially killed, he will only drop his badge. If the player kills him again with the badge in their inventory, he will reward loot according to his loot table. After throwing his badge into the well, he will no longer respawn.

label: Sir Lancelot
title: Sir Lancelot
lead:
Sir Lancelot is the strongest of King Arthur's knights. Players must help him break out of jail during the quest King's Ransom.

Players can also challenge Sir Lancelot during the Knight Waves Training Grounds activity, being the eighth and final Knight of the Round Table to appear in the Training Grounds.

label: Sir Mordred
title: Sir Mordred
lead:
Sir Mordred can be found on the top floor of Keep Le Faye near Catherby. He is fought during the Merlin's Crystal quest. He can be fought, but when he reaches 0 hitpoints, Morgan Le Faye will appear and ask that you spare him. The player must then ask Morgan to help them free Merlin from the crystal.

The player can also choose to spare or kill him through a dialogue, but they will have to repeat the fight afterwards. If killed, he will respawn shortly.

label: Sir Percival
title: Sir Percival
lead:
Sir Percival was a knight of Camelot, and was part of King Arthur's Knights of the Round Table. While searching for a set of legendary artefacts called the "Golden Boots of Arkanesses," he was kidnapped by goblins in northern Asgarnia. He became their slave, and was thrust into a sack and forgotten for over a day.

Percival is rescued by the player during the Holy Grail quest and succeeds his father, The Fisher King, as new king of the Fisher Realm. It is not known what happens to the old Fisher King, though it is implied that he passes away. After the quest, King Percival can be found on the of the castle to the south of fairy ring code .

label: Sir Prysin
title: Sir Prysin
lead:
Sir Ehntor Prysin is one of King Roald's knights. He is located in the south-west part of Varrock Palace, on the . He is the great-grandson of Wally who defeated Delrith 150 years ago, and, as such, is the custodian of Silverlight. To reduce the risk of Silverlight falling into the wrong hands, Sir Prysin placed the sword in a protective box that requires three keys to open. He then gave one key to wizard Traiborn, another to Captain Rovin, and kept the third key for himself.

If lost, Sir Prysin will return Silverlight for a fee of 500 coins, stating the importance of the sword. If Shadow Of The Storm is completed, Sir Prysin will instead return Darklight for 1000 coins. Sir Prysin states that killing the Demon makes Silverlight stronger so he charges more to return it to you as Darklight although he does not refer to it as such, retaining the name Silverlight instead. If the player already possesses Silverlight, Darklight, or Emberlight, Sir Prysin will not provide a replacement. However, players may temporarily drop their existing weapon, claim a Silverlight or Darklight from him, and then pick the original item back up afterward.

label: Sir Vyvin
title: Sir Vyvin
lead:
Sir Vyvin is a ranked White Knight officer that is involved in The Knight's Sword quest, his being the sword that was lost. He lives at the White Knights' Castle in Falador, in the eastern part of the . He sells white equipment to anyone who has completed Wanted!.

Buying a white 2h sword from his shop is a requirement for the elite Falador Diary.

label: Sito foil
title: Sito foil
lead:
Sito foil is a quest item used in Jungle Potion. It is made by cleaning grimy sito foil.

It is given to Trufitus so he can create a potion.

label: skavid
title: skavid
lead: Skavids are an elusive race of small, clawed humanoid creatures that dwell in the Feldip Hills in small caves. They are forced to serve as slaves to the Ogre race around the city of Gu'Tanoth. Skavids can be found in their dark Skavid caves, where the player must explore in the Watchtower quest, though they need maps to find their way around the caves.

label: Skavid caves
title: Skavid caves
lead:
The Skavid caves are a set of six caves around the ogre city of Gu'Tanoth. The caves are inhabited by the Skavid, a race of creatures enslaved by the Ogres. The caves are an important feature of the Watchtower quest. Also, two caves each have a slow spawn of cave nightshade (also known as nightshade or belladonna), the collection of which is a part of the medium Ardougne Diary.

Players need a light source and skavid map to enter any of the caves. If players attempt to enter a skavid cave without having a skavid map in their inventory, they become confused and end up outside another skavid cave.

label: Skavid map
title: Skavid map
lead:
The skavid map is required to successfully navigate the Skavid caves around Gu'Tanoth. Without possession of this map, players entering into one of the Skavid caves will immediately exit the next cave entrance in a clockwise direction, the last one being next to Toban's island, before starting at the north-west cave again. Players do not need to read the map to enter the Skavid caves, only have it in their inventory.

During the Watchtower quest, you obtain the map by visiting the ogre city guards all the way at the end of the path leading into Gu'Tanoth. To obtain the map the first time, you will need a Rock cake, a Death rune and 20 coins to reach the City guard and buy the map. If you lose the map, you'll only need 20 coins to get back to the city guard to replace it.

label: Skeleton
title: Skeleton
lead: Skeletons are undead monsters found in various locations across Gielinor, often in graveyards and dungeons. Being an undead monster, they are susceptible to Crumble Undead and the Salve amulet. They are also often weak against crush attacks.

label: Skeleton (Melzar's Maze)
title: Skeleton (Melzar's Maze)
lead:
Five skeletons can be found on the of Melzar's Maze. They must be killed in order to obtain the yellow key, which can unlock the yellow doors and progress through the maze.

The yellow key is always dropped by the skeleton holding a round shield, and will never be dropped by the other skeletons.

label: Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)
title: Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)
lead:
The skeleton is an undead monster encountered during the quest The Restless Ghost. When the player takes the ghost's skull from the altar in the basement of the Wizards' Tower, the skeleton animates and attacks them. The skeleton is not a particularly dangerous enemy, and it is not required to kill it in order to complete the quest. The player can simply leave after retrieving the skull, and the skeleton will disappear after a while.

Searching the altar while the skeleton is attacking another player will respawn the skeleton, with it attacking you and the other player no longer in combat.

label: Skeleton Mage
title: Skeleton Mage
lead:
Skeleton Mages are a rare variant of skeleton that make use of Magic to attack. Thus, it is recommended to wear magic-resistant armour such as dragonhide armour. They play a role in the Swan Song quest, where the player creates an army of them to help defeat the sea trolls.

Level 16 mages usually attack with melee and will occasionally cast a spell, exclaiming "I infect your body with rot..." that resembles Weaken as a projectile and Curse when it lands successfully. If successful, it will lower the player's Attack, Strength and Defence stats by 4 levels.

label: Sketch
title: Sketch
lead:
The sketch is a quest item obtained from Gujuo during the Legends' Quest. Gujuo gives the sketch to the player after speaking with his tribe's shaman, Ungadulu, who is currently trapped in a magical flame pit inside a cave in the jungle.

The sketch is a rough drawing of a gold bowl that the player must make in order to quench the flames that are holding Ungadulu prisoner.

label: Skull (item)
title: Skull (item)
lead:
A Skull is an item that can be found in various places, and is used as a material for Construction in player-owned houses. The player can use them to make a skeleton throne (level 88), skull torches (level 94), and hanging skeletons (level 94).

Skulls are involved in Mourning's End Part II, where Thorgel's item list includes a skull.

label: Skull (unobtainable item)
title: Skull (unobtainable item)
lead:
A skull is an unobtainable version of the Skull. The skull could previously be traded and turned into bank notes; however, it was made untradeable in 2007. Any player who had a noted Skull was given this now discontinued item. It is identical to the real skull, except it is stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Slave (Fight Arena)
title: Slave (Fight Arena)
lead: Slaves are present at the Fight Arena, a small settlement situated in southern Kandarin. Slave fighters are innocent prisoners taken from townships and villages around the region and forced to fight, very often to the death, with each other and ferocious beasts such as Ogres and giant scorpions, for the amusement of the young Mahjarrat warlord General Khazard. Slaves play a very minor role in the Fight Arena quest, being imprisoned alongside Justin and Sammy Servil in the prison.

label: Slave (Underground Pass)
title: Slave (Underground Pass)
lead: Slaves are workers who are forced and unwillingly work for Iban in the Underground Pass. In cages, they will be rotting away until fully transformed into a soulless, who guard the dungeons for Iban. After completion of the Underground Pass quest, they disappear.

label: Slave boots
title: Slave boots
lead:
The slave boots are an item of clothing that is required to enter the mine undetected in The Tourist Trap quest. Players obtain this item by trading desert boots with a slave during the quest. Rowdy slaves can also be killed in the mine to drop it.

Wearing the slave boots will delay the onset of desert heat by 3 seconds.

label: Slave robe
title: Slave robe
lead:
The slave robe is an item of clothing that is required to enter the mine undetected in The Tourist Trap quest. Players obtain this item by trading a desert robe with a slave during the quest. Rowdy slaves can also be killed in the mine to drop it.

Wearing the slave robe will delay the onset of desert heat by 6 seconds.

label: Slave shirt
title: Slave shirt
lead:
The slave shirt is an item of clothing that is required to enter the mine undetected in The Tourist Trap quest. Players obtain this item by trading a desert shirt with a slave during the quest. Rowdy slaves can also be killed in the mine to drop it.

Wearing the slave shirt will delay the onset of desert heat by 6 seconds.

label: Slayer task/Bandits
title: Slayer task/Bandits
lead:
Bandit can be assigned as a slayer task. It does not have a required combat level to be assigned by Krystilia. Bandits are most commonly found in Bandit Camp (Wilderness).

Along with Bandits and Guard Bandit, Speedy Keith, Donny the lad, and Black Heather can be killed to satisfy the task.

label: Slayer task/Earth warriors
title: Slayer task/Earth warriors
lead: Earth warriors are a type of humanoid earth elemental found in a dirt-lined chamber in the Edgeville Dungeon. This area is in the Wilderness so it is advised to come prepared for player killers.

label: Sliding piece (Castle)
title: Sliding piece (Castle)
lead: Sliding pieces are the individual pieces that can be seen in a Puzzle box. The pieces themselves are actually items, although they can only be seen in the puzzle box interface and can never be obtained by players.

label: Small bush
title: Small bush
lead: Small bushes are found throughout Mort Myre Swamp in Morytania. After starting Nature Spirit players may cast Bloom whilst standing adjacent to these bushes to turn them into golden pear bushes, afterwards they can be picked to receive mort myre pears.

label: Small fishing net
title: Small fishing net
lead: A small fishing net is used to catch fish such as shrimps, anchovies, karambwanji, minnows, and monkfish. Nets can be purchased from various fishing shops for 5 coins. It can also be obtained for free from either the Fishing tutor south of Lumbridge near the coast east of the swamp, or from the Spirit Angler at the Ruins of Unkah.

label: Small gravestone
title: Small gravestone
lead: Many small gravestones can be found at the Morytania Graveyard and the graveyard on Ape Atoll. Players cannot interact with the gravestones, but they can examine them.

label: Smashed cage
title: Smashed cage
lead: The Smashed cage is the result of the player rolling a large boulder downhill onto the Unicorn and the cage trapping it in the Underground Pass during the Underground Pass quest, it can be searched for a Unicorn horn. The horn is required to proceed further in the quest, and the only way to obtain it is through killing the unicorn by smashing the cage with the boulder.

label: Smashed chair
title: Smashed chair
lead: Smashed chairs are found in various locations in many different colours. They serve no purpose other than aesthetics.

label: Smashed glass
title: Smashed glass
lead: Smashed glass is a useless item found in several places. Three of them can be found in the southernmost house in Mort'ton. Fighting with holy water results in smashed glass appearing on the ground. Finally, it appears after a Mourner throws a potion that reduces a player's combat stats. It is similar to broken glass but it can be traded to other players and can not be used to light a torch.

label: Smashed table
title: Smashed table
lead:
A smashed table is found in Ah Za Rhoon during the Shilo Village quest. The player can look at it, which produces the dialogue "This table might be useful with some adjustment." and attempting to craft it offers the player three options: a ladder, a crude raft and a pole vault.

Only a raft can be successfully crafted, granting 5 Crafting experience. The resulting raft can be boarded in order to escape Ah Za Rhoon. Alternatively, players may walk south and exit through the waterfall, or simply teleport out.

label: Smithing
title: Smithing
lead: Smithing is a production skill through which players create a wide variety of metal items from ore and metal bars. It is the companion skill of Mining, which generates raw materials used in Smithing. Ores acquired from Mining are smelted into metal bars at furnaces, and then hammered into items at anvils. Many smithable items are useful in combat, quests, and the training of a number of other skills such as Crafting and Fletching.

label: Smithing Level Up!
title: Smithing Level Up!
lead: Smithing Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Smithing.

label: Smithing Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Smithing Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Smithing Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Smithing.

label: Snake
title: Snake
lead: Snakes (Serpentes Fellis) are serpentine monsters primarily found on Karamja. Unlike bush snakes, these snakes do not inflict poison.

label: Snake weed
title: Snake weed
lead:
Snake weed is a herb found by searching a marshy jungle vine, twenty of which can be found south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai, on the coast of western Karamja. It is also dropped in grimy form by jogres and tribesmen. It can be used as a secondary ingredient in Herblore to make relicym's balm or Sanfew serum. It is not possible to store it in a reagent pouch.

Snake weed is first encountered during the Jungle Potion quest, but is also used during Zogre Flesh Eaters as well as Legends' Quest; therefore it may be wise to take extras during Jungle Potion.

label: Snakeweed mixture
title: Snakeweed mixture
lead:
A snakeweed mixture is an unfinished potion made via the Herblore skill. Players make it by using a snake weed on a vial of water.

Using a rogue's purse herb on it will make a Relicym's balm.

label: snapdragon
title: snapdragon
lead:
Snapdragon is a herb which can be cleaned at level 59 Herblore. It may be grown from a snapdragon seed with a Farming level of 62, granting 98.5 Farming experience for every snapdragon grown. Once planted, the herb takes 80 minutes to fully grow.

Snapdragons are used to make super restore potions and sanfew serums with a Herblore level of 63 and a Herblore level of 65 respectively. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a snapdragon potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

label: Snapdragon potion (unf)
title: Snapdragon potion (unf)
lead: A snapdragon potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a snapdragon on a vial of water, requiring 63 Herblore. Using red spiders' eggs on a snapdragon potion (unf) with 63 Herblore yields a super restore(3) and 142.5 Herblore experience.

label: Snape grass
title: Snape grass
lead:
Snape grass is a Herblore secondary ingredient that can be grown through the Farming skill at level 61 with snape grass seeds. 8 snape grass are needed to protect growing potato cactus.

It is used to make prayer potions and fishing potions. It is also used when making the hangover cure quest item. When placed in a compost bin, snape grass will create supercompost.

label: Snare
title: Snare
lead:
Snare is a level 50 Magic spell. Casting Snare on an opponent will prevent it from moving for 16 ticks (9.6 seconds). When used on a player and the snare is about to wear off, the snared player will receive this message in their chatbox: The holding effect is beginning to fade. Players can increase the binding duration by equipping swampbark armour; the helm, body, and legs will increase the duration by 2 ticks (1.2 seconds) each, up to a maximum of 22 ticks (13.2 seconds).

Snare gives 61 Magic experience if it successfully hits the target, or 60 experience if it splashes.

label: Soda ash
title: Soda ash
lead:
Soda ash is made into Molten glass to make glass items in Crafting. Soda ash is made using seaweed, giant seaweed, swamp weed, or edible seaweed on a range, oven, or fire. Smelting it with a bucket of sand in a furnace or the Lunar spell Superglass Make produces molten glass.

It can be purchased from Trader Stan's Trading Post at charter ships for coins; the closest one to a bank is in Port Khazard. Another option close to a bank is the Corsair Cove shop, which is about 10 tiles farther from a bank but may be more likely to have soda ash in stock.

label: soft clay
title: soft clay
lead:
Soft clay is used to create items in the Crafting and Construction skills and to make magic tablets. It can be created by using a container of water such as a vial of water, jug of water, or bucket of water on clay, by using the Humidify spell, or by mining clay rocks whilst wearing a bracelet of clay. It is used on a potter's wheel to craft various Crafting items.

The only place to mine soft clay directly is in the Trahaearn mine, where soft clay rocks can be found. In addition, wearing a bracelet of clay in this mine can yield 2 soft clays per action, whereas mining clay rocks elsewhere yields only a single soft clay per action.

label: Soil
title: Soil
lead: Soil can be found throughout the digsite area, and plays an important role in The Dig Site quest. Depending on the type of digs in the area, players can use their trowel or rock pick, along with a specimen brush and specimen jar in their inventory, to dig up several items. Soil can also be found on Fossil Island in the Museum Camp.

label: Sojourn
title: Sojourn
lead:
Sojourn is a music track unlocked around Trollheim and the entrance to the Troll Stronghold. It can also be unlocked without having completed any quests, using Classic mode on the eastern side of the Mountain Camp.

During the fight with the Giant Roc, Roc and Roll plays on the plateau with My Arm instead.

label: Soldier (Burthorpe, sitting)
title: Soldier (Burthorpe, sitting)
lead: Three soldiers are sitting in front of a campfire in Burthorpe eating a drumstick, in the midst of the camp where other members of the Burthorpe Imperial Guard are training. Although the player can attempt to speak to them, doing so will only print the game message: The soldier is busy eating.

label: Soldier (Death Plateau)
title: Soldier (Death Plateau)
lead:
The wounded soldier is located south of the Death Plateau, troll territory, and he is featured prominently in the Death Plateau quest. He was hit by thrower trolls and is unable to head back to Burthorpe, warning players not to head on further. He is the brother of Harold.

After seeing him, players can head south-west on the winding mountain path to reach Tenzing's hut. If proceeding north, however, it is strongly advised to activate Protect from Missiles to negate the thrower trolls' bombardment of Ranged attacks.

label: Soldier (Yanille)
title: Soldier (Yanille)
lead:
Soldiers are similar to Guards except they are higher level and are found only in Yanille. They are under the command of Colonel Radick.

They appear to be wearing a Steel med helm, a Steel chainbody, Leather gloves and Leather boots. They also wield a Steel longsword as a weapon.

label: Sorcerer's Tower
title: Sorcerer's Tower
lead:
The Sorcerer's Tower is a four-story tower south of Seers' Village. It is the residence of Thormac the sorcerer.

At the Sorcerer's Tower, players may begin the Scorpion Catcher quest by talking to Thormac, the completion of which allows the player to pay Thormac 40,000 coins to enchant any elemental battlestaff into a mystic staff.

label: Sorcerer's Tower Portal
title: Sorcerer's Tower Portal
lead: The Sorcerer's Tower portal is one of the three teleportation portals found on the top floor of the Wizards' Guild. Located on the western wall of the guild, entering the portal will teleport the player to Sorcerer's Tower, south of Seers' Village.

label: Soul rune
