title: Soul rune
lead: Soul runes are one of the runes used to cast spells in the Magic skill. It is used for the strongest curse spells, the teleport-other spells, Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Dragonstone), Blood Barrage, the shadow spells, and most Reanimation spells. Soul runes are also used in charging Tumeken's shadow, the soul bearer, and Kharedst's memoirs, as well as creating Elidinis' ward (f).

label: Soulless
title: Soulless
lead:
Soulless are soulless humans found within the Underground Pass. They are aggressive and retreat at low health, and they do not drop anything besides bones.

The Soulless are humans who have entered the Underground Pass and fell under the control of Iban. Those who resist are locked in cages, being subjected to Iban's voice until they deteriorate to become the half-soulless. They are seen as still visibly human, rocking back and forth with extremely pale skin. From here, they deteriorate further into Soulless.

label: Soundscape
title: Soundscape
lead:
Soundscape is a music track that is unlocked at the areas directly north west and west of Yanille, including the Castle Wars Lobby.

If music area type is set to Classic, it unlocks at the Feldip Hills glider area. It is one of the few tracks that plays has no overlap in unlock area between Classic and Modern mode.

label: South Brimhaven mine
title: South Brimhaven mine
lead:
The South Brimhaven mine (also known as the Brimhaven Dungeon mine) is located south-west of Brimhaven by the entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon. The mine contains 6 gold rocks. Due to its large distance from a bank and few gold rocks, it is not recommended for any use, even if you have your house in Brimhaven. The mine is not easy to reach, and far from any banks. The low amount of rocks makes it an inefficient place to train mining or obtain gold ore, especially compared to the North Brimhaven mine with 10 gold rocks and a gold ore spawn closeby.

The mine is also a possible crash site for a shooting star.

label: South Crandor mine
title: South Crandor mine
lead: The South Crandor mine consists of two mining spots very close to one another on the southern portion of the island of Crandor. Access to this mine is obtained by traversing the tunnel entered from the Karamja Volcano, or as a one-time deal, through a ship from the Dragon Slayer I quest. The closest bank to these mines are in Draynor Village for free players and in Mor Ul Rek for members.

label: South Falador Farm
title: South Falador Farm
lead:
The South Falador Farm is a large farm between Falador and Port Sarim. Found in the north-eastern edge of the farm, there is a herb patch, a flower patch, and two allotment patches that can be used to train Farming. A tool leprechaun and compost bin are located nearby, and Elstan will watch over your crops for you if you pay him. Players that have completed the Medium Falador Diary will receive 10% more Farming experience from these patches.

In the farm building, Sarah runs a Farming shop that stocks various farming items, such as sacks and baskets. The building also has a loom, which can be used to created certain items using Crafting.

label: South Varrock farm
title: South Varrock farm
lead: The South Varrock farm is a large farm in Lumbridge, north of Groats' farm and outside the walls of Varrock. The farm features a wheat field, sheep, rams, and a master farmer. The farm can be quickly reached by travelling to the Champions' Guild canoe station.

label: South Wilderness mine
title: South Wilderness mine
lead:
The south Wilderness mine is a small mine located in level 6 Wilderness, near the Air Obelisk hill. It is rarely used, if ever, although visited quite often for the Mage of Zamorak is stationed nearby the mine and can teleport players to the Abyss. It is, however, quite close to the banks at Edgeville and the Grand Exchange.

It contains three coal rocks and two iron rocks, and so can be useful for Superheat Item smithers. The downside is the mine is filled with several aggressive level 22 and 25 Skeletons, which also patrol around the River Lum, meaning you will constantly be attacked when mining. PKers can also attack you here, but because the level of the Wilderness is so low here, the skeletons are usually a greater threat than the PKers.

label: South-east Ardougne mine
title: South-east Ardougne mine
lead:
The South-east Ardougne mine, also referred to as Monastery Mine or South Ardougne Mine, can be found south of East Ardougne and east of the Clock Tower near the Kandarin Monastery. It contains four coal rocks and thirteen iron rocks, which form a channel leading to the monastery door and a ring around the entrance to the Ardougne Sewers. There are nine light coloured rocks which do not have ores; five between the door and coal rocks and four between the coal and iron rocks.

The mine can be useful for mining the resources for steel bars, as there is a furnace in East Ardougne along with the North Ardougne Bank nearby.

label: South-east Varrock mine
title: South-east Varrock mine
lead:
The south-east Varrock mine (also called East Varrock Mine) is a good low to medium level mine located outside the south-east corner of the city wall. The mine contains no resident monsters, which makes it suitable for newer players or players with a low Combat level, with iron and the raw materials for bronze. However, there is a level 6 Giant rat slightly to the north of the mine, which is aggressive to players level 12 Combat or lower.

It is also arguably one of the closest free-to-play mines in relation to a bank (along with the Dwarven Mine), making it popular for miners who wish to bank the iron ore that they obtain. The nearest bank is Varrock east bank, which is accessed via going north by the city wall and taking the east entrance. Players walking to the east bank should make sure to walk to the bank with a full inventory, to conserve run energy, and then run on the way back. Although Varrock west bank and the Grand Exchange are only slightly further, the east bank should be used, and the Varrock Teleport can be used for a faster trip if money isn't an issue. However, competition for iron ore here makes it hard for low levelled players to get iron ore.

label: South-west Varrock mine
title: South-west Varrock mine
lead:
The South-west Varrock mine (also called West Varrock Mine) is a low-medium level mine located outside the south-western corner of Varrock. The mine contains 8 tin rocks, 3 iron rocks, 3 silver rocks, and 3 clay rocks, along with some other rocks that have no ores.

Due to its close proximity to Varrock west bank and the Grand Exchange, this mine is suitable for mining large amounts of iron, clay or other ores. However, as this is one of the few silver mining sites on free-to-play, it is often crowded with higher-level miners.

label: South-west Wilderness mine
title: South-west Wilderness mine
lead:
The south-west Wilderness mine is located in level 9 Wilderness, just north-west of Edgeville, north of the Black Knights' Fortress, and south of the Dark Warriors' Fortress. This Mining site is a very rich coal mine since it contains over 30 coal rocks, which is sizeable in comparison to the Mining Guild, but players have to rely on running to safety or teleporting if attacked by player killers. This mine is recommended when the Mining Guild or other coal sites are crowded, or for players with a high Combat level.

*The skeletons are aggressive to players of all levels. They stop being aggressive after around 10 minutes.
*If players want to avoid additional monster encounters, they should travel north/south along the edge of the Black Knights' Fortress.
*The closest bank is in Edgeville.
*Because of the large amount of coal present here, this place is excellent for players wishing to use Superheat Item to smelt ores into bars.

label: spade
title: spade
lead:
A spade is a multi-functional tool used for a variety of activities. One of its major uses is in the Farming skill, though it also comes in handy for many quests and Treasure Trails. A spade is also needed to enter the Barrows crypts and the Mole Hole.

Spades are sold in farming shops and many general stores, and an infinite supply can be added to the player-owned house by making a tool store 2. They can also be obtained from a rogue kit, or taken from scenery objects found in various places. Finally, players can ask Konoo at the saltpetre mine in Hosidius for a spare spade.

label: Sparkling pool
title: Sparkling pool
lead: The Sparkling pools connect the Mage Arena bank area to the cave that contains the Statue of Saradomin, Statue of Guthix, and the Statue of Zamorak. The Chamber guardian and his shop, Mage Arena Staffs, are also found in this cave. The sparkling pools can only be used after completion of the Mage Arena I miniquest, at which point Kolodion will tell the player to travel through the pool and choose their god.

label: Spear wall
title: Spear wall
lead: Spear walls are bits of decorative scenery that can be found across Gielinor.

label: Specimen brush
title: Specimen brush
lead:
Specimen brush is an item used in the Digsite. It is needed in The Dig Site quest and to dig in level 3 sites. It can be obtained by pickpocketing a Digsite workman. You can also take it from the tool rack in the Varrock Museum. It cannot be withdrawn as a bank note.

It is also given to the player during the quest Another Slice of H.A.M.

label: Specimen jar
title: Specimen jar
lead:
A specimen jar is an item that is obtainable during The Dig Site quest, used to dig in the level 3 digs. Specimen jars can be obtained by searchingsacks in the Digsite, or by searching the cupboard on the south wall in the west room in the Exam Centre.

In addition to being used for level 3 digs, specimen jars can also be used to dig in specimen trays for charcoal (also used during The Dig Site) and other loot.

label: Specimen tray
title: Specimen tray
lead: A specimen tray is a pile found in the Digsite, which contains a collection of items found in the nearby excavation. It can be searched to obtain several items, most notably charcoal, which is used in The Dig Site quest. The player must have a specimen jar on them or a digsite workman will stop them from searching the tray.

label: Spectator (Fight Arena)
title: Spectator (Fight Arena)
lead: Spectators are non-player characters found at the Fight Arena south of East Ardougne. They have come to watch General Khazard's slaves and creatures fight to the death in the arena.

label: Speedy Keith
title: Speedy Keith
lead: Speedy Keith is one of the three leaders of the Wilderness Bandit Camp. Like the other two leaders, Black Heather and Donny the lad, he is not aggressive. Attempting to talk to Speedy Keith yields the message: "Speedy Keith is not interested in talking".

label: spell scroll
title: spell scroll
lead: Spell scroll is a scroll that you receive as a reward from the quest, Watchtower. When read, the player learns the Watchtower Teleport (requires level 58 Magic). If a player loses the scroll before use, they can speak to the Watchtower Wizard. The player may learn the spell even without the requirement of level 58 Magic to use it. The drop trick may be performed to obtain multiple scrolls, allowing the player to 'learn' this spell multiple times.

label: spice
title: spice
lead:
Spice is an item used in Cooking. It can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest after completing the beginning portion of Recipe for Disaster or from spice stalls in Ardougne, Civitas illa Fortis, and Prifddinas. It can also be stolen from those stalls with level 65 Thieving or looted from a Gourmet impling or Baby impling.

You need spice in the goblin sub-quest of Recipe for Disaster, as well as for the Desert Treasure I quest.

label: Spice seller
title: Spice seller
lead: The spice seller runs the spice stall in the south-west corner of the Ardougne Marketplace in East Ardougne. He guards his spice stall while continually circling it in the south-west corner of the market square, near the fur stall and the silk stall. If he sees a player trying to steal from his stall, he'll stop them. He cannot be talked to or traded with for six minutes after a player has stolen from the spice stall.

label: Spice stall
title: Spice stall
lead:
The spice stall is a stall that can be found in multiple locations across Gielinor. Players can steal from this stall with a Thieving level of 65. If players are successful, they will steal spice. Items that can be seen on the spice stall, other than the spice which can be stolen, are a knife and a limpwurt root, as well as some unknown twigs, leaves, and a scroll.

There is also a spice stall in Sophanem that cannot be stolen from; it instead has "Search" option that yields the message "Nothing interesting happens." when searched.

label: Spice stall (unused)
title: Spice stall (unused)
lead: Spice stall is an unused variant of spice stalls that may have been intended for use in free-to-play areas. The stall has no interaction options, but is otherwise identical to the standard stalls.

label: Spicy crunchies
title: Spicy crunchies
lead:
Spicy crunchies are a food that players consume in one bite, healing 7 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade s'y crunch are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 85 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make spicy crunchies via gnome cooking with 12 Cooking, yielding 102 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Spicy toad's legs
title: Spicy toad's legs
lead:
Spicy toad's legs was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Toad batta. It could be made by adding Gnome spice to Toad's legs. Equa leaves was then added to these in order to create Seasoned legs, an ingredient in the Toad batta.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the toad's legs, equa leaves and gnome spice are all automatically added at once to create a Half made crunchy. If the player attempts to add Gnome spice to toad's legs, nothing happens.

label: Spicy worm
title: Spicy worm
lead:
A Spicy worm was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Worm batta. It could be made by adding Gnome spice to a King worm. This was then added to a Half baked batta alongside Cheese, then cooked to make an Unfinished batta.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the king worm and gnome spice are all automatically added at once to create a Half made batta. If the player attempts to add gnome spice to a king worm, nothing happens.

label: Spider
title: Spider
lead:
Spiders are found all over Gielinor, but most notably in the Stronghold of Security, where a stronger variant can be found in large numbers. Spiders are usually considered a nuisance and rarely drop items, and are generally only killed to quickly complete a spider Slayer task.

Similar to rats, spiders do not appear on the minimap.

label: Spiderwebs
title: Spiderwebs
lead: Spiderwebs are pieces of scenery found in corners of eerie locations such as the Forthos Dungeon, Sisterhood Sanctuary and Observatory Dungeon. Players cannot interact with them, but the webs can be examined.

label: Spiked boots
title: Spiked boots
lead:
Spiked boots are boots that can be obtained by bringing Dunstan (the Burthorpe blacksmith) an iron bar and a pair of climbing boots. Dunstan will only help after a player completes a required portion of the Death Plateau quest.

note: Spiked boots cannot be used in place of climbing boots for climbing over rocks in the mountain path.

label: Spinach roll
title: Spinach roll
lead:
Spinach roll is a food item that restores 2 hitpoints when eaten. It is received as a reward from random events such as the Mysterious Old Man and Rick Turpentine, or looted from opening a Crystal chest, Christmas cracker or Barrel.

During Demon Slayer, Traiborn will give players a spinach roll if they choose chat options When eaten, the messages You eat the spinach roll. and It tastes a bit weird, but it fills you up. are displayed.

label: Spinning blades (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Spinning blades (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead:
The spinning blades are an Agility obstacle found within the Brimhaven Agility Arena. Failing to dodge the obstacle will cause the player to take damage, and display the message You were hit by the spinning blades!.

The amount of damage is based on the player's current health, according to the formula below.

label: spinning wheel
title: spinning wheel
lead:
A spinning wheel is a device used with the Crafting skill to spin fibers into strings. Spinning wheels are marked on the map by this symbol: .
The following table shows what fibers can be spun into what strings using a spinning wheel:

The closest spinning wheel to a bank is in the Crafting Guild, but the bank requires the hard Falador Diary or 99 Crafting to use, and the spinning wheel is a floor above the bank so requires two extra clicks per trip.

label: Spirit (music track)
title: Spirit (music track)
lead:
Spirit is a music track that can be unlocked inside Varrock city walls, excluding the Grand Exchange. It also plays in the Phoenix Gang Hideout and in the basement of the Blue Moon Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Adventure, Garden, and Medieval.

In Classic mode, this track plays in western Varrock.

label: Spirit of Scorpius
title: Spirit of Scorpius
lead:
The Spirit of Scorpius is a Zamorakian ghost. After completion of Observatory Quest, he will give the player an unholy mould and bless unholy symbols. He is found south-west of Ardougne by the Grave of Scorpius, due north of the Observatory. An unholy mould must be claimed from him before he will bless any unholy symbols. He will not give the player an unholy mould if there is one already in their inventory.

Scorpius is close to both the red salamander hunting area and the Ourania Cave.

label: Spirit of Zadimus
title: Spirit of Zadimus
lead:
The Spirit of Zadimus is a ghost who appears during the Shilo Village quest, when you bury the Zadimus corpse at the Tribal Statue in Tai Bwo Wannai. In the following conversation, he gives you a bone shard.

According to Trufitus, Zadimus was a high priest of Zamorak. Zadimus was loved by Rashiliyia, however he did not love her back and was later tortured and killed by her. His corpse was found hanging in the gallows in the Temple of Ah Za Rhoon, which he built.

label: Spirit tree
title: Spirit tree
lead: Spirit trees are a gnomish method of transportation. Completion of the Tree Gnome Village quest is required for access to the network. Additional completion of The Grand Tree is required to travel from the spirit tree at the Tree Gnome Stronghold, but is not required to travel to it. All other trees can be used to travel directly from one tree to another tree.

label: Splendour
title: Splendour
lead:
Splendour is a music track that is unlocked in Taverley. In this area, the track shuffles between playing this track and Horizon.

In Classic music mode, this track plays at an area between Taverley and Burthorpe where the Heroes' Guild is located or at the Chaos Temple.

label: Spooky
title: Spooky
lead:
Spooky is a music track that is unlocked at Draynor Manor or during the Gravedigger random event. It could also be unlocked during the 2021 Halloween event.

Although it is presumably not supposed to do so, Spooky is replaced with Scape Soft and Lightness in Modern mode after playing once within Draynor Manor fenced area.

label: Spooky Jungle
title: Spooky Jungle
lead:
Spooky Jungle is a music track that is unlocked in the Kharazi Jungle, in Rashiliyia's Tomb and the Tomb of Bervirius, and during cutscenes in Tai Bwo Wannai Trio when Tamayu fights The Shaikahan . It also plays in the Nightmare Zone when facing Nazastarool in Practice or Endurance mode.

In Classic mode, it does not play in the Tomb of Bervirius, and in the Kharazi Jungle it only plays in the westernmost area.

label: Spooky picture
title: Spooky picture
lead:
Spooky pictures are pictures that appear to depict a red dragon. These pictures are found prominently throughout Melzar's Maze as well as inside Draynor Manor. There is also one located in the Misthalin Manor. They cannot be built within a player-owned house or interacted with in any way.

Upon loading a scene with a spooky picture in it, the picture will move in a specific way:
* 3 of the paintings in Draynor Manor and the one in Misthalin Manor will spin.
* The rest of the paintings and the ones in Melzar's Maze will look around the room.

label: Spotlight
title: Spotlight
lead: Two spotlights can be found in the mime random event. They turn on whenever the player or the mime performs an action.

label: Squire
title: Squire
lead: Squire Asrol is the squire of Sir Vyvin and can be found in the courtyard of the White Knights' Castle. Speaking to him starts the The Knight's Sword quest, in which he is heavily involved. He works hard but is often worried that his mistakes will anger his knight.

label: Staff
title: Staff
lead:
A staff is a cheap magic weapon which provides modest magical bonuses and the autocast option when equipped. Due to not possessing any elemental features and offering poor combat stats, it is only useful as a very cheap option for autocasting.

The staff can most easily be purchased from Zaff's staff shop in Varrock. It can also be bought on the Grand Exchange, obtained through other players or dropped by various enemies.

label: Staff of air
title: Staff of air
lead:
A staff of air is the basic air elemental staff. It provides unlimited amounts of air runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. All elemental staves offer the same Magic bonuses and only differ by the type of rune they supply and their Melee stats.

The staff can be purchased from various shops across Gielinor, including Zaff's Superior Staffs! in Varrock. It can also be bought on the Grand Exchange, obtained through other players, dropped by various enemies, or obtained as a reward from beginner and easy clue caskets.

label: Staff of armadyl
title: Staff of armadyl
lead:
The Staff of Armadyl is a quest item in the Temple of Ikov quest. If allied with Lucien, the staff of Armadyl is stolen from a table within the Temple of Ikov dungeon after killing a Guardian of Armadyl and brought to Lucien to complete the quest. If allied with the guardians, the player will receive an Armadyl pendant to equip and prove they are no longer allies of Lucien, then go and kill him.

Multiple copies of the staff cannot be obtained. The staff also cannot be telekinetically grabbed. If the staff is dropped and then the quest is completed, attempting to pick up the staff will yield the message: "You have completed the quest of the Temple of Ikov."

label: Staff of earth
title: Staff of earth
lead:
A staff of earth is the basic earth elemental staff. It provides unlimited amounts of earth runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. All elemental staves offer the same Magic bonuses and only differ by the type of rune they supply and their Melee stats.

The staff can be purchased from various shops across Gielinor, including Zaff's Superior Staffs! in Varrock. It can also be bought on the Grand Exchange, obtained through other players, dropped by various enemies, or found as a continually spawning item in the lava maze.

label: Staff of fire
title: Staff of fire
lead:
A staff of fire is the basic fire elemental staff. It provides unlimited amounts of fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. All elemental staves offer the same Magic bonuses and only differ by the type of rune they supply and their Melee stats.

The staff can be purchased from various shops across Gielinor, including Zaff's Superior Staffs! in Varrock. It can also be bought on the Grand Exchange, obtained through other players, or dropped by various enemies.

label: Staff of water
title: Staff of water
lead:
A staff of water is the basic water elemental staff. It provides unlimited amounts of water runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. All elemental staves offer the same Magic bonuses and only differ by the type of rune they supply and their Melee stats.

The staff can be purchased from various shops across Gielinor, including Zaff's Superior Staffs! in Varrock. It can also be bought on the Grand Exchange, obtained through other players, dropped by various enemies, or obtained as a reward from an easy tier clue scrolls.

label: Stagnant
title: Stagnant
lead:
Stagnant is a music track that is unlocked in the Mort Myre Swamp.

It can later be heard while Temple Trekking, during the River puzzle or in combat events with no escape routes. The track also plays during Sins of the Father, when escorting Ivan Strom past the River puzzle and In Aid of the Myreque during the meeting between Gadderanks and Vanstrom Klause. In the Mort Myre Swamp area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Dead Quiet and Waterlogged.

label: Stairs (Count Draynor)
title: Stairs (Count Draynor)
lead: These stairs lead to the crypt of Count Draynor Drakan in the Draynor Manor. During the Vampire Slayer quest the player must use these stairs to enter the crypt and slay Count Draynor.

label: Stairs (Dwarven Tunnel)
title: Stairs (Dwarven Tunnel)
lead: These stairs serve as entrances and exits to the White Wolf Tunnel. The stairs down into the tunnel are guarded by Austri and Vestri. To be allowed into the tunnel, players must win the local Fishing Contest at Hemenster.

label: Stairs (Tribal Totem)
title: Stairs (Tribal Totem)
lead: Stairs are a scenery object found in the western room on the of Handelmort Mansion in East Ardougne. Before climbing the stairs, players must first investigate them for traps, requiring level 21 Thieving. If players attempt to climb the stairs without first disabling the trap, a trapdoor will open dropping the player to the Ardougne Sewers below. During the Tribal Totem quest, players must use these stairs in order to reach the chest on the floor above in order to obtain the totem.

label: Stake
title: Stake
lead:
The stake is a quest item used in the Vampyre Slayer quest. This item is obtained by talking to Dr Harlow at the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. The player must use the stake, along with a hammer, to kill Count Draynor.

Duplicates can be obtained with the drop trick and offering another beer to Dr Harlow. All duplicates must be dropped before killing Count Draynor, if the player wishes to keep them after the quest. Any duplicates that are not dropped will be destroyed.

label: Standing torch
title: Standing torch
lead: Standing torches are decorative scenery found across Gielinor.

label: Stanford
title: Stanford
lead:
Stanford is the gardener of the Sinclair Mansion. He had an affair with Anna Sinclair, the daughter of his employer Lord Sinclair, but when the relationship ended, she tried to have him fired by destroying the flowers in the garden. When Lord Sinclair was murdered, he was convinced Anna was the killer.

When Anna was arrested and put on trial, he was called as a witness, where he claimed she didn't use her poison for her chore but couldn't provide any concrete evidence that she was the killer.

label: Stankers
title: Stankers
lead: Stankers is a dwarf who runs the coal trucks. Players may place their coal into the trucks and collect them later at the coal truck depot. Players may also obtain a poison chalice from him for free.

label: Starlight (music track)
title: Starlight (music track)
lead:
Starlight is a music track that is unlocked in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.

The track is in A Minor.

label: Start
title: Start
lead:
Start is a music track that is unlocked around Draynor Village and Draynor Manor. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Unknown Land and Wander.

In Classic mode, the track plays in northern Draynor Village.

label: Statue (Paterdomus Temple)
title: Statue (Paterdomus Temple)
lead: A statue is located to the east of the Paterdomus Temple, leading into Morytania.

label: Statue of a king
title: Statue of a king
lead: Statue of a king is a type of decorative scenery that can be found in various locations across Gielinor. The Warriors' Guild has two unique versions of the statue, representing King Roald (or one of his ancestors) and King Healthorg.

label: Statue of a warrior
title: Statue of a warrior
lead: Statue of a warrior is a type of decorative scenery that can be found in various locations across Gielinor. The two examples found inside the Warriors' Guild have different lighting when compared to other statues, but are otherwise the same model.

label: Statue of Glarial
title: Statue of Glarial
lead: The Statue of Glarial is located within Waterfall Dungeon and plays a key role during the Waterfall Quest in which the player must place Glarial's Amulet upon it.

label: Statue of Guthix
title: Statue of Guthix
lead: The Statue of Guthix can be found in the Mage Arena cave after completing the Mage Arena I miniquest, alongside the Statue of Saradomin and Statue of Zamorak. They can be accessed by travelling through the Sparkling pool in the bank area, near Kolodion. Praying at the Statue of Guthix will not recharge your prayer points, and instead will drop a Guthix cape on the floor. After claiming their first cape, players can talk to the Chamber guardian to claim a free staff of the god cape of their choice.

label: Statue of Saradomin
title: Statue of Saradomin
lead: The Statue of Saradomin can be found in the Mage Arena cave after completing the Mage Arena I miniquest, alongside the Statue of Zamorak and Statue of Guthix. They can be accessed by travelling through the Sparkling pool in the bank area, near Kolodion. Praying at the Statue of Saradomin will not recharge your prayer points, and instead will drop a Saradomin cape on the floor. After claiming their first cape, players can talk to the Chamber guardian to claim a free staff of the god cape of their choice.

label: Statue of Zamorak
title: Statue of Zamorak
lead: The Statue of Zamorak can be found in the Mage Arena cave after completing the Mage Arena I miniquest, alongside the Statue of Guthix and Statue of Saradomin. They can be accessed by travelling through the Sparkling pool in the bank area, near Kolodion. Praying at the Statue of Zamorak will not recharge your prayer points, and instead will drop a Zamorak cape on the floor. After claiming their first cape, players can talk to the Chamber guardian to claim a free staff of the god cape of their choice.

label: Statue of Zamorak (witch's house)
title: Statue of Zamorak (witch's house)
lead: Two statues of Zamorak can be seen in the garden of the witch's house. They can only be examined.

label: Statue steps
title: Statue steps
lead:
Statue steps are an unused scenery object that were added in the RuneScape 2 beta. Originally, they could be found in Falador, and were a plinth upon which the statue of Saradomin stood. However, they were removed from Falador quite early on and have not been seen since. It is unknown when exactly they were removed, but it was definitely between 13 and 21 December 2004.

The statue steps cannot be found anywhere else, and as a result have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Steel 2h sword
title: Steel 2h sword
lead:
The steel 2h sword is a two-handed sword that requires 5 Attack to wield.

Players may smith one at level 44 Smithing with 3 Steel bars for 112.5 experience. Steel 2h swords can also be acquired from several monsters and one of the few two-handed sword shops, like Gaius' Two Handed Shop in Taverley.

label: Steel arrow
title: Steel arrow
lead:
Steel arrows are stronger than iron arrows, and can be used with any standard bow of oak or stronger. Steel arrows can be made at level 30 Fletching by using 15 steel arrowtips on 15 headless arrows, granting 75 Fletching experience. As with most arrows, they can be poisoned.

Ava's accumulator (from the Animal Magnetism quest) generates steel arrows in the ammo slot, and also randomly attracts items into your inventory.

label: Steel arrowtips
title: Steel arrowtips
lead:
Steel arrowtips are made with a steel bar requiring 35 Smithing, yielding 37.5 Smithing experience and 15 steel arrowtips. They are made into steel arrows when used with headless arrows, requiring 30 Fletching, yielding 75 experience per 15 arrows.

At 47 Thieving, they can be stolen from chests in Hemenster, Rellekka, and West Ardougne.

label: Steel axe
title: Steel axe
lead:
The Steel axe is slightly stronger than the Iron axe. It can be used in combat or in Woodcutting to cut trees. It requires an Attack level of 5 to be equipped, and a Woodcutting level of 6 to be used.

The success rate for chopping a log is approximately 200% that of the Bronze axe, or 33% better than an Iron axe.

label: Steel axe head
title: Steel axe head
lead:
The steel axe head is an unobtainable item that was originally used in the axe handle random event. The axe head would become detached from the player's axe while Woodcutting. To fix their axe, players had to collect the axe head off the ground and reattach it to the axe handle.

A similar event used to happen to players while Mining, but with a pickaxe head and pickaxe handle.

label: Steel bar
title: Steel bar
lead:
A Steel bar is an item used for creating steel weaponry and armour. It can be smelted using the Smithing skill at level 30 Smithing by using 1 iron ore and 2 coal on a furnace, providing 17.5 experience points. Steel bars can be used with an anvil to make steel armour and weaponry, granting 37.5 Smithing experience per bar, unless the bar is used with a furnace and cannonball mould to make steel cannonballs, granting 25.6 experience per bar instead, which is profitable experience popular among low and mid-level smiths. Steel bars are also used in the Mahogany Homes minigame.

Currently, smelting a steel bar yields a profit of . For free players or members without a coal bag, the most bars one can smith at a time is 9, achieved with an inventory of 18 coal and 9 iron ore.

label: Steel battleaxe
title: Steel battleaxe
lead:
The steel battleaxe is a battleaxe stronger than the iron battleaxe. The steel battleaxe requires 5 Attack to wield.
Players can make a steel battleaxe with the Smithing skill at level 40 using 3 steel bars, giving the player 112.5 experience. 
Players can purchase this battleaxe from Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar in Port Sarim or Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge.

label: Steel cannonball
title: Steel cannonball
lead:
Steel cannonballs are ammunition used for a dwarf multicannon, as well as for a boat cannon during ship combat. They can be fired from steel cannons or stronger.

Four can be made from a single steel bar with level 35 Smithing, granting 25.6 experience per bar. Smithing cannonballs require the use of an ammo mould, which requires partial completion of Dwarf Cannon to obtain. Alternatively, a double ammo mould (requiring Foundry Reputation to purchase via the Giants' Foundry minigame) allows players to process two bars into eight cannonballs at the same speed as a regular ammo mould processes one bar into four.

label: Steel chainbody
title: Steel chainbody
lead:
The Steel chainbody is the third weakest chainbody, and it can be worn by a player with level 5 Defence.

A player with level 41 Smithing can forge the steel chainbody by using three steel bars on an anvil with a hammer in their inventory, granting 112.5 Smithing experience. It can also be bought from Wayne's Chains in Falador, or Horvik's Armour Shop in Varrock.

label: Steel claws
title: Steel claws
lead:
Steel claws are a fast two-handed melee weapon. To wield them the player must have at least level 5 Attack. They are given as a reward for completing the Death Plateau quest.

After completing the Death Plateau quest, they can be created at 43 Smithing. They require 2 Steel bars, and yield 75 Smithing experience. They can also be bought from Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den.

label: Steel dagger
title: Steel dagger
lead:
The steel dagger is the third-weakest dagger, requiring level 5 Attack to wield. They can be bought from shops and obtained drops from monsters, and can also be smithed from a steel bar at level 30 Smithing. As with most daggers, steel daggers can be poisoned.

Players must bring Veliaf a steel dagger during In Search of the Myreque.

label: steel dart
title: steel dart
lead:
Steel darts are Ranged throwing weapons. To wield steel darts, players must have at least level 5 Ranged. They can be obtained by either using the Smithing and Fletching skills or trading with another player. Steel darts can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

To create steel darts, the player must have completed the Tourist Trap quest and have at least level 34 Smithing and level 37 Fletching. Each steel bar will create 10 steel dart tips and the player will receive 37.5 Smithing experience. When feathers are added the player will receive 10 steel darts and 7.5 Fletching experience per steel dart.

label: Steel dart tip
title: Steel dart tip
lead:
The steel dart tip is a dart tip made with the Smithing skill. Players can craft this item when using a steel bar on an anvil with a hammer in their inventory and a Smithing level of 34. Smithing one set of 10 dart tips will provide the player with 37.5 Smithing experience. They can be fletched into steel darts at level 37 Fletching when used with feathers, granting 75 Fletching experience per 10 darts made.

To smith darts, one must complete the Tourist Trap quest.

label: Steel fire arrow
title: Steel fire arrow
lead:
Steel fire arrows are steel arrows wrapped in an oily cloth, which are then lit by using them on a tinderbox. They, along with any other fire arrow, are primarily used to pierce the rope in the Underground Pass to lower the bridge so that a player may walk across.

They have the same Ranged Strength as regular steel arrows.

label: Steel full helm
title: Steel full helm
lead:
The steel full helm is the third weakest full helm. The steel full helm grants greater defensive bonuses than its medium helmet counterpart, though at a cost of offensive bonuses for Ranged and Magic. Wearing this helmet requires at least 5 Defence.

To create a steel full helmet you need at least 37 Smithing, a hammer, and two steel bars. Then use one of the bars on an anvil with the hammer in your inventory. This will grant 75 Smithing experience.

label: Steel gauntlets
title: Steel gauntlets
lead:
Steel gauntlets are a reward for completing the Family Crest quest and an heirloom of the Fitzharmon family. Players can take them to any of the three brothers from the quest and have them enchant the gauntlets with a special ability. The magic of these gauntlets will always return them to the head of the Fitzharmon house should they be lost, so if a player loses the gauntlets, they can be retrieved from Dimintheis with their previous enchantment.

Before completion of the Family Pest miniquest, players can only have one pair of gauntlets at a time. After completing the miniquest, Dimintheis will hand the player as many pairs of steel gauntlets as they want for free.

label: Steel javelin
title: Steel javelin
lead:
The steel javelin is a type of member's only Ranged ammunition used by the light and heavy ballistas. As with most javelins, they can be poisoned.

They can be fletched by attaching steel javelin tips to javelin shafts at level 32 Fletching, granting 75 experience per 15 javelins made. They can also be obtained by buying them from the Ranging Guild, the Void Knight Archery Store or from Oobapohk's Javelin Store after Monkey Madness II.

label: Steel kiteshield
title: Steel kiteshield
lead: The steel kiteshield is the fourth-best smithable kiteshield, requiring 5 Defence to wield. A player with 42 Smithing can make the shield by using three steel bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 112.5 Smithing experience.

label: Steel knife
title: Steel knife
lead:
The steel knife is a throwing knife that requires a Ranged level of 5 to wield. It is stronger than an iron knife but weaker than a black knife. To create steel knives, the player must have at least 37 Smithing. Each steel bar will create 5 steel knives and give the player 37.5 Smithing experience. They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Throwing knives are among the fastest weapons in the game (along with darts), and are commonly used for PKing or training Ranged. Steel knives can be purchased from Martin Thwait's Lost and Found shop in the Rogues' Den with 50 Thieving and 50 Agility. A single steel knife also spawns in the cave of the Kendal located north of the Mountain Camp.

label: Steel longsword
title: Steel longsword
lead: The steel longsword is a longsword that is stronger than the iron longsword, but weaker than the black longsword. Like all other steel weapons, it requires 5 Attack to wield. Players can make a steel longsword with a Smithing level of 36 using two steel bars and a hammer on an anvil, granting 75 experience.

label: Steel mace
title: Steel mace
lead: The steel mace is a mace stronger than the iron mace, requiring 5 Attack to wield. Players can make it with the Smithing skill at level 32 using one steel bar, giving 37.5 Smithing experience.

label: Steel med helm
title: Steel med helm
lead: A steel med helm is the third-weakest medium helmet. A player with 33 Smithing can make this helmet by using one steel bar on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 37.5 Smithing experience. It requires 5 Defence to equip.

label: Steel nails
title: Steel nails
lead:
Steel nails are nails made with a steel bar on an anvil with a hammer in the player's inventory, requiring 34 Smithing, yielding 15 steel nails and granting 37.5 Smithing experience per bar.

These nails are the only nails that can be made in free-to-play because they are required in the Dragon Slayer I quest. Steel nails are tradeable and the sawmill operator will sell them to members for coins each.

label: Steel pick head
title: Steel pick head
lead:
A steel pick head was obtained as part of a discontinued random event, in which the steel pickaxe head flew off the handle while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle.

If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another.

label: Steel pickaxe
title: Steel pickaxe
lead:
The steel pickaxe is a pickaxe that mines on a 6-tick cycle, 1-tick faster than the iron pickaxe. It can be used in combat or in mining to mine rocks. The steel pickaxe requires 6 Mining to use, and 5 Attack to equip. Players lacking 5 Attack can still use it for mining.

Like all pickaxes, a steel pickaxe cannot be made with the Smithing skill.

label: Steel platebody
title: Steel platebody
lead:
The steel platebody is an armour used in melee with stat bonuses between iron and mithril (not including the black and white platebodies). It requires 5 Defence to equip and provides greater protection than a steel chainbody. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's Ranged and Magic stats.

Players with level 48 Smithing can make one by using 5 steel bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 187.5 experience. Alternatively, they can be bought from Horvik's Smithy, Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop, or in Varlamore.

label: Steel platelegs
title: Steel platelegs
lead:
Steel platelegs are the third weakest platelegs in the game. They have the same bonuses and penalties as a steel plateskirt but weigh more. A player with 46 Smithing can make them by using three steel bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 112.5 Smithing experience. They can also be bought from Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar. They require 5 Defence to wear.

As they spawn in the Wilderness at the Ruins north of the Graveyard of Shadows, they are one of the most easily accessible and most popular money making methods for new Ironman accounts when being sold to Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar starting at 650 each at base stock of 2, reducing by 10 per extra set.

label: Steel plateskirt
title: Steel plateskirt
lead: The Steel plateskirt is a plateskirt made from steel, requiring level 5 Defence to wear. It can be made at level 46 Smithing by using 3 Steel bars on an anvil with a hammer in the inventory. It has identical stats to the steel platelegs, with the notable exception that it weighs less.

label: Steel scimitar
title: Steel scimitar
lead:
The steel scimitar is a scimitar made by using 2 steel bars on an anvil, as long as you have a hammer and at least level 35 Smithing, granting 75 experience. Players can purchase this scimitar from Zeke's Superior Scimitars in Al Kharid.

Players require 5 Attack to wield steel weapons.

label: Steel Skin
title: Steel Skin
lead:
Steel Skin is a prayer unlocked at level 28 Prayer. Steel Skin increases the player's Defence by 15%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Defence level, such as Piety, with the notable exceptions of Deadeye and Mystic Vigour which allow for simultaneous use.

label: Steel spear
title: Steel spear
lead: The steel spear is a two-handed melee weapon that requires 5 Attack to wield. It can be bought from the Mount Karuulm Weapon Shop or Fortis Blacksmith, or obtained as a drop from monsters. Players who have started learning Barbarian Smithing and have level 35 Smithing may produce a spear at a Barbarian anvil from one steel bar and one willow log, receiving 75 Smithing experience. Smithing spears at the Barbarian anvil requires completion of Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. Like most spears, it can be poisoned.

label: Steel sq shield
title: Steel sq shield
lead: A steel sq shield is the third weakest square shield. It requires 5 Defence to equip. A player with 38 Smithing can make the shield by using two steel bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 75 experience.

label: Steel studs
title: Steel studs
lead: Steel studs can be smithed from a steel bar at an anvil with level 36 Smithing, granting 37.5 experience. They can then be used on leather bodies with level 41 Crafting or leather chaps with level 44 Crafting, to make studded bodies and studded chaps respectively.

label: Steel sword
title: Steel sword
lead:
The steel sword is a low-level weapon made of steel, stronger than the iron sword. It can be purchased from the Varrock Swordshop, or made at level 34 Smithing using 1 steel bar, granting 37.5 experience. It requires 5 Attack to wield.

Two swords are needed for the In Search of the Myreque quest, along with some other steel equipment.

label: Steel thrownaxe
title: Steel thrownaxe
lead: The steel thrownaxe is a Ranged throwing weapon. To wield a steel throwing axe the player must have at least level 5 Ranged. They can be obtained either by buying from the Tribal Weapons store at the Ranging Guild or trading with another player. The steel throwing axe can be wielded with a shield or prayer book for protection.

label: Steel warhammer
title: Steel warhammer
lead:
The steel warhammer is a warhammer stronger than the iron warhammer. Unlike other steel weapons, it requires 5 Strength to wield. Players can make a steel warhammer with the Smithing skill at level 39 using three steel bars, giving 112.5 Smithing experience.

A steel warhammer is one of the weapons requested during the In Search of the Myreque quest.

label: Stepping stone (Wilderness Agility Course)
title: Stepping stone (Wilderness Agility Course)
lead:
The stepping stone is an Agility obstacle found within the Wilderness Agility Course. Passing the obstacle grants 20 Agility experience, and failing it causes the player to take damage based on their current health, according to the expression below.

\left\lfloor\text{Hitpoints}\times\frac{4}{20}\right\rfloor + 1

label: Stew
title: Stew
lead:
Stew is a type of food that restores 11 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking uncooked stew on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 25 Cooking and granting 117 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt stew. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Stew is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 58, or 54 when using the Lumbridge range.

Stew is the starting ingredient for spicy stew.

label: Stick
title: Stick
lead:
Stick is a troll found on Death Plateau. While not as strong as the nearby Rock, he can hit a max of 27, although this can be completely blocked with Protect from Melee. Like the rest of the "big", "bad" trolls in the area, such as Rock, Pee Hat, and Kraka, he can drop a rune warhammer or granite shield, making him a common target for ironman accounts.

Stick can be safespotted with Ranged to the south-west of his spawn location.

label: Stile
title: Stile
lead: Stiles can be found at the Ardougne farm, near the beehives in Catherby, and in Taverley. They serve as shortcuts over fences, or the only access points to various areas. They do not have an Agility level requirement and do not provide any experience.

label: Stile (Death Plateau)
title: Stile (Death Plateau)
lead: A stile can be found on the garden fence of Tenzing's house, located west of Burthorpe. Climbing over the stile provides access to a pathway leading further up Death Plateau. Accessing the stile requires partial completion of the Death Plateau quest.

label: Still Night
title: Still Night
lead:
Still Night is a music track that can be unlocked at locations outside Varrock city walls, including the Cooks' Guild, Champions' Guild, and Jolly Boar Inn. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Doorways, Expanse, and Greatness.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the mining area to the south-east of Varrock.

label: Stone (Nature Spirit)
title: Stone (Nature Spirit)
lead:
Stones can be found in a triangular pattern outside of the Nature Grotto, located within the Mort Myre Swamp. During the Nature Spirit quest, players must use a Mort Myre Fungus on the brown stone, a used spell on the grey stone, and be standing on the orange stone in order for Filliman Tarlock to commence his transformation ritual into the Nature Spirit.

Searching the stones will provide information detailing the sort of symbol scratched onto the stone.

label: Stone ball
title: Stone ball
lead:
The stone ball are quest items used in the Death Plateau quest. They must be arranged in the correct order on a mechanism inside Burthorpe Castle in order to unlock the door to the equipment room.

The combination to the positions of each stone ball can be won from Harold in the nearby bar by playing a dice rolling game. When Harold loses sufficiently he will declare that he has no money and will give the player an IOU instead. Inspecting the back of this IOU will reveal that it is really the combination to the lock.

label: Stone bridge
title: Stone bridge
lead: Multiple stone bridges in a maze-like pattern can be found in part 2 of the Underground Pass quest. If the player doesn't have 50 Thieving, they have to find their way through the maze by crossing the stone bridges to finish this part of the quest. Otherwise, they can pick the lock on two doors south of the maze to bypass it completely.

label: Stone Staircase
title: Stone Staircase
lead: Stone Staircases are found within the Troll Stronghold. It allows players to move between the levels of the stronghold.

label: Stone table (Delrith)
title: Stone table (Delrith)
lead:
A Stone table can be found in the centre of the stone circle south of Varrock. During Demon Slayer, the table is opened up by a Zamorakian ritual performed by dark wizards, and Delrith is summoned.

After the quest is over, the table is not broken anymore.

label: Stone Tablet (Digsite Dungeon)
title: Stone Tablet (Digsite Dungeon)
lead: The stone tablet is an object found in the Digsite Dungeon, accessed during the quest The Dig Site. When taken, the actual item is placed into the player's inventory.

label: Stone tablet (The Dig Site)
title: Stone tablet (The Dig Site)
lead:
The stone tablet is a quest item. It is used in The Dig Site quest to find that the digsite was a temple dedicated to Zaros. Giving it to Terry Balando finishes the quest. It is found from a cave that can only be entered with a chemical compound.

If the player tries to give another tablet after the quest, Terry will say: "I don't need another tablet! One is enough, thank you."

label: Stone tablet (Underground Pass)
title: Stone tablet (Underground Pass)
lead:
Five stone tablets can be found throughout the Underground Pass. They play a role in the Underground Pass quest, giving a similar sense of danger to the messages that occasionally appear in the chatbox when walking through the dungeon, before killing Iban in the quest.

The stone tablets appear to praise Iban or attempt to scare people going through the dungeon, which ties into the theme of the quest that people will lose their mind when venturing too deep into the dungeon. They also claim Iban is the son of Zamorak, and provide a slight bit of information on quest progression.

label: Stone-plaque
title: Stone-plaque
lead:
The stone-plaque is a quest item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by using a chisel, a spade, or a pickaxe on a strange looking stone in Ah Za Rhoon.

The tablet is close to the ruined table by the hand-like water. The plaque should be given to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai village along with a tattered scroll (pink), crumpled scroll (green), and the Zadimus corpse in order to progress through the quest. Trufitus translates it as a message left by Rashiliyia dooming Zadimus to eternal suffering.

label: Storeroom Door
title: Storeroom Door
lead: The Storeroom Door is located in the Goutweed store accessed from the stairs going down from the troll kitchen, located within the Troll Stronghold.

label: Strange box
title: Strange box
lead:
The strange box was an item formerly received during a random event. When opened the box presented you with a puzzle asking which shape contains which number or which number is in which shape. Upon completing the puzzle the player received coins, gems (Sapphire, Emerald, Ruby, or Diamond) or a half key. Ignoring the strange box resulted in spawning of even more strange boxes. The strange box would stack when there were no available spaces for it to spawn another box into. Casting High or Low Alchemy on the box, dropping it, or banking it also caused another box to spawn.

If the player received the strange box when they had a full inventory, the Mysterious Old Man instead teleported them to a maze.

label: strange fruit
title: strange fruit
lead:
The strange fruit is an item that can be picked from the strange plant random event, obtained from the Flowering Tree Forestry event, or stolen from fruit stalls.

It can be eaten to cure poison, venom, and restore 30% run energy, making it a potential substitute for energy potions and antipoisons/anti-venoms in situations where they are both needed. Upon being consumed, it prevents further re-application of poison or venom for approximately 18 seconds (note that this is not traditional immunity, therefore cannot be used to mitigate special attacks from a Dreadborn Araxyte). No Hitpoints are restored upon eating the fruit.

label: Strange looking stone
title: Strange looking stone
lead:
The strange-looking stone in Ah Za Rhoon is an object that players interact with during the Shilo Village quest. Using a chisel, spade or pickaxe on the strange-looking stone yields the stone-plaque, and awards 5 Crafting experience.

Different tools have varying crafting requirements to interact with.

label: Strange plant
title: Strange plant
lead:
A strange plant appears as a random event, where it will start growing near a player. The player must wait until the plant is fully grown before they can pick the strange fruit. The player can pick the fruit or ignore/dismiss the plant.

Previously, the plant would attack and poison the player if ignored for too long. However, since the Optional Randoms update, the plant will simply disappear if ignored or dismissed.

label: Strange shrine
title: Strange shrine
lead:
The Strange shrine is an object in the centre of the Maze, which can be touched to complete the random event. Players touching the shrine with a full inventory will be teleported back to their original location first, and then have their rewards dropped on the floor below their feet.

The shrine's examine text claims this object is a shrine of the gods. The human symbolising Saradomin, the skull symbolising Guthix, and the demon symbolising Zamorak.

label: Strange watcher
title: Strange watcher
lead:
The strange watchers are three non-player characters present in the audience during the Mime random event, as well as being featured in the Realm of Memories as Mysterious Watchers, which was part of the 20th and 25th Anniversary events. They are the only audience members in the Mime audience.

The three men represent three gods: Saradomin, Guthix, and Zamorak, resembling statues of these gods found throughout Gielinor. The order they are seated may represent the order-balance-chaos relationship between these gods, with the Saradomin-esque watcher seated to the east, the Zamorak-esque watcher to the west, with the Guthix-esque watcher in between.

label: Stratosphere
title: Stratosphere
lead: Stratosphere is a music track that is unlocked at the Cosmic Altar.

label: Straven
title: Straven
lead:
Straven Enroy is a professional thief and the leader of the Phoenix Gang. He is found in an underground basement in southern part of Varrock, in the Phoenix Gang Hideout. For players who are starting the quest Shield of Arrav, Straven assigns the player the task of killing Jonny the Beard and bringing him the intel report before he will let the player become a part of the Phoenix Gang. He also provides the Weapon store key to players who are members of his gang.

Straven claims to be the head of the "VTAM Corporation" to people who aren't a member of either gang. This is a cover for his gang, and the corporation likely doesn't exist.

label: Strength
title: Strength
lead: Strength is a player's power in melee combat. As a player raises their Strength level, they can deal more damage against opponents. A high Strength level is often favoured by players over their Attack level because it raises max hit, helping to deal more damage compared to training Attack or Defence.

label: Strength Level Up! (2-49)
title: Strength Level Up! (2-49)
lead: Strength Level Up! (2-49) is a jingle for levelling Strength.

label: Strength Level Up! (50-99)
title: Strength Level Up! (50-99)
lead: Strength Level Up! (50-99) is a jingle for levelling Strength.

label: strength potion
title: strength potion
lead:
A Strength potion is a potion that can be made by free-to-play players in addition to members. Both non-members and members can make a strength potion (4) by providing the Apothecary in Varrock with coins, a limpwurt root, and red spiders' eggs. Members who have attained at least level 12 Herblore additionally have the ability to use a limpwurt root on a tarromin potion (unf), yielding a Strength potion(3) and 50 Herblore experience. A dose of Strength potion provides a temporary skill boost to Strength equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down. This is less than the super Strength's and super combat potion's boost of 5 + 15% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down.

After Barbarian Herblore Training, roe or caviar can be added to a Strength potion(2), requiring 14 Herblore, yielding a Strength mix and 17 Herblore experience. A Strength mix has 2 doses, boosts Strength equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down, and heals 3 Hitpoints.

label: Stronghold
title: Stronghold
lead: The stronghold entrance is located west of Trollheim in the Troll Country, and leads to the Troll Stronghold.

label: Studded body
title: Studded body
lead: A studded body is a part of studded leather armour set and it requires 20 Ranged and Defence to equip.

label: Studded chaps
title: Studded chaps
lead: Studded chaps are part of studded leather armour set and they require 20 Ranged to equip.

label: Studded Leather
title: Studded Leather
lead: Studded leather is a scenery element located in the Ranging Guild. The item resembles a Studded body mounted on the wall.

label: Student
title: Student
lead:
The Students are found studying archaeology around the Digsite. During The Dig Site quest, each student has lost one personal item that must be returned. The items are Teddy, animal skull, and special cup. After the items are returned, the students will provide the correct answers to the digsite exam.

After the quest, the female student can be pickpocketed to retrieve the Teddy bear.

label: Study desk
title: Study desk
lead: Study desks are examinable scenery found throughout Gielinor in various buildings.

label: Stun
title: Stun
lead:
Stun is a level 80 Magic spell. When cast on an opponent, their Attack level is reduced by 10%. The spell can only be cast if their stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you cannot stack stat reduction with multiple spells in a row.

The spell gives 90 Magic experience and needs 1 Soul, 12 Earth, and 12 Water runes to be cast.

label: Sturdy wooden gate
title: Sturdy wooden gate
lead: A sturdy wooden gate can be found at the Sinclair Mansion, as part of the Sinclair Guard's dog pen. Upon investigating the gate, the Sinclair Guard dog will start barking loudly at the player. This deduces that no intruder could have committed the murder; the Sinclair Guard dog could have known the suspect at the time.

label: Suit of armour
title: Suit of armour
lead:
Suits of armour guard the prison door of the Cauldron of Thunder utilised in Druidic Ritual.

At first, the suit of armour will appear inconspicuous and will not appear to be an enemy; when one attempts to open the door, it animates, and attacks. When this occurs, a message in the chatbox will state Suddenly the suit of armour comes to life!

label: Suit of armour (black and red)
title: Suit of armour (black and red)
lead: Suit of armour is a non-interactive scenery object which can be found in many places around Gielinor.

label: Suit of armour (Imperial Guard)
title: Suit of armour (Imperial Guard)
lead: Suit of armour is scenery depicting the ceremonial armour of the Imperial Guard. It can be found on the of Burthorpe Castle and in the animation room of the Warriors' Guild.

label: Suit of armour (red and yellow)
title: Suit of armour (red and yellow)
lead: Suit of armour is a non-interactive scenery object which can be found in many places around Gielinor.

label: Suit of armour (rusty)
title: Suit of armour (rusty)
lead: Suit of armour is a non-interactive scenery object which can be found in many places around Gielinor.

label: Suit of armour (Varrock, old)
title: Suit of armour (Varrock, old)
lead: Suit of armour is a non-interactive scenery object which can be found in the Warriors' Guild in Burthorpe. Prior to Varrock's restyle in 2007, they could be found throughout the Varrock Palace.

label: Suit of armour (Varrock)
title: Suit of armour (Varrock)
lead: Suit of armour is a non-interactive scenery object which can be found in the Varrock Palace. The shield bears the emblem of the Varrock guards.

label: Suit of armour (white and blue)
title: Suit of armour (white and blue)
lead: Suit of armour is a non-interactive scenery object which can be found in many places around Gielinor.

label: sulphuric broline
title: sulphuric broline
lead:
Sulphuric broline is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is obtained from Elena after returning her distillator to her.

It is first given to Hops, who will smuggle it into the Dancing Donkey Inn, past the Guard conducting body searches. After retrieving it from Hops, it is given to Guidor in south-east Varrock, alongside plague sample, liquid honey, ethenea, and touch paper.

label: Summoned Zombie
title: Summoned Zombie
lead:
Summoned Zombies are occasionally summoned by Invrigar the Necromancer and the Necromancer in the Necromancer Tower south of East Ardougne.

They attack in a multicombat area so they can be a minor threat to low levels.

label: super attack
title: super attack
lead:
A super attack is a potion made by using an eye of newt on an irit potion (unf), requiring 45 Herblore, yielding a super attack(3) and 100 Herblore experience. A dose of super attack provides a temporary skill boost to Attack equal to 5 + 15% of the player's current Attack level, rounded down.

Super attacks along with super strengths are popular for player killing, bossing, Slayer, or melee training.

label: super defence
title: super defence
lead:
A super defence is a potion made by using white berries on a cadantine potion (unf), requiring 66 Herblore, yielding a super defence(3) and 150 Herblore experience. A dose of super defence provides a temporary skill boost to Defence equal to 5 + 15% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down.

Crystal dust may be added to super defence, 1 dust per dose of potion, to make a divine super defence potion, requiring 70 Herblore.

label: Super energy
title: Super energy
lead:
A super energy is a potion made by mixing avantoe with mort myre fungi in a vial of water, giving 117.5 Herblore experience. It requires level 52 Herblore.

Super energy potions recover 20% of run energy per dose.

label: super restore
title: super restore
lead:
A super restore is a potion that restores all player stats that have been lowered, including Prayer, but not Hitpoints. Players with level 63 Herblore can make a super restore potion by using a red spiders' eggs on a snapdragon potion (unf), giving 142.5 experience. Super restores can further be made into Sanfew serums by adding (in order) unicorn horn dust, snake weed, and nail beast nails into a super restore potion.

The restore value obtained per dose is 8 + 25% of the player's base level (rounded down) in each of the affected skills. For example, a player with 84 Thieving and 63 Smithing would restore both 29 points of Thieving and 23 points of Smithing for each dose consumed. The maximum amount of points that can be restored with this potion is 32 at level 96. This means that a super restore potion will restore 1 more Prayer point per dose than a prayer potion.

label: super strength
title: super strength
lead:
A super strength is a potion made by using a limpwurt root on a kwuarm potion (unf), requiring 55 Herblore, yielding a super strength(3) and 125 Herblore experience. A dose of super strength provides a temporary skill boost to Strength equal to 5 + 15% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down.

Super strength along with super attacks are popular for player killing, bossing, Slayer, or melee training. The dragon battleaxe special may be preferable for melee training because it provides a similar boost while being much cheaper in the long run.

label: superantipoison
title: superantipoison
lead:
A superantipoison is a potion made by using unicorn horn dust on an irit potion (unf), requiring 48 Herblore, yielding a superantipoison(3) and 106.3 Herblore experience. A dose of superantipoison cures poison and provides poison immunity for 6 minutes. Drinking two doses of superantipoison will cure venom. The first dose will reduce the venom to poison and the second will remove the poison.

A superantipoison(1) can be found in the southern most collapsed building north-east of the Observatory, near the entrance to the Observatory Dungeon with a respawn time of 55 seconds.

label: Superheat Item
title: Superheat Item
lead:
Superheat Item is a utility spell available in the standard spellbook. It requires level 43 Magic to cast, and grants 53 Magic experience per cast. It allows players to smelt ore into bars without a furnace. It cannot be cast on noted ore.

Casting the spell on a piece of ore in the player's inventory requires the same Smithing level as smelting the bar at a furnace, along with the appropriate amount of coal. Each bar made yields the same amount of Smithing experience as would be gained from smelting the bar at a furnace. The experience-boosting effect of the goldsmith gauntlets or Smithing cape is applied when casting Superheat Item.

label: Superhuman Strength
title: Superhuman Strength
lead:
Superhuman Strength is a prayer unlocked at level 13 Prayer. While in use, the prayer increases the player's Strength by 10%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Strength level, such as Ultimate Strength.

label: Surgeon General Tafani
title: Surgeon General Tafani
lead:
Surgeon General Tafani is the lead surgeon at the Emir's Arena hospital. She, along with Jaraah and the nurses Sabreen and A'abla, can heal players if they have lost hitpoints (but cannot cure poison). They can heal players who are not playing the minigame, and can be useful to players fighting in the nearby area. The healing is free of charge.

Tafani, as the master of Hitpoints, sells the Hitpoints cape to players with level 99 in Hitpoints for .

label: Survival Expert
title: Survival Expert
lead: The Survival Expert, whose name is Brynna, is the second NPC players meet in the game. She teaches the basics about the Cooking, Firemaking, Fishing and Woodcutting skills.

label: Swamp Toad
title: Swamp Toad
lead:
Swamp toads are creatures found near the swamp south of the Castle Wars arena. They can be filled with swamp gas using ogre bellows to create a bloated toad, which is used as bait when trying to kill a chompy bird. They are also used in the quest Mourning's End Part I, in which they are injected with dye to produce coloured toads. They occasionally say "Ribbit" or "Croak" overhead.

Swamp toads that can be picked up cannot be used to fill ogre bellows. Attempting to do so results in the chatbox message stating "The chompy bird doesn't like this species of toad."

label: Swamp paste
title: Swamp paste
lead:
Swamp paste is made by mixing flour with swamp tar to make raw swamp paste, and then cooking the mixture on a fire, yielding 2 Cooking experience. It cannot be cooked on a range. It is possible to burn the tar, though it is automatically discarded. Swamp tar spawns in Lumbridge Swamp and Mort Myre Swamp.

To make a large amount of swamp paste from swamp tar, use a barrel of flour at either the Sinclair Mansion or Gordon and Mary's farm. Bring as much swamp tar as needed and 26 pots, Gordon's farm also has a pot spawn. Click the barrel to fill the pots, then combine with the swamp tar to create raw swamp paste. Repeat this until the desired amount is obtained, then cook it. A permanent fire is recommended for large amounts. There is a permanent fire at the base of Mount Karuulm, very near the fairy ring and in front of the shack with a rope spawn.

label: Swamp tar
title: Swamp tar
lead:
Swamp tar is a thick substance found in the Lumbridge Swamp, Mort Myre Swamp, and in tar barrels.

Swamp tar can be turned into swamp paste, which is used for various repairing purposes. It can also be distilled into lamp oil, which is used as fuel for various light sources, or be used to make guam, marrentill, tarromin, harralander, and irit tar, which are used as bait and ammunition for salamanders.

label: Swamp toad (item)
title: Swamp toad (item)
lead:
A swamp toad is a small creature with removable legs. Doing so yields toad's legs in place of the swamp toad. Toad's legs heal for 3 Hitpoints, are used as the second ingredient for agility potions (toadflax potion unf), and the gnome cooking foods: Tangled toad's legs, toad batta and toad crunchies.

Collecting a swamp toad at the Gnome Stronghold is a requirement for the Easy Western Provinces Diary.

label: Swarm (random event)
title: Swarm (random event)
lead: The swarm was a random event that has since been discontinued. It attacked a player, and the player could not attack back, hitting for one or two points of damage. They would continue to attack the player until either the player dies, or if the player moves a short distance away which would cause the swarm to stop attacking.

label: Sword pommel
title: Sword pommel
lead: The sword pommel is an item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by searching the dolmen in the Tomb of Bervirius. The pommel must be given to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai village. The player must then use a chisel on the pommel to turn it into bone beads which, when combined with bronze wire, form a beads of the dead necklace. If lost, the pommel can be regained by returning to the tomb and searching the dolmen again.

label: Swordfish
title: Swordfish
lead:
Swordfish is a type of fish that restores 14 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw swordfish on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 45 Cooking and granting 140 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt swordfish. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 80 on ranges and level 86 on fires.

Swordfish are one of the fish required by Caleb during the quest Family Crest.

label: Table (Gnome)
title: Table (Gnome)
lead: Table is a scenery object found in both the Tree Gnome Village and the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Players cannot interact with the table, but they can examine it.

label: Table (Granite)
title: Table (Granite)
lead:
A Table that seems to be made of granite can be found in several places among Gielinor. Like most tables, these tables can be used to put things on, by simply using the item on the table.

It looks identical to the ceremonial table found in Klenter's Pyramid.

label: Table (Shaman Caves)
title: Table (Shaman Caves)
lead: A Table is found in the first room of the Shaman Caves, and can be searched in order to obtain A scribbled note during the Legends' Quest. Looking at the table results in the message: "A crudely constructed makeshift table made from various pieces of wood. You see nothing on the table."

label: Tagged a Ticket! (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
title: Tagged a Ticket! (Brimhaven Agility Arena)
lead: Tagged a Ticket! (Brimhaven Agility Arena) is a Jingle that plays when obtaining a ticket in the Brimhaven Agility Arena. It is based upon Aztec.

label: Tai Bwo Wannai
title: Tai Bwo Wannai
lead:
Tai Bwo Wannai, meaning 'small clearing in the jungle', is a village located south of Brimhaven, deep in the jungle of Karamja. It is home to a number of villagers. However, it does have a problem with its location, as the surrounding jungle always seems to be trying to grow back over where it once was.

If you do travel to Tai Bwo Wannai, be aware of broodoo victims. They're part of the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame, but most players run from them, due to their high hp, strong damage, and low benefits for killing them. They also cast stat-reducing spells.

label: Talking Forest
title: Talking Forest
lead: Talking Forest is a music track that is unlocked at McGrubor's Wood.

label: Tall Reeds
title: Tall Reeds
lead:
Tall Reeds are aquatic plants found in Kharazi Jungle, Kourend Woodland, by the River Salve and in the garden of the Ratcatchers Mansion. Using either a machete or knife on them allows the player to obtain a hollow reed, which is used to retrieve the pure water from the spring in Kharazi Jungle, which is used to make holy water. 
Since the tall reeds are found at the spring in Kharazi Jungle, there is no reason to obtain hollow reed elsewhere, and the other occurences of tall reeds appear to be serving as scenery rather than function.

Looking at the tall reeds yield the message: "These look like interesting plants, right next to the waters edge. They make the pool look really picturesque.", despite the fact that the reeds can also be found next to the River Salve. Whilst searching them yields the message: "These tall reeds look nice and long with a long tube for a stem. They reach all the way down to the water."

label: Tan cavalier
title: Tan cavalier
lead:
The tan cavalier is a piece of headwear. There are no requirements for wearing this cavalier, and they do not confer combat bonuses upon the player.

A cavalier of any colour is a potential reward from hard Treasure Trails.

label: Tangled toad's legs
title: Tangled toad's legs
lead:
A tangled toad's legs is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 15 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade tangled toad's legs are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 160 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make a tangled toad's legs via gnome cooking with 40 Cooking, yielding 185 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Tanner (Crafting Guild)
title: Tanner (Crafting Guild)
lead: Tanner is a tanner on the of the Crafting Guild. He will tan hides for a small fee per item. Members who have claimed the rewards for completing the hard Falador Diary or have 99 Crafting can use the bank chest on the . This is the fastest method of tanning hides. With maximum focus, up to 9000 leather can be tanned per hour.

label: Target (Ranging Guild)
title: Target (Ranging Guild)
lead:
Targets can be found in the eastern corner of the Ranging Guild, which play the central role in the guild's shooting range minigame. To shoot at the target, players must provide their own bow, but bronze arrows are provided by the judge. Players who lose any of the provided 10 arrows may buy more arrows for 100 coins, regardless of the amount of arrows they happen to be missing.

Shooting at these targets can only be done after paying the Competition Judge 200 coins to partake in the minigame, after which you will receive 10 bronze arrows to shoot at the target. 1 Ranged experience is rewarded for every 2 points obtained. At the end of the game, one archery ticket is rewarded for every 10 points obtained in the game. It is also possible to miss the target, which will reward no points and grants no experience.

label: Tarromin
title: Tarromin
lead:
Tarromin is the third lowest level herb. It can be cleaned at level 11 Herblore, and it is used for making strength potions, serum 207, shrink-me-quick and tarromin tar. It can be grown with the Farming skill with a level of 19, by planting a tarromin seed in a herb patch. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a tarromin potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

According to the book Gielinor's flora - herbs, tarromin are native to tropical regions and it is believed to be one of the earliest cultivated plants of Gielinor.

label: Tarromin potion (unf)
title: Tarromin potion (unf)
lead: A tarromin potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a tarromin on a vial of water, requiring 12 Herblore. Using a limpwurt root on a tarromin potion (unf) with 12 Herblore yields a Strength potion(3) and 50 Herblore experience.
