In the Shades of Mort'ton quest, after reading the diary of Herbi Flax, using ashes on a tarromin potion (unf) with 15 Herblore yields a Serum 207 (3) and 50 Herblore experience. In the Grim Tales quest, using shrunk ogleroot on a tarromin potion (unf) with 52 Herblore yields a Shrink-me-quick and 6 Herblore experience.

label: Tattered eye patch
title: Tattered eye patch
lead: The tattered eye patch is a quest item that appears in the Watchtower quest and it can be found after the quest's completion. Players can find it by searching the bushes surrounding the Watchtower outside the north wall of Yanille. It serves no purpose during the quest, and it cannot be worn.

label: Tattered scroll
title: Tattered scroll
lead:
The tattered scroll is a quest item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by searching a pile of loose rocks in the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. The scroll must be given to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai village. It is not used after the quest and can be sold to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 100 coins. If dropped it will "Slip down a narrow crevice never to be seen again".

The scroll details the death and resurrection of Bervirius.

label: Taverley
title: Taverley
lead: Taverley is a small Guthixian village found north-west of Falador inhabited primarily by druids. The village has no bank, but it is a starting point for several quests, and houses the Taverley Dungeon. The village is often the first place that members visit outside of free-to-play.

label: Taverley Dungeon
title: Taverley Dungeon
lead: The Taverley Dungeon is one of the largest dungeons in Old School RuneScape. There are many monsters, ranging from low to high combat levels, getting stronger as players venture deeper into the dungeon. These include poisonous monsters, so bringing antipoison potions is advised if travelling through the parts of the dungeon that contain them. Taverley Dungeon is entirely single combat (although cannons can still attack multiple targets if the player is not in direct combat).

label: Tea seller
title: Tea seller
lead:
The tea seller runs a tea stall in Varrock south-east of the east bank. Stealing from his stall will make him yell "You're the one who keeps stealing from me! Guards, Guards!", although no-one will ever come to him. If players touch the tea sitting on the table in front of him, he will yell, "Hey! Put that back! Those are for display only!" Furthermore, using Telekinetic Grab on the cup will prevent the spell and result in him saying the same thing.

Level 5 Thieving is required to steal from a tea stall. Like all stalls, if you talk to him again, he will shout rather pointlessly. The tea he sells is sold for coins.

label: Tea stall
title: Tea stall
lead:
Tea stall is a stall located in south-eastern Varrock and Kourend Castle. In Varrock the shop is owned by the tea seller as part of Ye olde Tea Shoppe. The player can steal from it with a Thieving level of 5, granting 16 experience.

There is a cup of tea on the bench nearby, but it cannot be taken because it is apparently just for display.

label: Teal boots
title: Teal boots
lead:
Teal boots can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The boots come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. They give the same stats as leather boots.

Unlike leather boots, these cannot be crafted. Because of their stats, they are mostly worn for cosmetic purposes.

label: Teal gloves
title: Teal gloves
lead:
Teal gloves can be purchased in Canifis from Barker at his store, Barker's Haberdashery, and are also dropped by Crawling Hands. The gloves come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. These gloves are often worn to match certain armour sets, such as gold-trimmed and god armour sets.

Their defence bonus is equal to that of leather gloves.

label: Teal hat
title: Teal hat
lead: Teal hats can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The hats come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Teal robe bottoms
title: Teal robe bottoms
lead: Teal robe bottoms can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe bottoms come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Teal robe top
title: Teal robe top
lead: Teal robe tops can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe tops come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Technical plans
title: Technical plans
lead:
The technical plans are a quest item from The Tourist Trap quest. You bring these plans for a weapon to the Bedabin nomads and use their experimental anvil to make it. After you've shown the prototype to Al Shabim, he takes the plans from you.

The first option on this item is "Read", if you read it, this comes up: The plans look very technical! But you can see that this item will require a bronze bar and at least 10 feathers. Upon completing the quest, it will instead read: Some technical looking plans.

label: Ted Rehnison
title: Ted Rehnison
lead: Ted Rehnison is a man who lives in the Rehnison household, located in north-eastern West Ardougne. He is the husband of Martha Rehnison. He has two children, Billy and Milli. His family sells cooking apples and are known friends of Elena.

label: Telekinetic Grab
title: Telekinetic Grab
lead:
Telekinetic Grab (also known as telegrab) is a utility spell available in the standard spellbook. It requires level 33 Magic to cast, and grants 43 Magic experience per cast.

The spell can be used to pick up an item (or a pile of a stackable item) up to 10 tiles away, including over or through obstacles such as fences, gates, and rivers. It is useful when picking up item spawns that are guarded by dangerous monsters, such as the wine of Zamorak in the Chaos Temple, and is also sometimes required for quests in order to pick up items that are guarded by NPCs or otherwise unreachable. For repeated casting, it is recommended to have a staff of air equipped to negate the need for air runes, and to have a way of restoring Magic level if grabbing wine of Zamorak outside of the Deep Wilderness Dungeon.

label: Telescope (Observatory reception)
title: Telescope (Observatory reception)
lead: A telescope can be found next to the Observatory assistant at the Observatory reception. Players cannot interact with it, but they can examine it.

label: Telescope (Observatory)
title: Telescope (Observatory)
lead: The Observatory telescope is repaired and used during Observatory Quest.

label: Temple door (Iban's Temple)
title: Temple door (Iban's Temple)
lead: The Temple door is the entrance to Iban's Temple, where Iban is fought during the Underground Pass quest. In order to fight Iban, players have to wear zamorak monk robes and carry the Doll of iban.

label: Temple Guardian
title: Temple Guardian
lead:
The Temple Guardian (also known as Spots) is a dog-like monster that dwells in the entrance of the underground passageway to Canifis.

Players are required to kill the Temple Guardian in the Priest in Peril quest. Attempting to attack the monster outside of the quest will result in the message You have no reason to attack a helpless dog!

label: Temple of Ikov
title: Temple of Ikov
lead: Temple of Ikov is a quest featuring Lucien, a Mahjarrat. The quest revolves around the infiltration of the Temple of Ikov in order to steal a powerful artefact known as the Staff of Armadyl.

label: Temple of Ikov (dungeon)
title: Temple of Ikov (dungeon)
lead:
The Temple of Ikov is a dungeon underneath Hemenster. The main entrance to the dungeon is located south of the Ranging Guild and secondary entrance inside the house in McGrubor's Wood requires a shiny key.

There are no requirements to access the dungeon, however players that have not completed the Temple of Ikov quest will need to wear a pendant of lucien to pass through the gates north-west of the southern entrance.

label: Tent door (Bedabin Camp)
title: Tent door (Bedabin Camp)
lead: A tent door is located at the entrance to the north tent in the Bedabin Camp. It is being guarded by the Bedabin Nomad Guard, who will only allow players to use it during The Tourist Trap quest. Behind the door is an experimental anvil, which is used to smith prototype dart tips.

label: Tenti pineapple
title: Tenti pineapple
lead:
The Tenti pineapple is a quest item used in The Tourist Trap quest. It is received from the Bedabin Camp bandits to bribe the guards to let the player pass into the slave mining dungeon. Like ordinary pineapples, it has an 'Eat' option, but cannot be consumed whole, and it is possible to use a knife on it, giving the option to cut it into pineapple rings or pineapple chunks. It can also be placed in a compost bin to create supercompost. If it is lost, it can be re-obtained from Al Shabim until The Tourist Trap is completed.

Also known as the 'Bedabin ambrosia' (according to the Bedabin nomads) it is a special pineapple that according to Al Shabim is grown in a secret location in order to prevent thieves from raiding them.

label: Tenzing
title: Tenzing
lead:
Tenzing is a living in the house just west of Burthorpe. The player needs to go through his house to take the secret path past Death Plateau on the way to Trollheim.

He is involved in the Death Plateau and Troll Romance quests. He sells climbing boots for 12 coins each.

label: Terrorbird
title: Terrorbird
lead:
Terrorbirds (Aves Terror) are animals used by the gnomes as mounts. They are found on the west side of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. They are also involved in the Rag and Bone Man II quest, where the ones that don't have any gnomes mounted upon them will drop a special bone needed for the quest.

Killing a Terrorbird is a requirement for the Easy Western Provinces Diary.

label: Terry Balando
title: Terry Balando
lead:
Terrance Balando, known by his nickname Terry, is an archaeological expert at the Digsite who is interested in the historical value of items which might be found there. Players can use items on him and he will tell them if there is any archaeological significance to the item. Players who bring him 3 gold nuggets will also receive 1 gold ore in return.

He is involved in the Desert Treasure I quest, where he translates a set of etchings near the beginning of the quest. If players speak to him while wielding an ancient staff, he will say it is incredible and will comment on the Zarosian symbol.

label: The Desert
title: The Desert
lead:
The Desert is a music track unlocked in members parts of Kharidian Desert. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Arabian 3, Desert Heat, Desert Voyage, Egypt, Scarab, Sphinx, and Sunburn.

In Classic mode, the track plays in or east of the Bedabin Camp.

label: The Dig Site
title: The Dig Site
lead: The Dig Site is a quest where you must pass an archaeology exam for the Varrock Museum to be able to excavate the site where the city of Saranthium previously stood, but you discover something else...

label: The Emir's Arena
title: The Emir's Arena
lead: The Emir's Arena is a music track that is unlocked in or around the Emir's Arena.

label: The Fisher King
title: The Fisher King
lead:
The Fisher King ruled the Fisher Realm and protected the Holy Grail. During the quest he and his land have a connected sickness. This is cured only when Sir Percival, his son, arrives to take the crown from his father's sick head. At the end of the quest, it is speculated he dies.

During the quest, the Fisher King appears to be wearing a white chainbody, though it has a shoulder pad and a sleeve on the left arm. He is also wearing white platelegs, leather gloves, and wielding a staff.

label: The Forgotten Cemetery
title: The Forgotten Cemetery
lead:
The Forgotten Cemetery is a minor area in the Wilderness at around level 30. It contains ankous, ghosts, skeletons, zombies, and a man. The cemetery is visited by those wishing to complete the Wilderness Diary, as a medium task requires the player to kill an ankou in the Wilderness and is the one of the two locations where they can be found.

The Agility shortcut (level 60) just north-west of the cemetery is a one-way shortcut from the God Wars Dungeon into the Wilderness.

label: The Grand Tree
title: The Grand Tree
lead: The Grand Tree is a gnome quest centred on protecting the Grand Tree from dying upon the gnome race.

label: The Knight's Sword
title: The Knight's Sword
lead: The Knight's Sword is a free-to-play intermediate quest in which the White Knight Squire Asrol needs help making Sir Vyvin a new ceremonial sword.

label: The Lady of the Lake
title: The Lady of the Lake
lead:
The Lady of the Lake is a powerful sorceress and guardian and bestower of Excalibur. She is located on a peninsula in the lake south-east of Taverley. She plays a minor role in the Merlin's Crystal quest by giving the player Excalibur after the player passes her test.

If you lose your Excalibur, you can visit her and pay 500 coins for another one.

label: The Long Hall
title: The Long Hall
lead: The Long Hall is a tavern located in the northern part of Barbarian Village. Many Barbarians are found inside. It may be dangerous to attack more than one Barbarian, especially since one or two use Ranged weapons. It has a cooked meat spawn. There are also two non-stop fires at the end of the hall, useful for cooking fish caught in the river to the east. If players take an empty beer glass and use it on a barrel of beer, they will be attacked by barbarians that are close to the player.

label: The North
title: The North
lead:
The North is a frozen region of snow and ice where the city of Ghorrock once stood, along with its surrounding lands.

The area is often referred to by the Mahjarrat, expressing plans to “go North” or “meet again in the North” since an old shrine at the center of the area serves as the site of their rejuvenation ritual.

label: The Rehnison household
title: The Rehnison household
lead:
The Rehnison household is a house in the northern part of West Ardougne. It is inhabited by Ted Rehnison, his wife Martha Rehnison, and their two children Billy and Milli.

Its basement, accessed by searching the eastern bed, acts as a shelter for the Ardougne Resistance during the Song of the Elves quest.

label: The Restless Ghost
title: The Restless Ghost
lead: The Restless Ghost is one of the six quests released with the launch of RuneScape Classic. In it, the player helps the priest of the Lumbridge church get rid of the ghost that haunts the Lumbridge graveyard.

label: The Shadow
title: The Shadow
lead:
The Shadow is a music track that is unlocked on Crandor. Since 2021, it requires partial completion of Dragon Slayer I to unlock.

In Classic mode, there is a very small region on the west of Crandor that is accessible to Members only, which plays Fruits de Mer.

label: The Shrimp and Parrot
title: The Shrimp and Parrot
lead: The Shrimp and Parrot is a restaurant in Brimhaven. It is run by Alfonse the waiter. During the Heroes' Quest, it is revealed that the restaurant is actually a hideout for the Phoenix Gang, set up as part of a scheme to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

label: The Toad and Chicken
title: The Toad and Chicken
lead:
The Toad and Chicken is a bar and an inn found in Burthorpe, north of Taverley. It caters primarily to the soldiers and citizens of Burthorpe. Wizard's mind bomb, Dwarven stout and Asgarnian ale are all purchasable from Tostig for two coins each. Players can also find a trapdoor leading to the Rogues' Den behind the bar on the . Players can also pickup an Asgarnian ale and an empty beer glass on the bar counter.

Players doing the Death Plateau quest can find Harold in the last room on the of the inn. On the , players can help Bernald, in the garden, during the Garden of Tranquillity quest by curing his grape vines.

label: The Tourist Trap
title: The Tourist Trap
lead: The Tourist Trap is an intermediate quest set in the Kharidian Desert. The quest involves an undercover rescue operation into a slave camp to save an Al Kharidian woman's daughter.

label: The Tower
title: The Tower
lead: The Tower is a music track that is unlocked in East Ardougne. It can also be heard in Ardougne's western sewers. In Classic mode, it also unlocks in the basement of the Chaos Druid Tower.

label: Theme
title: Theme
lead: Theme is a music track that is unlocked at the Coal Trucks, or in the Waterfall Dungeon.

label: Thessalia
title: Thessalia
lead: Thessalia Nitter runs Thessalia's Fine Clothes, a makeover shop in Varrock. Items of clothing can be bought from her, or a player can get a makeover to change their appearance underneath their worn items free of charge. She also exchanges frog tokens for a royal frog costume, a frog mask, or an experience lamp. She will also return bunny ears and scythes to a player if they have lost them.

label: Thessalia's Fine Clothes.
title: Thessalia's Fine Clothes.
lead: Thessalia's Fine Clothes is located in central Varrock square. In addition to selling clothes, Thessalia will offer to give a player a "total clothing-makeover". This allows the player to change the default shirt or trousers they chose when creating their character. Browsing the store is a requirement for the Easy Varrock Diary. An old woman named Iffie sits against the northern wall of the store.

label: Thessalia's Makeovers
title: Thessalia's Makeovers
lead:
Thessalia's Makeovers was a shop in Varrock that could change a player's default clothing free of charge. The makeover was run by Thessalia, who also owns another clothing shop in the same building. Players could not customise shoes here — they must have instead gone to Yrsa's Shoe Store. There was no fee attached to the service, neither for the tops or for the legwear, allowing players to customise their default outfit as often as they like.

To get a makeover, talk to Thessalia and ask for one, or right-click her and choose "Makeover". Equipment can be worn while getting a makeover, but a player will not be able to see the changes afterwards until they remove anything in the torso or leg slots.

label: Thick Skin
title: Thick Skin
lead:
Thick Skin is a Prayer that the player starts with upon creating their character. Thick Skin increases the player's Defence by 5%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Defence level, such as Rock Skin, with the notable exceptions of Deadeye and Mystic Vigour which allow for simultaneous use.

label: Thief
title: Thief
lead: A thief is a criminal found in various places around Gielinor, and can be a challenge for new or low level players. They can be either male or female. One of their characteristics is that they will stop attacking and retreat when at low health.

label: thieves' armband
title: thieves' armband
lead:
A thieves' armband is one of the three items required by Achietties during Heroes' Quest. To obtain it for the quest, you must speak to your gang leader (Black Arm Gang, Katrine; Phoenix Gang, Straven). You will also need a partner from the other gang.

Firstly, both of you must go to the Black Arm Gang's hideout Brimhaven. The Black Arm gang member should be wearing full Black armour (Black full helmet, Black platebody, Black platelegs). Then, the Black Arm gang member is to retrieve an ID to enter the building, but you must get two candlesticks from Scarface Pete first. (Note: You need to give one to your Phoenix gang partner.) Then, you must retrieve a Miscellaneous key, in order for your partner to range the level 22 Grip, who drops the key required for the armband. Both of you must bring your candlestick back to your gang leaders for reward, that is: Straven for the Phoenix gang member, and Katrine for the Black Arm gang member.

label: Thieving
title: Thieving
lead: Thieving is a members-only skill which allows players to obtain coins and items by stealing from market stalls, chests, or by pickpocketing non-player characters. This skill also allows players to unlock doors and disarm traps.

label: Thieving Level Up!
title: Thieving Level Up!
lead: Thieving Level Up! is a Jingle for leveling Thieving.

label: Thieving Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Thieving Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Thieving Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Thieving.

label: Think
title: Think
lead:
Think is the fifth listed emote. Upon use the player scratches their head.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Thistle
title: Thistle
lead: Thistles are a common decorative scenery found across Gielinor, with notable concentrations near Lumbridge, the Fight Arena, and Hosidius. They are purely decorative and have no particular function. A similar-looking thistle can be constructed in the garden of a player-owned house.

label: Thormac
title: Thormac
lead:
Thormac is a sorcerer who can be found at the top of his home; the Sorcerer's Tower, found south of Seers' Village. Players must speak to him to begin the Scorpion Catcher quest.

After completing the quest, he can perform a service for players which will enchant a battlestaff into a mystic staff. This service costs 40,000 coins. The price is reduced to 30,000 coins if the player has completed the Hard Kandarin Diary, or 20,000 if the player has completed the Elite Kandarin Diary.

label: Thrantax the Mighty
title: Thrantax the Mighty
lead:
Thrantax the Mighty is a ghost that players must bring under their control during the Merlin's Crystal quest. This can be done by using the magic words found under the chaos altar.

If the player uses the wrong words, Thrantax will attack them. The player may attempt to fight him or run away. Either way, he will despawn shortly.

label: Thread
title: Thread
lead:
Thread is used along with a needle to make armour out of leather, dragon leather and cured yak-hide. Each thread spool has 5 uses before it is consumed. A "use" means an action performed, not number of leathers used (e.g. making vambraces, which use 1 hide each, consumes thread at the same rate as making chaps, which use 2 hides each).

After completion of Death on the Isle, a Costume needle can be used for crafting without needing thread.

label: Throne (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
title: Throne (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
lead: A throne can be found on the of the Grand Tree, located within the Tree Gnome Stronghold. This kingly seat is for the royal behind of King Narnode Shareen.

label: Thrower Troll
title: Thrower Troll
lead:
A Thrower Troll is a troll that attacks with ranged. They are relatively annoying monsters that throw rocks at passing adventurers, regardless of being engaged in combat or not. They are rarely ever on their own, preferring to be together in groups. Unlike most other monsters, the thrower troll's attacks are always successful hits. As they are found in multi-way areas, being attacked by three or more thrower trolls at once can be deadly.

Equipping a Neitiznot shield will reduce their maximum hit to 2.

label: Thrower troll (Trollheim)
title: Thrower troll (Trollheim)
lead:
A thrower troll is a troll that attacks with ranged. They are aggressive monsters that throw rocks at passing adventurers, regardless of being engaged in combat or not. They are rarely ever on their own, preferring to be together in groups. Unlike most other monsters, the thrower troll's attacks are always successful hits. As they are found in multi-way areas, being attacked by three or more thrower trolls at once can be deadly.

Equipping a Neitiznot shield will reduce their maximum hit to 2.

label: Throwing rope
title: Throwing rope
lead: The throwing rope is an animation item used in the Underground Pass. It is temporarily wielded by the player during the animation when tying a rope to the rope swing. Aside from this, the item cannot be obtained.

label: Thug
title: Thug
lead:
Thugs are level 10 aggressive monsters who are found exclusively in the Wilderness. A group of them can be found in low level Wilderness, north of the Grand Exchange, and another group can be found at the beginning of the Wilderness section of the Edgeville Dungeon.

They are rarely killed, except by players trying to obtain a looting bag who kill them due to their low hitpoints, as well as their locations being out of the way from the more heavily trafficked sections of the Wilderness.

label: Thurgo
title: Thurgo
lead:
Thurgo, the supposed last of the Imcando dwarf race, is found outside the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, south of Port Sarim, and just north of Mudskipper Point. You can use the fairy ring code and run north to reach him. He is a master of Smithing and players who have achieved level 99 in Smithing can purchase the Smithing cape from him for 99,000 coins. Additionally, he is one of the main characters encountered during the The Knight's Sword quest.

Using the book Imcandoria's fall on him will reveal hidden dialogue in which he asks the player that they bring him along should they plan an expedition to the Isle of Garmr mentioned in the book. After the player talks to Ramarno upon completing the Below Ice Mountain quest, Thurgo can be informed of the discovery of another living Imcando dwarf. He is taken aback by the revelation and has yet to meet Ramarno because he "wouldn't know what to say".

label: Ticket Dispenser
title: Ticket Dispenser
lead:
The ticket dispenser is found inside the Brimhaven Agility Arena where it will distribute Agility arena tickets and Brimhaven vouchers to players that tag the correct dispenser in time. There is no Agility level required to touch either this version of the dispenser, or the version that shoots darts, to claim a ticket. Tagging the marked dispenser awards 30 Agility experience for every 10 Agility levels (including Agility boosts or drains), maxing out at 300 if boosting to level 100 Agility, and will display the message You have received an Agility Arena Ticket and Brimhaven Voucher!.

Attempting to touch a marked pillar after having touched it and claimed experience already will not award additional experience or tickets, and will display the message You can only get one ticket at a time, wait till the arrow moves again..

label: Ticket Dispenser (darts)
title: Ticket Dispenser (darts)
lead:
The ticket dispensers with darts are Ticket Dispensers found inside the Brimhaven Agility Arena where it will distribute Agility arena tickets and Brimhaven vouchers to players that tag the correct dispenser in time, and are also an obstacle within the arena. Tagging the marked dispenser awards Agility experience scaled to the player's Agility level, and will display the message You have received an Agility Arena Ticket and Brimhaven Voucher!.

Attempting to touch a marked pillar after having touched it and claimed experience already will not award additional experience or tickets, and will display the message You can only get one ticket at a time, wait till the arrow moves again..

label: Ticket Merchant
title: Ticket Merchant
lead:
Ticket Merchants are members of the Ranging Guild who run the Ranging Guild Ticket Exchange. The shop deals exclusively in archery tickets which can be earned in the guild's target shooting minigame. As they are in the guild's western corner, they require level 40 Ranged to access.

You buy the whole quantity of items for the indicated price. That is, for example, you buy 30 Barb bolttips at once for 140 Archery tickets.

label: Tile
title: Tile
lead:
A tile is a formerly useless item that can be found in certain places in the Wilderness. Some tiles spawn in the Graveyard of Shadows and the western ruins.

Prior to the release of the Construction skill in 2006, many players speculated that tiles would be used in player-owned houses; however, they were never given a purpose when the skill was released. The tile remained a useless item until the robe bottom of ruin was discovered during the Crack the Clue III event, as a tile is required to obtain this reward.

label: Time Out
title: Time Out
lead: Time Out is a music track that is unlocked at the Maze Random event. It also plays at the end of Death on the Isle, when the player confronts Naiatli during the play.

label: Tin ore
title: Tin ore
lead: Tin ore can be mined at level 1 Mining providing 17.5 Mining experience. After mining tin rocks, it will take 2.4 seconds until it reappears. Tin ore is used with copper ore to smelt bronze bars. Smelting a bronze bar gives 6.2 Smithing experience.

label: Tin rocks
title: Tin rocks
lead:
Tin rocks contains tin ore mined upon with a pickaxe. It can be mined with any level Mining. Mining 14 tin ore and 14 copper ore (wielding the pickaxe as a weapon to free the 28th inventory space) and smelting them to bronze bars is a slow but effective way to raise Mining and Smithing.

For members, players can power level the Mining skill with tin ore in the Port Khazard mine and amass ore. This is because of two fast respawning tin rocks that are very close to a bank deposit box. These two tin rocks are the closest mining rocks to a fast bank source, which surpasses the West Falador mine and level 5 Agility shortcut.

label: Tinderbox
title: Tinderbox
lead:
The tinderbox is used primarily for lighting fires by clicking 'use' on the tinderbox, then clicking a log. A tinderbox can be bought in most general stores. It is also used to light and relight candles and lanterns, so any player venturing into a dark area such as the Lumbridge Caves should bring one in case their light source goes out.

When used on logs that the player has the Firemaking level to light, the messages You attempt to light the logs. and The fire catches and the logs begin to burn. are displayed. If the player does not have the Firemaking level, a variation of the message will display You need a Firemaking level of X to burn X logs.

label: toad batta
title: toad batta
lead:
A toad batta is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 12 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade toad battas are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 120 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make a toad batta via gnome cooking with 26 Cooking, yielding 152 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Toad crunchies
title: Toad crunchies
lead:
Toad crunchies are a food that players consume in one bite, healing 8 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade t'd crunch are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 85 coins, with 3 in stock. They are also dropped by tortoises.

Members can make toad crunchies via gnome cooking with 10 Cooking, yielding 100 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Toad's legs
title: Toad's legs
lead:
Toad's legs are a food used in Cooking and Herblore. They are made by pulling the legs off of swamp toads found in the swamp of Tree Gnome Stronghold or lake south of Taverley, and from pickpocketing gnomes, requiring 75 Thieving. They heal for 3 Hitpoints. Adding them to a toadflax potion (unf) makes an Agility potion (3), requiring 34 Herblore, and yielding 80 Herblore experience. Toad's legs are main ingredients of the gnome cooking foods: Tangled toad's legs, toad batta and toad crunchies.

Toad's legs can be used as a fast food, a subtype of food that incurs non-standard attack or eating delays when consumed. Toad's legs may be consumed after other foods with almost no delay; this does not work if the toad's legs are eaten first, and does not work when eating two toad's legs in a row. This technique (commonly referred to as combo eating) can be further enhanced by drinking a dose of Saradomin brew after your alternative food item, and before your toad's legs (food>brew>toad's legs).

label: Toadflax
title: Toadflax
lead:
Toadflax is a low level herb, requiring level 30 Herblore to clean. It can be acquired from Random events or grown with a Farming level of 38, by planting toadflax seeds in herb patches. It can also be acquired by trading in 3 vouchers from the Brimhaven Agility Arena or as a reward from Temple Trekking. It is used to make agility potions and most commonly, Saradomin brews. To create a potion, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a toadflax potion (unf), and then add the secondary ingredient.

Using Toadflax in the coconut milk based Antidote+ potion is often considered a waste, as Antidote++ is vastly preferred by PvM'ers, whereas the Antidote+ is not usually in demand. However, Antidote+ can be a viable and cheaper option in certain situations, such as fending off poison while training Ranged or Magic at the Skeletal Monkeys on Ape Atoll. Ironmen may also prefer to create Antidote+ until they reach a high enough level to create its more potent counterpart.

label: Toadflax potion (unf)
title: Toadflax potion (unf)
lead:
A toadflax potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a toadflax on a vial of water, requiring 34 Herblore. Using toad's legs on a toadflax potion (unf) with 34 Herblore yields an agility potion (3) and 80 Herblore experience. Using a crushed nest on a toadflax potion (unf) with 81 Herblore yields a saradomin brew (3) and 180 Herblore experience.

One is used in the Land of the Goblins quest.

label: Toban
title: Toban
lead:
Toban is one of the chieftains of an ogre tribe in the Feldip Hills. His tribe lives on an island east of the ogre city.

Toban enjoys chewing on dragon bones and gives players the Relic part 3 in exchange for a set of them. Players also have to recover a bar of gold that Toban stole from his nemesis, Og, during the same quest in order to get another part of the Ogre relic.

label: Toban's gold
title: Toban's gold
lead: Toban's gold is a bar of gold stolen from Og by his nemesis, Toban. The player must recover this item from Toban as part of the Watchtower quest. This is a unique gold bar, and Og will not accept a gold bar created by normal use of the Smithing skill.

label: Toban's key
title: Toban's key
lead: Toban's key is given by Og in the Watchtower quest to open the chest near Gorad. After opening the chest you will find Toban's gold and the key will be consumed.

label: Tomato
title: Tomato
lead:
Tomatoes are a food item mainly used in Cooking. They can be grown through the Farming skill at level 12 with tomato seeds. Eating one heals 2 hitpoints.

They are used in the following recipes:
* Ugthanki kebab
* Egg potato
* Cheese+tom batta, vegetable batta (Gnome cooking)
* Pizza base ingredient
* Garden pie (temporarily boosts Farming level by 3)

label: Tomb (Iban)
title: Tomb (Iban)
lead:
A tomb belonging to Iban can be found in the lowest level of the Underground Pass, beneath Iban's lair. During the Underground Pass quest, players must set the tomb alight using some dwarf brew and a tinderbox on it, in order to obtain Iban's ashes which are used on the doll of iban.

Searching the tomb before setting it on fire will cause the player to take 10 damage.

label: tomb dolmen (Rashiliyia's Tomb)
title: tomb dolmen (Rashiliyia's Tomb)
lead:
A tomb dolmen can be found within the Rashiliyia's Tomb, located in a room behind a set of tomb doors adorned with skeletons. Players must search the dolmen during the Shilo Village quest in order to spawn Nazastarool.

The dolmen is typically used by players as a safespot whilst killing Nazrastool.

label: Tomb dolmen (Tomb of Bervirius)
title: Tomb dolmen (Tomb of Bervirius)
lead: A tomb dolmen can be found within the Tomb of Bervirius. Players must search the tomb during the Shilo Village quest in order to receive a sword pommel, a locating crystal, and Bervirius notes.

label: Tomb doors
title: Tomb doors
lead: Tomb doors are scenery objects found within Rashiliyia's Tomb. Players must pass through the doors during the Shilo Village quest to reach the dolmen used to spawn Nazastarool. In order to open the doors, players must first use three bones on the doors to complete the skeletons. Subsequent openings do not require bones.

label: Tomb of Bervirius
title: Tomb of Bervirius
lead: The Tomb of Bervirius (referred to as Cairn Island Dungeon in the world map) is a burial ground visited during the Shilo Village quest. The player finds the sword pommel, locating crystal and Bervirius notes on the dolmen inside. To get to the tomb, head to Cairn Isle, and cross the bridge. Climb down the well stacked rocks to the north, and enter the cave from there.

label: Tombstone
title: Tombstone
lead: The Tombstone is an unused object that was added in the RuneScape 2 beta. Presumably, it would have been found in several graveyards alongside the Large grave stone, but was ultimately never added. It had an identical appearance to Glarial's tomb.

label: Tomorrow
title: Tomorrow
lead: Tomorrow is a music track that is unlocked south of Port Sarim.

label: Tony's Pizza Bases
title: Tony's Pizza Bases
lead:
Tony's Pizza Bases is a shop owned by Fat Tony that sells pizza bases for 4 coins each stocking them 30 at a time. The shop is located in the Wilderness Bandit Camp. Players should be careful as the shop is in the Wilderness and they risk getting attacked by PKers and Bandits.

There is also a cheese and tomato spawn, as well as giant rats that can be killed for meat and fishing spots for anchovies, making the shop an excellent place to make various pizzas. There are also everlasting fires outside, which allows the player to cook their rat meat.

label: Toolkit
title: Toolkit
lead:
The toolkit is a quest item used only in Dwarf Cannon. It is obtained from Captain Lawgof after rescuing Lollk in the Goblin Cave.

It is used to fix the damaged Dwarf multicannon he has set up nearby in the dwarven outpost, south of the Coal Trucks near Baxtorian Falls.

label: Tooth half of key
title: Tooth half of key
lead:
The tooth half of key is an item dropped by any monster that has access to the gem drop table or the rare drop table. It is also a reward from various random events, the gnome restaurant, from Managing Miscellania, caskets, looting magpie implings, and unlocking the crystal chest in Taverley. It can also be found in the Barrows chest as a separate item if the player has 100% rewards potential.

The tooth half of a key is used with a loop half of key to make a crystal key, which is used to unlock the crystal chest, which contains a dragonstone and an assortment of other items.

label: Torch
title: Torch
lead:
An unlit torch may be used with a tinderbox or used on a fire or range to get a lit torch. It is useful for dark tunnels and smoking Hunter traps once lit. 39 Hunter is required to smoke traps. Smoking traps increases the chance of catching a creature by 2% (additive).

Unlit torches are dropped by many cave dwelling creatures including the level 49 and level 76-78 Catablepons, and Cave slimes. They can also sometimes be found inside barrels in the Shaman Caves.

label: Torch (unobtainable item)
title: Torch (unobtainable item)
lead:
A Torch is an unobtainable version of the Lit torch. Torches were previously tradeable and could be turned into banknotes. However, they were made untradeable due to an unfixable bug where trading a lit torch in a dark area would not update the lighting for either player. Any player who had a noted lit torch was given this now discontinued item. Originally, the item was identical to the real lit torch, except being stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Tormented Warrior
title: Tormented Warrior
lead: Tormented Warriors are spearsmen that dwell in the Kharazi Jungle, much akin to the tribespeople located in various other places around Karamja.

label: Torstol
title: Torstol
lead:
Torstol is the highest level herb, which requires level 75 Herblore to clean and yields 15 experience. Torstol can be grown in herb patches at level 85 Farming with a torstol seed.

Obtaining torstol herbs may be difficult as they are only rarely dropped by monsters. They can be obtained by Farming, looting nature implings, or rarely as drops from Zulrah and the Kalphite Queen. They can also be obtained in their grimy form from the Sinister chest, Skotizo, Cerberus, and the Chambers of Xeric. To create a Zamorak brew, you need to add the cleaned herb to a vial of water to create a torstol potion (unf), and then add jangerberries.

label: Torstol potion (unf)
title: Torstol potion (unf)
lead: A torstol potion (unf) is an unfinished potion made by using a torstol on a vial of water, requiring 78 Herblore. Using jangerberries on a torstol potion (unf) with 78 Herblore yields a Zamorak brew(3) and 175 Herblore experience. Using a super attack, super strength, and super defence on a torstol potion (unf) with 90 Herblore yields a super combat potion(4) and 150 Herblore experience. Using an anti-venom(4) on a torstol potion (unf) with 94 Herblore yields an anti-venom+(4) and 125 Herblore experience. Using a demonic tallow on a torstol potion (unf) with 81 Herblore yields a surge potion(3) and 185 Herblore experience.

label: Torture Rack
title: Torture Rack
lead:
Torture racks or simply Racks are scenery found throughout Gielinor. They do not serve any in-game purpose, although they are presumably meant to be used by NPCs for torture.

The rack found in the Troll Stronghold can be used to hide a drunk parrot during the events of Eadgar's Ruse.

label: Tostig
title: Tostig
lead: Tostig is the bartender at The Toad and Chicken pub in Burthorpe. He stocks 12 Asgarnian ale, 12 wizard's mind bomb, and 12 dwarven stout at 2 coins each.

label: Totem
title: Totem
lead:
The totem is a holy relic of the Rantuki Tribe. It is a quest item used only in Tribal Totem. Lord Handelmort of Ardougne had stolen it from the Rantuki Tribe and the player is asked by Kangai Mau, a member of the tribe, to retrieve it.

The player can acquire multiple totems in the quest by using the drop trick.

label: Totem Pole (Kharazi Jungle)
title: Totem Pole (Kharazi Jungle)
lead:
Totem Poles can be found during the Legends' Quest all around the Kharazi Jungle. They have been corrupted by the demon Nezikchened, and must be replaced with a freshly carved Yommi totem during the quest.

When looked at, the totem pole will turn either restored or corrupted depending on whether it has been replaced or not.

label: Totem Pole (Legends' Guild)
title: Totem Pole (Legends' Guild)
lead:
The totem pole can be found in the main hall of the Legends' Guild. It is the scenery version of the gilded totem, which the player receives as a reward during the quest. It can be used to recharge skills necklaces and combat bracelets after the player has completed the Legends' Quest.

Unlike the Fountain of Rune, which charges skills necklaces and combat bracelets with 6 use charges, the totem pole only charges jewellery with 4 uses.

label: Touch paper
title: Touch paper
lead:
Touch paper is a quest item used only in Biohazard. It is obtained from the Chemist in Rimmington after Elena has given the player the testing materials.

It is given to Guidor in south-east Varrock, alongside plague sample, liquid honey, sulphuric broline, and ethenea.

label: Tourist Information Centre
title: Tourist Information Centre
lead: The Tourist Information Centre is located just to the south of the Baxtorian Falls. Hadley is the tourist information officer. The centre is visited during the Waterfall Quest, and the Book on Baxtorian can be found upstairs in a bookcase. Gerald can be found near the river just south of the centre.

label: Tower Advisor
title: Tower Advisor
lead: Tower Advisors are found on the of the Ranging Guild and explain the activity on this floor. Players may attack Tower Archers of varying strengths for no reward. Tower Advisors will exclaim when Tower Archers spawn or are all killed in one adjacent tower.

label: Tower Archer
title: Tower Archer
lead:
Tower archers are located on top of the archer tower in the Ranging Guild. They are aggressive to players of all levels. The archers have an attack range of 11, and players must have an attack range of at least 9 to be able to hit them with Ranged or Magic attacks.

When the archers attack, sometimes an arrow appears underneath where the player is standing. The level 19, 34, 49, and 64 archers drop iron, steel, mithril, and adamant arrows, respectively.

label: Tower guard
title: Tower guard
lead: Located in Yanille, Tower guards are one of the many kinds of guards in Gielinor. Unlike most other guards, these ones cannot be pickpocketed. They are found around the city and some are located in the Watchtower.

label: Tracker gnome 1
title: Tracker gnome 1
lead: The First tracker gnome, known in game as Tracker gnome 1 is a member of the Gnome royal army, sent to obtain the co-ordinates of the Khazard forces headquarters in the Battlefield south of West Ardougne. This tracker can be found behind the largest building of the Khazard stronghold (just across the River Dougne from the Battlefield itself).

label: Tracker gnome 2
title: Tracker gnome 2
lead: The Second tracker gnome, known in game as Tracker gnome 2, is a member of the Gnome royal army, sent to obtain the co-ordinates of the Khazard forces headquarters in the Battlefield south of West Ardougne. He can be found in the building to the north of the Battlefield, where he has been captured, beaten and imprisoned by Khazard's army.

label: Tracker gnome 3
title: Tracker gnome 3
lead: The Third tracker gnome, known in game as Tracker gnome 3 is a member of the Gnome royal army, sent to obtain the co-ordinates of the Khazard forces headquarters on the Battlefield south of West Ardougne. The Third gnome can be found in the south-western corner of the Khazard stronghold, amongst the battle. He is encountered in the Tree Gnome Village quest to get part of the coordinates of the battlefield so the gnomes can fire the ballista. This tracker, however, has been driven mad by the constant and unrelenting fighting, and now only speaks in riddles and frightened gibberish.

label: Tramp
title: Tramp
lead:
The tramp is a poor, penniless human who can be found in south-east Varrock. Upon speaking to him, he will ask the player for money, giving the player options to donate money to him (one coin) or to refuse, resulting in the tramp shouting phrases such as "I hate [player name]!" and "Don't ask [player name] for anything - he's/she's/they're stingy!" This also happens when you don't have any money and explain this to him.

Varrock is also home to Charlie the Tramp, a quest NPC who begins the Shield of Arrav quest by informing the player of the Black Arm Gang. He also asks the player for money, though does not shout anything out when a player refuses to give him money.

label: Translation book
title: Translation book
lead:
The Translation book, or Gnome-English Translation Dictionary, is a book written by Anita. It is obtained during The Grand Tree quest to help players translate what Hazelmere, who only speaks in the Gnomic tongue, is telling them. It is also used to help solve a puzzle later in the quest. During The Eyes of Glouphrie however, players don't need the book to talk to Hazelmere, as he will use magic to communicate with the player instead.

After completing the quest, players can reclaim the book from their bookcase in their player-owned house under the name 'Gnome Translation Dictionary'.

label: Travel cart
title: Travel cart
lead:
The travel cart is a scenery object that is part of the Shilo Village cart system. The carts are run by, and can be found near, Hajedy in Brimhaven, and Vigroy in Shilo Village. Players can utilise the carts to quickly travel to the alternate cart within the system. Boarding the cart will incur a varying fee between 10 to 200 coins, based on the amount of coins the player is carrying. Alternatively, a flat fare can be paid for 200 coins which will skip the dialogue with the cart operators.

The cart system is free to use after a player has completed the Karamja Elite Diary.

label: Trawler (music track)
title: Trawler (music track)
lead: Trawler is a music track that is unlocked while playing Fishing Trawler. The track has a minor key variant.

label: Trawler Minor
title: Trawler Minor
lead: Trawler Minor is a music track that is unlocked while playing Fishing Trawler, upon the Trawler sinking. It can sometimes unlock when the boat is only partially flooded. It is the minor key variant of Trawler.

label: Trawler net
title: Trawler net
lead: Trawler net is found in Port Khazard and can be inspected after completing a game of Fishing Trawler to collect rewards.

label: Treasure Trails
title: Treasure Trails
lead: Treasure Trails is a Distraction and Diversion which involves solving clue scrolls. Clue scrolls contain a number of randomly chosen clues and riddles for the player to solve in steps to eventually find a reward casket, which could contain unique rewards. While the activity is available to free-to-play players, only beginner clues can be found and completed in free-to-play worlds.

label: Treasure! (Treasure Trails)
title: Treasure! (Treasure Trails)
lead: Treasure! (Treasure Trails) is a Jingle that plays when opening the reward casket from a Treasure Trail.

label: tree
title: tree
lead:
Trees are the most common scenery found almost everywhere around Gielinor, and can be chopped down to provide logs and 25 Woodcutting experience.

The most common varieties of regular trees in Gielinor are a double canopy tree with round leaves, and a single canopy with a pointy tip. The single canopy and pine varieties can be used with a knife to fill a bucket of sap from an empty bucket; the double canopy variants do not provide sap. The trees can also be distinguished by their examine text and the icon that appears on the minimap, with the double canopy tree showing a round tree icon ( ), the single canopy variety showing a pointy-tipped icon ( ), and the pine variant showing a pine ( ).

label: Tree (Lost City)
title: Tree (Lost City)
lead: Tree is a unique variant of regular trees that is involved in Lost City. The tree is located north-west of Lumbridge Swamp and can be identified by having the option "Chop" instead of "Chop down" like regular trees. Attempting to chop the tree will cause the leprechaun Shamus to appear, who will tell the player how to access Zanaris.

label: Tree (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
title: Tree (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
lead: The tree in Tree Gnome Stronghold is used during The Grand Tree quest to climb into Glough's watch tower and put the twigs on the pillars. Climbing the tree requires 25 Agility.

label: Tree (Tutorial Island)
title: Tree (Tutorial Island)
lead:
Trees are a type of scenery found on Tutorial Island, which can be chopped down to obtain logs. The types of tree found here have a darker bark than other trees found across most of Gielinor. There are three varieties of regular trees on Tutorial Island: a double canopy tree with round leaves, and a single canopy with a pointy tip, and a dead tree.

Trees can only be cut during the Woodcutting section of the tutorial. Attempting to chop down a tree before this will print the message You cannot cut down this tree yet. You must progress further in the tutorial. After the first gate is passed, further attempts to chop down trees will print the message Perhaps you've done enough woodcutting now. Only the double-canopy variant is found before the gate, so the single canopy and dead variants are impossible to chop down.

label: Tree (young)
title: Tree (young)
lead:
Young trees are a variant of regular trees that have slightly orange bark. They can be chopped at level 1 Woodcutting to obtain regular logs. After the tree is chopped down, it will be replaced by a tree stump for a few seconds before respawning.

The first variant of the young tree is found around the Ratcatchers Mansion and in the unicorn pen at the Ardougne Zoo, while the second variety is only found in the zoo.

label: Tree branch (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
title: Tree branch (Gnome Stronghold Agility Course)
lead: The Tree branch is an Agility obstacle found within the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. An Agility level of one is required to pass the obstacle, which will then grant the player 6.5 Agility experience. It is not possible to fail this obstacle.

label: Tree Gnome Stronghold
title: Tree Gnome Stronghold
lead: The Tree Gnome Stronghold, sometimes shortened to Gnome Stronghold, also called Ta Quir Priw in Gnomish, is one of the largest cities in Gielinor and is populated solely by gnomes. Its most notable features are the Grand Tree, the Gnome Stronghold agility course, the Gnome Ball field and the Stronghold Slayer Cave. As the largest gnome settlement it is considered the capital of the Gnome Empire.

label: Tree Gnome Village
title: Tree Gnome Village
lead: Tree Gnome Village is the first quest in the Gnome quest series and focuses on the war between General Khazard's army and the Tree Gnomes. During the quest, you need to aid the gnomes by retrieving stolen orbs.

label: Tree Gnome Village (location)
title: Tree Gnome Village (location)
lead: The Tree Gnome Village is the home of the gnomes. It is primarily a giant hedge maze, at the centre of which lies a village. To enter the village, follow the Gnome Maze and then squeeze through the loose railing. If you talk to Elkoy, he will take you through the maze saving a bit of time.

label: Tree Gnome Village Dungeon
title: Tree Gnome Village Dungeon
lead:
The Tree Gnome Village Dungeon is found beneath the Tree Gnome Village. Its surface entrance is in the maze just south of the main village area.

The dungeon features in Waterfall Quest, where players visit it to obtain glarial's pebble from Golrie. To reach Golrie, a key must first be obtained from the eastern room, which is inhabited by zombies and giant bats. The key is found in the large crate in the south-east corner that is coloured differently from the rest of the crates. The key can then be used in the western room full of hobgoblins to unlock the door Golrie is imprisoned behind.

label: Tree spirit
title: Tree spirit
lead:
for Tree Spirits utilizing plants. Tree Stumps and other objects can also be used to safe spot them.]]

Tree spirits are monsters which can be found in the Enchanted Valley using the fairy ring code when attempting to cut down a tree (an axe is required). They commonly drop nature rune, rune and adamant axes and various seeds. However, they give reduced experience and as such are mainly a source of early game resources. The tree spirit's combat level varies depending on that of the player's, a minimum of 14, and up to a maximum of level 159.

label: Tree spirit (Lost City)
title: Tree spirit (Lost City)
lead:
The Dramen Tree Spirit only appears in Entrana Dungeon when doing the Lost City quest. Players have to fight it with limited armour and weapons, as it only appears on Entrana.

During the quest, it is also considered a ghost for the purposes of a Slayer task. It can be fought in the Nightmare Zone after the quest is complete, but will not count towards a ghost task.

label: Tree Spirits
title: Tree Spirits
lead: Tree Spirits is a music track that is unlocked west of the entrance to the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

label: Tree stump
title: Tree stump
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a tree after a short amount of time (35.4 - 58.8 seconds). The tree stump has no interaction options.

The basic variety of tree stump is shared by multiple kinds of trees, including:
* Double and single canopy regular trees
* One variety of jungle tree
* The third variant of evergreen
* Double and single canopy trees found in Pest Control
* Double canopy trees found on Tutorial Island
* Regular trees found on The Node

label: Tree stump (dead, weathered)
title: Tree stump (dead, weathered)
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a weathered dead tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a dead tree after a short amount of time. The tree stump has no interaction options.

Strangely, the weathered dead tree stump variant is used when cutting down a maple tree in Miscellania. When a maple tree is cut down anywhere else, a maple tree stump is used instead.

label: Tree stump (dead)
title: Tree stump (dead)
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a dead tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a dead tree after a short amount of time. The tree stump has no interaction options.

There is a different variant of tree stump for each type of dead tree. Strangely, the dark variant dead tree stump is also used when chopping down burnt dead trees, as well as the light variant jungle tree in the dense Kharazi Jungle.

label: Tree stump (Evergreen tree)
title: Tree stump (Evergreen tree)
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when an evergreen tree has been chopped down. The stump will respawn into a tree after a short amount of time, and has no interaction options before regrowing.

This stump variant is shared by the first, second, and fourth variant of evergreen, as well as all three variants of snow covered trees.

label: Tree stump (jungle)
title: Tree stump (jungle)
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when the dark variant of jungle tree in the dense Kharazi Jungle has been chopped down. After the jungle tree is chopped down, the player will automatically walk across the stump. The stump can otherwise not be walked across, and further movement requires chopping another jungle tree.

A stump will respawn into a jungle tree after a short amount of time. The tree stump has no interaction options.

label: Tree Stump (magic)
title: Tree Stump (magic)
lead: A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a magic tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a magic tree after a short amount of time. The tree stump has no interaction options.

label: Tree Stump (maple)
title: Tree Stump (maple)
lead: A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a maple tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a tree after a short amount of time (35.4 seconds). The tree stump has no interaction options.

label: Tree stump (oak)
title: Tree stump (oak)
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when an oak tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a tree after a short amount of time (8.4 seconds). The tree stump has no interaction options.

The regular oak stump is also shared by the variant oak trees found on The Node.

label: Tree Stump (willow)
title: Tree Stump (willow)
lead:
A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a willow tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a tree after a short amount of time (8.4 seconds). The tree stump has no interaction options.

The multi-canopy variants of willow trees all share a single type of stump, while the single-canopy willow has a separate stump model.

label: Tree stump (yew)
title: Tree stump (yew)
lead: A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a yew tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a yew after a short amount of time. The tree stump has no interaction options.

label: Tree stump (young)
title: Tree stump (young)
lead: A tree stump is a type of scenery left on the ground when a young tree has been chopped down. A stump will respawn into a tree after a short amount of time. The tree stump has no interaction options.

label: trellis
title: trellis
lead: The trellis is a wall obstacle on the north wall of the Watchtower building that acts as the ladder up to the Watchtower quest starting point. Level 18 Agility is required to climb the trellis. Doing so will grant the player 31 experience in Agility. It is not possible to climb down the trellis.

label: Tremble
title: Tremble
lead: Tremble is a music track that is unlocked on the Death Plateau.

label: Tribal
title: Tribal
lead:
Tribal is a music track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 1, Jungly 2, Jungly 3, Jungle Troubles, Reggae, Reggae 2 and Tribal 2.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked south-east of Tai Bwo Wannai Village, at the entrance to the Nature Altar.

label: Tribal 2
title: Tribal 2
lead:
Tribal 2 is a music track that is unlocked in the Karamjan Jungle. In this area, the music player will shuffle between playing this track, Jungly 1, Jungly 2, Jungly 3, Jungle Troubles, Reggae, Reggae 2 and Tribal.

In Classic mode, the track is unlocked at the gnome glider on Karamja, and east of Shilo Village.

label: Tribal Background
title: Tribal Background
lead:
Tribal Background is a music track that is unlocked in Tai Bwo Wannai, including the area north of the fenced part of the village.

In an update in 2022, the track got extended to include the area north of Tai Bwo Wannai. After 2024, the Modern mode got an update changing the track's unlock area, whereas Classic mode still plays the track in the area north of Tai Bwo Wannai, as well as in the Pothole Dungeon.

label: Tribal Totem
title: Tribal Totem
lead: Tribal Totem is a quest that involves the retrieval of an artefact sacred to the Rantuki tribe of Karamja, which has been taken from them by the nobleman Lord Handelmort.

label: Tribal Weapon Salesman
title: Tribal Weapon Salesman
lead: The Tribal Weapon Salesman is a shop keeper in the Ranging Guild. His shop is called Authentic Throwing Weapons, which sells javelins and throwing axes of all types, up to rune.

label: Tribesman
title: Tribesman
lead:
Tribesmen are warriors that inhabit the jungles of Karamja. They can be found in various areas around Karamja, notably near Brimhaven around a cauldron and in the Tai Bwo Wannai village. They may also be encountered during the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame when players attempt to cut the jungle bushes. Though their attacks have a fairly low max hit, any successful hit from them will inflict a potent poison, dealing 11 poison damage per hit. As a result, players are advised to bring a form of antipoison when travelling through their areas.

They are not aggressive towards players with a Combat level of 65 or higher, eliminating the need to counteract their poison.

label: Trinity
title: Trinity
lead: Trinity is a music track that is unlocked inside of the Legends' Guild, as well as a small corner just south of Keep Le Faye. It can also be heard in the Legends' Guild dungeon.

label: Trobert
title: Trobert
lead: Trobert is a Black Arm Gang contact players must meet during the Heroes' Quest. He can be found in the building south of the Brimhaven Agility Arena.

label: Troll (historical)
title: Troll (historical)
lead:
The Troll was a former character that appeared in RuneScape 2. It is arguably the most obscure character to have existed since the transition to RuneScape 2, with very little information and no screenshots of the monster surviving.

At least one troll could be found in the Clock Tower Dungeon, locked in one of the jail cells. It had the appearance of a much thinner version of the River troll.

label: Troll arena
title: Troll arena
lead:
The Troll arena is a combat arena used by trolls in the Troll Country.

The arena is on one route to Trollheim and the Troll Stronghold. Players can enter the area during and after the Troll Stronghold quest. The player fights trolls in the arena is in two quests: Troll Stronghold, against Dad, and Troll Romance, against Arrg.

label: Troll Country
title: Troll Country
lead: The Troll Country is a region in north Gielinor. It is a mountainous kingdom controlled mainly by trolls.

label: Troll General
title: Troll General
lead:
Troll generals are huge and powerful trolls that live in the Troll Stronghold, on the top floor.

Troll generals can be very advantageous to kill as a higher-level choice when assigned trolls, as they have a reasonably high drop rate of law and nature runes, as well as high alch drops such as steel platebodies, adamant axes, rune warhammers, and granite shields.

label: troll kitchen
title: troll kitchen
lead:
The troll kitchen is a kitchen located on the middle floor of the Troll Stronghold.

In the middle of the room lies a gigantic cooking pot used by the trolls to prepare their meals, to the north of the room is a caged pen where goats are kept for cooking, the Strongholds prison is used to store humans, the more valued meat by trolls. On the east side of the room there are drawers which contain a hidden key for the Goutweed storeroom.

label: Troll spectator
title: Troll spectator
lead: Troll spectators are trolls found in the Troll arena, where fights with Dad and Arrg take place. They watch instead of fight, just as the name suggests. They may be battled though, and are exactly the same as mountain trolls. They are non-aggressive, but if the player kills Dad, they will immediately attempt to attack the player.

label: Troll Stew
title: Troll Stew
lead: Troll stews can be seen inside cooking pots in the cave during Making Friends with My Arm and in the Troll Stronghold kitchen.

label: Troll Stronghold
title: Troll Stronghold
lead: Troll Stronghold is a quest about gaining access to the Troll Stronghold beneath Mount Trollheim in order to rescue Godric, a soldier from Burthorpe. It is the second quest in the Troll Series.

label: Troll Stronghold (location)
title: Troll Stronghold (location)
lead:
The Troll Stronghold is a stronghold inhabited by mountain trolls in the Troll Country. Notable trolls found inside include Burntmeat, My Arm, Ug and Kob from various quests involving trolls.

The stronghold itself is carved into the side of the mountain that the Mountain Camp is situated on top of.

label: Trollheim
title: Trollheim
lead: Trollheim is a mountain in Old School RuneScape. It is located directly to the east of the entrance to the Troll Stronghold.

label: Troubled
title: Troubled
lead:
Troubled is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the Western Ruins in the Wilderness.

label: Trout
title: Trout
lead:
Trout is a type of fish that restores 7 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw trout on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 15 Cooking and granting 70 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt trout. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Trout is one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 49, or 45 when using the Lumbridge range.

Trout is used as an ingredient in fish pie which requires Cooking level 47 to make. 10 Trout are required during the Death Plateau quest.

label: Trowel
title: Trowel
lead:
The trowel is an item used in the Digsite to dig level 1 and 3 sites. One is also needed in The Dig Site quest to find the Ancient talisman, as well as Another Slice of H.A.M. to dig up ancient goblin artefacts. They can be obtained after clearing the first exam of the quest. Players can get another from examiners if they lose theirs. After the quest, players can also use a trowel to clean Uncleaned finds in the Varrock Museum activity.

Digging grants 6 Mining experience at level 1 sites and 8 Mining experience at level 3 sites. Items you can obtain digging with a trowel are as follows:
*Ancient talisman (in Level 3 dig site during The Dig Site)
*Belt buckle
*Black med helm
*Bones
*Broken armour
*Broken arrow
*Broken staff
*Bronze spear
*Buttons
*Ceramic remains
*Charcoal
*Clay
*Coins
*Damaged armour
*Iron knife
*Leather boots
*Needle
*Old tooth
*Pie dish
*Rusty sword
*Vase

label: Trufitus
title: Trufitus
lead:
Trufitus Shakaya is the shaman of Tai Bwo Wannai Village. He wishes to "commune with the gods", possibly the Karamjan gods, and needs herbs to do so. During Jungle Potion, the player gathers these herbs for him. During Shilo Village, the adventurer brings to him scrolls and other artefacts to have them examined and be given advice on what to do next. He is in the eastern-most house north of Tai Bwo Wannai Village. He appears to be wearing beads of the dead. He seems to be an influential figure on Karamja.

After completion of the Shilo Village quest, players can speak to Trufitus to remove the prompt when entering Shilo Village.

label: Tulips
title: Tulips
lead: Tulips are mainly located around McGrubor's Wood and Yanille, however, there are a few in Rimmington and Tirranwn, north-west of Lletya. Players cannot interact with the tulips, but they can examine them.

label: Tuna
title: Tuna
lead:
Tuna is a type of fish that restores 10 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw tuna on a fire or cooking range, requiring level 30 Cooking and granting 100 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt tuna. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 63 on both ranges and fires.

Tuna is one of the fish required by Caleb in the quest Family Crest.

label: Tunnel entrance (Kalphite Lair)
title: Tunnel entrance (Kalphite Lair)
lead:
The tunnel entrance to the Kalphite Lair in the Kharidian Desert requires a rope to be attached to it until completion of the hard Desert Diary when it becomes permanent. Without the hard Diary, the rope will disappear after 2 minutes.

Note that the rope seen from the inside of the Kalphite Lair is permanent, so leaving the lair is always possible even if the 2 minute timer has expired.

label: Tunnel entrance (Kalphite Queen Lair)
title: Tunnel entrance (Kalphite Queen Lair)
lead:
The tunnel entrance to the Kalphite Queen's lair in the Kalphite Lair requires a rope to be attached to it until completion of the hard Desert Diary when it becomes permanent. Prior to that, the rope will disappear after 2 minutes.

Ironman accounts enter a separate instance that is shared between all ironmen and is totally separate from non-ironman accounts.

label: Turquoise boots
title: Turquoise boots
lead: Turquoise boots can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Turquoise hat
title: Turquoise hat
lead: A turquoise hat can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree. These hats are a slight upgrade from Wizard hats, as Gnome hats have 1 more Magic attack and defence.

label: Turquoise robe bottoms
title: Turquoise robe bottoms
lead: Turquoise robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions. You can find Rometti on the of the Grand Tree, in the north-eastern area.

label: Turquoise robe top
title: Turquoise robe top
lead: A turquoise robe top can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.

label: Tutorial Island
title: Tutorial Island
lead:
Tutorial Island is the starting place for every new Old School RuneScape player character. It is located in the Kingdom of Misthalin, and is connected to The Node just to the south. The island is also the starting location for the Learning the Ropes quest, which all players must complete before they can leave the island.

If players get stuck during the tutorial, the required next action will be hinted at from the controls guide in the top left corner of the game client screen after a short amount of time has passed. The controls guide will also inform them to follow the instructions in the chat box.

label: Tutorial Island bank
title: Tutorial Island bank
lead:
The Tutorial Island bank is the only bank on the Tutorial Island. The bank has three floors: immediately to the left of the booths is a ladder to a vault on the . Slightly behind and to the right of the booths is a ladder to another area on the , which leads to a vault on the .

The Account Guide is also found here.

label: Tutorial Island chapel
title: Tutorial Island chapel
lead: The Tutorial Island chapel is the chapel of Tutorial Island. The chapel has another floor, on which players can find a playable organ.

label: Tutorial Island mine
title: Tutorial Island mine
lead:
The Tutorial Island mine is a mine located in underground Tutorial Island, which is accessible only by new players. It is part of a larger underground area which also includes the combat instructor and giant rats; however, they are separated by a gate.

Inside the mining area of the underground area are copper and tin rocks, a furnace, an anvil, and the Mining instructor, Dezzick, who teaches players how to mine, smelt, and smith.

label: Twig
title: Twig
lead:
Twig is a troll that guards the prison in Troll Stronghold. He appears in the Troll Stronghold quest, and holds the cell key 1, which opens Godric's cell.

Players can pickpocket him for the key if they have level 30 Thieving. He is normally sleeping, and therefore non-aggressive, but if pickpocketing fails, he wakes up and starts fighting.

label: Twig (unused)
title: Twig (unused)
lead: The Twig is an unused NPC that was added to the game files during the RuneScape 2 beta. It was intended to appear during the Waterfall Quest, and the name and examine suggest it would have been seen floating along the Baxtorian Falls. For unknown reasons however, it was never added to the game.

label: Twigs
title: Twigs
lead:
Twigs are quest items used only in The Grand Tree quest. King Narnode Shareen gives all of the twigs to you. When placed on the pillars in Glough's house to spell out "TUZO" ("OPEN" in Ancient Gnomish), the trapdoor in Glough's house with open, and gives access to a secret passage into the roots of the Grand Tree.

There are four separate items, each bound in the shape of a different letter. The player must arrange them in the correct order on the barrels by the trapdoor in order to unlock it. After the quest, the trapdoor remains open, rendering the twigs useless.

label: Twilight
title: Twilight
lead: Twilight is a music track that is unlocked during Elemental Workshop I and plays on the first floor.

label: Ugthanki
title: Ugthanki
lead:
Ugthanki are camels found in the Kharidian Desert, south of Shantay Pass. Ugthanki are the only creatures that drop ugthanki meat, which is used to make ugthanki kebabs.

They are aggressive, so players with low Hitpoints should keep away from them.

label: Ugthanki & onion
title: Ugthanki & onion
lead:
Ugthanki & onion is an intermediate product towards making an ugthanki kebab. It is made by chopping an onion and a piece of cooked Ugthanki meat into a bowl with a knife.

If players add a tomato, this makes kebab mix, which allows players to make an Ugthanki kebab if some pitta bread is added. The pitta bread requires level 58 Cooking, but the rest can be made at level 1.

label: Ugthanki & tomato
title: Ugthanki & tomato
lead:
Ugthanki & tomato is an intermediate product towards making an ugthanki kebab. It is made by chopping a tomato and a piece of cooked Ugthanki meat into a bowl with a knife.

If players add an onion to make kebab mix, they can make an Ugthanki kebab if some pitta bread is added. The pitta bread requires level 58 Cooking, but the rest can be made at level 1.

label: ugthanki kebab
title: ugthanki kebab
lead:
The ugthanki kebab is a type of food which restores 19 Hitpoints. It can be obtained by chopping a tomato, an onion, and a piece of cooked ugthanki meat into a bowl with a knife, then using the resulting kebab mix with a baked pitta bread. Level 58 Cooking is required to make the pitta bread, but the rest may be made at Cooking level 1. There is a chance to fail when creating one with a low Cooking level, instead creating a Ugthanki kebab (bad).

The player will exclaim in contentment if any hitpoints were restored when eaten.

label: Ugthanki kebab (bad)
title: Ugthanki kebab (bad)
lead: A strange-smelling ugthanki kebab is sometimes the result of attempting to make a regular ugthanki kebab with a low Cooking level, similar to how burning food works. It will usually heal nothing when eaten, but sometimes heals for 9. Despite its strange smell, it can still be combined with red hot sauce to create a regular super kebab.

label: Ugthanki meat
title: Ugthanki meat
lead:
Ugthanki meat is a type of food that restores 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw ugthanki meat, granting 40 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt meat. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Ugthanki meat is unusual as despite lacking a cooking requirement, it never stops burning altogether even at level 99. At levels up to 82, the chance to burn this meat is higher on a range than on a fire.

Ugthanki meat is used to make ugthanki kebab which restores 19 hitpoints.

label: Ulizius
title: Ulizius
lead:
Ulizius is a monk who guards the gate into Mort Myre Swamp. You need to start the Nature Spirit for him to let you through the gate into the swamp. When players return through the gate he will exclaim .

It is not known why Drezel or whoever Ulizius reports to would want to guard the entrance to the Mort Myre swamp nor why they would send such a poorly armed and nervous individual to do so. He seems to simply be there to warn players of the dangers of Mort Myre.

label: Ultimate Strength
title: Ultimate Strength
lead:
Ultimate Strength is a prayer unlocked at level 31 Prayer. Ultimate Strength increases the player's Strength by 15%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Strength level, such as Piety.

label: unblessed symbol
title: unblessed symbol
lead:
Unblessed symbols are made by using a ball of wool with an unstrung symbol, granting the player 4 Crafting experience.

Players with a Prayer level of 31 or higher can have their unblessed symbols blessed by Brother Jered in the Edgeville Monastery, turning them into holy symbols.

label: Uncooked apple pie
title: Uncooked apple pie
lead:
An uncooked apple pie is an uncooked food item made by using a cooking apple on a pie shell that has already had pastry dough added to it. Players need at least level 30 Cooking to make it. If successfully cooked, an apple pie provides 130 Cooking experience.

The uncooked pie can be cooked on a range (but not a fire) to make an apple pie. However, there is a risk that the pie will burn and become a burnt pie. Like other pies, apple pies can also be cooked with the Lunar spell Bake Pie without the chance of burning.

label: Uncooked berry pie
title: Uncooked berry pie
lead: An Uncooked berry pie is made by adding Redberries to a Pie shell. Its cooked variant is a redberry pie.

label: Uncooked cake
title: Uncooked cake
lead: Uncooked cake can be made with the Cooking skill by using an egg, a bucket of milk, and a pot of flour with a cake tin. To bake a cake, players must use it on a range with level 40+ Cooking. This will either turn the uncooked cake into a Cake or it will burn the cake (burnt cakes have no use). After cooking the cake, successfully or burnt, the player will receive back their cake tin.
