Later in the quest you will give Drezel either Rune essence or Pure essence in order for him to bless the well and return the holiness of Saradomin to the river Salve.

In the In Aid of the Myreque quest you make the Rod of ivandis and it needs to be blessed by dipping it into the river Salve via the well. In order to do this players MUST HAVE a rope in their inventory.

label: Well of Voyage
title: Well of Voyage
lead:
The Well of Voyage (also known as the Well of the Damned up until starting Regicide) is a well that allows transport between Tirannwn and Kandarin, located in the Underground Pass in Iban's Temple. The player uses the Well of Voyage during Underground Pass to destroy Iban by throwing a doll combined with his blood, shadow, ashes and the crushed bones of a dead dove into it.

It was constructed by the elves in the Second Age as a means of expanding their land, but it was captured and corrupted recently by Iban. King Lathas has his wizards work on repairing the well after completing Underground Pass, and the well becomes usable by the player upon starting Regicide.

label: Well stacked rocks
title: Well stacked rocks
lead: Well stacked rocks are found on Cairn Isle in Karamja. Players can search them to enter the Tomb of Bervirius during the Shilo Village quest.

label: West Ardougne
title: West Ardougne
lead: West Ardougne is the western part of the capital city of Ardougne. Which has been quarantined due to a mysterious plague. It is only available to players who have partially completed the Plague City quest.

label: West Ardougne church
title: West Ardougne church
lead: The West Ardougne church is a Saradominist church in the city of West Ardougne. It is only available to players who have partially completed the Plague City quest.

label: West Ardougne clinic
title: West Ardougne clinic
lead: The West Ardougne clinic is a small clinic run by Nurse Sarah in the city of West Ardougne. It is only available to players who have partially completed the Plague City quest. Players visit the clinic during the elf questline.

label: West Ardougne General Store
title: West Ardougne General Store
lead:
The West Ardougne General Store is run by Chadwell in West Ardougne. It is where most of the city's populace get their food from.

The store sells items that all other general stores sell with the addition of food. The store is convenient for players who wish to go through the Underground Pass, as it carries nearly everything that they will need - a bow, arrows, and two ropes. The only two things the shop is lacking for this are a plank and a spade.

label: West Falador mine
title: West Falador mine
lead:
The West Falador mine is located west of Falador and south of Taverley. The mine features two copper, six tin, three iron, and two coal rocks.

Players needing to bank their ores may walk south-east to a crumbled wall on the borders of Falador, climb over it, and walk a very short distance to the Falador west bank. Players need to have at least level 5 Agility to pass over the crumbled wall. An alternative banking method is heading south of the mine to the gate near the Makeover Mage, and going east and then north to Falador. Either way, this makes the mining site very convenient for players.

label: West Lumbridge Swamp mine
title: West Lumbridge Swamp mine
lead: The West Lumbridge Swamp mine, also known as Lumbridge Swamp (South) West Mine or South-west Lumbridge Swamp Mine, is a mine that may be found in the south-west area of the Lumbridge Swamp. The closest bank from this mine is the Draynor Village bank; walking/running there takes about 1 minute and 10 seconds. Alternatively, a ring of the elements can be used to reach the mine quickly by teleporting to the water altar.

label: Wheat
title: Wheat
lead:
Fields of wheat can be picked to obtain grain, which can then be milled into flour.

Crop circles may appear inside of a wheat fields.

label: Whirlpool (random event)
title: Whirlpool (random event)
lead:
The whirlpool is a discontinued random event. While fishing, there was a chance of the players' fishing spot becoming a whirlpool. If the player continued to fish in the same spot, they would lose their fishing equipment. Like most random events, its purpose was to prevent macroing.

Attempting to fish with Barbarian Fishing caused a dialogue box to come up saying "I'm not putting my hands in there."

label: Whisky
title: Whisky
lead:
Whisky is an alcoholic beverage that heals 5 hitpoints and temporarily increases Strength by 5% + 1 and decreases Attack by 2% + 3. It is also used as an ingredient to make the gnome drink choc saturday. It, along with the other gnome drinks, is often used at player parties or other events.

There are several ways to obtain whisky: it can be bought from Heckel Funch at the of the Grand Tree, from The Asp & Snake Bar in Pollnivneach, from Jossik at the of the Lighthouse, from Atlazora's Rest in Outer Fortis, or from The Flaming Arrow in Civitas illa Fortis. It can also obtained for free by searching Grip's cupboard (while Grip and the guards are dead) in Scarface's mansion from the Heroes' Quest.

label: white apron
title: white apron
lead: A white apron is a piece of clothing that gives no stat bonuses and is largely worn for fashion. It is used in the Pirate's Treasure and Mourning's End Part II quest. A white apron respawns in Gerrant's Fishy Business every 10 ticks, and another spawns in Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim, though players must be wearing a white apron to grab the one in Wydin's Grocery.

label: white bead
title: white bead
lead:
The white bead is a bead used in the Imp Catcher quest. It is a drop from imps and must be returned to Wizard Mizgog in the Wizards' Tower along with a black bead, red bead, and yellow bead to finish the quest.

Beads are used as optional bait in the box catching of imps.

label: White beret
title: White beret
lead:
The white beret is a hat that can be obtained from Easy Treasure Trails. They provide no stat bonuses and are worn purely for cosmetic purposes. There are other variants: the blue beret, black beret and red beret.

The examine text, when translated, reads "Do you speak French?"

label: White berries
title: White berries
lead:
White berries can be harvested from a bush patch after planting whiteberry seeds. They are used in Herblore to make defence potions and super defences.

Adding them to a compost bin makes supercompost, though this is not recommended as watermelons or pineapples are far cheaper and have the same effect.

label: White cog
title: White cog
lead:
The white cog is a quest item used only in Clock Tower. It is found behind a gate that can be opened by adding rat poison to the food trough in the Clock Tower's basement.

It is used to repair the western white clock spindle on the .

label: White flowers
title: White flowers
lead:
White flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds. Players have a 1/1,001 chance of obtaining a white flower when harvesting from a mithril or adamant seed.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: White Knight
title: White Knight
lead:
White knights are found at the White Knights' Castle in Falador. Their helmets' plume colour indicates what combat level they are. The initiates (red plume) are level 36, the proselytes (yellow plume) are level 38, the acolytes (green plume) are level 39, and the partisans (blue plume) are level 42. The partisans can hit up to 7 damage; all the lower classes have a max hit of 6.

If the player has completed Wanted!, killing white knights will act as a penalty toward their White Knight rank.

label: White Knight (Burthorpe)
title: White Knight (Burthorpe)
lead:
Sir Culler Flife is a white knight located just south of Burthorpe, next to the cluster of four rocks. He has a squire named Vicks, who is currently cleaning the White Knights' Castle Crypt.

It is revealed by Vicks that he was sent to keep watch over the Burthorpe Imperial Guard. As such, he is one of only two white knights not located in the White Knights' Castle, the other being Sir Pear Visor.

label: White Knights
title: White Knights
lead:
The White Knights are a Saradominist order of knights based in Asgarnia. They are headquartered at the White Knights' Castle in Falador, where they oversee the kingdom. The Kinshra, aka the Black Knights, have been their greatest rivals since at least the beginning of the Fifth Age.

The Temple Knights are an elite faction of the White Knights, described as being smarter, stronger, and better than the others. Their order may also be much older. During the Wanted! quest, Sir Tiffy Cashien states that the White Knights were founded many centuries ago, though it is unclear how far back this goes, as much of their early history is unknown.

label: White Knights' Castle
title: White Knights' Castle
lead:
The White Knights' Castle is the centre of Falador and base of the White Knights, who are a major political force in Asgarnia and loyal to Saradomin.

If the player has completed Recruitment Drive, they can talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien and make the castle their respawn point.

label: White partyhat
title: White partyhat
lead:
White partyhats are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year.

Previously, they were obtainable during the 2013 Rare Drops event (from 4 July to 14 July) as part of a rare item drop.

label: White Wolf Mountain
title: White Wolf Mountain
lead: The White Wolf Mountain is a natural region in the members-only area. It acts as a mountainous border between Taverley and Catherby, and as a borderline between the kingdoms of Asgarnia and Kandarin. The mountain is notorious for being a dangerous area for low levelled players wishing to travel to Kandarin. The Ice Queen's Lair can be found beneath the mountain, where players can fight the Ice Queen during Heroes' Quest.

label: White Wolf Tunnel
title: White Wolf Tunnel
lead:
White Wolf Tunnel is a shortcut beneath White Wolf Mountain and home to a small group of dwarves. The tunnel only becomes accessible after the player helps the guards Austri and Vestri win the local Fishing Contest at Hemenster, after which it becomes a convenient way to pass White Wolf Mountain while avoiding the aggressive wolves that roam the slopes.

White Wolf Tunnel has a station for the Keldagrim minecart system manned by a cart conductor, which can be used after starting The Giant Dwarf. The tunnel also has a small bar where Holoy runs a crossbow shop.

label: White toy horsey
title: White toy horsey
lead:
White toy horseys are items made as a joke by Jagex, poking fun at the requests made by players to have horses. Toy horseys are obtainable from Diango for 150 coins, and come in 4 different colours: white, black, grey, and brown. They can also be made from a plank on any crafting table in a player-owned house, which requires level 10 or higher Crafting.

When you play with the horsey, an animation showing your character playing with it appears, and your character says

label: White wolf
title: White wolf
lead: White wolves are a type of wolf that can be found primarily atop the White Wolf Mountain, as well as near at The Proudspire and near the Wilderness Agility Course. Its bones can be used with a chisel to create wolfbone arrowtips used to make ogre arrows for use in the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest and Freeing Skrach Uglogwee during Recipe for Disaster. These wolves can also be killed for Slayer tasks.

label: Wig
title: Wig
lead:
The wig is an item used in the Prince Ali Rescue quest. Ned creates it if three balls of wool are given to him. A yellow dye can be used on a grey wig to turn it blonde. The player may ask Ned to create as many as they want.

The wig is one of the necessary items to disguise Prince Ali as Lady Keli, as part of the rescue operation.

label: Wild Isle
title: Wild Isle
lead:
Wild Isle is a music track that can be unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

Prior to an update on 28 April 2021, the track could be unlocked south of Lava Dragon Isle in the Wilderness. However, it can still be heard there if using Classic music mode.

label: Wilderness
title: Wilderness
lead:
The Wilderness, also known as the Wild or Wildy, is a large and dangerous wasteland that makes up most of north-eastern Gielinor.

The entirety of the Wilderness is a PvP area, except for Ferox Enclave, Mage Arena bank, Corporeal Beast's Lair, and King Black Dragon Lair. When the player is killed by another player, all unprotected items will be lost to the killer. Hardcore ironmen will lose their status if they die to a player, just like they would in the event of any other unsafe death.

label: Wilderness (music track)
title: Wilderness (music track)
lead:
Wilderness is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

If using Classic mode, it plays at the Hobgoblin mine, west of Dark Warriors' Fortress, north of Grand Exchange, as well as in Daimon's Crater.

label: Wilderness 2
title: Wilderness 2
lead:
Wilderness 2 is a music track unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

Prior to an update on 28 April 2021, the track could be unlocked south of the Lava Maze and the hint referred "to the south of the Lava Maze in the Wilderness". However, it can still be heard there if using Classic music mode.

label: Wilderness 3
title: Wilderness 3
lead:
Wilderness 3 is a music track unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, it plays at and east of Forgotten Cemetery in the Wilderness.

label: Wilderness Agility Course
title: Wilderness Agility Course
lead:
The Wilderness Agility Course is a training area located deep in the Wilderness, requiring level 52 Agility to enter, and 49 Agility to complete the first obstacle inside. , taking place in a singles-plus combat area that allows player killers to attack at any time, even if you are already in combat with a monster.

The course can be completed either risk-free, or with paid access to the agility dispenser, rewarding the player with valuable loot after each lap. This feature costs 150,000 coins, which is lost every time a player dies or leaves the course, but is not removed if they log out and remain within the course. This money must be deposited from a player's inventory, unlike other Wilderness fees which can be withdrawn from a bank. Even though the coins are not lost when logging out inside the course, doing so will remove 10 laps from the reward lap counter. Lastly, the player must have an open looting bag in their inventory to obtain loot. Looting bags cannot be destroyed within the course.

label: Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon
title: Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon
lead:
The Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon is a small dungeon beneath the Wilderness Agility Course in high level Wilderness. It covers level 53 to 56 Wilderness. The dungeon entrance is a ladder in the north-east corner of the Agility course, which is past the rope swing and before the stepping stones. The dungeon contains eight skeletons and four bone spawns.

Players who fail the rope swing or log balance obstacles will enter the middle or end of the dungeon by falling on spikes, depending on the obstacle failed.

label: Wilderness fence
title: Wilderness fence
lead: The Wilderness fence is a long fence that separates the Wilderness from the members-only "deep Wilderness" above. There are three gates in the fence, two of which are found at level 48 Wilderness, and one found at level 47. Originally a straight line, the fence was extended with the addition of the Wilderness volcano.

label: Willow logs
title: Willow logs
lead:
Willow logs are logs, which can be cut from willow trees using the Woodcutting skill. Cutting willow logs from a willow tree requires an axe and level 30 Woodcutting and grants 67.5 Woodcutting experience per log. Players can burn willow logs using the Firemaking skill and a tinderbox. This requires level 30 Firemaking and grants 90 Firemaking experience per log.

Members may also use the Fletching skill and a knife to carve willow logs into arrow shaft, willow shortbow (u), willow longbow (u), willow shields or willow stocks. This requires levels 30, 35, 40, 42 and 39 Fletching respectively and grants 15, 33.3, 41.5, 83 and 22 experience. However, you need 2 willow logs for the willow shield.

label: Willow longbow
title: Willow longbow
lead:
The willow longbow is a longbow made from willow logs. It requires 20 Ranged to equip and can fire arrows up to mithril. It has a longer attack range than its shortbow counterpart, but has a slower attack speed. It can be purchased from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock.

Willow longbows can be created at level 40 Fletching by using a knife on willow logs to create a willow longbow (u), granting 41.5 experience, and then using a bowstring on the unstrung bow, granting another 41.5 experience.

label: Willow longbow (u)
title: Willow longbow (u)
lead: A willow longbow (u) is made using a knife with willow logs, requiring 40 Fletching and yielding 41.5 Fletching experience. Stringing a willow longbow (u) with a bowstring makes a willow longbow, also requiring 40 Fletching and yielding an additional 41.5 experience.

label: Willow shortbow
title: Willow shortbow
lead:
The willow shortbow is a two-handed ranged weapon stronger than the oak shortbow, but weaker than the maple shortbow. It can use arrows up to mithril. The willow shortbow requires a Ranged level of 20 or higher to wield. Players can purchase this bow from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock.

Members can also make a willow shortbow through the Fletching skill at level 35. First, a player must cut an unstrung willow shortbow from willow logs, granting 33.3 Fletching experience. Then, the player must string the unstrung willow shortbow with a bow string, granting an additional 33.2 experience.

label: Willow shortbow (u)
title: Willow shortbow (u)
lead: A willow shortbow (u) is made using a knife with willow logs, requiring 35 Fletching and yielding 33.3 Fletching experience. Stringing a willow shortbow (u) with a bowstring makes a willow shortbow, also requiring 35 Fletching and yielding an additional 33.3 Fletching experience.

label: Willow tree
title: Willow tree
lead:
A willow tree is a lumber tree requiring level 30 Woodcutting to cut, granting 67.5 Woodcutting experience for each set of willow logs received.

Chopping these trees is arguably one of the best Woodcutting experience for free players. Thus, it is not uncommon to find large quantities of woodcutters on a willow tree in a free-to-play world.

label: Wilough
title: Wilough
lead:
Wilough Fairweather is one of Gertrude's children, the others being Kanel, Philop and Shilop.

During the Gertrude's Cat quest, he tells the player information about Fluffs (Gertrude's cat) in exchange for a bribe. He can be found near Benny.

label: Winch
title: Winch
lead:
A winch is an object found in the digsite which can be used to enter the Digsite Dungeon. While the north-eastern winch in the 'Private dig' section does not require a rope to be operated, the south-western winch in the 'Level 2 digs' section requires players to use a rope on it to climb down. This does not use up the rope, however. The eastern winch

Using this winch gives the player access to a different area depending on the progress in The Dig Site quest. Players who have detonated their explosives to clear out rubble will get access to several silver rocks, as well as a part of the cave containing several Skeleton spawns.

label: Winch (scenery)
title: Winch (scenery)
lead: Winches are decorative interactive scenery found in various locations around Gielinor. Attempting to operate the winch results in the game message It seems the winch is jammed - I can't move it.

label: Winch (Shaman Caves)
title: Winch (Shaman Caves)
lead: A Winch can be found at the end of the Shaman Caves in a room with a large number of barrels. The winch leads to the lower level of the cave system, known as the Viyeldi caves. To operate the winch, the player must first use a rope on it. This only needs to be done the first time, and searching the winch later will cause the rope to appear. During the Legends' Quest the player must drink a bravery potion before they can use the winch to descend to the lower level of the caves. The potion only needs to be drunk once.

label: Winch (The Tourist Trap)
title: Winch (The Tourist Trap)
lead: A winch can be found in the south-western corner of the Desert Mining Camp. During The Tourist Trap quest, players must use the winch to pull up a barrel containing Ana to the surface from the mines below.

label: Winch bucket
title: Winch bucket
lead:
A Winch bucket can be found in the underground portion of the Desert Mining Camp, and is used in The Tourist Trap quest.

During the quest, players must use the winch to smuggle Ana in a barrel out of the Desert Camp's underground portion.

label: Wind Blast
title: Wind Blast
lead:
Wind Blast is an air-based blast spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 41 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

It is the strongest wind spell available to free-to-play players, as well as the most cost-effective blast spell to cast.

label: Wind Bolt
title: Wind Bolt
lead: Wind Bolt is an air-based bolt spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 17 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

label: Wind Strike
title: Wind Strike
lead:
Wind Strike is an air-based strike spell in the standard spellbook available starting at level 1 Magic. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

Wind Strike is the weakest wind spell in the game, as well as the first combat spell players gain access to. It is commonly used by players training Magic via splashing, due to its low rune cost.

label: Wind Wave
title: Wind Wave
lead:
Wind Wave is an air-based wave spell in the standard spellbook, requiring level 62 Magic to cast. As an offensive combat spell it can only be cast on attackable NPCs, or other players in a PvP situation.

It is the second-strongest wind spell in the game, with the strongest being Wind Surge. It is also the most cost-effective wave spell to cast.

label: Wine of Zamorak
title: Wine of Zamorak
lead:
Wine of Zamorak is a secondary ingredient used in Herblore. It can be found on both floors of Asgarnia's Chaos Temple and the Chaos Temple south-west of the Chaos Fanatic in level 38 Wilderness, in which both locations have their wine respawn by default every 30 seconds. It can also be found at the end of the Deep Wilderness Dungeon, where it respawns every 6.6 seconds and is obtained in noted form if players have completed the hard Wilderness Diary. Respawn rates for wines are affected by the amount of players on a world, reducing the time to spawn with more players on a world; Asgarnia's Chaos Temple on high population worlds has an approximate respawn rate of 16 seconds, and Deep Wilderness Dungeon has an approximate respawn rate of every 4.2 seconds.

The wine can also be made by using Zamorak's grapes with a jug of water, requiring Level 65 Cooking and granting 200 Cooking experience.

label: Winelda
title: Winelda
lead: Winelda is a witch found in the Temple of Ikov. She requires a one-time payment of 20 unnoted limpwurt roots. In return, she will allow the player to teleport over the lava an infinite amount of times.

label: Wistan
title: Wistan
lead: Wistan is the owner and only employee of Burthorpe Supplies, a general store located on the east side of Burthorpe.

label: Witch (Lensig)
title: Witch (Lensig)
lead:
Lensig, referred to in-game simply as Witch, is a witch serving the Kinshra order of Black Knights based in the Black Knights' Fortress.

She can be seen in an inaccessible room in the fortress, alongside Greldo, the Black Knight Captain and her black cat. Lensig's name is revealed in the Temple Knight archives concerning Lord Daquarius, accessed through the commorb.

label: Witch (monster)
title: Witch (monster)
lead:
The Witch was a former level 25 monster that resided in Draynor Manor, and a small house south of Al Kharid. They had ten hitpoints, and were very seldom fought by players. Witches used magic, specifically fire strike and weaken, and were not immune to poison.

The two witches were both removed from the game at various points. During the Animal Magnetism quest update, the Draynor Manor witch was secretly switched to a non-attackable NPC called Witch. The witch south of Al Kharid also became non-attackable with the Sorceress's Garden update, as she was turned into the Sorceress.

label: Witch's cat
title: Witch's cat
lead:
The Witch's cat is used in the Underground Pass quest. It must be recovered from the maze of walkways deep inside the dungeon west of West Ardougne and then used as a distraction to allow the player to enter Kardia the witch's house and search a chest to find the Doll of iban.

Before it was possible to take the cat out of the area by grabbing another one and keeping it with you via banking. Dropping it though, it will always run away, essentially disappearing. Should the player manage to get another cat after returning the cat to Kardia and use it on the door, the game will say, "The witch is busy playing with her other cat...".

label: Witch's experiment
title: Witch's experiment
lead:
The witch's experiment is a shapeshifting monster fought near the end of the Witch's House quest. It has four forms that only use melee and must be fought consecutively: a level 19 skavid, a level 30 spider, a level 42 bear and a level 53 wolf, each of which are purple recolours of the respective monsters. Once you have defeated it, you may retrieve the ball.

The experiment is described by Nora T. Hagg in her diary, where it appears to have been akin to a pet for her, as she is both angered and sorrowed at the loss of her precious 'Fritz'.

label: Witch's House
title: Witch's House
lead: Witch's House is a quest involving a boy whose ball had been lost in the garden of an unpleasant local witch, Nora T. Hagg. The adventurer is asked to retrieve it, having to figure out how to proceed in Nora's house along the way.

label: Witch's house (location)
title: Witch's house (location)
lead:
The witch's house is the primary setting of the Witch's House quest and is also visited during Grim Tales. It is located in northern Taverley and belongs to the witch Nora T. Hagg.

During Witch's House, a boy kicked his ball into the garden and the player must enter the house to retrieve it. Entering the house requires the door key, and entering the garden requires placing a magnet on a mouse after luring it with cheese. Before retrieving the ball, the player must fight the Witch's experiment.

label: Witch's Potion
title: Witch's Potion
lead: Witch's Potion is a free-to-play quest where players help the witch Hetty in making a magical potion.

label: Witchaven Dungeon
title: Witchaven Dungeon
lead: The Witchaven Dungeon is a dangerous dungeon in Witchaven that players with low-medium combat levels should not enter without a very good amount of food. The quickest way to get to Witchaven dungeon would be using Ardougne Teleport or the tablet then head east. The other option is to use the fairy ring code and head south. The entire dungeon is single way combat and the dwarf multi-cannon is usable here.

label: Witchaven mine
title: Witchaven mine
lead: The Witchaven (dungeon) mine can be found inside Witchaven Dungeon, where the hellhounds are. The only purpose that the mine serves is for obtaining 'perfect' gold ore, which is used to make Avan's perfect jewellery during the Family Crest quest.

label: Witching
title: Witching
lead:
Witching is a music track that is unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

Prior to an update on 28 April 2021, the track could be unlocked on the eastern edge of level 24-32 Wilderness and the hint referred "on the east side of Wilderness". However, it can still be heard there if using Classic music mode.

label: Wizard
title: Wizard
lead: Wizards are low levelled humans commonly killed for their drops of runes, talismans, and wizard apparel. Their attack resembles Fire Strike, though weaker. As they attack with Magic, it is recommended to wear armour with a Magic defence bonus while fighting them.

label: Wizard (Lost City)
title: Wizard (Lost City)
lead: The Wizard is part of a band of adventurers searching for Zanaris. The Wizard and his three companions, an archer, a monk, and a warrior, can be found in the north-west part of the Lumbridge Swamp, near the Draynor Village bank. He is a part of the Lost City quest.

label: Wizard Akutha
title: Wizard Akutha
lead: Wizard Akutha runs the Rune Store in the Wizards' Guild. The quest, The Hand in the Sand, must be completed to access his store.

label: Wizard blizzard
title: Wizard blizzard
lead:
Wizard blizzard is a drink that can be made at level 18 Cooking, granting 110 Cooking experience. When consumed, the wizard blizzard heals 5 hitpoints and boosts Strength by 6% + 1 levels, but reduces Attack by 2% - 3 levels.

The ingredients for wizard blizzard are: two bottles of vodka, one bottle of gin, one orange, one lime, and one lemon. To make the wizard blizzard, put all of the ingredients into a cocktail shaker, next pour the contents of the cocktail shaker into a cocktail glass. Finally, add pineapple chunks and lime slices.

label: Wizard boots
title: Wizard boots
lead: Wizard boots are magical blue boots. These boots can be obtained from medium Treasure Trails. They require level 20 Magic to wear. They have slightly better stats than mystic boots, but are worse than Infinity boots.

label: Wizard Cromperty
title: Wizard Cromperty
lead:
Wizard Cromperty, located in north-east Ardougne, can teleport you to the Rune essence mine. This is a requirement for the easy Ardougne Diary. He is also involved with the Tribal Totem, One Small Favour and King's Ransom quests. He has a slight problem with the Postal service.

Players can claim 100 pure essence from Wizard Cromperty for free once a day after completing the medium Ardougne Diary, increasing to 150 and 250 after the hard and elite tiers.

label: Wizard Distentor
title: Wizard Distentor
lead: Wizard Distentor is one of the non-player characters who teleports you to the rune essence mine. He is the leader of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. He is also considered by most to be the best NPC for rune essence, as he is positioned closest to a bank; however, players need to have a Magic level of 66 to access this.

label: Wizard Frumscone
title: Wizard Frumscone
lead:
Wizard Frumscone is a wizard found in the basement of the Wizards' Guild, where he summons magical zombies. He is involved in the Swan Song quest, but does not play much of a role, as he sends you to speak to Malignius Mortifer instead. He wears robes similar to wizard robes.

His colleagues at the guild think he is crazy, but he dismisses them as not understanding the power of zombies. 
 .]]

label: Wizard Grayzag
title: Wizard Grayzag
lead:
Wizard Grayzag is a wizard and necromancer on the of the Wizards' Tower, outside the lesser demon cage. He seems to have a grudge against Wizard Mizgog, who stands across the hall from him, as he summoned imps to steal items from Mizgog. During the Imp Catcher quest, the player is tasked with retrieving some of the items the imps have stolen.

When Evil Dave began learning 'demon-summoning', he asked Grayzag for help summoning imps, but ended up summoning an even lower level of demon: Hell-Rats.

label: Wizard hat
title: Wizard hat
lead:
A black wizard hat is an item of clothing that can be worn in the head slot. It has the same bonuses as the blue wizard hat. It can be purchased from Betty's Magic Emporium in Port Sarim, and can be found as a drop from the dark wizards south of Varrock.

It can be created by using black dye on a blue wizard hat; similarly, blue dye can be used on it to create a blue wizard hat.

label: Wizard Mizgog
title: Wizard Mizgog
lead:
Wizard Mizgog is a stuttering and clumsy wizard found on the of the Wizards' Tower and the start point of the Imp Catcher quest. After the quest he will trade a complete set of imp beads to players for another amulet of accuracy.

He seems to be rivals with Wizard Grayzag, who is across the hall. A keeper of magical trinkets, he is often bullied by Wizard Grayzag, a devotee of slightly 'grander' and more destructive magics. Trying to keep to himself won't work as across the hall, Grayzag is always plotting another nefarious scheme against him. When asked whether he could teach the player "any interesting spells", a surprised Mizgog will reply that he does not think so, as he says, "The type of magic I study requires years of meditation and research."

label: Wizard Traiborn
title: Wizard Traiborn
lead: Wizard Traiborn is a peculiar wizard who resides on the of the Wizards' Tower. He often addresses people as "thingummywuts" and claims to see these indescribable creatures everywhere, claiming they cause minor havoc in the tower. Despite these seemingly mad theories and his goofy look, Traiborn is one of the Senior Wizards of the tower and possesses considerable magical skill. He is involved in the Recipe for Disaster, Demon Slayer, and Temple of the Eye quests.

label: wizard's mind bomb
title: wizard's mind bomb
lead:
The wizard's mind bomb is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Magic by +2 (+3 if level 50+ Magic) while draining Attack, Strength and Defence by \lfloor Level \times 0.05\rfloor + 1 (see table below). It can be obtained through brewing at level 34 Cooking, granting 314 experience per batch. It is brewed using 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, 4 yanillian hops, and a pot of ale yeast. It can also be bought from several shops.

The stronger, mature version of the ale is the mature wmb.

label: Wizards' Guild
title: Wizards' Guild
lead: The Wizards' Guild, located in Yanille, contains a number of useful resources for those interested in Magic. You must have level 66 Magic to enter. Boosts, such as a wizard's mind bomb at level 63, can be used to enter. Entering the Wizards' Guild is a task in the Hard Ardougne Diary.

label: Wizards' Tower
title: Wizards' Tower
lead: The Wizards' Tower is located south of Draynor Village, over a bridge. The tower plays a part in many quests.

label: Wizards' Tower Portal
title: Wizards' Tower Portal
lead: The Wizards' Tower portal is one of the three teleportation portals found on the top floor of the Wizards' Guild. Located on the eastern wall of the guild, entering the portal will teleport the player to Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village.

label: Woad leaf
title: Woad leaf
lead:
Woad leaves can be harvested from a flower patch after planting woad seeds. They are used to make blue dye and, by extension, green and purple dye. Players must take two woad leaves and to Aggie to make blue dye, which is enough to dye one item.

They can either be grown through Farming or bought from Wyson the gardener in Falador Park. Offering him 20 coins provides the best value since he actually gives two for being so generous. Adding them to a compost bin makes regular compost.

label: wolf
title: wolf
lead:
Wolves are canine monsters that can be found in various places around Gielinor. They have a variety of different combat levels, with level 64 wolves being the most common, and level 11 and 14 wolves only being found in the Stronghold of Security.

Their bones can be used with a chisel to create wolfbone arrowtips used to make ogre arrows, which are necessary for completing Big Chompy Bird Hunting and Freeing Skrach Uglogwee during Recipe for Disaster.

label: Wolf bones
title: Wolf bones
lead:
Wolf bones are an item obtained by killing a wolf or werewolf. Wolf bones have various uses, including in skills (such as Prayer, Fletching, Crafting) and in some quests.

Wolf bones look very similar to regular bones, except wolf bones are slightly more greyish in colour.

label: Wolfbane
title: Wolfbane
lead:
Wolfbane is a dagger given as a quest item reward in Priest in Peril. It is obtained from Drezel after completion of the quest.

It is used to keep the citizens of Canifis from transforming into werewolves when the player attacks them. As a silver item, it can also be used against tier 1 Vampyres. It has the same bonuses as a mithril dagger except it also gives a prayer bonus. Wolfbane cannot be poisoned. It can be reclaimed by talking to Drezel in the dungeon below Paterdomus; players are only allowed to own one at a time but more can be obtained with the drop trick.

label: Wolfbone arrowtips
title: Wolfbone arrowtips
lead:
Wolfbone arrowtips are used as to create the ogre arrows used in the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. Players must partially complete Big Chompy Bird Hunting in order to fletch the arrowtips. They require level 5 in Fletching to make. Using a chisel with wolf bones will result in 2-6 arrowheads and gives 2.5 Fletching and Crafting experience per arrowtip. The amount of arrowtips carved out of each wolf bone is random, and is not influenced by Fletching or Crafting level.

Use these on some flighted ogre arrows to create completed ogre arrows.

label: Wolfman
title: Wolfman
lead:
Wolfmen were monsters formerly found in Canifis. They would appear if players attacked one of the men of Canifis without wielding a wolfbane dagger.

In 2007, werewolves were graphically updated. The men were replaced by new named citizens, while the Wolfmen were replaced by werewolves. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Wolfwoman
title: Wolfwoman
lead:
Wolfwomen were monsters formerly found in Canifis. They would appear if players attacked one of the women of Canifis without wielding a wolfbane dagger.

In 2007, werewolves were graphically updated. The women were replaced by new named citizens, while the Wolfwomen were replaced by werewolves. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Woman
title: Woman
lead:
Women are generic NPC civilians of Gielinor, particularly common in human-dwelling towns such as Lumbridge, Falador, among other settlements. They are also less commonly found outside of towns, and in remote places.

Women can be pickpocketed by members at level 1 Thieving, yielding 8 experience points.

label: Woman (Canifis)
title: Woman (Canifis)
lead:
Women were formerly the citizens of Canifis. If players were not wielding a wolfbane dagger when attacking them, they would turn into wolfwomen.

In 2007, werewolves were graphically updated. The women were replaced by new named citizens, while the Wolfwomen were replaced by werewolves. As a result, they have never been present in Old School RuneScape.

label: Woman (East Ardougne)
title: Woman (East Ardougne)
lead: A unique type of woman wearing a tan dress can be found in East Ardougne, one in a house with Ross and one upstairs in the Flying Horse Inn. They can be pickpocketed and fought like normal, but unlike regular women, they only drop bones.

label: Woman (West Ardougne)
title: Woman (West Ardougne)
lead:
Women are citizens of West Ardougne. They are similar to women found throughout Gielinor, but can only be attacked and talked to, and not pickpocketed. Their appearance is slightly different, in keeping with the theme of West Ardougne supposedly being afflicted with a plague, and their dialogue is slightly different, reflecting their plight under Mourner rule.

They are often seen near the civilians and children. As they are exclusively found in West Ardougne, they are also members-only NPCs.

label: Wonder
title: Wonder
lead:
Wonder is a music track that unlocks in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon and Charred Island.

In Classic mode, the track plays north of Goblin Village in the Wilderness.

label: Wonderous
title: Wonderous
lead: Wonderous is a music track that is unlocked near the north of East Ardougne.

label: Woodcutting
title: Woodcutting
lead:
Woodcutting is a gathering skill that primarily involves chopping trees to obtain logs used in the Fletching, Firemaking, and Construction skills. Players with a higher Woodcutting level can chop down new types of trees and cut down trees quicker, especially as higher levels of axes become available.

Woodcutting is a useful skill for a low-levelled player to make money early in the game. On the map, locations of rare trees can be located with a tree icon.

label: Woodcutting Level Up!
title: Woodcutting Level Up!
lead: Woodcutting Level Up! is a jingle for levelling Woodcutting.

label: Woodcutting Level Up! (Unlocks)
title: Woodcutting Level Up! (Unlocks)
lead: Woodcutting Level Up! (Unlocks) is a jingle for levelling Woodcutting.

label: Wooden cart (The Tourist Trap)
title: Wooden cart (The Tourist Trap)
lead: A wooden cart being pulled by the Cart Camel can be found in the centre of the Desert Mining Camp. During The Tourist Trap quest, players must use the wooden cart to smuggle Ana, who is in a barrel, out of the camp by complimenting and convincing the mine cart driver to leave.

label: Wooden defence
title: Wooden defence
lead: The wooden defence is a piece of scenery that looks like a wood pallet held up at an angle to protect from projectiles. They're very common in the Tree Gnome Stronghold and the Battlefield, possibly because they're big enough to shelter a gnome.

label: Wooden shield
title: Wooden shield
lead:
A wooden shield is the weakest shield available, but one of a small group with no Attack or defence penalties to any form of combat. It is round in shape, and while all warriors should quickly progress to something better (such as an iron kiteshield, which can also be equipped at 1 Defence), it is better than nothing for magic users, since it has no penalties. It can be purchased from Cassie's Shield Shop in Falador, found north of the Varrock city wall as a respawn, and one is given free on Tutorial Island.

Its combat stats are equal to the training shield but worse than the anti-dragon shield. The training shield also weighs approximately twice as much.

label: Wool
title: Wool
lead:
Wool is gathered from sheep and alpacas using shears. It can be spun at a spinning wheel to be made into a ball of wool for 2.5 Crafting experience. Wool cannot be obtained from rams or penguin sheep. In free-to-play, the best method of collecting wool is by shearing sheep north of Lumbridge, then going to Lumbridge Castle to bank on the .

Alternatively, members can shear sheep behind Watson's house, spin it inside his house, and then bank it at the Hosidius Kitchen for a similar distance.

label: Workbench (Elemental Workshop)
title: Workbench (Elemental Workshop)
lead:
The workbench is used during and after the quests Elemental Workshop and Elemental Workshop II. They are used to smith elemental shields during and after the first quest and elemental helmets, mind shields, mind helmets and crane claws during and after the second quest.

In order to use one of these, the player must have either a slashed or battered book, elemental or mind bars, and a hammer. Other bars cannot be smithed on a workbench.

label: Workbench (scenery)
title: Workbench (scenery)
lead: A Workbench can be found in several places across Gielinor. Players cannot interact with the workbenches. When an item is used on the workbench, the message "The table appears to be in use." appears in the chatbox, signifying that the workbench cannot be used as a table.

label: Workshop (music track)
title: Workshop (music track)
lead:
Workshop is a music track that can be unlocked inside Falador city walls. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Arrival and Fanfare.

In Classic mode, the track plays in eastern Falador.

label: Worm (unobtainable item)
title: Worm (unobtainable item)
lead: A Worm is an unobtainable item seen when conversing with a Gnome child. When talking to a gnome child, they have a chance of offering you a snack, which displays a picture of this item in the chatbox. Although the "Worm" item is shown, King worms are obtained instead.

label: Worm batta
title: Worm batta
lead:
A worm batta is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 12 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade w'm battas are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 120 coins, with 3 in stock. They are also dropped by tortoises.

Members can make a worm batta via gnome cooking with 27 Cooking, yielding 154 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Worm crunchies
title: Worm crunchies
lead:
Worm crunchies are a food that players consume in one bite, healing 8 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade w'm crun' are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 85 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make worm crunchies via gnome cooking with 14 Cooking, yielding 104 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Worm hole
title: Worm hole
lead:
A worm hole is a food that players consume in one bite, healing 12 hitpoints. Players may need to make one as part of Training part I for the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Premade worm holes are sold by gnome waiters in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree for 150 coins, with 3 in stock.

Members can make a worm hole via gnome cooking with 30 Cooking, yielding 170 experience. Like all gnome foods, they stop burning at Cooking level 38.

label: Wormbrain
title: Wormbrain
lead: Wormbrain is a goblin in Port Sarim jail that the player must barter with, paying coins, or attack for Lozar's map part of the Crandor map during the Dragon Slayer I quest. Lowering his Hitpoints to 0 causes him to say, "Ow!", and drop the map part, which Telekinetic Grab must be used on to acquire.

label: Wrapped oomlie
title: Wrapped oomlie
lead:
Wrapped oomlies are uncooked food made from the raw oomlie and a palm leaf. If cooked, it creates a cooked oomlie wrap.

Wrapped oomlies can be cooked with a Cooking level of 50 or higher, granting 30 Cooking experience.

label: Wrought iron key
title: Wrought iron key
lead:
The Wrought iron key is a reward from the Tourist Trap quest. It opens a door deep inside the Desert mining camp and allows passage to a special mining area inside. If you lose it, it can be replaced by searching one of the tables in the building located inside the Desert Mining Camp.

This key allows access to the north-western most tunnel (after riding the cart underground) that has several higher rocks for mining including adamantite ore and mithril ore bearing rocks.

label: Wydin
title: Wydin
lead:
Wydin is the owner of Food Store in Port Sarim. He sells a variety of fresh food. Wydin also plays a small part in the Pirate's Treasure quest; players must retrieve smuggled rum from a crate in his storeroom. To enter the storeroom players must be both an employee of Wydin's store, and wearing a white apron. There is an apron located in the storeroom, but it cannot be telegrabbed as there is a solid wall in the way. However, there is also an apron hanging in the nearby Gerrant's Fishy Business directly north.

It is suggested that Wydin lives in the store, as there is a bed on the , above the .

label: Wyson the gardener
title: Wyson the gardener
lead:
Wyson the gardener is a gardener in the Falador Park. You can buy woad leaves from him, which you can give to Aggie in Draynor Village to make blue dye.

Wyson will send players off to kill the Giant Mole underneath the park. He will take players' mole skins and mole claws in exchange for bird nests which may contain seeds or jewellery, with a higher chance of containing high-level allotment and herb seeds than other nests. Players will receive nest boxes when exchanging noted mole parts.

label: Yanille
title: Yanille
lead: Yanille (pronounced "ya-NEEL") is a members-only city south of Ardougne, known for hosting Wizards' Guild. Due to the threat of ogres from nearby Gu'Tanoth, the city is surrounded by tall walls, and is heavily patrolled by guards.

label: Yanille Agility Dungeon
title: Yanille Agility Dungeon
lead:
The Yanille Agility Dungeon (also known as Yanille Dungeon) is the dungeon under the town of Yanille. Part of the dungeon can be entered by players with any Agility level, while other parts have minimum Agility requirements.

The experience rewards for using this dungeon are not as good as most other Agility courses, so players rarely come here to train Agility. Instead, players use it to train combat skills using the monsters there and gather their drops. Players training Herblore also use the dungeon, since many monsters here sometimes drop high-level herbs. Torstol, a fairly rare herb, can be obtained here.

label: Yanille bank
title: Yanille bank
lead: The Yanille bank is the only bank in the city of Yanille. There is a Deadman chest in the bank.

label: Yanille Chain
title: Yanille Chain
lead:
The Yanille Chain is a series of islands to the east of Yanille where Hazelmere the gnome lives. His house is on the southern end of the easternmost island in this small chain. The gnome can be found on the top floor of his house.

There are several Jungle spiders that reside in the small chain.

label: Yanni Salika
title: Yanni Salika
lead:
Yanni Salika owns the antique store in Shilo Village, and is also the starting point for the One Small Favour quest. He is located north of the river. Yanni will buy many non-tradeable items that are made or gathered during quests, but are of no use after the quest has been completed.

After the completion of Shilo Village, he will buy the Tattered scroll, Crumpled scroll, Bervirius notes, Bone key, Stone-plaque, Locating crystal, and Beads of the dead. After the completion of Zogre Flesh Eaters, he will buy the Black prism.

label: Ye olde Tea Shoppe.
title: Ye olde Tea Shoppe.
lead:
Ye olde Tea Shoppe is a Tea stall located in south-eastern Varrock, next to the city wall. The shop is owned by the tea seller. The player can either buy tea from the shop or steal it with a Thieving level of 5, granting 16 experience. It takes roughly four seconds for the stall to reset and one second to steal. Without the need to empty one's inventory, one could gain up to 11,520 Thieving experience per hour, but as it takes about 20 seconds to run to bank and return, the maximum experience per hour is around 10,000.

There is a cup of tea on the bench nearby, but it cannot be taken because it is apparently just for display.

label: Yellow bead
title: Yellow bead
lead:
The Yellow bead is a bead used in the Imp Catcher quest. It is returned to Wizard Mizgog in the Wizards' Tower along with a black bead, a white bead and a red bead to finish the quest. It can be obtained by killing imps.

The bead can also be used to bait traps when hunting imps.

label: Yellow boots
title: Yellow boots
lead:
Yellow boots can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The boots come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. They give the same stats as leather boots.

Unlike leather boots, these cannot be crafted. Because of their stats, they are mostly worn for cosmetic purposes.

label: Yellow cape
title: Yellow cape
lead: A yellow cape can be made by using yellow dye on another coloured cape and can be purchased from Barkers' Haberdashery in Canifis, Fancy Clothes Store in the Varrock, or Shayzien Styles in Shayzien.

label: Yellow door
title: Yellow door
lead: The Yellow doors are located on the of Melzar's Maze. They must be opened during Dragon Slayer I, using a yellow key obtained from killing the nearby Skeleton with a round shield.

label: Yellow dye
title: Yellow dye
lead: Yellow dye is a dye that can be created by taking 2 onions and 5 coins to Aggie in Draynor Village, or 2 onions and 25 coins if taken to Ali the dyer in Pollnivneach. It can also be bought in Lletya from Oronwen for 6 coins. It can also be found in the farmhouse featured in Getting Ahead, south of the Farming Guild, located in the shelves next to the stairs in the house. Yellow dye can be combined with red dye to create orange dye, and with blue dye to create green dye. It can be used to dye normal capes yellow.

label: Yellow flowers
title: Yellow flowers
lead:
Yellow flowers are a type of flower that can be harvested after planting mithril or adamant seeds.

When planting the seeds, players have an option to either pick the flowers (and obtaining a random coloured flower) or leave them planted on the ground. A player only has one chance to pick their flowers; if they refuse to do so, they will not get the option again unless they plant another seed. Flowers that are left on the ground will stay there temporarily for around 5 minutes.

label: Yellow gloves
title: Yellow gloves
lead:
Yellow gloves can be purchased in Canifis from Barker at his store, Barker's Haberdashery, and are also dropped by Crawling Hands. The gloves come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple. These gloves are often worn to match certain armour sets, such as gold-trimmed and god armour sets.

Their defence bonus is equal to that of leather gloves.

label: Yellow hat
title: Yellow hat
lead: Yellow hats can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The hats come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Yellow partyhat
title: Yellow partyhat
lead:
Yellow partyhats are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the Christmas holiday events that occur once per year.

Previously, they were obtainable during the 2013 Rare Drops event (from 4 July to 14 July) as part of a rare item drop.

label: Yellow robe bottoms
title: Yellow robe bottoms
lead: Yellow robe bottoms can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe bottoms come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Yellow robe top
title: Yellow robe top
lead: Yellow robe tops can be purchased in Canifis from Barker in his store, Barkers' Haberdashery. The robe tops come in five different colours: grey, red, yellow, teal, and purple.

label: Yellow Sheep
title: Yellow Sheep
lead:
Yellow Sheep are sick sheep found near the East Ardougne north bank that must be prodded with the cattleprod to the sheep pen and fed the poisoned sheep feed during the Sheep Herder quest. Its wool is slightly yellow. Once killed, it drops the sheep bones (4).

After Mourning's End Part I, the sheep are of a darker yellow as a result of the player dyeing them with a Fixed device loaded with a Yellow toad. Once dyed, they can no longer be prodded or interacted with in any way. Luckily, players only need to dye one and all the sheep of the same colour turn dark. This is how players can tell they haven't missed the sheep during the quest.

label: Yes
title: Yes
lead:
Yes is the first listed emote. Upon use the player nods their head up and down.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Yesteryear
title: Yesteryear
lead:
Yesteryear is a music track that is unlocked when the player first arrives in Lumbridge. It can also be heard around the Lumbridge Swamp and farmlands. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Autumn Voyage, Book of Spells, Dream, Flute Salad, and Harmony.

In Classic mode, the track plays in the eastern part of Lumbridge swamp.

label: Yeti
title: Yeti
lead:
The Yeti was a Runescape 2 beta monster that would have been found in the ice lands, as a Behind the Scenes article from March 2004 promised that one of the upcoming updates would be "A large 'frozen lands' area including penguins, mammoths, polar bears and more."

For unknown reasons the Yeti was never released, but its model was reused for King Vargas, who is revealed to have been transformed into a Yeti.

label: yew logs
title: yew logs
lead:
Yew logs are logs obtained from cutting yew trees, which require at least level 60 Woodcutting for players to cut. They give 175 experience when cut with an axe. Players can burn these logs with the Firemaking skill at level 60, granting 202.5 Firemaking experience.

Yew logs can also be made into bows, stock, and arrow shafts using the Fletching skill. When the log is cut into a yew longbow (u) at level 70, it yields 75 experience. Cutting a yew shortbow (u) at level 65 will give 67.5 experience. Stringing the unstrung bows will give the same experience as for cutting them.

label: yew longbow
title: yew longbow
lead:
The yew longbow is a longbow stronger than the maple longbow that can use arrows up to rune. The yew longbow requires a Ranged level of 40 or higher to wield.

Players can make a yew longbow through the Fletching skill at level 70. First, a player must cut a yew longbow (u) from yew logs, giving 75 Fletching experience. The unstrung bow is then strung with a bow string, for an additional 75 experience for a total of 150 experience a log. It can also be obtained as a very rare drop from a young impling.

label: Yew longbow (u)
title: Yew longbow (u)
lead: A yew longbow (u) is made using a knife with yew logs, requiring 70 Fletching and yielding 75 Fletching experience. Stringing a yew longbow (u) with a bowstring makes a yew longbow, also requiring 70 Fletching and yielding an additional 75 Fletching experience.

label: yew shortbow
title: yew shortbow
lead:
A yew shortbow is a two-handed ranged weapon stronger than the maple shortbow but weaker than the magic shortbow. It can be made with a Fletching level of 65 by using a yew shortbow (u) on some bow string, granting 67.5 experience when made, or 135 total experience when making one from scratch.

Fletching a yew shortbow from yew logs and a bow string will profit while fletching a yew shortbow from a yew shortbow (u) and a bow string will profit .

label: Yew shortbow (u)
title: Yew shortbow (u)
lead: A yew shortbow (u) is made using a knife with yew logs, requiring 65 Fletching and yielding 67.5 Fletching experience. Stringing a yew shortbow (u) with a bowstring makes a yew shortbow, also requiring 65 Fletching and yielding an additional 67.5 Fletching experience.

label: Yew tree
title: Yew tree
lead: A yew tree is a high level lumber tree requiring level 60 Woodcutting to chop, providing 175 experience per set of yew logs received. They are mostly used for Woodcutting to gather yew logs used in Fletching or Firemaking, but also play a role in Farming. Due to the use of yew logs for fletching yew longbows, which are commonly used with the High Alchemy spell, yew logs are extremely popular and constantly in demand. Cutting yew logs is a common moneymaker for free-to-play.

label: Yohnus
title: Yohnus
lead:
Yohnus owns the blacksmith in Shilo Village. Inside of his blacksmith contains the closest furnace to a bank in the entire game, which requires 20 coins per smelt to use, unless the player has completed the Karamja Elite Diary.

After completion of the Karamja Elite Diary, money can no longer be deposited into his coffer, only withdrawn.

label: Yommi totem
title: Yommi totem
lead:
The yommi totem is a quest item used during the Legends' Quest to replace the evil totem in the centre of the Kharazi Jungle. It may be cut from a yommi tree, grown from yommi tree seeds in the fertile soil just north-west of the pool of pure water.

Players must be quick in producing the yommi totem in order to prevent the tree from rotting. If the tree does rot, players may ask Ungadulu for more seeds to restart the production process.

label: Yommi tree
title: Yommi tree
lead:
The Yommi tree is a tree grown during Legends' Quest in the Kharazi Jungle. It is grown from Yommi tree seeds and then chopped down and carved to create the Yommi totem.

The tree progresses through 3 growth stages. The tree starts out as a baby, then grows to a sapling, and finally an adult. Once grown, it can be felled, then trimmed, and finally carved into a liftable totem. The tree may also die or become rotten if it is not quickly carved and "lifted-up" (picked-up).

label: Yommi tree seeds
title: Yommi tree seeds
lead:
Yommi tree seeds are a quest item used during the Legends' Quest. They are given to the player by Ungadulu after freeing him. The seeds must first be germinated in holy water before they can be grown into a Yommi tree, and to do this the player must perform a number of tasks in an underground dungeon.

It is possible to be unsuccessful when planting the seed, prompting the following message: "You planted the seed incorrectly in the fertile soil". The chance of this happening is dependent on the player's Herblore level. . Once the tree has grown the player can cut a Yommi totem from it. Three seeds are obtained from Ungadulu at a time. If the seeds are lost or planted incorrectly, one can ask Ungadulu for three more. The seeds require level 45 Herblore to plant. The tree grows at an amazing rate, but can be cut only with a rune axe, and must be cut quickly so as to prevent it from getting rotten.

label: You Are Dead!
title: You Are Dead!
lead: You Are Dead! is a Jingle that plays when the player dies.

label: You Are Victorious! (Emir's Arena)
title: You Are Victorious! (Emir's Arena)
lead: You Are Victorious! (Emir's Arena) is a Jingle that plays when winning a match in the Emir's Arena.

label: Zadimus corpse
title: Zadimus corpse
lead:
The Zadimus corpse is a quest item that is obtained during the Shilo Village quest by searching an ancient gallows in the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. The corpse must be given to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai village. Afterward, it must be buried next to the Tribal Statue in the middle of Tai Bwo Wannai. The Spirit of Zadimus then appears and gives the player the key to Rashiliyia's tomb.

Though it cannot be dropped, the Zadimus corpse can be lost upon death or alchemised using Magic (albeit for 0 coins). Simply search the gallows again to reclaim it.

label: Zaff
title: Zaff
lead:
Zaff is a salesman who owns Zaff's Superior Staves in the city of Varrock. He is located in his shop just north-west of Varrock centre. His shop is often visited because it is one of the few places that sells battlestaves, the other being Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle. He is also involved in the What Lies Below quest. During the quest, players can summon him by using a beacon ring and Zaff's instructions.

Zaff is secretly a member of the Varrock Palace Secret Guard (likely accounting for his shop's proximity to it), known to Rat Burgiss, and it appears his proficiency at magic is far higher than many would presume, as it was he who possessed the Beacon and used a spell to counter Surok's mind control spell, disabling Surok's teleportation magic and imprisoning him in the library.

label: Zaff's Superior Staffs!
title: Zaff's Superior Staffs!
lead: Zaff's Superior Staffs is a staff shop located near central Varrock, owned by Zaff. It is the main source of battlestaves and of elemental staves for free players.

label: Zahwa
title: Zahwa
lead:
Zahwa is an injured fighter at the Emir's Arena. He has tattered brown clothes and has several injuries, such as cut shins, some sort of eye injury, and outgrown, unkempt hair.

He, along with several other NPCs at the Emir's Arena, serves no distinct purpose other than to represent wounded fighters after participating in several battles.

label: Zamorak brew
title: Zamorak brew
lead:
A Zamorak brew is a potion made by using jangerberries on a torstol potion (unf), requiring 78 Herblore, yielding a Zamorak brew(3) and 175 Herblore experience. A dose of Zamorak brew provides a temporary skill boost to Attack equal to 2 + 20% of the player's base Attack level, rounded down, and Strength equal to 2 + 12% of the player's base Strength level, rounded down. It temporarily lowers Defence equal to 2 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down, and current Hitpoints by 12%, rounded down, though it will not lower a player's Hitpoints below the minimum of 1. Additionally, 10% of the player's current Prayer level is restored as Prayer points. When used in conjunction with a Saradomin brew, Attack and Defence will be boosted, Prayer and Health will be restored (possibly boosted by the brew), Ranged and Magic will be lowered.

Restore potions are frequently used with Zamorak brews to raise lowered Defence. A super strength potion will always boost Strength level higher than a Zamorak brew; however, the Zamorak brew's Attack boost is slightly better than a super attack potion. At levels 85, 86, 90-93, and 95-99, the Zamorak brew will give a boost of 2 levels more than a Super attack potion. You can also use a super strength potion or a dragon battleaxe special attack before you sip a dose to increase your Strength level to the max.

label: Zamorak cape
title: Zamorak cape
lead:
The Zamorak cape is a reward from Mage Arena I miniquest. To receive the cape, the player must defeat Kolodion in his four guises, then speak to him, step through the nearby sparkling pool, and finally pray at the Statue of Zamorak. Upon praying at the statue, the Zamorak cape will appear next to the player and can be picked up.

The Zamorak cape and the Zamorak staff are required to benefit from the Charge spell, which enables the player to hit up to 50% more damage with the Flames of Zamorak spell.

label: Zamorak full helm
title: Zamorak full helm
lead:
Zamorak full helm is a decorated rune full helm that is affiliated with the god Zamorak. Sharing the same stats as the rune full helm except for a prayer bonus, the Zamorak full helm also looks visually similar. Its appearance differs in that the helm features an ornamental red plume instead of the typical purple plume.

The full helm requires 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Zamorak kiteshield
title: Zamorak kiteshield
lead:
The Zamorak kiteshield is a decorated rune kiteshield that is affiliated with the god Zamorak. Sharing the same stats as the rune kiteshield except for the ranged attack bonus and prayer bonus, the Zamorak kiteshield also looks visually similar. Its appearance differs in that the shield features an ornamental red trim.

The shield requires 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Zamorak monk bottom
title: Zamorak monk bottom
lead:
The Zamorak monk bottom is part of the Zamorak monk robes set. They are bright red, and like the related Zamorak monk top they are dropped by disciples of Iban and monks of Zamorak.

Zamorak monk robes are commonly used by mages in the Wilderness due to providing decent Prayer and Magic bonuses and being easy to replace if lost. They can also be used to telegrab Wine of Zamorak at the Chaos Temple (Asgarnia) without being attacked.

label: Zamorak monk top
title: Zamorak monk top
lead:
The Zamorak monk top is part of the Zamorak monk robes set. They are bright red, and like the related Zamorak monk bottom they are dropped by disciples of Iban, necromancers and monks of Zamorak.

Zamorak monk robes are commonly used by mages in the Wilderness due to providing decent Prayer and Magic bonuses and being easy to replace if lost. They can also be used to telegrab Wine of Zamorak at the Chaos Temple (Asgarnia) without being attacked.

label: Zamorak platebody
title: Zamorak platebody
lead:
The Zamorak platebody is a trimmed rune platebody fashioned to the colours of Zamorak. It has the same stats as a normal rune platebody, but provides protection from followers of Zamorak in the God Wars Dungeons as well as a +1 prayer bonus. It requires 40 Defence and the completion of the Dragon Slayer I quest to wear.

It can only be obtained as a reward from hard Treasure Trails, and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

label: Zamorak platelegs
title: Zamorak platelegs
lead:
Zamorak platelegs are a trimmed version of rune platelegs which are associated with the god Zamorak. Zamorak platelegs have the same stats as rune platelegs, apart from a Prayer bonus of 1. Like rune platelegs, these platelegs require 40 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

Players can obtain Zamorak platelegs as a reward from completing hard Treasure Trails. Wearing Zamorak platelegs in the God Wars Dungeon will cause followers of Zamorak to become unaggressive.

label: Zamorak staff
title: Zamorak staff
lead:
The Zamorak staff is a god staff aligned with Zamorak, obtainable after completing Mage Arena I miniquest by defeating Kolodion. Like the other God staves, this staff requires 60 Magic to acquire and wield.

After the miniquest, players pick a god to worship to receive a god cape and the god staff corresponding to that god. If a different god is chosen, the staff can be purchased from the chamber guardian for coins. This staff and corresponding runes are required to cast Flames of Zamorak from the standard spellbook.

label: Zamorak wizard
title: Zamorak wizard
lead:
Zamorak wizards are hostile followers of Zamorak that appear when doing hard clue coordinates in the Wilderness.

Upon appearing, they will call out , immediately attacking the player with the Flames of Zamorak spell. Unlike their Saradomin wizard counterparts, they attack exclusively with Magic, do not deal poison and all damage can be negated with Protect from Magic. They are also generally weaker, having low Hitpoints and low Defence (except against Magic).

label: Zamorakian Chapel
title: Zamorakian Chapel
lead:
The Zamorakian Chapel, referred to in-game as the evil temple, is a small temple found in the south-east part of Varrock. The temple is run by the Mage of Zamorak, a member of the ZMI who helps other Zamorakians in hiding. In addition to the chaos altar, there is also an altar slab found in the northern section of the temple.

The temple has no official name in-game, but is referred to as "evil temple" in dialogue with Elsie. The name "Zamorakian Chapel" comes from an update post on 15 June 2022.

label: Zanaris
title: Zanaris
lead:
Zanaris, also known as the Lost City, is the home of the fairies and is the moon of Gielinor. Accessed during the Lost City quest, the settlement is notable for bearing several amenities, such as a marketplace to buy a dragon longsword, and the highly useful fairy ring transportation system.

The entrance to Zanaris is located in the shed in Lumbridge Swamp.

label: Zanaris bank
title: Zanaris bank
lead:
The Zanaris bank is a bank in the fairy city of Zanaris, found in the north-west corner of the city. The Zanaris bank was released to members only alongside the bank in Catherby. There are no bank booths; instead, five chests and four bankers inhabit the area.

Interestingly, the two tiles to the east of the deposit box cannot be walked on; players who click on them will have their character take a step to the south immediately after.

label: Zanaris General Store
title: Zanaris General Store
lead:
The Zanaris General Store is run by the fairy shop keeper and her assistant, both denizens of Zanaris.

The fairy shop keeper sells the usual general store items, including Newcomer maps.

label: Zanaris windmill
title: Zanaris windmill
lead:
The Zanaris windmill is a windmill located in Zanaris, east of the bank. The windmill can be used to grind grain into flour. Unlike most wind-powered mills, the Zanaris mill is powered by a cow on an oversized hamster wheel. There is a wheat field located south-east of the windmill.

On the of the mill there is a flour bin into which all the milled flour is poured. On the there is the hopper into which grain is put and the hopper controls which control the flow of the grain from the hopper to the millstones. To mill flour, a player will need grain and an empty pot to collect the flour.

label: Zarosian Empire
title: Zarosian Empire
lead: The Zarosian Empire was a vast ancient empire that covered the territories of where Misthalin, Asgarnia, the Wilderness, and north-western Morytania now stand. Zaros founded the Empire expeditiously after his arrival on Gielinor. It was the predominant force during the Second Age and the beginning of the Third Age. The fall of the Empire was instigated when Zaros was betrayed by Zamorak, which banished Zaros from Gielinor. The God Wars ensued, in which the Empire was destroyed. Saradomin and Zamorak attempted to remove all traces of the Empire after its fall. Today, only its ruins remain as evidence of its existence. The Empire was ruled by the god Zaros himself, presumably from the capital city of Senntisten which was located east of Varrock where the Digsite can be found today. Recently, archaeological discoveries at the Digsite have ignited interest in Zarosian history and culture.

label: Zealot (music track)
title: Zealot (music track)
lead: Zealot is a music track that is unlocked at the Water Altar or Anglers' Retreat.

label: Zeke
title: Zeke
lead:
Zeke is the owner of Zeke's Superior Scimitars in Al Kharid. He sells scimitars up to mithril.

If asked about dragon scimitars, Zeke will say "A dragon scimitar? A DRAGON scimitar? No way, man! The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never dream of selling any to me. Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar." This is a reference to the Monkey Madness I quest which must be completed to wield a dragon scimitar, and in which the player pretends to be the uncle of a Monkey Child. If the player has completed the quest, they will respond with "Hmmm, funny you should say that...".

label: Zeke's Superior Scimitars.
title: Zeke's Superior Scimitars.
lead: Zeke's Superior Scimitars is located in Al Kharid, just north-east of the bank. It is run by Zeke, and sells scimitars up to mithril.

label: Zembo
title: Zembo
lead: Zembo runs a bar and Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers, on Musa Point in Karamja. He is involved in the Pirate's Treasure quest, where he sells the player a bottle of Karamjan rum, which they have to smuggle off the island to Port Sarim.

label: Zenesha
title: Zenesha
lead: Zenesha is a platebody seller who resides in East Ardougne. Additionally, she is one of the several NPCs that appear in the Ratcatchers quest as a guest in the mansion.

label: Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop.
title: Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop.
lead:
Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop is a shop owned by Zenesha in East Ardougne. As the name suggests, it sells types of platebodies. These platebodies range from bronze to mithril.

This shop can be found in a building on the south-west side of the East Ardougne market square.

label: Zodiac symbols
title: Zodiac symbols
lead: Zodiac symbols are used somewhat rarely as decorative ground‑scatter. They are primarily used in places where magical‑looking incantations are likely to occur, in areas of wizardry and necromancy.

label: zombie
title: zombie
lead:
Zombies are generic monsters found throughout Gielinor, often located in cemeteries, sewers, and dungeons. They count as undead NPCs and are weak to the effects of both the Salve amulet and the Crumble Undead spell.

Most common zombies are low-leveled, hence serving as a decent training method for low-level players. Many locations have distinct zombie [[#Variants|variants]] that have different combat levels, drops, and appearances.

label: Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)
title: Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)
lead: Zombies can be found in the Entrana Dungeon, near the entrance. While visually similar to generic zombies, the ones in the Entrana Dungeon are the only zombies with a combat level of 25, and have a unique drop table as well.

label: Zombie (Melzar's Maze)
title: Zombie (Melzar's Maze)
lead:
Two zombies can be found in the basement of Melzar's Maze. They must be killed in order to obtain the blue key, which can unlock the blue door to progress through the maze.

According to Melzar's notes, the zombies were created as a result of attempting to grow flesh on the skeletons of Crandorian refugees so their bodies could hold a spirit, but this failed as the flesh immediately decayed.

label: Zombie (Wilderness)
title: Zombie (Wilderness)
lead:
Zombies are monsters found in the Wilderness at the Graveyard of Shadows and the Eastern Ruins. They have combat levels of 18 and 24 and are aggressive to players.

Both level 18 and 24 zombies in the Wilderness share the same drop table.

label: Zombie rat
title: Zombie rat
lead:
A zombie rat is a monster only found in Melzar's Maze. It comes in two sizes, but both have the same stats. It is quite similar to the giant rat except with a few cuts, gashes, and a washed-out colour. The small zombie rat with a long tail is the only variant that will drop the red key. Players may choose to equip a salve amulet for a combat bonus against this creature.

According to Melzar's notes, zombie rats are the result of Melzar's first experiments with necromancy in his efforts to resurrect the dead Crandorians that were slain by Elvarg.

label: Zoo keeper
title: Zoo keeper
lead: Zoo keepers are employees who work at the Ardougne Zoo. They keep watch over the animals and clean up after them. Players can talk to a zoo keeper named Larry to start the Cold War quest and can also talk to a zoo keeper named Charlie to start the Eagles' Peak quest.
